prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个深色背景的电动汽车充电桩用户界面。屏幕顶部显示“CHARGING”字样和“正在进行超快充...”的提示，以及环境温度“24°C / 1013 hPa”和“ONLINE”状态。左侧面板显示“BATTERY LEVEL”为“85%”，并标明“MODE V-TO-L”，背景是一张灰度处理的现代化充电站图片，有两辆车正在充电。右侧面板详细列出了充电数据，包括“充电功率 125.4 kW”、“剩余时间 00:24 min”、“当前电流 350.0 A”和“实时电压 380.5 V”。下方是“TARGET LIMIT”为“90%”的设置，并配有从“50%”到“100%”的百分比刻度条。屏幕底部有三个功能按钮，从左到右依次是绿色背景的“预约管理”、深色背景的“充电记录”和红色背景的“停止充电”。
prompt_en: This image displays a dark-themed user interface for an electric vehicle charging station. The top of the screen shows "CHARGING" and the prompt "正在进行超快充..." (Ultra-fast charging in progress...), along with environmental data "24°C / 1013 hPa" and "ONLINE" status. The left panel indicates "BATTERY LEVEL" at "85%" and "MODE V-TO-L", set against a grayscale background image of a modern charging station with two cars charging. The right panel details charging data, including "充电功率 125.4 kW" (Charging Power 125.4 kW), "剩余时间 00:24 min" (Remaining Time 00:24 min), "当前电流 350.0 A" (Current: 350.0 A), and "实时电压 380.5 V" (Real-time Voltage 380.5 V). Below this, the "TARGET LIMIT" is set to "90%", accompanied by a percentage scale bar from "50%" to "100%". At the bottom of the screen, there are three functional buttons: "预约管理" (Appointment Management) with a green background on the left, "充电记录" (Charging Record) with a dark background in the center, and "停止充电" (Stop Charging) with a red background on the right.

prompt_en: This image is a comic-style promotional poster or comic book cover. At the center are two stylized male characters, appearing to be wrestlers or fighters. The character on the left wears a sombrero, a black jacket, and gloves, with the red text "CHALLENGER" above him. The character on the right wears a red horned mask, red shorts, and holds a championship belt, with the red text "CHAMPION" above him. A red, dripping "VS" separates the two characters. The background is predominantly orange and beige, adorned with skull and demon head illustrations on the top left and right, respectively. At the top of the image, "CULVER VILLALOBOS PROMOTIONS" and the main title "ROMERO MUERTE" are displayed in black text. A large red banner at the bottom features the black text "CHAPTER THREE: FIGHT!". The very bottom section contains creator information, presented in two columns separated by a stylized skull motif with a rose and heart, detailing names for "STORY BY", "WRITTEN BY", "ILLUSTRATED AND COLORED BY", and "ALSO FEATURING LETTERS BY". The overall visual style is strong, reminiscent of Lucha Libre aesthetics.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于企业社会责任的演示文稿页面或信息图表。图片背景为深蓝色渐变，顶部左侧是主标题“社会责任 IMPACT”和副标题“以科技之名，重塑人类与自然的和谐边界”，右侧有一个蓝色圆角矩形标签显示“2024 年度报告”。页面主体内容分为左右两栏。左栏上方是一幅覆盖着文字的绿色自然风景图片，文字内容包括标题“共生共荣: 我们的可持续愿景”及一段关于ESG核心业务的描述。左栏下方是两个并列的深蓝色圆角矩形卡片，分别介绍了“绿色供应链”和“科技普惠”的具体措施。右栏垂直堆叠着三个深蓝色圆角矩形卡片，分别展示了“碳中和进度”（85%）、“公益覆盖”（1.2 M+）和“社区共建”的具体数据和描述。所有文字均为白色，部分标题为粗体，整体布局清晰，旨在传达企业的可持续发展理念和成果。
prompt_en: This is a presentation slide or infographic detailing corporate social responsibility initiatives. The image features a dark blue gradient background. At the top left, the main title "社会责任 IMPACT" and subtitle "以科技之名，重塑人类与自然的和谐边界" are displayed. To the top right, a blue rounded rectangular tag reads "2024 年度报告". The main content area is divided into two columns. The left column features a large green natural landscape image overlaid with text, including the title "共生共荣: 我们的可持续愿景" and a paragraph describing the integration of ESG into core business. Below this, two side-by-side dark blue rounded rectangular cards detail "绿色供应链" (Green Supply Chain) and "科技普惠" (Tech Inclusion) measures. The right column contains three vertically stacked dark blue rounded rectangular cards, presenting data and descriptions for "碳中和进度" (Carbon Neutrality Progress, 85%), "公益覆盖" (Public Welfare Coverage, 1.2 M+), and "社区共建" (Community Co-building). All text is white, with some titles in bold, and the overall layout is clear, conveying the company's sustainable development philosophy and achievements.

The upper left corner features a corner of a Chinese architectural eaves with dark blue/cyan tiles, below which hangs a black Chinese lantern. A light gray wall is positioned slightly to the left of the center, and a dark branch with white blossoms extends from the lower left to the middle of the image. The background is mostly white. Below the billboard, a wooden boat carries several people through the flooded street, with the Chinese text "真相如舟渡人" (Truth is like a boat carrying people across) written on its side. On the left, a blue sign attached to a street light pole reads "警示: 辨别信息, 寻求真相" (Warning: Discern information, Seek truth). Several newspapers are scattered on the street in the foreground, with "FAKE NEWS" clearly visible on one in the bottom right corner. Tall city buildings form the background. The overall color palette is cool, dominated by grays, blues, and browns, with the red heart on the billboard being the only bright color in the scene.

In the upper left corner of the image, there are Chinese texts "图标设计" (Icon Design) and below it, "图标规范" (Icon Specification). In the upper-middle part of the image is a grid of 12 circular icons. These icons have two background colors, purple and light gray, with the icon content being either orange or purple. In the lower-left corner, a man wearing glasses sits on a light purple chair, using a laptop at a beige desk. In the lower-right corner, another bearded man sits on an orange cushion, using a smartphone. Between the two figures, at the bottom center of the image, is a potted plant with an orange pot and leaves in dark blue, yellow, and pink. The text content and the icon collection in the image together form the theme.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色照片，展现了中国传统水乡古镇中一场热闹的鲤鱼节庆典场景。画面中央，一座木质牌坊横跨街道，其上方牌匾上书写着“鲤鱼节祈福法会”七个深色汉字。牌坊下方及街道两旁聚集着众多身着传统服饰或日常服装的民众，他们围绕着一个巨大的金色鲤鱼形装饰物。街道上空飘洒着五彩纸屑，两旁挂满了红灯笼。前景左右两侧各有一张木桌，桌旁有人正用毛笔在卷轴上书写，其中右侧卷轴上写着“鲤跃龙门”。左侧有两人举着一幅绘有黑色鲤鱼的白色布幡，右侧另有两人举着一幅绘有红色鲤鱼的白色布幡。左侧建筑墙壁上可见“鲤鱼堂”的牌匾。背景中，河流蜿蜒，两岸是古朴的传统建筑，远方可见连绵的山峦轮廓。
prompt_en: This is a color photograph depicting a lively carp festival celebration scene in a traditional waterside ancient town in China. In the center of the frame, a wooden archway spans the street, with a plaque above it displaying seven dark Chinese characters: "鲤鱼节祈福法会" (Fa Li Yu Jie De Hua Fa). Below the archway and along both sides of the street, a large crowd of people, some in traditional attire and others in casual clothes, gather around a giant golden carp-shaped decoration. Colorful confetti sprinkles from above, and red lanterns hang along the street and on the archway. In the foreground, on both the left and right sides, there are wooden tables where individuals are writing on scrolls with brushes; the right scroll bears the calligraphy "鲤跃龙门" (Carp Leaping over the Dragon Gate). On the left, two people hold a white banner painted with a black carp, while on the right, another two people hold a white banner painted with a red carp. A plaque with "磐鲤堂" (Pan Li Tang) is visible on the wall of the building on the left. In the background, a river winds through, flanked by quaint traditional buildings, and distant mountains are visible on the horizon.

prompt_en: This is a promotional poster with a red background, adorned with dark red auspicious cloud or scroll patterns. In the center of the poster, a partially unrolled bamboo slip is displayed, with its right side rolled up. Ten vertically arranged brown texts are carved on the bamboo slip, all starting with "坚持" (Persist in), listed from right to left, from "坚持加强国家安全干部队伍建设" (Persist in strengthening the national security cadre team building) to "坚持党对国家安全工作的绝对领导" (Persist in the Party's absolute leadership over national security work). In the upper left corner of the poster, there is text "搜狐号@盘锦网信", below which are a golden "415" and a white "全民国家安全教育" (National Security Education for All) label. The main title "坚定不移贯彻 总体国家安全观" (Unwaveringly implement the holistic national security concept) in white and gold is at the top center, with the white subtitle "第十一个全民国家安全教育日" (The 11th National Security Education Day for All) below it. At the bottom center of the poster, there is a white graphic, with the white text "国安宣工作室" (National Security Publicity Office) below it.

现代桥梁的 4 种核心力学构型与跨度极限
FOUR CORE STRUCTURAL CONFIGURATIONS AND SPAN LIMITS OF MODERN BRIDGES
II. 拱桥 COMPRESSION
LUPU BRIDGE (570m)
I. 梁桥 BENDING
LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN (300m)
径向力学轨道系统
RADIAL MECHANICS ORBIT
III. 斜拉桥 TENSION + COMP.
RUSSKY ISLAND (1176m)
IV. 悬索桥 PURE TENSION
1915 ÇANAKKALE (2023m)
几何演进与力学传导 / FORCE EVOLUTION
现代桥梁构型的演进不仅是材料科学的突破，更是力学几何分布的极致优化。从弯曲内力向纯拉压应力的转化，使人类跨越千米天堑成为可能。轨道环线示意结构力学的封闭循环。
BEAM / 梁
弯矩 Bending
ARCH / 拱
压力 Comp.
CABLE / 斜拉
拉压 T+C
SUSP. / 悬索
拉力 Tension
力学传导路径 / TRANSMISSION PATHS
• 梁桥：荷载 → 梁体弯矩 → 桥墩轴向受压
• 拱桥：荷载 → 拱轴线压力 → 拱座斜向推力
• 斜拉桥：荷载 → 索具拉力 → 塔柱轴向受压
• 悬索桥：荷载 → 吊索受拉 → 主缆受拉 → 锚碇重力平衡
工程实例与跨度极限 / SPECIFICATIONS
构型 / TYPE | 受力 / FORCE | 代表案例 / CASE | 跨度 / SPAN | 锚固 / BASE
梁桥 / Beam | 弯矩主导 | 庞恰特雷恩湖桥 | 300m | 直接承压
拱桥 / Arch | 轴向受压 | 卢浦大桥 / Lupu | 570m | 拱座承载
斜拉桥 / Cable | 拉压组合 | 俄罗斯岛大桥 | 1176m | 塔底固结
悬索桥 / Susp. | 主缆受拉 | 1915恰纳卡莱 | 2023m | 重力锚碇
设计规范与测试基准 / METRIC SPECIFICATION
极限跨度指主跨长度。受力状态指恒载与活载共同作用下的截面主应力分布。红色线代表拉应力传递，蓝色线代表压应力传递。
注：本图所载极限跨度指截至2024年已建成的最大公认主跨长度。力学路径为简化示意。

prompt_en: This is a promotional poster themed around the traditional Chinese festival "Po Wu Jie" (the Fifth Day of the Lunar New Year). The main part of the image is a cartoon-style illustration depicting the God of Wealth, two adults, and two children celebrating. They are dressed in red traditional attire and smiling. The illustration also includes Spring Festival elements such as red lanterns, gold ingots (yuanbao), and an incense burner, all framed within a white circular area in the lower-middle of the image. The background is dark red, with numerous light-colored, repeating "福" (fu, meaning good fortune) characters as a pattern. The upper left corner displays the English date "Lunar January 5th," while the upper right corner features large Chinese characters "初五" (Chu Wu, meaning the fifth day). On the left side, there is descriptive text about the customs of "Po Wu Jie." On the right side, there are vertically arranged golden characters "门 财神来到我家" (Men Cai Shen Lai Dao Wo Jia, meaning "God of Wealth comes to my home"). A QR code is located in the bottom left corner, and the company name and contact information are at the bottom center. The overall color scheme is predominantly red, gold, and white, creating a festive visual effect.

Potted plants and several casual tables and chairs are placed below the wall. A billiard table is situated in the central area, with industrial-style lighting fixtures suspended above it. The floor is covered with gray square tiles, and multiple spotlights and pendant lights are installed on the ceiling, collectively creating a stylish and comfortable leisure atmosphere.

prompt_en: This is a cartoon-style illustration for a life guide. The image features a beige textured background. At the top is the title "熬完大夜别摆烂" (Don't give up after an all-nighter), with "熬完大夜" in black and "别摆烂" in blue. Below it is the subtitle "(6件小事把身体拉回来)" (6 small things to get your body back on track), enclosed in yellow parentheses. In the center of the image is a tired-looking cartoon character with dark circles under its eyes, wearing a green top, and with a blue shadow on the right side of its head. Behind the character is a dark blue night sky with a yellow crescent moon and stars. Below the character is a two-row, three-column list of text items, each preceded by a blue checkmark icon. The list items include "补水" (Hydrate), "早餐" (Breakfast), "咖啡" (Coffee), "午餐" (Lunch), "小睡" (Nap), and "早睡" (Sleep early).

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface with a dark purple to blue gradient background. The top status bar displays "P 12,850" and "85/100", accompanied by a coin icon and a lightning bolt icon, respectively. In the upper center of the page is the title "消息中心" (Message Center), with a small yellow dot next to it. Below the title, there is text stating "你有 3 条新的答疑反馈待查收" (You have 3 new Q&A feedback messages to check). The main content area displays multiple messages in a card-like layout. The first card is a Q&A feedback, featuring a circular user avatar on the left, with the title "王老师已回答" (Teacher Wang has replied) on the right. Below it is the question "关于《二次函数最值问题》" (Regarding "Quadratic Function Extremum Problems"), followed by a quoted text: "'同学你好，这道题的关键在于先确定对称轴的位置…'" (Hello student, the key to this problem is to first determine the position of the axis of symmetry...). A red "NEW!" tag is in the top right corner of the card. At the bottom, there is an orange gradient button with the text "立即进入教室" (Enter Classroom Immediately). The second card is a "每日答疑达人" (Daily Q&A Expert) task, with text on the left saying "完成 5 次提问可获得勋章" (Complete 5 questions to earn a badge), and on the right, it shows the progress "3/5" with a progress bar. The third card is a "系统通知" (System Notification), with a speaker icon on the left, and the content reads "你的提问‘如何理解量子纠缠’获得了 15 个赞！" (Your question "How to understand quantum entanglement" received 15 likes!). The fourth card is "奖励发放" (Reward Distribution), with a gift box icon on the left, and the content reads "连续 7 天提问奖励：1000 经验值已到账" (7-day consecutive questioning reward: 1000 experience points credited). At the bottom is a fixed navigation bar, containing five icons and text labels: "首页" (Home), "题库" (Question Bank), "快速提问" (Quick Questioning, represented by a blue circular plus button in the center), "消息" (Messages, with a red notification dot), and "我的" (My Profile). The interface adopts a dark theme overall, with text primarily in white and light gray, and some elements accented with bright colors like orange, yellow, and blue.

prompt_en: This is an electronic invitation card with a white background and a rounded-corner border featuring pink, purple, and blue gradient effects. At the top center, "INVITATION" in English and "百日礼赞" (Hundred-Day Celebration) in Chinese serve as titles. A black and white photograph is embedded in the center of the image, showing a sleeping baby wrapped in soft clothing, surrounded by decorations. Below the photo, the main invitation text reads "初见惊喜，满心欢喜" (First sight, full of joy) and "诚邀您共同见证宝贝‘沐沐’的百日之礼" (Sincerely invite you to witness baby 'Mumu''s hundred-day ceremony), with "沐沐" (Mumu) in blue bold text. Following this are the event details: "时间 | TIME 2024年12月28日 12:00" (Time | TIME December 28, 2024 12:00) and "地点 | VENUE 悦格庄酒店·3楼 禧悦厅" (Location | VENUE Yuege Zhuang Hotel · 3rd Floor Xiyue Hall), where "时间 | TIME" and "地点 | VENUE" are in light gray. At the bottom of the invitation, "— 席设候光临 —" (Awaiting your presence) is written in pink text, and "家长: 林先生 & 苏女士 敬邀" (Parents: Mr. Lin & Ms. Su cordially invite) is in dark gray text. All text content is centrally aligned.

text:
谢帖
在先家严丧礼期间，承蒙各位亲朋好友不辞辛劳，亲临吊唁，惠赐赙仪，或以花圈、电唁等方式寄托哀思。
这份深情厚谊，令我们全家在悲痛之中倍感温暖与慰藉。感恩之情，铭记于心，难以言表。
在此，谨代表全家向各位致以最诚挚的谢意。愿大家平安顺遂，福寿康宁。
公元二〇二四年 仲秋
孝眷 叩谢

Behind and to the sides of the main figures, dense silhouettes of people stand on the sand dunes. A textured blue planet or moon is visible in the mid-right of the image. At the top of the poster are two lines of white, uppercase English title text, "A WORLD BEYOND YOUR EXPERIENCE, BEYOND YOUR IMAGINATION.", centrally aligned. Below the title, on the right side, is a block of white English body text describing the film's premise. The extra-large white English movie title "DUNE" is at the bottom center. The very bottom contains multiple lines of small white text for cast and crew credits, production information, and copyright statements, arranged in two columns.

text:
[manual no. 04 — mechanical cycles]
The Four-Stroke Cycle
[thermodynamics of the internal combustion engine]
A reliable prime mover for survival machinery. This page details the mechanical and thermodynamic events governing the four-stroke gasoline engine (Otto cycle), translating combustive force into rotational torque.
Mechanical Phase Sequences
I. Intake
[piston] downward
[intake] open
[exhaust] closed
The piston moves downward, expanding chamber volume. A vacuum pulls the fuel-air charge into the cylinder.
II. Compression
[piston] upward
[intake] closed
[exhaust] closed
Valves seal hermetically. The piston ascends, compressing the charge to ~10:1 ratio, raising thermal pressure.
III. Power
[piston] downward
[temp.max] ~2000°C
[event] spark ignition
A timed spark ignites the gas. The rapid chemical expansion drives the piston down, delivering kinetic force.
IV. Exhaust
[piston] upward
[intake] closed
[exhaust] open
The exhaust valve opens. The piston returns upward, sweeping burnt, toxic waste gases out of the open port.
[warning: stoichiometric limits & detonation]
Detonation & Fuel Tuning
Operating field machinery requires strict fuel calibration. Detonation occurs when fuel auto-ignites prematurely due to excessive cylinder heat or low octane. Always maintain correct air-fuel ratios (AFR) to prevent piston crown degradation.
Fuel Type Compression Range Optimal AFR Auto-Ignition
Low-grade Petrol 8.0:1 – 9.5:1 14.7:1 ~280°C
High-grade Petrol 9.5:1 – 11.5:1 14.7:1 ~310°C
Ethanol / Spirits 10.0:1 – 12.5:1 9.0:1 ~365°C

prompt_en: This is an English technical document page detailing the four-stroke cycle of an internal combustion engine and fuel tuning. The page features a clean, single-column layout with all text in black against a white background. At the top, there is a document number "[manual no. 04 — mechanical cycles]" and the main title "The Four-Stroke Cycle," followed by a subtitle on the thermodynamics of the internal combustion engine. The main text elaborates on the mechanical and thermodynamic events governing the four-stroke gasoline engine (Otto cycle). The page is divided into two main sections: "Mechanical Phase Sequences" and "Detonation & Fuel Tuning." The former explains the engine's operating principles through four phases (Intake, Compression, Power, Exhaust), each with a title, bulleted list items (such as piston direction, valve status, temperature, and events), and a detailed description. The latter discusses detonation and fuel tuning, including an explanatory paragraph and a table that lists the compression range, optimal air-fuel ratio, and auto-ignition temperature for different fuel types (Low-grade Petrol, High-grade Petrol, Ethanol / Spirits).

Below the title, four illustrated square panels are arranged in a 2x2 grid, each secured by red thumbtacks. Each square panel features a colorful illustration on the left and a vertically arranged black text label on the right. The top-left illustration depicts a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a reflective vest, with the text label '正确防护' (Correct Protection). The top-right illustration shows a doctor examining a worker in a yellow hard hat, with the text label '定期检查' (Regular Check-ups). The bottom-left illustration portrays an instructor in a yellow hard hat conducting safety training for three students, also in yellow hard hats, in front of a whiteboard that reads '安全教训' (Safety Lessons), and the panel's text label is '安全教育' (Safety Education). The bottom-right illustration shows a tidy office or workstation area with a computer, files, and a plant, accompanied by the text label '改善环境' (Improve Environment). The overall color scheme is bright, predominantly featuring brown, white, yellow, blue, and red.

text:
伊顿 12 色相环与 5 种色彩和谐关系
色彩体系 [Color System] 由包豪斯教师约翰内斯·伊顿 (Johannes Itten) 于 1961 年完善。该系统建立在红、黄、蓝三原色基础之上，通过逻辑混合构建出具有数学精确度的十二色循环。此模型旨在揭示色彩间的结构性联系，成为现代平面设计与视觉艺术教育的基石。
原色 (Primary) 01. 红、02. 黄、03. 蓝。这些颜色无法由其他色彩混合而成，位于色相环的最核心位置。
二次色 (Secondary) 两种原色等量混合，包括：橙 (红+黄)、绿 (黄+蓝)、紫 (红+蓝)。
三次色 (Tertiary) 原色与相邻二次色混合，如红橙、黄橙、黄绿、蓝绿、蓝紫、红紫。
12
色相环
色彩和谐 (Harmonies)
1. 互补色: 色环上相对 180° 的颜色，产生最强烈的视觉对比。
2. 相邻色: 相邻 30-60° 范围内的三至五色，视觉感官和谐。
3. 分离互补: 主色与互补色两侧的等色组合，减缓了直接互补的生硬感。
4. 三色和谐: 等边三角形分布，色彩均衡且丰富。
5. 同色和谐: 矩形分布，包含两组互补色，适合复杂构图。

prompt_en: This is an educational infographic about Itten's 12-color wheel and color harmony relationships. The top of the image features the title "伊顿 12 色相环与 5 种色彩和谐关系" (Itten's 12-Color Wheel and 5 Color Harmony Relationships). The main content area is divided into two columns. The left column details the composition of the color system, including primary, secondary, and tertiary colors, accompanied by a triangular diagram illustrating the geometric derivation of the red, yellow, and blue primary colors. The right column explains five types of color harmony relationships, such as complementary and analogous colors, with three small diagrams showing diagonal, analogous, and triangular relationships. Centrally, there is a 12-segment color wheel labeled "12" and "色相环" (Color Wheel), below which is a table listing color numbers, names, composition, and complementary pairs. The bottom left of the image contains a note about color mixing ratios, while the bottom right features a quote from Johannes Itten and footer information.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于瑜伽拜日式的信息图表，背景为浅米色。页面顶部中央是中文标题“瑜伽拜日式”，下方是英文副标题“SURYA NAMASKAR / 12 VINYASA CYCLE”。标题上方左右两侧各有一个红黑相间的抽象装饰图案。标题下方左侧是一段介绍性文字，解释了拜日式是哈他瑜伽的基石序列及其能量循环原理。页面主体内容分为左右两部分。左侧是一个三列表格，详细列出了12个瑜伽体式及其对应的梵文名称和呼吸指示。表格的列标题分别为“#”、“体式 / Sanskrit”和“呼吸 / Breath”。表格中每个体式的呼吸指示（如“呼气 Exhale”、“吸气 Inhale”、“屏息 Retain”）均以红色字体显示。页面右侧是一个圆形图表，中心有一个简化的太阳图案，周围按顺时针方向均匀分布着12个红色数字（1至12）。圆形图表下方是三条图例，每条前面有一个红色方块标记，分别解释了“吸气 (Inhale)”、“呼气 (Exhale)”和“屏息 (Retain)”的身体状态。页面底部是页脚信息，包含“PLATE NO.”、“SEQUENCE”、“CALIBRATION”和“SOURCE DOC”及其对应的值。图片中大部分文字为深灰色，部分关键信息如呼吸指示和圆形图表数字为红色。
prompt_en: This image is an infographic about Yoga Surya Namaskar, set against a light beige background. At the top center of the page is the Chinese title "瑜伽拜日式" (Yoga Sun Salutation), with the English subtitle "SURYA NAMASKAR / 12 VINYASA CYCLE" below it. Above the title, on both the left and right sides, are small, abstract decorative patterns in red and black. Below the title, on the left, is an introductory text explaining that Sun Salutation is a foundational sequence in Hatha Yoga and its energy circulation principles. The main content of the page is divided into two sections. The left side features a three-column table detailing 12 yoga poses with their Sanskrit names and corresponding breath instructions. The table column headers are "#", "体式 / Sanskrit" (Pose / Sanskrit), and "呼吸 / Breath" (Breath / Breath). The breath instructions for each pose in the table (e.g., "呼气 Exhale", "吸气 Inhale", "屏息 Retain") are displayed in red text. On the right side of the page is a circular diagram with a simplified sun icon at its center, surrounded by 12 red numbers (1 to 12) arranged clockwise. Below the circular diagram are three legends, each preceded by a red square marker, explaining the physical states associated with "吸气 (Inhale)" (Inhale), "呼气 (Exhale)" (Exhale), and "屏息 (Retain)" (Retain). The bottom of the page contains footer information, including "PLATE NO.", "SEQUENCE", "CALIBRATION", and "SOURCE DOC" with their respective values. Most text in the image is dark gray, while some key information, such as breath instructions and the numbers in the circular diagram, is red.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a fitness application user interface. The interface has a dark blue background, with the application name "IRON PROTOCOL V2.4" and the current time "10:45 AM" displayed at the top. Below that is the training plan title "力量增肌训练计划" (Strength and Muscle Gain Training Plan), followed by the phase information "阶段：胸部与肱三头肌强化 (Day 12)" (Phase: Chest and Triceps Strengthening (Day 12)). In the center of the interface is a video player showing a man performing a barbell bench press. A blue label "当前动作" (Current Exercise) is at the bottom left of the video, and "杠铃平板卧推" (Barbell Flat Bench Press) is displayed below the video. Below the video is a data card, with "当前组数 SET 03 / 05" (Current Set SET 03 / 05) on the left and "目标重量 85.0 KG" (Target Weight 85.0 KG) on the right. The center of the card shows a large white number "10", with gray text "/ 12次" (/ 12 reps) to its right, indicating completed repetitions. At the bottom are two side-by-side cards; the left one shows a "组间休息" (Rest Between Sets) timer "01:24", and the right one shows the "下一项" (Next Exercise) details "上斜哑铃飞鸟 4组 x 15次" (Incline Dumbbell Fly 4 sets x 15 reps). At the very bottom of the interface are two action buttons: "减少次数" (Decrease Reps) on the left, and a blue-background button "完成本组" (Complete Set) on the right.

text:
A COMPREHENSIVE ARCHITECTURAL ATLAS
MODERN BRIDGES
concerning the
FIVE STRUCTURAL SYSTEMS
being a survey of
MECHANICAL FORCES, TENSION, & COMPRESSION IN CIVIL ENGINEERING
Gravity Load
BEAM BRIDGE
ARCH BRIDGE
SUSPENSION
CABLE-STAYED
TRUSS BRIDGE
Figure 1. Geometric schematics of structural types and primary force resolution paths.
SIMPLE STRUCTURES
THE LONG SPANS
COMPARATIVE DATA
The Beam Bridge is the most ancient form, relying on the vertical resistance of piers. Its strength is limited by the bending capacity of the span; as length increases, the material must thicken to prevent catastrophic snapping. Most modern beam structures utilize prestressed concrete for spans under 300 meters.
The Arch Bridge converts the downward weight of the deck into axial compression. This “thrust” travels along the curve of the arch into solid abutments at either end. These structures are ideal for deep valleys where the rock walls can naturally absorb the massive horizontal forces generated.
Arch Internal Compression
Suspension Bridges utilize high-tensile steel cables to cover vast distances. The main cables are draped over massive towers and anchored deep into the earth. The deck “hangs” from vertical suspender ropes, ensuring that the primary force experienced by the main cable is pure tension.
The Cable-Stayed Bridge features a distinct silhouette where cables run directly from the tower to the deck. Unlike suspension systems, the cables are straight and taut. This design is highly efficient for medium-to-long spans (500–1100m) and offers greater rigidity against aerodynamic forces than the suspension type.
Truss Bridges employ a series of triangles to distribute stress. Triangles are mechanically stable; they cannot be deformed without changing the length of a side, making them exceptionally rigid for heavy railway loads.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于古罗马军团编制的信息图表。图片背景为深蓝色，主要文字和图表元素使用白色、橙色、黄色、浅蓝色和青色。页面布局清晰，分为多个区域。顶部左侧是主标题“古罗马 军团编制”及其简介，右侧是橙色大字“5320”和三组白色数字统计，分别表示“重装步兵(INFANTRY) 5,200”、“附属骑兵(CAVALRY) 120”和“战术大队(COHORTS) 10”，由青色竖线分隔。中部左侧是“单位层级轨道图”，通过同心圆和连接线展示了从“LEGIO (军团)”到“CONTUBERNIUM (8人小组)”的层级结构，并配有详细说明。中部右侧是“核心逻辑:最小单元”的文字描述和“后勤数据 100% 模块化”的标签。底部左侧是“核心单兵装备”表格，列出了“装备名称”和“规格/描述”，如“方形长盾(Scutum)”和“木质覆皮,高1m”，下方有橙色脚注。底部中央是“著名战术阵型:龟甲阵”的示意图，由24个橙色边框、黄色圆点的方块排列成矩形，上方有一条浅蓝色曲线表示“防御性抛物线:弹开投射物”。底部右侧是“TACTIC”标题及其对龟甲阵的文字解释。图片底部页脚处有青色文字“ROMAN MILITARY SCHEMATIC // PLATE NO. 14”和“帝国扩张与军事工程学研究 // 1958年版”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the organization of the ancient Roman legion. The image features a dark blue background with text and graphic elements primarily in white, orange, yellow, light blue, and cyan. The page layout is clear, divided into multiple sections. The top left presents the main title "古罗马 军团编制" (Ancient Roman Legion Organization) and its introduction. To the top right, a large orange number "5320" is displayed, alongside three sets of white numerical statistics: "重装步兵(INFANTRY) 5,200" (Heavy Infantry), "附属骑兵(CAVALRY) 120" (Auxiliary Cavalry), and "战术大队(COHORTS) 10" (Tactical Cohorts), separated by cyan vertical lines. The mid-left section features a "单位层级轨道图 / UNIT HIERARCHY" (Unit Hierarchy Orbital Diagram), illustrating the hierarchical structure from "LEGIO (军团)" (Legion) to "CONTUBERNIUM (8人小组)" (8-man squad) using concentric circles and connecting lines, accompanied by detailed explanations. The mid-right section contains a text description of "核心逻辑:最小单元" (Core Logic: Smallest Unit) and a "后勤数据 100% 模块化" (Logistics Data 100% Modular) label. The bottom left shows a "核心单兵装备 / EQUIPMENT" (Core Individual Equipment) table, listing "装备名称" (Equipment Name) and "规格/描述" (Specifications/Description), such as "方形长盾(Scutum)" (Rectangular Shield) and "木质覆皮,高1m" (Wood-covered, 1m high), with an orange footnote below. The bottom center displays a diagram of the "著名战术阵型:龟甲阵 / TESTUDO FORMATION" (Famous Tactical Formation: Testudo Formation), composed of 24 orange-bordered squares with yellow dots arranged in a rectangle, with a light blue curve above representing "防御性抛物线:弹开投射物" (Defensive Parabola: Deflecting Projectiles). The bottom right has the "TACTIC" title and its textual explanation of the Testudo formation. The footer at the bottom of the image shows cyan text: "ROMAN MILITARY SCHEMATIC // PLATE NO. 14" and "帝国扩张与军事工程学研究 // 1958年版" (Imperial Expansion and Military Engineering Research // 1958 Edition).

prompt_cn: 这是一张以橙色为主色调的招聘海报。海报顶部左侧是“Canva”品牌标识，右侧有一个黄色横幅，内有“即刻入职”字样。海报中央是主要招聘信息，包括“加入我们 JOIN US”和“寻找不凡的你”等白色粗体大字标题，上方还有“乘风破浪·未来可期”的标语。海报中部描绘了一个身穿蓝色西装的3D卡通男性角色，其左右两侧分别列出了“五险一金”、“周末双休”、“期权分红”以及“免费旅游”、“带薪休假”、“生日福利”等福利待遇。海报下半部分是一个白色矩形区域，详细列出了“新媒体运营”和“开发工程师”两个职位，每个职位下方都有英文名称（“NEW MEDIA OPERATIONS”）和三点具体职责描述。海报底部左侧有一个二维码，旁边是“扫码投递简历”的提示，以及邮箱和地址联系方式。底部右侧则显示了一个大号的电话号码“001-12345678”。海报中还散布着小行星、星星和箭头等装饰性图形元素。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster predominantly in orange. At the top left, there is the "Canva" brand logo, and on the right, a yellow banner with the text "即刻入职" (Immediate Onboarding). The central part of the poster displays the main recruitment information, including large white bold titles like "加入我们 JOIN US" (Join Us JOIN US) and "寻找不凡的你" (Seeking the Extraordinary You), with the slogan "乘风破浪·未来可期" (Ride the Wind and Break the Waves, Future is Promising) above them. The middle section features a 3D cartoon male character in a blue suit, flanked by two lists of benefits: "五险一金" (Five Insurances and One Fund), "周末双休" (Weekends Off), "期权分红" (Stock Option Dividends) on the left, and "免费旅游" (Free Travel), "带薪休假" (Paid Leave), "生日福利" (Birthday Benefits) on the right. The lower half of the poster is a white rectangular area detailing two job positions: "新媒体运营" (New Media Operations) and "开发工程师" (Development Engineer). Each position has an English title ("NEW MEDIA OPERATIONS") below it, followed by three bullet points describing specific responsibilities. At the bottom left, there is a QR code with the prompt "扫码投递简历" (Scan to Submit Resume), along with email and address contact information. The bottom right displays a large phone number "001-12345678". The poster also includes decorative graphic elements such as small planets, stars, and arrows.

prompt_cn:
这张图片是一份DIY手工制作指南，展示了如何制作羊年新春台历。背景是木质桌面，散落着彩色纸屑、胶棒和铅笔屑，营造出手工制作的氛围。图片整体色调明亮，以红、绿、黄、蓝等鲜艳色彩为主。页面布局清晰，分为顶部标题区、左侧材料清单区、中央成品展示区、底部提示信息区和右侧分步教学区。
顶部标题为“羊年新春台历制作指南 (四年级适用版)”。左侧有一个可爱的卡通羊角色，旁边是对话气泡，写着“好好好，你们是一个羊年新春台历制作指南，让点赞的翻好礼吧！”。卡通羊下方是“小艺”的标签，以及“材料准备”的标题，下方列出了两列图文并茂的材料清单，包括A4卡片纸、剪刀、尺子、红丝带、马克笔、金属打孔器和铆钉。
图片中央展示了一个红色边框的日历页面，上面有“正月初一”、“(2027.2.7)”和“羊年大吉”等文字，并配有卡通羊图案，下方写着“祝爷爷奶奶笑口常开，福寿安康！”。右侧是四个编号的步骤图，每个步骤图下方配有文字说明，详细展示了台历的制作过程，包括折叠卡纸、设计页面、打孔缀链和完成台历。底部有一个虚线边框的“小艺贴心提示”区域，包含三条文字提示，分别是“打印印刷：在打印前，请将制作手册的桂印。”、“日记：在制作完成后，请打印笔记。”和“照片分享：拍照，共享给朋友、照片分享享受。”
prompt_en:
This image is a DIY craft guide, demonstrating how to make a New Year calendar for the Year of the Sheep. The background is a wooden desk scattered with colorful paper scraps, glue sticks, and pencil shavings, creating a crafting atmosphere. The overall color scheme is bright, predominantly featuring vibrant reds, greens, yellows, and blues. The page layout is clear, divided into a top title area, a left-side materials list area, a central finished product display area, a bottom tip information area, and a right-side step-by-step instruction area.
The top title reads "羊年新春台历制作指南 (四年级适用版)" (New Year Calendar Making Guide for the Year of the Sheep (Fourth Grade Edition)). On the left, there is a cute cartoon sheep character with a speech bubble next to it, saying "好好好，你们是一个羊年新春台历制作指南，让点赞的翻好礼吧！" (Alright, you are a New Year calendar making guide for the Year of the Sheep, let those who like it get a good gift!). Below the cartoon sheep is the label "小艺" (Xiao Yi), and a "材料准备" (Materials Preparation) title, followed by a two-column illustrated list of materials, including A4 cardstock, scissors, ruler, red ribbon, markers, metal hole punch, and rivets.
The center of the image displays a calendar page with a red border, featuring text such as "正月初一" (First Day of the First Lunar Month), "(2027.2.7)", and "羊年大吉" (Good Luck in the Year of the Sheep), along with a cartoon sheep illustration. Below this, it reads "祝爷爷奶奶笑口常开，福寿安康！" (Wishing grandparents always smiling, healthy and peaceful!). On the right are four numbered step-by-step diagrams, each with text descriptions below, detailing the calendar making process, including folding cardstock, designing the page, punching holes and threading ribbons, and completing the calendar. At the bottom, there is a "小艺贴心提示" (Xiao Yi's Warm Tips) area with a dashed border, containing three text tips: "打印印刷：在打印前，请将制作手册的桂印。" (Printing: Before printing, please refer to the '桂印' of the manual.), "日记：在制作完成后，请打印笔记。" (Diary: After completion, please print notes.), and "照片分享：拍照，共享给朋友、照片分享享受。" (Photo Sharing: Take photos, share with friends, enjoy photo sharing.).

The middle-left section displays a simplified map, using orange, red, purple, and blue lines to indicate various trade routes, with colored dots marking city nodes like "Chang'an," "Dunhuang," and "Kashgar," each with a code, Chinese name, and English name. To the right of the map is an information box detailing key statistics such as "TOTAL DISTANCE," "AVG ALTITUDE," "TERRAIN" (e.g., Hexi Corridor, Taklamakan, Pamir Plateau), and "TRAVEL CYCLE" (180-240 DAYS). The bottom section of the chart features two detailed tables: "输出货物 / EXPORTS" on the left and "输入货物 / IMPORTS" on the right, listing goods like silk, porcelain, Ferghana horses, and spices with their Chinese and English names and brief descriptions. In the bottom center, a legend explains the different route types represented by the colored lines, such as "Hexi Main Line" and "Northern Route." A footnote at the very bottom provides context on the establishment of the Silk Road, the basis for the chart's depiction, and the node coding standards.

这张图片展示了四个并排悬挂在木质框架中的垂直矩形海报，背景是浅灰色墙壁，上方有三个嵌入式射灯。
最左侧的海报以深蓝色为背景，展示了一碗盛满海鲜（包括刺身、海胆和虾）的黑色碗，上方有日文“海の宝石箱、どうぞ。”和中文“每日直送，鲜甜满溢”的标语。下方是“特上海鲜丼”及其价格“2,500 日元”，底部是品牌名“海鲜界”和店铺地址及营业时间“千禧市场店 铜锣湾恩平道524号 千禧一期M层 10:00~10:30”。
左起第二张海报以书架为背景，一位穿着西装的男士站在画面中央。海报顶部是英文“ELEGANCE”和中文“绅士格调”，右侧垂直排列着“从容有度”。底部显示“2024秋季定制系列”、“11月1日发布”以及一个橙色背景的“预约试穿 >”按钮。
右起第二张海报描绘了一个家庭在迪士尼城堡前自拍，背景有烟花。顶部是“梦与魔法的王国”、“东京迪士尼”和“全家共享欢乐时光”。中部有橙色背景的“秋季特别优惠，截止至10月31日 (周五)”促销信息。底部有“乐园门票”、“度假酒店”、“快速通行”三个蓝色按钮，以及一个橙色背景的“立即购票 >”按钮。
最右侧的海报以白色为主，展示了一台笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示云存储界面。顶部是“CloudBox”品牌标识和日文“データを自由に、安全に。”，下方是中文“企业级云存储服务”。中部有橙色背景的“超过10,000个团队使用”宣传语。底部是“文件同步”、“版本历史”、“团队共享”三个功能标签，一个蓝色背景的“免费获取2TB >”按钮，以及网址“www.cloudbox.jp”。
prompt_en:
This image displays four vertical rectangular posters hung side-by-side within a wooden frame, set against a light gray wall with three recessed spotlights above.
The leftmost poster features a dark blue background with a black bowl filled with seafood (including sashimi, sea urchin, and shrimp). Above it are the Japanese slogan "海の宝石箱、どうぞ。" (Jewel Box of the Sea, please.) and the Chinese slogan "每日直送，鲜甜满溢" (Daily direct delivery, fresh and sweet). Below are "特上海鲜丼" (Special Seafood Donburi) and its price "2,500 日元", with the brand name "海鲜界" (Seafood World) and store information "千禧市场店 铜锣湾恩平道524号 千禧一期M层 10:00~10:30" at the bottom.
The second poster from the left shows a man in a suit standing against a bookshelf background. The top features the English word "ELEGANCE" and the Chinese "绅士格调" (Gentleman's Style), with "从容有度" (Calm and Measured) arranged vertically on the right. The bottom displays "2024秋季定制系列" (2024 Autumn Custom Collection), "11月1日发布" (Released November 1st), and an orange-backed button "预约试穿 >" (Book a fitting >).
The third poster from the left depicts a family taking a selfie in front of Cinderella Castle with fireworks in the background. The top reads "梦与魔法的王国" (Kingdom of Dreams and Magic), "东京迪士尼" (Tokyo Disney), and "全家共享欢乐时光" (Family Enjoying Happy Times). In the middle, there's an orange-backed promotion "秋季特别优惠，截止至10月31日 (周五)" (Autumn Special Offer, ends Oct 31st (Friday)). The bottom has three blue buttons: "乐园门票" (Park Tickets), "度假酒店" (Resort Hotel), "快速通行" (Fast Pass), and an orange-backed "立即购票 >" (Buy Tickets Now >) button.
The rightmost poster is predominantly white, featuring a laptop displaying a cloud storage interface. At the top are the "CloudBox" brand logo and the Japanese slogan "データを自由に、安全に。" (Data freely, safely.), followed by the Chinese "企业级云存储服务" (Enterprise Cloud Storage Service). The middle contains an orange-backed promotional phrase "超过10,000个团队使用" (Used by over 10,000 teams). The bottom lists three feature tags: "文件同步" (File Sync), "版本历史" (Version History), "团队共享" (Team Sharing), a blue-backed button "免费获取2TB >" (Get 2TB Free >), and the URL "www.cloudbox.jp".

prompt_en: This is an infographic about CPU internal architecture set against a dark blue background. At the top, there is a header "PLATE NO. 084 // COMPUTATIONAL BIOLOGY". The main title is "CPU 内部架构" (CPU Internal Architecture), with the subtitle "INTERNAL ARCHITECTURE: PIPELINE & CACHE HIERARCHY". Below the title, it states "SPECIES: Siliconicum logicus DEPTH: 0.000007 mm (7nm) DATE: 2024.Q3". The left side of the image is divided into three main information sections. The first section, "指令流水线 / INSTRUCTION PIPELINE", includes a Chinese description and five labeled boxes with English abbreviations and Chinese names (IF/Fetch, ID/Decode, EX/Execute, MEM/Memory Access, WB/Write Back). To its right, there is a vertical flowchart composed of dots and lines. The second section, "缓存层级 / CACHE LEVELS", presents a four-column table detailing L1, L2, and L3 cache capacity, latency, and type. The third section, "测绘数据 / CARTOGRAPHIC DATA", contains a four-column table listing coordinates, signal amplitude, thermal offset, and specimen status. On the right side of the image, there is an information box with "LOG_SEQ_ID: 0x8F2A" at the top, followed by a Chinese description of the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) and Floating-Point Unit (FPU). The bottom of the image features footer information, including geographical coordinates, a reference number, and "END OF LOG".

线粒体内部结构与能量工厂
线粒体是真核生物进行氧化磷酸化并产生 ATP 的主要场所。其双层膜结构不仅隔离了生化反应，更通过高度折叠的内膜构建了高效的电化学梯度转化系统。

电子传递链与质子泵

高能电子在复合体 I-IV 间传递，释放能量将 H+ 泵入膜间隙，形成的浓度梯度通过 ATP 合酶回流，驱动 FO 单元旋转。

At the top left of the page is the header "CELLULAR ORGANELLE ATLAS / VOL 04", and on the top right, within a red square, is the "能量之源" (Source of Energy) logo. The main title, "线粒体内部结构与能量工厂" (Mitochondrial Internal Structure and Energy Factory), is positioned towards the top-center left. Below the title is an introductory text describing mitochondrial function.
The content area is laid out in two columns. The upper part of the left column is the "超微结构与组分" (Ultrastructure and Components) section, which includes a schematic diagram of mitochondrial structure labeled with "外膜 (Outer Membrane)", "嵴 (Cristae)", and "基质 (Matrix)", accompanied by detailed explanatory text below. The lower part of the left column features a table titled "三羧酸循环产物统计" (TCA Cycle Product Statistics), listing biochemical stages, substrate consumption, main products, and quantities.
The upper part of the right column is the "氧化磷酸化偶联机制" (Oxidative Phosphorylation Coupling Mechanism) section, containing a subheading "电子传递链与质子泵" (Electron Transport Chain and Proton Pump) and a simplified diagram of the electron transport chain, with explanatory text below. The middle part of the right column is the "能量净产出计算" (Energy Net Output Calculation) section, prominently displaying "36 ATP / Glucose" in red, followed by explanatory text. Below this is another table listing energy carriers, equivalent ATP, and source stages.
In the bottom right corner of the page, there is a dark box with the title "核心反应式 / CORE FORMULA" (Core Reaction Formula), inside which is the chemical equation "C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + 能量" (C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + Energy). At the bottom left of the page is the data source "数据来源: LEHNINGER 生物化学原理" (Data Source: LEHNINGER Principles of Biochemistry), and on the right is the copyright information "© 2024 精密寰宇地理图册" (© 2024 Precision Global Geographic Atlas).

这是一张数字银行或金融应用的用户界面设计图。界面背景采用从左上角淡黄色到右下角淡紫色的柔和渐变。顶部导航栏包含品牌名称“incard |”，以及“Products”、“About”、“Features”、“Pricing”等导航链接，右侧是“Login”和“Sign up”按钮。

主内容区域由多个重叠的卡片式组件构成。左侧一张深绿色背景的卡片展示了“Spotify Music”订阅信息，包括“Music for everyone”的描述和“$ 8.99/month”的价格。中间卡片显示账户余额“$ 4,256,99”和“Balance”标签，以及一张带有“.... 0345”字样的信用卡图标。右侧区域标题为“Upcoming payments”，下方显示总金额“$ 238,99”，以及一个“transactions”列表。

左下角是“Payment Method”区域，其中一张蓝色卡片显示“$ 2,456,89”和“Mastercard .... 3674”字样。下方“Settings”区域包含“Delay Payment”选项。右侧的“transactions”列表详细列出了多笔交易，包括“Dropbox”、“Spotify”、“Netflix”的“Feb 28”日期和“$ 8,99”金额，以及“Parking”和“Transport”的支出“- $8,00”。

底部区域分为左右两部分。左侧是醒目的标题“Best banking solution for everyone”。右侧是描述性文字“Track your savings and build the habits of saving money. Make investment choices based on verified data”，下方是一个邮件订阅表单，包含占位符为“Enter your email”的输入框和一个蓝色“Get Started”按钮。

The main content area consists of multiple overlapping card-like components. A dark green card on the left displays "Spotify Music" subscription information, including the description "Music for everyone" and a price of "$ 8.99/month". The middle card shows an account balance of "$ 4,256,99" with a "Balance" label, and a credit card icon with ".... 0345". The right section is titled "Upcoming payments", showing a total amount of "$ 238,99", and a "transactions" list.

The bottom left features a "Payment Method" area, where a blue card displays "$ 2,456,89" and "Mastercard .... 3674". Below it, a "Settings" area includes a "Delay Payment" option. The "transactions" list on the right details multiple transactions, including "Dropbox", "Spotify", and "Netflix" with "Feb 28" dates and "$ 8,99" amounts, as well as "Parking" and "Transport" expenses of "- $8,00".

The bottom section is divided into two parts. The left features a prominent title "Best banking solution for everyone". The right contains descriptive text "Track your savings and build the habits of saving money. Make investment choices based on verified data", followed by an email subscription form with an "Enter your email" placeholder in the input field and a blue "Get Started" button.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅数字奇幻插画，描绘了一个宏大而激烈的宇宙战场。画面中央偏左，一位头戴官帽、身着深色长袍的男性角色，手持长矛，骑乘着一头双头黑色犬形生物，正面向右侧。其左上方，一位金发白裙的女性角色站立在浮空的岩石平台上。右上方，一位留有胡须、手持三叉戟和宝珠的神祇形象，乘坐着一辆浮空战车，背景中还有一辆类似的战车。画面右侧和前景处，大量身披盔甲、长有尖角、眼睛和胸口发出红光的恶魔或怪物形象呈进攻姿态。背景是浩瀚的宇宙星空，中央有一个巨大的螺旋星系，色彩以紫色、蓝色和粉色为主。前景地面散落着发光的能量球体和齿轮状机械部件。画面右侧竖排着金色渐变、带有紫色描边和阴影的“星穹帝尊”四个大字，左下角红色背景上竖排着白色文字“墨羽”。整体色调偏暗，以深蓝、紫、黑为主，辅以金色、红色和亮色光效。
prompt_en: This is a digital fantasy illustration depicting a grand and intense cosmic battlefield. Slightly to the left of the center, a male character wearing an official's hat and dark robes, holding a spear, rides a two-headed black dog-like creature, facing right. To his upper left, a blonde-haired female character in a white dress stands on a floating rock platform. In the upper right, a bearded deity-like figure holding a trident and an orb rides a floating chariot, with another similar chariot in the background. On the right side and in the foreground, numerous armored demon-like figures with horns and glowing red eyes and chests are in an attacking posture. The background features a vast cosmic starry sky with a large spiral galaxy at its center, colored predominantly in purple, blue, and pink. The foreground ground is scattered with glowing energy orbs and gear-like mechanical parts. On the right side of the image, the four characters "星穹帝尊" (Star Dome Emperor/Lord) are arranged vertically in a golden gradient with purple outlines and shadows. In the bottom left, the white characters "墨羽" (Ink Feather) are arranged vertically against a red background. The overall color scheme is dark, dominated by deep blue, purple, and black, complemented by gold, red, and bright light effects.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface, displaying the "Today's Work Overview" page of a task management or productivity app. The top of the interface shows a status bar with the time "09:41". Below it is the page title "今日工作概览" (Today's Work Overview), accompanied by a blue vertical line. Under the title, there's a handwritten-style text "太棒了！任务已全部达成" (Great! All tasks completed). The center of the page features a blue card showing "完成率 100%" (Completion Rate 100%), along with a white circular progress bar containing a square icon. At the bottom of this card, smaller text reads "超越 98%的用户" (Surpassed 98% of users). Below the blue card, two white cards are arranged side-by-side: the left one displays "已办事项 12 项" (12 Completed Items), and the right one shows "专注时长 6.5 h" (Focus Duration 6.5 h). Further down is the "任务清单" (Task List) section, with a "查看全部" (View All) link on the right. The task list presents three completed tasks, including "季度财务报表审核" (Quarterly Financial Report Review), "产品原型设计评审会议" (Product Prototype Design Review Meeting), and "客户需求文档更新" (Client Requirements Document Update), each indicating its specific completion time. At the bottom of the page, there is a dark blue floating button labeled "生成今日复盘报告" (Generate Today's Review Report). The very bottom features a navigation bar with four options: "首页" (Home), "任务" (Tasks), "日历" (Calendar), and "我的" (My Profile), with "任务" highlighted in blue.

01
透光层
EPIPELAGIC (0-200M)
阳光充足,光合作用活跃。栖息着海洋中90%的已知物种,是海洋生态链的起点,代表生物为金枪鱼、海豚及各类浮游植物。
02
弱光层
MESOPELAGIC (200-1000M)
暮光区域,光线极其微弱,无法进行光合作用。此层生物多发育出发光器或巨大的感光眼,代表生物为灯笼鱼、巨大型乌贼。
03
无光层
BATHYPELAGIC (1000-4000M)
完全黑暗,温度恒定在4℃左右。这里的生物不依赖阳光,主要以有机碎屑“海洋雪”为食,代表生物为深海鮟鱇鱼与吸血乌贼。
04
深渊层
ABYSSOPELAGIC (4000-6000M)
广阔的泥质平原,盐度高、水温极低且水压巨大。这里生物代谢缓慢且极其耐压,代表生物为深海海参、海百合及盲虾。
05
超深渊层
HADALPELAGIC (6000-11000M)
深邃海沟底部,承受超过1000倍大气压。仅有极少数经过高度特化的物种能够存活,代表生物为深海狮子鱼及特殊端足类动物。
+ 极渊生存适应法则/ADAPTATION
+ 骨骼与肌肉具有极高透水性,以维持内外压力平衡。
+ 降低机体代谢率,最大程度适应稀缺的有机食物源。
+ 触觉及化学感知高度发达,彻底取代退化的视觉器官。

prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating ocean depth stratification and the distribution of representative deep-sea organisms. The top of the chart features a main title and a subtitle, followed by a red warning banner about high pressure and lightless conditions in the deep sea. The main body of the chart is divided into two sections: the left side displays a vertical schematic of ocean depth stratification, ranging from 0 to 11000 meters, with different colors and textures distinguishing the Epipelagic, Mesopelagic, Bathypelagic, Abyssopelagic, and Hadalpelagic zones. Adjacent to the schematic is a table detailing the range, temperature, and pressure for each depth zone. The right side presents a semi-circular pressure gauge, indicating pressure from 1 ATM to 1100 ATM, accompanied by warning text regarding the extreme pressure in the Hadal Zone. At the bottom, five numbered boxes provide detailed descriptions of each depth layer's environmental characteristics, representative organisms, and survival adaptations. The overall background is dark, with text primarily in white, and some titles and warning messages highlighted in red and green.

中国古建筑屋顶形制阶级图谱
STRUCTURAL HIERARCHY OF ANCIENT CHINESE ROOFING SYSTEMS // ATLAS PLATE NO. 042
中国古代建筑的屋顶不仅是遮蔽风雨的构件，更是森严等级制度的视觉外化。通过脊的数量、坡的形态以及装饰物的多寡，精准标注了使用者的社会阶位。最高等级的庑殿顶仅限于皇家正殿与孔庙。

prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the hierarchical classification of ancient Chinese architectural roof forms. The image features a dark green background with text primarily in white and yellow. At the top center is the main title "中国古建筑屋顶形制阶级图谱" with its English subtitle. The upper left contains an introductory text explaining the relationship between roof forms and the social hierarchy. In the middle left, a circular diagram labeled "RANK" at its center connects via lines to four roof types: "庑殿顶" (Wudian), "歇山顶" (Xieshan), "悬山顶" (Xuanshan), and "硬山顶" (Yingshan). The middle right displays a schematic diagram of roof ridge decorative elements, labeling "正脊" (Main Ridge) and "垂脊" (Drooping Ridge), accompanied by a detailed description of "龙吻" (dragon kiss) and mythical beasts. Below this, a comparative matrix of roof forms lists "形制名称" (Form Name), "脊数" (Number of Ridges), "代表建筑" (Representative Architecture), and "阶级等级" (Class Rank), covering Wudian, Xieshan, Xuanshan, Yingshan, and Zuanjian roofs. The lower left includes a textual description of the five main typologies, a large number "10", and an explanation of the mythical guardian beast system. The lower right provides a technical note on "营造法式" (Yingzao Fashi). Copyright information is centered at the bottom of the image.

prompt_en: This image displays a dark-themed user interface for a remote equipment diagnostic system. The interface is divided into three main vertical panels: the left panel shows "Core Operating Parameters," including main bearing temperature (74.2℃, orange), hydraulic system pressure (18.5MPa, blue), and vibration frequency (1240Hz, green); the upper part of the middle panel features "LIVE: Remote Real-time Footage," showing a worker and an industrial robot, while the lower part contains a "Diagnostic Suggestions" area with text recommendations and a "Generate Report" button; the right panel is for "Remote Expert Support," displaying the expert "Wang Jianguo Senior Engineer"'s avatar and information, along with "Real-time Diagnostic Log" and two buttons, "Voice Call" and "Emergency Stop." The top of the interface includes the system title "Remote Equipment Diagnostic System v4.2.0," current status "Expert Online Connection," and time "14:30:25." The bottom shows network latency, data throughput, and the "SYSTEM SECURE" status. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark blue/black backgrounds with various text colors.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of an in-car infotainment system's software interface, featuring a dark theme with rich text and element colors including white, cyan, green, yellow, orange, blue, and red. The interface layout is clear, divided into a top status bar, a left information panel, a central main display area, and a right information panel. The top status bar shows system status "SYSTEM STATUS ADAS ACTIVE", "GNSS LOCKED", along with the date "2024-05-24" and time "14:30:22". The left panel displays vehicle information, including speed "64 KM/H", gear "P R N D" (with D highlighted), and energy flow "ENERGY FLOW 72% 380 KM". The central main display area presents a road scene with a mountainous and dry environment in the background, where a large white truck is driving on a two-way, two-lane road. Two objects are detected in the image, labeled "PEDESTRIAN 01" and "PEDESTRIAN 02". The rear of the truck shows "90", "www.granotrade.cl", "80", and "DON". A blue oval button at the bottom displays "AUTO-PILOT ENGAGED". The right panel shows "OBJECT LIST 04 DETECTED", listing detected objects with their risk and distance, such as "PEDESTRIAN HIGH RISK 12.4m", "PEDESTRIAN NORMAL 28.1m", and "VEHICLE". The bottom of the panel is a collision warning area, displaying "COLLISION ALERT" and "BRAKE ASSIST READY". On the right side of the central image, there is a yellow diamond-shaped traffic sign with two opposing black arrows.

III. ARCHITECTURAL DESCRIPTORS
I. PYRAMID OF GIZA (EGYPT)
Constructed around 2560 BC for Pharaoh Khufu. Rising to an original height of 146 meters, this monumental tomb was the tallest man-made structure for over 3,800 years. It is built from 2.3 million limestone blocks and remains the only ancient wonder surviving to this day.
II. HANGING GARDENS OF BABYLON
Reportedly built by Nebuchadnezzar II around 600 BC. This legendary multi-tiered green mountain featured vaulted terraces, exotic flora, and complex irrigation systems drawing from the Euphrates. No definitive physical traces have ever been unearthed.
III. OLYMPIAN ZEUS & ARTEMIS
The chryselephantine Statue of Zeus (435 BC) was crafted of ivory and gold plates. The Temple of Artemis (550 BC) featured a forest of 127 towering marble columns. Both fell to fire—Zeus in a Constantinople blaze, Artemis to arson.
IV. MAUSOLEUM, COLOSSUS & PHAROS
The Mausoleum at Halicarnassus (351 BC) and the Pharos of Alexandria (280 BC) were shattered by medieval earthquakes. The Colossus of Rhodes (280 BC), a giant bronze sun god, stood for only 54 years before buckling under a massive tremor.
V. SUMMARY OF STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING
The construction of these monuments spans over two millennia, representing the zenith of ancient Egyptian, Babylonian, Greek, and Persian engineering. Seismic shifts in the Mediterranean basin proved to be the ultimate destroyer of these structural giants, leaving only Giza's solid geometric mass to survive the passage of millennia.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application's location permission request interface. The interface, set against a white background, appears as a modal dialog box, divided into two main sections: left and right. The left section is a text description area, with the title "位置权限申请" (Location Permission Application) at the top, accompanied by a location icon. Below it are two paragraphs explaining the purpose of obtaining location information and the functions enabled after granting permission. Following these are two list items, each with a gray dot icon, detailing "实时地图导航与路况更新" (Real-time Map Navigation and Traffic Updates) and "自动识别当前城市及区域服务" (Automatic Identification of Current City and Regional Services). The right section displays a black-and-white stylized aerial view of a city, featuring dense buildings, a grid-like pattern with light points in the central area, and a blue location pin icon with a white text label "正在定位您的当前位置..." (Locating your current position...). The bottom of the interface is the action area, with three light gray text labels above: "数据收集" (Data Collection), "使用目的" (Purpose of Use), and "安全保障" (Security Assurance). Below these are two side-by-side buttons: the left one is "暂不开启" (Do Not Enable for Now) with white background and dark blue text, and the right one is "同意并开启权限" (Agree and Enable Permission) with a dark blue background and white text. A light gray "隐私受保护" (Privacy Protected) label is also visible at the top right.

解剖学引言
纳米级结构解剖: 病毒作为生命与非生命边界的物理化学实体, 其几何对称性直接决定了侵染效率与宿主特异性。本章以T4噬菌体为核心, 深度解析其复杂的机械式注入结构与形态特征。

鞘蛋白刺突(Spike)呈三聚体构象, 易受体结合域可特异性识别宿主膜受体, 启动融合机制。

01 螺旋形 (TMV)

prompt_cn: 这张科学信息图表以深色背景为主，展示了病毒的形态学分类、纳米级结构解剖及其尺度对比。图表顶部是主标题“病毒形态学分类与纳米级结构解剖”和副标题“四大门类解剖学特征与尺度对比”，右上方标有“板块编号: BIO-047”和“技术标准: ICTV-2024”。内容分为多个区域，左侧“解剖学引言”部分包含一段文字描述，右侧配有T4噬菌体的结构示意图，标注了二十面体头部、中空螺旋尾鞘、尾基底板和核酸收缩尾丝，以及鞘蛋白刺突的微观解剖图及其文字说明。下方“四大病毒形态类型”区域详细介绍了螺旋形、二十面体、包膜形和复合形四种病毒类型，每种类型都配有编号、名称、代表病毒、文字描述和关键尺寸参数。再下方是“尺度对比 (纳米级)”的水平条形图，比较了丁型肝炎、腺病毒、流感病毒、T4噬菌体和烟草花叶病毒的相对大小，X轴刻度从0cm到350nm。最下方是“结构解剖参数表”，以表格形式列出了六种病毒的分类名称、代表病毒、平均尺度、基因组类型和核心结构。图表底部还包含比例尺、数据来源和页码信息。
prompt_en: This scientific infographic, set against a dark background, illustrates the morphological classification of viruses, their nanoscale structural anatomy, and a comparison of their sizes. The top of the chart features the main title "病毒形态学分类与纳米级结构解剖" (Virus Morphological Classification and Nanoscale Structural Anatomy) and the subtitle "四大门类解剖学特征与尺度对比" (Anatomical Features and Scale Comparison of Four Major Categories). The upper right corner displays "板块编号: BIO-047" (Block No.: BIO-047) and "技术标准: ICTV-2024" (Technical Standard: ICTV-2024). The content is divided into several sections. The "解剖学引言" (Anatomical Introduction) section on the left includes a textual description, accompanied by a structural diagram of a T4 bacteriophage on the right, labeling its icosahedral head, hollow helical tail sheath, tail base plate, and nucleic acid contractile tail fibers. Below this is a microscopic anatomical diagram of spike proteins with a textual explanation. The "四大病毒形态类型" (Four Major Virus Morphological Types) section details four virus types: helical, icosahedral, enveloped, and complex, each with a number, name, representative virus, textual description, and key size parameters. Further down, a horizontal bar chart titled "尺度对比 (纳米级)" (Scale Comparison (Nanoscale)) compares the relative sizes of Hepatitis D, Adenovirus, Influenza virus, T4 bacteriophage, and Tobacco mosaic virus, with the X-axis scaled from 0cm to 350nm. The bottom section, "结构解剖参数表" (Structural Anatomy Parameter Table), presents a table listing the classification name, representative virus, average size, genome type, and core structure for six viruses. The chart's footer includes a scale, data source, and page number.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电子游戏截图，展示了三名拟人化角色与一个巨大怪物在黑暗洞穴或空间中战斗的场景。画面中央，一名身着白色和蓝色机甲的角色正在挥舞武器攻击右侧的深色怪物，攻击处爆发出黄色光芒和粒子效果。怪物身体呈深棕色和黑色，带有橙色发光的纹路。左侧有另外两名穿着相似机甲的角色，其中一名角色背部有发光的蓝色翅膀。屏幕右上角显示有白色数字“103”和“110”，可能是怪物的生命值或状态。屏幕左下角有一个蓝色半透明框，内含白色文字“Rush”，可能是一个技能按钮。右下角显示有紫色的“2 HIT”和橙色的“174 DAMAGE”战斗信息。图片最左下角还有一行小字版权信息。

In the center of the image, a character in white and blue mecha-like armor is attacking the dark monster on the right with a weapon, generating yellow light and particle effects. The monster has a dark brown and black body with orange glowing patterns. On the left, two other characters in similar mecha-like suits are present, one of whom has glowing blue wings on their back. The top right of the screen displays white numbers "103" and "110", likely indicating the monster's health or status. A blue semi-transparent box in the bottom left corner contains the white text "Rush", possibly a skill button. The bottom right shows combat information: "2 HIT" in purple and "174 DAMAGE" in orange. A small line of copyright information is also visible at the very bottom left of the image.

prompt_cn: 这是一张游戏角色状态界面的截图。界面顶部显示“ステータス”标题，下方有四个角色肖像按钮，其中“肖像1 銀髪竜騎”被选中。界面中央是角色“ヴァルキリー”的全身立绘，她是一位白发女性，身着红色龙鳞甲，手持火焰长剑，左臂上有一只小红龙。立绘左侧是角色详细信息面板，包含角色名称、职业“クラス ドラグーン”、角色描述“与龙为伴的远古战士后裔。”、等级“Lv. 25”、经验条、HP/MP数值、以及“力”、“魔力”、“技”、“速さ”、“守備”、“魔防”、“移動”等详细属性值。面板底部列出了“耐性”属性，如“火 +20”、“雷 -10”等。立绘右侧是技能和装备面板，上方是“アビリティ”列表，包括“ドラゴンランス”等技能，以及角色类型“炎の竜騎士”的描述“驾驭火龙翱翔战场，以龙枪和吐息粉碎敌军。”。中间是一个六边形雷达图，显示“HP”、“攻撃”、“防御”、“耐久”、“速さ”、“魔力”六项属性，其中“攻撃”和“HP”数值较高。雷达图下方是“装備”列表，包括“レッドドラゴンランス”等。最下方是“支援まとめ”区域，总结了角色的战斗特点，如“物理・炎攻撃”。界面底部有“查看角色详细状态。”的提示和“× 切り替え”、“◎ 戻る”两个操作按钮。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a game character status interface. The top of the interface displays the title "ステータス" (Status), with four character portrait buttons below it, among which "肖像1 銀髪竜騎" (Portrait 1 Silver-haired Dragon Knight) is selected. In the center of the interface is a full-body illustration of the character "ヴァルキリー" (Valkyrie), a white-haired woman wearing red dragon scale armor, holding a flaming longsword, with a small red dragon on her left arm. To the left of the illustration is a detailed character information panel, including the character's name, class "クラス ドラグーン" (Class Dragoon), a character description "与龙为伴的远古战士后裔。" (Descendant of ancient warriors who accompany dragons.), level "Lv. 25", an experience bar, HP/MP values, and detailed attribute values such as "力" (Strength), "魔力" (Magic), "技" (Skill), "速さ" (Speed), "守備" (Defense), "魔防" (Magic Defense), and "移動" (Movement). The bottom of the panel lists "耐性" (Resistance) attributes, such as "火 +20" (Fire +20) and "雷 -10" (Lightning -10). To the right of the illustration is the abilities and equipment panel. The upper part contains an "アビリティ" (Ability) list, including skills like "ドラゴンランス" (Dragon Lance), and a description of the character type "炎の竜騎士" (Flame Dragon Knight): "驾驭火龙翱翔战场，以龙枪和吐息粉碎敌军。" (Riding fire dragons to soar across the battlefield, crushing enemies with dragon lances and breath attacks.). In the middle is a hexagonal radar chart displaying six attributes: "HP", "攻撃" (Attack), "防御" (Defense), "耐久" (Durability), "速さ" (Speed), and "魔力" (Magic), with "攻撃" and "HP" showing higher values. Below the radar chart is the "装備" (Equipment) list, including items like "レッドドラゴンランス" (Red Dragon Lance). The bottom section is the "支援まとめ" (Support Summary) area, summarizing the character's combat characteristics, such as "物理・炎攻撃" (Physical/Fire Attack). At the very bottom of the interface are a prompt "查看角色详细状态。" (View detailed character status.) and two action buttons, "× 切り替え" (Switch) and "◎ 戻る" (Back).

text:
NIPPONESE GARDEN TAXONOMY
A Statistical and Architectural Survey of Three Schools & Five Visual Components
KAREsansui
MAJOR CLASSIFICATIONS
Dry Landscape
Zen
Hill Garden
Nature
Tea Garden
Ritual
CHANIWA
TSUKIYAMA
Figures based on architectural prevalence across Kyoto Prefecture,
14th–17th Century.
TOBI-ISHI
Stepping stones
arranged to control
gait and focus the
visitor's eye.
TORO
Buddhist votive
lanterns adapted
for illumination of
tea paths.
TSUKUBAI
A stone washbasin
for ritual
purification of the
hands and mouth.
SHISHI-
ODOSHI
A bamboo water-
clack originally
designed to frighten
away deer.
MATSU
Pine trees pruned
into asymmetric
balances to evoke
ancient age.
METHODOLOGICAL OBSERVATIONS & PHILOSOPHICAL CONTEXT
The traditional garden of Nippon is not merely a
botanical collection but a rigorous spatial
manifestation of Shinto and Buddhist cosmology.
The Karesansui (枯山水), or "dry landscape,"
emerged under the patronage of Zen monasteries
during the Muromachi period. These gardens
dispense with physical water, employing raked
white gravel to represent the void or the sea, and
upright stones to signify mountain peaks. The
viewer is intended to sit in meditative stillness,
perceiving the infinite within the finite
constraints of a walled courtyard.
The Chaniwa (茶庭), associated with the tea
ceremony, emphasizes the transition from the
mundane world to the sacred space of the tea
room. The design is utilitarian yet profoundly
aesthetic, centered on the Roji (dewy path). Every
element—from the Tobi-ishi stones to the stone
lanterns—is positioned to cultivate a sense of
detached tranquility. It is a functional landscape
where the act of walking becomes a ritualized
process of cleansing the mind before the
commencement of the Chanoyu.
Conversely, the Tsukiyama (築山) style
represents a more literal reproduction of nature.
These "hill gardens" utilize borrowed scenery
(Shakkei), incorporating distant vistas into the
garden's own composition. They typically feature
a central pond, artificial elevations, and winding
paths that offer changing perspectives as one
moves through the space, reflecting the Heian
period's aristocratic preference for boat-traversed
water features and grand poetic associations.
Vegetation in all three schools is subject to strict
architectural discipline. The Japanese Pine
(Matsu), often the focal point, is painstakingly
pruned to achieve a "cloud" shape (Niwaki),
symbolizing resilience and longevity. Unlike
Western gardens that favor symmetry, the
Nipponese tradition seeks a dynamic equilibrium
through the placement of stones in odd numbers
—typically groups of three or five—avoiding the
stagnation of perfect geometric balance in favor
of naturalistic vitality.
PLAT NO. VIII — KYOTO SURVEY
PRINTED BY IMPERIAL AUTHORITY
YEAR 1858

prompt_cn: 这是一张产品详情页面的广告图，整体布局分为左右两大栏。左侧栏顶部展示了“小仙炖鲜炖花胶燕窝”产品，规格为“75g×4瓶 独立包装”，并列出了“真材实料”、“Q弹浓稠”、“开盖即食”、“即食滋补”四个产品特点。下方是宣传语“一瓶好燕窝 美丽每一天”，并配有四张图片展示了“清晨空腹”、“午后保养”、“睡前滋养”、“送礼佳品”等食用场景。右侧栏顶部是“食材精选 /INGREDIENTS”标题，下方以圆形图标展示了“燕窝”、“花胶”、“银耳”、“枸杞”、“冰糖”五种食材。中部是“浓稠丝滑 入口即化”的标题，配有四张图片和文字说明“丝丝可见 Visible silk”、“浓稠顺滑 Rich & Smooth”、“高端滋养 Premium”、“开盖即食 营养滋补”。再下方是“独立玻璃瓶 随身携带”的标题，配有三张图片和文字说明“独立玻璃瓶 便携卫生”、“锁住新鲜 密封保鲜”、“1瓶1次 精准份量”，并标注“75g”。图片底部是一个表格，标题为“视频推广广告 seedance 2.0 视频提示词 + 分镜头脚本”，详细列出了7个镜头的标题和描述。
prompt_en: This is an advertisement image for a product detail page, with an overall layout divided into two main columns. The top of the left column displays the "Xiaoxiandun Fresh Stewed Fish Maw Bird's Nest" product, specified as "75g×4 bottles, individually packaged," and lists four product features: "Authentic Ingredients," "Chewy and Rich," "Ready to Eat," and "Instant Nourishment." Below is the slogan "One bottle of good bird's nest, beauty every day," accompanied by four images illustrating consumption scenarios such as "Empty stomach in the morning," "Afternoon nourishment," "Nourishment before bed," and "Gift for special occasions." The top of the right column features the title "Selected Ingredients /INGREDIENTS," with five ingredients—"Bird's Nest," "Fish Maw," "Tremella," "Goji Berry," and "Rock Sugar"—shown with circular icons. The middle section has the title "Rich and Smooth, Melts in Your Mouth," with four images and text descriptions: "Visible silk," "Rich & Smooth," "Premium nourishment," and "Ready to eat, nutritious and nourishing." Further down is the title "Individual Glass Bottle, Easy to Carry," with three images and text descriptions: "Individual glass bottle, portable and hygienic," "Locks in freshness, sealed for preservation," and "1 bottle, 1 serving, precise portion," marked with "75g." The bottom of the image contains a table titled "Video Promotion Ad seedance 2.0 Video Prompts + Shot Breakdown," detailing the titles and descriptions for 7 shots.

prompt_en: This is a color photograph showcasing a modern office or research and development environment. In the foreground, a black monitor is centrally placed, displaying the "XYZ" brand logo on its screen. The text is composed of circuit board patterns, featuring a green and blue gradient with lightning effects. Below it, the words "XYZ NEW ENERGY MOTOR CONTROLS" are shown in white, uppercase letters. On the white desk in front of the monitor, several motor or engine components are arranged, including a stator, a rotor, and a bearing, along with a sheet of paper featuring engineering drawings, a white keyboard, and a mouse. In the background, four individuals in business casual attire are seated or standing around a table; one person is operating a laptop, while two others appear to be engaged in discussion. To the left in the background, there is a whiteboard with technical drawings or design sketches. The entire scene is brightly lit, creating a professional working atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用程序的界面截图，展示了医生预约挂号功能。界面顶部是固定标题栏，左侧显示“预约挂号”字样，右侧是“上海市第一人民医院”名称及一个下拉图标。标题栏下方是一个搜索框，内有放大镜图标和“搜索医生、科室、疾病名称”的占位符文本。搜索框下方是四个筛选按钮：“全部科室”、“综合排序”、“专家门诊”和“筛选”，其中“全部科室”按钮呈绿色背景，表示被选中。界面主体是一个垂直滚动的医生列表，每项包含圆形医生头像、医生姓名、职称（如“主任医师”）、科室、专长或疾病标签（如“冠心病”、“高血压”）、评分、评价数量、橙色显示的挂号费金额以及一个绿色的“立即预约”按钮。界面底部是固定导航栏，包含“首页”、“找医生”、“挂号记录”和“我的”四个功能入口，其中“找医生”图标和文字以绿色高亮显示，表明当前页面。整体界面背景为白色或极浅灰色。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface, showcasing a doctor appointment booking feature. The top of the interface features a fixed title bar, displaying "预约挂号" (Appointment Booking) on the left and "上海市第一人民医院" (Shanghai First People's Hospital) with a dropdown icon on the right. Below the title bar is a search box with a magnifying glass icon and placeholder text "搜索医生、科室、疾病名称" (Search doctors, departments, disease names). Below the search box are four filter buttons: "全部科室" (All Departments), "综合排序" (Comprehensive Sort), "专家门诊" (Expert Clinic), and "筛选" (Filter), with "全部科室" highlighted in green, indicating it is selected. The main body of the interface is a vertically scrolling list of doctors. Each entry includes a circular doctor's profile picture, doctor's name, title (e.g., "主任医师" - Chief Physician), department, specialty or disease tags (e.g., "冠心病" - Coronary Heart Disease, "高血压" - Hypertension), rating, number of reviews, the registration fee displayed in orange, and a green "立即预约" (Book Now) button. At the bottom of the interface is a fixed navigation bar with four functional entries: "首页" (Home), "找医生" (Find Doctor), "挂号记录" (Appointment Records), and "我的" (My Profile), with "找医生" highlighted in green, indicating the current page. The overall interface background is white or very light grey.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅由七个分格组成的日式漫画，描绘了未来花浴设施中的日常场景。漫画布局为三行，第一、二行各含两个分格，第三行有三个分格。画面主要角色包括一名穿着绿色背带裤的年轻女性、一个黄色毛茸茸生物和一个蓝色机器人。左上分格展示了花浴设施入口，招牌上写有“未来花浴 フラワーバス”，并有“芳香 100%”标签和“Flower Bath Promotion”海报，圆形窗外是梦幻景色。右上分格中，女性正在调整控制面板，对话框显示“よし！今日の花湯加減も完璧ね！”。中间左侧分格里，黄色生物在花瓣浴缸中放松，木牌上写着“ゆったり フローラル リラックス”。中间分格中，机器人手持拖把，在“清掃中”警示牌旁清洁地面。左下分格中，女性手持一瓶“花エキス”。中间下方分格里，机器人溅起水花，黄色生物受惊，对话框写着“ぷわ〜ん!!”。右下分格中，机器人站在写有“フラワーバス”的水桶旁，黄色生物在浴缸中拿着一瓶“花フルーツオーレ”，对话框显示“あ〜 やっぱり花浴は最高ロボ！”。背景墙上还有粉色的“花”字。整幅漫画色彩明亮，风格卡通。
prompt_en: This is a Japanese comic composed of seven panels, depicting daily scenes in a futuristic flower bath facility. The comic is laid out in three rows, with two panels in the first and second rows, and three panels in the third row. The main characters include a young woman wearing green overalls, a yellow fluffy creature with a flower-patterned towel on its head, and a blue robot. The top-left panel shows the entrance of the flower bath facility, with a sign reading "未来花浴 フラワーバス" (Future Flower Bath) and a "芳香 100%" (Aroma 100%) label, along with a "Flower Bath Promotion" poster. A circular window outside reveals a dreamy landscape. In the top-right panel, the woman is adjusting a control panel on the wall, with a speech bubble saying "よし！今日の花湯加減も完璧ね！" (Alright! Today's flower bath temperature is perfect!). In the middle-left panel, the yellow creature relaxes in a bathtub filled with petals, with a wooden sign nearby reading "ゆったり フローラル リラックス" (Relaxing Floral Relaxation). In the middle panel, the robot holds a mop, cleaning the floor next to a "清掃中" (Cleaning in Progress) warning sign. In the bottom-left panel, the woman holds a bottle labeled "花エキス" (Flower Extract). In the bottom-middle panel, the robot splashes water, startling the yellow creature, with a speech bubble saying "ぷわ〜ん!!" (Splash!!). In the bottom-right panel, the robot stands next to a bucket labeled "フラワーバス" (Flower Bath), while the yellow creature in the bathtub holds a bottle labeled "花フルーツオーレ" (Flower Fruit Au Lait), with a speech bubble saying "あ〜 やっぱり花浴は最高ロボ！" (Ah~ Flower bath is the best, robot!). The background wall also features pink "花" (Flower) characters. The entire comic is brightly colored and has a cartoon style.

The top of the interface displays the app name "AI Translator Pro" and its icon. To the right are function selections "智能识别" (Intelligent Recognition) and translation direction "英译 -> 中文" (English to Chinese). Below, the interface is divided into three main sections: The first section has a light gray background, titled "ORIGINAL TEXT", containing an English original text: "The essence of artificial intelligence is not to replace human thought, but to amplify our creative potential and bridge the gaps between global cultures.". The second section has a blue background, titled "智能翻译结果" (Intelligent Translation Result), displaying the corresponding Chinese translation: "人工智能的本质并非取代人类思考，而是放大我们的创造潜能，并消除全球文化之间的隔阂。". The third section is titled "AI 深度解析" (AI Deep Analysis), with two tags "学术语气" (Academic Tone) and "信达雅" (Faithfulness, Expressiveness, Elegance) on the right. Below this are two detailed analysis paragraphs, titled "核心词汇: Amplify" (Key Vocabulary: Amplify) and "句式优化" (Sentence Structure Optimization), explaining translation details. The bottom left of the interface shows "生成时间: 2023年10月24日" (Generation Time: October 24, 2023) and "由 AI Translator Pro 强力驱动" (Powered by AI Translator Pro). The bottom right features "扫码体验" (Scan to Experience) and "探索语言的无限可能" (Explore the Infinite Possibilities of Language), accompanied by a QR code image.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于色彩理论的信息图表，标题为“THE CORE THEORY OF COLOR”，副标题是“CHARTING THE CHROMATIC SPECTRUM: FROM PIGMENT TO PSYCHOLOGY”。图表顶部有一个红色方块，内含中文“色”字，旁边是“SUPREME HIERARCHY — RYB SYSTEM”的标签。图表分为多个区域，顶部展示了红、黄、蓝三种原色，分别标有“YOKOZUNA”、“OZEKI”、“SEKIWAKE”的等级，以及颜色名称、数字和波长（如“RED 15 — 0 700nm”）。中部左侧是一个彩色的色轮，中心标有“WHEEL”。色轮右侧是一个表格，详细解释了“HUE (H)”、“SATURATION (S)”、“LIGHTNESS (L)”等色彩属性及其定义，以及“COMPLEMENTARY”、“ANALOGOUS”、“TRIADIC”等色彩关系。图表下方分为四列，分别阐述了“WARMTH”、“COOLNESS”、“CHROMA”和“VALUE”的概念及其描述性文字和数值。最下方区域左侧是“Psychological Response”部分，配有心形图标，描述了RYB色彩传统中颜色与人类情感的关联。右侧是“The Banzuke of Harmony”部分，包含一个表格，列出了“Relationship”和“Effect”，如“Complementary”对应“Maximum Contrast”。图片底部是数据来源“Data source: Itten's Elements of Color, 1961 Archive.”和页脚“OFFICIAL ATLAS OF VISUAL SCIENCES — NO. 042”。整体背景为浅色，文字以黑色为主，部分关键信息使用红色、黄色、蓝色或灰色，并混合使用了衬线和无衬线字体。

text:
ATLAS PLATE 042 / SERIES: NAVIGATION
GPS 全球定位系统
卫星星座与三维测量
EVENT SCORE FOR AN OBSERVER
在开阔的荒野站立。
闭上双眼。
想象你头顶上方二万公里的高空，六个巨大的钢圈正以每秒三
公里的速度旋转。
二十四颗原子钟在黑暗中发出无声的滴答声。
计算它们与你心跳跳动的延迟。
睁开双眼，指向你确切的坐标。
ITEM 01 / CONSTELLATION
二十四颗卫星分布于六个倾角为五十五度的轨道面。它们在二
万零二百公里的高度交织，每十一小时五十八分环绕地球一
周。任何时刻，地面上的观察者皆可与至少六颗卫星保持视线
接触。
ITEM 02 / DIAGRAM
SV2
EARTH
SV1
SV3
ITEM 03 / PARAMETERS
c (光速) = 299,792,458 m/s
R (地球半径) = 6,371 km
H (轨道高度) = 20,200 km
T (轨道周期) = 11h 58m
i (轨道倾角) = 55°
f (载波频率) = 1575.42 MHz
Δt (时钟偏差) = 38 μs/day
ITEM 04 / CLOCK CORRECTION
卫星搭载的原子钟与地面原子钟每日受物理规律扭曲。引力使
时间变快 (每天增加四十五微秒)。速度使时间变慢 (每天减
少七微秒)。综合相对论修正量: 每天需调慢三十八微秒。所
有卫星时钟与地面的微差必须被实时校准，以维持定位的绝对
精度。
ITEM 05 / TRILATERATION
测量从太空抵达地表的时间，距离等于光速乘以时间差。三颗
卫星确立三维空间中的两个可能位置。第四颗卫星校正接收机
的石英钟误差，锁定唯一的经度、纬度和海拔。
d1 = c * (t - t1)
d2 = c * (t - t2)
d3 = c * (t - t3)
d4 = c * (t - t4)
ITEM 06 / SYSTEM LOG
01号卫星 (PRN 01): 运行中, 轨道A1
02号卫星 (PRN 02): 运行中, 轨道B2
03号卫星 (PRN 03): 运行中, 轨道C3
04号卫星 (PRN 04): 运行中, 轨道D1

技术声明 / TECHNICAL STATEMENTS
本图谱所示之杯型适配关系基于典型流体动力学与感官气味分布测试得出。实际品鉴体验受酒液侍酒温度、气压变化及个体嗅觉感官阈值差异影响。杯肚最大径处的倒酒基准线 (1/3) 是保证香气分子充分释放与对流循环的流体力学临界点。

text_45:
内容: 本图谱所示之杯型适配关系基于典型流体动力学与感官气味分布测试得出。实际品鉴体验受酒液侍酒温度、气压变化及个体嗅觉感官阈值差异影响。杯肚最大径处的倒酒基准线 (1/3) 是保证香气分子充分释放与对流循环的流体力学临界点。
语言: 混合
位置: 底部左侧，标题下方
字体/排版: 浅灰色，小字号，常规，左对齐
作用: 页脚正文
prompt_cn: 这是一个深色背景的信息图表，主题是葡萄品种与酒杯几何结构的适配。图表顶部标题为“葡萄品种与酒杯几何结构适配 图谱”，右侧有“PLATE 048 · SENSORY PHYSICS & ALLOCATION”的标识。图表分为三个主要部分：左上角是“01 杯型几何特征与舌尖感官投影”，通过文字描述和两个酒杯（波尔多型和勃艮第型）的示意图，解释了酒杯形状对品酒体验的影响，其中勃艮第杯内标有“1/3 级限注酒面”。右上角是“03 物理机制与极限数据”，展示了“720 ml 勃艮第杯最大腔体容量”和“1/3 杯肚最宽处黄金注酒比例”，并配有一个显示“78%”的圆形图表，说明了香气富集效率差异。左下角是“02 核心杯型与葡萄品种适配矩阵”，包含一个详细的表格，列出了“适配杯型”、“标准容量”、“推荐葡萄品种”和“感官传导机制”。右下角是“侍酒温度法制”的文字说明。图表底部是“技术声明 / TECHNICAL STATEMENTS”，提供了关于图谱科学依据的详细解释。
prompt_en: This is an infographic with a dark background, focusing on the adaptation of grape varietals to wine glass geometry. The main title at the top reads "葡萄品种与酒杯几何结构适配 图谱" (Grape Varietals and Wine Glass Geometric Structure Adaptation Atlas), with "PLATE 048 · SENSORY PHYSICS & ALLOCATION" on the right. The infographic is divided into three main sections: The top-left section, titled "01 杯型几何特征与舌尖感官投影" (01 Glass Shape Geometric Features and Tongue Sensory Projection), uses text and two wine glass diagrams (Bordeaux type and Burgundy type) to explain the impact of glass shape on tasting experience, with the Burgundy glass indicating "1/3 级限注酒面" (1/3 limit fill line). The top-right section, "03 物理机制与极限数据" (03 Physical Mechanisms and Limit Data), displays "720 ml 勃艮第杯最大腔体容量" (720 ml Burgundy glass maximum cavity volume) and "1/3 杯肚最宽处黄金注酒比例" (1/3 golden fill ratio at the widest part of the bowl), accompanied by a circular chart showing "78%" to illustrate aroma enrichment efficiency differences. The bottom-left section, "02 核心杯型与葡萄品种适配矩阵" (02 Core Glass Types and Grape Varietal Adaptation Matrix), features a detailed table with columns for "适配杯型" (Adapted Glass Type), "标准容量" (Standard Volume), "推荐葡萄品种" (Recommended Grape Varietals), and "感官传导机制" (Sensory Conduction Mechanism). The bottom-right provides text on "侍酒温度法制" (Serving Temperature Regulations). At the very bottom, "技术声明 / TECHNICAL STATEMENTS" offers a detailed explanation of the scientific basis for the atlas.

This is a promotional poster or greeting card with a clean, elegant design. The main content area is white, framed by a thin golden border, set against a light beige background. At the top, the golden English text "ART SALON SELECTION" is centered, followed by the larger, bold black Chinese title "悦享・生辰". Below this, a grayscale photograph features three macarons: two standing upright on the left and a stack of two on the right. Above the macarons, the English text "CHOCOLATE MACARONS" is displayed with a white outline and black fill. In the bottom right corner of the photo, a small white rectangular box contains the black Chinese text "法式奶油夹心系列" (French Cream Filling Series). Below the photograph, there are three paragraphs of centered black Chinese text. The first paragraph reads "愿你的生活如马卡龙般缤纷" (May your life be as vibrant as macarons), followed by "每一刻都包裹着奶油夹心的细腻与
甜蜜" (with every moment enveloped in the delicate sweetness of cream filling). The final paragraph states "在这个充满艺术气息的特别日子里，
我们为您呈上这份来自沙龙的精致祝愿。
愿岁月的流转，只为您增添优雅的底蕴。" (On this special day filled with artistic flair, we present you with this exquisite wish from the salon. May the passage of time only enhance your elegant essence.)

prompt_cn:
这是一幅彩色漫画，描绘了一个以蒸汽火车为主题的温泉设施。画面由三行面板组成，第一行和第二行各包含一个宽面板和两个窄面板，第三行包含四个等宽的窄面板。主要角色包括一名穿着工装的女性和多个不同形态的机器人。
在顶部左侧面板，招牌上写着“蒸気機関車温泉”和“スチームのゆ”，门帘上是“汽”字，下方仪表盘显示“速度 60km/h”。顶部中间面板，女性角色在操作设备，对话框中说“今日の湯加減は
最高よ！”和“準備完了！”，胸前名牌是“STAFF”。顶部右侧面板，一个机器人泡在浴池里，旁边的木牌写有“ゆったり”、“のんびり”和“車窓”。
中部左侧面板展示了自动售货机，上面有“炭酸飲料”和“Coca-Cola”字样，旁边竖牌写着“炭泉温泉”。中部中间面板是火车车厢内部，海报上写着“蒸気機関車温泉”和“スチームのゆ”，一个清洁机器人手持“清掃中”的牌子。中部右侧面板，泡澡机器人手中拿着一瓶饮料，标签上是“車窓”、“フルーツ”、“オーレ”。
底部左侧面板，女性和机器人正在浴池中玩耍，水花上方有音效“シューッ!!”。底部中间偏左面板，女性手中拿着一瓶“汽罐牛乳”。底部中间偏右面板，机器人手中拿着与中部右侧面板相同的饮料。底部右侧面板，一个机器人拿着拖把和水桶，对话框中说“スチームのゆは
最高だロボ！”，水桶上写着“スチームのゆ”。
prompt_en:
This is a colorful comic strip depicting a hot spring facility themed around steam locomotives. The image is composed of three rows of panels; the first and second rows each contain one wide panel and two narrow panels, while the third row consists of four equally wide narrow panels. The main characters include a woman in work attire and several robots of different forms.
In the top-left panel, a sign reads "蒸気機関車温泉" (Steam Locomotive Hot Spring) and "スチームのゆ" (Steam no Yu), with the character "汽" (Steam) on a blue curtain below. A gauge displays "速度 60km/h" (Speed 60km/h). In the top-middle panel, the female character operates equipment, with speech bubbles saying "今日の湯加減は\n最高よ!" (Today's bath temperature is the best!) and "準備完了!" (Preparation complete!). Her name tag reads "STAFF". In the top-right panel, a robot is in a bath, and a wooden sign next to it says "ゆったり" (Relaxed), "のんびり" (Leisurely), and "車窓" (Train window).
The middle-left panel shows a vending machine with "炭酸飲料" (Carbonated drinks) and "Coca-Cola" on it, and a vertical sign nearby reads "炭泉温泉" (Carbonated Spring Hot Spring). The middle-middle panel depicts a train car interior with a poster displaying "蒸気機関車温泉" and "スチームのゆ". A cleaning robot holds a sign that says "清掃中" (Cleaning in progress). In the middle-right panel, a bathing robot holds a drink bottle labeled "車窓" (Train window), "フルーツ" (Fruit), and "オーレ" (Au Lait).
In the bottom-left panel, the woman and a robot are playing in the bath, with the sound effect "シューッ!!" (Whoosh/Steam sound) above the splashing water. In the bottom-middle-left panel, the woman holds a bottle of "汽罐牛乳" (Steam Boiler Milk). In the bottom-middle-right panel, a robot holds the same drink bottle as in the middle-right panel. In the bottom-right panel, a robot holds a mop and bucket, with a speech bubble stating "スチームのゆは\n最高だロボ!" (Steam no Yu is the best, robot!). The bucket is labeled "スチームのゆ".
