prompt_cn: 一张冬至社区活动的宣传海报，采用左右分栏设计。左侧背景是一张温馨的纪实照片，展示几位社区居民围坐在桌前一起包饺子的场景，桌上摆放着装满馅料的钢盆和大量整齐排列的生饺子；照片上方叠加了白色大字“冬至 暖心 包饺子”，下方有红色矩形色块，内写“节气 · 传统”，最底部是白色英文“WINTER SOLSTICE FESTIVAL”和中文标语。右侧为浅米色背景的信息面板，右上角带有淡红色的“冬至大吉”圆形印章；面板顶部为英文“Community Gathering”和带红色竖线装饰的标题“饺子里的邻里情”，中间是活动介绍正文，下方是三个带橙色数字序号（01、02、03）的活动亮点列表（五彩面皮、花式捏法、暖心派送），最下方用红色菱形符号引导，列出了活动的时间和地点。
prompt_en: An event promotional poster for the Winter Solstice community gathering, featuring a split-screen layout. The left side has a warm documentary photograph as its background, showing several community residents gathered around a table making dumplings, with stainless steel bowls filled with fillings and rows of neatly arranged raw dumplings on the table. Large white text '冬至 暖心 包饺子' (Winter Solstice, Warm-hearted, Making Dumplings) is overlaid on the photo, with a red rectangular block below containing '节气 · 传统' (Solar Term · Tradition), and the bottom features white English text 'WINTER SOLSTICE FESTIVAL' and a Chinese slogan. The right side is an information panel with a light beige background, featuring a faint red circular seal containing '冬至大吉' (A Auspicious Winter Solstice) in the top right corner. The panel displays the English text 'Community Gathering' and the title '饺子里的邻里情' (Neighborhood Affection in Dumplings) decorated with a vertical red line at the top, followed by introductory body text, a list of three event highlights numbered with orange digits (01, 02, 03), and the event's time and location details marked by red diamond bullet points at the bottom.

The top of the page has a rounded rectangular blue area displaying the drug name "Amoxicillin Clavulanate Potassium", with a "处方药 (Rx)" (Prescription Drug (Rx)) label in the upper left and "药品编号: A20230815" (Drug No.: A20230815) in the upper right. Below the drug name is a description: "适用于敏感菌引起的各类感染症状" (Applicable to various infectious symptoms caused by sensitive bacteria). The main body of the page is divided into two columns of cards. The upper right side features a dark blue card titled "肝肾功能不全者" (Patients with Impaired Liver and Kidney Function), and below it is a white card titled "儿童用药" (Pediatric Use). In the lower left, there is an image of a doctor and patients, with white text overlaid below it stating: "请务必在执业医师指导下购买和使用药品" (Please be sure to purchase and use medication under the guidance of a licensed physician). The bottom of the page shows "数据更新日期: 2023年10月" (Data Update Date: October 2023) and "批准文号: 国药准字H10950021" (Approval No.: National Drug Approval H10950021) in dark gray, with a blue "查看说明书" (View Instructions) button on the right.

text:
Why Animation Works for Research Communication
Animation is one of the most effective ways to explain complex research.
Unlike traditional video, animation allows universities to:
Visualise processes that cannot be filmed
Explain abstract mechanisms and systems
Simplify complex ideas without losing accuracy
Communicate across disciplines and audiences
Improve accessibility for diverse learners
Visualise the Invisible
Explain Complex Systems
Simplify Without Losing Accuracy
Reach Wider Audiences
Improve Accessibility
A well-structured research animation can transform a technical publication into a clear visual explanation that audiences actually understand.
These assets can then support communication across many areas of a university.
Complex research becomes clear when audiences can see it.

A black-framed smartphone is positioned slightly to the left of the center, its screen displaying a space landscape similar to the external environment. The primary visual element is a large, brightly colored space station or spaceship structure, composed of pink, yellow, and blue, showcasing complex geometric forms. Several yellow humanoid figures in spacesuits are distributed on and around the structure, some operating equipment, others observing. In the upper left corner, there is a partially cropped white Chinese character "式" and the complete Chinese text "主题设计大赛" (Theme Design Competition). The lower right corner features the red Huawei (HUAWEI) brand logo and its English name "HUAWEI". The overall illustration boasts a rich composition and vivid color contrast.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深蓝色渐变背景为主的数字宣传海报，背景中带有网格图案和半透明的“DIGITAL”水印。海报左上角是英文标题“FUTURE TECH INFRASTRUCTURE”和中文副标题“云计算体验厅”。右上角有一个蓝色圆角矩形标签，内含白色英文文字“CLOUD 2024”。海报中央偏左位置，有一条短横线和“引领数字化转型”的中文文字，下方是超大字号的白色中文主标题“数字化 底座”。主标题下方是白色中文正文“构建智能世界的云化骨干，赋能千行百业实现数智化跨越式发展。”页面右侧边缘垂直排列着白色英文装饰文字“CLOUD NATIVE ARCHITECTURE”。海报左下角有四组列表项，分为两列排布，每组包含一个粗体标题和一行描述性文字。右下角嵌入了一张描绘服务器机房或数据中心的图片，图片上叠加有白色英文文字“INFRASTRUCTURE”。页面底部是页脚文字，左侧为英文“HUAWEI CLOUD / ALIBABA CLOUD”，右侧为中文“全栈云化 | 智能升级 | 普惠算力”，旁边还有一个黑色方块内含白色圆点。
prompt_en: This is a digital promotional poster with a dark blue gradient background, featuring a grid pattern and a semi-transparent "DIGITAL" watermark. In the top-left corner of the poster are the English title "FUTURE TECH INFRASTRUCTURE" and the Chinese subtitle "云计算体验厅" (Cloud Computing Experience Hall). The top-right corner features a blue rounded rectangular tag with white English text "CLOUD 2024". Towards the central-left of the poster, there is a short horizontal line followed by the Chinese text "引领数字化转型" (Leading Digital Transformation), below which is the very large white Chinese main title "数字化 底座" (Digital Foundation). Below the main title is white Chinese body text stating "构建智能世界的云化骨干，赋能千行百业实现数智化跨越式发展。" (Building the cloud-based backbone of the intelligent world, empowering all industries to achieve leapfrog digital and intelligent development.). Along the right edge of the page, white English decorative text "CLOUD NATIVE ARCHITECTURE" is arranged vertically. In the bottom-left corner of the poster, there are four sets of list items, arranged in two columns, each including a bold title and a line of descriptive text. The bottom-right corner embeds an image depicting a server room or data center, with white English text "INFRASTRUCTURE" overlaid on it. The bottom of the page contains footer text: "HUAWEI CLOUD / ALIBABA CLOUD" in English on the left, and "全栈云化 | 智能升级 | 普惠算力" (Full-stack Cloudification | Intelligent Upgrade | Inclusive Computing Power) in Chinese on the right, next to which is a black square containing a white dot.

On the sign face, the Arabic numeral "٦٠" is at the top, and the Western numeral "60" is at the bottom, both in black bold font. The sign is supported by a gray-green pole, standing in the sandy foreground on the right side of the frame. prompt_cn: 这是一张展现古色古香中式庭院的摄影作品。画面前景是一个高大的木质牌坊，其上方题有白色书法字“龙腾九州”，作为入口的标识。牌坊后方是一座两层高的传统木结构建筑，其二层阳台中央悬挂着一块写有“江湖客栈”的白色牌匾，明确了建筑的名称和商业性质。庭院中央，左侧有两人围坐石桌旁，似乎在饮茶或交谈；右侧有两人手持刀剑正在对练武术，另有旁观者。建筑的阳台和屋檐下挂有多盏中式灯笼，增添了古朴的氛围。建筑右侧背景处有一棵枝繁叶茂的古树，远处天空呈明亮的黄昏色，整个场景充满古典武侠的韵味。
prompt_en: This is a photograph depicting an antique Chinese courtyard scene. In the foreground, a tall wooden archway is inscribed with white calligraphic characters "龙腾九州" (Long Teng Jiu Zhou) at its top, serving as an entrance marker. Behind the archway stands a two-story traditional wooden building, featuring a white plaque with "江湖客栈" (Jiang Hu Ke Zhan) hanging centrally on its second-floor balcony, clearly indicating the building's name and commercial nature. In the courtyard's center, two individuals are seated at a stone table on the left, appearing to drink tea or converse; on the right, two others are practicing martial arts with swords, while onlookers observe. Several Chinese lanterns hang beneath the building's balconies and eaves, enhancing the ancient ambiance. To the right of the building in the background, a lush old tree is visible, and the distant sky displays bright twilight colors, imbuing the entire scene with a classical martial arts charm.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影海报。画面中央是两位男性角色，右侧的伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴身穿黑色长风衣，手持两把枪管发出蓝色光芒的左轮手枪，他略微站在左侧的马修·麦康纳身前。马修·麦康纳也身着深色长外套，两人都面朝前方，眼神坚定。他们似乎站在一座高楼的屋顶上，俯瞰着下方广阔的城市景观，城市中高楼林立，远景处有一座高耸入云的奇幻风格巨塔。背景天空明亮而朦胧。海报顶部左右两侧分别标有两位演员的名字“IDRIS ELBA”和“MATTHEW MCCONAUGHEY”，右侧演员名下方还有一行法文标语“LEUR GUERRE MENACE NOTRE MONDE”（他们的战争威胁着我们的世界）。海报底部中央是电影主标题“LA TOUR SOMBRE”（黑暗塔），其下方是副标题“D'APRÈS LA SAGA ÉPIQUE DE STEPHEN KING”（根据斯蒂芬·金的史诗传奇改编）。最底部是多行制作人员名单、公司标志和网址信息。
prompt_en: This is a movie poster. In the center of the image are two male characters; Idris Elba on the right, wearing a black trench coat and holding two revolvers with blue glowing barrels, stands slightly in front of Matthew McConaughey on the left. Matthew McConaughey also wears a dark long coat. Both characters face forward with determined expressions. They appear to be standing on a rooftop, overlooking a vast city landscape filled with tall buildings, with a towering, fantastical mega-structure in the distant background. The sky in the background is bright and hazy. At the top of the poster, the names of the two actors, "IDRIS ELBA" and "MATTHEW MCCONAUGHEY," are displayed on the left and right, respectively. Below the right actor's name is a French tagline, "LEUR GUERRE MENACE NOTRE MONDE" (Their war threatens our world). At the bottom center of the poster is the main movie title, "LA TOUR SOMBRE" (The Dark Tower), with the subtitle "D'APRÈS LA SAGA ÉPIQUE DE STEPHEN KING" (Based on Stephen King's epic saga) below it. The very bottom features multiple lines of production credits, company logos, and website information.

text:
SOCIAL ETIQUETTE
节日感谢信 / 2024
编号：FD-2024-0616
稳如磐石
爱如深海
致：我生命中的锚点
在波澜万丈的岁月里，您始终是那枚沉静而坚定的锚。无论外界的风浪如何翻涌，只要想到您在后方，我的世界便有了定力与方向。
感谢您用无声的坚韧，为家庭筑起避风的港湾；感谢您用宽厚的肩膀，扛起那些不曾言说的重担。您的存在，不仅是血缘的纽带，更是我人格底色中最坚实的力量源泉。
值此父亲节之际，谨以此信表达我最深沉的敬意与感激。愿您岁岁平安，如松柏之茂，如山岳之恒。
致礼人
您的孩子
日期
二〇二四年六月十六日

text:
THE ARCHITECTURE OF
The establishment of standardized network models created a common language for the digital age. The Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model, conceived in the late 1970s, provides a granular seven-layer abstraction that defines how information from a software
application moves through a network medium to another application. In contrast, the TCP/IP model, which emerged from ARPANET research, offers a pragmatic four-layer structure that has become the functional foundation of the global internet today.
OSI 7-LAYER REFERENCE MODEL
L7: Application
L6: Presentation
L5: Session
L4: Transport
L3: Network
L2: Data Link
L1: Physical
TCP/IP 4-LAYER MODEL
Upper Suite
Application Layer
STACKS
Transport Layer
COMPARISON OF PROTOCOL STACKS
Internet Layer
Network Interface
MAPPING AND SPECIMENS
L7 Application
HTTP
DNS
SMTP
FTP
L4 Transport
TCP
UDP
SCTP
L3 Network
IPv4/v6
ICMP
BGP
L2 Data Link
Ethernet
ARP
PPP
TCP: TRANSMISSION CONTROL
Connection-oriented protocol providing reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of a stream of octets. Ideal for applications requiring high reliability.
SYN
SYN-ACK
ACK
Three-Way Handshake: Ensures both sides are ready to exchange data before any transmission begins.
UDP: USER DATAGRAM
A simple connectionless communication model with a minimum of protocol mechanism. It provides checksums for data integrity but no delivery guarantees.
DATA
DATA (LOST)
Best Effort: Transmission is fast with low overhead. Suitable for real-time traffic like voice, video, or online gaming.
In the OSI architecture, each layer serves the one above it and is served by the one below it. The physical layer deals with electrical signals, while the application layer manages end-user processes. In the TCP/IP suite, the four layers are designed for interoperability across diverse physical networks. This modularity allows
the internet to function as a “network of networks,” where high-level applications remain agnostic to the specific hardware (be it fiber optics or satellite) carrying the binary pulses. The primary trade-off in the transport layer is between the reliability and ordering of TCP versus the speed and efficiency of UDP.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅插画作品，描绘了一只全身覆盖火焰的红色神兽，形似麒麟，占据画面中央偏下的大部分区域。神兽头部朝向左侧，身体向右延伸，姿态生动。背景呈现米黄色至浅棕色的做旧纸张纹理，营造出古朴的氛围。画面左侧中部有竖排的深色文字“山海•经”，作为标题。右上角是多行竖排的古文，内容为“麟者仁兽 圣王之嘉瑞也 时元明王 出而遇获 仲尼伤周道之不兴 感嘉瑞之元应 故因鲁春秋 而修中兴之教 绝笔于获麟之一句 所感而作 故所以为终也”。右下角同样有竖排的深色文字“麒麟”，作为标签。所有文字均采用竖排书写方式。
prompt_en: This is an illustration depicting a red mythical beast, resembling a Qilin, covered in flame-like patterns, dominating the central-lower part of the image. The creature's head faces left, with its body extending to the right, in a dynamic pose. The background features a beige to light brown aged paper texture, creating an antique atmosphere. On the mid-left side of the image, there is vertically aligned dark text "山海•经" (Shanhai Jing), serving as a title. The upper right corner contains multiple lines of vertically aligned classical Chinese text, which reads: "麟者仁兽 圣王之嘉瑞也 时元明王 出而遇获 仲尼伤周道之不兴 感嘉瑞之元应 故因鲁春秋 而修中兴之教 绝笔于获麟之一句 所感而作 故所以为终也". In the lower right corner, there is also vertically aligned dark text "麒麟" (Qilin), acting as a label. All text is written vertically.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色照片，展示了中国农历新年期间一条繁忙的传统街巷。画面中央上方悬挂着一个大型霓虹灯招牌，上面用绿色和红色字体写着“NND 春节快乐”。街巷两侧是古朴的建筑，灰砖墙面与红色的木质门窗和屋檐相映成趣。左侧一家店铺的门楣上方挂着“潮州猪肚鸡”的牌匾，其上方还有“老北京”字样，下方则有“开门大吉”的红色牌匾。店铺门前装饰着红色的竖幅，上面写有“生意兴隆”和“招财进宝”，顶部有一个“福”字。街巷中人头攒动，许多行人穿着冬装，有的手持小吃，有的提着购物袋。右侧有一个商品摊位，展示并出售印有“NND”字样的T恤，包括白色、红色和黑色款式，摊位前方的红色展示架上也印有“NND”。整个街巷洋溢着浓厚的节日气氛，挂满了红灯笼和鞭炮状装饰。
prompt_en: This is a color photograph depicting a bustling traditional street alley during the Chinese Lunar New Year. A large neon sign hangs above the center of the alley, displaying "NND 春节快乐" (NND Happy Spring Festival) in green and red characters. On both sides of the alley are quaint buildings with grey brick walls, complemented by red wooden doors, windows, and eaves. Above a shop entrance on the left, there is a plaque reading "潮州猪肚鸡" (Chaozhou Pork Belly Chicken), with "老北京" (Old Beijing) above it and a red plaque with "开门大吉" (Good luck for business) below. The shop entrance is adorned with red vertical banners, featuring "生意兴隆" (Prosperous Business) and "招财进宝" (Bringing in Wealth and Treasure), topped with a "福" (Fortune) character. The alley is crowded with people in winter attire, some holding snacks, others carrying shopping bags. On the right, a merchandise stall displays and sells T-shirts printed with "NND" in white, red, and black, and the red display stand in front of the stall also features "NND". The entire alley is filled with a strong festive atmosphere, decorated with red lanterns and firecracker-shaped ornaments.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于现代CPU微架构的技术文档或信息图。图片以深色背景为主，文字多为白色，部分标题和关键信息使用红色或绿色突出显示。文档结构清晰，顶部是主标题“现代 CPU 微架构: 从硅片到三级缓存”和副标题“军用级硬件维护与结构部署规范手册”，下方标有文档编号。内容分为四个主要部分，分别以“[ STEP 01 ]”、“[ STEP 02 ]”、“[ STEP 03 ]”和“[ DATA ]”为引导。第一部分“物理安装与座圈锁紧机制”通过图示和文字说明了CPU的安装步骤及注意事项。第二部分“流水线指令执行周期”用流程图展示了指令从提取到写回的五个阶段。第三部分“高速缓存层级检索”通过示意图和文字描述了L1、L2、L3缓存的层级结构和数据检索流向。第四部分“[ DATA ]”则以表格形式列出了不同缓存单元的规格参数，包括容量、响应时间和共享属性。底部是机密文献的页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical document or infographic about modern CPU microarchitecture. The image features a dark background with most text in white, while some headings and key information are highlighted in red or green. The document has a clear structure, with the main title "现代 CPU 微架构: 从硅片到三级缓存" (Modern CPU Microarchitecture: From Silicon to L3 Cache) and subtitle "军用级硬件维护与结构部署规范手册" (Military-Grade Hardware Maintenance and Structure Deployment Specification Manual) at the top, followed by a document number. The content is divided into four main sections, introduced by "[ STEP 01 ]", "[ STEP 02 ]", "[ STEP 03 ]", and "[ DATA ]". The first section, "物理安装与座圈锁紧机制" (Physical Installation and Socket Locking Mechanism), uses a diagram and text to illustrate CPU installation steps and precautions. The second section, "流水线指令执行周期" (Pipeline Instruction Execution Cycle), presents a flowchart showing the five stages of instruction processing from fetch to writeback. The third section, "高速缓存层级检索" (Cache Hierarchy Retrieval), describes the hierarchical structure of L1, L2, and L3 caches and data retrieval flow using a schematic diagram and text. The fourth section, "[ DATA ]" (Data), provides a table listing the specifications of different cache units, including capacity, response time, and sharing attributes. Confidential document footer information is located at the bottom.

In the red box at the top left, the brand name "ANDREA" and its Chinese equivalent "安德丽" are visible. The main title "眼博会" (Eye Expo) is displayed in large, blue-to-white gradient characters. The badges are irregularly shaped with golden borders, featuring colorful enamel-like textures and glitter effects. One badge is centrally placed, surrounded by six others, forming a roughly hexagonal or floral arrangement. Each badge clearly displays "HARBIN 2025" text, a large number (indicating countdown days), corresponding Chinese commemorative text and date, and a cartoon mascot figure dressed in winter sports attire. These mascots exhibit various poses, such as skiing, holding a trophy, or holding a banner with "新年快乐" (Happy New Year) written on it. The backgrounds of the badges are rich in detail, depicting Harbin's cityscapes, winter sports scenes, or natural landscapes, including elements like ice sculptures, bridges, towers, mountains, and snowflakes. The badges are placed on a light-colored (off-white or light gray) surface, casting subtle shadows. Some badges overlap, with their edges covered by others.

On the left side, there is a prominent English title "CITY WALK" and its subtitle "| HISTORICAL ROUTE 01". The top right corner displays "上海" in Chinese and "SHANGHAI / 2024" in English, indicating the location and year. The central part of the poster includes two black and white photographs: one depicting a narrow street with old buildings, and another a close-up of an ornate window with a balcony. These two photos are diagonally overlapped. Below the left photo, there is white text "寻堂回响". The right side of the poster lists the theme "THEME 海派文化 深度漫步", followed by route points such as "START 武康大楼" and "STATION 思南公馆", connected by a dashed line and dots. One station also includes a descriptive text: "穿梭于红砖绿瓦之间，在历史的褶皱里寻找城市的温度。" Large, faded, 90-degree rotated English decorative words "DISTRICT" and "HISTORICAL" are printed in the background. The bottom left corner shows coordinate information "COORD: 31.2304° N, 121.4737° E", with three color blocks (black, red, white) below it. The bottom right corner features a call to action "EXPLORE MORE". The overall poster design uses an asymmetrical layout, combining bold sans-serif fonts with handwritten-style typography.

Below the main title, an introductory paragraph describes an analysis of the 7,000km overland trade artery. The main body of the graphic is divided into four columns, each with a numbered title (01 to 04) and a subtitle, focusing on "LOGISTICS CAPACITY", "NETWORK NODES", "COMMODITY FLOW", and "WESTERN TERMINUS" respectively. The first column features a textual description of Bactrian camels, a line graph showing load vs. distance efficiency, and a table with "Metric" and "Value" columns. The second column details core stations like Chang'an and Samarkand, and includes a table listing "Station", "Output", and "Depth Map". The third column describes the nature of trade exchanges and presents a bar chart illustrating the trade volume of "SILK", "SPICE", "GOLD", and "HORS". The fourth column introduces Western termini such as Baghdad and Venice, and lists "RISK FACTOR ANOMALIES" with their percentage data. The bottom of the graphic contains footer information, including document reference and vertical depth scale.

The center of the image features the woman's eyes and nose area, with blue eye makeup. Several blue rectangular frames highlight different parts of the face, accompanied by white English labels, such as "Pretty" in the upper right, "Ear" in the mid-left (next to a spiky metallic sphere), "Eye" in the mid-right, and "Nose" in the lower right (next to metallic blue flowers). In the bottom left corner, there are two blocks of white English text: above, "Maiden Classicism" repeated three times, and below, a four-line poem that reads: "Classical, distilled to a sigh. The shadow of a rose at dawn. Memory made perfect, yet distant. She is the pause before meaning." The overall image is dominated by dark blue, complemented by light blue and silver-white, creating a visual effect that blends technology with classicism.

内容: This analytical plate illustrates the structural taxonomy and physical dynamics governing volcanic eruptions. Classification is determined by crustal boundary conditions, magma silica saturation, and rheological viscosity. High-viscosity dacitic and rhyolitic magmas systematically yield highly explosive, gas-rich Plinian-type eruptions, whereas low-viscosity basaltic flows produce gentler effusive shields.

At the top, the main title "GLOBAL VOLCANO TYPES & ERUPTION DYNAMICS" is presented with a subtitle and an introductory paragraph. The middle-left section contains "FIG. 1. — MORPHOLOGICAL PROFILES OF VOLCANIC CONDUIT TYPES," illustrating three volcanic conduit profiles with labels for summit crater, central conduit system, and stratified layers. To its right, "FIG. 2. — VOLCANIC EXPLOSIVITY INDEX (VEI) EJECTA VOLUMES" is a bar chart using red and blue bars to represent ejecta volumes across different VEI levels. The lower-middle section on the left features "TABLE I. — GEOLOGICAL PROFILES AND MAGMA RHEOLOGY," a table listing six volcanic types with their viscosity, slope angle, primary ejecta, and representative specimens. On the right, a world map titled "GEOGRAPHIC TECTONIC DISTRIBUTION" highlights the Circum-Pacific Volcanic Ring, accompanied by a "TECTONIC DENSITY METRICS" box providing statistical data. The bottom of the page is divided into three columns, offering detailed information on "ERUPTIVE PHASES & MATERIALS," "MAGMA THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES," and "CHRONOLOGY OF MODERN ERUPTIONS." The very bottom includes the attribution "SURVEYED BY THE IMPERIAL GEOLOGICAL SOCIETY OF LONDON" and the date "MDCCCLVI — 1856."

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于中国传统色彩理论和颜料提取的教学信息图。图片整体背景为深蓝色，内容区域被划分为浅蓝色和深蓝色面板，采用三列布局。左侧面板包含一个红色警告框，提示朱砂等矿物颜料的毒性及使用注意事项；下方是一个圆形色轮图，标示了“FIRE | RED”、“CYAN | BLUE”等五行元素对应的颜色；底部文字解释了“五正色”与五行元素的关系。中间面板展示了一个详细的颜色分类与化学性质表格，列出了十一种传统颜色的中英文名称、色块、十六进制代码、来源材料和分类。表格下方是一个关于靛蓝发酵的提取示意图，包含“LEAF HARVEST”、“VAT STEEP”、“OXIDATION”三个步骤，并引用了“青出于蓝而胜于蓝”的谚语。右侧面板上方是一个部署序列流程图，详细说明了颜料制备、提取和固色的三个步骤。右侧面板下方是材料样本分析区，展示了青、赤、黄、白、黑、彩六种颜色的色块，并附有中英文名称。图片底部页脚包含版权信息和安全提示。
prompt_en: This is an instructional infographic about traditional Chinese color theory and pigment extraction. The image features a dark blue background, with content areas divided into light blue and dark blue panels, arranged in a three-column layout. The left panel includes a red warning box about the toxicity of mineral pigments like cinnabar and precautions for use; below it is a circular color wheel diagram labeled with colors corresponding to the Five Elements, such as "FIRE | RED" and "CYAN | BLUE"; text at the bottom explains the relationship between the "Wuzhengshe" (Five Primary Colors) and the Wu Xing elements. The middle panel presents a detailed table of color classification and chemical properties, listing eleven traditional colors with their Chinese and English names, color swatches, HEX codes, source materials, and classifications. Below the table is an extraction schematic for indigo fermentation, detailing three steps: "LEAF HARVEST," "VAT STEEP," and "OXIDATION," accompanied by the proverb "Blue is extracted from the indigo plant, but is bluer than the plant it comes from." The upper right panel contains a deployment sequence flowchart, outlining three steps for pigment preparation, extraction, and fixation. The lower right panel is a material specimen analysis section, displaying color swatches for six colors—Qing (Cyan), Chi (Red), Huang (Yellow), Bai (White), Hei (Black), and Cai (Multi)—with their Chinese and English names. The image footer at the bottom includes copyright information and safety warnings.

prompt_cn: 这是一张日式料理的菜单或宣传海报。画面顶部是正在油炸的天妇罗特写，旁边标有“68元/份”的价格。海报的主标题“日和本风料理雅韵”以黑色大字垂直排列在右上角，其左侧有白色小字“精选食材,匠心制作”。左侧区域垂直排列着“新鲜直送”和“海洋之味”的黑色文字，下方展示了甜虾刺身、金枪鱼刺身和三文鱼刺身，每道菜品都配有图片、名称、价格（如“108元/份”）以及红色的“产地直送”标签。左下角是寿司组合和加州卷的图片、名称和价格。右侧区域标题为“用餐提示”，列出了五条顾客须知，如“请提前告知服务员您的任何饮食限制或过敏情况”。下方是“·风味炸物·”标题下的烤鸡肉串、盐烤鲭鱼和烤鳗鱼，同样配有图片、名称和价格。整个背景顶部为深色，底部为浅米色，并带有几何图案。
prompt_en: This is a Japanese cuisine menu or promotional poster. The top of the image features a close-up of tempura being deep-fried, with a price of "68元/份" next to it. The main title of the poster, "日和本风料理雅韵", is vertically arranged in large black characters in the upper right corner, with smaller white text "精选食材,匠心制作" to its left. The left section has vertical black text "新鲜直送" and "海洋之味", below which are images, names, and prices (e.g., "108元/份") for sweet shrimp sashimi, tuna sashimi, and salmon sashimi, each accompanied by a red "产地直送" label. The bottom left shows images, names, and prices for sushi combo and California rolls. The right section is titled "用餐提示" (Dining Tips) and lists five customer notices, such as "请提前告知服务员您的任何饮食限制或过敏情况" (Please inform the waiter of any dietary restrictions or allergies in advance). Below this is the "·风味炸物·" (Fried Delicacies) section, featuring grilled chicken skewers, grilled mackerel, and grilled eel, also with images, names, and prices. The overall background is dark at the top and light beige with a geometric pattern at the bottom.

USB4 v2.0 引入了 PAM3 (三电平脉冲幅度调制) 信号编码，在不显著提高物理频率的前提下，实现了带宽翻倍。这种调制方式在每个时钟周期传输更多比特。
Type-C 接口支持 DisplayPort Alt Mode 和 PCIe 隧道，使其成为真正意义上的单一电缆解决方案 (Single Cable Solution)，兼容 8K 视频输出与外部 GPU 连接。

prompt_cn:
这是一张关于USB接口标准演进的信息图表。图表以深灰色为背景，标题为“USB 接口标准家族树: 从 USB 1.0 到 USB4 V2.0 的传输演进”，副标题为“EVOLUTION OF UNIVERSAL SERIAL BUS STANDARDS”。图表内容分为多个区域，顶部右侧有“庚子年肆月记”的日期标记。
左上角是“ORIGIN / 起源”部分，介绍了USB的历史和带宽演进，并突出显示“80 Gbps”为“CURRENT PEAK / 当前峰值速率”。中间上方是“PHYSICAL INTERFACE / 物理形态”部分，展示了Type-A、Type-B、Type-C、Micro-B和Mini-USB五种USB接口的示意图，并配有文字说明。右上角是“CHRONOLOGY / 编年”部分，以列表形式列出了从1996年的USB 1.0到2022年的USB4 v2.0的各个版本及其主要特性。
图表中部是一个“SPECIFICATION COMPARISON / 技术参数对比”表格，详细对比了USB 2.0到USB4 v2.0各版本的市场名称、最大带宽和主要特性。表格右侧是“POWER DELIVERY / 供电”部分，突出显示“240 W”并说明了PD 3.1协议的供电能力。
图表下方是“BANDWIDTH GROWTH LOGIC / 带宽演进辑示”区域，包含一个名为“LOGARITHMIC GROWTH / 对数级增长”的折线图，展示了USB 1.1、USB 2.0、USB 3.0、USB 3.2 Gen2x2和USB4 v2.0的带宽增长趋势。最下方是“DATA ENCODING / 编码”和“ALT MODE / 扩展模式”两个文字说明区域，分别解释了PAM3调制技术和Type-C接口的扩展功能。页脚包含数据来源和设计信息。
prompt_en:
This is an infographic illustrating the evolution of USB interface standards. The chart features a dark gray background with the main title "USB 接口标准家族树: 从 USB 1.0 到 USB4 V2.0 的传输演进" and the subtitle "EVOLUTION OF UNIVERSAL SERIAL BUS STANDARDS". The content is divided into multiple sections, with a date mark "庚子年肆月记" at the top right.
The top-left section, titled "ORIGIN / 起源", introduces the history and bandwidth evolution of USB, highlighting "80 Gbps" as the "CURRENT PEAK / 当前峰值速率". The top-middle section, "PHYSICAL INTERFACE / 物理形态", displays schematic diagrams of five USB connector types: Type-A, Type-B, Type-C, Micro-B, and Mini-USB, accompanied by textual explanations. The top-right section, "CHRONOLOGY / 编年", lists various USB versions from USB 1.0 in 1996 to USB4 v2.0 in 2022, along with their key characteristics.
In the middle of the chart, a "SPECIFICATION COMPARISON / 技术参数对比" table provides a detailed comparison of USB 2.0 to USB4 v2.0 versions, including their marketing names, maximum bandwidth, and key features. To the right of the table is the "POWER DELIVERY / 供电" section, highlighting "240 W" and explaining the power delivery capabilities of the PD 3.1 protocol.
Below the table, the "BANDWIDTH GROWTH LOGIC / 带宽演进辑示" area contains a line graph titled "LOGARITHMIC GROWTH / 对数级增长", showing the bandwidth growth trend for USB 1.1, USB 2.0, USB 3.0, USB 3.2 Gen2x2, and USB4 v2.0. The bottom-most sections are "DATA ENCODING / 编码" and "ALT MODE / 扩展模式", which explain PAM3 modulation technology and the extended functionalities of the Type-C interface, respectively. The footer includes data source and editorial design information.

Vallum.

territory.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以蓝天白云为背景的公益宣传海报，画面中央描绘了一位身着红衣蓝裤、头戴斗笠的卡通武士，他手持一把弯刀，刀刃上写有“刀下不留非法交易”。武士正摆出格斗姿势，前方散落着几枚星形飞镖，其中一枚飞镖上标有“外盘期货”，另一枚被画面右下角伸出的一双手握住，上面标有“高额回报”。武士身后偏右侧有一个红色大鼓，鼓面上写着“擂”字。海报顶部是“中国金融期货交易所”及其英文名称，以及“中金所期货学院”及其英文名称和宣传语“国字号认证期货教育”。画面上方红色醒目大字标题为“外盘期货无监管 非法交易‘藏暗器’”，下方配有白色正文解释外盘期货的风险。
prompt_en: This is a public service announcement poster set against a blue sky with white clouds. The center of the image features a cartoon warrior figure, dressed in a red top and blue pants, wearing a straw hat. He holds a curved sword, on which the text "刀下不留非法交易" (No illegal transactions under the sword) is written. The warrior is in a fighting stance, with several star-shaped darts scattered in front of him. One dart is labeled "外盘期货" (Offshore Futures), and another is held by a pair of hands extending from the bottom right, labeled "高额回报" (High Returns). Behind the warrior, slightly to the right, is a large red drum with the character "擂" (Beat/Drum) on its surface. At the top of the poster are the names "中国金融期货交易所" (China Financial Futures Exchange) and its English equivalent, along with "中金所期货学院" (CFFEX Futures and Options Institute), its English name, and the slogan "国字号认证期货教育" (State-certified futures education). The prominent red title at the top reads "外盘期货无监管 非法交易‘藏暗器’" (Offshore futures unregulated, illegal transactions 'hide dark weapons'), accompanied by white body text explaining the risks of offshore futures.

prompt_cn:
这张图片是一张宣传活动的海报或邀请函。画面背景是一幅黑白或去饱和处理的城市夜景航拍图，展现了密集的建筑灯光。前景叠加了一个深灰色半透明的矩形区域，用于承载大部分文字信息。整体色调以黑、白、灰为主，并以黄色作为强调色。

图片顶部左侧是品牌名称“赫府·悦居”及其副标题“LIN'S PRIVATE RESIDENCE”，顶部中央有“LIMITED ED”，顶部右侧是编号“NO. 2024-0520”。左侧中央区域，一个黄色矩形背景上标有“NEW LIFE”，下方是活动主标题“公寓派对 零食之夜”，其中“公寓派对”为白色大字，“零食之夜”为黄色大字。主标题下方是活动描述：“在城市之巅，开启一段关于味蕾与新居的电影感旅程。”

再下方是“派对成分表 / DETAILS”副标题，接着是活动详情列表，以两列形式呈现，包括日期、时间、地点和着装要求等具体信息。

图片右侧中央有一个黑白条形码图案，下方是“RSVP-2024”、“NET WEIGHT”以及“无限快乐 / ∞”等文字。左下角是多行备注信息，说明了现场提供的服务和出席确认要求。右下角有一个“扫码开启导航”的提示，下方是一个带有白色边框的矩形按钮，内部写有“MAP”字样。
prompt_en:
This image is an event poster or invitation. The background features a black and white or desaturated aerial view of a city at night, showing dense building lights. A dark gray translucent rectangular overlay is superimposed in the foreground, holding most of the text information. The overall color scheme is dominated by black, white, and gray, with yellow used as an accent color.

At the top left of the image is the brand name "赫府·悦居" and its subtitle "LIN'S PRIVATE RESIDENCE". "LIMITED ED" is at the top center, and the number "NO. 2024-0520" is at the top right. In the central left area, a yellow rectangular background displays "NEW LIFE". Below it is the event's main title, "公寓派对 零食之夜", with "公寓派对" in large white text and "零食之夜" in large yellow text. Below the main title is the event description: "在城市之巅，开启一段关于味蕾与新居的电影感旅程." (At the pinnacle of the city, embark on a cinematic journey of taste buds and new residences.)

Further down is the subtitle "派对成分表 / DETAILS" (Party Ingredients / DETAILS), followed by a list of event details presented in two columns, including specific information such as date, time, location, and dress code.

On the central right side of the image, there is a black and white barcode pattern, with "RSVP-2024", "NET WEIGHT", and "无限快乐 / ∞" (Infinite Happiness / ∞) text below it. The bottom left corner contains multi-line remarks detailing on-site services and attendance confirmation requirements. The bottom right corner shows a "扫码开启导航" (Scan to navigate) prompt, below which is a white-bordered rectangular button with "MAP" written inside.

桥梁的演进是一部与重力、拉力及压力博弈的史诗。从最初以抗弯为主的简支梁,到利用几何形态将荷载转化为纯压力的拱桥,再到现代依靠高强钢索将荷载悬吊拉索的高空结构,力学形式的变化不断突破着人类工程的极限跨度。
01 弯曲应力
梁桥 BEAM BRIDGE
最基础的桥型,桥墩支撑横梁。受力特征为上部受压、下部受拉。材料抗弯强度决定了其跨度。
极限经济跨度:~80m
04 悬臂弯矩
悬臂桥 CANTILEVER BRIDGE
两端向中心延伸并连接,受力状态类似跳水悬臂板。弯矩在支座处达到最大。
极限经济跨度:~500m
02 拉压杆件
桁架桥 TRUSS BRIDGE
由三角形钢骨架构成,通过拉压杆件将弯矩应力分散至整个框架。节点仅传递轴向力。
极限经济跨度:100-300m
05 斜拉梁压
斜拉桥 CABLE-STAYED BRIDGE
主塔通过斜拉索直接拉住梁体,呈A型或竖琴型。拉索受拉,主梁受压。
极限经济跨度:500-1100m
03 自身受压
拱桥 ARCH BRIDGE
荷载沿拱圈传递至两侧基座,全靠自身抗压,无拉应力。跨度可达500米以上。
极限经济跨度:500m+
06 轴向受拉
悬索桥 SUSPENSION BRIDGE
悬挂在主缆上的吊索拉起桥面,主缆受拉力。跨越能力极大,适合深水天堑。
极限经济跨度:1000-3000m+

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于桥梁结构力学原理与极限跨度的信息图表。页面顶部是页眉，包含“PAGE 042 / SECTION D”和“STRUCTURAL MECHANICS & ARCHITECTURAL LIMITS 力学结构与几何极限,特别专题”。主标题为“世界6大桥梁结构力学原理与极限跨度”。图表主体分为三个主要部分：左侧是引言，标题为“人类跨越天堑的几何演进”，并配有“重力博弈”和“应力分配”标签，下方是关于桥梁演进的文字描述。中间部分以两列形式详细介绍了六种桥梁类型，包括梁桥、桁架桥、拱桥、悬臂桥、斜拉桥和悬索桥，每种桥梁都标有编号、中英文名称、力学原理描述、极限经济跨度及一个简化的结构示意图。底部是一个名为“桥梁结构力学性能比较”的表格，对比了不同桥梁类型的结构类型、主控应力、极限跨度及代表桥梁，并配有“压力结构”和“拉力结构”的图例。页面底部是页脚，包含“SECTION D: CIVIL ENGINEERING AND STRUCTURES”、“PAGE 042”和版权信息。

The top of the page features a header with "PAGE 042 / SECTION D" and "STRUCTURAL MECHANICS & ARCHITECTURAL LIMITS 力学结构与几何极限,特别专题". The main title reads "世界6大桥梁结构力学原理与极限跨度". The main body of the infographic is divided into three primary sections: The left side presents an introduction titled "人类跨越天堑的几何演进", accompanied by "重力博弈" (Gravity Game) and "应力分配" (Stress Distribution) tags, followed by a textual description of bridge evolution. The central part is arranged in two columns, detailing six bridge types: Beam Bridge, Truss Bridge, Arch Bridge, Cantilever Bridge, Cable-Stayed Bridge, and Suspension Bridge. Each type is numbered and includes its Chinese and English names, a description of its mechanical principles, its economic span limit, and a simplified structural diagram. The bottom section features a comparative table titled "桥梁结构力学性能比较" (Comparison of Bridge Structural Mechanical Properties), which contrasts different bridge types based on their structural type, dominant stress, span limit, and representative bridges, along with a legend for "压力结构" (Compression Structure) and "拉力结构" (Tension Structure). The page footer includes "SECTION D: CIVIL ENGINEERING AND STRUCTURES", "PAGE 042", and copyright information.

The bottom of the poster is laid out in three columns: "DATE" with "11.24 - 11.27" on the left, "VENUE" with "国际机械博览中心" (International Machinery Expo Center) in the middle, and a slogan "探索现代装备UI与工业4.0的完美融合。构建未来生产力。" (Exploring the perfect integration of modern equipment UI and Industry 4.0. prompt_cn: 这是一张关于ABO和Rh血型系统及输血机制的信息图。图片整体背景为黑色，顶部中央是标题“ABO & RH BLOOD SYSTEMS”，下方是副标题“ANTIGEN MATRIX & TRANSFUSION MECHANICS”，标题右侧有一个红黄相间的四角星形图标。图片内容分为三个主要区域：中部左侧展示了一个红细胞（RBC）的扫描图示，中央红色圆圈内标有“RBC”，周围有绿色虚线圆环和黄绿线条，上方有“SCAN MODE: ACTIVE”和“ERYTHROCYTE CORE”标签。中部右侧是四个红色背景的信息块，分别介绍了TYPE A、TYPE B、TYPE AB和TYPE O四种血型，包括其表面抗原、血浆抗体、反应特性及各自的百分比（42%、10%、04%、44%）。底部区域左侧是“RH FACTOR ANALYSIS”部分，包含一段关于Rh系统D抗原的文字描述，以及Rh+ (D+)和Rh- (D-)的百分比（85%绿色，15%红色）。底部区域右侧是“COMPATIBILITY MATRIX”表格，以黑底白字显示了不同血型间的输血兼容性，表格下方有脚注解释通用供血者和受血者。底部中央是一个绿色边框的黑色信息块，标题为“FETAL INCOMPATIBILITY ALERT”，左侧有一个红色加号图标，内容描述了Rh阴性母亲与Rh阳性胎儿可能导致的新生儿溶血病。图片底部页脚处有“PLATE NO. 088 // HEMATOLOGY SERIES”和“CONFIDENTIAL MEDICAL DATA // 1974 EDITION”字样。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing the ABO and Rh blood systems and transfusion mechanics. The overall background of the image is black. At the top center, the main title reads "ABO & RH BLOOD SYSTEMS", with the subtitle "ANTIGEN MATRIX & TRANSFUSION MECHANICS" below it. To the right of the title is a red and yellow four-pointed star icon. The image content is divided into three main sections: The middle-left section displays a scan diagram of a red blood cell (RBC), with "RBC" in a central red circle, surrounded by green dashed rings and yellow-green lines. Above it are labels "SCAN MODE: ACTIVE" and "ERYTHROCYTE CORE". The middle-right section contains four information blocks with red backgrounds, each describing one of the four blood types: TYPE A, TYPE B, TYPE AB, and TYPE O. Each block includes details on surface antigens, plasma antibodies, reaction characteristics, and their respective percentages (42%, 10%, 04%, 44%). The bottom-left section is "RH FACTOR ANALYSIS", which includes a text description of the Rh system's D-Antigen, and percentages for Rh+ (D+) and Rh- (D-) (85% in green, 15% in red). The bottom-right section features a "COMPATIBILITY MATRIX" table, presented with white text on a black background, illustrating blood type transfusion compatibility. A footnote below the table explains universal donors and recipients. At the bottom center, there is a black information block with a green border, titled "FETAL INCOMPATIBILITY ALERT". To its left is a red plus icon. The content describes Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn (HDN) that can result from an Rh-negative mother carrying an Rh-positive fetus. The footer at the very bottom of the image displays "PLATE NO. 088 // HEMATOLOGY SERIES" on the left and "CONFIDENTIAL MEDICAL DATA // 1974 EDITION" on the right.

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于恒星演化系统和生命周期映射的美国专利文件。页面采用两栏布局，左侧顶部是专利信息，包括“UNITED STATES PATENT”字样、专利号“10,727,042 B2”、专利日期“May 21, 2024”，以及主标题“STELLAR EVOLUTIONARY SYSTEM AND LIFE-CYCLE MAPPING”。下方列出了发明人“Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar, Hans Bethe, Arthur Eddington”和受让人“Galactic Regulatory Authority (GRA)”。左下角是一个名为“EVOLUTIONARY THRESHOLD DATA”的表格，详细列出了恒星的初始质量、主要燃料、残余类型和极限质量。右侧区域包含两个图表和详细描述。图1是“H-R DIAGRAM SCHEMATIC”，展示了恒星的光度与表面温度关系，图中有三个蓝色圆圈标记（101, 102, 103）对应下方的图例。图2是“BIFURCATION LOGIC”，一个流程图，描绘了恒星从“Molecular Cloud”开始，根据质量阈值（< 8 M☉, > 8 M☉）分化为不同演化阶段和最终残骸（如“White Dwarf 204”、“Neutron Star 208”、“Black Hole 210”）的路径。右下角的正文标题为“TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & DETAILED DESCRIPTION”，包含四段编号为[0001]至[0004]的文字，详细解释了恒星演化的过程和图表内容。

Below the main title, the inventors "Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar, Hans Bethe, Arthur Eddington" and assignee "Galactic Regulatory Authority (GRA)" are listed. The bottom left contains a table titled "EVOLUTIONARY THRESHOLD DATA", detailing initial mass, main fuel, remnant type, and limiting mass of stars. The right section includes two diagrams and a detailed description. Figure 1, "H-R DIAGRAM SCHEMATIC", illustrates the relationship between stellar luminosity and surface temperature, with three blue circular markers (101, 102, 103) corresponding to the legend below. Figure 2, "BIFURCATION LOGIC", is a flowchart depicting the stellar evolution path from "Molecular Cloud", branching based on mass thresholds (< 8 M☉, > 8 M☉) into different evolutionary stages and final remnants (e.g., "White Dwarf 204", "Neutron Star 208", "Black Hole 210"). The bottom right section, titled "TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & DETAILED DESCRIPTION", contains four numbered paragraphs from [0001] to [0004] that elaborate on the stellar evolution process and diagram content.

古罗马军团编制架构
公元一世纪帝国军团(LEGIO)指挥层级与战术单位之解剖
FIG. I
军团组织系统解剖图谱
军团长 LEGATUS
第一大队 (800人)
普通大队 (480人)
附属骑兵 (120人)
百人队 (80人)
轻便小队 (8人)
FIG. II
战术细胞: 百人队与大队
百人队(Centuria)是军团内最核心的行政与战术单位。虽名为百人, 但在公元一世纪的实际编制通常为80名重装步兵。每10个步兵组成一个“帐篷小队”(Contubernium), 共用一套烹饪用具与骡子。百夫长(Centurion)是该单位的灵魂, 负责维持严酷的纪律与日常操练。由6个百人队组成的大队(Cohort)构成了军团的标准战术集群, 全员约480人, 具备独立作战与防御能力。
FIG. III
鹰旗: 第一大队的特权
第一大队(Cohors Prima)处于指挥层级的顶点。其编制人数几乎是普通大队的两倍, 达到约800人, 由五名资深百夫长指挥。最重要的是区别在于, 该大队负责守护军团的鹰旗(Aquila)。鹰旗手(Aquilifer)穿着兽皮, 手持纯金或镀金的鹰旗。这被视为军团的神圣灵魂、一旦鹰旗丢失。整个军团将被视为蒙羞并可能面临撤编。这种高度集中的荣誉感确保了战前战线的绝对稳定性。

III 鹰旗: 第一大队的特权”，详细阐述了相关概念。图片底部左侧是“公元一世纪标准单兵装备参数”表格，列出了短剑、方盾、标枪和环片甲的名称、物理特征和战斗用途。右侧是“NOTAE 临床观察笔记”，包含三条关于军团的补充信息。最下方是页脚“ROMANI IMPERII EXERCITUS . AD 100”和“帝国总参谋部解剖档案 严禁复制”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing the organizational structure of the ancient Roman Legion. The image features a dark green background with all text in white or light gray, while some key characters and diagram connecting lines are red. At the top, the main title "古罗马军团编制架构" (Organizational Structure of the Ancient Roman Legion) is displayed, followed by the subtitle "公元一世纪帝国军团(LEGIO)指挥层级与战术单位之解剖" (Anatomy of the Imperial Legion (LEGIO) Command Hierarchy and Tactical Units in the 1st Century AD). Below this is "FIG. I 军团组织系统解剖图谱" (Anatomical Chart of Legion Organization System), which uses boxes and lines to illustrate the hierarchical relationships and personnel numbers, from "军团长 LEGATUS" (Legion Commander LEGATUS) down to "第一大队 (800人)" (First Cohort (800 men)), "普通大队 (480人)" (Standard Cohort (480 men)), "附属骑兵 (120人)" (Auxiliary Cavalry (120 men)), "百人队 (80人)" (Centuria (80 men)), and "轻便小队 (8人)" (Light Squad (8 men)). Below the diagram are two columns of text: the left column is "FIG. II 战术细胞: 百人队与大队" (Tactical Cells: Centuria and Cohort), and the right column is "FIG. III 鹰旗: 第一大队的特权" (The Eagle Standard: Privilege of the First Cohort), both elaborating on their respective concepts. The bottom left of the image presents a table titled "公元一世纪标准单兵装备参数" (Standard Individual Equipment Parameters in the 1st Century AD), listing the name, physical characteristics, and combat use for Gladius (short sword), Scutum (shield), Pilum (javelin), and Lorica (segmentata). To its right is "NOTAE 临床观察笔记" (Clinical Observation Notes), containing three supplementary points about the legion. The very bottom includes the footer "ROMANI IMPERII EXERCITUS . AD 100" and "帝国总参谋部解剖档案 严禁复制" (Imperial General Staff Anatomy Archives. Reproduction Strictly Forbidden).

The top of the interface features a title bar with "选择收货地址" (Select Delivery Address) on the left and an "新增地址" (Add New Address) button on the right. Below the title bar is a search box, including a search icon and the placeholder text "搜索写字楼 / 小区 / 学校" (Search Office Building / Community / School). The middle section of the interface shows a black-and-white aerial map area depicting city buildings, with a blue location marker at its center. Below the map, an information card displays the "当前定位" (Current Location) detailed address "上海市浦东新区陆家嘴环路1000号" (Lujiazui Ring Road No. 1000, Pudong New Area, Shanghai) and a "重新定位" (Relocate) button on the right. Below the map area is a "附近地址" (Nearby Addresses) list, containing three address entries: "恒生银行大厦" (Hang Seng Bank Tower), "上海国金中心 IFC" (Shanghai IFC), and "金茂大厦" (Jin Mao Tower). Each entry shows the building name, specific address, distance, and estimated walking time, along with a type label (e.g., "写字楼" (Office Building) with a light blue background, "购物中心" (Shopping Mall) with an orange background). The bottom of the interface features an "已选地址" (Selected Address) area, showing the currently selected "恒生银行大厦" and a "确认位置" (Confirm Location) button with a blue background and white text on the right. The overall interface has a light gray background, with main text in dark blue and auxiliary text in gray.

prompt_cn: 这是一张卡通风格的暑期反诈骗公益海报。海报顶部是醒目的标题“暑期护航，反诈同行”，采用大号、粗体、白色描边字，部分文字为蓝色和红色，具有立体感。海报中部被分为左右两格漫画场景。左侧漫画描绘了一只猫咪在电脑前打电话，上方有钱币飞舞，一只狼在另一台电脑后，气泡中写有“刷单 (刷单诈骗)”，下方配有警示语“兼职刷单，馅饼是陷阱！”。右侧漫画中，一只猫咪正在玩掌上游戏机，一只狐狸提着一个露出手枪的纸袋，气泡中文字为“购买 假包装备”，下方警示语为“游戏交易，谨防被骗！”。海报底部，一只戴着警帽、穿着警服的卡通猫咪手持扩音器，其右侧的对话气泡内写有重要的防诈骗口号：“不轻信，不转账，不透露！”。警官猫咪下方设有一个二维码和两个圆形官方徽章。整张海报通过生动的漫画和明确的文字，旨在宣传防范刷单和游戏交易等诈骗行为。
prompt_en: This cartoon-style public service announcement poster promotes summer anti-fraud awareness. The top features a prominent title, "暑期护航，反诈同行" (Summer Escort, Anti-Fraud Together), in large, bold, white outlined text with blue and red accents, creating a 3D effect. The middle section is divided into two cartoon scenes. The left scene shows a cat on a computer, talking on the phone, with money flying around and a wolf behind another computer. A speech bubble reads "刷单 (刷单诈骗)" (Brush Order (Brush Order Fraud)), and a warning below states: "兼职刷单，馅饼是陷阱！" (Part-time brush order, pie is a trap!). The right scene depicts a cat playing a handheld game console, while a fox holds a paper bag revealing a gun. A speech bubble says "购买 假包装备" (Purchase fake packaged equipment), with a warning below: "游戏交易，谨防被骗！" (Game transactions, beware of being cheated!). At the bottom, a police cat in uniform holds a megaphone. To its right, a speech bubble displays the anti-fraud slogan: "不轻信，不转账，不透露！" (Don't easily trust, don't transfer money, don't reveal!). Below the police cat are a QR code and two circular official emblems. The poster effectively uses vivid cartoons and clear text to warn against scams like brush order and game transaction fraud.

Another man stands behind him, slightly to the left. In the background, a woman in a black gown stands towards the center-right, while on the far right, a woman in a sheer red gown stands with her back to the viewer, exposing her back. The entire scene is set in a foggy forest, dominated by dark tones, with the flames and red gown providing a stark contrast. The series title, "the Vampire Diaries," is centered at the top of the poster, with the "V" and "i" in "Vampire" in red, and the rest in white. White promotional text is vertically aligned in the bottom right corner, including "SEASON PREMIERE OCT 3," "THURS 8/7c," and "THE CW NOW" with the CW logo.

The bottom section contains a "TACTICAL COMBAT LOG" area with three log entries, such as "[14:12:01] WARN: Kinetic impact.", where keywords like "WARN", "INFO", and "OK" are highlighted in different colors. Rich floral patterns, primarily in beige, olive green, and soft orange, adorn the areas around and at the bottom of the arched frame. Multiple lines of beige text are distributed within the left arched area of the image. At the top is "The 1990s" in small script, followed by two lines of large cursive text "Flower Fables". Below that are four lines of medium sans-serif body text: "FROM THEN ON. I ALWAYS LOOKED BACK AT THE ROAD.". At the very bottom is "NOTEBOOK" in large sans-serif with a decorative 'O' crossed by a curve. The entire illustration conveys an elegant cover design aesthetic.

text:
PLATE NO. 042 / 食品科学与工艺
全球奶酪
分类图谱
奶酪是乳蛋白（酪蛋白）受凝乳酶或乳酸菌作用凝聚后的产物。通过分离乳清、控制水分及调整熟成周期，微生物在蛋白质与脂肪基质中演化出迥异的质地与风味。本图谱基于水分含量与熟成工艺，将全球奶酪划分为五大核心标准。
分类逻辑严格遵循乳液物理状态的改变：从含水量极高的非熟成新鲜奶酪，到经过数年脱水、产生酪氨酸结晶的超硬质奶酪。颜色编码代表了其工业化标准分类下的感官特性与技术指标。
生产工艺流程 / PRODUCTION SCHEMATIC

凝乳反应
凝乳 (Curd) > 固体形态
压榨与熟成
乳清 (Whey) > 液体副产
分类标准色卡 / CLASSIFICATION CHIPS
新鲜奶酪
水分含量 > 50%。不经熟成，保留乳酸清香。代表品种: Mozzarella, Ricotta, Mascarpone。
HEX: #FF5A5F
SYS.01: FRESH
白霉软质
表面喷洒白青霉 (P. camemberti)，形成天鹅绒外壳。熟成 3-4 周。代表品种: Brie, Camembert。
HEX: #00A699
SYS.02: SOFT
半硬质
经过压榨去水，质地致密有弹性。熟成数月。代表品种: Gouda, Cheddar, Edam。
HEX: #FC642D
SYS.03: SEMI
硬质/特硬
水分含量 < 30%。熟成 1-3 年，富含酪氨酸颗粒。代表品种: Parmigiano-Reggiano, Grana Padano。
HEX: #FFB400
SYS.04: HARD
蓝纹奶酪 / BLUE VEIN
制作过程中刺穿干酪体以充氧，促使洛克福青霉 (P. roqueforti) 在内部缝隙繁殖。风味辛辣、微咸，具有独特的蓝色理石纹路。代表品种: Roquefort, Gorgonzola, Stilton。熟成环境需严格控制湿度。
HEX: #111827
TYPE: OXYGENATED
TEMP: 10-12°C

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于全球奶酪分类与生产的信息图表。图表以白色为背景，主要文字为深灰色，并辅以多种彩色色块作为视觉分类标识。页面布局清晰，顶部包含标题“全球奶酪分类图谱”、引言和奶酪生产工艺流程图。流程图通过方框和箭头展示了从“原料乳”到“压榨与熟成”的步骤，并标注了“凝乳”和“乳清”等产物。中部是五块奶酪分类色卡，其中四块（红色、青色、橙色、黄色）呈2x2网格排列，分别代表新鲜奶酪、白霉软质、半硬质和硬质/特硬奶酪。每块色卡下方都详细列出了奶酪类型名称、描述、HEX颜色代码和系统分类代码。第五块深蓝色（近黑色）色卡单独位于下方，介绍了蓝纹奶酪的特点。图表底部是一个理化指标对比表格，详细展示了不同奶酪类型的水分含量、脂肪含量、熟成周期和核心微生物等数据。最下方是数据来源和版权信息。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about global cheese classification and production. The chart features a white background with dark gray text, complemented by various colored blocks serving as visual classification indicators. The page layout is clear, with the top section containing the title "Global Cheese Classification Atlas," an introduction, and a cheese production schematic. The flowchart uses boxes and arrows to illustrate steps from "Raw Milk" to "Pressing & Aging," noting products like "Curd" and "Whey." The middle section presents five cheese classification color cards; four of them (red, teal, orange, yellow) are arranged in a 2x2 grid, representing Fresh Cheese, Soft-Ripened Cheese, Semi-Hard Cheese, and Hard/Extra Hard Cheese, respectively. Below each card, the cheese type name, description, HEX color code, and system classification code are detailed. The fifth dark blue (nearly black) card is positioned separately below, describing the characteristics of Blue Vein Cheese. The bottom of the chart features a comparative table of physicochemical indicators, detailing data such as moisture content, fat content, aging period, and core microorganisms for different cheese types. The very bottom includes data source and copyright information.

prompt_en: This is a photograph taken on a clear day, showing the main facade of a modern multi-story building. The building's main body is light beige, featuring a regular grid-like window structure with dark frames and reflective glass. Red signs are placed both on the building's rooftop and above the main entrance. The rooftop sign displays "门诊楼" (Outpatient Building) and its English translation "OUTPATIENT BUILDING". The sign above the main entrance also repeats "OUTPATIENT BUILDING" and "门诊楼". Below this sign, above the main entrance, there is a red illuminated LED display scrolling the promotional message: "2024年消防安全宣传月活动主题：全民消防，生命至上" (2024 Fire Safety Publicity Month Theme: Fire Safety for All, Life First). In front of the building, there is a gray paved area and a green lawn with a few small trees. Several people are seen walking towards the building's entrance.

The top section features a dark blue banner with the main title "京剧脸谱色彩与谱式构图系统指南" (Peking Opera Facepaint Color & Geometric System) and system specifications. The main content area is white, divided into two columns. The left column presents a "色彩寓意与属性对照" (Color Matrix) table, listing colors, their symbolic meanings, proportions, and classic characters, with production details below. The right column displays a "五大基本谱式构图规范" (Composition System) table, outlining different face paint patterns, their geometric features, visual focus, contrast, and classic examples. At the bottom, two diagrams illustrate "谱式几何结构解析" (Geometric Model) and "色彩性格映射系统" (Conflict Mapping), both featuring red lines and points with bilingual labels. The document employs a mixed Chinese and English layout.

prompt_cn: 这是一张由四个独立广告组成的拼贴图片，呈2x2网格布局。左上角是草津温泉的广告，展示了一对男女在雪山背景下的露天温泉中泡澡，画面中包含竹制水管和白色毛巾，并配有温泉、住宿和巴士的图标。右上角是护发产品广告，一位长发女性展示着光泽的秀发，旁边放置着一罐名为“SILKY SMOOTH TREATMENT”的护发产品。左下角是寿司广告，展示了一盘摆放精美的寿司拼盘。右下角是编程课程广告，一名戴眼镜的男性坐在办公桌前使用电脑，屏幕上显示着代码，桌上放有咖啡杯，并配有手机和笔记本电脑的图标。图片中的文字内容主要为日文，夹杂少量英文和数字，温泉、护发和寿司广告均明确标示了价格。每个广告区域都采用了不同的主色调和视觉风格，如温泉广告的自然风光、护发广告的金色调、寿司广告的深色暖调以及编程广告的蓝色调。
prompt_en: This is a collage image composed of four independent advertisements, arranged in a 2x2 grid layout. The top-left quadrant features an advertisement for Kusatsu Onsen, showing a couple bathing in an outdoor hot spring against a snowy mountain backdrop, with a bamboo water spout and white towels, accompanied by icons for hot springs, accommodation, and a bus. The top-right quadrant displays a hair care product advertisement, with a long-haired woman showcasing her lustrous hair, next to a jar of hair product labeled “SILKY SMOOTH TREATMENT”. The bottom-left quadrant is a sushi advertisement, presenting a beautifully arranged sushi platter. The bottom-right quadrant is a programming course advertisement, depicting a bespectacled man sitting at a desk using a computer with code on the screen, a coffee cup on the desk, and accompanied by phone and laptop icons. The text content in the image is primarily Japanese, interspersed with some English and numbers. The hot spring, hair care, and sushi advertisements all clearly display prices. Each advertisement section adopts different main color schemes and visual styles, such as the natural scenery of the hot spring ad, the golden tones of the hair care ad, the dark warm tones of the sushi ad, and the blue tones of the programming ad.

The device list includes two card-style entries, each with a device thumbnail on the left, the device name and signal strength in the middle, and an "添加" (Add) button on the right. The first entry is "米家智能吸顶灯 Pro" (Mijia Smart Ceiling Light Pro) with "信号强度：极强" (Signal strength: Excellent), and its thumbnail shows a ceiling light. The second entry is "智能加湿器 2S" (Smart Humidifier 2S) with "信号强度：良好" (Signal strength: Good), and its thumbnail shows a humidifier. At the bottom, there is a light gray rounded rectangular button with the text "手动输入设备代码" (Manually enter device code). Below this information box is a blue horizontal line, with a white oval label centered on it, containing blue text "REFLECTION OF HEALTH". Each column includes a large, semi-transparent light blue number (01, 02, 03), a dark blue title (PREPARE, THREAD, C-SHAPE), and gray descriptive text. The dark bottom section features brand information "ORTHOCENTER Professional Dental Care Unit" on the left, and a prompt "SCAN FOR VIDEO TUTORIAL" with the website "WWW.ORTHO-CENTER.COM" on the right. prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类脑容量演变的信息图表。图表以黑色为背景，顶部有白色标题“人类脑容量演变”和英文副标题“4,000,000 YEARS OF CRANIAL EVOLUTION”，右侧有一个红色背景的标签“演化关键档案”。图片主体分为左右两部分，左侧展示了脑容量增长趋势的折线图和不同物种的脑容量信息框，右侧是“脑化指数(EQ)”的解释性文本、关键里程碑列表以及一个详细的物种数据表格。折线图描绘了从400万年前到现代的脑容量（CC）变化，并标注了南方古猿、能人、直立人、尼安德特人和智人的脑容量。下方还有一条“技术演化”的时间线，展示了奥杜威石器、阿舍利手斧、莫斯特技术和农业等阶段。图片左下角突出显示了“2,100,000”这一数字，并配有文字“大脑快速发育期的起始年限”。右下角是“EXPLORER ATLAS”的品牌标识。
prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the evolution of human cranial capacity. The image features a black background with a white main title "人类脑容量演变" and an English subtitle "4,000,000 YEARS OF CRANIAL EVOLUTION" at the top. A red-background label "演化关键档案" is on the top right. The main content is divided into two sections: the left side displays a line graph showing the trend of cranial capacity growth and information boxes for different species, while the right side contains an explanatory text for "脑化指数(EQ)", a list of key milestones, and a detailed table of species data. The line graph depicts the change in cranial capacity (CC) from 4 million years ago to the present, with specific capacities marked for Australopithecus, Homo Habilis, Homo Erectus, Neanderthal, and Homo Sapiens. Below, a "技术演化" (Technological Evolution) timeline shows stages like Oldowan tools, Acheulean hand axes, Mousterian technology, and agriculture. The bottom left highlights the number "2,100,000" with the text "大脑快速发育期的起始年限" (Starting age of rapid brain development). The bottom right features the "EXPLORER ATLAS" brand logo.

On the glass curtain wall at the front of the building, there is a golden floral logo on the left, and to its right are the golden Chinese characters "中国进出口商品交易会" with the corresponding English "CHINA IMPORT AND EXPORT FAIR" below. On the grey vertical panel to the right of the building, white numbers "5" and "4" are arranged vertically. In front of the building is a neatly trimmed green hedge, embedded with the white Chinese slogan "广交世界 互利天下" and its English counterpart "Canton Fair Global Share" below. Below the hedge is a sea of dense red flowers. Within the flower sea, on the left and right sides of the foreground, there are two yellow cartoon bee mascots wearing sunglasses, both facing forward. In the right foreground of the image, within the flower sea, stands a large golden 3D number "133", partially obscured by flowers. The overall composition is layered, with the building in the background, the hedge in the midground, and the flower sea, mascots, and golden number in the foreground.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于防溺水安全的宣传海报或信息图。图片背景分为左右两部分：左侧是深蓝色调的海边实景照片，右侧是白色背景的文字信息区。左侧照片中，一个浅蓝色的救生站建筑矗立在海水中，周围有波浪，救生站上可见“NO SWIMMING”、“KEEP OFF”、“海滨浴场救生站”和“TORREY LINES”等文字。照片左侧垂直排列着醒目的白色大字“珍爱生命预防溺水”。图片顶部有深蓝色横幅，左侧写有“SAFETY FIRST / 安全第一”，右侧是“DANGER KEEP AWAY FROM WATER”。右侧白色信息区的主标题是“防溺水‘六不’原则”，下方以数字编号列出了六条防溺水准则，每条包含中文和英文说明。图片底部同样有深蓝色横幅，上面写着“生命至上 安全第一”。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster or infographic about drowning prevention safety. The image background is divided into two parts: the left side features a dark blue-toned real photo of a beach lifeguard station, and the right side is a white background with textual information. In the left photo, a light blue lifeguard station building stands in the water, surrounded by waves, with visible texts like "NO SWIMMING," "KEEP OFF," "海滨浴场救生站" (Beach Lifeguard Station), and "TORREY LINES." To the left of the photo, prominent white characters "珍爱生命预防溺水" (Cherish Life, Prevent Drowning) are vertically arranged. The top of the image has a dark blue banner, with "SAFETY FIRST / 安全第一" (Safety First) on the left and "DANGER KEEP AWAY FROM WATER" on the right. The main title in the white information area on the right is "防溺水‘六不’原则" (Six Principles for Drowning Prevention), followed by six numbered drowning prevention guidelines, each with Chinese and English explanations. The bottom of the image also features a dark blue banner, stating "生命至上 安全第一" (Life First, Safety First).

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑色为背景的活动宣传海报。画面中心偏右是一个金色的圆形图案，其中包含醒目的中文“中秋”二字。海报顶部左侧有白色小字“传 统 时 令”，右侧是日期“08.15”及其下方的小字英文“LUNAR CALENDAR”。画面左侧，在“传 统 时 令”下方，有白色粗体字“仲秋之夜”，其下方是垂直排列的白色文字“露台月光下露天露营”。右侧边缘有垂直排列的白色英文“MINIMALIST MOONCAKE AESTHETIC”。左下角是两行中文描述：“在城市之巅，”（白色）和“共赴一场月光的露营。”（金色）。其下方并列着四个带有金色文字的黑色矩形标签，内容分别为“赏月”、“品茗”、“露营”和“雅聚”。右下角是一个包含“月满\n中秋”金色文字的黑色矩形标签。
prompt_en: This is an event promotional poster set against a black background. Slightly to the right of the center, there is a golden circular emblem containing the prominent Chinese characters "中秋" (Mid-Autumn). In the top left, white small text reads "传 统 时 令" (Traditional Season). The top right displays the date "08.15" with the smaller English text "LUNAR CALENDAR" below it. On the left side of the image, below "传 统 时 令", there is bold white text "仲秋之夜" (Mid-Autumn Night), followed by vertically arranged white text "露台月光下露天露营" (Terrace Moonlight Open-Air Camping). The right edge features vertically arranged white English text "MINIMALIST MOONCAKE AESTHETIC". The bottom left contains a two-line Chinese description: "在城市之巅，" (white, "Atop the city,") and "共赴一场月光的露营。" (golden, "embark on a moonlight camping trip."). Below this, four black rectangular tags with golden text are arranged side-by-side, reading "赏月" (Moon Gazing), "品茗" (Tea Tasting), "露营" (Camping), and "雅聚" (Elegant Gathering). In the bottom right corner, there is another black rectangular tag with golden text "月满\n中秋" (Full Moon Mid-Autumn).

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于真菌形态学与毒性辨识的紧急通知或报告。页面背景为浅米色，顶部有网格状的元数据区域，包含“发号/NO”、“字数/WORDS”、“日期/DATE”、“发觉地点/ORIGIN”、“路线/ROUTING”和“紧急程度/URGENCY”等信息，以及对应的具体数值和文本。一个红色的倾斜“紧急通知”水印覆盖在顶部元数据区域。页面中央是标题“真菌的隐秘世界：蘑菇形态学与毒性辨识”。主体内容分为左右两栏。左栏包含关于蘑菇结构特征的文字描述和编号列表，如菌盖、菌褶、菌环和菌托。右栏上方是“警告：高危识别标志”及其说明，下方是一个表格，对比了剧毒和可食用蘑菇的“基部结构”、“菌环状态”、“氧化反应”和“颜色特征”。左栏下方配有一张蘑菇的解剖结构示意图，标示了“菌盖 CAP”、“菌褶 GILLS”、“菌环 ANNULUS”、“菌柄 STIPE”和“菌托 VOLVA”。右栏下方则是一个雷达图，标题为“孢子扩散力学模型”。页面底部是关于“致命白毒伞”的提示、中毒征兆和结论，右下角有文件归档编号。
prompt_en: This is an urgent notice or report on fungal morphology and toxicity identification. The page has a light beige background. The top section features a grid-like metadata area, including "发号/NO" (Issue No.), "字数/WORDS" (Word Count), "日期/DATE" (Date), "发觉地点/ORIGIN" (Origin Location), "路线/ROUTING", and "紧急程度/URGENCY", along with their corresponding values and text. A red, tilted "紧急通知" (Urgent Notice) watermark overlays the top metadata area. The central title reads "真菌的隐秘世界：蘑菇形态学与毒性辨识" (The Hidden World of Fungi: Mushroom Morphology and Toxicity Identification). The main content is divided into two columns. The left column contains textual descriptions and a numbered list of mushroom structural features, such as cap, gills, annulus, and volva. The upper right column displays a "警告：高危识别标志" (Warning: High-Risk Identification Mark) and its explanation, followed by a table comparing "基部结构" (Base Structure), "菌环状态" (Annulus State), "氧化反应" (Oxidation Reaction), and "颜色特征" (Color Characteristics) for poisonous and edible mushrooms. Below the left column is a diagram illustrating the anatomical structure of a mushroom, labeled with "菌盖 CAP" (Cap), "菌褶 GILLS" (Gills), "菌环 ANNULUS" (Annulus), "菌柄 STIPE" (Stipe), and "菌托 VOLVA" (Volva). Below the right column is a radar chart titled "孢子扩散力学模型" (Spore Dispersal Mechanics Model). The bottom of the page includes a warning about "致命白毒伞" (Deadly White Amanita), symptoms of poisoning, and a conclusion, with a file archive number in the bottom right corner.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用界面的截图，背景为浅灰色。顶部有返回箭头和“帮助中心”字样。页面主标题为“榜单规则说明”，副标题是“致力于打造最权威、最公正的音乐流行风向标”。界面主体由三个垂直堆叠的圆角矩形卡片构成。第一个白色背景卡片标题为“计算维度”（前有蓝色竖线），列出“播放热度 45%”、“互动分享 30%”、“付费支持 25%”，并附有说明“* 综合得分每日凌晨 4:00 重新计算过去 24 小时数据。”第二个白色背景卡片标题为“更新周期”（前有绿色竖线），包含“实时榜单”（绿色圆点）及其描述“每小时更新，反映当前最热动态。”，以及“周期榜单”（蓝色圆点）及其描述“每周一及每月 1 日更新经典佳作。”第三个深色背景卡片标题为“公平性保障”（前有红色竖线），正文为“采用多重反作弊算法，实时过滤异常播放及恶意刷票行为。”，底部红色区域显示警告信息“违规作品将面临永久禁榜处罚”。界面底部有一张抽象图片，显示两只手操作彩色矩形块，下方有三个分页指示器，中间一个高亮。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface with a light gray background. At the top, there is a back arrow icon and the text "帮助中心" (Help Center). The main title of the page is "榜单规则说明" (Ranking Rules Explanation), followed by a subtitle: "致力于打造最权威、最公正的音乐流行风向标" (Committed to creating the most authoritative and fair music trend indicator). The main body of the interface consists of three vertically stacked rounded rectangular cards. The first card has a white background and is titled "计算维度" (Calculation Dimensions), preceded by a blue vertical bar. It lists "播放热度 45%" (Playback Popularity 45%), "互动分享 30%" (Interactive Sharing 30%), and "付费支持 25%" (Paid Support 25%), with a footnote: "* 综合得分每日凌晨 4:00 重新计算过去 24 小时数据。" (* Composite score recalculated daily at 4:00 AM based on the past 24 hours of data.). The second card also has a white background and is titled "更新周期" (Update Cycle), preceded by a green vertical bar. This card includes "实时榜单" (Real-time Ranking) with a green dot and its description "每小时更新，反映当前最热动态。" (Updated hourly, reflecting current hottest trends.), as well as "周期榜单" (Periodic Ranking) with a blue dot and its description "每周一及每月 1 日更新经典佳作。" (Classic works updated every Monday and on the 1st of each month.). The third card has a dark background and is titled "公平性保障" (Fairness Guarantee), preceded by a red vertical bar. The main text states: "采用多重反作弊算法，实时过滤异常播放及恶意刷票行为。" (Utilizes multiple anti-cheat algorithms to filter abnormal playback and malicious vote-rigging in real-time.), and a warning message "违规作品将面临永久禁榜处罚" (Violating works will face permanent ban from the rankings) is displayed within a red area at the bottom. At the very bottom of the interface, there is an abstract image showing two hands manipulating colorful rectangular blocks, with three circular pagination indicators below it, the middle one highlighted.

prompt_cn:
这是一张关于兆瓦级风力发电机机舱的详细技术信息图。图片以深蓝色、灰色和白色为主色调，黑色文字为主，部分关键数据用红色突出显示。页面顶部是标题“兆瓦级风力发电机机舱 解剖”，右侧列有技术文档编号、区域坐标和比例尺等信息。内容区域分为五个编号的章节，呈网格状布局。
第一章节“机舱内部结构示意图”展示了风力发电机机舱内部主要部件的方框图，包括轮毂、主轴、增速箱、同步发电机和偏航系统。第二章节“环境规格”列出了切入风速、切出风速、设计寿命和生存极限等运行参数。第三章节“关键核心组件性能参数表”是一个详细的表格，列出了变桨驱动装置、主轴承组、行星增速齿轮箱、双馈感应发电机、偏航控制驱动和冷却循环系统等组件的型号代码、转速范围、转化效率、质量和核心功能描述。第四章节“贝茨极限理论”解释了风力发电机提取风能的物理学理论上限，并用图表强调了“59.3% MAX”这一数值。第五章节“功率曲线输出特征”展示了一个功率曲线图，描绘了风速与功率输出的关系，并划分了静止/待机、变转速运行和额定功率输出三个阶段。页面底部包含测量基准和版权信息，以及“GIPROGOR 国家级新能源规划院”的署名。
prompt_en:
This is a detailed technical infographic about the nacelle of a megawatt-class wind turbine. The image primarily uses dark blue, gray, and white tones, with black text, and some key data highlighted in red. The top of the page features the title "Megawatt-class Wind Turbine Nacelle Anatomy," with technical document information such as document number, regional coordinates, and scale on the right. The content area is divided into five numbered sections, arranged in a grid layout.
Section 01, "Nacelle Anatomy," presents a block diagram of the main internal components of the wind turbine nacelle, including the hub, main shaft, gearbox, generator, and yaw system. Section 02, "Environmental Specifications," lists operational parameters such as cut-in wind speed, cut-out wind speed, design life, and survival limit. Section 03, "Component Performance Data," is a detailed table outlining the model codes, speed ranges, conversion efficiencies, masses, and core functional descriptions for components like the pitch drive, main bearing assembly, planetary gearbox, doubly-fed induction generator, yaw control drive, and cooling circulation system. Section 04, "Betz Limit Theory," explains the theoretical physical limit for wind turbines to extract wind energy, with a chart emphasizing the "59.3% MAX" value. Section 05, "Power Curve Characteristics," displays a power curve graph illustrating the relationship between wind speed and power output, divided into three stages: idle/standby, variable speed operation, and rated power output. The bottom of the page includes measurement standards and copyright information, along with the attribution "GIPROGOR National New Energy Planning Institute."

prompt_cn: 这是一张iPad屏幕截图，展示了Apple Shortcuts应用界面。屏幕主体是一个黑色边框的iPad，其内部界面呈白色背景，并采用两栏布局。左侧是导航侧边栏，顶部标题为“Shortcuts”，下方包含“Gallery”、“Automation (2)”、“My Shortcuts”等导航项，其中“All Shortcuts (12)”被选中并以蓝色背景高亮显示。侧边栏底部还有“Folders”分类，包含“Morning (3)”和“Evening (3)”。右侧主内容区顶部标题为“All Shortcuts”，右侧有“Search”搜索框。主内容区展示了多个彩色快捷指令卡片，每张卡片上包含一个白色粗体的快捷指令名称和下方白色细体的动作数量，例如“Laundry Timer (4 actions)”、“Message This Song (3 actions)”、“Home ETA (7 actions)”等。下方还按“Morning”和“Evening”分类展示了更多快捷指令，如“Morning Briefing (6 actions)”、“NPR News Now (1 action)”、“Read Later (16 actions)”等。iPad屏幕左右两侧的黑色背景上，垂直排列着白色粗体的“UIViewController”字样。
prompt_en: This is an iPad screenshot displaying the Apple Shortcuts application interface. The main subject is an iPad with a black frame, whose internal interface features a white background and a two-column layout. The left side is a navigation sidebar, with "Shortcuts" as the top title. Below it are navigation items such as "Gallery", "Automation (2)", and "My Shortcuts", with "All Shortcuts (12)" highlighted in blue as the selected item. The sidebar also includes a "Folders" category at the bottom, containing "Morning (3)" and "Evening (3)". The right main content area has "All Shortcuts" as its top title and a "Search" input field on the right. The main content area showcases multiple colorful shortcut cards, each containing a white bold shortcut name and a white thin action count below it, such as "Laundry Timer (4 actions)", "Message This Song (3 actions)", "Home ETA (7 actions)", and so on. Further down, more shortcuts are categorized under "Morning" and "Evening", including "Morning Briefing (6 actions)", "NPR News Now (1 action)", "Read Later (16 actions)", etc. On the black background to the left and right of the iPad screen, the white bold text "UIViewController" is vertically arranged.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅卡通插画，描绘了在健身房中，一对男女正在进行深蹲举重训练的场景。画面以一个圆形构图为中心，男性角色位于左侧，身穿蓝色背心和黑色短裤；女性角色位于右侧，身穿粉色运动内衣和黑色紧身裤。两人都面带笑容，额头有汗珠，共同举着杠铃，展现出运动的活力。背景是健身房内部，墙上挂有两张海报，其中右侧海报上清晰可见黑色的英文单词“STRENGTH”。整体画面色彩鲜明，以蓝色、粉色、黑色、灰色和浅绿色为主。
prompt_en: This is a cartoon illustration depicting a man and a woman performing barbell squats in a gym. The scene is centered within a circular composition. The male character is on the left, wearing a blue tank top and black shorts, while the female character is on the right, dressed in a pink sports bra and black leggings. Both are smiling, with sweat beads on their foreheads, jointly lifting barbells, showcasing the energy of exercise. The background is a gym interior with two posters on the wall; the English word "STRENGTH" is clearly visible in black on the right poster. The overall image features vibrant colors, predominantly blue, pink, black, gray, and light green.

prompt_cn: 这是一张户外活动照片，画面中，八位市民（七位成人和一位儿童）站在一个大型宣传背景板前合影。背景板以浅蓝色和绿色为主色调，描绘了山水和树木的图案，左上角印有“民生微实事 Min Sheng Wei Shi Shi 深圳宝安 · 西乡街道 · 盐田社区”字样，中央是“盐田社区 “环保趣分类，绿动新生活” 宣传活动”的绿色大字，右侧有垂直排列的“环保”二字。人们手持白色标语牌，上面印有绿色文字和卡通图案，内容包括“绿水青山 就是金山银山”、“垃圾分类 你我同行”、“共建文明城市 畅享美好生活”、“垃圾分类 从我做起”、“低碳生活 环保有我”、“爱护环境 共建和谐”、“公勺公筷 文明就餐”以及一个垂直的“环保”字样。图片左侧可见一块写有“西宾 W”的小型白色路牌，右侧有一个显示数字“20”的圆形限速标志和一个禁止停车标志，旁边停放着一辆婴儿推车。人物站立在铺设地砖的地面上，背景是茂密的绿色树木和灌木丛。
prompt_en: This is an outdoor event photo, showing eight citizens (seven adults and one child) posing in front of a large promotional banner. The banner features a light blue and green color scheme with mountain and tree patterns. The top left corner displays "民生微实事 Min Sheng Wei Shi Shi 深圳宝安 · 西乡街道 · 盐田社区", while the center features the large green text "盐田社区 “环保趣分类，绿动新生活” 宣传活动" (Yantian Community "Fun Environmental Classification, Green New Life" Promotional Event). The right side of the banner has the characters "环保" (Environmental Protection) arranged vertically. People are holding white placards with green text and cartoon illustrations, including slogans like "绿水青山 就是金山银山" (Green waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets), "垃圾分类 你我同行" (Waste sorting, you and I together), "共建文明城市 畅享美好生活" (Build a civilized city, enjoy a better life), "垃圾分类 从我做起" (Waste sorting starts with me), "低碳生活 环保有我" (Low-carbon living, I'm part of environmental protection), "爱护环境 共建和谐" (Protect the environment, build harmony), "公勺公筷 文明就餐" (Serving spoons and chopsticks, civilized dining), and a vertical "环保" (Environmental Protection). On the left side of the image, a small white road sign with "西宾 W" is visible. On the right, there is a circular speed limit sign showing "20" and a no parking sign, with a baby stroller parked nearby. The people are standing on a paved ground, with lush green trees and shrubs in the background.

The top left of the interface displays "SYSTEM VALIDATION" in English and "系统权限与校验中心" in Chinese, accompanied by an orange triangular icon; the top right shows "节点: OX-F29" and "状态: 等待响应" with an orange background. At the center of the interface is a warning pop-up window with rounded corners. The top left of the pop-up indicates "警告级别: 高" (Warning Level: High), with the character "高" (High) having an orange background; the top right shows "校验标识: V-2024-9981" (Validation ID). The pop-up's title is "安全敏感操作校验提示" (Security Sensitive Operation Validation Prompt), and the body text details potential issues caused by the current operation. The content area of the pop-up includes two sections: "预期影响范围" (Expected Impact Scope), preceded by an orange dot, and "建议优化措施" (Suggested Optimization Measures), preceded by a blue dot. These sections provide detailed information on the operation's impact and optimization recommendations. At the bottom of the pop-up are two action buttons: the left one is "取消并重新检查" (Cancel and Re-check) with a dark gray background, and the right one is "确认风险并继续" (Confirm Risk and Continue) with an orange background. The bottom of the interface is divided into three areas from left to right: The left area displays "数据一致性评分" (Data Consistency Score) as "99.8%" along with a green upward-pointing arrow icon; the middle area shows "实时系统日志" (Real-time System Log), including two log entries: an orange "[WARN] Auth check ..." and a blue "[INFO] Session active."; the right area displays "环境安全等级" (Environment Security Level) as "SECURE AREA", preceded by a green dot.

FILE REF: 71-75-DEGREE-AXIS // BUREAU OF KINETICS
The modern racing bicycle is no longer a simple machine of steel tubes. It is a calculated structural response to the twin demands of human physiology and Newtonian physics. The frame geometry acts as the primary interface, determining not only how the rider interacts with the asphalt but how energy is preserved over the course of a four-hour stage.

Reach and Stack have replaced top-tube length as the industry standard for fit. These coordinates provide a pure measurement of the frame's cockpit size, independent of seat tube angles or component choices.
CLASSIFIED DATA
Carbon fiber allows for an asymmetric design where the drive-side chainstay is reinforced to resist the lateral forces of high-wattage sprinting. A frame weighing less than 800g must still maintain a bottom bracket stiffness exceeding 150 N/mm to ensure that no energy is wasted as heat or frame flex.
"THE MECHANICAL ADVANTAGE IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ASCENT AND DEFEAT ON THE MOUNTAIN."

The interface adopts a dark color scheme and a clear layout, with a top information bar centrally displaying the title "皇家锻造工坊·宝石镶嵌" (Royal Forge Workshop · Gem Inlay), and on the right, the player's currency amounts: "GOLD 1,240,500" and "MANA 8,200". The left "宝石库存" (Gem Inventory) panel shows "48 / 100" gems, with four gem icons listed below, each with its name and attribute bonus, such as "深海蓝宝石 法强 +120" (Deep Sea Sapphire Magic Power +120) and "炽热红宝石 物攻 +150" (Blazing Ruby Physical Attack +150). The central area displays an image of a sword with a scabbard; there is a red circular icon with a yellow border on the sword hilt, and a white plus icon within a gray circular background below the sword blade. Below this, it shows "当前选择装备 灭世者之锋 +12" (Currently Selected Equipment Destroyer's Edge +12), along with "成功率 85.0%" (Success Rate 85.0%) and an orange "立即镶嵌" (Inlay Now) button. The right "属性预览" (Attribute Preview) panel lists three attributes and their changes, for example, Physical Attack increasing from "4,850" to "5,000", Critical Damage from "240%" to "255%", and Armor Penetration from "12.5%" to "15.0%", with the increased values shown in green. The bottom of the panel shows "消耗材料 强化石 x 20" (Materials Consumed Enhancement Stone x 20) and notes "拥有: 450" (Owned: 450). All panels and buttons feature a rounded rectangular design, and the text uses various colors to distinguish different types of information.

prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a fitness event or anniversary. The central figure is a muscular man, shirtless, with his head tilted back and mouth open in an expression of exertion or triumph. The background is dark gray with a textured appearance. The poster features several text elements. At the top left, the main title "力量之巅" (Peak of Power) is in large white bold font, with "壹周年" (First Anniversary) in smaller red text above it, and "FITNESS COMMEMORATION" in white below it. To the top right, "ANNIVERSARY EDITION" and "VOL. 365 / 2024" are displayed in white. In the mid-left, "意志的勋章" (Medal of Will) is in white bold text, followed by "刻画在每一寸肌理" (Carved into every inch of muscle) in red bold text. Below this, three sets of statistics are presented: "累计打卡" (Cumulative Check-ins) with "365 DAYS", "里程挑战" (Mileage Challenge) with "1,280 HRS", and "极限突破" (Extreme Breakthrough) with "+25 KG". All statistics have small white labels above large white numbers. At the bottom left, a paragraph of white text reads: "这一年，你用重力对抗平庸，用酸痛定义新生。每一条隆起的肌肉线条，都是对懒惰的无声宣判。这不是终点，而是强者之路的序章." (This year, you used gravity to fight mediocrity, and soreness to define rebirth. Every bulging muscle line is a silent declaration against laziness. This is not the end, but the prelude to the path of the strong.) Below this is "STRENGTH & HONOR" in large red bold text, and "致：坚持不懈的自己" (To: The persistent self) in smaller white text. On the bottom right, a red circular badge contains "1st" in white, next to which is "官方认证成就" (Official Certified Achievement) in white, with "ISSUED: 2023-2024" below it in smaller white text. The overall design emphasizes strength, perseverance, and fitness achievement.

prompt_cn: 这是一张游戏界面截图，展示了一个充满中国新年氛围的室内场景。画面中央，一个由无数红色红包堆叠而成的巨大红包塔从地面直抵天花板。前景中央站着一男一女，身着红色传统服饰，双手抱拳行礼；左侧黄色沙发上坐着一位穿红色连衣裙的女性；右侧黄色沙发上坐着两位身穿红色衣服的老年人。画面底部还有两只猫。房间内摆放着白色咖啡桌、木质柜子、盆栽植物和鱼缸。墙壁上挂有红色的菱形“福”字、一幅年画和红灯笼。屏幕顶部是游戏的用户界面，包括标题“发完所有红包”、计时器“4:57”，以及“加时”和“提示”两个圆形按钮。底部有一条深色字幕栏，显示文字“过大年！发红包咯！”。整体画面以红色和黄色为主色调。
prompt_en: This is a game interface screenshot, depicting an indoor scene filled with Chinese New Year atmosphere. In the center of the image, a towering stack of countless red envelopes (红包, hóngbāo) reaches from the floor to the ceiling. In the foreground, a man and a woman in red traditional attire stand with clasped hands; a woman in a red dress sits on a yellow sofa to the left; and two elderly individuals in red sit on a yellow sofa to the right. Two cats are also visible at the bottom of the frame. The room is furnished with a white coffee table, a wooden cabinet, potted plants, and a fish tank. The wall is adorned with a red diamond-shaped '福' (fú) character, a New Year painting, and red lanterns. The top of the screen displays game user interface elements, including the title "发完所有红包" (Distribute all red envelopes), a timer "4:57", and two circular buttons labeled "加时" (Add time) and "提示" (Hint). At the bottom, a dark subtitle bar shows the text "过大年！发红包咯！" (Celebrate New Year! Send out red envelopes!). The overall color scheme of the image is dominated by red and yellow.

The bag's main body is black, adorned with red, gold, and green Khokhloma-style floral patterns along its edges. Five matryoshka doll designs of varying sizes are at the top. The central white area of the bag depicts a farmer couple in traditional attire, surrounded by an abundant harvest of vegetables such as pumpkins, carrots, cabbage, and tomatoes, along with a wooden barrel. The top of the bag features Russian text "БОГАТЫЙ УРОЖАЙ. Водорастворимое Удобрение" (meaning "Rich Harvest. Water-Soluble Fertilizer"), while the bottom has English text "RICH HARVEST: Macro-Element Water-Soluble Fertilizer". The background is a blurred Russian village scene, showing wooden houses, market stalls filled with produce, and two Orthodox churches with onion-shaped domes. The packaging bag stands upright on a wooden tabletop in the foreground, and the overall image is rich with Russian national character.

prompt_en: The image displays a software interface for configuring a smartwatch watch face, set against a dark background. At the top, there is a title "Theme Configuration Center", status text "Draft auto-saved 14:20", and a "Publish Theme" button. Below the title, a navigation path "Smart Wearable / Watch Face Management / Color and Text Association" is shown. The main content area is divided into two sections: the left section features a circular smartwatch display previewing a watch face with the time "10:45", day "WEDNESDAY", battery "85% POWER", and steps "12,480 STEPS". Below the preview, it reads "Real-time rendering preview: Current application "Aurora Green" scheme". The right section contains configuration options, including a "Core Color Association" section with "Configuring" status, detailing "Main color (Primary)" as green with code "#34D3F3" linked to time and steps, and "Accent color (Accent)" as blue with code "#3B82F6" linked to power and date. Below this is a "Text Style Sync" section, showing "Font Family" as "HarmonyOS Sans" and "Dynamic Font Weight Association" with values "800", "700", "400". The bottom of the interface displays device information "Watch GT Pro 4" and "466 x 466 px", along with "Reset" and "Sync Device" buttons.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的医疗影像远程会诊系统软件界面截图。界面顶部显示系统名称“远程会诊影像中心 v4.2.0”，右侧是日期“2023年10月24日”和时间“星期二 14:30:45”，以及一个用户头像。下方是“快速检索病例资源”区域，包含一个搜索框和“开始检索”按钮。搜索框下方是筛选条件，包括“检查类型”和“紧急程度”，各有多个按钮选项。界面主体部分水平排列展示了三张病例卡片。每张卡片包含病例ID、状态标签、患者姓名、性别、年龄、一张医学影像图、影像描述、所属科室和“详情 >”链接。第一张卡片显示“已上传”的胸部增强CT影像，第二张为“待会诊”的颅脑MRI，第三张为“处理中”的左腿骨折DR影像。界面底部是状态栏，显示“PACS 已连接”、“云端同步正常”以及“在线专家: 12 位”和“今日处理: 148 例”等信息。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a medical imaging remote consultation system software interface with a dark background. The top of the interface displays the system name "远程会诊影像中心 v4.2.0" (Remote Consultation Imaging Center v4.2.0), with the date "2023年10月24日" and time "星期二 14:30:45" (Tuesday 14:30:45) on the right, along with a user avatar. Below is the "快速检索病例资源" (Quick Case Resource Retrieval) area, which includes a search box and a "开始检索" (Start Search) button. Below the search box are filter conditions, including "检查类型" (Examination Type) and "紧急程度" (Urgency Level), each with multiple button options. The main part of the interface horizontally displays three case cards. Each card contains a case ID, a status tag, patient name, gender, age, a medical imaging picture, an image description, the department, and a "详情 >" (Details >) link. The first card shows an "已上传" (Uploaded) chest enhanced CT image, the second is a "待会诊" (Pending Consultation) cranial MRI, and the third is a "处理中" (In Progress) left leg fracture DR image. The bottom of the interface is a status bar, showing information such as "PACS 已连接" (PACS Connected), "云端同步正常" (Cloud Sync Normal), "在线专家: 12 位" (Online Experts: 12), and "今日处理: 148 例" (Cases Processed Today: 148).
