This infographic, set against a dark green background, presents the theme of "和色图谱 (Japanese Color Spectrum): The Evolution of Plant Dyes and Natural Aesthetics." At the top, there is information such as "公式编号: NO. 1887-IV-WASHOKU" (Formula Number), "季节周期: 二十四节气卷" (Seasonal Cycle: Twenty-Four Solar Terms Scroll), and "归档日期: 庚子年仲秋" (Archiving Date: Mid-Autumn of Gengzi Year). In the center of the image, a table lists eight "和色名(Item)" (Japanese Color Names) with their corresponding "提取原材(Part)" (Extraction Material), "质量(Qty)" (Quantity), and "物候特征(Notes)" (Phenological Characteristics). To the right of the table, a vertical text block explains that the essence of Japanese colors lies in adapting to natural changes, and mentions that this scroll records three hundred and fifty-five phenological colors.

The middle-lower part of the image contains two diagrams. The left one is a circular chart indicating the four seasons: "春" (Spring), "夏" (Summer), "秋" (Autumn), and "冬" (Winter), with the titles "四季色环演化图 (SEASONAL CYCLE)" (Seasonal Color Cycle Evolution Diagram) and "物候色彩向心力模型" (Phenological Color Centripetal Model). The right diagram is a process diagram showing four interconnected boxes labeled "浸渍" (Soaking), "煎熬" (Boiling), "固色" (Color Fixing), and "媒染" (Mordanting), with arrows connecting them. Its title is "染料提取工艺路径(EXTRACTION PATH)" (Dye Extraction Process Path), and below it is the caption "实验室色素分离原理图" (Laboratory Pigment Separation Schematic).

At the bottom of the image are three step-by-step instructions, each beginning with a large character "步" (Step). The titles are "步骤一:预备" (Step One: Preparation), "步骤二:提炼" (Step Two: Refinement), and "步骤三:媒染" (Step Three: Mordanting), detailing the plant dye production process. In the bottom right corner, there is a red circular badge with the text "和色特选" (Japanese Color Special Selection).

REF. NO. ATH-2024 / MUSCLE RECOVERY LOG
三大主流健身分化训练计划
肌肉群抗阻训练周期与恢复时间对照表
I. 历史演变与恢复理论
训练分化 (Workout Splits) 是现代运动生理学的核心产物。自阿诺德时代起,运动员发现针对特定肌群的专项轰炸能产生更强的代谢压力。然而,肌肉的生长并非发生于健身房,而是在休整期间。大肌群如胸部、背部及腿部,在经历高强度力竭后,其蛋白质合成窗口通常持续48至72小时。
超补偿曲线 (SUPERCOMPENSATION)
生长峰值 (PEAK)
疲劳期 (FATIGUE)
图1.1:肌肉组织受损后的生理恢复与超量补偿路径示意
III. 三大核心分化方案
01. 五分化(Bro Split)
传统的健美式训练,每日专注单一肌群。周一胸、周二背、周三肩、周四腿、周五手臂。此方案泵感极强,但单部位训练频率每周仅一次,对自然训练者而言,蛋白质合成窗口利用率较低。
02.上下肢二分化 (Upper/Lower)
将身体分为上半身(推、拉、手)与下半身(腿、核心)。每周循环两次,通常采用“练2休1”节奏。此方案在容量与频率间取得了极佳平衡,是力量举运动员与中阶爱好者的首选。
03. 推拉腿三分化(PPL)
现代效率之王。推日(胸/肩前中束/三头)、拉日(背/肩后束/二头)、腿日。每周循环2次(6练1休)。其优势在于符合人体肌肉功能链,且单部位每周可获得2次刺激,生长效率最高。

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一份关于健身训练计划的信息图表，背景为深蓝色，大部分文字为白色或浅黄色。页面顶部居中显示主标题“三大主流健身分化训练计划”和副标题“肌肉群抗阻训练周期与恢复时间对照表”，主标题下方有一个装饰性的十字星形图标。内容区域分为左右两栏。左栏包含标题为“I. 历史演变与恢复理论”的文本段落，一个描绘“超补偿曲线”并标注“生长峰值”和“疲劳期”的线形图（图1.1），以及标题为“II. 目标肌群生理属性对照”的表格，表格列出了目标肌群分类、建议恢复时长和疲劳耐受度。右栏包含标题为“III. 三大核心分化方案”的文本段落，详细介绍了“01. 五分化”、“02. 上下肢二分化”和“03. 推拉腿三分化”三种方案。右栏下方还有一个图示（图1.2），展示了“BRO SPLIT”、“UPPER/LOWER”和“PPL”三种分化模式，并标明了各自的周训练频率，其中“PPL”模式的方框被黄色边框突出显示。页面底部是页脚信息，包括纬度、经度、页码和规格。
prompt_en: This image is an infographic about fitness training plans, featuring a dark blue background with most text in white or light yellow. At the top center, there is a main title "三大主流健身分化训练计划" (Three Mainstream Fitness Split Training Plans) and a subtitle "肌肉群抗阻训练周期与恢复时间对照表" (Muscle Group Resistance Training Cycle and Recovery Time Comparison Chart), with a decorative compass-like icon below the main title. The content area is divided into two columns. The left column includes a text paragraph titled "I. 历史演变与恢复理论" (I. Historical Evolution and Recovery Theory), a line graph depicting the "超补偿曲线 (SUPERCOMPENSATION)" with "生长峰值 (PEAK)" and "疲劳期 (FATIGUE)" labeled (Figure 1.1), and a table titled "II. 目标肌群生理属性对照" (II. Target Muscle Group Physiological Attributes Comparison) listing muscle group categories, recommended recovery duration, and fatigue tolerance. The right column contains a text paragraph titled "III. 三大核心分化方案" (III. Three Core Split Programs), detailing "01. 五分化 (Bro Split)", "02. 上下肢二分化 (Upper/Lower)", and "03. 推拉腿三分化 (PPL)" schemes. Below the right column is a diagram (Figure 1.2) illustrating the "BRO SPLIT", "UPPER/LOWER", and "PPL" split modes, each with its weekly training frequency, with the "PPL" mode box highlighted by a yellow border. The bottom of the page displays footer information, including latitude, longitude, page number, and specifications.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深蓝色背景的软件界面截图，展示了一个名为“QUANTUM-V ANALYSIS SCIENTIFIC SUITE V4.0.2”的分析系统。界面顶部显示当前时间“14:20:45”和系统状态“STATUS: OPTIMAL”，响应时间为“0.0004ms”。界面主要分为三个面板：左侧是“实时变量监控”，中间是“CORE COMPUTATION”，右侧是“系统参数控制”。左侧面板列出了“Alpha (α)”、“Beta (β)”和“Gamma (γ)”三个变量，分别显示其数值（如“0.0042791”、“128.450 T”、“1.204e-9”）和状态标签（“ACTIVE”、“STABLE”、“DRIFT”），以及各自的子标签（“Thermal Coeff.”、“Mag. Flux”、“Decay Rate”）。中间的“CORE COMPUTATION”面板标题下方是“计算结果矢量图”，其中央显示一个抽象的蓝色3D矢量图形，上方标注“RESULTANT VECTOR”及其数值“842.19 kN”，下方则显示“X-Offset”、“Y-Offset”、“Z-Offset”的偏移量（如“+12.044”、“-04.812”、“+67.901”）。右侧的“系统参数控制”面板包含“迭代深度”和“采样频率”的参数设置，分别显示“1024 px”和“4.8 GHz”的数值，并带有进度条。下方有两个操作按钮：“执行重算”和“导出数据”。该面板底部还有一个“NOTICE”区域，提示“变量已按 ISO-27001 标准加密。”界面底部是状态栏，显示“LOG:”信息（如“[14:20:45] Alpha Sync. | [14:20:45] Awaiting Delta-V...”），以及CPU和RAM的使用情况（“CPU: 12%”、“RAM: 4.2G”）。文字颜色以白色为主，辅以浅蓝色、浅绿色和黄色，部分标签和按钮带有彩色背景。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a software interface with a dark blue background, displaying an analysis system named "QUANTUM-V ANALYSIS SCIENTIFIC SUITE V4.0.2". The top of the interface shows the current time "14:20:45" and system status "STATUS: OPTIMAL" with a response time of "0.0004ms". The interface is primarily divided into three panels: "实时变量监控" (Real-time Variable Monitoring) on the left, "CORE COMPUTATION" in the center, and "系统参数控制" (System Parameter Control) on the right. The left panel lists three variables: "Alpha (α)", "Beta (β)", and "Gamma (γ)", each displaying its value (e.g., "0.0042791", "128.450 T", "1.204e-9") and status tag ("ACTIVE", "STABLE", "DRIFT"), along with their respective sub-labels ("Thermal Coeff.", "Mag. Flux", "Decay Rate"). The central "CORE COMPUTATION" panel has "计算结果矢量图" (Computed Result Vector Graph) below its English title, featuring an abstract blue 3D vector graphic. Above the graphic, "RESULTANT VECTOR" and its value "842.19 kN" are displayed, while below, "X-Offset", "Y-Offset", and "Z-Offset" values (e.g., "+12.044", "-04.812", "+67.901") are shown. The right "系统参数控制" panel includes parameter settings for "迭代深度" (Iteration Depth) and "采样频率" (Sampling Frequency), showing values "1024 px" and "4.8 GHz" respectively, accompanied by progress bars. Below these are two action buttons: "执行重算" (Execute Recalculation) and "导出数据" (Export Data). At the bottom of this panel, a "NOTICE" area states "变量已按 ISO-27001 标准加密." (Variables have been encrypted according to ISO-27001 standard.). The bottom of the interface features a status bar displaying "LOG:" information (e.g., "[14:20:45] Alpha Sync. | [14:20:45] Awaiting Delta-V...") and CPU and RAM usage ("CPU: 12%", "RAM: 4.2G"). Text colors are predominantly white, complemented by light blue, light green, and yellow, with some labels and buttons having colored backgrounds.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于日本武士盔甲演变的信息图。图片背景为深灰色，整体布局分为多个区域。左上角是标题“SAMURAI ARMOR”，下方有关于O-YOROI（平安时代）到TOSEI-GUSOKU（战国时代）盔甲结构演变的文字说明。右上角标题为“TACTICAL SHIFT”，解释了火绳枪引入后盔甲材料的变化。图片中部左侧是“ANATOMY OF THE ROKUGU / 六具”部分，展示了TOSEI-GUSOKU盔甲的六个基本组成部分，通过线稿图和编号标签详细标注了头盔、护臂、护腿等部件。中部右侧是“MATERIAL COMPOSITION”部分，以列表和条形图形式展示了盔甲的材料构成，包括铁/钢、漆/漆器和丝绸/皮革及其各自的百分比。底部左侧是一个表格，对比了O-YOROI和TOSEI-GUSOKU两种盔甲的总重量、主要用途、结构和机动性。底部中间是“BALLISTIC RESISTANCE”部分，通过条形图比较了两种盔甲的抗弹性能，并给出了偏转概率和普及年代的数据。图片底部还有页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the evolution of Japanese samurai armor. The image has a dark gray background and is divided into multiple sections. The top left features the title "SAMURAI ARMOR," followed by text explaining the structural analysis of the transition from O-YOROI (Heian Period) to TOSEI-GUSOKU (Sengoku Era) armor. The top right section, titled "TACTICAL SHIFT," describes the change in armor materials after the introduction of the matchlock gun. The middle left section, "ANATOMY OF THE ROKUGU / 六具," illustrates the six fundamental components of the TOSEI-GUSOKU system with a line drawing and numbered labels for parts like the helmet, armored sleeves, and thigh guard. The middle right section, "MATERIAL COMPOSITION," presents the armor's material composition, including iron/steel, lacquer/urushi, and silk/leather, along with their respective percentages, using a list and bar charts. The bottom left contains a table comparing the total weight, primary use, construction, and mobility of O-YOROI and TOSEI-GUSOKU armor. The bottom middle section, "BALLISTIC RESISTANCE," uses a bar chart to compare the ballistic resistance of the two armor types, providing data on deflection probability and peak era adoption. Footer information is also present at the bottom of the image.

HELL OF A TIME PTY LTD”。
prompt_en: This is a movie poster, predominantly featuring dark reddish-brown and orange tones. A man stands in the center of the poster, wearing a red and black plaid shirt and dark pants, with a serious expression. He holds a red power tool in his left hand and a golf club in his right. Behind him, two large male faces are symmetrically split, forming an arch-like background; the left face is grinning, while the right face has a calm expression. Several smaller figures are scattered in the background, including a man holding a torch on the left, a frightened woman on the right, and indoor groups seated around tables. In the upper-middle section of the poster is the white tagline "ONE HELL OF A FAIRY TALE," below which is the large, stylized yellow-orange title "BLOODY HELL." The bottom of the poster contains multiple lines of small white text, including production company information, cast and crew credits, the release date "JANUARY 14, 2021," and copyright information "© 2020. HELL OF A TIME PTY LTD."

prompt_cn: 这是一张以蓝色为主色调的国际展销会邀请函海报。海报背景为深浅不一的蓝色渐变，并有抽象的白色和蓝色流线型光线轨迹，营造出科技感和动感。画面右上角是“Canva 可画”的品牌标识，下方是活动名称“INTERNATIONAL 国际展销会”。海报中央偏右位置是醒目的主标题“邀请函”，下方配有英文副标题“International”，并带有光效。其下方列出了三条活动宗旨：“打造一站式商贸平台”、“助力推动新材料”、“新产品和新技术迅速发展”，每条前有小圆点。海报左侧是巨大的半透明装饰性文字“邀请函”。左下角清晰标明了“活动时间 9.15”至“9.20”以及“活动地点 可画大厦内一楼”。海报底部中央有一行标语：“[市场方兴未艾,期待各界精英人士的莅临]”。整体设计简洁现代，信息层级清晰。
prompt_en: This is an invitation poster for an international exhibition, predominantly in blue. The background features a blue gradient from dark to light, with abstract white and blue streamlined light trails, creating a sense of technology and dynamism. In the top-right corner is the "Canva 可画" brand logo, with the event name "INTERNATIONAL 国际展销会" below it. The prominent main title "邀请函" (Invitation) is located slightly to the right of the center, with an English subtitle "International" below it, enhanced with a light effect. Below this, three event objectives are listed with bullet points: "打造一站式商贸平台" (Create a one-stop business platform), "助力推动新材料" (Help promote new materials), and "新产品和新技术迅速发展" (Rapid development of new products and technologies). On the left side of the poster is a large, translucent decorative text "邀请函" (Invitation). The bottom-left clearly states the "活动时间" (Event Time) from "9.15" to "9.20" and the "活动地点" (Event Location) as "可画大厦内一楼" (First Floor, Canva Building). At the bottom center, there is a slogan: "[市场方兴未艾,期待各界精英人士的莅临]" (The market is booming, looking forward to the presence of elites from all walks of life). The overall design is clean, modern, and the information hierarchy is clear.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于机械表机芯分析的信息图表。图表背景为浅卡其色，顶部居中是黑色粗体主标题“MECHANICAL WATCH MOVEMENT ANALYSIS”，下方是副标题“ENERGY TRANSFER FROM MAINSPRING TO THE BALANCE WHEEL”。整个信息图分为六个编号部分（I-VI），按从左到右、从上到下的顺序布局。第一部分展示了红色水平条形图，条形内嵌白色文字，说明动力储存分布。第二部分是深绿色垂直柱状图，柱体上叠加灰色弧线，显示频率与振荡速率。第三部分是一个机械传动示意图，由红色、黄色、绿色圆形和黑色矩形组件通过虚线连接，下方有四个数据框，分别展示了机芯的来源、旋转、传动比和释放信息。第四部分包含两个大尺寸的彩色框（黄色和红色）和两个较小的白色框，用于说明宝石数量和摩擦减少。第五部分是一个表格，深灰色表头，浅灰色行，文字为黑色，展示了机械机芯的精度等级。第六部分包含一个进度条状元素，显示“35%”的效率损失。大部分文字为黑色或白色，部分强调文字使用红色或黄色。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about mechanical watch movement analysis. The chart has a light khaki background, with the main title "MECHANICAL WATCH MOVEMENT ANALYSIS" in black bold text centered at the top, followed by the subtitle "ENERGY TRANSFER FROM MAINSPRING TO THE BALANCE WHEEL". The entire infographic is divided into six numbered sections (I-VI), arranged from left to right and top to bottom. Section I displays a horizontal bar chart with red bars and white text, illustrating power reserve distribution. Section II features a vertical bar chart with dark green bars and an overlaid gray arc, showing frequency and oscillation rates. Section III presents a schematic diagram of mechanical transmission, composed of red, yellow, and green circular components and black rectangular components connected by dashed lines. Below it are four data boxes, detailing the movement's source, rotation, ratio, and release information. Section IV includes two large colored boxes (yellow and red) and two smaller white boxes, explaining jewel count and friction reduction. Section V is a table with dark gray headers and light gray rows with black text, presenting the precision grades of mechanical movements. Section VI contains a progress bar-like element, indicating a "35%" efficiency loss. Most text is black or white, with some emphasized text in red or yellow.

CHILDREN'S DAY THANK YOU LETTER
NO. 2024-0601
亲爱的宝贝:
在这个充满欢笑与奇迹的节日里，我们要对你说一声：谢谢你。谢谢你用纯真的眼睛，带我们重新发现了这个世界的美好；谢谢你用小小的手，在生活的画布上涂抹出最绚烂的色彩。
你就像一颗落在凡间的星星，虽然偶尔调皮，却始终闪烁着好奇与善良的光芒。请记住，无论世界如何变迁，你眼里的星光和心中的童话，都是这世上最珍贵的宝藏。
愿你永远保持那份探索未知的勇气，像涂鸦一样自由自在地生长。在未来的日子里，我们会一直守护在你身旁，陪你一起摘星，陪你一起长大。
爱你的家人
二零二四年六月一日

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色网格为背景的活动海报或演示文稿。画面顶部左侧是“2024 GLOBAL SUMMIT”字样，右侧是“05”和“DATA / CLOUD”。海报中央醒目地显示着带有描边效果的白色大字“USER PROFILING”，下方是中文副标题“大数据与云计算博览会：通过多维数据解构数字孪生人格”。右侧垂直条形区域内有“TECH EXPO”和“SHANGHAI”。中部有三个并列的彩色信息块：左侧蓝色块内有“89%”和“Behavioral Accuracy”；中间深蓝色块内有蓝色圆点图标、“Cloud Computing”、“Infrastructure”、“01001101 01000001”二进制数字、“DATA MINING STRATEGY”及白色菱形图标；右侧绿色块内有三个垂直条图标和“REAL-TIME ANALYTICS”。底部左侧是白色块内的“V.02”、“DECODING HUMAN BEHAVIOR”和“IN THE ERA OF BIG DATA”，右侧是描边文字“ALGORITHM”。最下方有三个白色边框方块，分别写着“AI”、“IOT”、“5G”，旁边是中文描述“探索数据背后的无限可能，构建精准的用户画像体系。”，以及“INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION CENTER”和“NOV 12-15”的日期信息。
prompt_en: This is an event poster or presentation slide with a dark grid background. At the top left, it displays "2024 GLOBAL SUMMIT", and at the top right, "05" and "DATA / CLOUD". The center of the poster prominently features large white outlined text "USER PROFILING", with a Chinese subtitle below it: "大数据与云计算博览会：通过多维数据解构数字孪生人格" (Big Data and Cloud Computing Expo: Deconstructing Digital Twin Personalities through Multi-dimensional Data). On the right, within a vertical bar, are "TECH EXPO" and "SHANGHAI". The middle section contains three side-by-side colored information blocks: the left blue block shows "89%" and "Behavioral Accuracy"; the central dark blue block includes a blue circle icon, "Cloud Computing", "Infrastructure", binary numbers "01001101 01000001", "DATA MINING STRATEGY", and a white diamond icon; the right green block features three vertical bar icons and "REAL-TIME ANALYTICS". The bottom left has a white block containing "V.02", "DECODING HUMAN BEHAVIOR", and "IN THE ERA OF BIG DATA", while to its right is the outlined text "ALGORITHM". At the very bottom, there are three white-bordered squares labeled "AI", "IOT", and "5G", next to a Chinese description "探索数据背后的无限可能，构建精准的用户画像体系。" (Explore infinite possibilities behind data, build a precise user profiling system.), followed by "INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION CENTER" and the date "NOV 12-15".

prompt_cn: 这是一张以橙色和米色为主色调的数字插画，展示了信用卡申请和优惠信息。图片顶部左侧是“Canva”品牌标志。顶部中央是白色大字的主标题“一卡开启便捷生活 畅享无忧金融体验”，下方是副标题“从申请到激活,全程指导助您轻松拥有心仪信用卡”。图片右上方有一个描绘金融场景的插画，包含一个站立的人物、一部智能手机、一堆金币和文件。图片下半部分是一个米色背景的笔记本状图形，内部包含两列信息。左侧列标题为“1 限时特惠,精彩不停歇”，列出了三个优惠项目，每个项目都有一个橙色背景的标签和黑色文字描述。右侧列标题为“2 在线申请 & 审核过程”，列出了五个编号的步骤，每个步骤都有一个图标、黑色粗体标题和黑色文字描述。两列信息之间以及右侧列的步骤之间都有虚线分隔。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration primarily in orange and beige tones, presenting credit card application and offer information. The top left of the image features the "Canva" brand logo. At the top center, the main titles "一卡开启便捷生活 畅享无忧金融体验" (One Card for Convenient Life, Enjoy Worry-Free Financial Experience) are displayed in large white text, with the subtitle "从申请到激活,全程指导助您轻松拥有心仪信用卡" (From application to activation, full guidance helps you easily own your desired credit card) below. The upper right of the image shows an illustration depicting a financial scene, including a standing person, a smartphone, a pile of gold coins, and documents. The lower half of the image is a notebook-shaped graphic with a beige background, containing two columns of information. The left column is titled "1 限时特惠,精彩不停歇" (1 Limited Time Offer, Excitement Never Stops) and lists three discount items, each with an orange background label and black text description. The right column is titled "2 在线申请 & 审核过程" (2 Online Application & Review Process) and outlines five numbered steps, each with an icon, a bold black title, and a black text description. Dashed lines separate the two columns of information and also connect the steps in the right column.

prompt_cn: 图片展示了一个深色背景的健身应用界面。顶部左侧显示品牌名称“TITAN PRO”，右侧有“LIVE 训练中”的状态指示，并带有一个红色圆点。下方是课程标题“HIIT 燃脂巅峰挑战”。界面中部是一个视频播放器，其中有三名人物正在进行体能训练。视频左下角标有“难度等级”，并以四个蓝色方块表示进度；右侧显示“预计消耗 650 KCAL”。视频下方是一个统计区域，显示“当前全球在线学习人数 1,285,492 人”以及“击败了全国 98.2% 的健身爱好者”。再下方是“训练模块”列表，包含三项内容：第一项“动态热身与关节激活”显示“5 组动作 · 08:00”并标记为“已解锁”；第二项“高强度间歇有氧 (HIIT)”显示“12 组动作 · 25:00”并标记为“待进行”；第三项“核心力量强化训练”显示“8 组动作 · 15:00”并标记为“待进行”。界面底部是一个宽大的“立即开始训练”按钮，其下方左右两侧分别显示“设备已连接”和“心率同步中”，各带有一个绿色圆点。整体界面以深色为主，文字多为白色、浅蓝色和浅灰色。
prompt_en: The image displays a fitness application interface with a dark background. At the top left, the brand name "TITAN PRO" is shown, and on the right, there is a "LIVE 训练中" (LIVE Training) status indicator with a red dot. Below this is the course title "HIIT 燃脂巅峰挑战" (HIIT Fat Burning Peak Challenge). The middle section of the interface features a video player showing three individuals performing physical training. The bottom left of the video indicates "难度等级" (Difficulty Level) with four blue squares representing progress; the right side shows "预计消耗 650 KCAL" (Estimated Consumption 650 KCAL). Below the video is a statistics area displaying "当前全球在线学习人数 1,285,492 人" (Current Global Online Learners 1,285,492 people) and "击败了全国 98.2% 的健身爱好者" (Beat 98.2% of fitness enthusiasts nationwide). Further down is a "训练模块" (Training Modules) list, containing three items: the first, "动态热身与关节激活" (Dynamic Warm-up and Joint Activation), shows "5 组动作 · 08:00" (5 sets of movements · 08:00) and is marked "已解锁" (Unlocked); the second, "高强度间歇有氧 (HIIT)" (High-Intensity Interval Cardio (HIIT)), shows "12 组动作 · 25:00" (12 sets of movements · 25:00) and is marked "待进行" (Pending); the third, "核心力量强化训练" (Core Strength Enhancement Training), shows "8 组动作 · 15:00" (8 sets of movements · 15:00) and is also marked "待进行" (Pending). At the bottom of the interface is a large button labeled "立即开始训练" (Start Training Now). Below this button, on the left and right, "设备已连接" (Device Connected) and "心率同步中" (Heart Rate Syncing) are displayed respectively, each with a green dot. The overall interface is dark-themed, with text predominantly in white, light blue, and light gray.

In the "Coupons to Use" section, two coupon cards are displayed: an orange-themed "¥200" coupon (valid for purchases over ¥2000, a limited-time digital appliance general coupon, expiring today), and a blue-themed "¥50" coupon (no threshold required, a general category red packet, expiring in 5 hours). Both coupons have a "立即使用" (Use Now) button. In the "Featured Products with Available Coupons" section, two products are shown: a "旗舰新款手机" (Flagship New Phone) priced at "¥4999" with a "省¥200" (Save ¥200) offer, and an "办公笔记本" (Office Laptop) priced at "¥6888" also with a "省¥200" (Save ¥200) offer. The bottom navigation bar includes three options: "首页" (Home), "领券" (Get Coupons, highlighted in orange), and "我的" (My Account).

In the middle of the image is an illustration area with a light beige/orange background, depicting cartoon characters writing, opening gift boxes, and various prizes such as mobile phones and coupons. To the right are two orange buttons labeled "领券券" (Get Coupons). Below the illustration, within orange rectangular boxes, are the event time "时间: 2023年11月23日-26日" (Time: November 23-26, 2023) and location "地点: 市中心广场B区活动台" (Location: City Center Plaza Area B Activity Stage). At the bottom center of the poster is the small text "活动规则详见现场海报" (For activity rules, see on-site poster). To its lower left is "主动承商:" (Main Sponsors:), followed by sponsor information including "广场集团 (CHINA.NORTH.COM)", "瀚鹏集团", and "市投集团 (HONGTOU GROUP)".

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of an industrial equipment diagnosis and recommendation software interface with a dark background. The top of the interface displays the title "设备诊断与建议措施" and its English subtitle "DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM V4.2". On the right, there is a green system status "SYSTEM STATUS: OPTIMIZING" and a white date and time "2023-10-27 14:30:05". The main body of the interface is divided into three column panels. The left panel shows the "当前诊断对象" (Current Diagnostic Object) as "#04 核心主轴承 Main Spindle", with "振动频率 142.5 Hz" (Vibration Frequency, in red) and "运行温度 88.2 ℃" (Operating Temperature, in orange) listed below. At the bottom is the diagnostic conclusion: "润滑油膜破裂导致非正常摩擦, 建议立即干预。" (Lubricating oil film rupture leading to abnormal friction, immediate intervention recommended.) The middle panel is for "故障根因分析" (Fault Root Cause Analysis), featuring a bar chart where one red bar is labeled "异常峰值: 142.5Hz" (Abnormal Peak: 142.5Hz). The bottom of this panel shows "置信度 98.2%" (Confidence, in green) and "影响范围 LEVEL 3" (Impact Level, in orange). The right panel presents "建议处置方案" (Recommended Solutions), listing three numbered suggestions including reducing spindle speed, forced circulation cooling, and scheduling a shutdown for inspection. At the bottom of this panel is a green button labeled "执行一键优化方案" (Execute One-Click Optimization Plan). The man is framed by an ornate wooden picture frame, and the background inside the frame features an abstract pattern of mixed blue and green. The overall background of the poster is a textured yellowish-brown wall. At the top left of the poster is the "Tencent Video" logo, and at the top right is the "X Theater" logo. The upper part of the screen features prominent large white characters "我是谁" (Who Am I), with a semi-transparent "WHO AM I" in the background above it. Below the man is a torn light brown paper with character information, including "【姓名】高风" (Name: Gao Feng), his personality description, and red highlighted keywords. At the bottom of the poster is the red artistic text "人之初" (Light of Dawn), with a semi-transparent "LIGHT OF DAWN" in the background above it, and at the very bottom are small characters "【如有相关信息请联系--人之初】" (If you have relevant information, please contact -- Light of Dawn). The overall color scheme is dominated by yellowish-brown, black, white, and red.

感 恩 父 爱
FATHER'S DAY COMMEMORATION
"父爱如衣，沉稳内敛，历久弥新。"
致：亲爱的父亲
如果说人生是一场盛大的社交礼仪，您便是那 件最考究的西装。您用坚毅的线条，为我勾勒出处世 的轮廓；用宽厚的质地，包容我所有的任性与成长。
在那些风雨交加的时刻，是您的沉默与担当，如同 精纺的羊毛般抵御寒冷，赋予我行走世间的体面与底气。
今日以此函件，致敬您如秩序美学般严谨而深沉的 爱。愿岁月温柔，正如这恒久的织物，在时光中愈发醇厚。
您的孩子 敬上
品质·传承·责任
编号: 2024-FATHERS-DAY
二零二四年·仲夏

text:
SPECIALTY COFFEE QUARTERLY REPORT
咖啡豆处理法四大工艺
VOLUME XXXV / NO. 350
ISSUED: 2024 OCTOBER
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY / 概要
处理工艺是决定生豆风味表现的关键环节。从海拔1800米以上的庄园实践来看，处理法的选择不仅受当地气候（湿度与光照）约束，亦直接影响最终市场的溢价能力与风味纯净度。本文分析目前主流的四种工艺：日晒、水洗、蜜处理及厌氧发酵。
水洗工艺 / Washed
水洗法(Washed)强调风味的透明感。去除果皮后果实进入水槽发酵12-72小时以分解果胶，随后彻底清洗。此工艺产生的酸度明亮，风味边界清晰，是商业精品豆的主流选择。
厌氧发酵 / Anaerobic
近年来崛起的厌氧发酵(Anaerobic Fermentation)将处理技术推向极端。将果实置于密闭金属桶，注入二氧化碳排出氧气，通过控制温度和pH值精准干预发酵。产生极具辨识度的肉桂、酒香及热带水果香气。
日晒工艺 / Natural
日晒法(Natural Process)是最古老的处理方式。将采摘后的咖啡果实平铺在晒床，通过整果暴晒15至30天，直至水分降至11%左右。该法保留了果肉的完整糖分。
蜜处理 / Honey
蜜处理(Honey Process)介于日晒与水洗之间。去除果皮但保留不同程度的果胶(Mucilage)进行干燥。根据保留比例分为白蜜、黄蜜、红蜜与黑蜜。黑蜜保留最多果胶，发酵感最强。

IMPACT FACTORS / 影响因子
发酵环境的稳定性是处理法的核心。在厌氧环境下，乳酸菌的代谢活动显著优于醋酸菌，这使得豆体内部分有机酸结构发生重组。数据显示，控制在15摄氏度的低温发酵能显著提升最终杯测分值(SCA Score)约2.5分。

数据来源于2023-2024产季实地抽样。价格为FOB标准(离岸价)。日晒法成本较低，但晾晒风险受降雨影响极大。厌氧发酵虽单价极高，但设备投入与技术门槛限制了小规模农户的介入。中国云南产区在厌氧处理法的应用增速位列全球前三。

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于咖啡豆处理法的季度报告信息图。页面顶部中央是中文主标题“咖啡豆处理法四大工艺”，左上角有“SPECIALTY COFFEE QUARTERLY REPORT”字样，右上角标有“VOLUME XXXV / NO. 350”和“ISSUED: 2024 OCTOBER”。报告主体内容采用三栏布局，底部设有一个横跨两栏的宽区域。报告详细介绍了日晒、水洗、蜜处理和厌氧发酵四种主要工艺，每种工艺都配有中英文小标题和一段中文描述。右侧栏包含“MARKET SHARE / 市场占比”表格，列出了不同产区的产量和变化百分比，其中增长数据以橙色显示，下降数据以蓝色显示。左侧栏下方有一个折线图，展示了2019年至2024年的价格趋势。中间栏下方是一个咖啡豆结构示意图，标有“EXOCARP (果皮)”。底部宽区域包含一个“PROCESS COMPARISON MATRIX / 处理法综合对比矩阵”表格，对比了四种处理法的风味特征、醇厚度、酸质和成本，以及“ANALYTIC NOTE / 分析备注”段落。页脚显示了数据来源和版权信息。报告整体以黑白为主色调，橙色作为强调色。
prompt_en: This is an infographic quarterly report on coffee bean processing methods. The main Chinese title "咖啡豆处理法四大工艺" (Four Major Coffee Bean Processing Methods) is at the top center of the page, with "SPECIALTY COFFEE QUARTERLY REPORT" at the top left and "VOLUME XXXV / NO. 350" and "ISSUED: 2024 OCTOBER" at the top right. The main body of the report features a three-column layout, with a wide section spanning two columns at the bottom. The report details four main processing methods: Natural, Washed, Honey, and Anaerobic, each with bilingual (Chinese/English) subheadings and a Chinese description paragraph. The right column includes a "MARKET SHARE / 市场占比" table, listing production volume and percentage changes for various regions, with positive changes highlighted in orange and negative changes in blue. Below the left column is a line chart showing price trends from 2019 to 2024. Below the middle column is a coffee bean structure diagram labeled "EXOCARP (果皮)". The wide bottom section contains a "PROCESS COMPARISON MATRIX / 处理法综合对比矩阵" table, comparing the flavor profiles, body, acidity, and cost of the four processing methods, along with an "ANALYTIC NOTE / 分析备注" paragraph. The footer displays data source and copyright information. The report primarily uses a black and white color scheme, with orange as an accent color.

prompt_cn: 这是一张美食宣传海报。画面主体是两块带有雪花纹理的生牛肉，放置在深色纹理表面上，可能为石板，并以少量绿色植物点缀。整体色调偏暗，牛肉的红白纹理突出，搭配白色和橙色文字。左上方有橙色的“NEW”和白色的“SEASONAL”标签，表明新品和季节性。右上方标有“2024 / SPRING”字样，指明季节。画面中央是巨大的白色中文标题“旬味·匠心”，下方是橙色背景条上的白色英文副标题“CRAFTED WITH PASSION”。牛肉左侧有两行白色文字，分别是“严选当季鲜活食材”和“历经百次调味打磨”，描述了产品的特点。左下角有一个橙色菱形图标，后接“匠心制作·每日现供”和一段描述性文字：“每一道新菜都承载着主厨对季节的敏锐，只为呈现食材最本真的鲜美。”右下角是一个白色矩形按钮，内含黑色的“立即品鉴”和灰色的“STORE LOBBY”。最下方是橙色的“全国连锁门店同步上市”字样。
prompt_en: This is a food promotional poster. The main visual features two cuts of raw, marbled beef, placed on a dark, textured surface, possibly a stone slab, with a few green leaves as garnish. The overall color scheme is dark, with the beef's red and white marbling standing out, complemented by white and orange text. At the top left, "NEW" in orange and "SEASONAL" in white indicate a new seasonal offering. At the top right, "2024 / SPRING" specifies the season. The central text, "旬味·匠心" (Taste of the Season · Craftsmanship) in large white characters, is the main title, with "CRAFTED WITH PASSION" in white on an orange bar below it. To the left of the beef, two lines of white text, "严选当季鲜活食材" (Carefully selected fresh seasonal ingredients) and "历经百次调味打磨" (Refined through a hundred seasoning adjustments), describe the product. text:
桥梁结构力学综述
STRUCTURAL MECHANICS OF MAJOR BRIDGE SYSTEMS / AN ENGINEERING ANALYSIS
结构之美
受力机制分析
Fundamental Force Distribution
现代长跨度方案
Modern Long-Span Systems
桥梁设计的核心在于如何将活载与恒载有效传递至地基。梁桥 (Beam Bridge) 依靠材料的抗弯强度，其截面上部受压下部受拉。拱桥 (Arch Bridge) 则通过几何构型将垂直力转化为拱圈内部的轴向压力，极大释放了材料的抗拉需求，适用于石材或混凝土等抗压材料。
在超大规模跨越中，斜拉桥通过桥塔引出的拉索直接支撑梁体，受力路径最短；而悬索桥则利用主缆的悬链线形态，将载荷通过吊索传递至锚碇。悬索桥是人类目前跨越天堑的极限手段，其跨度已突破2000米大关。

压力 Compression
主缆拉力 Tension

随着高强钢丝与碳纤维复合材料的普及，跨度界限不断被刷新。现代工程不仅关注强度，更强调空气动力学稳定性，以防止类似塔科马海峡大桥的共振灾难。
TECHNICAL NOTE
桁架桥通过三角形的几何稳定性将荷载转化为杆件的纯拉压应力，这种设计消除了笨重的夹梁，通过空心化设计大大减轻自重，常见于大跨度铁路桥梁设计。

The upper part of the poster features a black and white urban street scene photograph as the background, while the bottom part is a solid yellow area. In the top left, there is the "STREET LEAGUE" brand logo and "SEASON 2024 VOL.08" season information. On the top right, there is an "OFFICIAL SELECTION" label with a white border. At the center of the poster is a large yellow "MVP" text, below which is a horizontal bar with alternating red, green, and yellow colors, featuring the white English text "BORN TO WIN". To the lower left of "MVP" are three lines of white Chinese text: "球场主宰者", "社区体育健身公园", and "年度最有价值球员评选正式开启". The bottom yellow area of the poster contains event location and time information on the left, including "VENUE COMMUNITY SPORTS PARK" and "TIME AUG 15 - SEPT 30, 2024", with "VENUE" and "TIME" highlighted in dark grey boxes. On the bottom right, there are dark grey English texts "REGISTER VIA" and "SCAN TO VOTE", along with a QR code placeholder. The overall text is clear and has high contrast.

At the bottom left of the image, there is small pink text "LOCATION" with "梦幻棕榈海岸" (Fantasy Palm Coast) below it. The main body of the page is divided into three primary sections: three parallel information modules at the top, a USB Type-C connector pinout diagram in the middle, and a detailed technical specification table at the bottom. The top-left module illustrates the evolution of USB bandwidth, including a bar chart and a list of data rates for various USB versions. The top-middle module describes USB power delivery capabilities, highlighting the maximum EPR capacity of 240W. The top-right module explains alternate mode support and data integrity. The central pinout diagram clearly labels the 12 pins on both the A and B sides of the USB Type-C interface. The bottom table provides detailed parameters for different USB interface generations (e.g., USB 2.0, USB4 v2.0), including year, data rate, encoding scheme, and signal mode. The footer at the bottom contains engineering plate information and a copyright notice.

text:
PLATE 084 / ATLAS OF AESTHETICS
色彩学理论 COLOR THEORY
伊顿色彩轮与
六种和谐配色
The Itten Color Wheel & 6 Harmonies
背景 BACKGROUND
约翰内斯·伊顿（Johannes Itten）作为包豪斯早期的核心导师，在1921年开发了这套12色环系统。它基于RYB（红、黄、蓝）三原色模型，通过几何方式定义了色彩之间的心理与视觉张力。这一模型至今仍是视觉艺术教育的核心，用于理解对比（Contrast）与和谐（Harmony）。
“Color is life; for
a world without
colors appears
to us as dead.”
12 色轮几何 / THE 12-STEP GEOMETRY
原色 Primary
间色 Secondary
经典和谐方案 / CLASSIC HARMONIES
01. 单色 Monochromatic
色轮上不同的明度与纯度
变化。高度统一，视觉舒
适。
02. 相似色 Analogous
色轮上相邻的3-5种颜色。
常见于自然界，过渡柔和。
几何结构定义了
人类对平衡的感
知 / Geometry
defines balance.
03. 互补色 Complementary
色轮上相对的180°配色。对
比极强，充满活力。
84
04. 分裂互补 Split-Comp.
基色加互补色两侧的邻近
色。保留对比但更协调。
05. 三等分 Triadic
间隔120°的等边三角形空
间。色彩饱满且平衡感强。
06. 矩形 Tetradic
两组互补色组成的矩形。提
供最丰富的色调组合变化。
数据注释 NOTES
本页基于Johannes Itten的《色彩艺术》(The Art of Color, 1961)。RYB模型虽然在工业印刷(CMYK)或屏幕显示(RGB)中并非物理准则，但在绘画艺术与审美构图领域仍是直觉平衡的金科玉律。

On the left and center of the image, a long-haired woman is seated on a light-colored sofa, wearing a light-colored dress and a black jacket, looking towards the viewer. All textual information is displayed on the right side of the poster, including the artist's name "MIKA NAKASHIMA" and "中島美嘉", the event title "Live in TAIPEI", the presenter "presented by billboard LIVE TAIPEI", and the performance schedule for November 18th (Tuesday) and November 19th (Wednesday) in 2025, showing OPEN/START times. At the bottom, a website "詳細資訊 billboardlivetaipei.tw" is provided for more details. The background is a light beige or white fabric with subtle vertical folds. The text is primarily dark brown, contrasting with the light background.

text:
锦绘：日本浮世绘多色木版画制作工艺
Xylographia Japonica Multiplex (Nishiki-e)
四重分工体系 / The Fourfold System
HANMOTO / 版元
出版商与策划人：负责选题策划、资金投入、销售渠道及市场把控。如著名出版商蔦屋重三郎。
ESHI / 绘师
原画创作者：绘制“版下绘”（图线稿）。代表人物如葛饰北斋、歌川广重。
HORISHI / 雕师
木板雕刻专家：将画稿转印至樱木板并进行极致精细的雕刻，区分主版与各色版。
SURISHI / 刷师
上色印刷专家：负责调色、敷纸与压印。通过掌控马连的力度表现色彩浓淡与渐变效果。
材料要素 / Primary Materials
版材 / Block
山樱木 (Yamazakura)
原纸 / Paper
越前奉书纸 (Washi)
颜料 / Pigment
植物矿物色 (Natural)
胶着 / Binder
米糊/饭水 (Rice Paste)
SYSTEMATIC EXPLOSION / 工艺拆解图
KENTO / 见当线
色版 (iro-ban) 蓝色层
色版 (iro-ban) 红色层
主版 (Omo-ban) 墨线轮廓
套印核心 / Registration
见当 (KENTO) 构造图
见当 / Kento：雕刻于版木右下角的“引见当”与长边侧的“见当”，是防止数十层套色错位的一物理基准。
STEP 01 / 版下绘
画师在极薄的和纸上完成墨线稿。雕师将其反贴在樱木板表面。
STEP 02 / 主版雕刻
雕出仅留线条的“主版”。此时必须在版边刻下L形的定位标记（见当）。
印刷工具 / Printing Tool
STEP 03 / 色版区分
利用主版印出多张“校合摺”，画师于其上指定颜色区域，随后雕刻多块色版。
STEP 04 / 叠印成像
按照由浅入深顺序叠印。摺师通过见当确保数十次套色毫无偏位。
马连 / Baren：由竹皮编织的芯、涂漆纸垫及竹皮外壳组成。通过圆周运动将压力均匀传导至纸张，产生细腻色泽。
SECTION 14: ARTISANAL REPRODUCTION
EDITION 2024 / PLATE NO. 082
PLATE DIMENSIONS: 390 × 260 MM (O-BAN)

prompt_cn: 这是一张详细介绍日本浮世绘多色木版画制作工艺的信息图。图片背景为深绿色。顶部标题为“锦绘：日本浮世绘多色木版画制作工艺”，下方附有英文副标题。整体布局分为左右两大垂直区域。左侧区域提供文字说明，主要包含“四重分工体系 / The Fourfold System”和“材料要素 / Primary Materials”两个部分。“四重分工体系”列出了四种角色（HANMOTO、ESHI、HORISHI、SURISHI）及其职责描述。“材料要素”则是一个两列表格，列出了“版材 / Block”和“原纸 / Paper”等材料。右侧区域展示了多个图示和工艺步骤。其中包括一个“SYSTEMATIC EXPLOSION / 工艺拆解图”，展示了蓝色、红色和墨线轮廓分层叠加的版块；一个“套印核心 / Registration”图示，描绘了带有L形定位标记的“见当 (KENTO) 构造图”；以及一个“印刷工具 / Printing Tool”图示，展示了一个圆形工具。这些图示下方详细描述了版画制作的四个步骤（STEP 01至STEP 04），并对“马连 / Baren”工具进行了详细解释。图片底部是三行页脚信息，包括“SECTION 14: ARTISANAL REPRODUCTION”、“EDITION 2024 / PLATE NO. 082”和“PLATE DIMENSIONS: 390 × 260 MM (O-BAN)”。
prompt_en: This infographic details the Japanese Ukiyo-e multi-color woodblock printing process. The image features a dark green background. The main title at the top reads “锦绘：日本浮世绘多色木版画制作工艺” with its English subtitle “Xylographia Japonica Multiplex (Nishiki-e)”. The overall layout is divided into two main vertical sections. The left section provides textual explanations, organized under two headings: “四重分工体系 / The Fourfold System” and “材料要素 / Primary Materials”. The “四重分工体系” lists four roles (HANMOTO, ESHI, HORISHI, SURISHI) and their respective descriptions. The “材料要素” is a two-column table detailing materials such as “版材 / Block” and “原纸 / Paper”. The right section presents various diagrams and process steps. It includes a “SYSTEMATIC EXPLOSION / 工艺拆解图” showing layered blocks (blue, red, and outline), a “套印核心 / Registration” diagram illustrating the “见当 (KENTO) 构造图” with an L-shaped registration mark, and a “印刷工具 / Printing Tool” diagram depicting a circular tool. Below these diagrams, four steps (STEP 01 to STEP 04) of the printing process are described, along with a detailed explanation of the “马连 / Baren” tool. The bottom of the image contains three lines of footer text: “SECTION 14: ARTISANAL REPRODUCTION”, “EDITION 2024 / PLATE NO. 082”, and “PLATE DIMENSIONS: 390 × 260 MM (O-BAN)”.

谢 仪
各位亲朋好友:
在家父告别仪式期间，承蒙各位亲友厚爱，不辞辛劳，远道而来，同表哀悼。
在这一段艰难的时光里，是您的关怀与慰藉，如同冬日里的温暖光晕，给予了我们莫大的力量与支持。
诸事繁杂，未能一一登门致谢，深表歉意。在此，家属全体成员向各位致以最诚挚的谢意。
家属: 张文远 携全家 叩谢
二〇二四年五月二十二日

prompt_cn: 这是一张以浅米色为背景的致谢信。顶部中央是一幅黑白照片，照片中一棵枝叶繁茂的树立于水面之上，有清晰的倒影，背景模糊。照片下方是标题“谢 仪”，标题上方和下方各有一条短横线作为装饰。标题下方左侧是称谓“各位亲朋好友:”，字体加粗。接着是三段左对齐的正文，内容表达了对亲友在告别仪式期间关怀与支持的感谢，并为未能一一登门致谢表示歉意。右下角是署名“家属: 张文远 携全家 叩谢”和日期“二〇二四年五月二十二日”，两者均右对齐。左下角有一个浅色的星形装饰图案。整体排版简洁庄重，文字均为深色，与浅色背景形成良好对比，易于阅读。

At the top center is a black and white photograph featuring a lush tree standing above water with a clear reflection, against a blurred background. Below the photo is the title "谢 仪" (Xie Yi, meaning Thank You Ceremony/Etiquette), flanked by a short horizontal line above and below it as decoration. To the lower left of the title is the salutation "各位亲朋好友:" (Dear Relatives and Friends:), in bold font. Following this are three left-aligned paragraphs of body text, expressing gratitude for the care and support from relatives and friends during a farewell ceremony, and apologizing for not being able to thank everyone in person. In the bottom right corner are the signature "家属: 张文远 携全家 叩谢" (Family: Zhang Wenyuan and family respectfully thank you) and the date "二〇二四年五月二十二日" (May 22, 2024), both right-aligned. A light star-shaped decorative pattern is present in the bottom left corner. The overall layout is simple and solemn, with all text in dark color, providing good contrast against the light background for easy readability.

prompt_en: This is a digital illustration in a fantasy art style. At the center of the image is a young female character with long pink hair, pointed ears, and a pair of large, glowing pink butterfly-like wings. She has tear stains on her face, a sad expression, and holds a glowing pink orb in her hands. The background depicts a dark, mysterious forest with glowing trees and pink butterflies. The overall color scheme is dominated by pink, black, and dark purple, complemented by bright white glowing elements and scattered star-shaped particles. The left side of the image simulates a social media comment section interface, displaying user avatars, the username "魔法界" (Magic World), and multiple comment texts, with "赞 评论 分享" (Like Comment Share) buttons below the comments. At the top of the comment section, there is "← 魔法界" (← Magic World) navigation text and a "..." menu icon. On the right side of the image, four lines of dialogue text are arranged, such as "婳姥: 衷给你闻除吗" (Hua Lao: Do you want me to remove it for you?). In the top right corner, there is a rectangular banner with a neon pink border, containing the text "紧急预警中" (Emergency Warning). The large, pink-outlined main title "魔法诅咒" (Magic Curse) and subtitle "破咒指南;;" (Curse-Breaking Guide;;) are centrally placed, partially overlapping the character. A pink star-shaped icon is in the top left corner. In the top left, a speech bubble contains the warning text "别碰那个咒语！;;" (Don't touch that spell!;;). The middle left features artistic font titles like "黑森林秘闻" (Black Forest Secrets), "精灵之泪" (Tears of the Elves), and "永恒之誓" (Eternal Oath). In the bottom right, there is a question "你敢尝试解除吗?" (Do you dare to try to lift it?).

prompt_cn: 这是一张游戏战绩结算界面截图，背景为深蓝色到黑色的渐变，带有细微的网格纹理。图片整体呈三段式布局。顶部左侧显示玩家角色头像和名称“GHOST_OPERATOR”，下方有“MVP”标签和“排位赛 - 极地工厂”的游戏模式信息。顶部中央以半透明效果叠加显示“VICTORY”和“胜利”字样。中部核心数据区左侧有一个紫蓝色渐变条，显示“TOTAL ELIMINATIONS”和数值“24”，下方有“+120%”和“超越同段位玩家”的描述。中部右侧是一个灰度调的工业场景小图，下方标注“最高连杀: 8”。底部是详细统计区，包含多个数据卡片，如带有进度条的“爆头率 42.5 %”卡片（右侧有时钟图标），紫色背景的“总伤害 12,450”卡片（下方有“RANK #1”），以及“助攻 14”、“死亡 3”、“KDA 12.7”等。页脚部分显示“MATCH DURATION 18:42”、“SERVER East Asia #04”和“TIMESTAMP 2024.05.24 22:15”。所有文字主要为白色，部分关键数据使用蓝色、红色、黄色或紫蓝色渐变色突出显示。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a game results screen, featuring a dark blue to black gradient background with subtle grid textures. The image is structured into three main sections. The top left displays a player character avatar and the name "GHOST_OPERATOR," with an "MVP" tag and "Ranked - Polar Factory" game mode information below. The top center shows "VICTORY" and "胜利" (Victory) overlaid in a semi-transparent effect. The central core data area on the left has a purple-blue gradient bar, displaying "TOTAL ELIMINATIONS" and the value "24," with "+120%" and "Surpassed players of the same rank" below. The central right features a small grayscale image of an industrial scene, labeled "Highest Kill Streak: 8" below. The bottom section provides detailed statistics, including multiple data cards such as "Headshot Rate 42.5 %" with a progress bar (and a clock icon on the right), a purple-background "Total Damage 12,450" card (with "RANK #1" below), and "Assists 14," "Deaths 3," "KDA 12.7," among others. The footer displays "MATCH DURATION 18:42," "SERVER East Asia #04," and "TIMESTAMP 2024.05.24 22:15." All text is primarily white, with some key data highlighted in blue, red, yellow, or purple-blue gradient colors.

The poster's background is a dark grey-blue gradient. On the left side of the poster, large light green letters "COMING HOME" are arranged vertically. To the right are the artist's Chinese and English names, "潘玮柏 Will Pan". The lower section of the poster details concert information, including the date and venue: "2023 WORLD TOUR 世界巡回演唱会", "10月 19 OCT SYDNEY 悉尼站 THE STAR EVENT CENTRE". Additionally, it includes ticketing information "TICKETS AT: TICKETEK PREMIER.TICKETEK.COM.AU", and brand names of various sponsors and partners under categories like "制作单位" (Producers), "票务代理" (Ticketing Agent), "行业赞助" (Industry Sponsors), "指定旅行合作伙伴" (Official Travel Partner), "票务支持" (Ticketing Support), and "支持机构" (Supporting Organizations). A golden handwritten signature is present in the lower right corner of the poster. The entire poster is laid flat on a beige leather sofa, with slight creases on its surface.

A silver-gray fuel truck is parked beneath the aircraft's left wing, and a worker wearing a yellow-green reflective vest is operating near the aircraft engine. The fuel truck's tank has the black "swissport" brand logo in the center. The left side of the tank displays red warning labels "FLAMMABLE" and "NO SMOKING". The right side of the tank has red labels "JET A", "NO SMOKING", and "1863". The rear left of the fuel truck tank shows "JET A", "64025", and "NO SMOKING" labels, while the rear right has "FLAMMABLE" and "1863" labels. text:
STORM RIDER
D&D 2024 圣骑士原型
天空同伴
有些圣骑士依靠信仰。
有些依靠剑盾或光环。
而 Storm Rider 依靠的是他们的天空同伴。
鹰能俯瞰战场。隼能截击飞矢。乌鸦能传递警告。
翼蛇能钻入云缝、撕裂法阵，并将正义带到任何地面无法触及的高塔之巅。
这些生物不是克哈的仆从。它们不是装饰。
它们是先驱、护卫、判官、天罚，以及风暴中的活闪电。
Storm Rider 不仰望天空。
他们本身就是风暴，与雷电同行，
在云端上、闪电中、云端城堡的顶端书写审判。
雷电与羽翼，审判降临。

The main subject is a knight in silver armor and a white cloak, kneeling on a castle wall with his left arm extended forward, against a backdrop of lightning. A majestic castle is situated in the mid-ground, enveloped by clouds, with a large full moon behind it. Various flying creatures are distributed throughout the scene, including a hawk perched on a gargoyle on the left, a raven on a clock tower on the right, an owl and a bat flying in the air, and a winged serpent coiling on the right. The overall color palette is dark, dominated by shades of purple, gold, gray, and dark blue. Both the top and the bottom text area of the image feature ornate golden borders. The bottom section contains multiple paragraphs of Chinese text, with the title "天空同伴" (Sky Companions), detailing the characteristics and abilities of "Storm Rider" and their "Sky Companions," closely echoing the fantasy scene and creature theme in the image. At the very bottom, there is a slogan "雷电与羽翼，审判降临。" (Thunder and Wings, Judgment Descends.).

prompt_cn: 这是一张显示网页或应用界面的截图。界面以浅灰色为背景，顶部居中偏左位置显示文章标题“交互设计中的空间留白与信息密度研究”，字体较大且为深灰色粗体。标题下方是发布日期“发布于 2023年10月24日”和评论数量“1,284 条评论”，字体较小且为浅灰色。页面主体部分是评论区，包含多个独立的评论卡片，每个卡片背景为白色，边角圆润。每个评论卡片左侧有圆形用户头像，右侧显示用户名（如“张若虚”、“李清照”、“王维”），字体为深灰色粗体；用户名下方是用户职位（如“资深产品设计师”、“前端架构师”、“独立开发者”），字体为浅灰色；评论卡片右上角显示发布时间（如“2小时前”、“5小时前”、“昨天”），字体为浅灰色。评论内容（如“这篇文章对‘克制’的定义非常精准。”）以深灰色常规字体显示在卡片下方。页面底部是分页导航区域，左侧有两个深蓝色背景、白色文字的按钮，分别为“上一页”和“下一页”。中间是分页数字，当前页“1”被深蓝色背景高亮显示，文字为白色；其他页码“2”、“3”、“...”和“42”为浅灰色文字。分页导航右侧有“跳转至”文本、一个显示数字“1”的输入框和“页”文本。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot displaying a webpage or application interface. The interface has a light gray background. At the top, slightly left of center, is the article title "交互设计中的空间留白与信息密度研究" (Research on White Space and Information Density in Interaction Design), in large, dark gray bold font. Below the title are the publication date "发布于 2023年10月24日" (Published on October 24, 2023) and the comment count "1,284 条评论" (1,284 Comments), both in smaller, light gray font. The main part of the page is the comment section, which contains multiple individual comment cards, each with a white background and rounded corners. Each comment card features a circular user avatar on the left, with the username (e.g., "张若虚", "李清照", "王维") in dark gray bold font to its right. Below the username is the user's job title (e.g., "资深产品设计师" - Senior Product Designer, "前端架构师" - Frontend Architect, "独立开发者" - Independent Developer) in light gray font. The top right of each comment card shows the post time (e.g., "2小时前" - 2 hours ago, "5小时前" - 5 hours ago, "昨天" - Yesterday) in light gray font. The comment content (e.g., "这篇文章对‘克制’的定义非常精准。" - This article's definition of "restraint" is very precise.) is displayed below in dark gray regular font. At the bottom of the page is the pagination navigation area. On the left are two dark blue background buttons with white text, labeled "上一页" (Previous Page) and "下一页" (Next Page). In the middle are page numbers; the current page "1" is highlighted with a dark blue background and white text, while other page numbers "2", "3", "..." and "42" are in light gray text. To the right of the pagination navigation are the text "跳转至" (Jump to), an input box displaying the number "1", and the text "页" (Page).

prompt_cn: 这是一张详细介绍美国航天飞机发射系统的信息图。整体布局分为三个主要部分：中央是航天飞机的插图，两侧是两列垂直排列的文字信息。背景为深灰色。顶部以大号白色文字显示标题“美国航天飞机 发射系统”，并附有项目代码、坐标以及总重量、近地轨道运载能力和主要飞行器等关键系统规格。左侧栏详细介绍了“轨道飞行器 / ORBITER”、“隔热防护系统”和“推进动力”，每个部分都包含黄色标题、描述性文本和醒目的数据点。右侧栏则涵盖了“外罐 / ET”、“固体助推器 / SRB”和“关键时序”，结构类似，包含黄色标题、文本和数据。中央插图右侧有一个大型的、垂直排列的水印文字“PROJECT: STS-TRINITY // SYSTEM CODE: 1981-2011”。底部有一个小表格，展示了“高度”、“跨度”、“燃料”和“核心”等额外规格。页脚还包含其他系统详细信息。
prompt_en: This infographic details the American Space Shuttle launch system. The overall layout is divided into three main sections: a central illustration of the space shuttle, flanked by two vertical columns of textual information. The background is dark gray. At the top, the title "美国航天飞机 发射系统" (American Space Shuttle Launch System) is displayed in large white characters, accompanied by project codes, coordinates, and key system specifications such as total weight, low earth orbit capacity, and primary vehicle. The left column provides detailed information about the "轨道飞行器 / ORBITER" (Orbiter), "隔热防护系统" (Thermal Protection System), and "推进动力" (Propulsion System), each with a yellow section title, descriptive text, and prominent data points. The right column covers the "外罐 / ET" (External Tank), "固体助推器 / SRB" (Solid Rocket Boosters), and "关键时序" (Key Timelines), similarly structured with yellow titles, text, and data. A large, vertically oriented watermark "PROJECT: STS-TRINITY // SYSTEM CODE: 1981-2011" is visible on the right side of the central illustration. At the bottom, a small table presents additional specifications: "高度" (Height), "跨度" (Span), "燃料" (Fuel), and "核心" (Core). The footer contains further system details.

The image features a grid layout, divided into three columns, with each column detailing one character. The background is light beige with a fine grid pattern. Each character is shown in front, side, and back views, wearing unique uniforms or gear. Japanese labels with connecting lines point to specific parts of their clothing or equipment. Below each character, there is an English description, ID, role name, a circular emblem, and a barcode. At the bottom of each column, an equipment list with small icons is provided. The bottom left of the image displays a row of eight color swatches, while the bottom right contains Japanese footer information, including "公式記録" (Official Record), "発行元" (Publisher), and "記録日" (Record Date).

prompt_cn: 这是一张以米色和棕色为主色调的数字拼贴画，模拟了剪贴簿的风格。画面顶部中央有一架纸飞机，其下方是两个带有虚线边框的空白矩形区域，暗示着可填充内容。图片右上角是一个日历，显示“July”月份，并列出了从1到31的日期，其中周日到周六的缩写为“SUN”到“SAT”。日历下方夹着一个红色夹子和一朵红色花朵。画面右下角放置着一个复古的唱片机，其上方飘散着音符图案。唱片机旁边有一只手握着一朵红玫瑰，玫瑰花瓣上插着一片带有“STAINLESS”和“Philips”字样的刀片。图片底部中央是手写风格的白色描边文字“Modern Girl”。整个背景由撕裂的纸张纹理和模糊的文字组成，包括左上角的芬兰语“kayttöohje”，右侧的瑞典语“2 års garant”，左下角的葡萄牙语“Serviço”和垂直排布的“BRASIL”，以及右下角的葡萄牙语“garantia”。
prompt_en: This is a digital collage in a scrapbook style, predominantly in beige and brown tones. A paper airplane is at the top center, below which are two blank rectangular areas with dashed borders, suggesting fillable content. In the upper right corner is a calendar displaying the month "July" and dates from 1 to 31, with days of the week abbreviated from "SUN" to "SAT". Below the calendar, a red clip and a red flower are attached. A vintage turntable is placed in the lower right corner, with musical notes floating above it. Next to the turntable, a hand holds a red rose, and a razor blade with the words "STAINLESS" and "Philips" is inserted into the rose petals. At the bottom center of the image, the phrase "Modern Girl" is written in a handwritten style with a white outline. The entire background consists of torn paper textures and blurred texts, including Finnish "kayttöohje" in the upper left, Swedish "2 års garant" on the right, Portuguese "Serviço" and vertically arranged "BRASIL" in the lower left, and Portuguese "garantia" in the lower right.

江户前寿司 (Edomae Sushi) 是基于“处理”艺术的工程学。其核心在于舍利 (醋饭) 与种 (鱼料) 的动力学平衡。通过醋渍、昆布渍、煮制等手段改变蛋白质结构,以达到风味巅峰。本图鉴确立了五大核心鱼料品类及三种标准手握技法。

现今主流手法,利用手腕局部转动,减少体温干扰。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于江户前寿司的详细信息图表，标题为“江户前寿司图鉴 EDOMAE SUSHI”，右上角标有数字“24”。图表整体采用深色背景，文字以白色为主，部分标题和强调数字使用红色。图表分为多个区域，顶部左侧是关于江户前寿司的概述，解释了其核心理念和五大鱼料品类及三种手握技法。顶部右侧列出了舍利温度、环境湿度和含盐浓度等环境参数。中部左侧展示了握寿司的内部切面结构图，标示出鱼料、舍利和内部空隙。中部右侧详细介绍了“三大握法分类”，包括本手返、小手返和立返，并配有“关键动量指示图”展示压力传递路径。底部左侧是一个数据表，详细列出了五种鱼料分类（赤身、白身、光物、煮物、贝类）的代表品种、关键工序和推荐调味。底部右侧是“季节性供应周期表”，通过柱状图展示了春、夏、秋、冬四季鱼料的油脂含量，并注明纵轴代表油脂含量指数。图表底部包含技术档案编码、分类等级和版权信息。
prompt_en: This is a detailed infographic about Edomae Sushi, titled '江户前寿司图鉴 EDOMAE SUSHI', with the number '24' in the top right corner. The chart features a dark background with predominantly white text, while some titles and emphasized numbers are in red. The infographic is divided into several sections. The top left provides an overview of Edomae Sushi, explaining its core philosophy, five main fish ingredient categories, and three standard nigiri techniques. The top right lists environmental parameters such as shari temperature, ambient humidity, and salt concentration. The middle left displays a cross-section diagram of nigiri sushi, indicating the neta (fish topping), shari (vinegared rice), and internal air pockets. The middle right elaborates on 'Three Main Nigiri Techniques', including Honte-Gaeshi, Kote-Gaeshi, and Tate-Gaeshi, accompanied by a 'Key Momentum Indicator Diagram' showing pressure transmission paths. The bottom left features a data table detailing five fish ingredient classifications (Akami, Shiromi, Hikari, Nimon, Shell) with their representative species, key processes, and recommended seasonings. The bottom right presents a 'Seasonal Supply Cycle Chart', using a bar chart to illustrate the lipid content of fish ingredients across spring, summer, autumn, and winter, with a note indicating the vertical axis represents the Lipid Index. The bottom of the chart includes technical archive codes, classification levels, and copyright information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张日出或日落时分的沙滩摄影照片。画面上半部分是橙红色调的天空和大海，太阳在地平线上散发着光芒，海面波光粼粼。下半部分是金黄色的沙滩，海浪轻柔地拍打着岸边。沙滩中央有一个可爱的沙堡，被塑造成卡通形象，面带微笑，并举着一个粉白色的贝壳。沙堡上方沙滩上刻有“欢迎光临2021”字样。沙堡左侧卷着一条棕白相间的毛巾，右侧放置着一个白色充电宝和一把蓝白条纹的折叠伞。沙滩左下角和右侧偏上分别有一个蓝黄相间和绿色的纸巾盒。
prompt_en: This is a photographic image of a beach at sunrise or sunset. The upper half of the picture shows an orange-red sky and sea, with the sun radiating light on the horizon, creating sparkling reflections on the water surface. text:
常见人类病毒形态分类学
在微观世界的精密秩序中，病毒以其极端简约的构造挑战着生物学的传统定义。这种非细胞生物实体的形态并非偶然，而是其遗传物质——脱氧核糖核酸 (DNA) 或核糖核酸 (RNA) ——与其蛋白质外壳 (衣壳) 之间物理作用的必然结果。根据巴尔的摩分类法及结构形态，我们得以观测到从简单的二十面体到具有复杂包膜的日冕状结构。
DNA 病毒通常表现出高度的对称性。腺病毒 (Adenoviridae) 作为典型的无包膜病毒，其二十面体衣壳由 252 个壳粒组成，顶端伸出的纤维蛋白负责识别宿主受体。相比之下，疱疹病毒 (Herpesviridae) 则拥有一层源自宿主细胞核膜的复杂脂质包膜，包裹着内里的线状双链 DNA 核心。
腺病毒 / Adenovirus
冠状病毒 / Coronavirus
图一：无包膜二十面体对称与有包膜变形性结构之比较
RNA 病毒的形态则更为多变，反映了其基因组的不稳定性与进化压力。冠状病毒 (Coronavirus) 属于单链正链 RNA 病毒，其典型的日冕状棘突 (Spike Protein) 赋予了其强大的跨物种传播能力。而流感病毒 (Orthomyxoviridae) 的形态则由于其分节段的负链 RNA 基因组而呈现不规则的球形或丝状，表面布满了血凝素 (HA) 与神经氨酸酶 (NA) 蛋白。
逆转录病毒如艾滋病病毒 (HIV) 展现了更为特殊的结构：在其脂质双层包膜内，包裹着一个由蛋白质组成的圆锥形核心，其中含有两条单链 RNA。而在所有的形态分类中，丝状病毒 (Filoviridae) 如埃博拉病毒最令人惊叹，其长度可达 800 纳米，如同一条纤细的丝线，在电子显微镜下呈现出独特的 U 形或 6 字形轮廓。
埃博拉病毒丝状结构 / Filiform Structure of Ebola

病毒的形态分类学不仅是分类工具，更是理解其感染机制的关键。从二十面体的几何刚性到包膜病毒的流体动力学，每一种结构都是数亿年自然选择的精妙产物。在这些极小尺度的物质中，功能与形式达到了完美的统一。
184 / ANTHROPOGENIC VIROLOGY

SPECIAL EDITION
VOL. 2024 / NO. 06
父亲节致辞
用心爱·筑匠
致 我生命中最伟大的工程师
在我的成长记忆里，您的双手总是带着淡淡的金属气息与机油的味道。那口沉重的工具箱，不仅修理好了家里摇晃的桌椅，更在无形中修整了我人生的航向。
坚韧如钢
温情如火
您教会我，生活就像一件复杂的精密仪器，需要用耐心去拆解，用坚韧去组装。每一次挫折后的鼓励，都像是为我的意志涂上了防锈漆；每一次成功后的叮嘱，都像是对我的前行校准了精度。
父爱规则说明
结构强度
无限承重
精细程度
微米级守护
品质期限
终身有效
感谢您，用那双布满老茧的手，为我搭建起遮风挡雨的港湾。在这个属于您的节日里，愿您卸下重担，享受这份由您亲手打造的幸福时光。
落款人
您的孩子
感恩
致敬
QUALITY ASSURED
EST. 19XX
LOVE LEVEL: 100%

人类眼球解剖学
ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN EYE
TECHNICAL SCHEMATIC: OPTICAL SYSTEM 01-A
MODULE 01
1 光学折射系统
人眼球的总折射力约为60-62D，其中角膜贡献了约43D（约70%的折射率），其曲率固定。晶状体由睫状肌调节，提供约19D的变焦能力，确保光线精确聚焦于视网膜。
角膜 CORNEA
晶状体 LENS
黄斑 FOVEA
LIGHT PATH
入射光线
MODULE 02
2 光圈调节机制
虹膜通过环形肌和辐射状肌收缩调节瞳孔直径（2mm至8mm）。该过程由自主神经控制，调节进入眼内的光通量，同时增加景深并减少球面像差。
视网膜 RETINA
MODULE 03
3 感光信号转换
视网膜通过光解反应将光子转化为生物电信号。黄斑中心凹仅含视锥细胞，提供极高分辨率和色彩识别；周边区域以视杆细胞为主，负责弱光感知。
MODULE 04
4 生理盲点
视神经乳头处是神经纤维汇聚并穿出眼球的部位。该区域完全没有感光细胞，在视野中形成一个生理性缺损，即盲点(Blind Spot)。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类眼球解剖学的信息图表。图片顶部是深蓝色背景的标题栏，显示中文标题“人类眼球解剖学”和英文副标题“ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN EYE”。主体内容分为中间左右两栏和底部表格区。左侧是一个简化的眼球横截面示意图，标示了“角膜 CORNEA”、“晶状体 LENS”、“黄斑 FOVEA”、“视网膜 RETINA”等主要结构，并用虚线箭头指示“入射光线 LIGHT PATH”。右侧是四个编号为“MODULE 01”至“MODULE 04”的文字模块，每个模块都有橙色背景，分别解释了眼球的光学折射系统、光圈调节机制、感光信号转换和生理盲点。图片底部是一个五列四行的表格，标题栏为深蓝色，详细列出了“感光细胞类别 PHOTORECEPTOR TYPE”、“总量 QUANTITY”、“主要功能 PRIMARY FUNCTION”、“敏感度 SENSITIVITY”和“分布区域 DISTRIBUTION”等信息，并具体展示了视杆细胞和三种视锥细胞的数据。整张图表通过图文结合的方式，系统地介绍了人眼球的结构与功能。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the anatomy of the human eye. The top of the image features a dark blue background title bar, displaying the Chinese main title "人类眼球解剖学" and the English subtitle "ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN EYE". The main content is divided into a central two-column section and a bottom table area. On the left is a simplified cross-section diagram of the eyeball, labeling key structures such as "角膜 CORNEA", "晶状体 LENS", "黄斑 FOVEA", and "视网膜 RETINA", with a dashed arrow indicating "入射光线 LIGHT PATH". On the right are four text modules, numbered "MODULE 01" to "MODULE 04", each with an orange background, explaining the eye's optical refractive system, aperture adjustment mechanism, photoreceptor signal conversion, and physiological blind spot, respectively. The bottom of the image contains a five-column, four-row table with a dark blue title bar, detailing information such as "感光细胞类别 PHOTORECEPTOR TYPE", "总量 QUANTITY", "主要功能 PRIMARY FUNCTION", "敏感度 SENSITIVITY", and "分布区域 DISTRIBUTION", specifically presenting data for rod cells and three types of cone cells. The entire infographic systematically introduces the structure and function of the human eye through a combination of text and visuals.

内容: 包豪斯不仅仅是一所学校, 它是一种思维方式。通过将艺术、手工与大工业生产相结合, 它彻底改变了20世纪的视觉面貌。从字体设计到建筑结构, 其“去装饰化”的理念至今仍是现代主义设计的核心基石。

text_63:
内容: MODERNISM SECTION
语言: 英文
位置: 图片右下角，PROCEED TO下方
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，右对齐
作用: 导航
prompt_cn: 这是一张关于包豪斯百年设计流变的信息图，采用浅米色背景和三栏式布局。顶部是中文主标题“包豪斯百年设计流变”及其英文副标题“BAUHAUS: 100 YEARS OF EVOLUTION”，右侧红色方块内标有“100 YEARS ANNIV.”。左侧栏以时间轴形式介绍了包豪斯的三个时期：魏玛时期、德绍时期和柏林时期，每个时期都配有日期、描述和红色背景的英文标签（如“ART & CRAFT”）。中间栏上方是“核心导师团队”表格，列出了姓名、职责和任职时间；下方是“经典器物图志”，展示了MT8 LAMP和WASSILLY CHAIR的线稿图，并附有设计师和描述。右侧栏包含“材质革新”部分，通过不同颜色背景条展示了钢管、工业玻璃和混凝土三种材料；下方是“形式追随功能”的理念阐述。右下角蓝色方块内引用了“LESS IS MORE.”和“GOD IS IN THE DETAILS.”等中英文名言。底部红色条上标有“BAUHAUS-ARCHIV BERLIN / MUSEUM FÜR GESTALTUNG”和页码信息。左下角有一段中文总结性文字，右下角是“PROCEED TO MODERNISM SECTION”导航。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the hundred-year evolution of Bauhaus design, featuring a light beige background and a three-column layout. At the top, there is a Chinese main title "包豪斯百年设计流变" (Bauhaus: A Hundred Years of Design Evolution) and its English subtitle "BAUHAUS: 100 YEARS OF EVOLUTION". A red square on the top right corner displays "100 YEARS ANNIV.". The left column presents the three periods of Bauhaus in a chronological timeline: Weimar, Dessau, and Berlin, each with dates, descriptions, and English labels on a red background (e.g., "ART & CRAFT"). The middle column features a "核心导师团队 / MASTERS" (Core Faculty Team) table listing names, roles, and periods of service, and below it, "经典器物图志 / ICONIC OBJECTS" (Classic Object Illustrations) showing line drawings of MT8 LAMP and WASSILLY CHAIR with designers and descriptions. The right column includes a "材质革新 / MATERIALS" (Material Innovation) section, displaying three materials (steel tube, industrial glass, and concrete) with different colored background bars, and below it, the concept of "形式追随功能 / FORM FOLLOWS FUNCTION". A blue square at the bottom right quotes "LESS IS MORE." and "GOD IS IN THE DETAILS." in both Chinese and English. A red bar at the bottom contains "BAUHAUS-ARCHIV BERLIN / MUSEUM FÜR GESTALTUNG" and page number information. The bottom left has a concluding Chinese text about Bauhaus philosophy, and the bottom right shows "PROCEED TO MODERNISM SECTION" for navigation.

prompt_en: This is an event poster set against a beige paper texture background. At the top left, the poster features the emblem and Chinese and English names of Shanghai Theatre Academy, with five black five-pointed stars to its right. The main subject of the poster is a large black clock face, marked with Roman numerals XII, I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X, XI as hour markers. A black silhouette of a person in a walking pose is depicted in the center of the clock face. Below the clock is the English title "HAMILTON," rendered in a gold gradient, bold, serif font. Beneath it is a black star-shaped graphic, on which a white quill pen is placed. The middle left of the poster contains three lines of black text: "音乐剧中心" (Musical Theatre Center), "2021级" (Class of 2021), and "多幕剧教学汇报" (Multi-Act Play Teaching Report). The middle right section provides performance venue and time information, including "演出场地: 华山路630号、上戏新空间" (Venue: 630 Huashan Road, STA New Space) and "演出时间: 12月8、9、10日、每晚7:00" (Performance Time: December 8, 9, 10, 7:00 PM nightly). Below the star graphic is the Chinese title "汉密尔顿," in a gold gradient, bold, handwritten-style font, followed by an orange italic English slogan "I am not throwing away my shit." The bottom of the poster lists the staff, including art director, general coordinator, directors, dance instructor, vocal instructors, chorus instructor, and art instructors, all in small black text. Hand-drawn illustrations of items like an ink bottle, a scroll, books, and a wine bottle are scattered on the left and right sides of the poster.

prompt_cn: 这是一张数字图形设计，展示了一份以浅蓝色为主色调的婚礼菜单。背景是柔和的浅蓝色渐变，四角点缀着水彩风格的蓝色和灰色花卉图案。画面中央是一个带有精致边框的白色矩形面板，承载着菜单的详细内容。面板顶部是艺术字体“Menu”，下方是“百年好合餐 1299元/席”，两侧配有装饰符号。菜单内容按“凉菜”、“热菜”、“主食”、“汤羹”和“小菜 & 甜点”等章节划分，每个章节下方列出具体的菜品名称。图片顶部右侧有“Canva 可”字样，左右两侧边缘垂直排列着“WEDDING MENU”作为装饰。
prompt_en: This is a digital graphic design showcasing a wedding menu with a light blue main color scheme. The background features a soft light blue gradient, adorned with watercolor-style blue and grey floral patterns at the four corners. At the center of the image is a white rectangular panel with an ornate border, containing the detailed menu. At the top of the panel is the artistic font "Menu", followed by "百年好合餐 1299元/席" (Hundred-Year Harmony Meal 1299 yuan/table) with decorative symbols on both sides. The menu content is divided into sections such as "凉菜" (Cold Dishes), "热菜" (Hot Dishes), "主食" (Staple Food), "汤羹" (Soups), and "小菜 & 甜点" (Side Dishes & Desserts), with specific dish names listed under each section. The top right of the image displays "Canva 可", and "WEDDING MENU" is vertically arranged along the left and right edges as decoration.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色照片，展示了舞台上两名身着传统戏曲服装的表演者。左侧表演者背对观众，身着浅蓝色戏服，头戴华丽头饰。右侧表演者面向观众，身着红色戏服，戴有头饰，右手置于胸前，正在表演。舞台背景由红色和橙色布幔构成，红色布幔上饰有金色图案和流苏。舞台中央偏左有一张红色小桌，桌面有金色雕花。舞台右侧悬挂一幅垂直画卷，绘有山水图案，画卷上可见“王江山”字样。舞台地面铺设绿色地毯。图片顶部悬挂红色横幅，上面有白色文字“2022年历城区农村文化艺术节”。图片右下角有白色水印，包含“大众网”、“DAZHONG NEWS”、“大众报业”、“海报新闻”以及“速度·深度·温度”等文字和标识。

The performer on the left has their back to the audience, wearing a light blue costume and an elaborate headdress. The performer on the right faces the audience, dressed in a red costume with a headdress, performing with their right hand placed on their chest. The stage background consists of red and orange drapes, with the red drapes adorned with golden patterns and tassels. A small red table with golden carved patterns on its surface is positioned slightly to the left of the stage center. On the right side of the stage, a vertical scroll painting depicting a landscape is hung, with the characters "王江山" visible on it. The stage floor is covered with a green carpet. A red banner hangs at the top of the image, displaying white text that reads "2022年历城区农村文化艺术节". In the bottom right corner of the image, there is a white watermark containing text and logos such as "大众网", "DAZHONG NEWS", "大众报业", "海报新闻", and "速度·深度·温度".

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示现代室内空间的图片，其墙壁和天花板采用几何多边形设计，整体色调为灰色和黑色，并辅以白色和蓝色的灯光。左侧墙壁上有一个大型显示屏，其左半部分显示疑似科学公式或图表，右半部分显示世界地图。大型显示屏下方和右侧墙壁上各有两个较小的显示屏，均显示“全球10-CELL”字样和蓝色地球图像。房间中央区域设有一张讲台或办公桌，前方整齐排列着多排桌椅，呈会议或教室布局。两名人物（一男一女）站在右侧的桌椅区域旁。天花板上安装有条形灯、射灯以及一个蓝色的抽象装饰结构。地面铺设了深灰色地毯，前景区域为浅灰色地面。
prompt_en: This image displays a modern interior space featuring geometric polygonal walls and ceiling, with an overall color scheme of gray and black, complemented by white and blue lighting. On the left wall, there is a large display screen; its left half shows what appear to be scientific formulas or diagrams, while the right half displays a world map. Below the large screen and on the right wall, there are two smaller display screens each, all showing the text "全球10-CELL" and a blue earth image. In the central area of the room, there is a podium or desk, with multiple rows of tables and chairs neatly arranged in front, suggesting a conference or classroom setup. Two individuals, a man and a woman, are standing near the tables and chairs on the right side. The ceiling is equipped with strip lights, spotlights, and a blue abstract decorative structure. The floor is covered with dark gray carpet, with a lighter gray area in the foreground.

prompt_cn: 这是一张特写照片，展示了一个悬挂着的白色纹理卡片和部分黄铜色金属装饰物。卡片位于画面左下至中央，表面有明显的纸张纹理，顶部有一个穿孔，通过一个金属环悬挂。卡片上印有三行金色的手写体风格文字。第一行是“心存阳光,”，第二行是“一路芬芳!”，第三行是“愿我的挚友，笑靥如花。”。卡片右上方和右侧可见部分由杆件、圆盘和方形金属片组成的黄铜色金属悬挂装饰物。背景是模糊的暖金色墙面，光线从左上方照射过来，在墙面和金属装饰物上形成高光。
prompt_en: This is a close-up photograph featuring a hanging white textured card and a partial brass-colored metal decoration. The card is positioned from the lower-left to the center of the frame, displaying a clear paper texture and a punched hole at the top, through which it hangs by a metal loop. Three lines of gold, handwritten-style text are printed on the card. The first line reads "心存阳光," (May your heart be filled with sunshine,), the second line reads "一路芬芳!" (and your path be fragrant all the way!), and the third line reads "愿我的挚友，笑靥如花。" (May my dear friend's smile be like a flower.). Parts of a brass-colored metal hanging decoration, composed of rods, a disc, and square metal pieces, are visible to the upper-right and right of the card. The background is a blurred warm golden wall, with light shining from the upper-left, creating highlights on the wall and the metal decoration.

They are dressed in dark blue baseball caps, light grey short-sleeved shirts, dark aprons, and disposable shoe covers. The brand name "巧蜂管家" (Qiaofeng Guanjia) is printed in orange on the front of their caps and on the chest of their aprons. Transparent storage boxes filled with folded clothes are placed under the table and on the floor to the right. The background is a brightly lit room with wooden wardrobes on the left and right, some of which have glass doors reflecting the interior. A large window is visible at the back of the room, with buildings and green plants outside.

text:
PLATE NO. 47 — EASTERN ARMOR SYSTEMS
日本武士盔甲:当世具足 (TOUSEI GUSOKU)
Structural deconstruction and modular dynamics of late Sengoku-period field defenses
BY DR. KENJI SATO & DR. HELEN VANCE
PUBLISHED AUTUMN 2024
I. DEVELOPMENT & RATIONALE
To meet the demands of mass musket fire and heavy spear combat in the late Sengoku period, Japanese armor underwent a revolutionary structural shift. The Tousei Gusoku (当世具足), or "modern armor," emerged as a practical, iron-plated defense system. Unlike the ornate, lacquer-bound cords of classical O-Yoroi, this design prioritized structural coverage, modular maintenance, and bullet resistance.
II. COMPONENT SCHEMA
TECHNICAL METRICS
KABUTO
MENPO
SODE
DOU
KUSAZURI
■ Total Assembly Weight: 15.0 to 20.0 kilograms.
■ Plating Thickness: 1.2 mm to 2.5 mm variable steel.
■ Lacing Density: Reduced spacing to minimize weight.
■ Ballistic Proofing: Tameshi-do verified against matchlock.
Each plate served a tactical purpose. The primary chest protection, the Dou (胴), utilized large forged plates instead of delicate scales. Vulnerable neck joints were shielded by the Menpo (面頬), a menacing iron face mask that also anchored the Kabuto (兜) helmet. Mobility was maintained by dividing the lower tassets (Kusazuri) into six or eight independent panels, allowing rapid movement.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅具有国画风格的数字插画，画面以米色和黄色调为主，背景带有纸张纹理，并被分割成不同的色块。画面中央偏左是醒目的黑色毛笔书法“立春”二字，其右侧有一个椭圆形印章，内有“第1气”字样。右上方有“Canva”标志。画面右侧竖排书写着两行小字：“立春启新序”和“梅雀栖枝暖”。画面下方，一只黑头、白喉、棕色身体的小鸟栖息在开满白色和淡黄色梅花的枝头。背景中，顶部有半透明的英文“LICHUN”字样，底部右侧有半透明的斜体英文“Spring”，其下方是日期“02.04”和“农历腊月十七”。整幅画作通过文字和图案共同营造出春意盎然的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration in the style of traditional Chinese painting, predominantly featuring beige and yellow tones with a paper-like textured background divided into different color blocks. On the left-center, the prominent black brush calligraphy characters "立春" (Lichun, meaning Start of Spring) are displayed. To their right, an oval seal contains the characters "第1气" (the 1st solar term). The "Canva" logo is in the top right corner. On the right side, two vertical lines of smaller text read "立春启新序" (Lichun opens a new chapter) and "梅雀栖枝暖" (Plum blossoms and sparrows warm the branches). In the lower part of the image, a small bird with a black head, white throat, and brown body perches on a branch adorned with white and pale yellow plum blossoms. In the background, the semi-transparent English word "LICHUN" appears at the top, and a semi-transparent italicized "Spring" is at the bottom right, below which are the dates "02.04" and "农历腊月十七". The entire artwork uses both text and imagery to evoke a vibrant spring atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张摄影照片，展示了一个贴有暑假早上日程表的软木板。日程表由一张米白色的纸张制成，通过一个白色图钉固定在左侧的棕色软木板上。日程表的标题是“暑假早上日程表”，下方详细列出了从7:00到9:30的各项活动，每项活动旁都配有相应的黑色线稿图标。具体活动包括：7:00起床（闹钟图标）、7:10~7:30做数学题（旁边有“7=1+2 X=4=”的算式）、7:31~7:35休息（咖啡杯图标）、7:36~8:00听英语听力（耳机图标）、8:01~8:20写暑假作业本（书本图标）、8:21~8:40玩益智游戏（拼图图标）、8:41~9:00游泳（泳池图标）和9:01~9:30户外跳绳（跳绳图标）。画面右下角，一支棕色木纹笔身的钢笔，其金色笔尖正指向日程表上的“玩益智游戏”一项。背景是一个木质桌面，上面放置着一个方形木质时钟和几支笔。右侧的窗户透出明亮的户外光线，窗外景色模糊。
prompt_en: This is a photograph showing a cork board with a summer morning schedule pinned to it. The schedule is on an off-white paper, secured by a white thumbtack on the brown cork board on the left. The schedule's title is "暑假早上日程表" (Summer Morning Schedule), and below it, various activities from 7:00 to 9:30 are listed in detail, each accompanied by a corresponding black line-art icon. Specific activities include: 7:00 getting up (alarm clock icon), 7:10~7:30 doing math problems (with equations "7=1+2 X=4=" next to it), 7:31~7:35 resting (coffee cup icon), 7:36~8:00 listening to English (headphone icon), 8:01~8:20 writing summer homework (book icon), 8:21~8:40 playing puzzle games (jigsaw piece icon), 8:41~9:00 swimming (pool icon), and 9:01~9:30 outdoor jump rope (jump rope icon). In the lower right of the frame, a fountain pen with a brown wood-grain body and a golden nib is pointing to the "playing puzzle games" item on the schedule. The background features a wooden desk with a square wooden clock and several pens. A window on the right lets in bright outdoor light, with the scenery outside appearing blurry.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深蓝色/黑色背景的软件界面截图。界面布局分为顶部导航栏、左侧筛选面板和主内容区。顶部导航栏显示产品名称“AI 数据集管理 / 智能筛选”，右侧有“1,284,092 TOTAL ASSETS”和“新建数据集”按钮。左侧筛选面板包含“筛选维度”，提供“数据格式”（如“全部”、“图像”、“文本”）和“标注进度”（如“已完成”）的选项。主内容区显示“匹配结果 42”和“按时间排序 ↓”按钮。下方展示了两个图片预览卡片：左侧是“自动驾驶场景分割”，显示车辆和建筑并叠加了彩色识别框；右侧是“医疗影像诊断库”，显示三名医护人员正在查看X光片。主内容区右侧的“数据分布”面板显示“74% 有效”，并列出“图像类 45.2%”、“文本类 32.8%”和“存储占用 8.4 / 12.0 TB”。界面底部状态栏左侧显示“系统正常”，右侧显示“延迟: 24ms”和日期“2024-05-23”。大部分文字为白色或亮蓝色，部分辅助信息为灰色，按钮和输入框边缘呈圆角。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a software interface with a dark blue/black background. The layout is divided into a top navigation bar, a left-side filter panel, and a main content area. The top navigation bar displays the product name "AI 数据集管理 / 智能筛选" (AI Dataset Management / Smart Filtering), with "1,284,092 TOTAL ASSETS" and a "新建数据集" (New Dataset) button on the right. The left filter panel includes "筛选维度" (Filter Dimensions), offering options for "数据格式" (Data Format) such as "全部" (All), "图像" (Image), "文本" (Text), and "标注进度" (Annotation Progress) like "已完成" (Completed). The main content area shows "匹配结果 42" (Matching Results 42) and a "按时间排序 ↓" (Sort by Time ↓) button. Below this, two image preview cards are displayed: the left one is for "自动驾驶场景分割" (Autonomous Driving Scene Segmentation), showing vehicles and buildings with colored bounding boxes; the right one is for "医疗影像诊断库" (Medical Image Diagnosis Library), showing three medical staff examining X-ray images. The "数据分布" (Data Distribution) panel on the right side of the main content shows "74% 有效" (74% Valid), followed by a list of "图像类 45.2%" (Image Category 45.2%), "文本类 32.8%" (Text Category 32.8%), and "存储占用 8.4 / 12.0 TB" (Storage Usage 8.4 / 12.0 TB). The bottom status bar displays "系统正常" (System Normal) on the left, and "延迟: 24ms" (Latency: 24ms) and the date "2024-05-23" on the right. Most text is white or bright blue, with some auxiliary information in gray, and buttons and input fields have rounded corners.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影宣传海报，画面以灰蓝色、白色和深绿色为主色调，呈现出水墨画般的意境。海报中央偏下，一座由不规则石块铺成的古朴石桥横跨水面，桥面湿润，倒影清晰。桥的右侧有一位身着深色上衣和浅色裤子的人影，正面向左侧行走。远景是雾气缭绕、若隐若现的山峦和树木。海报上方居中是黑色艺术字体的中文标题“云上的云”，左侧伴有红色印章状的“丽”字，下方是红色英文副标题“NOSTALGIA IN THE CLOUDS”。标题上方有“— 李玉刚 导演作品 —”及其英文“A FILM BY LI YUGANG”。右上角有“2023 倾情献映”和宣传语“乡愁，只有云知道 HOMESICKNESS, ONLY YUN KNOWS”。左下角有半透明的白色英文“CLOUDS”作为设计元素。右下角是地点信息“中国·丽水·缙云”和宣传语“以光影勾勒爱的归途”。
prompt_en: This is a movie promotional poster, dominated by shades of grey-blue, white, and dark green, evoking an ink wash painting aesthetic. In the lower-middle of the poster, an ancient stone bridge, paved with irregular stones, spans across water, its wet surface reflecting clearly. A figure dressed in a dark top and light-colored trousers walks leftward on the right side of the bridge. The background features misty, indistinct mountains and trees. Centered at the top is the main Chinese title "云上的云" in black artistic script, accompanied by a red seal-like character "丽" on its left, with the red English subtitle "NOSTALGIA IN THE CLOUDS" below. Above the title, it reads "— 李玉刚 导演作品 —" and its English counterpart "A FILM BY LI YUGANG". The top right corner displays "2023 倾情献映" (Presented in 2023) and the slogan "乡愁，只有云知道 HOMESICKNESS, ONLY YUN KNOWS". The bottom left features a semi-transparent white English text "CLOUDS" as a design element. The bottom right corner provides location information "中国·丽水·缙云" (China, Lishui, Jinyun) and the promotional phrase "以光影勾勒爱的归途" (Sketching the way home with light and shadow).

The main body of the interface is divided into two columns: the left column features the "Active Deployments" list, showing a total of 128 deployments. Four specific model deployments are listed, each including its name (e.g., "Llama-3-70B-Instruct"), version configuration (e.g., "v2.4.0 • fp16 • 8x A100"), and a status label (e.g., green "RUNNING", blue "DEPLOYING", red "FAILED", gray "IDLE"), along with associated numerical values or error messages. The upper right section is the "GPU CLUSTER LOAD" area, showing a GPU load of 72% with a blue progress bar, and below it, memory usage "642/1024 GB" and power consumption "4.2 kW". The lower right section is the "DEPLOYMENT EVENTS" area, listing event logs in reverse chronological order, with some timestamps highlighted in green or red. The bottom status bar displays "API GATEWAY: ONLINE", "REGION: US-EAST-1", and the current time "2024-10-24 14:21:05 UTC". All text primarily uses white, gray, green, blue, and red colors, and the overall layout is clear and information-rich.

The image features multiple cartoon-style characters, including a barista making coffee, staff working behind the counter, and customers enjoying coffee and pastries at tables or by the counter. The coffee shop interior is brightly decorated with wooden counters, shelves, and large windows, with a street view visible outside. Centered at the top of the image is the game title "COFFEE SHOP TYCOON," with the slogan "BUILD. BREW. THRIVE." below it. The top left features the "PS5™" logo, and the top right reads "ONLY ON PlayStation®". In the bottom left corner is the ESRB rating "EVERYONE E ESRB". The overall color scheme is dominated by warm tones such as brown, beige, and orange, accented with green and blue. The composition uses a slightly high wide-angle perspective, showcasing the depth of the scene.

In the bottom left corner of the artwork, there is a small, red, horizontal line of text that reads "书法欣赏 www.yac8.com", serving as a footer or watermark. The overall composition is rigorous, and the characters are clearly legible, showcasing the artistic appeal of traditional calligraphy.

prompt_en: This is a photograph of a car launch event or exhibition. A large LED display screen is centrally positioned, showcasing detailed information about the "Fifth Generation Hongguang MINIEV Trade-in Subsidy Price". The screen's upper section features the title, below which four columns present different models (205km Advanced, 205km Premium, 301km Advanced, 301km Premium) with their trade-in subsidy prices (42,800 yuan, 46,800 yuan, 47,800 yuan, 51,800 yuan respectively) and their official list prices. At the bottom of the screen are two promotional banners: "Order now to enjoy four fun gifts" and "Can be combined with national/local subsidies", followed by four specific offers: "Worry-free car purchase gift up to 3,000 yuan", "Charging power gift: free 3.5KW charging pile", "Financial assistance gift up to 3,000 yuan", and "Worry-free car use gift: lifetime warranty for three core components". A QR code is displayed on the right side of the screen, with the text "Scan code to order now" below it. Two Hongguang MINIEV cars are parked on the stage below the display, a dark-colored one on the left and a white one on the right. A male presenter in a light-colored suit stands between the two cars, facing the audience and pointing to the screen with his right hand. The stage background features spotlights and a brand logo.

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个医疗收费结算与折扣配置的用户界面。界面顶部显示主标题“医疗收费结算 | 折扣配置”以及操作员“张晓明”和工号“MED-9527”的信息。界面主体分为三个主要区域：左侧是“折扣方案列表”，中间是“方案参数配置”，右侧是“结算对比预览”。左侧面板列出了“离休干部优待”、“职工家属优惠”和“体检合作单位”三个折扣方案，其中“离休干部优待”方案被蓝色背景高亮显示为选中状态，并标注“生效中”，其折扣率为15.0%。中间面板详细展示了当前选中方案的参数配置，包括方案名称“离休干部优待方案 (2023 正式版)”，折扣比例15.00%，最高减免额度“无上限”，以及适用科室范围，如“内科”、“外科”、“放射科”等。右侧面板提供了结算金额的对比预览，显示待结算原始总额为“¥ 12,480.50”，方案减免“-¥1,872.08”，医保支付“-¥8,500.00”，最终应付金额为“¥ 2,108.42”，下方还有“确认并应用”和“取消操作”按钮。界面底部左侧显示“系统运行正常 同步时间: 14:30:05”，右侧是版本号“V4.2.0-STABLE”。整体界面以深蓝色、白色和灰色为主色调，绿色用于突出“生效中”状态和减免金额。
prompt_en: This image displays a user interface for medical billing and discount configuration. The top of the interface shows the main title "医疗收费结算 | 折扣配置" (Medical Billing | Discount Configuration), along with operator information: "操作员: 张晓明" (Operator: Zhang Xiaoming) and "工号: MED-9527" (Employee ID: MED-9527). The main body of the interface is divided into three primary sections: the left panel is "折扣方案列表" (Discount Scheme List), the middle panel is "方案参数配置" (Scheme Parameter Configuration), and the right panel is "结算对比预览" (Settlement Comparison Preview). The left panel lists three discount schemes: "离休干部优待" (Retired Cadre Preferential Treatment), "职工家属优惠" (Employee Family Discount), and "体检合作单位" (Medical Examination Partner Unit). The "Retired Cadre Preferential Treatment" scheme is highlighted with a blue background, indicating it is selected, and marked "生效中" (In Effect), with a discount rate of 15.0%. The middle panel details the parameter configuration for the currently selected scheme, including the scheme name "离休干部优待方案 (2023 正式版)" (Retired Cadre Preferential Treatment Scheme (2023 Official Version)), a discount percentage of 15.00%, a maximum reduction limit of "无上限" (No Upper Limit), and applicable department scopes such as "内科" (Internal Medicine), "外科" (Surgery), and "放射科" (Radiology). The right panel provides a settlement amount comparison preview, showing the original total amount to be settled as "¥ 12,480.50", scheme reduction as "-¥1,872.08", medical insurance payment as "-¥8,500.00", and the final payable amount as "¥ 2,108.42". Below these figures are "确认并应用" (Confirm and Apply) and "取消操作" (Cancel Operation) buttons. The bottom left of the interface displays "系统运行正常 同步时间: 14:30:05" (System Running Normally Sync Time: 14:30:05), and the bottom right shows the version number "V4.2.0-STABLE". The overall interface uses dark blue, white, and gray as primary colors, with green used to highlight the "In Effect" status and reduction amounts.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以餐厅内部为背景的宣传图片，整体色调偏暗，营造出高级感。画面顶部和底部有白色L形边框，模拟摄像机取景框。左上角显示“REC”和右上角显示“4K 60FPS”、“00:12:45:22”等视频录制信息。图片中央展示了餐厅内部，两排餐桌整齐排列，铺有白色桌布，摆放着餐具，深色墙壁上装饰有壁画，吊灯散发着柔和的光线。左侧是主要的宣传文字，包括黄色背景框内的“MUST-VISIT SPOT”，大字体的“探店”、“打卡”，以及“城市味蕾 · 隐藏菜单 · 视觉盛宴”。图片右侧边缘垂直排列着“SHANGHAI 2024”。左下角深色蒙版区域内，有黄色文字“HIDDEN EATING HACK”，下方是“隐藏吃法: 芝士瀑布+脆皮烤肉”和“解锁餐厅 0.1% 的极致口感体验”。最底部左侧是“LOCATION”和“静安区·某某网红概念”，右侧是“ISO F 1/125”等摄影参数。
prompt_en: This is a promotional image set against a restaurant interior, with a generally dark color scheme creating a sophisticated atmosphere. White L-shaped borders at the top and bottom simulate a camera viewfinder. The top left displays "REC" and the top right shows "4K 60FPS", "00:12:45:22" as video recording information. The center of the image features the restaurant interior, with two rows of dining tables neatly arranged, covered with white tablecloths and set with tableware. Dark walls are adorned with murals, and pendant lights emit soft illumination. The main promotional text is on the left, including "MUST-VISIT SPOT" in a yellow background box, large "探店" (Explore Store) and "打卡" (Check-in), followed by "城市味蕾 · 隐藏菜单 · 视觉盛宴" (City Taste Buds · Hidden Menu · Visual Feast). "SHANGHAI 2024" is vertically aligned along the right edge of the image. In the dark overlay area at the bottom left, there is yellow text "HIDDEN EATING HACK", below which are "隐藏吃法: 芝士瀑布+脆皮烤肉" (Hidden Way to Eat: Cheese Waterfall + Crispy Roasted Meat) and "解锁餐厅 0.1% 的极致口感体验" (Unlock the restaurant's 0.1% ultimate taste experience). At the very bottom, the left side shows "LOCATION" and "静安区·某某网红概念" (Jing'an District · Ji[unrecognizable] Internet-famous Concept), while the right side displays photography parameters like "ISO F 1/125".

Below "隐者", the English subtitle "Hidden Landscapes" is horizontally arranged in white serif font. In the upper right part of the image, there are two lines of vertically arranged small white text, reading "一个属于世界的作曲家" (A Composer Belonging to the World) and "陈其钢 传记电影《隐者山河》" (Chen Qigang Biographical Film "Hidden Landscapes"). In the lower central part of the poster is the director's credit, "郭旭锋 导演作品" (Guo Xufeng's Directorial Work), displayed in white bold text and centered. At the very bottom, multiple lines of small white text are left-aligned, detailing the names of the production companies, copyright supporters, and numerous supporting organizations.
