A white poster is suspended slightly to the left of the center, attached to a beige or brown textured wall with visible cracks and peeling, using two black clips. The main subject of the poster is a geometric-style illustration featuring two figures in traditional attire (resembling door gods or deities) and two lions, rendered in vibrant colors primarily red, blue, green, yellow, and black. At the top of the poster are multi-colored characters "几何迎春" (Geometric Spring Welcome). In the middle, between the two figures, are the characters "福" (Fortune) and "春" (Spring) in white on a red background. At the bottom are multi-colored characters "万象更新" (All things renewed). On the wall to the right of the poster, there are two lines of small black text: "高清清冽，丰富特感" (High definition and crisp, rich special effects).

prompt_cn: 这是一张杂志封面，主色调为红色。画面中央是一位正在指挥的男性，他身着深色西装和白色衬衫。背景是红色，上面有四颗黄色的五角星，其中一颗大星位于左上角，另外三颗小星分布在指挥家头部右侧。杂志标题“GRAMOPHONE”位于顶部居中位置，下方是副标题“THE WORLD'S BEST CLASSICAL MUSIC REVIEWS”。右上方标有“Est 1923 · APRIL 2019”和网址“gramophone.co.uk”。封面主题“CHINA & CLASSICAL MUSIC”位于图片中部，其中“CHINA”为黄色超大字体，部分覆盖在指挥家身体上，“& CLASSICAL MUSIC”为白色大字。右侧有描述文字“An extraordinary story of growth”。图片左侧垂直排列着三段文章摘要，包括“André Previn: a tribute to the complete man of music”、“Alban Gerhardt: the freethinking cellist on Bach”和“Rachmaninov's Symphonic Dances: the best recordings”。右下角是特辑信息“Festival GUIDE 2019”，其中“Festival”为黄色手写体，“GUIDE 2019”为白色粗体。左下角有条形码、数字“04>”和价格信息“UNITED KINGDOM £5.99”。
prompt_en: This is a magazine cover with a predominant red color scheme. In the center of the image is a male conductor, dressed in a dark suit and white shirt. The background is red, featuring four yellow five-pointed stars; one large star is in the upper left, and three smaller stars are positioned to the right of the conductor's head. The magazine title "GRAMOPHONE" is centered at the top, with the subtitle "THE WORLD'S BEST CLASSICAL MUSIC REVIEWS" below it. The upper right corner displays "Est 1923 · APRIL 2019" and the website "gramophone.co.uk". The cover's main theme, "CHINA & CLASSICAL MUSIC," is located in the middle of the image, with "CHINA" in extra-large yellow font partially overlapping the conductor's body, and "& CLASSICAL MUSIC" in large white letters. To the right, there is descriptive text "An extraordinary story of growth". On the left side of the image, three article summaries are vertically arranged: "André Previn: a tribute to the complete man of music", "Alban Gerhardt: the freethinking cellist on Bach", and "Rachmaninov's Symphonic Dances: the best recordings". The bottom right corner features special feature information "Festival GUIDE 2019", with "Festival" in yellow script and "GUIDE 2019" in bold white. The bottom left corner includes a barcode, the number "04>", and price information "UNITED KINGDOM £5.99".

In the center of the image is a young male model, wearing a printed short-sleeved shirt and light-colored jeans, seated with his right hand supporting his chin, looking directly forward. Subtle gray geometric line patterns are faintly visible in the background. In the upper left, large, bright green vertical Chinese characters read "杨可瓦", to their right are white vertical Chinese texts "著名男模" (Famous Male Model) and "名品牌代言人" (Brand Spokesperson). On the mid-left side of the image, bright green vertical English text reads "MODEL", and at the bottom left, white vertical Chinese text states "走秀是我的态度" (Runway is my attitude). On the mid-right side, bright green vertical English text reads "FORD YANG". The upper right area contains multiple lines of white horizontal text, which from top to bottom are "微信号: wl96101", "深圳市南山区金色商业区" (Shenzhen Nanshan District Golden Commercial Area), "123-456-789", and "hello@greatsite.com". Above these contact details are a green Canva logo, white text "YOUR LOGO", and the website "https://www.canva.cn". Below the contact information, there is a fingerprint icon.

Towards the upper right of the back panel, there is "TIME SET" text, and on the right side, a pinout diagram with numbers like "ANT. OSC.", "IF", and "50C5". A two-prong power outlet and a "RADIO OFF-ON" toggle switch are located towards the center-right of the back panel. A "NOTICE" warning instruction regarding service is printed on the lower left. A faded white sticker is affixed to the right side, displaying a patent statement, manufacturer information "TRAVELER RADIO CORPORATION, U. S. A.", and serial number "3039356". The text "CB - 115" is also present at the bottom center of the back panel. Below the radio, a coiled brown power cord is placed, secured with a white zip tie, and a red warning tag hangs from it, featuring the title "IMPORTANT!" and safety instructions "To avoid damage to tubes...". Both the radio and the power cord rest on a wooden tabletop with horizontal grain, against a light-colored wall in the background. Some holes on the radio's back panel show signs of scorching or wear.

prompt_cn: 这是一张采用左右分屏构图的拼贴艺术图片，对比了“拼命挣钱”与“用钱买命”的社会现象。图片左侧为暗色调，描绘一名男子在堆满文件和现金的办公桌前疲惫工作，背景挂钟显示时间，数字时钟显示“3:00 AM”。图片右侧为亮色调，描绘一名老年男子躺在医院病床上，连接着医疗设备，床头柜上堆放着现金和药瓶；医疗监护仪显示数字“20”和“30”，下方文字提示“剩余生命: 30天”。画面顶部，左侧是红色大字“拼命挣钱”，右侧是蓝色大字“用钱买命”。图片中央叠加了一张彩色照片，显示一名中年男子、一名女子和一名儿童在户外跑步，象征着健康与平衡的生活。画面中部，横跨左右两部分，是黄色大字标语“用钱养命，平衡生活”，点明了图片的主题。
prompt_en: This is a collage art image using a left-right split-screen composition, contrasting the social phenomena of "working hard to earn money" and "spending money to buy life". The left side of the image, in dark tones, depicts a man working exhaustedly at a desk piled with documents and cash. A wall clock is in the background, and a digital clock displays "3:00 AM". The right side, in bright tones, shows an elderly man lying in a hospital bed, connected to medical equipment, with cash and medicine bottles on his bedside table. A medical monitor displays numbers "20" and "30", and text below it reads "Remaining life: 30 days". At the top of the image, "拼命挣钱" (Work hard to earn money) is in large red characters on the left, and "用钱买命" (Spend money to buy life) is in large blue characters on the right. A color photo is overlaid in the center, showing a middle-aged man, a woman, and a child running outdoors, symbolizing a healthy and balanced life. In the middle of the image, spanning both sides, is the large yellow slogan "用钱养命，平衡生活" (Spend money to maintain life, balance life), highlighting the image's theme.

prompt_cn: 这是一张APP界面截图，展示了一个关于献血公益宣传片的页面。页面顶部左侧是红色的主标题“| LIFE RELAY 2024”和“爱心献血·生命接力”，右侧深色背景块内有“公益宣传片”和“OFFICIAL RELEASE”标签。页面中央是一个视频播放器缩略图，画面显示献血车内部，一名医护人员正在为献血者服务。缩略图右上方叠加了一个白色气泡，内含“寻找你身边的爱心献血小屋，让爱在城市每个角落流动”的文字和红色心形图标。缩略图左下角有白色大字标题“每一次挽袖都是新生”及其英文副标题“THE POWER OF YOUR BLOOD”。页面下方并列放置两个圆角矩形卡片。左侧白色卡片标题为“01 智慧网点分布”，列出了三个献血点及其开放时间，底部有红色链接“扫码查看实时排队 →”。右侧深蓝色卡片标题为“02 影像故事”，下方是关于影片内容的描述，并有一个“立即观看”按钮和“WATCH”标签。页面底部是页脚区域，包含“生命·热血·城市”及其英文“Life · Blood · City Awareness”的品牌信息，以及右侧的“PARTNER HEALTH MINISTRY”合作伙伴信息。红色在页面中作为强调色，用于标题、图标和链接。
prompt_en: This is an app interface screenshot displaying a page about a blood donation public service announcement. The top left of the page features the red main titles "| LIFE RELAY 2024" and "爱心献血·生命接力" (Love Blood Donation · Life Relay). On the top right, within a dark background block, are the labels "公益宣传片" (Public Service Announcement) and "OFFICIAL RELEASE". The center of the page shows a video player thumbnail, depicting the interior of a blood donation vehicle with a medical professional assisting a donor. A white speech bubble is overlaid on the top right of the thumbnail, containing the text "寻找你身边的爱心献血小屋，让爱在城市每个角落流动" (Find the blood donation booths around you, let love flow in every corner of the city) and a red heart icon. The bottom left of the thumbnail has a large white title "每一次挽袖都是新生" (Every Sleeve Roll-up is a New Life) and its English subtitle "THE POWER OF YOUR BLOOD". Below the video, two rounded rectangular cards are placed side-by-side. The left white card is titled "01 智慧网点分布" (Smart Service Point Distribution), listing three blood donation points with their operating hours, and a red link "扫码查看实时排队 →" (Scan to view real-time queue) at the bottom. The right dark blue card is titled "02 影像故事" (Video Story), followed by a description of the film's content, and a "立即观看" (Watch Now) button with a "WATCH" label. The page footer at the bottom includes the brand information "生命·热血·城市" (Life · Blood · City) and its English translation "Life · Blood · City Awareness", along with "PARTNER HEALTH MINISTRY" on the right. Red is used as an accent color throughout the page for titles, icons, and links.

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示在室内走廊墙壁上的宣传海报，海报以蓝色为主色调，背景是抽象的科技感图案和二进制代码。海报中央是醒目的“在线诊断”四个大字，下方有一双手正在操作一块透明的数字屏幕，屏幕上显示着DNA双螺旋、心跳、医疗十字和加号等医疗相关图标。海报顶部左侧有“摄图网”的品牌标识和“专注版权 赋能创意”的标语，顶部中央是“科技 促进 发展 创新 成就 未来”的宣传语。海报右侧垂直排列着“智能导诊”、“精准分析”、“健康档案”和“医疗设备”等功能标签，左侧有“在线问诊”标签，下方列出了“预约挂号”、“检查报告”、“就诊记录”和“健康档案查询”等服务项目。海报底部包含一个二维码、英文服务热线“THE FREE SERVICE HOTLINE”及其电话号码“021-8018 7116”，以及一句英文标语“Investing and managing finances is a good way to make money”。海报右侧的走廊有大面积的落地窗，窗外景色模糊。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster displayed on an indoor corridor wall. The poster is predominantly blue, with an abstract, tech-inspired background featuring binary code. At the center of the poster are the prominent characters "在线诊断" (Online Diagnosis). Below, a pair of hands is operating a transparent digital screen, which displays medical-related icons such as a DNA double helix, a heartbeat, a medical cross, and a plus sign. In the top left corner, there is the "摄图网" (摄图网) brand logo and the slogan "专注版权 赋能创意" (Focus on copyright, empower creativity). The top center features the slogan "科技 促进 发展 创新 成就 未来" (Technology promotes development, innovation achieves future). On the right side of the poster, vertically arranged functional labels include "智能导诊" (Intelligent Navigation), "精准分析" (Precise Analysis), "健康档案" (Health Records), and "医疗设备" (Medical Equipment). On the left side, there is an "在线问诊" (Online Consultation) label, and below it, service items like "预约挂号" (Appointment Registration), "检查报告" (Examination Report), "就诊记录" (Medical Records), and "健康档案查询" (Health Record Inquiry) are listed. The bottom of the poster includes a QR code, the English service hotline "THE FREE SERVICE HOTLINE" with the phone number "021-8018 7116", and an English slogan "Investing and managing finances is a good way to make money". The corridor to the right of the poster features large floor-to-ceiling windows with blurred outdoor scenery.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于哥特式建筑结构的信息图，标题为“GOTHIC ENGINE”，副标题为“STRUCTURAL MANUAL THE TRIAD OF MEDIEVAL VERTICALITY”，右上角显示“SYSTEM STATUS OPERATIONAL 1140-1400 AD”。图片整体采用三栏布局，顶部和底部有红白相间的斜条纹装饰。左侧栏介绍了哥特式建筑的演变，并包含一个对比罗马式和哥特式建筑指标的表格，如墙体厚度、开窗率、拱顶重量、采光指数和结构类型。中间栏和右侧栏分别详细阐述了哥特式建筑的三个关键结构元素：肋拱（RIB VAULT）、飞扶壁（FLYING BUTTRESS）和彩色玻璃（STAINED GLASS），每个元素都配有编号（01、02、03）、文字描述和相应的线描结构示意图。右侧栏底部还有一个表格，列出了几座著名大教堂的高度和玻璃面积数据，以及一个关于结构平衡的警告信息。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the structural elements of Gothic architecture, titled "GOTHIC ENGINE" with the subtitle "STRUCTURAL MANUAL THE TRIAD OF MEDIEVAL VERTICALITY". The top right corner displays "SYSTEM STATUS OPERATIONAL 1140-1400 AD". The image features a three-column layout with red and white diagonal striped decorative bands at the top and bottom. The left column introduces the evolution of Gothic architecture and includes a table comparing Romanesque and Gothic architectural metrics such as wall thickness, opening percentage, vault weight, light index, and structure type. The middle and right columns detail three key structural elements of Gothic architecture: Rib Vault, Flying Buttress, and Stained Glass. Each element is accompanied by a number (01, 02, 03), a textual description, and a corresponding line-drawing structural diagram. The bottom of the right column also contains a table listing the height and glass area data for several famous cathedrals, along with a warning message about structural equilibrium.

Centrally, the title "爱情首映礼" (Love Premiere) is set on a pink oval background, followed by "CINEMATIC" in cyan and "ROMANCE" in white. The middle section of the poster displays a main visual of a futuristic city nightscape with glowing lines and buildings. In the bottom left of the main visual, "主演 / STARRING 陈慕云 & 林浅浅" (Starring Chen Muyun & Lin Qianqian) is indicated, and in the bottom right, the date "2024.10.20" is shown. At the bottom of the poster, there are two information boxes, one on the left and one on the right. The left box contains "放映时间 / TIME 17:18 准时开镜" (Screening Time / TIME 17:18 On Time Start) and "拍摄现场 / VENUE 霓虹之城大酒店·顶层 上海市黄浦区南京东路 888 号" (Filming Location / VENUE Neon City Grand Hotel·Top Floor, 888 Nanjing East Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai). prompt_en: This is a promotional poster or presentation slide about educational research and picture book sharing. The image is divided into two main parts: a text information area on the left and an image display area within a rounded rectangular frame on the right. The top of the left area features "教育科研" (Educational Research) and "EDUCATIONAL RESEARCH" labels. The main title, "绘本分享教室" (Picture Book Sharing Classroom), uses an artistic font, with "绘本分享" in black and "教室" in a purple-pink gradient. Below it is the subtitle "互动游戏·沉浸式阅读" (Interactive Games · Immersive Reading), accompanied by a short pink line on its left. The bottom contains a detailed description of the activity content. The right image displays a mural filled with fantasy elements, depicting children, a dragon, and castles, with bookshelves below the mural. Above the image, "2024 EDITION" is visible, and "PLAY & LEARN" is vertically arranged along its right edge. A white rounded rectangular label in the bottom-left corner of the image contains the number "01" and the text "互动探索环节" (Interactive Exploration Session).

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内摄影图片，画面中央是一位正在演讲的老年男性。他一头白发，身穿白色中式短袖上衣，左手持黑色麦克风，右手食指指向身后屏幕上的内容。屏幕为黑色边框，显示浅蓝色背景上的白色中文文字，内容分为三列。第一列标题为“俱舍論”，第二列标题为“成唯識論”，第三列标题为“大乘起信論”。每列标题下方均列有多项相关内容，如“所緣緣”、“親疏所緣緣”、“起業相”等。画面前景下方可见两名听众的后脑勺，他们面向讲者和屏幕。屏幕右侧是深红色的墙壁，墙上挂有一个圆形装饰物，下方摆放着一盆带有粉色花朵的植物。整个室内光线明亮。
prompt_en: This is an indoor photograph, featuring an elderly male speaker in the center. He has white hair, wears a white short-sleeved Chinese-style top, holds a black microphone in his left hand, and points his right index finger at the content displayed on the screen behind him. The screen, with a black frame, shows white Chinese text against a light blue background, divided into three columns. The first column is titled "俱舍論" (Jùshèlùn), the second column is titled "成唯識論" (Chéngwéishílùn), and the third column is titled "大乘起信論" (Dàchéngqǐxìnlùn). Each column's title is followed by several related items, such as "所緣緣" (Suǒyuányuán), "親疏所緣緣" (Qīnshūsuǒyuányuán), and "起業相" (Qǐyèxiàng). In the foreground, the backs of two audience members' heads are visible, facing the speaker and the screen. To the right of the screen is a dark red wall, adorned with a circular decorative object, and below it, a potted plant with pink flowers. The interior is brightly lit.

新鲜 (Fresh / Pâte Fraîche)
不经过压榨与熟成，保留了最纯粹的乳香。极高含水量（可达80%以上），色泽洁白，质地如奶油般柔滑。
白霉软质
白霉 (Soft White-Rind / Croûte Fleurie)
表面接种青霉菌，形成如天鹅绒般的白色外壳。内部在酶的作用下发生蛋白水解，呈现出迷人的流心质地。
硬质奶酪
硬质 (Hard / Pâte Pressée Cuite)
长时间压榨与陈化（通常12-36个月）。水分极低，质地致密且脆，带有浓郁的坚果风味与鲜咸感。
微生物作用
熟成过程中，乳酸菌持续分解乳糖，蛋白质分解为氨基酸（产生鲜
味），脂肪分解为脂肪酸（产生香气）。
水分与寿命
水分含量直接决定保质期。新鲜奶酪需数日内食用，而硬质奶酪在适
宜窖藏下可保存数年。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于奶酪分类的图谱信息图。图片顶部左侧是中文主标题“奶酪分类图谱”及其英文副标题“Systematics of Cheese Classification”，右侧有一个红色边框的“酪”字印章和垂直排列的“乳制品部·天成卷”字样。标题下方是一段关于奶酪演化和分类原则的中文介绍。图片中部被分为左右两栏。左栏标题为“熟成构造图 / MATURATION STRUCTURE”，包含一个展示水分流失和盐晶形成的示意图，并配有图注和关于“微生物作用”的文字说明。右栏标题为“五大分类范畴 / THE FIVE CATEGORIES”，列出了新鲜奶酪、白霉软质、硬质奶酪等五种奶酪类型，每种类型都有深色背景的中文名称、中英文子标题和详细的中文描述。右栏下方还有一段关于“水分与寿命”的文字说明。图片底部是一个五列表格，详细列出了五种奶酪的“分类/TYPE”、“水分/WATER CONTENT”、“熟成期/AGING PERIOD”、“感官特征/SENSORY NOTES”和“经典品种/NOTABLE VARIETIES”等信息。表格下方是页码、分类部和版权信息。图片整体背景为浅米色，文字以深棕色为主，部分标题和表格头部文字为白色。

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a web application user interface, displaying an order data management interface. At the top left is a breadcrumb navigation "工作台 / 订单数据中心" (Workbench / Order Data Center), and on the right, the user identity "A 系统管理员" (A System Administrator) is shown. Below that is the main page title "全渠道销售订单概览" (Omnichannel Sales Order Overview). Below the title is a filtering area, which includes three filter conditions: "订单编号" (Order Number), "客户名称" (Customer Name), and "订单状态" (Order Status), along with two buttons, "查询" (Query) and "重置" (Reset). The "订单编号" input field has a placeholder "输入订单号..." (Enter order number...), and the "客户名称" selection box displays "全部合作伙伴" (All Partners). The main part of the interface is a data table with five columns: "订单编号" (Order Number), "客户主体" (Customer Entity), "交易金额" (Transaction Amount), "当前状态" (Current Status), and "操作" (Operation). The table lists four order data entries; for example, order "ORD-2023102401" has a green status of "已完成" (Completed), order "ORD-2023102402" has a yellow status of "待审核" (Pending Review), order "ORD-2023102403" has a purple status of "进行中" (In Progress), and order "ORD-2023102404" has a dark gray status of "已取消" (Canceled). At the bottom left of the table, the total number of entries "共 1,284 条" (Total 1,284 entries) is displayed, and on the right are pagination controls, with page "1" currently selected.

prompt_cn: 这是一张充满涂鸦艺术风格的插画海报。画面中央偏右是一位年轻男性，他穿着夹克、连帽衫和工装裤，姿态动感，仿佛在跳跃或舞动。背景是色彩鲜艳的涂鸦墙面，融合了喷溅、线条和抽象图案，以黑、白、粉、绿、黄、蓝、红等多种颜色呈现。画面左上角有白色毛笔字“未来城市”，右下角有白色毛笔字“墨韵街头”，两者形成呼应。画面右侧垂直排列着黑色毛笔字“墨韵街头”、“水来城”、“山心种”。此外，画面中散布着多个标签和印章，如右上角的红色印章“中华意念”、橙色矩形标签“敬琪”、绿色和黑色矩形标签“蔬圃”。左侧有红色圆形标签“披萨”和“烧烤”，以及红色矩形标签“万新情”。画面中部偏左还有橙色涂鸦风格的“音”字和黑色毛笔字“世尚”。整幅作品将传统书法与现代街头艺术元素巧妙结合。
prompt_en: This is an illustration poster featuring a vibrant graffiti art style. A young man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, wearing a jacket, hoodie, and cargo pants, striking a dynamic pose as if jumping or dancing. The background is a brightly colored graffiti wall, incorporating splashes, lines, and abstract patterns in various hues such as black, white, pink, green, yellow, blue, and red. In the upper left, white brush-stroke characters read "未来城市" (Future City), echoed by "墨韵街头" (Ink Rhyme Street) in white brush strokes at the lower right. On the right side, vertically arranged black brush-stroke characters include "墨韵街头" (Ink Rhyme Street), "水来城" (Water City), and "山心种" (Mountain Heart Seed). Additionally, various labels and seals are scattered across the image, such as the red seal "中华意念" (Chinese Idea) in the upper right, an orange rectangular label "敬琪" (Jing Qi), and green and black rectangular labels "蔬圃" (Vegetable Garden). On the left, there are red circular labels "披萨" (Pizza) and "烧烤" (Barbecue), along with a red rectangular label "万新情" (Wan Xin Qing). The mid-left features an orange graffiti-style character "音" (Sound) and black brush-stroke characters "世尚" (Shi Shang). The entire artwork skillfully blends traditional calligraphy with modern street art elements.

text:
INTRO / 绪论
经典香水调性
与嗅觉光谱
THE PERFUME PYRAMID & OLFACTIVE
SPECTRUM
香水并非静止的芬芳，而是随分子质量挥发而展开的叙事。从瞬时的
柑橘前调到持久的木质基调，香气在皮肤上构建起三维的时间结构。
THE STRUCTURE / 金字塔结构
前调 TOP NOTES
15 - 30 MIN (柑橘,薄荷,醛)
中调 HEART NOTES
1 - 4 HOURS (花香,果香,辛香)
后调 BASE NOTES
4 - 24+ HOURS (木质,琥珀,麝香)

成分 INGREDIENT

挥发律原理:分子量越小(如柠檬烃),蒸汽压越高,留香越短;分子量越大(如大环麝香),留香越长。
FRAGRANCE FAMILIES / 迈克尔·爱德华兹香水分类频谱
FLORAL / 花香调
单一花香 (Floral)
柔和花香 (Soft Floral)
东方花香 (Floral Oriental)
ORIENTAL / 东方调
软东方调 (Soft Oriental)
经典东方 (Oriental)
木质东方 (Woody Oriental)
WOODY / 木质调
木质调 (Woods)
苔藓木质 (Mossy Woods)
干燥木质 (Dry Woods)
FRESH / 清新调
柑橘调 (Citrus)
绿叶调 (Green)
水生调 (Water)
"香水轮(The Fragrance Wheel) 揭示了香调之间的演化逻辑,相邻香调往往具有共享的化学核心。"
EXTRACTION / 萃取工艺
STEAM / 蒸馏
SOLVENT / 溶剂
EXPRESSION / 压榨
蒸馏法:适用于木质与部分花卉,提取精油(Essential Oil).
溶剂萃取:针对娇嫩花卉,生成原精(Absolute)。
冷压法:柑橘类果皮专用,保留最原始的清甜分子。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于香水知识的信息图，以米色为背景，通过多个区块和图表详细介绍了香水的调性、结构、香料指标、分类和萃取工艺。图片顶部左侧是“INTRO / 绪论”部分，包含“经典香水调性与嗅觉光谱”的中英文标题及一段关于香水挥发特性的中文描述。右侧是“THE STRUCTURE / 金字塔结构”部分，通过一个三层金字塔图示了香水的前调、中调和后调及其持续时间与主要香型。中部左侧是“DATA / 常见香料化学指标”表格，列出了六种香料成分、留香时间和族群。表格下方有一段关于挥发律原理的中文说明。中部横跨页面的是“FRAGRANCE FAMILIES / 迈克尔·爱德华兹香水分类频谱”部分，将香水分为花香调、东方调、木质调和清新调四大类，每类下又细分出多种具体香型，并配有一段关于“香水轮”的说明。图片底部左侧是“EXTRACTION / 萃取工艺”部分，通过流程图展示了蒸馏、溶剂萃取和压榨三种工艺，右侧配有详细的中文说明。图片底部是页脚信息，包含“ATLAS OF OLFACTION: PLATE NO. 42”、“CONFIDENTIAL DATA / REPRODUCTION PROHIBITED”和“© 1956 FRAGRANCE INSTITUTE”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about perfume knowledge, set against a beige background, detailing fragrance notes, structure, chemical indicators, classification, and extraction processes through multiple blocks and diagrams. The top left section, titled "INTRO / 绪论", includes the Chinese and English titles "经典香水调性与嗅觉光谱" and "THE PERFUME PYRAMID & OLFACTIVE SPECTRUM", followed by a Chinese description of fragrance volatility. The top right section, "THE STRUCTURE / 金字塔结构", uses a three-layered pyramid diagram to illustrate top, heart, and base notes, along with their duration and main scent types. The middle left features a table titled "DATA / 常见香料化学指标", listing six fragrance ingredients, their duration, and family. Below the table is a Chinese explanation of the law of volatility. Spanning the middle of the page is the "FRAGRANCE FAMILIES / 迈克尔·爱德华兹香水分类频谱" section, which categorizes fragrances into four main families: Floral, Oriental, Woody, and Fresh, each with several sub-types, accompanied by a note about "The Fragrance Wheel". The bottom left section, "EXTRACTION / 萃取工艺", presents a flowchart illustrating three extraction methods: steam distillation, solvent extraction, and expression, with detailed Chinese descriptions on the right. The footer at the very bottom includes "ATLAS OF OLFACTION: PLATE NO. 42", "CONFIDENTIAL DATA / REPRODUCTION PROHIBITED", and "© 1956 FRAGRANCE INSTITUTE".

prompt_cn: 这是一张在试衣间拍摄的照片。画面中，一位年轻女性站在镜子前，左手拿着一件棕色、黑色和米色格纹图案的V领连衣裙，连衣裙上挂着一个白色标签。她右手拿着一部浅金色边框的智能手机，屏幕朝向自己，表情略显困惑或思考。图片右上角有一个绿色的聊天气泡，里面显示中文文字“小艺这个选子好不好看”，气泡旁边是一个小头像。试衣间背景是浅色墙壁，墙上有金属挂钩和衣架杆。右侧的镜子反射出模糊的手机屏幕和一件米色衣物挂在衣架上。聊天气泡中的文字与女性的动作和表情相呼应，表明她正在通过手机征求朋友对连衣裙的意见。
prompt_en: This is a photo taken in a fitting room. In the image, a young woman stands in front of a mirror, holding a brown, black, and beige plaid V-neck dress in her left hand, with a white tag hanging from it. She holds a smartphone with a light gold frame in her right hand, its screen facing her, and her expression appears slightly confused or thoughtful. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a green chat bubble displaying the Chinese text "小艺这个选子好不好看" (Xiao Yi, does this choice look good?), with a small profile picture next to the bubble. The fitting room background features light-colored walls with metal hooks and a clothes rail. The mirror on the right reflects a blurry phone screen and a beige garment hanging on a hanger. The text in the chat bubble corresponds with the woman's actions and expression, indicating she is asking a friend for an opinion on the dress via her phone.

text:
四类核心病毒形态结构与尺寸对比
VIRAL MORPHOLOGY & TAXONOMY ATLAS
病毒(Virus)是介于生物与非生物之间的微小生命体,其基本结构由遗传物质(DNA/RNA)与蛋白质衣壳(Capsid)组成。在本卷中,我们将根据对称性与包膜存在与否,将已知病毒归纳为四种基础几何形态。这些形态不仅决定了病毒的侵染机制,更反映了其在分子层面的精密组装逻辑。
观测基准:所有模型均基于冷冻电镜(Cryo-EM)三维重建数据绘制,比例尺误差控制在±5nm 范围内。
300
250
01
二十面体对称 / ICOSAHEDRAL
这是自然界最稳固的几何形态。如腺病毒(Adenovirus),由20个等边三角形面和12个顶点组成。其结构遵循严格的准等效原理,能以最少种类的蛋白亚基构建出最大的封闭空间。
200
典型代表:腺病毒
尺寸:70-90nm
衣壳由252个子粒组成,包括240个六邻体和12个五邻体。顶点处常带有刺突蛋白。
SCALE
(nm)
150
02
包膜型 / ENVELOPED
病毒衣壳外包裹着一层脂质双分子层,通常来源于宿主细胞膜。这种结构极具柔性,表面镶嵌着识别宿主细胞受体的糖蛋白(Spike Protein),如SARS-CoV-2 或HIV。
典型代表:冠状病毒
尺寸:80-120nm
具囊膜,形态呈球形或多形性。刺突(S蛋白)长度约20nm,赋予病毒日冕状外观。
100
03
螺旋对称 / HELICAL
核酸(通常为单链RNA)呈螺旋状排列,蛋白质亚基按相同角度环绕其外,形成中空的管状结构。如烟草花叶病毒(TMV),长度可达300nm。
典型代表:TMV
尺寸:18×300nm
由2130个相同蛋白质亚基组成螺旋,内部包裹着约6400个核苷酸的单链RNA。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于病毒形态结构与尺寸对比的科学信息图表。图表以白色为背景，顶部有中文主标题“四类核心病毒形态结构与尺寸对比”和英文副标题“VIRAL MORPHOLOGY & TAXONOMY ATLAS”。左侧设有一个垂直的纳米（nm）刻度尺，用于指示病毒尺寸。图表主体内容分为四个编号部分（01-04），分别介绍了二十面体对称、包膜型、螺旋对称和复合型四类核心病毒。每个部分包含病毒形态的文字描述和对应的结构示意图。在每个结构示意图的右侧，有一个黄色边框的文本框，提供了该类型病毒的典型代表、尺寸范围以及详细的结构特征说明。图表右上方还有一个黄色背景的说明文字，阐述了观测基准。右下角是一个总结性表格，列出了这四种病毒的分类类型、尺寸范围和核酸类型。整体布局清晰，图文结合，系统地展示了病毒的微观结构信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic illustrating the morphology and size comparison of core virus types. The chart features a white background with a Chinese main title "四类核心病毒形态结构与尺寸对比" and an English subtitle "VIRAL MORPHOLOGY & TAXONOMY ATLAS" at the top. A vertical scale bar on the left indicates sizes in nanometers (nm). The main body of the chart is divided into four numbered sections (01-04), each introducing one of the four core virus types: icosahedral, enveloped, helical, and complex. Each section includes a textual description of the virus morphology and a corresponding structural diagram. To the right of each structural diagram, there is a text box with a yellow border, providing the typical representative, size range, and detailed structural characteristics of that virus type. In the upper right, there is also an explanatory text box with a yellow background, detailing the observation criteria. A summary table in the bottom right corner lists the classification type, size range, and nucleic acid type for these four viruses. The overall layout is clear, combining text and images to systematically present microscopic structural information about viruses.

(57) ABSTRACT
A method for the discrete separation of whole blood into constituent strata using high-velocity centrifugal force (approx. 2000-3000 G). The invention relates to the precise quantification of human blood components, specifically isolating the Plasma phase (1), the Buffy Coat interface (2), and the packed Erythrocyte volume (3). Whole blood typically constitutes 7% to 8% of total human body mass, roughly 4.5 to 5.5 liters in a standard adult male. The fractionation process enables clinical measurement of hematocrit levels (nominally 45%) and the density-based separation of leukocytes and thrombocytes within the intermediate buffy coat layer (less than 1% of total volume). The apparatus utilizes ultra-thin-walled borosilicate containment vessels to permit optical verification of the phase boundaries 10, 20, and 30 as illustrated in FIG. 1.

prompt_en: This is a scientific document or patent application page, primarily presenting information about a system for multi-phase centrifugal fractionation of whole human blood and its volumetric analysis. The page uses a two-column layout; the narrower left column contains patent metadata such as publication number, date of publication, international classification codes, application number, applicant, and inventors' information. The wider right column includes the main title, an abstract, a list of reference biological values, a schematic diagram of blood sample stratification, and a detailed quantitative composition table. The title reads "SYSTEM FOR MULTI-PHASE CENTRIFUGAL FRACTIONATION OF WHOLE HUMAN BLOOD AND VOLUMETRIC ANALYSIS THEREOF". The abstract describes the method and purpose of whole blood centrifugal separation. The schematic diagram shows a cylindrical container with a blood sample separated into three layers, labeled (1), (2), and (3), with a total height indicated as "h = 150mm". Table "TABLE 1" details the quantitative composition of fractionated whole blood, including the fraction layer name, percentage of total volume, primary constituents, reference concentration, and mean density. At the bottom of the page are notes regarding the basis of the values and footer information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张手机应用界面截图，背景为深紫色到蓝色的渐变。顶部是半透明搜索栏，内有放大镜图标和“搜索心仪的商品...”提示文字，右侧是房屋图标。界面中央的圆角矩形区域内含抽象几何图案，色彩丰富。图案下方显示网络错误信息，标题“信号去哪儿了?”，副标题“网络连接似乎遇到了一点小麻烦”。下方有一个主操作按钮“立即重试”，呈从左紫到右粉的水平渐变色。其下方并列有两个次级操作按钮：“检查网络设置”和“返回首页”，均为圆角矩形。界面底部是“为您推荐”的商品推荐区域，右侧有“换一批”文字。推荐区域包含两个并列的商品卡片：左侧展示一块棕色表带的智能腕表，下方文字为“极客系列智能腕表”，价格“¥2,999”和带有删除线的原价“¥3,500”；右侧展示一双蓝色/灰色运动鞋，下方文字为“限量版潮流运动鞋”，价格“¥1,280”和带有删除线的原价“¥1,880”。整个界面布局为单列垂直排列。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface, with a background gradient from dark purple to blue. At the top is a translucent search bar, containing a magnifying glass icon and the prompt text "搜索心仪的商品..." (Search for desired products...), with a home icon on the right. The center of the interface features a rounded rectangular area with abstract geometric patterns in rich colors. Below this pattern, network error information is displayed, with the title "信号去哪儿了?" (Where did the signal go?) and the subtitle "网络连接似乎遇到了一点小麻烦" (The network connection seems to have encountered a small problem). Below this, there is a main action button labeled "立即重试" (Retry Now), which has a horizontal gradient from purple on the left to pink on the right. Below the main button, two secondary action buttons are arranged side-by-side: "检查网络设置" (Check Network Settings) and "返回首页" (Return to Homepage), both with rounded rectangular shapes. The bottom of the interface features a "为您推荐" (Recommended for You) product recommendation section, with "换一批" (Change Batch) text on the right. This section includes two side-by-side product cards: the left card displays an image of a smart watch with a brown strap, with the text "极客系列智能腕表" (Geek Series Smart Watch) below it, priced at "¥2,999" and an original price of "¥3,500" with a strikethrough; the right card displays an image of a pair of blue/grey sports shoes, with the text "限量版潮流运动鞋" (Limited Edition Trendy Sports Shoes) below it, priced at "¥1,280" and an original price of "¥1,880" with a strikethrough. The overall interface layout is a single vertical column.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电子竞技赛事宣传海报。画面中央是六名身穿深蓝色队服的男性电竞选手，他们一字排开，姿态各异，其中一位选手双手比心。队服上印有“LNG”字样及其他队标。海报背景是深红色渐变，带有火焰和烟雾效果，并以巨大的红色艺术字“SUMMER PLAYOFFS”作为视觉焦点。顶部左侧是“LPL”标志，右侧是标语“无畏竞巅峰”。底部左侧是“LNG”战队标志。底部中央显示“2023 夏季赛 季后赛”以及完整的英文赛事名称“2023 LEAGUE OF LEGENDS PROFESSIONAL LEAGUE SUMMER PLAYOFFS”。右下角用醒目的红色大字标示日期“7/20”，旁边是白色大字“17:00”和“正式开赛”。海报整体色彩以深蓝色、红色和白色为主，通过文字和图像共同传达了赛事信息。
prompt_en: This is an esports event promotional poster. In the center of the image are six male esports players wearing dark blue team uniforms, standing in a row with various poses, one of whom is making a heart shape with his hands. The uniforms are printed with "LNG" and other team logos. The poster's background features a dark red gradient with flame and smoke effects, and the large red stylized text "SUMMER PLAYOFFS" serves as a visual focal point. The "LPL" logo is in the top left, and the slogan "无畏竞巅峰" (Fearless to Reach the Peak) is in the top right. The "LNG" team logo is at the bottom left. The bottom center displays "2023 夏季赛 季后赛" (2023 Summer Playoffs) and the full English event name "2023 LEAGUE OF LEGENDS PROFESSIONAL LEAGUE SUMMER PLAYOFFS". The bottom right corner prominently features the date "7/20" in large red text, next to which are "17:00" in large white text and "正式开赛" (Official Start). The overall color scheme of the poster is dominated by dark blue, red, and white, with text and images jointly conveying event information.

The man, dressed in a silver jumpsuit, has a bulging abdomen and smiles while cradling his belly with both hands. To his right, a blue translucent holographic display floats in the air, showing a fetal ultrasound image and related data, including "Fetal Ultrasound". The bottom-right card has a dark blue background and is titled "安全与执行" (Security and Execution), containing text "包含元数据与快照链" (Include Metadata and Snapshot Chain) with a checkbox, and a blue "开始导出任务" (Start Export Task) button at the bottom. prompt_cn: 这是一张展示室内场景的照片，画面中并排悬挂着两块矩形展板，它们固定在红棕色、带有模糊图案的墙面上。两块展板均以黑色为底，顶部和底部装饰有红色边框及圆形图案。左侧展板主要展示文字信息，分为上下两部分：上半部分包含关于彭冲参观汉墓的中文和英文介绍，以及他的手写题词“西汉神工”和签名“彭冲题”；下半部分则包含关于李鹏参观汉墓的中文和英文介绍，以及他的手写题词“龟山汉墓 堪称一绝”和签名“李鹏题”。展板底部有中文“龟山汉墓”及其英文翻译“Guishan Han Tomb”。右侧展板则以图片为主，上方是一张较大的石质结构照片，下方并列展示了三张较小的石块细节图，其中两张显示了刻有文字的粗糙石块表面。展板中部有中文标题“南墓道塞石原状及刻铭一组”及其英文翻译“Original Blocking Bulk Stones and Inscriptions”，底部同样标有“龟山汉墓”及其英文翻译。
prompt_en: This is a photograph of an indoor scene, featuring two rectangular display boards hung side-by-side on a reddish-brown wall with faint, repeating patterns. Both boards have a black background, adorned with red borders and circular motifs at the top and bottom. The left display board primarily presents textual information, divided into two sections: the upper section includes Chinese and English introductions about Peng Chong's visit to the Han Tomb, along with his handwritten inscription '西汉神工' and signature '彭冲题'; the lower section contains Chinese and English introductions about Li Peng's visit to the Han Tomb, accompanied by his handwritten inscription '龟山汉墓 堪称一绝' and signature '李鹏题'. The bottom of the board features '龟山汉墓' in Chinese and its English translation 'Guishan Han Tomb'. The right display board is image-centric, with a larger photograph of a stone structure at the top, and three smaller, parallel detail images of stone blocks below it, two of which show rough stone surfaces with carved inscriptions. The middle of this board displays the Chinese title '南墓道塞石原状及刻铭一组' and its English translation 'Original Blocking Bulk Stones and Inscriptions', with '龟山汉墓' and its English translation also present at the bottom.

MODERN RUNNING
FOOTWEAR
ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC & MECHANICAL PARAMETERS
01. STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION
The contemporary performance shoe is a multi-component energy return system. Unlike traditional footwear, these instruments prioritize mechanical advantage over simple protection.
MIDSOLE (PEBAX)

ENGINEERED MESH: Constructed from high-tenacity polyester. Features variable density zones for breathability and lockdown. No-sew overlays reduce friction.
HEEL COUNTER: Internal rigid thermoplastic member designed to lock the calcaneus into the neutral axis, preventing lateral eversion during high-velocity cornering.
THE DROP: Differential between rear and forefoot height. 8mm is standard for heel strikers; <4mm encourages midfoot landing.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于现代跑鞋工程原理的深色信息图。图片背景为深蓝色，文字主要为浅灰色，部分关键信息以橙色突出显示。图片顶部是页眉“REPORT NO. 884-A // PROPULSION LABS”，紧接着是主标题“MODERN RUNNING FOOTWEAR”和副标题“ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC & MECHANICAL PARAMETERS”。内容分为三个主要部分，分别编号为“01. STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION”、“02. KINETIC REBOUND MATRIX”和“03. CARBON PLATE GEOMETRY”。第一部分“STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION”介绍了跑鞋的结构组成，配有一段文字描述和一张跑鞋中底的剖面图，图中标注了“MIDSOLE (PEBAX)”、“CARBON PLATE”、“HEEL: 40MM”和“FORE: 32MM”。右侧是关于“ENGINEERED MESH”、“HEEL COUNTER”和“THE DROP”的详细说明。第二部分“KINETIC REBOUND MATRIX”展示了动能回弹矩阵，包含一个比较不同材料（Standard EVA, Supercritical TPU, PEBAX (Nylon)）密度、能量回弹、肖氏硬度和热稳定性的表格，其中能量回弹百分比用橙色标出。下方是一个条形图，显示了EVA、TPU和PEBA三种材料的“RETURN %”，PEBA的条形为橙色。右侧是关于“SUPERCRITICAL FOAMING”及其“RESULT”的解释。第三部分“CARBON PLATE GEOMETRY”探讨了碳板的几何结构，包含一段文字描述和一张碳板的线图，图中标注了“REAR ANCHOR”、“FULCRUM POINT”和“SPOON-CURVE TIP”。右侧列出了“MECHANICAL LEVERAGE”的四个优点。图片底部是页脚信息，包括“PLATE NO: 042-SHO-2024”、“ATLAS OF PERFORMANCE ENGINEERING”和“COPYRIGHT © 1914-2024”。
prompt_en: This is a dark infographic detailing the engineering principles of modern running footwear. The image features a dark blue background with text primarily in light gray, while some key information is highlighted in orange. At the top, there is a header "[ REPORT NO. 884-A // PROPULSION LABS ]", followed by the main title "MODERN RUNNING FOOTWEAR" and the subtitle "ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC & MECHANICAL PARAMETERS". The content is divided into three main sections, numbered "01. STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION", "02. KINETIC REBOUND MATRIX", and "03. CARBON PLATE GEOMETRY". Section 01, "STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION", describes the structural components of the running shoe. It includes a text description and a cross-sectional diagram of a shoe midsole, labeled with "MIDSOLE (PEBAX)", "CARBON PLATE", "HEEL: 40MM", and "FORE: 32MM". To the right, there are detailed explanations of "ENGINEERED MESH", "HEEL COUNTER", and "THE DROP". Section 02, "KINETIC REBOUND MATRIX", presents a kinetic rebound matrix. It features a table comparing the density, energy return, Shore hardness, and thermal stability of different materials (Standard EVA, Supercritical TPU, PEBAX (Nylon)), with energy return percentages highlighted in orange. Below the table is a bar chart illustrating the "RETURN %" for EVA, TPU, and PEBA materials, with the PEBA bar colored orange. To the right, there are explanations of "SUPERCRITICAL FOAMING" and its "RESULT". Section 03, "CARBON PLATE GEOMETRY", discusses the geometry of the carbon plate. It includes a text description and a line diagram of a carbon plate, labeled with "REAR ANCHOR", "FULCRUM POINT", and "SPOON-CURVE TIP". To the right, four benefits of "MECHANICAL LEVERAGE" are listed. The bottom of the image contains footer information: "PLATE NO: 042-SHO-2024", "ATLAS OF PERFORMANCE ENGINEERING", and "COPYRIGHT © 1914-2024".

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张以轮滑课程为主题的宣传海报。海报左侧描绘了一个卡通风格的女孩，她穿着轮滑鞋，戴着头盔和护具，正向前滑行。海报顶部右侧是一个黄色不规则形状的背景框，上面是主标题“SUMMER TERM 暑假 玩转轮滑 ROLLER-SKATING”。主标题下方并列着三个蓝色矩形按钮，分别标有“基础轮滑”、“自由式轮滑”和“速度轮滑”。海报中部是“课程介绍”区域，其中包含三张小照片，展示了不同场景下的轮滑活动。照片下方是一个课程时间表，左侧有垂直排布的“上课时间”标签，右侧详细列出了不同课程的名称及其对应的具体上课时间。海报下部设有“限时优惠”区域，突出显示了“低至299元”的价格，并提供了“三人成团限时领取运动头盔一个”等优惠信息。海报的背景色从顶部浅蓝色渐变到底部浅紫色。底部区域包含联系电话、地址信息，以及一个“扫一扫”文字和一个指纹形状的二维码图标。
prompt_en: This image is a promotional poster themed around roller-skating courses. On the left side of the poster, a cartoon-style girl is depicted, wearing roller skates, a helmet, and protective gear, gliding forward. The top right of the poster features an irregular yellow background box containing the main title: "SUMMER TERM 暑假 玩转轮滑 ROLLER-SKATING". Below the main title are three blue rectangular buttons arranged side-by-side, labeled "基础轮滑" (Basic Roller Skating), "自由式轮滑" (Freestyle Roller Skating), and "速度轮滑" (Speed Roller Skating). The middle section of the poster is a "课程介绍" (Course Introduction) area, which includes three small photographs showcasing roller-skating activities in different settings. Below the photos is a course schedule table, with a vertically arranged "上课时间" (Class Schedule) label on the left, and detailed course names with their corresponding class times listed on the right. The lower part of the poster features a "限时优惠" (Limited-Time Offer) section, highlighting a price of "低至299元" (as low as 299 yuan) and other offers such as "三人成团限时领取运动头盔一个" (form a group of three to receive a limited-time sports helmet). The poster's background color transitions from light blue at the top to light purple at the bottom. The bottom area includes contact phone number, address information, along with the text "(扫一扫)" (Scan to scan) and a fingerprint-shaped QR code icon.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以开学季为主题的图书文具促销海报。海报背景为浅米色纸张纹理，顶部和底部有深棕色格子图案。左上方是“Canva”品牌标志。海报左侧是垂直排布的主标题“向新学期梦想前行”和副标题“开学季图书特惠促销”，字体为深棕色。海报右侧上方是深棕色矩形框内的“活动内容”标题，下方列出了教辅类、工具书、作文类和文具类的具体折扣信息。中部是另一个深棕色矩形框内的“活动时间”标题，下方显示活动日期为“8.15-9.15”。海报底部左侧是咨询电话和地址信息。画面下方装饰有堆叠的书籍、地球仪、三角尺、铅笔、指南针、干花和羽毛球等学习和生活用品，与促销主题相呼应。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a back-to-school season book and stationery sale. The poster features a light beige paper texture background with dark brown checkered patterns at the top and bottom. The "Canva" brand logo is in the top-left corner. On the left side of the poster, the main title "向新学期梦想前行" (Towards New Semester Dreams) and the subtitle "开学季图书特惠促销" (Back-to-School Season Book Special Promotion) are arranged vertically in dark brown font. On the upper right side, a dark brown rectangular box contains the title "活动内容" (Activity Content), followed by a list of specific discount information for teaching aids, reference books, composition books, and stationery. In the middle, another dark brown rectangular box holds the title "活动时间" (Activity Time), with the activity dates "8.15-9.15" displayed below. The bottom-left of the poster provides contact phone and address information. The lower part of the image is decorated with stacked books, a globe, a set square, a pencil, a compass, dried flowers, and a badminton shuttlecock, all echoing the promotional theme of learning and daily life items.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以红色为主色调的数字插画海报。画面顶部是深红色背景，散布着金色光点，右上方有几只金色飞鸟。左侧垂直排列着多行白色文字，包括大字号的“山河无恙”和“海晏河清”作为主标题，下方是日期“2090/08/01”和“致敬最优秀的人”。画面中部偏左有“祝繁荣昌盛”和“生活越来越好”两行文字。画面右侧有一根白色华表，其周围缠绕着一条红色飘带，飘带从画面中上部向右下方延伸。画面底部是金色的天安门城楼，城楼下方是红色地面，地面上也有金色光点和光线效果。海报最下方居中位置是小字号的“可画设计工作室祝大家节日快乐”。整张海报营造出庄重而喜庆的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration poster predominantly in red. The top of the image features a dark red background with scattered golden light particles, and several golden flying birds are in the upper right. On the left side, multiple lines of white text are vertically arranged, including the large main titles "山河无恙" (The country is safe and sound) and "海晏河清" (Peace reigns over the land), followed by the date "2090/08/01" and "致敬最优秀的人" (Salute to the most outstanding people). In the mid-left, there are two lines of text: "祝繁荣昌盛" (Wish for prosperity) and "生活越来越好" (Life gets better and better). On the right side of the image, there is a white ornamental pillar (huabiao) wrapped with a red ribbon, which extends from the upper-middle to the lower-right. The bottom of the image depicts the golden Tiananmen Gate, with a red ground below it, also adorned with golden light particles and light effects. At the very bottom center of the poster, in smaller font, is "可画设计工作室祝大家节日快乐" (Kehua Design Studio wishes everyone a happy holiday). The entire poster creates a solemn yet festive atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张活动邀请海报，背景为浅黄色至粉色的渐变，并点缀有粉色、蓝色和黄色的抽象色块。海报左上方有一个黑色矩形标签，内有白色文字“CELEBRATION”，下方是灰色的“THE STARLIGHT HOTEL”。右上方显示日期“10 OCTOBER”，其中“10”为粉色，“OCTOBER”为灰色。海报中部是欢迎语“WELCOME TO”，下方是活动主题“LUCAS'”和“3RD PARTY”，前者为深灰色粗体大字，后者为黑色描边大字。主题下方有一条水平线，线上有三个彩色小圆点（粉、黄、蓝）。海报中下部是一个白色的圆角矩形卡片。卡片左上角有粉色的“LOCATION”，下方是深灰色粗体大字“梦幻童话礼堂”。其右侧是一个黄色圆形按钮，内含黑色右箭头符号。卡片下半部分分为两列：左列是蓝色的“FLOOR”及其下方的“酒店 3F 大宴会厅”，右列是蓝色的“ACTION”及其下方的“请沿气球指示前行”。海报左下角是灰色的邀请语：“期待您的光临，共同开启这场奇幻冒险之旅。”右下角是一个黑白相间的二维码占位符，下方有“扫码签到”字样。
prompt_en: This is an event invitation poster set against a light yellow to pink gradient background, adorned with abstract color blocks in pink, blue, and yellow. The top left corner features a black rectangular label with "CELEBRATION" in white text, beneath which "THE STARLIGHT HOTEL" is displayed in gray. On the top right, the date "10 OCTOBER" is presented in pink and gray. The central area of the poster contains a welcome message "WELCOME TO" in gray, followed by the main event title: "LUCAS'" in large, dark gray bold letters and "3RD PARTY" in large, black-outlined letters. Below this title, a horizontal line is accented with three small colored dots (pink, yellow, blue). A prominent white rounded rectangular card occupies the lower middle section. Inside this card, the upper left displays "LOCATION" in pink, followed by "梦幻童话礼堂" (Dreamy Fairytale Auditorium) in large, bold dark gray text. To its right, a yellow circular button with a black right-pointing arrow is present. The lower part of the card is split into two columns: "FLOOR" in blue with "酒店 3F 大宴会厅" (Hotel 3F Grand Ballroom) beneath it, and "ACTION" in blue with "请沿气球指示前行" (Please follow balloon signs) below it. The bottom left of the poster includes an invitation message in gray: "期待您的光临，共同开启这场奇幻冒险之旅。" (Looking forward to your visit, let's embark on this fantastic adventure together.). The bottom right corner shows a black and white placeholder for a QR code, with "扫码签到" (Scan to sign in) written below it.

In the middle of the poster, next to a small blue square, reads "2024 数字化转型峰会" (2024 Digital Transformation Summit), followed by the large main event title "智汇未来·行业交流 商务鸡尾酒会" (Wisdom Gathers Future · Industry Exchange Business Cocktail Party), with text color transitioning from white to light blue. prompt_cn: 这是一张赛博朋克风格的摄影照片，展示了一名戴着VR头显的男子坐在堆满杂物的办公桌前。桌上摆放着四台显示器，其中三台显示“ERROR: NO IDEAS FOUND”或“404 INSPIRATION NOT FOUND”等错误信息，另一台显示空白的Word文档。桌面上散落着咖啡杯、能量饮料罐、揉皱的纸张、键盘和大量缠绕的线缆。墙壁和显示器下方贴有多张写有“没思路”、“没灵感”的黄色便签，桌面右下角白纸上写着“没思路 没灵感 没头脑”。窗外是下着雨的城市夜景，高楼大厦灯火通明。画面整体色调偏暗，以蓝色、紫色和红色霓虹灯光为主，共同营造出一种缺乏灵感或遇到创作瓶颈的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a cyberpunk-style photograph showing a man wearing a VR headset sitting at a cluttered desk. On the desk are four monitors, three of which display error messages such as "ERROR: NO IDEAS FOUND" or "404 INSPIRATION NOT FOUND", while another shows a blank Word document. The desk is strewn with coffee cups, energy drink cans, crumpled papers, a keyboard, and a tangle of cables. Several yellow sticky notes with "没思路" (no ideas) and "没灵感" (no inspiration) are attached to the wall and below the monitors, and a white paper on the bottom right of the desk reads "没思路 没灵感 没头脑" (no ideas, no inspiration, no brains). Outside the window is a rainy city night view with brightly lit skyscrapers. prompt_cn: 这是一张以交通安全为主题的幻灯片页面。页面顶部左侧显示英文“TRAFFIC CIVILIZATION”和中文“驾校科目一理论教学中心”，右上角是页码“01”。页面左侧是主要内容区，包含超大字体的中文标题“平安出行”，下方是宣传语“每一公里 都是责任的延伸”以及两行小字正文“文明驾驶从理论起步，让规章制度内化于心，外化于行。”。页面右侧是一张灰度处理的巴士在山路上行驶的图片，图片中央叠加一个黑色矩形条，上面有白色英文“SAFE DRIVING”。页面底部有三列并排的文字区域，每列都以灰色英文“SEC.”开头，后接黑色中文标题和一句中文正文，内容分别为“知法守规 熟记交通法规”、“礼让三分 路口谨慎慢行”和“谨慎驾驶 杜绝危险行为”。右下角还有“PUBLIC SAFETY”和“2024 VISION”字样，旁边是一个黑色菱形图标。
prompt_en: This is a slide page themed around traffic safety. The top left of the page displays "TRAFFIC CIVILIZATION" in English and "驾校科目一理论教学中心" (Driving School Subject One Theoretical Teaching Center) in Chinese, with the page number "01" in the top right corner. The left side of the page is the main content area, featuring the large Chinese title "平安出行" (Safe Travel), followed by the slogan "每一公里 都是责任的延伸" (Every kilometer is an extension of responsibility) and two lines of smaller text: "文明驾驶从理论起步，让规章制度内化于心，外化于行。" (Civilized driving starts from theory, internalizing rules and regulations and externalizing them in action). The right side of the page features a grayscale image of a bus driving on a mountain road, with a black rectangular bar overlaid in the center of the image, containing white English text "SAFE DRIVING". The bottom of the page has three side-by-side text sections, each starting with "SEC." in gray English, followed by a black Chinese title and a line of Chinese body text. These sections are "知法守规 熟记交通法规" (Know and abide by rules, memorize traffic laws), "礼让三分 路口谨慎慢行" (Yield three points, drive slowly and carefully at intersections), and "谨慎驾驶 杜绝危险行为" (Drive cautiously, eliminate dangerous behaviors). The bottom right also shows "PUBLIC SAFETY" and "2024 VISION" with a black diamond icon next to them.

prompt_en: This is a movie poster featuring a half-length portrait of actor Michael Douglas. The background shows a dark blue, cloudy sky, with a faintly visible, snow-covered city skyline in the distance, suggesting New York City. The overall color scheme of the poster is dominated by blue, white, and gray, creating a cold and oppressive atmosphere. At the top center of the image is the white text "FROM THE DIRECTOR OF INDEPENDENCE DAY", and in the upper left corner, "A ROLAND EMMERICH FILM" is displayed. The movie title "THE DAY AFTER TOMORROW" is prominently featured in large, white, bold, uppercase letters in the mid-left section of the image. The bottom of the poster contains multiple lines of small, white text listing the cast, crew, production company information, and a website address, detailing the film's production team and personnel. The frozen image of the Statue of Liberty, combined with the movie title, conveys the film's theme of extreme climate disaster.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑白灰为主色调的活动宣传海报。海报左侧为深灰色背景上的浅灰色竖条，上面垂直排布着“CULTURAL & ARTISTIC”和巨大的“悦读沙龙”字样，后者是活动的主标题。海报右侧是主要内容区，顶部有活动主题“思想的重量”及其英文副标题“THE WEIGHT OF THOUGHTS”，右侧标有“NO. 087 / 2024”。中部是一张黑白照片，展示了一个现代风格的多层图书馆或书店内部，书架林立，楼梯交错，空间感十足。照片左下角叠加了一句引用：“书页间的留白，是思想起舞的剧场。”海报底部列出了活动信息，包括“时间 / TIME 2024.11.15 14:30”和“地点 / VENUE 艺术中心·悦读空间”，右下角是一个黑底白字的“扫码预约入场”按钮。
prompt_en: This is an activity promotional poster primarily in black, white, and gray tones. The left side of the poster features a light gray vertical strip on a dark gray background, with "CULTURAL & ARTISTIC" and the large "悦读沙龙" (Reading Salon) text arranged vertically, the latter being the main title of the event. The right side of the poster is the main content area, with the event theme "思想的重量" (The Weight of Thoughts) and its English subtitle "THE WEIGHT OF THOUGHTS" at the top, and "NO. 087 / 2024" on the right. The middle section contains a black and white photograph depicting the interior of a modern, multi-level library or bookstore, filled with bookshelves and crisscrossing staircases, creating a strong sense of space. A quote, "“书页间的留白，是思想起舞的剧场。”" (The blank space between pages is the theater where thoughts dance.), is overlaid on the bottom-left of the photo. The bottom of the poster lists event information, including "时间 / TIME 2024.11.15 14:30" and "地点 / VENUE 艺术中心·悦读空间" (Art Center · Reading Space), with a black button featuring white text "扫码预约入场" (Scan to reserve entry) in the bottom right corner.

On the top of the bus, there are three small red lights, and on the black section, there are two large amber lights, one on each side. At the bottom of the bus, there are four round lights, with two amber ones on the left and two red ones on the right. Rivet details are visible on the bus body. The rear of the school bus features three windows, with multiple children seated inside. In the left window, a boy covers his face with his hands, smiling; in the middle window, a girl rests her face on her hands, also smiling; and in the right window, a boy is making a shape with both hands. In the top central yellow area of the bus, large black text reads "SCHOOL BUS", with smaller black text "EMERGENCY DOOR" directly below it. In the bottom central yellow area, smaller black text reads "THIS VEHICLE STOPS AT ALL RAILWAY CROSSINGS". The background consists of a blue sky and blurry distant trees or buildings.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以招聘为主题的宣传海报，背景从左上角的浅紫色渐变至右下角的浅蓝色，并覆盖有细密的网格图案。海报顶部有“Recruiting”、“加入我们，让梦想发光”和“JOIN US AND LET YOUR DREAMS SHINE.”等文字。左上角有一个深紫色方框，内有“2025春招”字样。海报左侧主体部分是大型粉色实心和透明材质的3D立体字“不薪动不如行动”，下方粉色丝带上写有“JOIN US”。海报右侧是招聘信息区，标题为“‘薪’动不如行动”，下方副标题“你的‘钱途’正在 等你‘职’掌!”中，“职”字被虚线框强调。招聘岗位以网格状排列，包含“渠道 经理”、“前端 开发”、“线上 运营”、“视觉 设计”和“文案 策划”五项，每个岗位名称都在浅灰色边框内。下方是简历投递邮箱“cnsupport@canva.com”及提示语“(请注明应聘岗位)”。海报底部左侧是青绿色的Canva品牌Logo，右侧是联系电话“001-12345678”和地址“深圳市南山区金色商业街001号商铺”，中间有标语“不止薪动，更有舞台任你闪耀”和“WELCOME TO JOIN”。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster with a background that gradients from light purple in the upper left to light blue in the lower right, overlaid with a fine grid pattern. At the top of the poster are texts like "Recruiting", "加入我们，让梦想发光" (Join us, let dreams shine), and "JOIN US AND LET YOUR DREAMS SHINE.". In the upper left corner, there is a dark purple box with "2025春招" (2025 Spring Recruitment). The main part of the left side features large 3D volumetric letters "不薪动不如行动" (Not just about salary, but about action) in solid pink and transparent materials. Below it, a pink ribbon displays "JOIN US". The right side of the poster is the recruitment information area, with the title "'薪'动不如行动" (Not just about salary, but about action). Below this, the subtitle "你的'钱途'正在 等你'职'掌!" (Your 'career' is waiting for you to take charge!) emphasizes the character "职" (career) with a dashed outline. Recruitment positions are arranged in a grid, including "渠道 经理" (Channel Manager), "前端 开发" (Frontend Developer), "线上 运营" (Online Operations), "视觉 设计" (Visual Designer), and "文案 策划" (Copywriter Planner), each enclosed in a light gray border. Below are the resume submission email "cnsupport@canva.com" and a note "(请注明应聘岗位)" (Please specify the applied position). At the bottom left of the poster is the teal Canva brand logo. On the right are the contact number "001-12345678" and address "深圳市南山区金色商业街001号商铺", with slogans "不止薪动，更有舞台任你闪耀" (More than just salary, a stage for you to shine) and "WELCOME TO JOIN" in the center.

The main content is divided into two rounded rectangular card areas. The upper card is the pickup voucher, labeled "提货凭证" (Pickup Voucher) in the top left and showing "待取货" (Pending Pickup) status in the top right. At the center of this card is the prominent pickup code "A - 5028". Below it, the pickup location "幸福里社区 3 号楼 1 单元 102 室 (菜鸟驿站旁)" (Xingfuli Community Building 3 Unit 1 Room 102 (next to Cainiao Post)) and group leader information "张小美 138 **** 8888" (Zhang Xiaomei 138 **** 8888) are listed. prompt_cn: 这是一张车载信息娱乐系统的界面截图。界面背景为深蓝色，顶部栏显示“DRIVE OS v4.0”系统名称、当前时间“22:45”和温度“24°C”。界面左侧主区域展示一辆黑色保时捷Panamera Turbo汽车在高速公路上行驶的图片，车尾可见“PORSCHE”、“Panamera Turbo”字样及车牌“CVC-911”和下方小字“COOPER”。图片左上角有一个红色标签“SPORT MODE ACTIVE”。图片下方显示“扭矩分配 40:60”和“悬架硬度 LEVEL 4”两组车辆数据。左下角有两个数据卡片，分别显示“当前功率 450 kW”和“电池温度 38 °C”。界面右侧是一个垂直的驾驶模式列表，包含五种模式：带有绿色圆圈图标的“ECO”（节能优先·续航最大化）、带有蓝色方块图标的“COMFORT”（标准平衡·滤震优化）、带有红色三角形图标并被红色背景高亮显示的“SPORT”（极致响应·动力全开）、带有橙色方块图标的“OFF-ROAD”（四驱锁止·攀爬模式）和带有紫色加号图标的“INDIVIDUAL”（个性配置·自由定义）。底部导航栏有四个按钮，其中三个带有文字标签：“车辆设置”、“驾驶辅助”、“能量管理”，最右侧是一个蓝色的空心方块图标按钮。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a car infotainment system interface. The interface has a dark blue background, with a top bar displaying the system name "DRIVE OS v4.0", current time "22:45", and temperature "24°C". The main left area of the interface shows an image of a black Porsche Panamera Turbo car driving on a highway. The car's rear displays "PORSCHE", "Panamera Turbo" text, and the license plate "CVC-911" with "COOPER" in smaller text below it. A red label "SPORT MODE ACTIVE" is in the top-left corner of this image. Below the image, two sets of vehicle data are shown: "扭矩分配 40:60" (Torque Distribution 40:60) and "悬架硬度 LEVEL 4" (Suspension Hardness LEVEL 4). In the bottom-left, two data cards display "当前功率 450 kW" (Current Power 450 kW) and "电池温度 38 °C" (Battery Temperature 38 °C). The right side of the interface features a vertical list of five driving modes: "ECO" with a green circle icon (Energy Priority·Max Range), "COMFORT" with a blue square icon (Standard Balance·Vibration Optimization), "SPORT" with a red triangle icon and highlighted with a red background (Ultimate Response·Full Power), "OFF-ROAD" with an orange square icon (4WD Lock·Climbing Mode), and "INDIVIDUAL" with a purple plus icon (Personalized Configuration·Free Definition). The bottom navigation bar contains four buttons, three of which have text labels: "车辆设置" (Vehicle Settings), "驾驶辅助" (Driving Assistance), "能量管理" (Energy Management), and the rightmost one is a blue hollow square icon button.

In the upper left corner of the image, there is a dark rectangular panel containing "AFFALTERBACH", the "AMG" logo, and the words "DRIVING", "PERFORMANCE", below which is a vertical list of numbers from 1 to 10. prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色背景为主的宣传海报，中央是一个圆形图片，展示了海边日落时分的户外婚礼或求婚场地。图片中，绿色的草坪上整齐摆放着白色椅子，前方有花艺拱门和串灯，远处是波光粼粼的大海和橙蓝相间的日落天空。圆形图片上方弧形排列着“THE ETERNAL LOVE”，下方弧形排列着倒置的“SEASIDE ROMANCE”，图片中央叠加着醒目的白色手写体“YES”。海报顶部左侧标有“LOCATION”及其具体地点“THE SEASIDE GRANDSTAND”，右侧标有“ATMOSPHERE”及其描述“ROMANTIC LAWN”。右侧边缘垂直排布着“EXCLUSIVE PROPOSAL PLANNING SERVICE”。海报底部左侧是“WILL YOU MARRY ME?”的问句，下方是两行中文：“在海浪与草坪的见证下, 开启属于我们的永恒篇章。”底部右侧的黑色圆角矩形框内显示日期“2024.05.20”，下方是“PRIVATE EVENT”和“SUNSET SESSION”。整张海报通过图文结合，营造出浪漫而庄重的活动氛围。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster with a dark background, featuring a central circular image that displays an outdoor wedding or proposal venue at sunset by the sea. In the image, white chairs are neatly arranged on a green lawn, with a floral arch and string lights in front, and the sparkling sea and an orange-blue sunset sky in the distance. Above the circular image, "THE ETERNAL LOVE" is arranged in an arc, while below it, the inverted "SEASIDE ROMANCE" is arranged in an arc. The prominent white handwritten "YES" is superimposed in the center of the image. The top left of the poster indicates "LOCATION" with the specific venue "THE SEASIDE GRANDSTAND", and the top right shows "ATMOSPHERE" with its description "ROMANTIC LAWN". Along the right edge, "EXCLUSIVE PROPOSAL PLANNING SERVICE" is vertically arranged. The bottom left of the poster features the question "WILL YOU MARRY ME?", followed by two lines of Chinese text: "在海浪与草坪的见证下, 开启属于我们的永恒篇章。" The bottom right displays the date "2024.05.20" within a black rounded rectangular box, below which are "PRIVATE EVENT" and "SUNSET SESSION". The entire poster, through the combination of text and image, creates a romantic and solemn event atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑白灰为主色调的展览海报。画面背景为浅灰色，左侧有一个不规则的深灰色抽象多边形，右侧有一个大的黑色圆形抽象图形。海报顶部左侧标有“EXHIBITION 2024”，右侧是地点信息“创意园·极简画廊”及其英文“CREATIVE PARK GALLERY”。画面中央偏左，在深灰色多边形上叠加着白色倾斜的艺术展标题“墨影幻境”，右侧是副标题“现代水墨摄影艺术展”及其英文“Modern Ink Wash Photography Art”。顶部中央偏左有一个小红色正方形作为点缀。海报左下角清晰展示了展览日期“10/15 STARTING”和“11/20 ENDING”。右下角是关于展览理念的中文介绍：“以光影为墨，以镜头为笔。在虚实交错的抽象空间中，重构东方美学的意境。”下方有一个黑色矩形框，内有白色文字“FREE ENTRY”，右侧是标签“#ABSTRACT #INK #ART”。
prompt_en: This is an exhibition poster predominantly in black, white, and gray tones. The background is light gray, featuring an irregular dark gray abstract polygon on the left and a large black circular abstract shape on the right. At the top left, "EXHIBITION 2024" is displayed. The top right shows the venue information "创意园·极简画廊" (Creative Park · Minimalist Gallery) and its English translation "CREATIVE PARK GALLERY". Centered slightly to the left, the main exhibition title "墨影幻境" (Ink Shadow Illusion) is overlaid in white, tilted text on the dark gray polygon. To its right is the subtitle "现代水墨摄影艺术展" (Modern Ink Wash Photography Art Exhibition) and its English counterpart "Modern Ink Wash Photography Art". A small red square serves as an accent in the top-middle-left area. The bottom left clearly presents the exhibition dates: "10/15 STARTING" and "11/20 ENDING". The bottom right contains a Chinese description of the exhibition's concept: "以光影为墨，以镜头为笔。在虚实交错的抽象空间中，重构东方美学的意境。" (Using light and shadow as ink, the lens as a brush. Reconstructing the artistic conception of Eastern aesthetics in an abstract space where reality and illusion intertwine.) Below this, a black rectangular box with white text reads "FREE ENTRY", and to its right are the tags "#ABSTRACT #INK #ART".

prompt_cn: 这是一张以蓝色天空为背景的宣传海报。画面中央，一名男性撑杆跳运动员正处于腾空状态，身体倒挂，双手紧握撑杆，姿态充满动感。运动员下方是一个巨大的绿色弧形图形，从画面左下方向右上延伸，象征着上升的轨迹和超越的精神。海报顶部有大字号的白色标题文字“超越, 是一种企业的 追求”。底部左侧是重复的标题“超越 是一种企业的追求。”，下方配有详细的深灰色正文，阐述了企业在技术、服务和管理方面的追求。右下角是蓝色的品牌标识“HOTO 河图”及其标语“为您 想 更多”。整张海报通过运动员的超越动作与文字内容紧密结合，传达了积极向上、追求卓越的企业理念。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster set against a blue sky background. In the center of the image, a male pole vaulter is airborne, with his body inverted and hands firmly gripping the pole, displaying a dynamic posture. Below the athlete is a large green arc-shaped graphic, extending from the bottom left to the upper right of the frame, symbolizing an upward trajectory and the spirit of transcendence. At the top of the poster, there is large white title text that reads "超越, 是一种企业的 追求" (Transcendence is a company's pursuit). On the bottom left, the title "超越 是一种企业的追求。" is repeated, accompanied by detailed dark gray body text explaining the company's pursuit in technology, service, and management. The bottom right features the blue brand logo "HOTO 河图" and its slogan "为您 想 更多" (HOTO Hetu, Thinks more for you). The entire poster effectively conveys a positive and excellence-seeking corporate philosophy by closely integrating the athlete's act of transcendence with the textual content.

prompt_cn: 这是一张宣传海报，画面主体是一位女性的侧面特写。她闭着双眼，深色长发上别着一朵粉色花朵，身穿一件蓝色露肩上衣。图片左侧背景明亮，右侧背景较暗，光线主要集中在女性面部。海报的文字信息分布在左右两侧。左上角有白色竖排文字“为爱前行”，下方是蓝色的演职员表，包括“艺术总监 丁黑”、“导演 吴蒙恩”、“编剧 李顺慈”、“总制片人 赵毅”、“音乐总监 梁翹柏”以及“领衔主演 陈妍希 何润东 江珊 彭冠英 侯勇 吕一 倪虹洁”。图片右上角有白色竖排小字“任时光匆匆流去 我只在乎你”。右下角是金色的艺术字体竖排大字“但愿人长久”，其下方是白色横排小字“Teresa Teng”。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster featuring a close-up side profile of a woman. Her eyes are closed, and a pink flower is tucked into her dark long hair. She is wearing a blue off-shoulder top. The background on the left side of the image is bright, while the right side is darker, with light primarily focused on the woman's face. Text information is distributed on both the left and right sides of the poster. In the top left, there is white vertical text "为爱前行" (Moving forward for love). prompt_en: The image displays a dark-themed game or application interface, predominantly in deep blue and purple tones. The top bar includes a title section showing the guild name "星际远征军" (Star Expeditionary Force) with "LV.99", accompanied by the slogan "探索无尽星空，铸就永恒荣耀" (Explore the endless starry sky, forge eternal glory). To the right, it shows "当前在线" (Currently Online) players "142 / 200" and "公会资金" (Guild Funds) "9,241,000". The main content area is structured into several card-style panels. On the left, a large panel titled "公会领地" (Guild Territory) features a sci-fi space base image, with a description about upgrading core buildings and an "立即进入" (Enter Now) button. The central section contains two panels: the upper one, "限时活动" (Limited-Time Event), displays "跨服公会战：虚空裂痕" (Cross-Server Guild War: Void Rift) and a countdown "距离开战：02:14:55" (Time to Battle: 02:14:55), along with a "参与集结" (Participate & Assemble) button. Below it is the "日常远征" (Daily Expedition) panel, which includes a description of daily tasks and a progress bar. The right section also features two panels: the upper one is "公会副本" (Guild Dungeon), with a description about challenging guardians and the text "已开启挑战" (Challenge Activated). The lower right panel is "贡献周榜" (Weekly Contribution Ranking), listing the top three players with their ranks ("01", "02", "03"), avatars, names ("影之刃·杰克", "月光守望者", "绝望之锤"), and contribution values. At the bottom, it shows "我的排名: 15th" (My Rank: 15th) and "周累计: 12,500" (Weekly Total: 12,500). Text colors are mainly white, light green, orange, and gray, with ranks "01" and "03" in orange and rank "02" in white.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以米色为背景的咖啡烘焙工坊三周年纪念宣传海报。海报顶部居中是深棕色文字“SINCE 2021”和“三周年纪念”，下方是副标题“拾光三载 · 啡你莫属”。海报中部是一张黑白照片，展示了未烘焙和已烘焙的咖啡豆。照片右侧叠加一个深棕色矩形框，内有白色文字“1,095 DAYS OF ROASTING”。照片下方是关于咖啡烘焙和周年纪念的中文段落，以引号开头。海报左下角是品牌名称“醇享咖啡烘焙工坊”和日期“二零二四年·秋”。右下角有一个深棕色圆形徽章，内有白色“周年志庆”字样，外圈环绕着小字“VITALITY COFFEE BEANS”和“PREMIUM ROASTING”。海报整体设计简洁，以深棕色边框勾勒。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a coffee roasting workshop's third anniversary, set against a beige background. At the top center of the poster are the dark brown texts "SINCE 2021" and "三周年纪念" (Third Anniversary), with the subtitle "拾光三载 · 啡你莫属" (Three Years of Light · You are the One for Coffee) below. The middle of the poster features a black and white photograph displaying unroasted and roasted coffee beans. A dark brown rectangular box is overlaid on the right side of the photo, containing white text "1,095 DAYS OF ROASTING". Below the photo is a Chinese paragraph about coffee roasting and the anniversary, starting with quotation marks. The bottom left of the poster shows the brand name "醇享咖啡烘焙工坊" (Chunxiang Coffee Roasting Workshop) and the date "二零二四年·秋" (Autumn 2024). In the bottom right corner, there is a dark brown circular badge with white text "周年志庆" (Anniversary Celebration) inside, surrounded by small text "VITALITY COFFEE BEANS" and "PREMIUM ROASTING" in a ring. The poster's overall design is simple, outlined with a dark brown border.

prompt_cn: 这张信息图以深色背景展示了阿波罗计划中土星五号火箭的多级分离剖面。顶部是一个从地球到月球的火箭飞行轨迹示意图，图上清晰标注了S-IC第一级分离、S-II第二级分离和地月转移注入（TLI）三个关键事件点，并用橙色文字标示了对应的时间。轨迹终点处有一个新月形状的月球图标，旁边写有“目标:月球”。图示下方分为三列文本区域，分别详细介绍了“第一级与第二级动力”、“第三级与停泊轨道”以及“载荷时序与对接”。中间列还包含一个表格，列出了火箭各级段的发动机型号和推力。右侧列的文字下方是一个由S-IC、S-II、S-IVB和CSM四个方框组成的流程图，上方有“过渡适配器(LM)”的标签。图片底部页脚提供了发射地点、坐标和任务名称等信息。
prompt_en: This infographic, set against a dark background, illustrates the multi-stage separation profile of the Saturn V rocket during the Apollo program. The top section features a schematic diagram of the rocket's flight trajectory from Earth to the Moon. Key event points, including S-IC first stage separation, S-II second stage separation, and Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI), are clearly marked on the trajectory with corresponding times in orange text. A crescent moon icon with the label "目标:月球" (Target: Moon) is shown at the end of the trajectory. Below the diagram, the information is organized into three text columns, detailing "第一级与第二级动力" (First and Second Stage Power), "第三级与停泊轨道" (Third Stage and Parking Orbit), and "载荷时序与对接" (Payload Sequencing and Docking). The middle column also includes a table listing the engine types and thrust for each rocket stage. Below the text in the right column is a flowchart composed of four boxes labeled S-IC, S-II, S-IVB, and CSM, with "过渡适配器(LM)" (Transition Adapter (LM)) above it. The footer at the bottom of the image provides launch pad, coordinates, and mission name information.

The front of the monument bears the vertical inscription "中国人民抗日战争胜利纪念碑". Approximately 15 adults are standing in front of the monument, facing the camera and dressed in casual attire. There are propaganda signs on both the left and right sides of the monument. The red rectangular sign on the left features a yellow hammer and sickle emblem. The red rectangular sign on the right has "中国共产党入党誓词" (Chinese Communist Party Oath) at the top in white text, followed by the full oath text below. On the far right of the frame is a large circular sign, predominantly red, prominently displaying the large white number "80", with "1945-2025" in white numbers below it, and a line of smaller white Chinese characters at the bottom reading "隆重纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利80周年" (Solemnly commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War). The background features continuous mountains and a blue sky with white clouds, and a building with a traditional Chinese roof is visible on the left.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用程序的界面截图，显示了一个贷款申请的审核详情页面。页面顶部是深蓝色背景，包含一个左侧的返回箭头和“申请详情”标题，以及右侧的“在线客服”文本。下方中央区域有一个黄色时钟图标和“审核处理中”的标题，以及一行说明文字：“您的贷款申请已进入风险评估阶段，预计将在 24 小时内完成审核。”页面主体是一个圆角矩形的白色卡片区域，分为“申请金额”、“申请产品”、“申请单号”、“还款期限”等详情信息，以及“审核进度”部分。详情信息以左右两列形式展示，左侧是灰色标签，右侧是黑色数值，例如“申请金额 (元) ¥ 200,000.00”和“申请产品 尊享·精英贷”。审核进度部分以垂直时间轴形式呈现，包含“提交申请”、“风险评估中”、“最终审批”和“放款成功”四个阶段。其中，“提交申请”已完成，显示蓝色对勾图标和日期时间；“风险评估中”正在进行，显示黄色感叹号图标和说明文字；“最终审批”和“放款成功”为待处理状态，显示灰色圆点图标。页面底部有两个按钮，上方是金黄色背景的“刷新审核状态”按钮，下方是白色背景的“返回首页”按钮。最底部是灰色的“客服热线: 400-888-9999”信息。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface, displaying a loan application review details page. The top of the page has a dark blue background, featuring a back arrow and "申请详情" (Application Details) title on the left, and "在线客服" (Online Customer Service) text on the right. The central area below contains a yellow clock icon and the title "审核处理中" (Under Review), along with a descriptive line of text: "您的贷款申请已进入风险评估阶段，预计将在 24 小时内完成审核。" (Your loan application has entered the risk assessment phase and is expected to be completed within 24 hours.) The main body of the page is a rounded rectangular white card area, divided into detailed information sections like "申请金额" (Application Amount), "申请产品" (Application Product), "申请单号" (Application Number), "还款期限" (Repayment Period), and an "审核进度" (Review Progress) section. The detailed information is presented in two columns, with gray labels on the left and black values on the right, such as "申请金额 (元) ¥ 200,000.00" (Application Amount (Yuan) ¥ 200,000.00) and "申请产品 尊享·精英贷" (Application Product Zunxiang Elite Loan). The review progress section is displayed as a vertical timeline, including four stages: "提交申请" (Application Submitted), "风险评估中" (Risk Assessment in Progress), "最终审批" (Final Approval), and "放款成功" (Loan Disbursed Successfully). Among these, "提交申请" is completed, indicated by a blue checkmark icon and a date-time; "风险评估中" is in progress, indicated by a yellow exclamation mark icon and descriptive text; "最终审批" and "放款成功" are pending, indicated by gray dot icons. At the bottom of the page are two buttons: an upper "刷新审核状态" (Refresh Review Status) button with a golden-yellow background, and a lower "返回首页" (Return to Homepage) button with a white background. The very bottom displays gray "客服热线: 400-888-9999" (Customer Service Hotline: 400-888-9999) information.

THE ARCHITECTURE OF TANG
POETRY
TONAL MATRIX: VERSE
7.8
SONG DYNASTY EPIGRAPHIC
STYLE
01. THE BINARY PRINCIPLE
Classical Regulated Verse (Jintishi) is governed by the dialectic of Ping (Level) and Ze (Oblique) tones. Ping is perceived as sustained and high, while Ze is abrupt, rising, or falling. The structural beauty arises from the "Zhan" (sticking) and "Dui" (opposition) of these tonal sequences across lines, creating a mathematical symmetry known as the Tone Matrix.
03. RADIAL TONAL MAP / QILU MODEL
PING ZONE
ZE ZONE
04. FORMAL ANALYSIS
The Seven-Character Regulated Verse (Qi Lü) is the most complex form. It requires strict antithetical parallelism in the second (颔联) and third (颈联) couplets. This means nouns must match nouns, verbs must match verbs, and the tonal pattern of the third line must perfectly mirror the second to maintain harmony.
02. FUNDAMENTAL CONSTRAINTS
Line length: 5 or 7 characters.
Composition: 4 lines (Jueju) or 8 lines (Lüshi).
Rule: 1st, 3rd, 5th syllables are flexible; 2nd, 4th, 6th are strictly fixed.
Avoid: 'Lonely Level' (Gu Ping) – one Ping between two Ze.

prompt_cn: 这是一张排课管理系统的冲突检测报告界面截图。界面顶部显示标题“排课管理 - 冲突检测报告”和“检测到 3 处排程冲突”的提示，右侧是“忽略”和“立即调整”两个操作按钮。界面主体分为左右两个信息面板。左侧面板背景为白色，展示“拟排课程 (A)”的详细信息，包括课程名称、授课教师、教学场地和排课时间，其中场地和时间信息以红色突出显示，下方配有一张空教室的图片。右侧面板背景为深蓝色，展示“冲突课程 (B)”的详细信息，顶部有红色的关闭按钮和“已占用”状态，内容同样包括课程名称、授课教师、教学场地和排课时间，场地和时间信息也以红色突出。右侧面板还包含“冲突分析”部分，指出“场地 402 已占用。重叠 85 分钟。”界面底部是图例说明，红色圆点代表“场地冲突”，橙色圆点代表“时间重叠”，右侧显示“建议方案：更换至 501”和“信心指数：98%”。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a conflict detection report interface from a course scheduling management system. The top of the interface displays the title "排课管理 - 冲突检测报告" (Course Scheduling Management - Conflict Detection Report) and a notification "检测到 3 处排程冲突" (3 scheduling conflicts detected), with "忽略" (Ignore) and "立即调整" (Adjust Now) action buttons on the right. The main body of the interface is divided into two side-by-side information panels. The left panel, with a white background, shows detailed information for "拟排课程 (A)" (Proposed Course (A)), including course name, instructor, teaching venue, and scheduling time. The venue and time information are highlighted in red, and below is an image of an empty classroom. The right panel, with a dark blue background, displays detailed information for "冲突课程 (B)" (Conflicting Course (B)), featuring a red close button and an "已占用" (Occupied) status at the top. Its content also includes course name, instructor, teaching venue, and scheduling time, with venue and time information highlighted in red. The right panel also contains a "冲突分析" (Conflict Analysis) section, stating "场地 402 已占用。重叠 85 分钟。" (Venue 402 is occupied. Overlap 85 minutes.). The bottom of the interface provides a legend, where a red dot represents "场地冲突" (Venue Conflict) and an orange dot represents "时间重叠" (Time Overlap). On the right, it shows "建议方案：更换至 501" (Suggested Solution: Change to 501) and "信心指数：98%" (Confidence Index: 98%).

prompt_cn: 这是一张金融讲座的宣传海报，背景为深灰色，带有金色光斑和纹理装饰。画面右侧是一位身穿格子西装的男性讲师的半身像，他双手交叉，面带微笑。左侧是讲座的详细信息。顶部是金色大字标题“全数据趋势解读 探索新基金”，下方是白色小字副标题“带你了解更多投资方式”。中部有金色背景条，上面是讲师姓名“张小可”和“讲座内容”的标签。讲师介绍包括“可瓦大学金融学硕士”、“可瓦银行资深投资顾问”、“十余年投资经验”和“市场投资经验丰富”。讲座内容列表以黑色三角形项目符号呈现，包括“红利低波还要上车吗?”、“如何跟着政策做投资?”、“基金投资如何规划?”。海报底部左侧是“可瓦银行直播间 不见不散”和直播时间“9月27日 (周五) 20:00-21:30”，右侧是一个二维码，上方标有“扫码预约直播”，二维码中央有一个指纹图标。

On the right side is a half-body portrait of a male lecturer in a plaid suit, with his arms crossed and a smile. The left side provides detailed lecture information. The top displays the main title "全数据趋势解读 探索新基金" (All Data Trend Interpretation, Exploring New Funds) in large golden characters, followed by a smaller white subtitle "带你了解更多投资方式" (Guide you to learn more investment methods). In the middle, golden background strips highlight the lecturer's name "张小可" (Zhang Xiaoke) and the label "讲座内容" (Lecture Content). The lecturer's introduction lists his qualifications and experience, including "可瓦大学金融学硕士" (Master of Finance, Kewa University) and "可瓦银行资深投资顾问" (Senior Investment Advisor, Kewa Bank). The lecture content, presented with black triangular bullet points, covers questions such as "红利低波还要上车吗?" (Should we still get on board with high-dividend low-volatility stocks?), "如何跟着政策做投资?" (How to invest following policies?), and "基金投资如何规划?" (How to plan fund investments?). At the bottom left, "可瓦银行直播间 不见不散" (Kewa Bank Live Stream, See You There) and the live stream time "9月27日 (周五) 20:00-21:30" (September 27th (Friday) 20:00-21:30) are shown. On the bottom right, a QR code with "扫码预约直播" (Scan to book live stream) above it features a fingerprint icon in its center.

text:
全球五大洋表层洋流循环系统
洋流是地球系统中最重要的热量输送带。受行星风系、科里奥利力及陆地轮廓的共同影响，大洋表层形成规律性的环流系统。北半球副热带环流呈顺时针方向，南半球则呈逆时针方向，维系着全球气候的动态平衡，洋流不仅影响气候，还决定了海洋生物的分布。
北大西洋循环系统
北太平洋循环系统
01. 湾流 (Gulf Stream) 是全球最强劲的暖流，流量超过 1 亿 m³/s。它从墨西哥湾流出跨越洋盆，将热带热量带往西欧，维持其温和气候。加那利寒流则沿非洲西岸南下，为沿海带来降温减湿影响。
02. 黑潮 (Kuroshio) 又称日本暖流，水质清澈深蓝。它与北太平洋暖流相接，最终形成加利福尼亚寒流。此循环系统对东亚季风气候及北美西海岸降水具有决定性作用，也是重要的洄游鱼类通道。

03. 秘鲁寒流 (Peru Current) 源自高纬，导致了阿塔卡马沙漠的形成。其深层涌升流带出海底营养盐，支持了全球最高的产秘鲁渔场。它是南半球副热带环流向北的冰冷支柱。
04. 南极绕极流 (ACC) 是地球上唯一一无陆地阻挡、环绕全球的洋流。它连通三大洋，流量达 1.5 亿 m³/s。它是全球深层海水循环的枢纽，也是阻止低纬热量侵蚀南极冰盖的屏障。

At the top, a red main title is followed by a black introductory paragraph, outlining the formation and impact of ocean currents. The central part of the image features a simplified world map, visually representing the paths and types of major global ocean currents with red curves for warm currents and blue curves for cold currents, and a red dashed line indicating the Equator. Surrounding the map are four columnar text descriptions, detailing the North Atlantic Circulation System, North Pacific Circulation System, Southern Hemisphere Cold Currents and Fisheries, and the Antarctic Circumpolar Current. The bottom of the image includes a table with a red title, "Data Archive: Key Ocean Current Flow Comparison (SVERDRUPS)", listing data such as current names, sea areas, average flow rates, and climate impacts. A legend clearly explains the symbols for warm currents, cold currents, and the Equator. The very bottom of the image provides ocean current speed reference values and publication information.

Lunar Landing Mission Profile / 1969
384,400
Kilometers to the Moon
The first crewed mission to land on the Moon. Launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, via the Saturn V rocket. The mission goal: perform a crewed lunar landing and return safely to Earth.

Trans-Lunar Injection
S-IVB stage re-ignition sends Apollo toward the Moon.
LOI T+75:49
Lunar Orbit Insertion
Service Module engine fires to establish lunar orbit.
Splashdown
July 24, 16:50 UTC
Command Module hits Pacific Ocean at 11 km/s.
The Eagle's descent engine fired for 12 minutes and 30 seconds to slow the craft from 1,695 m/s to 0.5 m/s. The descent was largely automated, but Neil Armstrong took manual control to avoid a boulder field and landed with only 30 seconds of fuel remaining.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于阿波罗11号登月任务的信息图表。图表以黑色为背景，搭配黄色和白色文字及图形，整体布局清晰。顶部是任务标题“APOLLO 11”和副标题“Lunar Landing Mission Profile / 1969”。下方左右两侧分别展示了任务的关键数据：左侧是“384,400 Kilometers to the Moon”及任务描述，右侧是“08 Days Duration”和详细的总任务时间。中间部分是任务时间线，列出了发射、月球转移轨道注入、月球轨道插入和溅落四个阶段的日期、时间和简要说明。时间线左侧有一段垂直文本，详细描述了“鹰”号登月舱的下降过程。右侧是一个名为“LUNAR DESCENT LOGISTICS”的表格，记录了下降阶段的事件、高度、速度和状态。表格下方有一行红色警告文字。底部区域包含三个信息块：左侧是“2.5 Hours EVA”及舱外活动描述，中间是一个黄色面板，显示“LM EAGLE”标题、登月舱示意图和“LUNAR MODULE SCHEMATIC”副标题，右侧是垂直排列的着陆点坐标“SEA OF TRANQUILITY / 0.67° N 23.47° E”。最下方列出了“THE CREW”（船员）和“VESSELS”（飞船）信息。页脚是“PLATE NO. 11: LUNAR EXPLORATION DATA / TRANS-LUNAR TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the Apollo 11 lunar landing mission. The chart features a black background with yellow and white text and graphics, presenting a clear overall layout. At the top, the mission title "APOLLO 11" and subtitle "Lunar Landing Mission Profile / 1969" are displayed. Below, two main data blocks present key mission statistics: the left block shows "384,400 Kilometers to the Moon" with a mission description, while the right block details "08 Days Duration" and the total mission time. The central section includes a mission timeline, outlining four key phases—Launch, Trans-Lunar Injection, Lunar Orbit Insertion, and Splashdown—each with dates, times, and brief descriptions. To the left of the timeline, a vertical text block provides details on the Eagle lunar module's descent process. To the right, a table titled "LUNAR DESCENT LOGISTICS" records event phases, altitude, velocity, and status during descent. A red warning message appears below the table. The bottom section contains three information panels: the left panel describes "2.5 Hours EVA" and surface activities, the middle yellow panel features the title "LM EAGLE," a schematic icon of the lunar module, and the subtitle "LUNAR MODULE SCHEMATIC," and the right panel displays the vertical landing site coordinates "SEA OF TRANQUILITY / 0.67° N 23.47° E." At the very bottom, lists for "THE CREW" and "VESSELS" are provided. The footer reads "PLATE NO. 11: LUNAR EXPLORATION DATA / TRANS-LUNAR TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS."

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内拍摄的照片，画面中一名年轻女性站在前景，其身后左侧是一个大型白色宣传横幅，右侧是一个黑色边框的数字屏幕。横幅顶部印有“follow us:”字样和Facebook、Twitter、YouTube的社交媒体图标，以及一个红色字母C内含黄色小鸟的标志。标志右侧是“CHUNG WAH”、“COMMUNITY”、“CARE”等文字，下方小字写着“Chung Wah Association Inc”和“Est. 1909”。横幅中央印有四位老年人面带笑容、手持智能手机的合影。横幅底部有橙色、绿色和粉色的抽象色块，并以红色手写体写着“a better community”。数字屏幕上显示着与横幅相同的标志和部分文字，包括“CHUNG WAH”和部分“COMMUNITY”。前景的女性穿着深蓝色V领毛衣和浅蓝色衬衫，毛衣左胸处有一个小标志。图片左下角有版权信息“COPYRIGHT © 2023 — CHUNG WAH COMMUNITY CARE”。
prompt_en: This is an indoor photograph showing a young woman standing in the foreground, with a large white promotional banner to her left and a black-framed digital screen to her right. The top of the banner features "follow us:" text along with social media icons for Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube, and a logo depicting a red letter C with a yellow bird inside. To the right of the logo are the words "CHUNG WAH", "COMMUNITY", and "CARE", with smaller text below reading "Chung Wah Association Inc" and "Est. 1909". The center of the banner displays a group photo of four smiling elderly people holding smartphones. The bottom of the banner has abstract orange, green, and pink color blocks, with "a better community" written in red, handwritten style. The digital screen shows the same logo as the banner and partial text, including "CHUNG WAH" and part of "COMMUNITY". The woman in the foreground is wearing a dark blue V-neck sweater over a light blue shirt, with a small logo on the left chest of her sweater. The bottom left of the image contains the copyright information "COPYRIGHT © 2023 — CHUNG WAH COMMUNITY CARE".
