text:
PLATE 078 / VIROLOGY
巴尔的摩病毒分类系统
BALTIMORE SYSTEM OF VIRUS CLASSIFICATION
依据病毒基因组与mRNA合成路径的互作关系，诺贝尔奖得主巴尔的摩于1971年提出此分类模型，将所有病毒归入七个病毒性大类。
01 / 合成拓扑图 CENTRAL SYNTHESIS PATHWAY
说明 / PATHWAY LOGIC
I: dsDNA
III: dsRNA
核心机制: 不论基因组的物理形态如何，所有病毒都必须将基因信息转录为单链正义核糖核酸分子 (mRNA (+))，以利用宿主核糖体进行蛋白质合成。
mRNA (+)
II: ssDNA
IV: (+)ssRNA
第IV类群 (单链正义 RNA) 具备天然结构优势：其基因组可直接作为 mRNA 发挥翻译功能，无需在生命周期早期合成新的互补链。
V: (-)ssRNA
VII: dsDNA-RT
VI: ssRNA-RT
02 / 七大病毒纲 REPLICATION STEPS
01
双链DNA病毒 (dsDNA)
02
单链DNA病毒 (ssDNA)
直接进入细胞核，利用宿主RNA聚合酶II直接进行基因转录 (如腺病毒)。
须在宿主细胞内补充为双链中间体，随后进行常规转录 (如细小病毒)。
03
双链RNA病毒 (dsRNA)
04
单链正义RNA病毒 ((+)ssRNA)
基因组转录依赖于病毒体自带的依赖RNA的RNA聚合酶进行 (如轮状病毒)。
病毒基因组直接等同于mRNA，宿主核糖体识别后立即启动翻译 (如冠状病毒)。
05
单链反义RNA病毒 ((-)ssRNA)
06
单链反义RNA逆转录病毒 (ssRNA-RT)
必须携带自身聚合酶，转录出互补的正链RNA作为mRNA (如流感病毒)。
通过逆转录酶生成双链DNA并整合到宿主染色体中进行转录 (如艾滋病毒)。
07
双链DNA逆转录病毒 (dsDNA-RT)
以RNA为模板发生逆转录生成DNA基因组，机制独特 (如乙肝病毒)。
03 / 病毒体尺寸分布 VIRION SCALE COMPARISON
20nm
120nm
300nm
400nm
细小病毒
冠状病毒
腺病毒
巨病毒
04 / 核心特征对照 REFERENCE MATRIX
分类 (GROUP)
基因组特性 (GENOME)
转录起始机制 (TRANSCRIPTION INITIATION)
典型示范科 (EXEMPLAR FAMILY)
Group I
双链 DNA (dsDNA)
利用宿主 RNA 聚合酶直接合成
腺病毒科 Adenoviridae
Group II
单链 DNA (ssDNA)
先合成互补链为双链，再行转录
细小病毒科 Parvoviridae
Group III
双链 RNA (dsRNA)
依靠自身携带的 RNA 依赖聚合酶
呼肠孤病毒科 Reoviridae
Group IV
单链正义 RNA ((+)ssRNA)
基因组直接承担翻译功能
冠状病毒科 Coronaviridae
Group V
单链反义 RNA ((-)ssRNA)
借助自身的 RNA 聚合酶合成正链
正粘病毒科 Orthomyxoviridae
Group VI
单链 RNA 逆转录 (ssRNA-RT)
逆转录酶至宿主基因组后再行转录
逆转录病毒科 Retroviridae
Group VII
双链 DNA 逆转录 (dsDNA-RT)
生成 RNA 中间体，复制时再行逆转录
肝DNA病毒科 Hepadnaviridae

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于巴尔的摩病毒分类系统的科学信息图表。图表以白色为背景，大部分文字为黑色，部分关键信息和图表元素以橙色高亮显示。页面顶部是标题“巴尔的摩病毒分类系统”及其英文副标题，右侧配有一段关于该分类模型提出的背景介绍。中部区域左侧展示了一个病毒合成拓扑图，以“mRNA (+)”为中心，连接了七种不同类型的病毒基因组（I: dsDNA, II: ssDNA, III: dsRNA, IV: (+)ssRNA, V: (-)ssRNA, VI: ssRNA-RT, VII: dsDNA-RT）。右侧是“说明 / PATHWAY LOGIC”部分，详细阐述了核心机制和第IV类群的特点。下方是“七大病毒纲”的复制步骤列表，以橙色编号01至07，左右两栏交错排列，分别描述了七类病毒的复制方式及示例。再下方是“病毒体尺寸分布”示意图，通过刻度线和橙色高亮的“120nm”及“冠状病毒”等标签，比较了细小病毒、冠状病毒、腺病毒和巨病毒的尺寸。页面底部是一个“核心特征对照”表格，包含“分类”、“基因组特性”、“转录起始机制”和“典型示范科”四列，详细列出了七大病毒纲的特征。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the Baltimore system of virus classification. The chart features a white background with most text in black, while some key information and diagram elements are highlighted in orange. At the top of the page is the main title "巴尔的摩病毒分类系统" (Baltimore Virus Classification System) with its English subtitle, accompanied by an introductory paragraph on the right explaining the background of this classification model. The central area on the left displays a central synthesis pathway diagram, centered around "mRNA (+)", connecting seven different types of viral genomes (I: dsDNA, II: ssDNA, III: dsRNA, IV: (+)ssRNA, V: (-)ssRNA, VI: ssRNA-RT, VII: dsDNA-RT). On the right is the "说明 / PATHWAY LOGIC" section, detailing the core mechanism and characteristics of Group IV. Below this is a list of "七大病毒纲 REPLICATION STEPS" (Seven Major Virus Classes Replication Steps), numbered 01 to 07 in orange, arranged in two alternating columns, describing the replication methods and examples for each of the seven virus classes. Further down is a "病毒体尺寸分布 VIRION SCALE COMPARISON" diagram, using scale lines and orange-highlighted labels like "120nm" and "冠状病毒" (Coronavirus) to compare the sizes of parvoviruses, coronaviruses, adenoviruses, and giant viruses. The bottom of the page features a "核心特征对照 REFERENCE MATRIX" table, with four columns: "分类 (GROUP)", "基因组特性 (GENOME)", "转录起始机制 (TRANSCRIPTION INITIATION)", and "典型示范科 (EXEMPLAR FAMILY)", detailing the characteristics of the seven major virus classes.

The model on the right is dressed in a structured blue-gray gradient blazer and dark trousers. Blurred audience members are visible on both sides of the runway. White text "MISU" appears at the top right of the image, and large, semi-transparent white text "MISUIT" is in the lower-central foreground. prompt_cn: 这是一张电影宣传海报，画面主体是五位女性，包括一位年轻女孩和四位成年女性，她们站在或坐在一个白色木质栏杆的门廊上。左侧是红色的房屋墙壁，右侧和背景是绿色的树木与蓝天。画面中央，年轻女孩坐在栏杆上，身穿条纹上衣和棕色短裤，面带微笑。她身后是四位成年女性，其中一位身穿蓝色条纹连衣裙，另两位身穿黄色印花和蓝色上衣。海报顶部是电影的标题“La Vida Secreta de las Abejas”（蜜蜂的秘密生活），标题为黄色手写体，末尾带有一只蜜蜂图案。标题上方是主要演员的名字，如“QUEEN LATIFAH”、“DAKOTA FANNING”等，下方是电影标语“TU HOGAR ES ALLÍ DONDE ERES TU MISMO.”（你的家就是你做自己的地方），以及详细的演职员表和“Basada en la exitosa novela”（改编自畅销小说）的说明文字。
prompt_en: This is a movie promotional poster featuring five females, including a young girl and four adult women, standing or sitting on a white wooden porch railing. To the left is a red house wall, and to the right and in the background are green trees and a blue sky. In the center of the image, a young girl sits on the railing, wearing a striped top and brown shorts, smiling. Behind her are four adult women, one in a blue striped dress, and two others in a yellow floral print and a blue top. At the top of the poster is the movie title "La Vida Secreta de las Abejas" (The Secret Life of Bees), rendered in yellow script with a bee motif at the end. Above the title are the names of the main cast, such as "QUEEN LATIFAH" and "DAKOTA FANNING". Below the title is the movie tagline "TU HOGAR ES ALLÍ DONDE ERES TU MISMO." (Your home is where you are yourself), followed by detailed production credits and the text "Basada en la exitosa novela" (Based on the successful novel).

text:
PLATE XIV — DISPLAY METROLOGY
THE GEOMETRY OF THE LUMINOUS SCREEN
An Architectural Survey of Aspect Ratios and Spatial Resolutions from the Legacy CRT to Modern Ultra-Wide Canvases
For decades, the progression of display screens has followed a geometric evolution. Just as medieval master builders moved from the compact, grounded proportions of Romanesque naves to the soaring elevations of Gothic choirs, display standards have transitioned from early square-like monitors to expansive panoramic canvases.
This layout maps screen coordinates onto a classic cruciform layout. The transepts house the legacy 4:3 configurations, the nave traces the rise of widescreen standards, and the high altar represents the extreme pixel density of contemporary high-resolution systems.
FIGURE 1. THE CRUCIFORM LAYOUT OF DIGITAL ASPECT RATIOS
KEY ARCHITECTURAL ZONES
[ 1 ] The Crypt (VGA): The foundational baseline of color desktop computing, defining the legacy 4:3 aspect ratio.
[ 2 ] The Transept (XGA): The dominant expansion standard of the early LCD era, grounding productivity platforms.
[ 3 ] The Nave Crossing (FHD): The 16:9 widescreen layout that united consumer media and broadcast television.
[ 4 ] The Choir (UHD 4K): Four times the resolution of Full HD, allowing high fidelity across expansive physical surfaces.
[ 5 ] The High Altar (8K): The threshold of human visual acuity, rendering individual pixel grids imperceptible.
[ 6 ] The Ambulatory (UWQHD): An ultra-wide 21:9 wing wrapping the peripheral vision field of the observer.

The image features a light beige background with dark gray text, complemented by red numerical labels. The page layout is divided into a top title area and two content columns below. The left content column begins with an introductory text discussing the geometric evolution of display screens. This is followed by a "KEY ARCHITECTURAL ZONES" list, which metaphorically compares the evolution of display aspect ratios and resolutions to different areas of church architecture, marked with numbers 1-6. Next is a "GLOSSARY OF METRICS" defining terms like "Aspect Ratio", "Megapixel", and "Refresh Rate". At the bottom is a "CHRONOLOGICAL SPECIFICATIONS TABLE" that details the format, aspect ratio, pixel resolution, megapixels, and standard refresh rates for various display standards (e.g., VGA, XGA, FHD, UHD 4K, 8K UHD). The right content column contains two diagrams. Figure 1, titled "THE CRUCIFORM LAYOUT OF DIGITAL ASPECT RATIOS", is a cruciform layout diagram that illustrates different display aspect ratio zones in the form of a church floor plan, marked with red numbers 1-6 and text labels (e.g., NAVE (16:9), TRANSEPT L (4:3)). Figure 2, titled "NESTED DISPLAY DIMENSIONS AND SCALE COMPARISON", is a nested rectangle diagram showing a scale comparison of display dimensions from VGA to 8K UHD, with text labels (e.g., 8K UHD (7680x4320)) indicating resolutions.

prompt_en: This infographic presents the International Cloud Classification system. The image features a dark gray background, with content divided into multiple sections by yellow and blue banners and white borders. The top left displays the main title "INTERNATIONAL CLOUD CLASSIFICATION," prominently featuring the number "10" below it, accompanied by an English description explaining how the World Meteorological Organization standardized the Luke Howard system into 3 altitude levels and 10 primary genera. The right side of the image is vertically divided into three sections: "HIGH CLOUDS," "MID CLOUDS," and "LOW CLOUDS," each with a blue banner title and white text listing cloud types, altitude ranges, and composition. The central part of the image includes a chart titled "ALTITUDE SPECTRUM (M)," set against a white grid, illustrating the altitude ranges of various cloud types such as CIRRUS, STRATUS, ALTOSTRATUS, and CUMULONIMBUS. The bottom left features the "CORE CLOUD DATA" section, which contains a table listing cloud genera, IDs, and base altitudes. Below the table is a line of text about "TOTAL WATER CONTENT." To the right of the table is the "VERTICAL GENERA" section, providing detailed descriptions of two vertically developing cloud types. The bottom right corner shows a "PRECIPITATION KEY" legend, using a blue square for "RAIN / SNOW" and a green square for "HAIL / THUNDER," with this area also filled with a red polka dot pattern.

To the left, another boat with a white and dark hull is docked, with its brand name "AZIMUT" visible on its side. The center of the image features the yacht's stern entrance, connected by large glass sliding doors to the exterior deck and interior salon. The interior space has light wood flooring, with off-white sofas and beige curtains. On the left deck, there are steps leading to the upper level, and a red warning label reading "WARNING / HIGH PRESSURE WATER" is visible below. 梁桥是桥梁基础的结构形式，依靠梁的抗弯能力支撑载荷。顶梁受压，底梁受拉。预应力技术显著提升了跨度上限。
02 拱式压力转换
拱桥通过几何形态将桥面重力转换为向下的压力与向侧外的水平推力，极大地利用了混凝土的抗压特性。

The top of the notebook features a title section, including the English subtitle "PREPARATION FOR EMPLOYMENT" and the Chinese main title "入职准备" (Onboarding Preparation), with a slogan "教你如何优雅入职场" (Teach you how to elegantly enter the workplace) in a yellow oval background below. The left side of the notebook lists four items for onboarding preparation, each preceded by a yellow lightbulb icon. These items include "学历/学位证书复印件;" (Photocopy of diploma/degree certificate;), "身份证原件、复印件;" (Original and photocopy of ID card;), "其他要提前准备好的表格;" (Other forms to prepare in advance;), and "手机充电线、水杯、靠垫/抱枕、午睡毯、纸巾等" (Phone charging cable, water cup, cushion/pillow, nap blanket, tissues, etc.). On the right side of the image is a cartoon character wearing a yellow top and pink pants, holding a phone to their ear and several books. To the right of the character is a vertical yellow strip with the white text "WELCOME JOIN US" repeatedly arranged. The bottom left features an orange megaphone icon and a white computer window icon. In the bottom right, there is a yellow star-shaped "建议收藏" (Suggest to collect/save) button with a red exclamation mark next to it.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于海洋垂直分层系统的科学信息图表。图表以深色背景为主，搭配白色文字和红色强调元素，整体布局分为三列。左侧列顶部是“阶层坐标”数据，下方是“压力递增矩阵”标题及相关文字说明，并配有一张展示水压随深度变化的折线图，横轴为深度（0M至11000M），纵轴为压力（ATM）。中间列是“深渊祭位图解”，以垂直示意图形式展示了海洋从“SURFACE”到“超深渊层(>6000M)”的五个主要分层，包括透光层、弱光层、无光层和深渊层，并标注了各自的深度范围。中间列底部还有一段关于海洋生物量和生命形态的文字描述。右侧列顶部是“垂直生态参数”表格，列出了不同海洋区域的温度和压力范围。下方是“特征生物名录”，列举了五个编号对应的生物种类。图表右上角显示了地理坐标和深度信息（LAT: 48.8767° S, LONG: 123.3933° W, DEPTH: 10,984 M）。底部页脚包含“海洋学法典”、“UNVEIL THE ABYSS // 16:16:16”以及“禁忌知识归档: 2024-0X-09”等信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic illustrating the ocean's vertical stratification system. The chart features a dark background with white text and red accent elements, laid out in three columns. The left column contains "阶层坐标" (Stratum Coordinates) data at the top, followed by a section titled "压力递增矩阵" (Pressure Increase Matrix) with explanatory text and a line graph showing water pressure change with depth, from 0M to 11000M on the x-axis and Pressure (ATM) on the y-axis. The middle column presents an "深渊祭位图解" (Abyssal Schematic), a vertical diagram illustrating five main ocean layers from "SURFACE" down to the Hadal Zone (>6000M), including the Euphotic, Disphotic, Aphotic, and Abyssal Zones, each with its depth range. The bottom of the middle column also includes a text description about ocean biomass and life forms. The right column features a "垂直生态参数" (Vertical Ecological Parameters) table at the top, listing temperature and pressure ranges for different ocean regions. Below it is a "特征生物名录" (List of Characteristic Organisms), enumerating five numbered biological species. The top right corner of the chart displays geographical coordinates and depth information (LAT: 48.8767° S, LONG: 123.3933° W, DEPTH: 10,984 M). The footer at the bottom includes "海洋学法典" (Oceanography Codex), "UNVEIL THE ABYSS // 16:16:16", and "禁忌知识归档: 2024-0X-09".

prompt_en: This is a movie poster, predominantly in blue and white tones, featuring a background with snowflake or ice crystal-like textures, and a faint silhouette of a city skyline at the bottom. At the top center of the image is the prominent red artistic text "爱回家" (Love Home), while the top right features the white English title "HOME, SWEET HOME," arranged in three lines. Below and slightly to the left of the Chinese title, the date "12月24日" (December 24th) and the slogan "平安夜 让爱回家" (Christmas Eve, Let Love Come Home) are displayed. In the lower-middle part of the image, three dark silhouette figures (two adults, one child) stand on a reflective surface, with a suitcase beside them, seemingly on their way home. The bottom of the poster contains detailed cast and crew credits, including prominent information on the left for "监制:古天乐" (Supervisor: Louis Koo), "领衔主演: 黄小蕾" (Starring: Huang Xiaolei), "范安宜" (Fan Anyi), and on the right for "导演:沈江平" (Director: Leon Shen), "刘若谷" (Liu Ruogu), along with a multi-line list of smaller text credits at the very bottom. The entire poster, through the combination of text and silhouette figures, creates a warm atmosphere of returning home for winter holidays and family reunion.

prompt_cn: 这是一个深色背景的软件监控界面，展示了云原生运维的健康检查状态。界面顶部是标题栏，左侧显示“CLOUD-NATIVE OPS // HEALTH CHECK”字样和一个浅蓝色方块图标，右侧显示“集群状态: 运行中”和“节点: K8S-PROD-01”。界面底部是页脚栏，包含“TERMINAL V4.0.2”、“SECURE PROTOCOL”、“NEURAL MESH”以及当前日期时间“2024-05-20 14:21:44”。主体内容区域分为三列。左侧列显示“存活探针 (Liveness)”和“就绪探针 (Readiness)”的详细配置，包括路径、阈值、端口和延迟等参数，文字为白色和浅绿色。中间列是“服务拓扑动态监测 LIVE”，以方框形式展示了四个服务模块：API-GTW (PASS 100%)、AUTH-SVC (PASS 99.8%)、CORE-ENGINE 和 NODE-01 (HEALTHY)。CORE-ENGINE 模块下方有四个小方块，其中三个为绿色，一个为灰色，作为状态指示。右侧列包含“实时自愈日志”和“可用性 SLA”，日志显示时间戳和事件信息，可用性 SLA 以大号浅蓝色字体显示“99.998%”，下方有浅蓝色进度条，并标注“活跃: 12”和“异常: 0”。整个界面以深蓝色为主色调，带有网格状纹理，文字多为白色、浅蓝色和浅绿色。
prompt_en: This is a software monitoring interface with a dark background, displaying the health check status of cloud-native operations. The top of the interface is a title bar, with "CLOUD-NATIVE OPS // HEALTH CHECK" and a light blue square icon on the left, and "集群状态: 运行中" (Cluster Status: Running) and "节点: K8S-PROD-01" (Node: K8S-PROD-01) on the right. The bottom of the interface is a footer bar, including "TERMINAL V4.0.2", "SECURE PROTOCOL", "NEURAL MESH", and the current date and time "2024-05-20 14:21:44". The main content area is divided into three columns. The left column displays detailed configurations for "存活探针 (Liveness)" (Liveness Probe) and "就绪探针 (Readiness)" (Readiness Probe), including parameters like path, threshold, port, and delay, with text in white and light green. The middle column is "服务拓扑动态监测 LIVE" (Service Topology Dynamic Monitoring LIVE), presenting four service modules in boxes: API-GTW (PASS 100%), AUTH-SVC (PASS 99.8%), CORE-ENGINE, and NODE-01 (HEALTHY). Below the CORE-ENGINE module are four small squares, three green and one gray, serving as status indicators. The right column contains "实时自愈日志" (Real-time Self-healing Logs) and "可用性 SLA" (Availability SLA). The logs show timestamps and event information, and the Availability SLA is displayed in large light blue font as "99.998%", with a light blue progress bar below it, labeled "活跃: 12" (Active: 12) and "异常: 0" (Abnormal: 0). The entire interface is predominantly dark blue with a grid-like texture, and most text is white, light blue, and light green.

To the left of the podium is a vertical white promotional banner, featuring the "RIDW" logo and "HKIAC" logo at the top, followed by "RIDW24 HONG KONG AND RIYADH", and below that, images of iconic buildings from Hong Kong and Riyadh. Behind the speaker is a large projection screen, which also displays the "RIDW" logo and its full name in Arabic and English on the top left, and the text "Legal Tech" on the right. The front of the podium also bears the "RIDW" logo and the event's full name.

prompt_cn: 这是一张3D渲染插画，描绘了一群儿童在博物馆内参观的场景。画面左侧墙壁上有一个大型互动屏幕，三名儿童正在观看，屏幕下方有展示台。屏幕左侧墙壁上挂有两幅黑白照片，下方分别标注“history”和“RB”。画面中央偏右是一个石质雕塑，底座上刻有“和平纪念馆”字样，周围环绕着盛开的鲜花。右侧背景是一个木质门框，上方悬挂着写有“和平纪念馆”和“PEACE MUSEUM”的招牌，指示着一个入口。其他儿童或手持相机，或拿着笔记本，在馆内各处参观。互动屏幕上展示着一个带有卡通人物和图标的时间轴。整体色调温暖，以棕色、米色、橙色和黄色为主，辅以蓝色、绿色和粉色的衣物及花朵点缀。
prompt_en: This is a 3D rendered illustration depicting a group of children visiting a museum. On the left wall, there is a large interactive screen being viewed by three children, with a display stand below it. To the left of the screen, two framed black and white photos are hung on the wall, labeled "history" and "RB" respectively. In the center-right of the image, there is a stone sculpture with "和平纪念馆" (Peace Memorial Hall) inscribed on its base, surrounded by blooming flowers. In the background on the right, a wooden door frame has a sign above it, displaying "和平纪念馆" and "PEACE MUSEUM", indicating an entrance. Other children are seen holding cameras or notebooks, exploring various parts of the museum. The interactive screen shows a timeline with cartoon characters and icons. The overall color scheme is warm, predominantly brown, beige, orange, and yellow, complemented by blue, green, and pink in clothing and flowers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以课程表为主题的幻灯片或海报。图片背景为浅蓝色，点缀着白色圆点。左上角有绿色的“Canva”品牌标识，旁边是一个带有字母“J”的圆形图标。标题“暑假特训营课程表”位于顶部中央，采用蓝色粗体字。标题左下方有一个黄色的星形标签，上面用红色粗体字写着“初中年级”和“全科辅导”。图片主体是一个带有橙色边框的圆角矩形表格，表格表头背景为黄色，包含“上课时间”和从“周一”到“周日”的日期。表格内容区域为白色，其中课程行背景交替为浅灰色。表格列出了五个时间段，从9:30-10:30到15:20-16:20，每天的课程安排相同，依次为初中数学、初中语文、初中英语、初中物理和初中生物。图片右侧有一个卡通风格的棕发女孩形象，穿着蓝色背带裤和白色上衣，举起一只手。左下角有一个蓝色的笔筒，里面插着彩色铅笔和一把尺子。右下角有一个黄色弯曲的装饰元素。

In the top-left corner, there is a green "Canva" brand logo next to a circular icon featuring the letter "J". The title "暑假特训营课程表" (Summer Intensive Training Camp Course Schedule) is centrally located at the top, rendered in bold blue text. Below and to the left of the title, a yellow star-shaped label contains the red bold text "初中年级" (Junior High School Grade) and "全科辅导" (All Subjects Tutoring). The main body of the image is a rounded rectangular table with an orange border. The table header has a yellow background and includes "上课时间" (Class Time) and days from "周一" (Monday) to "周日" (Sunday). The content area of the table is white, with alternating light gray backgrounds for the course rows. The table lists five time slots, from 9:30-10:30 to 15:20-16:20. The daily course arrangement is identical, featuring Junior High School Mathematics, Chinese, English, Physics, and Biology in sequence. On the right side of the image, there is a cartoon-style brown-haired girl wearing blue overalls and a white top, raising one hand. In the bottom-left corner, a blue pen holder contains colorful pencils and a ruler. A yellow curved decorative element is present in the bottom-right corner.

垂直悬挂于墙面，适合表现高山流水之阔大。利用木质天地杆产生的重力使画心自然垂平。其比例通常极度修长，强调视觉纵深感。

将多幅小尺寸作品汇集成册。幅锦装，经折装为常见形式。每页约30cm见方，便于在案头近距离把玩欣赏。
分为折扇 (Folding Fan) 与团扇 (Round Fan)。扇面是附着于书画布局，提出极高的几何适应要求。
MATERIALS & TOOLING
书画装裱不仅是保护，更是审美的延伸。核心材料包括:
宣纸 (Xuan Paper) / 绫绢 (Silk) / 浆糊 (Starch Paste) / 红木轴头 (Hardwood Knobs)

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于中国传统书画装裱形制的信息图表。图表以深色背景为主，搭配白色、红色和黄色文字及图形元素。顶部是红色大字标题“中国传统书画 装裱形制”及其英文副标题“TRADITIONAL CHINESE MOUNTING FORMATS”。主体内容分为四个编号区域，分别介绍“01 立轴 / HANGING SCROLL”、“02 手卷 / HANDSCROLL”、“03 册页 / ALBUM LEAF”和“04 扇面 / FAN ART”四种装裱形式。每个区域都包含标题、文字描述和示意图，如立轴的结构图解和手卷的“10M+”最大长度标识。图表中部设有一个“规格对比 / FORMAT MATRIX”表格，详细对比了不同形制的纵横比、空间需求、观赏距离和交互方式。底部左侧是“MATERIALS & TOOLING”部分，列出了装裱所需的核心材料，右侧则以“100% CULTURAL HERITAGE”强调其文化遗产价值。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing traditional Chinese painting and calligraphy mounting formats. The chart features a dark background with white, red, and yellow text and graphic elements. At the top, the main title "中国传统书画 装裱形制" is displayed in large red characters, followed by its English subtitle "TRADITIONAL CHINESE MOUNTING FORMATS". The main content is divided into four numbered sections, introducing four mounting styles: "01 立轴 / HANGING SCROLL", "02 手卷 / HANDSCROLL", "03 册页 / ALBUM LEAF", and "04 扇面 / FAN ART". Each section includes a title, textual description, and illustrative diagrams, such as the anatomical diagram for hanging scrolls and the "10M+" maximum length indicator for handscrolls. A "规格对比 / FORMAT MATRIX" table in the middle of the chart provides a detailed comparison of different formats based on aspect ratio, space requirements, viewing distance, and interaction methods. The bottom left section, "MATERIALS & TOOLING", lists the core materials needed for mounting, while the right side highlights its cultural heritage value with "100% CULTURAL HERITAGE".

prompt_cn: 这是一张动漫电影宣传海报，以深蓝色调的宇宙星空为背景。海报中央是大型的黄色发光主标题“Gundam Gのレコンギスタ III”，下方是副标题“Reconguista in G”。海报左侧边缘有白色竖排文字“その色合い宇宙を染め、”。画面主体由多个人物角色和机动战士构成，中央偏右是一位穿着红色上衣、长发飘逸的女性角色，中央偏左是一位穿着黄色夹克的男性角色，两人目光望向右侧。右侧有一个大型的蓝色和红色相间的机动战士。海报中央偏下是黄色发光的副标题“宇宙からの遺産”。海报底部是密集的白色制作人员和配音演员名单。右下角显示白色日期“2021年 7.22”，旁边有竖排文字“祝 上り”。整体文字信息叠加在插画背景之上，标题部分与背景融合，呈现出独特的光影效果。
prompt_en: This is an anime movie promotional poster set against a dark blue cosmic starry sky. At the center of the poster is the large, glowing yellow main title "Gundam Gのレコンギスタ III", with the subtitle "Reconguista in G" below it. Along the left edge of the poster is white vertical text "その色合い宇宙を染め、". The main subjects of the image consist of multiple human characters and mobile suits. In the upper-right, there is a large blue and red mobile suit. A female character with long flowing hair and a red top is positioned slightly right of center, while a male character in a yellow jacket is slightly left of center, both looking towards the right. Below the center is the glowing yellow subtitle "宇宙からの遺産". The bottom of the poster features dense white text listing production staff and voice actors. The bottom right corner displays the white date "2021年 7.22" with vertical text "祝 上り" next to it. The textual information is overlaid on the illustrated background, with the title elements blending into the background and exhibiting a distinct glowing effect.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于喀斯特地质中次生化学沉淀的科学信息图。图片以深蓝色为背景，顶部有“ATLAS GEOLOGICAL SERIES VOL. 350 / 喀斯特地质图谱”的标题，以及红色大字“次生化学沉淀 SECONDARY PRECIPITATION”作为主标题，下方是“8 种钟乳石形态发育图 / SPELEOTHEM MORPHOLOGY”的副标题。图表中部通过一个红色的“VS”将“重力流沉积 GRAVITY DEPOSITION”和“非重力沉积 NON-GRAVITY”两种类型进行对比。下方是一个名为“TALE OF THE TAPE / 数据对比”的表格，比较了两种沉积类型的主要动力、生长速度、化学成分和矿物密度。表格下方左右两侧分别展示了“岩溶发育剖面图 / GEOLOGICAL CROSS-SECTION”和“沉积速率分析 / GROWTH RATE ANALYSIS”。剖面图描绘了筒管、钟乳石、石笋、卷曲石和石柱等多种钟乳石形态及其相对位置。沉积速率分析图则以条形图形式列出了筒管、石笋、流石、卷曲石和穴珠的年度生长长度。图片底部是一个详细的表格，分四列介绍了六种钟乳石形态的名称、发育机制、形态特征和典型规模。页脚提供了样本数量、地点、日期和记录等信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about secondary chemical precipitation in karst geology. The image features a dark blue background with a title at the top, "ATLAS GEOLOGICAL SERIES VOL. 350 / 喀斯特地质图谱", followed by the main title "次生化学沉淀 SECONDARY PRECIPITATION" in large red and white text, and a subtitle "8 种钟乳石形态发育图 / SPELEOTHEM MORPHOLOGY". The middle section contrasts "重力流沉积 GRAVITY DEPOSITION" and "非重力沉积 NON-GRAVITY" with a prominent red "VS" in between. Below this, a table titled "TALE OF THE TAPE / 数据对比" compares the primary force, growth rate, chemical composition, and mineral density of the two deposition types. The lower part of the image is divided into two sections: a "岩溶发育剖面图 / GEOLOGICAL CROSS-SECTION" on the left, illustrating various speleothem morphologies like soda straws, stalactites, stalagmites, helictites, and columns; and a "沉积速率分析 / GROWTH RATE ANALYSIS" on the right, presenting a bar chart of annual growth lengths for soda straws, stalagmites, flowstones, helictites, and pearls. The bottom of the image contains a detailed four-column table describing the name, mechanism, characteristics, and typical size of six speleothem forms. The footer provides information on total samples, field site, date, and record.

text:
人类牙齿微观解剖学
Human Dental Anatomy: 4 Tissues and 4 Functional Types
矿化组织 / Mineralized
敏感组织 / Sensitive
软组织与支撑 / Soft Tissue
牙齿是人体中最坚硬的器官，由牙冠 (Crown) 与牙根 (Root) 组成。其微观结构由四种各具特征的组织层包裹而成，承担着人切割和研磨的不同消化功能。
Teeth are the hardest organs in the human body, consisting of the crown and root, structured in four distinct tissue layers, performing different digestive functions of cutting and grinding.
01. 组织层横截面 / TISSUE CROSS-SECTION
矿化程度 / MINERALIZATION
牙釉质 ENAMEL (96% 无机盐)
牙釉质
ENAMEL
96%
牙本质 DENTIN (70% 矿物质)
牙本质
DENTIN
70%
牙髓 PULP (血管与神经)
牙骨质
CEMENTUM
45%
牙骨质 CEMENTUM
牙本质小管 / Dentinal Tubules:
每平方毫米含有约30,000个微小管道，连接牙髓神经。当牙釉质磨损，外部刺激通过小管传导，产生酸痛感。
02. 成人牙齿配置与功能 / ADULT DENTAL FORMULA & FUNCTION
切牙 (8颗)
INCISORS / CUTTING
尖牙 (4颗)
CANINES / TEARING
前磨牙 (8颗)
PREMOLARS / CRUSHING
磨牙 (12颗)
MOLARS / GRINDING
注: 数据基于成年人恒牙列 (32颗)。牙釉质不含神经或血管，无法再生。牙本质含有活细胞和突起，具有修复能力。
Note: Data based on permanent dentition (32 teeth). Enamel lacks nerves/vessels and cannot regenerate. Dentin contains living cell processes with repair potential.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类牙齿微观解剖学的科普信息图，标题为“人类牙齿微观解剖学”。图片分为上下两个主要部分。上半部分详细展示了牙齿的组织层横截面和矿化程度。左侧是牙齿的剖面图，标示出牙釉质、牙本质、牙髓和牙骨质，并附有中文、英文名称及主要成分比例。右侧通过条形图展示了牙釉质、牙本质和牙骨质的矿化程度百分比，并配有关于牙本质小管的详细中文描述。图的顶部有一个图例，用不同颜色方块解释了矿化组织、敏感组织和软组织与支撑。下半部分介绍了成人牙齿的配置与功能，列出了切牙、尖牙、前磨牙和磨牙的数量、中英文名称及其功能，并用不同形状和颜色的图标表示。图片底部有关于数据来源和牙齿组织特性的中英文注释。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the microscopic anatomy of human teeth, titled "人类牙齿微观解剖学" (Human Dental Anatomy). The image is divided into two main sections. The upper section details the cross-section of tooth tissue layers and their mineralization levels. On the left, a cross-sectional diagram of a tooth labels the enamel, dentin, pulp, and cementum, with their Chinese and English names and main component percentages. On the right, a bar chart illustrates the mineralization percentages of enamel, dentin, and cementum, accompanied by a detailed Chinese description of dentinal tubules. A legend at the top explains the color coding for mineralized tissue, sensitive tissue, and soft tissue & support. The lower section introduces the configuration and function of adult teeth, listing the number, Chinese and English names, and functions of incisors, canines, premolars, and molars, represented by different shapes and colored icons. At the bottom, there are Chinese and English footnotes regarding data sources and tooth tissue characteristics.

The interface primarily uses white, light gray, and blue tones, with a clear layout divided into a left navigation bar and a right main content area. The top left of the navigation bar displays the application name "CloudOS," followed by options such as "全部文件" (All Files), "最近使用" (Recently Used), "我的收藏" (My Favorites), and "回收站" (Recycle Bin), with "全部文件" highlighted in blue. At the bottom of the navigation bar, storage usage is shown as "存储空间 (85%)" (Storage Space (85%)) with a progress bar. The main content area features a search bar at the top with the placeholder text "搜索您的文件与协作文档" (Search your files and collaborative documents). Below the search bar is a breadcrumb navigation path: "我的云盘 / 2024 市场部 / 品牌升级方案 / 视觉资产库 (Assets)" (My Cloud Drive / 2024 Marketing Dept / Brand Upgrade Plan / Visual Asset Library (Assets)). To the right, there are two action buttons, "+ 新建" (+ New) and "上传" (Upload), and a user avatar in the top right corner. The core of the main content area is a file list with columns for "名称" (Name), "最后修改" (Last Modified), "大小" (Size), and "所有者" (Owner). The file list displays items like "高清品牌插图素材包" (HD Brand Illustration Material Pack), "社交媒体海报模板" (Social Media Poster Template), "VI_应用规范手册_v2.pdf," and "官网首页_最终版_240520.fig" (Official Website Homepage_Final Version_240520.fig), along with their modification times and sizes. The owner column is represented by different colored circular icons. At the bottom of the file list, statistical information "共 142 个项目 · 已选中 1 个文件 (12.4 MB)" (Total 142 items · 1 file selected (12.4 MB)) is displayed.

prompt_cn: 这是一张宣传海报，整体采用左右分栏布局。左侧为浅米色渐变背景的文字信息区，右侧为一张色彩鲜艳的食物图片。左侧顶部有“STAFF HOSPITAL 职工医院检测部”字样，旁边伴有一个垂直的橙色装饰条。主标题“营养指导”以深灰色粗体大字呈现，其右侧有一个浅棕色边框的椭圆形标签，内含“体检套餐”字样。下方是英文副标题“NUTRITIONAL GUIDANCE SERVICE”。文字区主体内容分为两列，列举了四项服务内容，包括“个性化膳食建议”、“慢性病饮食管理”、“身体成分分析”和“专家一对一咨询”，每项服务下方都有详细描述。右侧图片展示了一碗丰盛的沙拉，内含西兰花、生菜、胡萝卜、紫甘蓝、小番茄等多种蔬菜和水果，色彩鲜明。图片右下角叠加了一个半透明的圆角矩形框，框内显示“98% 健康改善率 科学管理·焕发生机”的文字。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster, featuring a left-right column layout. The left side is a text information area with a light beige gradient background, while the right side displays a vibrant food image. At the top left, "STAFF HOSPITAL 职工医院检测部" is visible, accompanied by a vertical orange decorative bar. The main title "营养指导" (Nutritional Guidance) is presented in large, dark gray bold font, with an oval-shaped, light brown-bordered label containing "体检套餐" (Physical Examination Package) to its right. Below is the English subtitle "NUTRITIONAL GUIDANCE SERVICE". The main text area is divided into two columns, listing four service items: "个性化膳食建议" (Personalized Dietary Advice), "慢性病饮食管理" (Chronic Disease Diet Management), "身体成分分析" (Body Composition Analysis), and "专家一对一咨询" (One-on-One Expert Consultation), each with a detailed description below. The right side of the image shows a rich salad bowl containing various vegetables and fruits such as broccoli, lettuce, carrots, purple cabbage, and cherry tomatoes, all brightly colored. A semi-transparent rounded rectangular box is overlaid on the bottom right of the image, displaying the text "98% 健康改善率 科学管理·焕发生机" (98% Health Improvement Rate Scientific Management · Revitalize Life).

prompt_cn: 这是一张暑期美术班的宣传海报。海报顶部和右侧由彩色铅笔构成弧形边框，背景为白色。海报顶部有两行深绿色和红色的标题文字“暑期美术班 开课啦”。中部偏左列出了“美术班”的课程类别，包括儿童画、手工创意、硬笔书法、软笔书法、国画、素描和彩色，下方是这些课程的详细内容介绍。课程介绍下方有四个水平排列的圆形色块，颜色分别为绿色、黄色、橙色和红色。海报底部是一个面带笑容的儿童，双手沾满颜料举在脸前，其下方散落着几支彩色蜡笔和一道彩虹色的涂鸦。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a summer art class. The top and right sides of the poster are framed by an arc of colored pencils, with a white background. At the top of the poster are two lines of dark green and red title text, "暑期美术班 开课啦" (Summer Art Class Starting Soon). The middle-left section lists the course categories for the "美术班" (Art Class), including Children's Painting, Handicraft Creativity, Hard-pen Calligraphy, Soft-pen Calligraphy, Traditional Chinese Painting, Sketching, and Color Painting, followed by detailed descriptions of these courses. Below the course descriptions are four horizontally arranged circular color blocks in green, yellow, orange, and red. At the bottom of the poster, a smiling child holds up hands covered in paint in front of their face, with several colored crayons and a rainbow-colored doodle scattered below.

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示两根银色项链的产品照片。项链被放置在一张棕色卡片上，卡片下方铺着一张白色镂空编织垫，左侧边缘有一束白色羽毛状装饰物。两根项链垂直排列，每根项链都带有一个银色的打结形状吊坠，上方项链略短于下方项链。卡片顶部居中印有深灰色文字，分为三行，内容为“FRIENDSHIP is a KNOT that cannot be untied”（友谊是一个无法解开的结）。卡片底部，在项链下方，印有另一段深灰色文字，内容为“Simply close your eyes and make a wish, then wear this necklace on your neck. When it falls off or wears through, legend says that your wish will come true.”（只需闭上眼睛许个愿，然后将这条项链戴在脖子上。当它脱落或磨损时，传说你的愿望就会实现。）。这段文字下方还有一个装饰性的打结图案。卡片上的所有文字均居中对齐。
prompt_en: This is a product photograph showcasing two silver necklaces. The necklaces are displayed on a brown card, which rests on a white openwork woven mat, with a cluster of white feather-like decorations along the left edge. The two necklaces are arranged vertically, each featuring a silver knot-shaped pendant, with the upper necklace being slightly shorter than the lower one. Dark gray text is printed centrally at the top of the card, in three lines, reading: “FRIENDSHIP is a KNOT that cannot be untied”. At the bottom of the card, below the necklaces, another section of dark gray text reads: “Simply close your eyes and make a wish, then wear this necklace on your neck. When it falls off or wears through, legend says that your wish will come true.” A decorative knot pattern is also present below this text. All text on the card is centrally aligned.

text:
标准交响乐团声部座次布局
The Symphony Orchestra: Modern Stage Configuration / 西方管弦乐传统
现代交响乐团的布局，通常遵循斯托科夫斯基 (Leopold Stokowski) 确立的“美国式”排布。弦乐组 (Strings) 作为核心，呈半圆状包围指挥台，占据乐团总人数的百分之六十。木管组 (Woodwinds) 位于中央轴心，确保其细腻的音色能够穿透弦乐。铜管 (Brass) 与打击乐 (Percussion) 置于后方高处，以平衡强大的声压级。
这种扇形布局不仅是为了视觉上的对称，更是为了声学上的精确。高音部位予左侧，低音部位予右侧，构成了一个巨大的立体声场。乐器材料跨越了自然木材、金属合金与动物皮革，体现了工业时代前的工艺巅峰。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于标准交响乐团声部座次布局的信息图表。图片顶部是标题“标准交响乐团声部座次布局”及其英文副标题。左侧区域包含两段中文正文，详细阐述了现代交响乐团的布局原则、斯托科夫斯基的“美国式”排布以及声学特性。右侧区域列出了“物理材质”、“典型规模”和“声学特性”三类信息，每类都包含中英文标签和具体内容。图片中央是一个大型的半圆形乐团座位布局图，用深色线条勾勒出不同乐器组的区域，并用中英文标注了“打击乐”、“圆号”、“木管组”、“铜管”、“小提琴”、“中提琴”、“大提琴”、“低音提琴”和“指挥”等位置。图表下方是一个四列五行的表格，详细列出了“声部组别”、“乐器构成”、“人数”和“舞台方位”。图片底部是关于“文化源流”和“核心地理坐标”的页脚信息。所有文字均为深灰色，背景为浅米色。
prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the standard seating arrangement of a symphony orchestra. At the top, the image features a main title "标准交响乐团声部座次布局" and its English subtitle. The left section contains two paragraphs of Chinese text, detailing the layout principles of modern symphony orchestras, Leopold Stokowski's "American style" arrangement, and acoustic characteristics. The right section presents three categories of information: "Physical Materials," "Standard Scale," and "Acoustic Profile," each with bilingual labels and specific content. A large semi-circular diagram of the orchestra's seating layout occupies the central part of the image, outlining different instrument sections with dark lines and labeling positions such as "Percussion," "Horns," "Woodwinds," "Brass," "Violins," "Violas," "Cellos," "Double Bass," and "Conductor" in both Chinese and English. Below the diagram, a four-column, five-row table provides detailed information on "Section Family," "Instrumentation," "Count," and "Positioning." The bottom of the image includes footer information regarding "Cultural Origin" and "Geographic Focus." All text is dark gray, set against a light beige background.

He is wearing a grey sweater and a red vest, carrying a simple wooden structure on his shoulder and holding a wooden stick in his hand. The wooden structure consists of a vertical wooden pole and two horizontal wooden planks, with a small white clip attached to the vertical pole on the upper plank. The man's face is turned to the right, his eyes slightly closed, and he has a pleasant expression. The background is a blurred street scene with visible buildings, trees, and vehicles, indicating bright, sunny lighting. In the bottom right corner of the image, there is a circular watermark containing the Chinese text "国摄网", the English text "www.cnphotos.net", and a camera lens icon.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色摄影照片，展现了戈壁荒漠中一座古老的城门楼和绵延的城墙。画面前景是广阔的沙地，其上散布着枯黄的草丛和几株形态扭曲、枝干嶙峋的枯树。画面中景偏左侧矗立着一座砖石结构的城门楼，其顶部是木质的歇山式屋顶建筑，门洞上方悬挂着一块黑底白字的横向牌匾，清晰可见“镇西关”三个字。城门楼右侧连接着一道城墙，城墙向远方延伸，并可见多个方形的瞭望塔。天空多云，整体色调以土黄、棕色和灰色为主。
prompt_en: This is a color photograph depicting an ancient gate tower and an extended city wall in a Gobi desert landscape. The foreground features a vast sandy area, scattered with withered yellow grass and several gnarled, skeletal dead trees. In the mid-ground, slightly to the left, stands a brick and stone gate tower with a wooden hip-and-gable roof structure at its top. Above the archway, a horizontal plaque with black characters on a white background clearly displays the three characters "镇西关". To the right of the gate tower, a city wall extends into the distance, featuring multiple square watchtowers. The sky is cloudy, and the overall color palette is dominated by earthy yellow, brown, and gray.

text:
重阳安康
岁岁重阳·今又重阳
尊敬的长辈:
金秋送爽，丹桂飘香。值此九九重阳佳节之际，晚辈怀着无比感恩之心，向您致以最诚挚的节日问候与祝福。
感念您多年来的言传身教，您的睿智与慈爱如春风化雨，润泽晚辈心田。在这尊老长久与尊贵的日子里，愿这份涓涓的暖意，能为您带去一丝暖意。
衷心祝愿您：福如东海长流水，寿比南山不老松。愿您身体康健，笑口常开，岁岁平安，吉祥如意。
吉祥如意
晚辈：敬呈
二〇二四年·重阳节

prompt_cn: 这是一张重阳节数字贺卡。卡片背景为暖色调的浅色渐变，并带有金色装饰边框。顶部中央是红色粗体的主标题“重阳安康”，下方是灰色的副标题“岁岁重阳·今又重阳”。贺卡左侧是左对齐的祝福语正文，以“尊敬的长辈:”开头。正文分为三段，第一段为黑色字体，后两段为较小的灰色字体。卡片中下部有一个圆形黑白浮雕图像，描绘了多个人物，可能为古代或宗教场景。圆形图像右侧有一个红色矩形框，内含竖排文字“吉祥如意”。卡片右下角是落款“晚辈：敬呈”和日期“二〇二四年·重阳节”。
prompt_en: This is a digital greeting card for the Double Ninth Festival. The card features a warm, light-colored gradient background with a golden decorative border. The main title "重阳安康" (Chongyang An Kang, meaning "Double Ninth Festival Peace and Health") is prominently displayed in red, bold font at the top center, followed by the subtitle "岁岁重阳·今又重阳" (Every year Chongyang, and now Chongyang again) in gray. The main body of the blessing message is left-aligned on the left side of the card, beginning with "尊敬的长辈:" (Respected Elder:). The message is divided into three paragraphs, with the first in black font and the subsequent two in smaller, gray font. In the lower central part of the card, there is a circular black-and-white relief-like image depicting multiple figures, possibly from ancient times or a religious scene. To the right of this circular image, a red rectangular box contains the vertical text "吉祥如意" (Jíxiáng Rúyì, meaning "Good fortune as one wishes"). At the bottom right, the card concludes with the sender's sign-off "晚辈：敬呈" (Junior: Respectfully presented) and the date "二〇二四年·重阳节" (2024 · Double Ninth Festival).

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色主题的软件界面截图，用于指标配置。界面结构分为顶部标题栏、三列主要内容区和底部状态/操作栏。顶部标题栏左侧显示“METRIC CONFIG V2.4”，下方是副标题“指标配置中心 · 聚合函数定义引擎”。右侧显示“UUID: DATA-7729-X”。左侧列标题为“原始字段”，列出了四个数据字段及其类型和中文描述，包括“order_amount (Double · 交易总额)”、“user_retention (Float · 留存比率)”、“latency_ms (Integer · 响应延迟)”和“request_id (String · 唯一标识)”，其中“user_retention”以蓝色高亮显示，表示被选中。中间列标题为“聚合算子配置”，提供了“SUM”、“AVG”、“COUNT”和“P99”四个聚合函数选项，其中“SUM”当前被选中并高亮，下方显示其描述“计算时间窗口内所有数据点的总和。”。这些选项下方是一个“窗口步长”的滑块控件，右侧以蓝色显示当前值“300s”。右侧列标题为“预览分析”，显示一个大的蓝色数字“88.2%”，下方标注“预估精度”，背景是数据图表。其下方是一个“QUERY”代码块，包含三行SQL代码：“SELECT SUM(amt)”、“FROM orders”和“WINDOW 5m;”。底部操作栏左侧显示绿色的“READY”状态和“LATENCY: 12MS”，右侧是“CANCEL”和蓝色的“DEPLOY”两个按钮。界面通过蓝色高亮选中项和关键数据，绿色指示状态。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface for metric configuration. The interface is structured into a top header, three main content columns, and a bottom status/action bar. The top header displays "METRIC CONFIG V2.4" on the left, with a subtitle "指标配置中心 · 聚合函数定义引擎" (Metric Configuration Center · Aggregation Function Definition Engine) below it. On the right, "UUID: DATA-7729-X" is shown. The left column, titled "原始字段" (Original Fields), lists four data fields with their types and Chinese descriptions, including "order_amount (Double · Transaction Amount)", "user_retention (Float · Retention Rate)", "latency_ms (Integer · Response Latency)", and "request_id (String · Unique Identifier)", with "user_retention" highlighted in blue, indicating selection. The middle column, titled "聚合算子配置" (Aggregation Operator Configuration), presents four aggregation function options: "SUM", "AVG", "COUNT", and "P99". "SUM" is currently selected and highlighted, with its description "计算时间窗口内所有数据点的总和。" (Calculates the sum of all data points within the time window.) displayed below it. Below these options, there is a "窗口步长" (Window Step) slider control, with its current value "300s" displayed in blue on the right. The right column, titled "预览分析" (Preview Analysis), features a large "88.2%" in blue, labeled "预估精度" (Estimated Accuracy), overlaid on a background of data charts. Below this, a "QUERY" section displays three lines of SQL code: "SELECT SUM(amt)", "FROM orders", and "WINDOW 5m;". The bottom bar shows a green "READY" status and "LATENCY: 12MS" on the left. On the right, there are two buttons: "CANCEL" and a blue "DEPLOY" button. The interface uses color coding, such as blue for selected items and key data, and green for status indicators.

prompt_cn: 这是一组奇幻风格的漫画页面，共两页，每页包含三个垂直排列的画格。画面描绘了拥有蓝色长发的女性角色和白色短发的男性角色，他们的面部被模糊处理。场景设定在一个寒冷的世界，有石质建筑的室内和带有北极光的室外夜景。画面中充满了魔法元素，如发光的魔法书、漂浮的魔法阵、发光的晶体和雪花图案。主色调为冷色系的蓝色和灰色，辅以灯笼发出的暖黄色光芒。右侧页面底部画格中，女性角色正在阅读一本带有雪花图案的书，旁边有一个对话气泡，里面写着日文“……凍えた”。
prompt_en: This is a set of fantasy-style comic pages, consisting of two pages, each with three vertically arranged panels. The images depict a blue-haired female character and a white-haired male character, whose faces are blurred. The scenes are set in a cold world, featuring interiors with stone architecture and outdoor night scenes with the aurora borealis. The panels are filled with magical elements such as glowing spellbooks, floating magic circles, luminous crystals, and snowflake patterns. The dominant color palette consists of cool blues and grays, complemented by warm yellow light emanating from lanterns. In the bottom panel of the right page, the female character is reading a book with snowflake patterns, and a speech bubble next to her contains the Japanese text "……凍えた".

Above the main entrance, on a transparent canopy, the text "THE OPEN SHELL: LGBTQ MUSEUM" is displayed. prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface, displaying an operation log details page. The top of the page features the title "操作日志详情" (Operation Log Details), with two blue buttons "导出 PDF" (Export PDF) and "返回列表" (Return to List) on the right, and a label showing "日志编号: LOG-20231024-0852" (Log ID). The main content area is divided into two columns. The upper part of the left column shows "操作人员" (Operator) information, including a professional photo of a man and the name "张建国" (Zhang Jianguo). Below it, "所属部门" (Department) is listed as "系统运维部 / 高级管理员" (System Operations Dept / Senior Administrator), "终端 IP" (Terminal IP) as "192.168.1.105 (北京)" (Beijing), and "操作时间" (Operation Time) as "2023-10-24 14:30:22". The bottom of the left column displays "执行状态" (Execution Status) as green bold "SUCCESS" and "耗时 124ms" (Time taken 124ms). The upper part of the right column shows "业务模块" (Business Module) as bold "用户权限管理" (User Permission Management) and "操作类型" (Operation Type) as orange bold "敏感权限变更" (Sensitive Permission Change). The middle of the right column contains "操作内容详情" (Operation Content Details), including a line of light blue code "UPDATE sys_role_permission", followed by two code snippets prefixed with red and green dots respectively, detailing the disabling and enabling of a permission ID. Below this is a "变更说明" (Change Description). The bottom of the right column shows "关联请求 ID" (Related Request ID) as "REQ-99283477102" and "审计校验码" (Audit Checksum) as "SHA256: 8f2e...a1b2".

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色背景为主的免疫系统实时监控信息图。图表顶部是标题“人类免疫系统: 白细胞分类与防线分工”及其英文副标题“IMMUNE DEFENSE SYSTEM REAL-TIME MONITORING”，右侧有“核心防御: 部署完毕”和“监控周期: T+14d”的状态标签。下方并列展示了三张数据卡片，分别显示“先天反应延迟 12 min”、“T细胞活化率 94.2 %”和“抗体分泌速率 2,000 /s”。中间区域是一个折线图，标题为“防御反应强度与抗体表达曲线”，图例显示“先天防御强度”和“特异性抗体浓度”两条曲线在0到14天内的变化。底部区域分为左右两栏和下方日志区。左栏标题为“三道防线战术部署架构”，详细描述了三道防线的组成和功能。右栏标题为“核心白细胞状态监控”，列出了四种白细胞及其当前状态（ACTIVE, KILLING, SECRETING, STANDBY）。最下方是“免疫反应实时事件历史日志”，按时间顺序记录了免疫反应的五个关键事件，包括警告、信息、执行和成功等不同类型。
prompt_en: This is an information graphic displaying a real-time immune system monitoring interface, set against a dark background. At the top, the title "人类免疫系统: 白细胞分类与防线分工" (Human Immune System: Leukocyte Classification and Defense Division) is presented with its English subtitle "IMMUNE DEFENSE SYSTEM REAL-TIME MONITORING". To the right, status labels read "核心防御: 部署完毕" (Core Defense: Deployed) and "监控周期: T+14d" (Monitoring Cycle: T+14d). Below, three data cards are arranged side-by-side, showing "先天反应延迟 12 min" (Innate Response Delay 12 min), "T细胞活化率 94.2 %" (T-cell Activation Rate 94.2 %), and "抗体分泌速率 2,000 /s" (Antibody Secretion Rate 2,000 /s). The central area features a line chart titled "防御反应强度与抗体表达曲线" (Defense Response Intensity and Antibody Expression Curve), with a legend indicating two curves: "先天防御强度" (Innate Defense Intensity) and "特异性抗体浓度" (Specific Antibody Concentration), showing their changes over 0 to 14 days. The bottom section is divided into two columns and a log area. The left column, titled "三道防线战术部署架构" (Three Lines of Defense Tactical Deployment Architecture), details the composition and function of three defense lines. The right column, titled "核心白细胞状态监控" (Core Leukocyte Status Monitoring), lists four types of leukocytes and their current statuses (ACTIVE, KILLING, SECRETING, STANDBY). The very bottom displays an "免疫反应实时事件历史日志" (Immune Response Real-time Event History Log), chronologically recording five key immune response events, including warnings, information, execution, and success.

prompt_cn: 这是一张放置在木桶中的宣传海报。海报上半部分展示了一群叶猴（langur）在岩石上的照片，画面色调偏冷。照片上方叠加着白色的标题文字“SAVE the LANGUR”，其中“SAVE”和“LANGUR”为大字号粗体斜体，而“the”字号略小。标题下方是白色的正文“50% of the proceeds of every Langur souvenir purchased will be donated to the Langur Conservation Project.”，说明了部分收益将捐赠给叶猴保护项目。海报中部有一条红色的水平粗线将上下部分隔开。红线下方是海报的底部区域，左侧是深蓝色的“Bhaya”品牌名称及其标语“THE CRUISE COMPANY”，下方还有三组小字品牌名称“Bhaya”、“auca”和“Legend”。右侧是绿色的“CAT BA LANGUR Conservation Project”项目名称，上方带有一个叶猴头像的绿色标志。整个海报被放置在一个深棕色木桶的开口处，木桶边缘有金属箍和铆钉。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster placed inside a wooden barrel. The upper part of the poster features a photograph of a group of langur monkeys on rocks, with a cool color tone. Overlaid on the photo is the white title text "SAVE the LANGUR", where "SAVE" and "LANGUR" are large, bold, and italic, while "the" is slightly smaller. Below the title is white body text stating "50% of the proceeds of every Langur souvenir purchased will be donated to the Langur Conservation Project.", explaining that a portion of proceeds will be donated to the langur conservation project. A thick red horizontal line separates the upper and lower sections of the poster. Below the red line, the bottom area of the poster displays the dark blue "Bhaya" brand name and its slogan "THE CRUISE COMPANY" on the left, with three smaller brand names "Bhaya", "auca", and "Legend" below them. On the right is the green "CAT BA LANGUR Conservation Project" project name, accompanied by a green logo featuring a langur head above it. The entire poster is positioned within the opening of a dark brown wooden barrel, which has metal bands and rivets along its rim.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以嘻哈音乐为主题的招新海报。海报背景分为上下两部分，顶部为绿色，底部为黑色。画面中央是一个戴着墨镜和耳机的3D卡通人物，身穿紫色长袖上衣和绿色裤子，双手放在一个DJ打碟机上。海报左侧区域主要展示招新信息，右侧区域则以卡通人物和DJ设备为主。顶部有白色大字标题“开启你的「说唱新世代」”，下方是副标题“说唱社等你来”，两侧饰有菱形图标。左侧列出了“HIPHOP CLUB”的招新详情，包括“招新对象：全体可画大学在读本科生”、“招新时间：9.10-9.17”、“线下招新地址：可画大学体育馆二层”和“招新流程”。流程中包含加入微信群、下载报名表、发送邮件至“cnsupport@canva.com”以及线下面试。海报左下角绿色方框内标有“联系方式”，右侧列出“招新群号：12345678”和“微信公众号：可画说唱”。右下角有一个二维码，上方提示“「码」上加入”。海报整体文字以白色、橙色和绿色呈现，与深色背景形成对比。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster with a hip-hop music theme. The poster's background is divided into two parts: green at the top and black at the bottom. In the center of the image is a 3D cartoon character wearing sunglasses and headphones, dressed in a purple long-sleeved shirt and green pants, with hands placed on a DJ turntable. The left side of the poster primarily displays recruitment information, while the right side features the cartoon character and DJ equipment. At the top, a large white title reads "开启你的「说唱新世代」" (Start Your "New Generation of Rap"), followed by the subtitle "说唱社等你来" (The Rap Club Awaits You), adorned with diamond icons on both sides. The left section details the "HIPHOP CLUB" recruitment, including "招新对象: 全体可画大学在读本科生" (Recruitment Target: All undergraduate students at Canva University), "招新时间: 9.10-9.17" (Recruitment Period: September 10-17), "线下招新地址: 可画大学体育馆二层" (Offline Recruitment Address: Second Floor, Canva University Gymnasium), and "招新流程" (Recruitment Process). The process involves joining a WeChat group, downloading the application form, sending it to "cnsupport@canva.com", and participating in an offline interview. In the bottom left green box, "联系方式" (Contact Information) is displayed, with "招新群号: 12345678" (Recruitment Group Number: 12345678) and "微信公众号: 可画说唱" (WeChat Official Account: Canva Rap) listed to its right. A QR code is located in the bottom right, with the prompt "「码」上加入" (Scan to Join) above it. The text on the poster is presented in white, orange, and green, contrasting with the dark background.

prompt_en: This is an infographic about the vertical stratification and ecological niches of the Amazon rainforest. The chart features a dark gray background with text and lines primarily in white, while some figure numbers and curves are highlighted in red. The main title at the top is "亚马逊雨林垂直冠层分层与生态位" with an English subtitle below. The main body of the chart is divided into two columns and a bottom footer. The upper left section presents a "VERTICAL DECONSTRUCTION" diagram, illustrating the height ranges of the emergent, canopy, understory, and forest floor layers. The lower left section contains an "ENVIRONMENTAL PARAMETER MATRIX" table, detailing light, humidity, wind, and biodiversity data for each stratum. The upper right section displays a "LIGHT ATTENUATION" curve graph, showing the relationship between height and light percentage. The middle right section is a "TYPICAL SPECIES INDEX," listing representative flora and fauna by layer. The lower right section, titled "NUTRIENT TURNOVER," explains the leaf litter decomposition cycle and process on the forest floor. The bottom footer includes the plate number, chart subject, and geographical coordinates.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用的用户界面截图，显示的是一个体温监测功能。界面背景为深蓝色，带有细密的网格纹理。顶部状态栏显示当前时间“10:08”和电池电量“85%”及电池图标。标题区域左侧有一个绿色竖条装饰，文字为“体温监测”。屏幕中央以超大白色字体显示当前体温读数“36.7”，其右上角的单位“℃”为绿色。下方有绿色小字“正在实时采样...”。屏幕中部有一个柱状图，显示体温采样数据，其中一个柱子为绿色。图表下方有从“35.0”到“39.0”的刻度标签，其中“37.0”为绿色。中下部显示“测量进度”和“75%”，下方是一个蓝绿色的进度条。进度条下方有一个蓝色信息图标和一行提示文字：“请保持手臂平放并紧贴皮肤，测量过程中请勿剧烈运动。”底部有两个卡片式信息框，左侧显示“环境温度”和“24.5 ℃”，右侧显示“预计剩余”和“15 秒”。界面最下方是一个红色的“停止测量”按钮。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application user interface, displaying a body temperature monitoring function. The interface background is dark blue with a fine grid texture. The top status bar shows the current time "10:08" and battery level "85%" with a battery icon. The title area has a green vertical bar decoration on the left, with the text "体温监测" (Body Temperature Monitoring). In the center of the screen, the current body temperature reading "36.7" is displayed in extra-large white font, with the unit "℃" in green at its top right. Below it, small green text reads "正在实时采样..." (Real-time sampling in progress...). The middle of the screen features a bar chart showing temperature sampling data, with one bar highlighted in green. Below the chart are scale labels from "35.0" to "39.0", with "37.0" highlighted in green. The mid-lower section shows "测量进度" (Measurement Progress) and "75%", below which is a blue-green progress bar. Below the progress bar, there is a blue information icon and a line of text: "请保持手臂平放并紧贴皮肤，测量过程中请勿剧烈运动。" (Please keep your arm flat and close to the skin; do not engage in strenuous activity during measurement.). At the bottom, there are two card-style information boxes; the left one displays "环境温度" (Ambient Temperature) and "24.5 ℃", while the right one shows "预计剩余" (Estimated Remaining) and "15 秒" (15 seconds). The very bottom of the interface features a red "停止测量" (Stop Measurement) button.

prompt_en: This is an illustration in the style of Chinese ink wash painting, depicting a general in golden armor and a helmet with a red tassel, standing majestically in the center of the frame, holding a long-handled saber. Behind the general, a neatly arranged army stands with multiple flags fluttering in the wind, and in the distance, rolling mountains are shrouded in mist, creating an ethereal atmosphere. The color palette primarily consists of earthy tones such as beige, brown, and gray, with black used for outlining and text, and red accentuating the seals, the general's helmet tassel, and the weapon's tassel. Compositionally, there is a prominent horizontal title "丙午年文哲大将军" at the top, and two sets of vertically arranged poems and inscriptions on the left, accompanied by three red seals. The text content complements the general's image and the background, collectively evoking a sense of history and heroism.

STRUCTURAL RULES
The ABO system, first classified by Karl Landsteiner in 1900, is governed by the presence of specific antigens on the erythrocyte surface. In Art Deco naval terms, these are the ship's distinct markings. If the recipient's "harbor" contains antibodies against the donor's "markings," an immune collision occurs.
The Rhesus (Rh) factor adds a third crucial dimension. Rh-positive individuals carry the D antigen, while Rh-negative individuals lack it, requiring strict navigation during transfusion to avoid sensitization.
Inheritance Laws
Blood groups follow Mendelian genetics. A and B alleles are co-dominant, while O is recessive. An A-type parent and B-type parent may yield an AB, A, B, or O offspring depending on genotype.
Global Variance
Type O remains the most common global lineage (~45%). Type A dominates in Europe (~40%), while Type B shows higher frequency across Central Asia and India (~20%). AB remains the rarest (~4%).
Terminology
Technical specimens for reference: A型 (Type A), B型 (Type B), O型 (Type O). All adhere to the same protein-carbohydrate architectural constraints.

prompt_cn: 这是一张具有复古风格的插画海报。画面中央和下方是一条巨大的、风格化的眼镜蛇，它张着大嘴，露出尖锐的毒牙和分叉的绿色舌头，身体盘绕，覆盖着深绿色、紫色和米黄色的鳞片图案。背景是带有粗糙纹理的深紫色。画面的右上方是一个蓝色的线框图，详细展示了蛇的骨骼结构，并用日文标注了“骨格”、“頭蓋骨”、“脊椎骨”、“肋骨”和“尾骨”。右侧有两列垂直排列的日文文本，提供了关于蛇的额外信息。左下角有三个并列的蓝色图标，分别是水滴、月亮和叶子，每个图标旁都配有对应的日文汉字“水”、“月”、“森”。画面底部中央，用醒目的浅蓝色粗体字写着巨大的日文标题“大蛇”。整幅插画和文字都呈现出一种旧纸张或老旧印刷品般的粗糙质感。
prompt_en: This is a vintage-style illustration poster. In the center and lower part of the image is a huge, stylized cobra with its mouth wide open, revealing sharp fangs and a forked green tongue. Its body is coiled and covered with scale patterns in dark green, purple, and beige. The background is a dark purple with a rough texture. In the upper right corner, there is a blue wireframe diagram detailing the snake's skeletal structure, labeled in Japanese with "骨格" (skeleton), "頭蓋骨" (skull), "脊椎骨" (vertebrae), "肋骨" (ribs), and "尾骨" (tailbone). On the right side, there are two columns of vertically arranged Japanese text providing additional information about snakes. In the lower left corner, there are three parallel blue icons: a water drop, a moon, and a leaf, each accompanied by its corresponding Japanese kanji: "水" (water), "月" (moon), and "森" (forest). At the bottom center of the image, a large, prominent title "大蛇" (giant snake) is written in bold, light blue Japanese characters. The entire illustration and text exhibit a rough texture, resembling old paper or vintage prints.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot displaying a system log management interface. The interface predominantly uses light tones, with a dark navigation bar at the top. The left side shows "系统日志管理中心 v2.4.0" (System Log Management Center v2.4.0), while the right side displays the user "admin_01" and the current date and time "2023-10-24 14:20". Below the navigation bar are three parallel statistical cards, presenting "今日日志总量 1,284,092 ↑ 12%" (Today's Total Logs 1,284,092 ↑ 12%), "异常报警次数 42 ↓ 3%" (Number of Anomaly Alerts 42 ↓ 3%), and "存储占用 856.2 GB" (Storage Usage 856.2 GB). The main area below features a log data table with five columns: "生成时间" (Generation Time), "级别" (Level), "服务模块" (Service Module), "日志详情描述" (Log Details Description), and "操作" (Operation). Entries in the "级别" (Level) column, such as "INFO", "ERROR", "WARN", and "DEBUG", are displayed with different colored rounded backgrounds. The "操作" (Operation) column in the table provides blue text links like "详情" (Details), "诊断" (Diagnosis), and "优化" (Optimize). At the bottom of the interface is a pagination control, showing "共 842 条" (Total 842 entries) and buttons for "上一页" (Previous Page), "1", "2", "3", and "下一页" (Next Page), with the number "1" highlighted by a blue background.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色模式下的软件界面截图，展示了一个高级搜索功能。界面采用两栏布局，左侧是搜索条件设置区，右侧是检索范围限定区。顶部标题栏显示“高级搜索 / 精确匹配”和“检索模式: 专家级”。左侧区域包含三个卡片，分别用于“包含以下全部关键词”、“排除以下关键词”和“检索逻辑预览 (Query Logic)”。在“包含以下全部关键词”卡片中，输入框内显示“人工智能伦理与全球治理框架 2024”，下方有提示文字“系统将仅返回包含完整短语且顺序一致的结果”。“排除以下关键词”卡片中，有一个输入框占位符“例如: 广告, 推广...”，并带有“关闭”和“开启”的切换按钮。最下方的“检索逻辑预览”卡片展示了 SQL 风格的查询语句。右侧的“检索范围限定”卡片列出了“发布时间”、“文件格式”、“语言区域”和“站点/域名”等筛选条件及其当前值，如“过去 12 个月”、“PDF, DOCX”、“中文 (简体)”和“.gov, .edu”。该卡片下方有一个抽象的背景图案，由许多小屏幕或图标组成。界面底部有“重置条件”、“保存模板”和“执行精确检索”三个按钮，其中“执行精确检索”按钮为深蓝色背景，其余为浅灰色背景。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a software interface in dark mode, showcasing an advanced search function. The interface features a two-column layout, with the left side dedicated to search condition settings and the right side to search scope limitations. The top title bar displays "高级搜索 / 精确匹配" (Advanced Search / Exact Match) and "检索模式: 专家级" (Search Mode: Expert). The left area contains three cards for "包含以下全部关键词" (Include all keywords below), "排除以下关键词" (Exclude keywords below), and "检索逻辑预览 (Query Logic)" (Search Logic Preview). In the "Include all keywords below" card, the input field shows "人工智能伦理与全球治理框架 2024" (AI Ethics and Global Governance Framework 2024), with a descriptive text below stating "系统将仅返回包含完整短语且顺序一致的结果" (The system will only return results containing the complete phrase in the exact order). The "Exclude keywords below" card has an input field placeholder "例如: 广告, 推广..." (e.g., ads, promotions...), along with "关闭" (Off) and "开启" (On) toggle buttons. The bottom "Search Logic Preview" card displays an SQL-style query statement. The right-side "检索范围限定" (Search Scope Limitation) card lists filtering conditions such as "发布时间" (Publication Time), "文件格式" (File Format), "语言区域" (Language Region), and "站点/域名" (Site/Domain), with their current values like "过去 12 个月" (Past 12 months), "PDF, DOCX", "中文 (简体)" (Chinese (Simplified)), and ".gov, .edu". Below this card is an abstract background pattern composed of many small screens or icons. At the bottom of the interface, there are three buttons: "重置条件" (Reset Conditions), "保存模板" (Save Template), and "执行精确检索" (Execute Exact Search), with the "Execute Exact Search" button having a dark blue background and the others having light gray backgrounds.

The main content of the page is divided into three major sections. The first section is “概述” (Overview), which includes a dark gray title and two black bulleted list items, introducing the company profile and project overview. The second section is “1.市场分析” (1. Market Analysis), featuring a blue-green title and a three-row, two-column table, detailing target market, competitive analysis, and market positioning. The third section is “2.产品或服务描述” (2. Product or Service Description), which includes a blue-green title and two parallel blue-green background titles, each with a black bulleted list item below, describing the product/service overview and development plan, respectively. The overall page layout is clear, using a white background and blue-green as accent colors.

TYPOGRAPHIC ANATOMY PLATE
西文字体解剖学: Serif 与 Sans-serif
分析与度量: 衬线与无衬线设计的基本法则 / Analysis & Metrics: Basic Rules of Serif and Sans-serif Design
T
1. 字形结构与基准线 (ANATOMY BASELINES)
字体排版之始,在于确立基准线系统。所有字母均放置于基线之上,小写字母的核心高度由x高度决定。
升部与降部延伸至基准线之外,为视觉提供节奏感。衬线体通过饰角引导视线,增强长文印刷可读性。
无衬线体舍弃装饰,追求笔画粗细一致。这种几何纯粹性使其在低分辨率屏幕上表现卓越,展现现代工业美学。

4. 黄金比例与字距微调 (TYPOGRAPHIC PRINCIPLES)
【字距微调 / Kerning】
特定字母组合 (如 AV, LT) 的间距需经过个性化缩减,以维持视觉灰度在排版中的绝对均匀。
视线引导 / Eye-leading 是衬线体核心。粗细交替的笔画与水平延伸的饰角,在纸面构筑无形轨道。
几何建构 / Geometric 如 Futura 采用正圆与直线组合。无衬线体剥离一切装饰,适应现代版面。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于西文字体解剖学的教育信息图表，可能出自书籍或海报。图表以白色为背景，顶部有中英文双语标题“TYPOGRAPHIC ANATOMY PLATE”和“西文字体解剖学: Serif 与 Sans-serif”，以及副标题“分析与度量: 衬线与无衬线设计的基本法则 / Analysis & Metrics: Basic Rules of Serif and Sans-serif Design”。右上角有一个大的装饰性字母“T”。页面内容分为四个编号的章节，每个章节标题位于红色背景条上。主体内容包含多栏文本、一个详细的表格、一个字体结构图示、一个柱状图和一个度量指标列表。表格列出了六种字体的类别、x-Height比例、对比度、饰角样式和年份。图示展示了字体中的升部、x高度、基线和降部，并以“hp”字符为例。柱状图对比了四种字体的x高度占比。底部左侧有一个灰色方框，解释了“字距微调/Kerning”的概念。页脚提供了图版信息和出版来源。
prompt_en: This is an educational infographic about typographic anatomy, possibly from a book or poster. The chart has a white background with bilingual English and Chinese titles at the top: "TYPOGRAPHIC ANATOMY PLATE" and "西文字体解剖学: Serif 与 Sans-serif", along with the subtitle "分析与度量: 衬线与无衬线设计的基本法则 / Analysis & Metrics: Basic Rules of Serif and Sans-serif Design". A large decorative letter "T" is in the upper right corner. The page content is divided into four numbered sections, each with a title on a red background bar. The main body includes multi-column text, a detailed table, a typeface structure diagram, a bar chart, and a list of metrics. The table lists the category, x-Height ratio, contrast, serif style, and year for six typefaces. The diagram illustrates the ascender, x-height, baseline, and descender of a typeface, using the characters "hp" as an example. The bar chart compares the x-height percentage of four typefaces. A gray box at the bottom left explains the concept of "Kerning". The footer provides plate information and publication source.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以“武汉美食打卡地图”为主题的拼贴风格海报。画面以白色为背景，顶部中央是深棕色立体字体的标题“武汉美食打卡地图”，旁边点缀着黄色手写体“Here”和橙色勾选图标。海报主体展示了三张美食照片，分别位于左上、右上和左下区域。每张照片下方都配有深灰色小字体的餐厅类型和地址信息，包括“墨西哥特色餐厅”、“创意韩国料理”和“日式风味烧肉”，以及统一的“1号线可画地铁站 A出口往南”的地址。画面中还散布着多个卡通人物插画和手绘风格的装饰性文字，如左侧的蓝色“YAY!”、右侧蓝色气泡框内的“LOOK!”、左下角的橙色“Nicocee”和右下角的蓝色“GO-”。这些装饰元素与手绘箭头共同营造出活泼的视觉效果，引导观众关注不同的美食推荐。整体色彩鲜明，以黄色、橙色、蓝色、棕色和深灰色为主。
prompt_en: This is a collage-style poster themed "Wuhan Food Check-in Map". The image features a white background, with the main title "武汉美食打卡地图" (Wuhan Food Check-in Map) in dark brown 3D-effect characters at the top center, accompanied by a yellow handwritten "Here" and an orange checkmark icon. The poster's main body displays three food photographs, positioned in the upper left, upper right, and lower left areas. Below each photo, there is restaurant type and address information in small, dark gray text, including "墨西哥特色餐厅" (Mexican Specialty Restaurant), "创意韩国料理" (Creative Korean Cuisine), and "日式风味烧肉" (Japanese-style Grilled Meat), along with the consistent address "1号线可画地铁站 A出口往南" (Line 1 Kehua Subway Station, Exit A South). The image is also interspersed with several cartoon character illustrations and hand-drawn decorative texts, such as the blue "YAY!" on the left, "LOOK!" inside a blue speech bubble on the right, the orange "Nicocee" in the lower left, and the blue "GO-" in the lower right. These decorative elements, along with hand-drawn arrows, create a lively visual effect, guiding the viewer's attention to different food recommendations. The overall color scheme is vibrant, predominantly featuring yellow, orange, blue, brown, and dark gray.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于调香金字塔的白色背景信息图，详细阐述了香氛组分的挥发动力学与留香时序。图片顶部是标题“调香金字塔”和参考编号“REF. 804. 298. 15”。上半部分分为左右两栏：左侧是“1 结构拆解图”，展示了三个菱形层级结构，并有“3 挥发率曲线 (VOLATILITY)”的标题；右侧是“2 使用说明”，通过图标和文字列举了香氛的涂抹位置和扩散方式。图片中部是一个大型线形图，描绘了香氛挥发率随时间（0h, 4h, 12h, 24h）的变化，并用粗体字标注了“前调”、“中调”、“后调”三个阶段。线形图下方是一个表格，标题为“4 组分特性 (INGREDIENT DATA)”，详细列出了不同香氛层次（前调、中调、后调）的组分名称、分子量、沸点、挥发速率和留香时长。表格下方是“5 扩散机制”的简要说明，解释了轻质分子和重质定香剂的特性。图片底部包含版权信息、红色字体标注的注意事项和页码。
prompt_en: This is an infographic on a white background, titled "调香金字塔" (Fragrance Pyramid), detailing the volatility kinetics and longevity sequence of fragrance components. The top of the image features the main title and a reference number "REF. 804. 298. 15". The upper section is divided into two columns: the left presents "1 结构拆解图" (Structural Disassembly Diagram) with three diamond-shaped hierarchical levels, and the heading "3 挥发率曲线 (VOLATILITY)" (Volatility Curve); the right column shows "2 使用说明" (Instructions for Use), listing fragrance application points and diffusion methods with icons and text. The middle of the image contains a large line graph illustrating the fragrance volatility rate over time (0h, 4h, 12h, 24h), with bold labels "前调" (Top Note), "中调" (Middle Note), and "后调" (Base Note) indicating different stages. Below the line graph is a table, titled "4 组分特性 (INGREDIENT DATA)" (Ingredient Data), which provides detailed information for various fragrance layers (top, middle, base notes), including component names, molecular weight, boiling point, volatility rate, and longevity. Further down, "5 扩散机制" (Diffusion Mechanism) briefly explains the characteristics of light molecules and heavy fixatives. The bottom of the image includes copyright information, a warning in red text, and page numbers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于USB接口与传输标准演进史的技术信息图。图片背景为浅棕色，顶部左侧是深灰色大标题“USB 接口与传输标准演进史”，下方有两行英文和中英文混合的副标题。图片右上角有一个红色边框的印章，内含俄文和中文“合格 1974.12.18”等信息。信息图主体内容分为五个编号分区，其中1至4区呈2x2网格布局，第5区横跨底部。第1区是一个表格，对比了不同USB版本的标准代号、原始命名、最大速率和物理接口。第2区介绍了电力传输规范PD 3.1，包含文字描述、功率与电压示意图，以及一个红色虚线框内的安全警示。第3区展示了TYPE-C 24-PIN双面引脚排布的文字说明和示意图。第4区通过文字和四种USB接口（TYPE-A、TYPE-B、MICRO-B、TYPE-C）的横截面图，展示了接口物理形态的演变轨迹。第5区以三点列表形式阐述了技术设计要求与局限性。图片底部是关于制图标准的脚注。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic detailing the evolution of USB interfaces and transmission standards. The image has a light brown background. At the top left, there is a large dark gray title "USB 接口与传输标准演进史" (USB Interface and Transmission Standard Evolution History), followed by two lines of subtitles in English and mixed Chinese-English. In the top right corner, there is a red-bordered stamp containing Russian text and Chinese text like "合格 1974.12.18" (Qualified 1974.12.18). The main content of the infographic is divided into five numbered sections; sections 1 to 4 are arranged in a 2x2 grid, and section 5 spans the full width at the bottom. Section 1 features a table comparing different USB versions by standard code, original naming, maximum speed, and physical interface. Section 2 introduces the power delivery specification PD 3.1, including a text description, a power and voltage diagram, and a safety notice within a red dashed box. Section 3 presents a text explanation and a diagram of the TYPE-C 24-PIN double-sided pinout. Section 4 illustrates the evolution of physical interface forms through text and cross-sectional diagrams of four USB connector types (TYPE-A, TYPE-B, MICRO-B, TYPE-C). Section 5 outlines technical design requirements and limitations in a three-point list. A footer at the bottom provides information about the drafting standard.

SECTION IV. 标准穿着程序
[ 穿着白色足袋 (TABI), 确保趾缝紧固。
[ 内层穿上肌襦袢与长襦袢, 修正身体轮廓。
[ 披上和服, 通过腰细调整长度 (形成“腰折”)。
[ 整理领口, 确保后颈留出约一个拳头的空间。
[ 绑扎伊达缔, 确保和服表面平整无褶。
[ 缠绕腰带 (OBI), 根据级别选择太鼓结或蝶结。
[ 最后插入带扬与带缔, 完成加固。
SECTION V. 材料与物理参数
警告 / WARNING
和服穿着遵循“左上前”原则 (左襟叠在右襟上)。禁止反向叠放, 那是专门用于入殓死者 的穿法, 会造成极大的文化冒犯。

prompt_en: This is an infographic titled "Japanese Kimono Classification Guide," primarily in dark green and light beige tones. The top of the image features the main title "日本和服分类指南" (Japanese Kimono Classification Guide) and a subtitle "战地手册编号: MACV-JK-1968 | 绝密等级: 公开执行" (Field Manual No: MACV-JK-1968 | Classification Level: Public Execution). The page is laid out in two columns. The left column includes "SECTION I. 正式等级量化" (SECTION I. Formal Ranking Quantification), which contains textual explanations about kimono selection and a horizontal bar chart displaying formality scores (0-100 scale) for different kimono types, including Kurotomesode/Furisode, Irotomesode, Houmongi, Tsukesage/Iromuji, Komon/Tsumugi, and Yukata, along with their respective scores. Below this is "SECTION II. 结构几何分解" (SECTION II. Structural Geometric Decomposition), featuring a simplified line drawing of a kimono with labeled parts such as "领 (ERI)" (collar), "袖 (SODE)" (sleeve), "衽 (OKUMI)" (overlapping panel), and "裾 (SUSO)" (hem). At the bottom of the left column is a warning box with a red title "警告 / WARNING" (Warning / WARNING), explaining the "left over right" rule for wearing kimonos. The top of the right column presents "SECTION III. 规格与场合矩阵" (SECTION III. Specifications and Occasion Matrix), which includes a table detailing kimono "种类" (Type), "婚姻" (Marital Status), "纹章数" (Number of Crests), and "典型场合" (Typical Occasion). Below the table is "SECTION IV. 标准穿着程序" (SECTION IV. Standard Wearing Procedure), providing a bulleted list of steps for wearing a kimono. The bottom of the right column contains "SECTION V. 材料与物理参数" (SECTION V. Materials and Physical Parameters), showing specific values and descriptions for Furisode sleeve length and Tanmono width, along with a note about kimono materials and weight. The bottom of the image features a footer with information such as "MACV FIELD MANUAL // NO. 350-1968 // CULTURAL INTELLIGENCE," "PAGE 184 / 350," and "CONFIDENTIAL - DO NOT DUPLICATE."

RADICAL: 魚 (FISH) · SECTION: EDOMAE SUSHI
INDEX: NI – SU | PAGE 284
Shari [ shè li ]
① The vinegared rice base of sushi. Originating from the Sanskrit "sarira" (Buddhist relics), referring to the small white grains. ② Types: [ Akazu ] (Red Vinegar) made from fermented sake lees, characterized by deep umami and brown hue; [ Shirozu ] (White Vinegar) for a cleaner, sharper profile. ③ Preparation: Rice must be polished and cooked to be firm (al dente). Mixed while hot to ensure absorption.
TEMPERATURE & TEXTURE METRICS
Optimal Flavor Peak
Rice Prep
Serving (36°C)
Cooling
Akami [ chi shēn ]
① Lean meat of Bluefin Tuna (Maguro). Found near the spine. ② Flavor: High iron content gives a subtle metallic tang and deep red color. ③ Technique: Often marinated in soy sauce (Zuke) to enhance preservation and tighten texture.
Hikarimono [ fā guāng yú ]
① "Shiny things." Silver-skinned fish such as Kohada (Gizzard Shad), Saba (Mackerel), and Sanma. ② Essential process: [ Su-jime ] The fish is salted to draw out moisture and then rinsed in rice vinegar to neutralize fishiness and firm the flesh. ③ Kohada is considered the "King of Edomae," where the chef's skill is judged by the duration of the vinegar bath.
FAT CONTENT BY TUNA PART
Neta Part
Fat %
Aging Duration
Akami (Lean)
2-5%

15-25%

30-40%

45%+

Shiromi [ bái shēn yú ]
① White-fleshed fish like Madai (Sea Bream) or Hirame (Flounder). ② Usually served after 2-3 days of aging to allow enzymes to break down tough proteins into amino acids (Umami). ③ Often garnished with Sudachi or sea salt.
Nigiri [ wò zhī ]
① Hand-pressed sushi. The core technique of Edomae. ② The "Half-Air" rule: A perfect Nigiri should have a firm exterior to be picked up by hand, but a loose interior containing roughly 50% air by volume. ③ Hand temperature must be kept cool; the final sushi should reach 36°C, matching human body temperature for immediate consumption.
STRUCTURE OF A SINGLE NIGIRI
NETA (Fish)
SHARI (Rice + Air)
Nimono [ zhǔ wù ]
① Cooked ingredients, typically simmered in a dashi-soy-mirin broth. ② Examples: Anago (Sea Eel) and Hamaguri (Clams). ③ Topped with [ Nitsume ], a thick, sweet reduction made from the simmering liquid, providing a heavy finish to the meal.
Shellfish [ bèi lèi ]
① Includes Akagai (Ark Shell) and Hokkigai. ② Often "slapped" against the cutting board before serving to stimulate the nerves, causing the muscle to curl and firm up.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以海洋为主题的活动宣传海报。画面主体是一片深浅不一的蓝色水域，背景带有波浪纹理，模拟海洋环境。海报顶部中央是白色大字标题“聽見海 電影節”。左侧区域包含活动信息，从上到下依次是“GREENPEACE”、“OCEAN FILM FESTIVAL”和日期“8 June - 13 July 2025”。画面右上方有两只黑白相间的企鹅站在波浪形的“陆地”上。画面中央偏右有一名浮潜者在水中，多条深色鱼的剪影散布在蓝色水域中。左下方有一条浅蓝色的鲸鱼和一丛橙红色的珊瑚。海报右下角是一个圆形的人物肖像，肖像上方有中文文字“綠色和平”、“聽見海電影節大使”和“談善言 小姐”。左下角则列出了“Presented by Greenpeace 綠色和平”以及“Screening Venue 百老匯電影中心 broadway cinematheque”等主办方和放映地点信息。

The main subject of the image is a body of blue water with varying shades, featuring wave-like textures in the background, simulating a marine environment. At the top center of the poster is the large white title "聽見海 電影節" (Listen to the Sea Film Festival). The left side contains event information, from top to bottom: "GREENPEACE", "OCEAN FILM FESTIVAL", and the date "8 June - 13 July 2025". In the upper right of the image, two black and white penguins stand on a wave-shaped "land" feature. A snorkeler is in the water in the mid-right, with multiple dark fish silhouettes scattered throughout the blue water. In the lower left, there is a light blue whale and a cluster of orange-red coral. The bottom right of the poster features a circular portrait of a person, above which are Chinese texts "綠色和平" (Greenpeace), "聽見海電影節大使" (Listen to the Sea Film Festival Ambassador), and "談善言 小姐" (Ms. Tam Sin Yin). The bottom left lists "Presented by Greenpeace 綠色和平" and "Screening Venue 百老匯電影中心 broadway cinematheque" (Broadway Cinematheque) along with other organizer and venue information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以橙色为主色调的宣传海报，背景带有浅色纹理和模糊的环保主题图案。海报中央是一个螺旋状的路径图形，内部描绘了多个与碳中和相关的插画场景，包括分类垃圾桶、绿色植物、风力发电机、城市建筑、垃圾分类的人、建筑设计工具、电脑显示器以及排放绿色烟雾的工厂。海报左上角是带有“CARBON NEUTRALITY EXPO”字样的白色月桂花环状商标和“TM”标志。右上角是“首届上海国际碳博会”的活动信息，包括“06.11~06.14”的日期和“国家会展中心”的地点。海报中部，螺旋图形周围，是中文主标题“走向碳中和之路”，下方是英文副标题“Path to Carbon Neutrality”。海报底部有三行白色文字，列出了上海市在建筑节能和碳排放监测方面的具体目标数据。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster predominantly in orange, with a light-textured background featuring subtle, blurred environmental-themed patterns. At the center of the poster is a spiral path graphic, illustrating multiple scenes related to carbon neutrality, including sorting trash bins, green plants, wind turbines, city buildings, people sorting waste, architectural design tools, a computer monitor, and factories emitting green smoke. In the upper left corner is a white laurel wreath-shaped logo with "CARBON NEUTRALITY EXPO" and a "TM" mark. The upper right corner displays event information for the "首届上海国际碳博会" (First Shanghai International Carbon Expo), including the date "06.11~06.14" and the venue "国家会展中心" (National Exhibition and Convention Center). In the middle of the poster, surrounding the spiral graphic, is the Chinese main title "走向碳中和之路" (Path to Carbon Neutrality), with the English subtitle "Path to Carbon Neutrality" below it. The bottom of the poster features three lines of white text, detailing specific target data for Shanghai's building energy conservation and carbon emission monitoring.

prompt_cn: 这是一张生活照片，展示了一个孩子在镜子中的反射。孩子坐在灰色的地毯上，穿着绿色连帽衫和黑色短裤，一头卷发，脸部被一个黄色矩形遮挡。他左手腕戴着一块蓝色数字手表，左手拿着一部浅蓝色智能手机给自己拍照。镜子是透明塑料边框，两侧装饰着多张卡通动物贴纸，包括熊、乌龟、蜜蜂、男孩、猫、狗和猴子等。背景是浅蓝色的墙壁，一扇带有白色百叶窗的窗户，以及散落的玩具和家具。右上方墙壁上挂着一幅卡通动物（熊和松鼠）的画作。孩子绿色连帽衫胸前有一个白色的字母“R”和一些被手机和胳膊挡住的字母。
prompt_en: This is a casual photograph showing a child’s reflection in a mirror. The child is sitting on a gray carpet, wearing a green hoodie and black shorts. He has curly hair, and his face is obscured by a yellow rectangle. A blue digital watch is worn on his left wrist, and he is holding a light blue smartphone in his left hand to take a mirror selfie. The mirror has a transparent plastic frame decorated on both sides with cartoon stickers, including bears, a turtle, a bee, a boy, cats, dogs, and a monkey. In the background are light blue walls, a window with white blinds, scattered toys, and furniture. A cartoon illustration of a bear and a squirrel hangs on the upper-right wall. The front of the child’s green hoodie features a white letter “R” and several additional letters partially obscured by the phone and his arm.

prompt_en: This is an infographic about the Apollo 11 lunar mission, set against a light beige background. At the top left, there is a large red title "APOLLO 11", followed by a large black title "THE LUNAR CONQUEST". At the top right, there is a title "SATURN V STRUCTURE" with its subtitle "TECHNICAL SCHEMATIC / 1:1000 SCALE", below which is a structural diagram of the Saturn V rocket. The diagram labels components such as "ESCAPE TOWER", "CSM/LM PAYLOAD", "S-IVB STAGE", "S-II STAGE", "S-IC STAGE", and "KEROSENE/LOX", with some text in red. In the middle left, a red rectangular area contains a large white title "THE EIGHT DAY MANIFESTO" and two paragraphs of white body text describing the mission's background. Below the red area is the title "VESSEL COMPONENTS", followed by parallel descriptions of "COLUMBIA (CSM)" and "EAGLE (LM)". In the middle right, a table presents data for different rocket stages, including "STAGE", "PROPELLANT", and "THRUST (KN)". Across the middle of the page is a large red title "THE 384,000 KM TRAJECTORY", beneath which is a diagram illustrating the Earth-to-Moon trajectory, labeled with "EARTH", "MOON", "OUTBOUND: 3 DAYS", and "INBOUND: 3 DAYS". To the right of the trajectory diagram, a "MISSION STATISTICS" section lists data such as distance covered, lunar stay duration, EVA duration, sample weight, and landing site, accompanied by a descriptive paragraph. Across the bottom of the page is a large black title "CHRONOLOGY OF THE MISSION", followed by a detailed mission timeline table with columns for "DATE (1969)", "MISSION EVENT", and "VELOCITY / STATUS". The very bottom of the page displays footer information: "CLASSIFICATION: HISTORICAL RECORD", "ARCHIVE REF: NASA-AP11-MSN", and "PAGE 082".

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个用于管理协作成员权限设置的用户界面。界面整体布局清晰，分为顶部标题栏、左侧成员列表面板、右侧权限设置面板以及底部状态栏。顶部标题栏居中显示主标题“协作成员权限设置”，其下方是项目信息“项目：2024 核心产品研发迭代计划”，右侧则并列有“取消”和“保存更改”两个按钮，其中“保存更改”按钮呈蓝色高亮。左侧面板顶部设有一个“搜索成员...”的输入框占位符，下方依次列出了三位成员的信息，每位成员都包含头像、姓名和对应的角色，例如“陈梓豪 项目负责人”。右侧面板分为“全局角色分配”和“详细权限控制”两个主要区域。“全局角色分配”区域展示了“管理员”、“编辑者”和“查看者”三个角色卡片，其中“管理员”卡片被蓝色边框和蓝色文字高亮，表示当前选中，并附有描述“拥有所有权限”。“详细权限控制”区域则列出了三项具体的权限设置，每项包含权限名称、详细描述和一个开关。其中，“文档编辑权限”和“成员邀请与移除”的开关处于开启状态（蓝色），而“导出与下载数据”的开关则处于关闭状态（灰色）。界面的底部状态栏左侧显示“所有更改已实时同步”的提示信息，右侧显示“最后操作：2023-10-27 14:30”的时间戳。界面背景色为浅灰色或白色，主要文字颜色为深灰色或蓝色。

The overall interface layout is clear, divided into a top title bar, a left member list panel, a right permission settings panel, and a bottom status bar. To the right, there are two buttons, "取消" (Cancel) and "保存更改" (Save Changes), with the "保存更改" button highlighted in blue. The top of the left panel features an input field placeholder "搜索成员..." (Search Members...), below which three member entries are listed. Each entry includes an avatar, name, and corresponding role, such as "陈梓豪 项目负责人" (Chen Zihao Project Manager). The right panel is divided into two main sections: "全局角色分配" (Global Role Assignment) and "详细权限控制" (Detailed Permission Control). The "全局角色分配" area presents three role cards: "管理员" (Administrator), "编辑者" (Editor), and "查看者" (Viewer). The "管理员" card is highlighted with a blue border and blue text, indicating it is currently selected, and includes the description "拥有所有权限" (Possesses all permissions). The "详细权限控制" area lists three specific permission settings, each comprising a permission name, a detailed description, and a toggle switch. The toggles for "文档编辑权限" (Document Editing Permission) and "成员邀请与移除" (Member Invitation and Removal) are in the ON state (blue), while the toggle for "导出与下载数据" (Export and Download Data) is in the OFF state (gray). The bottom status bar shows the message "所有更改已实时同步" (All changes have been synchronized in real-time) on the left and the timestamp "最后操作：2023-10-27 14:30" (Last operation: 2023-10-27 14:30) on the right. The interface background is light gray or white, and the main text colors are dark gray or blue.
