This is a character design sheet featuring a female character named LUNA ART (露娜·阿特). At the top center is the title “LUNA ART 露娜·阿特,” followed by the subtitle “用画笔描绘整个世界。” (“Painting the whole world with a brush.”).

Colorful paint splatters decorate both her jacket and apron. The left section lists basic character information, including her name, age, height, blood type, academy affiliation, role, and personality.
Below it, the “OUTFIT & GEAR 服装与装备” section displays labeled illustrations of her jacket, shirt, overalls, socks, apron, and shoes. The Expressions section shows six facial expressions: neutral, smiling, winking, serious, surprised, and inspired. Additional close-up images highlight paint splatters, a scarf, paintbrushes tucked into a pocket, and graffiti-style decoration on her shoes.
At the bottom left, the “PROFILE 个人简介” section describes LUNA ART as an artist who builds a personal world through color and imagination. Her work combines observations of everyday life, inner emotions, and free expression, forming a distinctive visual language through vivid colors, fluid lines, and expressive compositions. Moving between reality and fantasy, her art explores growth, self-confidence, and inner strength. Through continuous experimentation and practice, she refines her personal style and seeks to use art as a bridge between herself and the wider world.
The bottom center contains the “STORY KEYWORDS 故事关键词” section, listing art, academy, color, creativity, friendship, and dreams. The bottom right features the “SIGNATURE 签名” section, including a handwritten “LUNA ART” signature and labels for “手写签名” (“Handwritten Signature”) and “画笔图标” (“Paintbrush Icon”).

text:
亚马逊热带雨林垂直生态系统
自然史大展·垂直结构与微气候分布图谱
NO. AMZ-1851-992
I. 露生层 (40-60M)
EMERGENT LAYER
此层由极少数巨大的树木组成,它们冲破了连续的林冠顶部。由于直接暴露在外界,这些巨树必须承受极强的日照辐射、剧烈的气温波动以及强劲的风力。典型植物包括南美木棉,它们拥有巨大的板根以维持稳定。
物种观察: 角雕 (HARPY EAGLE)、金刚鹦鹉、大闪蝶。这些生物拥有极佳的视野与飞行能力。
垂直分层结构示意
生态平衡
III. 林下层 (2-20M)
UNDERSTORY LAYER
这里光照微弱,仅有2-15%的阳光能穿透上方。这里的植物进化出了宽大的深绿色叶片,以捕获每一丝微光。由于空气流动极少,这里的湿度常年保持在极高水平,是昆虫和两栖类的天堂。
典型物种: 美洲豹、红眼树蛙、竹节虫。许多在此生活的动物演化出了鲜艳的警告色或极佳的拟态能力。
60M
II. 林冠层 (20-40M)
CANOPY LAYER
雨林生命的“屋顶”。这里浓密的叶片截留了约80%的阳光和大部分降水。这是生物多样性最集中的区域,占据了雨林90%的物种。附生植物如兰花、凤梨科植物在这里直接从空气中摄取水分。
代表生物: 巨嘴鸟、树懒、吼猴、蜘蛛猴。这里的食物供应最为充足。
40M
IV. 地表层 (0-2M)
FOREST FLOOR
光照几乎为零。植被极为稀疏,主要由真菌、蕨类和腐生植物组成。这是一个强大的循环系统,落叶、枯枝和动物遗骸在这里被迅速分解,养分被表层根系重新吸收,支撑起上方的庞大森林。
主要栖息者: 切叶蚁、巨型食蚁兽、各种甲虫。分解作用在这里以惊人的速度进行。

The image features a dark blue background with the main title "亚马逊热带雨林垂直生态系统" (Amazon Tropical Rainforest Vertical Ecosystem) and subtitle "自然史大展·垂直结构与微气候分布图谱" (Natural History Exhibition · Vertical Structure and Microclimate Distribution Atlas) at the top. The top right corner displays the serial number "NO. AMZ-1851-992". The main body of the chart is divided into two columns of text descriptions on the left and right, and a central diagram illustrating the vertical structure. The left column describes "I. 露生层 (40-60M)" (Emergent Layer) and "II. 林冠层 (20-40M)" (Canopy Layer), while the right column describes "III. 林下层 (2-20M)" (Understory Layer) and "IV. 地表层 (0-2M)" (Forest Floor). Each layer includes its English name, a textual introduction, and observations of typical species. The central vertical structure diagram shows the relative positions of the four rainforest layers along a height axis (0M-60M), with a triangular icon labeled "生态平衡" (Ecological Balance) above it. The bottom of the image contains a table and a bar chart. The table compares "生态参数" (Ecological Parameters), including light ratio, relative humidity, wind speed intensity, and temperature fluctuation, across the four rainforest layers. The bar chart in the bottom right, titled "生物多样性指数" (Biodiversity Index), illustrates the biodiversity of each layer, with the canopy layer showing the highest index. The footer includes "ROYAL SOCIETY", "EST. 1851", a Chinese statement about the atlas's certification and rainforest protection, and the date "DATE: 21 OCT 1851" in the bottom right.

text:
THE STRATIFICATION OF TROPICAL
RAINFORESTS
热带雨林四级垂直成层结构与物种分布
The tropical rainforest is not a monolithic wall of green but a sophisticated architectural marvel divided into four distinct vertical tiers. Each stratum possesses a unique microclimate—defined by variance in solar radiation, humidity, and wind velocity—which dictates the biological specializations of its inhabitants. In the basin of the Amazon, this verticality allows for a density of life unparalleled elsewhere on the terrestrial globe.
01. The “Ceiba pentandra” (Kapok) often pierces the emergent layer, reaching heights of seventy meters. Its massive buttress roots provide the necessary stability against high-altitude winds.
I. VISUALIZING THE VERTICAL COLUMN
02. Lianas, or woody vines, provide essential arboreal highways, connecting the understory to the canopy, allowing non-avian species to navigate the vertical planes.
03. Light intensity at the forest floor is frequently less than one percent of that recorded at the canopy summit, creating a permanent twilight.

VISUALIZING THE VERTICAL COLUMN”，接着是图1.0，展示了热带雨林四个垂直层级（Emergent, Canopy, Understory, Floor）的高度范围和生物量分布，高度轴从0m到70m，生物量以不同大小的灰色几何图形表示。图1.0下方是第二个章节标题“II. COMPARATIVE STRATIGRAPHY DATA”，其下方是一个表格，详细列出了四个层级的名称、海拔高度、太阳光照百分比和代表性动物。表格下方是一段引文，内容关于森林的光线过滤，并署名“ATTRIBUTED TO ALEXANDER VON HUMBOLDT”。引文下方是第三个章节标题“III. LIGHT ATTENUATION & SPECIES DENSITY”，接着是图2.0，这是一个组合图表，用灰色条形图表示四个层级（Floor, Canopy (90%), Understory, Emergent），并用一条从左下到右上的红色折线表示太阳光的穿透率。图2.0下方是最后一段正文，重点描述了冠层和森林地面的生物活动。右侧辅助信息栏包含五个编号的斜体段落，提供了关于特定物种或生态现象的补充说明。底部是元数据，包括“Catalog No. 350-A”、“Plate XVII: Sylva Tropica”和“Printed in the Year 2024”。

At the top are the English main title "THE STRATIFICATION OF TROPICAL RAINFORESTS" and the Chinese subtitle "热带雨林四级垂直成层结构与物种分布". The main content area on the left begins with an introductory text about the rainforest's layered structure, featuring a red drop cap 'T'. Below this is the first section title "I. The height axis ranges from 0m to 70m, and biomass is represented by gray geometric shapes of varying sizes. Below Figure 1.0 is the second section title "II. COMPARATIVE STRATIGRAPHY DATA", under which is a table detailing the name, altitude, solar percentage, and characteristic fauna for each of the four strata. Following the table is a quote about the forest's light filtration, attributed to "ALEXANDER VON HUMBOLDT". Below the quote is the third section title "III. LIGHT ATTENUATION & SPECIES DENSITY", followed by Figure 2.0. This is a combined chart using gray bar graphs to represent the four layers (Floor, Canopy (90%), Understory, Emergent) and a red line graph extending from bottom-left to top-right to indicate solar penetration. The final paragraph of body text below Figure 2.0 focuses on the biological activities of the canopy layer and the forest floor. The right supplementary information column contains five numbered, italicized paragraphs providing additional details on specific species or ecological phenomena. At the bottom are metadata including "Catalog No. 350-A", "Plate XVII: Sylva Tropica", and "Printed in the Year 2024".

「新凝者柔，久陈者坚。风土纪异，菌菌相生。」
一、 新鲜奶酪
未经陈化，水分最高。质地
如凝脂，富含液态乳清。

代表：卡芒贝尔 / 布里
三、 洗皮奶酪
盐水或烈酒定期洗刷。表皮
生红带菌，风味浓郁复杂。
代表：主教桥 / 马罗瓦勒
四、 蓝纹奶酪
接种青霉，贯通气道。针孔
处繁衍大理石状深蓝菌丝。
代表：罗克福尔 / 戈贡佐拉
五、 半硬质地
中度加压排出乳清，质地致
密微带弹性，口感温和。
代表：切达 / 豪达
六、 硬质奶酪
强力压榨经陈放，水分极
低。咀嚼时有氨基酸晶体感。
代表：帕玛森 / 格鲁耶尔

凝乳与脱水 / DEHYDRATION
水分控制是决定奶酪质地的首要物理因素。通过加热、切碎与压榨，乳清被不同程度地排出，赋予了从新鲜莫扎雷拉到帕玛森之间截然不同的硬度光谱。
菌群之演替 / SUCCESSION
熟化不仅是时间沉淀，更是特定菌群的代谢剧场。白霉菌由表及里分解蛋白质，使硬皮下呈现流心；而蓝纹青霉则在针孔通气处繁衍，雕琢风味。
晶体与风味 / CRYSTALS
长达数年的陈化过程中，水分持续蒸发，蛋白质降解为游离氨基酸。在特硬奶酪中常能咀嚼到微小结晶，此乃风味与岁月凝结的物理实证。

prompt_en: This is an information graphic about cheese classification, titled "Cheese Texture Spectrum and Six Major Fermentation Lineages". The chart is presented with a dark background and white text, featuring a clear structure. The top section includes the main title, the subtitle "Systematic Classification Based on Curd Drainage and Microbial Maturation Pathways", and on the right, accession number and classification details. The middle section, "Six Major Fermentation Categories and Physicochemical Characteristics", lists six types of cheese: Fresh Cheese, White Mold Soft Cheese, Washed Rind Cheese, Blue Cheese, Semi-Hard Cheese, and Hard Cheese. Each type is presented in a rectangular box with a brief description and representative varieties. Below this is a "Physical State Rheological Spectrum" timeline, illustrating the water content and maturation time for different cheeses. The bottom features three parallel text blocks, explaining the concepts of "Curd and Dehydration", "Microbial Succession", and "Crystals and Flavor". The footer includes information about the analysis institution and plate number.

Multiple blue vertical banners stand on either side of the arches; the left banner repeatedly displays the "TCS" logo, while the banner next to the right arch shows sponsor logos such as "TCS", "NB", "ivv", and "tcs". The rightmost banner vertically spells out "START". A large crowd and a city skyline are visible behind the arches. Two drones are flying in the upper left and upper right of the frame. text:
哥特式大教堂的六大结构创新
STRUCTURAL EVOLUTION OF THE GOTHIC CATHEDRAL
(1140–1270)
1. 尖肋拱顶 / Rib Vault
由交叉石肋支撑的拱顶，将重量通过骨架引导至四角的垂直支撑柱，摆脱了罗马式半圆拱对跨度的物理限制。
2. 飞扶壁 / Buttress
设置在教堂外部的半拱状支撑结构，抵消了高大中庭墙壁受到的侧向推力，使墙体得以大面积开窗。
3. 彩色玻璃 / Stained Glass
墙壁不再承担主要重量，演变为光影的载体。玫瑰窗（Rose Window）不仅是装饰，更是神学光的象征。
SPHERE OF LIGHT
4. 束柱 / Bundled Shaft
由多根细柱簇拥而成的巨柱，视觉上连贯至拱顶肋架，增强了空间向天国延伸的垂直深邃感。
BUTTRESS
ARC-BOUTANT
5. 石像鬼 / Gargoyles
兼具排水功能的雕塑，其狰狞形象象征着驱邪避恶。通过伸出的水道，有效防止雨水侵蚀基座石材。
NAVE
6. 巴西利卡 / Basilica
布局演变为十字形结构，极高的中庭（Nave）与侧廊形成鲜明高度差，强化了建筑内部的层次与神圣感。

text:
容器化技术与 KUBERNETES 编排架构图谱
01 核心组件
容器化是一种轻量级的虚拟化技术，通过将应用程序及其所有依赖项打包在轻量化的镜像中，确保在任何环境下的运行一致性。Docker 引入了分层文件系统 (Layered FS)，极大地提升了分发效率。
DOCKERFILE 核心指令
FROM: 指定基础镜像
RUN: 执行构建命令
COPY: 复制本地文件
EXPOSE: 声明运行端口
CMD: 容器启动命令
可写容器层 (WRITABLE CONTAINER LAYER)
应用程序 (APPLICATION SOURCE)
依赖库 (LIBRARIES / DEPENDENCIES)
基础镜像层 (READ-ONLY BASE OS)
图 1.1: DOCKER 镜像分层结构示意图
02 隔离机制
容器并非虚拟机，它共享宿主机的内核。利用 Linux 内核的两个关键特性实现隔离与限制: Namespaces 提供视图隔离，Cgroups 提供资源配额。
在生产环境中，隔离性是安全性的基础。容器通过对 CPU 和内存的精确配额 (Quota)，防止单个服务因资源滥用而耗尽物理主机资源。
NAMESPACES (隔离)
PID (进程 ID 空间)
NET (网络设备隔离)
MNT (挂载点隔离)
CGROUPS (限制)
CPU (使用上限/周期)
MEMORY (内存限制)
IO (磁盘吞吐量)
图 2.1: LINUX 内核隔离限制技术
03 集群架构
Kubernetes (K8s) 是生产级别的容器编排系统。它将集群分为控制平面 (Control Plane) 和工作节点 (Worker Nodes)，通过声明式配置管理数万个容器的状态。
POD: 最小调度单位
Pod 是 K8s 的最小单元，一个 Pod 可以包含多个紧密协作的容器，它们共享同一个 IP 地址、网络空间和存储卷。
组件名称
附属功能
核心功能描述
API SERVER
控制平面
集群统一入口，处理所有 REST 请求
ETCD
控制平面
高可用键值存储，保存集群所有元数据
SCHEDULER
控制平面
根据资源需求将 POD 分配到最佳节点
KUBELET
工作节点
在节点上管理容器生命周期
KUBE-PROXY
工作节点
实现集群网络规则与负载均衡
状态监控: 24/7/365
自愈能力: 自动重启
04 性能对比
技术趋势 2024
从 Docker 到 ContainerD 的演进反映了云原生领域对轻量化、专业化的极致追求。CRI 接口的标准化使得集群调度更纯粹。
虚拟机 (VM)
原生容器 (DOCKER)
轻量容器 (CONTAINERD)
技术规格: X86_64/ARM64 兼容 | 云原生计算基金会 (CNCF) 纪念项目 | 2024 内部参考资料

prompt_cn:
这张图片是一份关于容器化技术与Kubernetes编排架构的图谱信息图。页面整体采用白色背景和深灰色文字，并以蓝色和黄色作为强调色，布局清晰。内容分为四个主要部分，从01到04编号，每个部分都包含左侧的主体内容和图表，右侧则提供补充说明或相关信息。
第一部分“核心组件”通过文字解释容器化技术，并配有一张蓝色的Docker镜像分层结构示意图，展示了可写容器层、应用程序、依赖库和基础镜像层。右侧列出了DOCKERFILE的核心指令。
第二部分“隔离机制”阐述了容器的隔离与限制原理，并用并列的图表展示了NAMESPACES（隔离）和CGROUPS（限制）的具体项目，如PID、NET、MNT、CPU、MEMORY和IO。
第三部分“集群架构”介绍了Kubernetes集群的组成，右侧详细说明了POD作为最小调度单位。下方是一个表格，列出了API SERVER、ETCD、SCHEDULER、KUBELET、KUBE-PROXY等组件的名称、附属功能和核心功能描述。右侧的黄色文本框突出显示了“状态监控: 24/7/365”和“自愈能力: 自动重启”。
第四部分“性能对比”通过一个蓝色柱状图比较了虚拟机、原生容器（DOCKER）和轻量容器（CONTAINERD）的性能。右侧的“技术趋势 2024”文字部分进一步阐述了云原生领域的发展。图片底部是页脚，包含技术规格和参考资料信息。
prompt_en:
This image is an infographic or technical diagram illustrating containerization technology and Kubernetes orchestration architecture. The page features a clean layout with a white background, dark grey text, and blue and yellow accent colors. The content is divided into four main sections, numbered 01 to 04, each presenting core information and diagrams on the left, with supplementary explanations or related details on the right.
Section 01, "Core Components," explains containerization technology with text and includes a blue layered diagram of Docker images, showing writable container layer, application source, libraries/dependencies, and read-only base OS. On the right, key DOCKERFILE instructions are listed.
Section 02, "Isolation Mechanisms," describes the principles of container isolation and resource limits. It features a parallel diagram illustrating specific items under NAMESPACES (isolation) like PID, NET, MNT, and CGROUPS (limits) such as CPU, MEMORY, and IO.
Section 03, "Cluster Architecture," introduces the components of a Kubernetes cluster, with a detailed explanation of PODs as the smallest scheduling unit on the right. Below, a table lists the names, auxiliary functions, and core functions of components like API SERVER, ETCD, SCHEDULER, KUBELET, and KUBE-PROXY. A yellow text box on the right highlights "Status Monitoring: 24/7/365" and "Self-healing: Automatic Restart."
Section 04, "Performance Comparison," uses a blue bar chart to compare the performance of Virtual Machines (VM), Native Containers (DOCKER), and Lightweight Containers (CONTAINERD). The "Technology Trends 2024" text on the right further discusses developments in the cloud-native domain. The footer at the bottom of the image provides technical specifications and reference information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于兆瓦级风力发电机内部结构的技术信息图。页面顶部标题为“兆瓦级风力发电机内部结构全解”，右侧有文稿编号和技术分类。图表内容分为四个主要部分：01.0 转子与空气动力系统、02.0 输出功率曲线、03.0 塔筒结构安全和 04.0 系统组件清单。页面中央是一个大型的“机舱核心架构”示意图，展示了变桨轴承、冷却单元、齿轮箱、发电机和偏航驱动等部件。左侧包含转子叶片描述和“叶片规格”表格，右侧是风力发电机输出功率曲线图及运行区间限制说明。底部左侧描述了塔筒结构，并列出了塔筒高度范围。底部中央是“系统组件清单”表格，详细列出了主变压器、齿轮箱等组件的代码、名称、技术指标和防护等级。右下角是“关键数据概览”，显示了额定功率、设计寿命和最大尖端速度等核心数据。页面底部包含版权信息、内部参考声明和页码。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic detailing the internal structure of a megawatt-class wind turbine. The page is titled "兆瓦级风力发电机内部结构全解" (Megawatt Wind Turbine Internal Structure Full Analysis) at the top, with document reference and technical classification on the right. The content is divided into four main sections: 01.0 Rotor and Aerodynamic System, 02.0 Output Power Curve, 03.0 Tower Structure Safety, and 04.0 System Component List. A large "NACELLE SCHEMATIC" diagram occupies the center of the page, illustrating components like pitch bearings, cooling units, gearbox, generator, and yaw drive. The left side includes a description of rotor blades and a "BLADE SPECS" table. The right side features an output power curve graph for the wind turbine, along with operational range limits. The bottom left describes the tower structure and lists the tower height range. The bottom center presents a "System Component List" table, detailing component codes, names, technical specifications, and protection ratings for items like the main transformer and gearbox. The bottom right displays "KEY DATA" overview, showing core metrics such as rated power, design life, and maximum tip speed. The page footer includes copyright information, an internal reference statement, and page numbers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色为背景的CPU存储层级技术图表。图表顶部中央是标题“CPU STORAGE HIERARCHY”，左上角有“ARCHITECTURE / SYSTEM LOGIC”标签，右上角有“ROUTE MAP ID ARCH-747-V2”标识。图表主体分为左右两大部分。左侧展示存储结构拓扑，包含一个金字塔图，从上到下依次标注为“REGISTERS”、“L1/L2 CACHE”、“L3 CACHE”、“SYSTEM RAM”和“NVME SSD”，金字塔右侧有橙色虚线箭头和垂直文字“CAPACITY INCREASE”，表示容量从上到下递增。金字塔下方是“DATA PATH VECTORS”部分，包含“EXECUTION CYCLE”副标题及一段解释性文字。再下方是“MEMORY PROTOCOL”副标题和“JEDEC DDR5-6400”。右侧是性能矩阵表格，列出了不同存储层级的“LEVEL”、“TECHNOLOGY”、“LATENCY”、“STANDARD CAPACITY”和“BANDWIDTH”数据，其中延迟数值以橙色粗体显示。表格下方是“LATENCY MAGNITUDE COMPARISON (LOGARITHMIC SCALE)”标题，接着是一个橙色柱状图，比较了各存储层级的延迟倍数，从“REGISTERS 1X BASE”到“NVME SSD 160,000X”，柱子高度逐渐增加。图表底部有三个信息框，分别显示“INTERFACE STANDARD”及其值“PCI EXPRESS GEN 5.0”、“CACHE LINE SIZE”及其值“64 BYTES (CONSTANT)”和“SYSTEM STATUS”及其橙色值“ALL TIERS OPERATIONAL”。图表页脚左侧是“FORM 1099-B // STORAGE HIERARCHY ATLAS // PAGE 142”，右侧是“DATA ACCURACY GUARANTEED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ARCHITECTURE”。

Below the table is the title "LATENCY MAGNITUDE COMPARISON (LOGARITHMIC SCALE)", followed by an orange bar chart comparing latency multiples for each storage tier, ranging from "REGISTERS 1X BASE" to "NVME SSD 160,000X", with bar heights progressively increasing. 清风雅辞
月照花林皆似霰
江流宛转绕芳甸
不知江月待何人
愿得一心人
相伴到白头
山水有清音
流传千年，诗意长存
清风入林，明月照心
相思相望，岁岁安然
人间有情，山河有暖
为君展卷，共赏春光
山水有清音，岁月共长歌

人类眼球解剖学

REFRACTIVE PATHWAYS & RETINAL IMAGING PHENOMENA
01 屈光介质通路 / REFRACTIVE SYSTEM
02 视网膜感光层 / RETINAL CELLS
03 脉络膜与盲区 / PHYSIOLOGY
屈光系统由角膜、房水、晶状体与玻璃体构成。角膜作为首要折射屏障，提供约 70% 的静态屈光力；晶状体则在睫状肌控制下改变曲率，实现动态调焦。折射后的光线通过长约 24mm 的眼轴，精确投影至视网膜。
视网膜感光层呈三级神经元排布。外层的视杆细胞对光极其敏感，可在单光子水平做出反应，但无法分辨颜色；视锥细胞集中于黄斑区，分为红 (L)、绿 (M)、蓝 (S) 三种，实现高清晰度彩色视觉。
视网膜代谢需求极高，脉络膜毛细血管网承载了眼球 85% 的血液流量，为其提供持续的氧气与营养供给。视神经纤维汇聚于视盘 (即盲点) 处穿出眼眶，该区域由于缺乏感光细胞，在视野中形成绝对盲区。

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于人类眼球解剖学的科学信息图。图片背景为深蓝色，整体布局清晰，分为顶部标题区、三列主要内容区和底部技术数据区。顶部标题为“人类眼球解剖学”，副标题为“屈光系统与视网膜细胞成像”及英文“REFRACTIVE PATHWAYS & RETINAL IMAGING PHENOMENA”。主要内容区包含三个主题，分别是“屈光介质通路”、“视网膜感光层”和“脉络膜与盲区”，每个主题都配有详细的中文文字描述、相关的图示或图表，以及关键数据总结。图示包括眼球横截面图、视网膜细胞结构图和细胞密度曲线图。底部是“TECHNICAL DATA SHEET”表格，详细列出了眼球各结构部件的标准曲率半径、折射率和轴向间距等数据。图片右下角设有一个颜色校准面板，包含黑、蓝、白、灰四种颜色块。大部分文字为白色，部分标题采用黑色文字在白色背景框中显示，关键数据则以蓝色粗体突出。
prompt_en: This image is a scientific infographic about human eye anatomy. The image features a dark blue background and a clear layout, divided into a top title area, three main content columns, and a bottom technical data section. The main title at the top is "人类眼球解剖学" (Human Eye Anatomy), with subtitles "屈光系统与视网膜细胞成像" (Refractive System and Retinal Cell Imaging) and the English "REFRACTIVE PATHWAYS & RETINAL IMAGING PHENOMENA". The main content area covers three topics: "屈光介质通路" (Refractive Pathways), "视网膜感光层" (Retinal Cells), and "脉络膜与盲区" (Choroid and Blind Spot). Each topic includes detailed Chinese text descriptions, relevant diagrams or charts, and key data summaries. The diagrams include a cross-section of the eyeball, a retinal cell structure diagram, and a cell density curve chart. At the bottom is a "TECHNICAL DATA SHEET" table, detailing standard curvature radii, refractive indices, and axial thicknesses for various optical segments of the eye. A color calibration panel with black, blue, white, and gray blocks is located in the bottom right corner. Most text is white, while some titles are black text within white background boxes, and key data is highlighted in bold blue.

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内展览厅的照片。展厅内光线较暗，顶部、墙壁和地面呈深色调，与明亮的白色玻璃展示柜和中央阶梯式展台形成对比。展厅的左右两侧及前方墙壁上设有三面大型玻璃展示柜，以时间轴的形式展示了山东考古学的发展历程。每个展示柜内都包含文字说明、历史照片、地图以及陶器、青铜器等文物。时间轴上的年份标签，如“1934”、“1954”等，以黄色方框突出显示。展厅中央是一个多层白色阶梯式展示台，上面整齐地摆放着多本图书，其中一本封面可见“山东考古六十年”字样。展厅顶部还可见一个监控摄像头。
prompt_en: This is a photo of an indoor exhibition hall. The hall is dimly lit, with dark-toned ceiling, walls, and floor, contrasting with the bright white glass display cabinets and the central tiered display stand. On the left, right, and front walls of the hall are three large glass display cabinets, presenting the development history of Shandong archaeology in a timeline format. Each display cabinet contains textual explanations, historical photos, maps, and artifacts such as pottery and bronze ware. The year labels on the timeline, such as "1934" and "1954", are highlighted in yellow boxes. In the center of the hall is a multi-tiered white display stand, neatly arranged with numerous books, one of which has "山东考古六十年" (Shandong Archaeology Sixty Years) visible on its cover. A surveillance camera is also visible on the ceiling of the hall.

prompt_cn: 这是一张教育机构的招生简章海报。海报背景由一条从左上到右下的对角线分为深蓝色和黄色两个区域。左上角深蓝色区域内，有“EDUCATION & RESEARCH”和“教育科研 · 赋能未来”的白色文字，下方是超大字号的白色主标题“招生简章”。主标题下方有半透明的浅灰色背景文字“OFFICIAL ENROLLMENT”。左下角深蓝色区域列出了两项内容：“01 优质资源”及其子项“对接核心教育科研机构”和“共享顶尖学术成长环境”，以及一个蓝色矩形框内的“升学通道”及其子项“直通名校联合培养项目”和“定制化个人规划路线”。右上角黄色区域内，有“少年宫唯一官方报名点”和“SINCE 1998”的白色文字。右侧中央有垂直排列的半透明浅灰色背景文字“FUTURE EDUCATION”。右下角黄色区域展示了一张现代建筑的照片，建筑前有几个人物，照片下方是带有黄色圆点的白色行动号召文字“立即前往预约”。
prompt_en: This is an enrollment brochure poster for an educational institution. The poster's background is diagonally divided into two areas, dark blue on the left and yellow on the right, by a line running from the top left to the bottom right. In the dark blue area at the top left, there are white texts "EDUCATION & RESEARCH" and "教育科研 · 赋能未来" (Education and Research · Empowering the Future). Below them is the large white main title "招生简章" (Enrollment Brochure). Beneath the main title, there is semi-transparent light gray background text "OFFICIAL ENROLLMENT". The dark blue area at the bottom left lists two sections: "01 优质资源" (01 Quality Resources) with its sub-items "对接核心教育科研机构" (Connecting with Core Educational and Research Institutions) and "共享顶尖学术成长环境" (Sharing Top Academic Growth Environment), and "升学通道" (Further Education Pathways) within a blue rectangular box, with its sub-items "直通名校联合培养项目" (Direct Access to Renowned University Joint Training Programs) and "定制化个人规划路线" (Customized Personal Planning Routes). In the yellow area at the top right, there are white texts "少年宫唯一官方报名点" (Children's Palace Only Official Registration Point) and "SINCE 1998". In the center right, there is vertically arranged semi-transparent light gray background text "FUTURE EDUCATION". The yellow area at the bottom right features a photograph of a modern building with several people in front of it, and below the photo, there is white call-to-action text "立即前往预约" (Book Now) preceded by a yellow dot.

prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a high-end restaurant, primarily in black, white, and gray tones. The central-right part of the image displays three pieces of raw Wagyu beef with clear marbling, placed on a white round plate, garnished with dark, crumbled ingredients. At the top left of the poster, there are the words "PREMIUM DINING EXPERIENCE" and "核心推介区" (Core Recommendation Area). On the top right, it reads "EST. 2024" and "RESTAURANT". Along the left edge of the image, "核心推介区" is vertically arranged as a decorative text, with "UNCOMPROMISING FLAVOR PROFILE" below it. Below the steak image, within a black background box, "SIGNATURE 主厨推荐" (Chef's Recommendation) is displayed. The bottom of the poster features the dish name "熟成和牛配 黑松露酱 / 01" (Aged Wagyu with Black Truffle Sauce / 01), followed by a detailed description: "精选澳洲M9级和牛，历经28天干式熟成。搭配现刨黑松露与主厨特调酱汁，在灰度美学中重塑味觉的极致边界。" (Selected Australian M9 Wagyu, dry-aged for 28 days. Paired with freshly shaved black truffle and chef's special sauce, reshaping the ultimate boundary of taste in grayscale aesthetics.) On the bottom right, the price "¥ 888" is shown, with "立即预约" (Book Now) and "RESERVATION ONLY" below it.

The overall color tone of the image is dark, with the background dominated by dark blue and purple, while the foreground floor is illuminated by warm yellow and orange light. The room is furnished with a bed, a guitar, a rocking horse, and a pink backpack. In the lower-central part of the image, a large silhouette of a dog is cast on the floor, occupying most of the area. A red bandana is placed in front of the silhouette. The textual information on the poster is concentrated in the lower half. Above the dog's silhouette, the director's credit "陆可 导演作品" is centrally aligned. Below the silhouette is the main movie title "来自汪星的你", displayed in large, orange-yellow gradient, centered text, followed by the English subtitle "Woof Woof Daddy". 堆高(Stack)与前伸量(Reach)是控制骑士上半身姿态的核心参数。两者共同决定了骑行时的俯仰角度与手臂伸展度，直接影响气动效率与操控稳定性。

/ STEERING DYNAMICS

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于自行车车架几何与骑行姿态控制的信息图。图片顶部是中文主标题“自行车车架几何与骑行姿态控制”及其英文副标题，右侧有“MGRS”标签。图片主体分为左右两栏和底部表格。左栏包含四个部分，分别详细阐述了“姿态控制参数”、“转向稳定性”、“轴距与重心”以及“战术图例”，每个部分都配有中文解释、英文副标题和相关的参数范围或图例说明。右栏展示了两张自行车几何示意图，图解01描绘了核心车架几何投影，标注了REACH（前伸）、STACK（堆高）、BB DROP（五通下沉）和WHEELBASE（轴距）等参数；图解02则展示了前叉控制向量与拖曳距，标注了STEERING AXIS（转向轴线）、HUB CENTER、HTA（头管角）、GROUND PLANE（地面）和TRAIL（拖曳距）。两张图之间有一行分隔文字。图片底部是一个“战术任务配置对照表”，以表格形式对比了公路竞赛、混合地形、林道越野和山地速降四种配置下的堆高、前伸、头管角、拖曳距和轴距等关键指标。整张图以浅灰色为背景，文字以黑色为主，部分辅助信息为灰色，图例和示意图中使用蓝色、红色和绿色元素。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing bicycle frame geometry and riding posture control. The top of the image features the main Chinese title "自行车车架几何与骑行姿态控制" with its English subtitle, and an "MGRS" label on the right. The main content is divided into two columns and a bottom table. The left column contains four sections, elaborating on "POSE METRICS," "STEERING DYNAMICS," "BASE & CENTER OF GRAVITY," and "TACTICAL LEGEND," each with Chinese explanations, English subtitles, and relevant parameter ranges or legend descriptions. The right column displays two schematic diagrams of bicycle geometry: Schematic 01 illustrates core frame geometry projection, labeling parameters such as REACH, STACK, BB DROP, and WHEELBASE; Schematic 02 shows steering dynamics, marking STEERING AXIS, HUB CENTER, HTA, GROUND PLANE, and TRAIL. A textual separator lies between the two diagrams. At the bottom, a "MISSION PROFILE CONFIGURATION MATRIX" table compares key metrics like STACK, REACH, HTA, TRAIL, and WHEELBASE across four configurations: Road Race, Gravel Profile, Trail Config, and Downhill. The entire infographic has a light gray background, with text primarily in black, some auxiliary information in gray, and blue, red, and green elements used in legends and schematics.

01 甲骨文与金文
殷
甲骨文刻于龟甲兽骨，笔画多折角，保留极强象形特征。其折角处锋利，透露出刀刻的刚劲与古拙感。金文铸于青铜，线条流畅圆润丰满，块面感显著增强，结构以圆构型。
02 小篆与隶书
秦
代李斯统一文字为小篆，结构呈纵向长方，线条均匀且圆滑对称。汉代隶变简化圆为方，创造“蚕头燕尾”之波磔，字形扁平，全面奠定汉字笔画之规范。隶变是汉字史上的关键转折，它打破了古文字的象形束缚。
03 楷书的确立
魏
晋至唐，楷书成熟，以颜柳欧赵为代表。字形横平竖直，结构严谨对称，成为标准规范书写体系。历代演变不仅是法度之更迭，亦是书写效率与美学之平衡。楷书确立了现代汉字的骨架，字形端正，法度森严。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于汉字五大字体演变史的信息图表。图表以深灰色为背景，主要文字为白色，部分标题、装饰性大字和图形元素使用红色进行强调。顶部是中英文主副标题“汉字五大字体演变史”和“EVOLUTION OF CHINESE WRITING SYSTEMS”，下方配有副标题“从殷商甲骨至魏晋楷书的结构性蜕变”。图表主体分为三个横向排列的内容区，分别介绍“甲骨文与金文”、“小篆与隶书”和“楷书的确立”，每个区域都包含一个红色大字作为装饰，以及详细的文字描述和相关的图例。左侧的图例展示了甲骨文的“契刻线”和“铸造体”，中间的图例则对比了小篆的“纵势对称”和隶书的“横势扁平”。图表右侧是一个“五大字体核心数据对照表”，详细列出了甲骨文、金文、小篆、隶书和楷书的字体、时代、主要载体和笔画特征。图表底部是注释和出版信息“帝国学术出版社 / IMPERIAL PRESS”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the evolution of the five major Chinese script styles. The chart features a dark gray background with most text in white, while some titles, decorative large characters, and graphic elements are highlighted in red. At the top are the main Chinese and English titles, "汉字五大字体演变史" and "EVOLUTION OF CHINESE WRITING SYSTEMS," followed by the subtitle "从殷商甲骨至魏晋楷书的结构性蜕变" (Structural transformation from Oracle Bone Inscriptions of the Shang Dynasty to Regular Script of the Wei and Jin Dynasties). The main body of the chart is divided into three horizontal content sections, introducing "Oracle Bone Inscriptions and Bronze Inscriptions," "Small Seal Script and Clerical Script," and "The Establishment of Regular Script," respectively. Each section includes a large red character as a decorative element, detailed textual descriptions, and relevant illustrations. The illustration on the left shows the "incised lines" and "cast forms" of Oracle Bone Inscriptions, while the middle illustration contrasts the "vertical symmetry" of Small Seal Script with the "horizontal flatness" of Clerical Script. On the right side of the chart is a "DATA TABLE" titled "五大字体核心数据对照表" (Comparison Table of Core Data for the Five Major Script Styles), which details the script style, era, main carrier, and stroke characteristics for Oracle Bone Inscriptions, Bronze Inscriptions, Small Seal Script, Clerical Script, and Regular Script. The bottom of the chart contains a note and publication information, "帝国学术出版社 / IMPERIAL PRESS."

She has long dark hair, wears a pair of fluffy rabbit ear hair accessories, and is dressed in ancient-style clothing predominantly white, accented with red and black, with flowing sleeves. The background is blurred, showing greenish-blue plants and scattered light spots, creating a soft and dreamy atmosphere. In the top-left corner is the cyan artistic title "观山梦", with the white subtitle "THE《落書·貳》LUOSHU" below it. The top-right of the image features vertical white poetic lines: "青山落叶盛 现书南柯梦". At the bottom-right is the brand name "YUNHUI 芸茴", with "芸茴" rendered in an artistic font. The bottom-left contains multiple lines of white production staff credits, while the very bottom center of the image displays an English disclaimer: "THE FALL OF FLOWERS IS NOT INTENDED, THE BOOK IS NOT INTENDED".

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示未来科技展厅内部的图片。画面中央是一个大型的建筑模型沙盘，其周围环绕着发光的青色线条，沙盘上展示着一个带有绿色植被和水池的现代化建筑群。沙盘后方是一块巨大的数字显示屏，屏幕上展示着一个带有太阳能电池板的建筑群俯视图，以及各种图表数据，屏幕右上角显示时间“03:00”，左下角有数字“6200”和“7000”。显示屏的背景墙壁上装饰有青色发光的六边形图案。左侧墙壁上，在太阳能电池板和彩色曲线图的上方，有两行白色中文文字，分别为“智慧基座”和“一绿色建筑与数字孪生”。沙盘两侧各有一个带有屏幕的互动式信息亭。图片右侧有一个模拟水流的装置，青色的管道中水流涌动。整个展厅以深色调为主，辅以明亮的青色灯光，营造出科技感和未来感。
prompt_en: This image displays the interior of a futuristic technology exhibition hall. In the center of the frame is a large architectural model sandbox, surrounded by glowing cyan lines, showcasing a modern building complex with green vegetation and a pool. Behind the sandbox is a massive digital display screen, which presents an aerial view of a building complex with solar panels, along with various charts and data. The top right corner of the screen shows the time "03:00", and the bottom left displays the numbers "6200" and "7000". The background wall of the display screen is decorated with glowing cyan hexagonal patterns. On the left wall, above a solar panel graphic and colorful curve charts, there are two lines of white Chinese text: "智慧基座" (Smart Foundation) and "一绿色建筑与数字孪生" (Green Building and Digital Twin). On either side of the sandbox, there is an interactive information kiosk with a screen. To the right of the image, there is a simulated water flow installation with water gushing through cyan pipes. The entire exhibition hall features a dark color scheme, complemented by bright cyan lighting, creating a sense of technology and futurism.

prompt_cn: 这是一张餐厅的节日促销海报。画面主体是一个高档餐厅的室内场景，透过巨大的落地窗，可以看到繁华的城市夜景。餐厅内部光线柔和，摆放着多张铺有白色桌布的餐桌和椅子，桌上可见餐具和装饰。画面右侧有高大的、装饰性的吊灯。海报整体色调以深棕色、金色和暖色灯光为主，与窗外城市夜景的蓝色调形成对比。画面上方和左侧有文字区域。主要文字包括品牌名称“御膳阁 IMPERIAL PAVILION”，活动主题“二零二四·岁末 FESTIVE SEASON”、“阖家团圆 岁末盛宴”，以及“节日限定 临窗雅座·尽揽繁华”等描述性文字。右侧边缘有竖排的装饰文字“良辰美景 赏心乐事”。左下角有关于套餐的详细介绍，右下角标示价格“¥2,888 每席 / PER TABLE”，并有一个红色印章状的“匠心 传世”字样。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a restaurant's festive season. The main subject of the image is the interior of a high-end restaurant, with a bustling city night view visible through large floor-to-ceiling windows. The restaurant interior is softly lit, featuring multiple dining tables and chairs covered with white tablecloths, along with visible tableware and decorations. On the right side of the image, there are tall, decorative chandeliers. The overall color scheme of the poster is dominated by dark brown, gold, and warm lighting, contrasting with the blue tones of the city night view outside the windows. Text areas are present at the top and left of the image. Key texts include the brand name "御膳阁 IMPERIAL PAVILION", the event theme "二零二四·岁末 FESTIVE SEASON", "阖家团圆 岁末盛宴", and descriptive text such as "节日限定 临窗雅座·尽揽繁华" (Festive Exclusive Window Seats · Embrace the Prosperity). Along the right edge, there are vertical decorative texts "良辰美景 赏心乐事" (Beautiful Scenery and Joyful Occasions). The bottom left provides a detailed introduction to the set menu, while the bottom right displays the price "¥2,888 每席 / PER TABLE" (per table), and a red stamp-like graphic with "匠心 传世" (Ingenuity Heritage).

prompt_cn: 这是一张以拼贴艺术风格呈现的时尚主题图片。画面中央是一位女性的脸部特写，她拥有深邃的眼睛、高挺的鼻梁和涂有亮红色唇膏的嘴唇，佩戴着金色耳饰。背景由撕裂的纸张、金色泼墨和报纸剪报构成，营造出一种复古而富有层次感的视觉效果。画面左侧边缘有红色和金色的织物纹理。左下角有两张拍立得风格的照片，展示了带有金色刺绣的印度传统服饰细节。右侧中部有三个香料罐，其中两个带有标签。画面右侧中部偏下是主要的英文标题“BOLLYWOOD HIGH FASHION”和“BOMBAY STREET EDIT”，以及印地语标题“मुंबई ठाठ”。底部中央有一个泰姬陵的黑色剪影。左下角有三个带有“SPICE”字样的标签。整体色调以深色、肤色、红色和金色为主，构图非对称，充满动感和时尚气息。
prompt_en: This is a fashion-themed image presented in a collage art style. The central focus is a close-up of a woman's face, featuring deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and lips adorned with bright red lipstick, complemented by gold earrings. The background is composed of torn paper, gold splatters, and newspaper clippings, creating a vintage yet layered visual effect. The left edge of the image shows red and gold fabric textures. In the bottom left, two Polaroid-style photos display details of traditional Indian attire with gold embroidery. On the mid-right, there are three spice jars, two of which have labels. The main English titles "BOLLYWOOD HIGH FASHION" and "BOMBAY STREET EDIT" are located in the mid-right-lower section, alongside the Hindi title "मुंबई ठाठ". A black silhouette of the Taj Mahal is visible at the bottom center. Three labels bearing the word "SPICE" are in the bottom left corner. The overall color palette is dominated by dark tones, skin tones, red, and gold, with an asymmetrical composition that conveys dynamism and a sense of fashion.

prompt_en: This is a vibrant oil or acrylic painting, characterized by distinct brushstrokes and an impressionistic style. The main subject is a male astronaut, depicted from the chest up. His face is turned towards the right, with a slight smile and his gaze directed into the distance. The background is an abstract cosmic sky, composed of various bright colors such as blue, purple, orange, green, and pink. Both the astronaut's suit and skin are rendered with the same vivid, high-contrast colors and brushwork, creating a dynamic artistic effect. On his right shoulder (viewer's left), there is a circular patch with a star-like emblem. On his left shoulder (viewer's right), there is another circular patch clearly displaying the word "NASA" and a red V-shaped symbol.

At the top of the image are three lines of text: a Japanese title "《竜騎士機甲戦記》", an English main title "DRAGONIA", and a Japanese subtitle "竜騎士のドラゴニアル世界戦記". prompt_en: This is an invitation card design set against a white background. At the top center, a dark red title "邀 请 函" (Invitation Letter) is displayed, followed by a black main title "乔迁之喜" (Housewarming Celebration) and a subtitle "古建修缮 · 雅筑落成" (Ancient Building Restoration · Elegant Residence Completed). A black and white photograph of a traditional Chinese architectural dougong (bracket set) structure is embedded slightly above the center of the page. Below the photograph is the main body of the invitation, beginning with "尊启者：" (To the Esteemed Recipient:), which details the housewarming event. Further down, information is presented in columns: the left column shows "【佳期】" (Date) with "二零二四年十月十八日 农历九月十六(周五)" (October 18, 2024, 16th day of the 9th lunar month, Friday); the right column shows "【雅集】" (Gathering) with "上午十时十八分 剪彩仪式及入宅礼" (10:18 AM, Ribbon-cutting Ceremony and Housewarming Ritual). At the very bottom, "【邸址】" (Address) is listed horizontally with "苏州市姑苏区平江路古建筑保护区 · 承德堂" (Pingjiang Road Ancient Architecture Protection Zone, Gusu District, Suzhou City · Chengde Hall). Light gray text "谨呈光临" (Your Presence is Cordially Requested) is in the bottom left, and "耕耘 耕耘 2024" (Cultivation 2024) is in the bottom right. A dark red rectangular border frames the entire page.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a financial trading application's user interface. The interface has a dark blue background and a clear layout, divided into a top navigation bar, left and right main content areas, and a bottom status bar. The top left displays the title "智投专业版 PRO" and the status "模拟交易系统·实时行情已连接" (Simulated Trading System · Real-time Quotes Connected), with a small green dot icon next to it. The top right shows "北京时间 2023-10-27 14:30:05" (Beijing Time) and the "JD" brand logo. The left main area presents financial data, including "总资产净值 (CNY) 12,480,256.00" (Total Asset Net Value) with a green increase of "+2.67%", and a "运行中" (Running) green label next to it. Below, "可用资金 4,210,500" (Available Funds), "证券市值 8,269,756" (Securities Market Value), and "当日盈亏 +42,890" (Daily P&L) with a green value are displayed side-by-side. The bottom left features an "资产收益曲线" (Asset Return Curve) chart, showing "分时" (Intraday) and "五日" (Five-day) options, with "五日" selected and highlighted with a green background. Dates "10-25", "10-26", and "今日" (Today) are labeled below the chart. The top right main area contains a "当前持仓 12项" (Current Holdings 12 items) list, detailing three stocks: "贵州茅台" (Kweichow Moutai), "宁德时代" (CATL), and "招商银行" (China Merchants Bank), including their names, codes, current prices, and percentage changes, where increases are green and decreases are red. The bottom right is the "市场要闻" (Market News) section, with an orange square icon next to the title, listing two news items: "14:25 央行今日开展5000亿元逆回购操作。" (14:25 Central Bank conducted 500 billion yuan reverse repurchase operation today.) and "14:10 半导体板块午后持续走强。" (14:10 Semiconductor sector continued to strengthen in the afternoon.). The bottom status bar displays index information for "上证 3,012.45 +0.45%" (Shanghai Composite Index) and "深证 9,852.10 -0.12%" (Shenzhen Component Index), and the "交易服务器已就绪" (Trading server ready) status with a green dot icon on the right.

text:
现代公路自行车车架几何
MODERN BICYCLE FRAME GEOMETRY & KINEMATICS
车架几何是连接运动员与路面的机械桥梁。通过对堆高 (Stack)、前伸量 (Reach)、头管角度及拖曳距 (Trail) 的精确量化，设计师可以在激烈的破风姿态与长距离耐力舒适性之间取得微妙平衡。
REACH / 前伸量
STACK / 堆高
HT ANGLE / 头管角度
AERODYNAMIC ENGINEERING
参数名称 / PARAMETER
竞技型 / RACE
耐力型 / ENDURANCE
头管角度 (HT Angle)
73.5°
71.5°
拖曳距 (Trail Value)
56 mm
63 mm
后下叉 (Chainstay)
405 mm
415 mm
轴距 (Wheelbase)
980 mm
1010 mm
五通下沉 (BB Drop)
68 mm
75 mm
核心参数解析 / TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
堆高 / STACK
520—580mm
五通中心到头管顶部垂直距离。直接决定骑行者的核心高程程度，堆高值越大，上半身越直立。
前伸量 / REACH
380—405mm
五通中心到头管顶部的水平距离。决定了手臂和躯干的伸展度，是判定车架尺码标准值的指标。
稳定性
拖曳距 / TRAIL
50—65mm
前叉转向轴与轮胎触地点间距。Trail越大，高速直行稳定性越强；越小则转向越灵敏。
后下叉 / CHAINSTAY
405—415mm
响应
五通中心到后轴中心的长度。较短的后下叉提供更直接的动力传输和更快的入弯响应。
头管角度 / HT ANGLE
71°—74°
响应
前叉转向管与地面的夹角。竞技车型常采用73°以上的角度，追求极致的转向反馈。
操控
操控系数 / STEERING
DYNAMIC BALANCE
综合头管角度与偏移量 (Offset) 生成的Trail值是现代公路车操控关键的终极秘密。
AGILITY / 灵活性 (SMALL TRAIL)
STABILITY / 稳定性 (LARGE TRAIL)
现代竞赛公路车优化区间 (55mm - 59mm)

prompt_cn: 这张信息图展示了现代公路自行车车架的几何参数及其对骑行性能的影响。图片以深灰色为背景，主要文字为白色和浅灰色，关键数值和图表线条则使用橙色突出显示。页面布局清晰，顶部是标题“现代公路自行车车架几何”及其英文副标题，下方是一段引言。中间区域左侧是一个带有橙色线条标注的自行车车架几何示意图，清晰展示了REACH（前伸量）、STACK（堆高）和HT ANGLE（头管角度）等关键参数。右侧是一个表格，对比了竞技型和耐力型自行车在头管角度、拖曳距、后下叉、轴距和五通下沉等参数上的具体数值。底部区域是“核心参数解析”，采用三列布局，详细解释了堆高、前伸量、拖曳距、后下叉、头管角度和操控系数等参数的定义、数值范围及其对骑行稳定性和响应的影响。图片底部还有三个标签，分别指示了“灵活性 (SMALL TRAIL)”、“稳定性 (LARGE TRAIL)”以及“现代竞赛公路车优化区间 (55mm - 59mm)”。
prompt_en: This infographic illustrates the geometry parameters of modern road bicycle frames and their impact on riding performance. The image features a dark gray background with text primarily in white and light gray, while key numerical values and chart lines are highlighted in orange. The page layout is clear, with the main title "现代公路自行车车架几何" and its English subtitle at the top, followed by an introductory paragraph. The central area on the left displays a geometric diagram of a bicycle frame, marked with orange lines to clearly show key parameters such as REACH, STACK, and HT ANGLE. On the right, a table compares specific values for parameters like head tube angle, trail value, chainstay, wheelbase, and BB drop for "RACE" (竞技型) and "ENDURANCE" (耐力型) bicycles. The bottom section, titled "核心参数解析 / TECHNICAL ANALYSIS," is arranged in three columns, providing detailed explanations of parameters such as stack, reach, trail, chainstay, head tube angle, and steering dynamic balance, including their definitions, numerical ranges, and effects on riding stability and responsiveness. At the very bottom, three labels indicate "AGILITY / 灵活性 (SMALL TRAIL)," "STABILITY / 稳定性 (LARGE TRAIL)," and "现代竞赛公路车优化区间 (55mm - 59mm)."

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于地球大气层垂直分层的信息图表。图表顶部包含文件流水号、标题“地球大气层垂直分层图”及其英文副标题，以及观测主体、重力场强度、数据基准、发货单位、总质量预估和状态确认等基本信息。图表中部左侧是一个垂直剖面示意图，展示了从对流层到散逸层的五个大气层，并用一条折线表示温度曲线趋势，同时标注了各层的大致高度（如12KM、50KM、85KM、600KM、10,000KM）。中部右侧列出了大气的主要化学组成及其百分比（氮气、氧气、氩气、二氧化碳及其他），下方是“货物状态描述”，简要说明了对流层和臭氧层的重要性。图表底部是一个详细的表格，按行展示了每个大气层的名称、高度范围、末端温度、物理特性与备注以及常见载荷。图表底部还包含技术总监签章、部门验证信息、总质量百分比和密级“绝密 TOP SECRET”以及版权声明。
prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the vertical stratification of Earth's atmosphere. The top section includes document serial number, the main title "地球大气层垂直分层图" with its English subtitle, and basic information such as observation subject, gravitational field strength, data baseline, issuing unit, estimated total mass, and status confirmation. The middle-left features a vertical profile schematic, displaying five atmospheric layers from the troposphere to the exosphere, with a line graph indicating temperature curve trends and approximate altitudes for each layer (e.g., 12KM, 50KM, 85KM, 600KM, 10,000KM). The middle-right section lists the main chemical compositions of the atmosphere with their percentages (Nitrogen, Oxygen, Argon, CO2/VAR), followed by "CARGO NOTES" briefly explaining the significance of the troposphere and ozone layer. The bottom part presents a detailed table, showing each atmospheric layer's name, height range, end temperature, physical characteristics/remarks, and common payloads. The very bottom includes a technical director's signature, department verification, total mass percentage, security classification "TOP SECRET", and a copyright statement.

prompt_cn: 图片展示了一个车载信息娱乐系统的界面截图，用于调节汽车座椅的舒适度。界面背景为深蓝色，带有细微的网格图案。顶部左侧是标题“座椅舒适度调节”，右侧显示“车内温度 24°C”和一个绿色圆形指示灯。界面主体分为左右两栏。左栏标题为“实时位置预览”，显示一张汽车座椅的俯视图，其中“腰撑区域”被浅蓝色光圈突出显示，上方有一个“主驾座椅”按钮。座椅下方显示“支撑高度 65%”和“支撑深度 42%”。右栏标题为“四向腰部支撑调节”，包含一个带有浅蓝色中心圆点的四向方向键，用于调节腰部支撑。方向键下方是“支撑强度 Level 4”和一个浅蓝色进度条。再下方是“记忆预设”区域，包含三个按钮：“1 通勤”、“2 长途”和“+ 保存”。界面底部有三个功能按钮：“重置位置”、“智能按摩”和“完成设置”，其中“完成设置”按钮为浅蓝色填充。
prompt_en: The image displays a screenshot of an in-car infotainment system interface, used for adjusting car seat comfort. The interface background is dark blue with a subtle grid pattern. At the top left is the title "座椅舒适度调节" (Seat Comfort Adjustment), and on the right, "车内温度 24°C" (Cabin Temperature 24°C) with a green circular indicator light. The main interface is divided into left and right columns. The left column, titled "实时位置预览" (Real-time Position Preview), shows a top-down view of a car seat, where the "腰撑区域" (Lumbar Support Area) is highlighted by a light blue halo, and above it is a "主驾座椅" (Driver's Seat) button. Below the seat, "支撑高度 65%" (Support Height 65%) and "支撑深度 42%" (Support Depth 42%) are displayed. The right column, titled "四向腰部支撑调节" (Four-way Lumbar Support Adjustment), features a four-way directional pad with a light blue central dot, used for adjusting lumbar support. Below the directional pad is "支撑强度 Level 4" (Support Intensity Level 4) and a light blue progress bar. Further down is the "记忆预设" (Memory Presets) area, containing three buttons: "1 通勤" (1 Commute), "2 长途" (2 Long-distance), and "+ 保存" (+ Save). At the bottom of the interface are three function buttons: "重置位置" (Reset Position), "智能按摩" (Smart Massage), and "完成设置" (Complete Settings), with the "完成设置" button filled in light blue.

prompt_cn: 这张图片由上下两个水平面板组成，展示了一位女性在办公室工位上的两种状态。在顶部面板中，女性戴着眼镜，身穿白色衬衫和深色西装外套，神情专注地看着电脑屏幕，屏幕上显示着编程代码，整体环境光线呈冷色调。面板上叠加有白色文字“看似在工位”。底部面板中，同一位女性穿着相同的服装，但姿态放松，双脚赤脚搭在电脑显示器上，身体向后靠，视线望向屏幕右侧，左脚踝上有一个卡通图案的纹身或贴纸。一双白色帆布鞋挂在显示器侧面，环境光线呈暖色调。面板上叠加有白色文字“心已在放假”。两个面板的办公桌上都放有纸质咖啡杯和便利贴，背景可见百叶窗和带有文件盒的置物架。图片通过对比展现了工作与放松的心境。
prompt_en: This image consists of two horizontal panels, depicting a woman in two different states at her office workstation. In the top panel, the woman, wearing glasses, a white shirt, and a dark suit jacket, is intently looking at a computer screen displaying programming code. The overall lighting in this panel is cool-toned. White text "看似在工位" (Seemingly at work) is overlaid on this panel. In the bottom panel, the same woman, dressed in the same attire, is in a relaxed posture, with her bare feet resting on the computer monitor, leaning back and looking towards the right side of the screen. A cartoon-patterned tattoo or sticker is visible on her left ankle. A pair of white canvas shoes hangs on the side of the monitor, and the environment's lighting is warm-toned. White text "心已在放假" (Mind is already on vacation) is overlaid on this panel. Both panels show paper coffee cups and sticky notes on the desk, with blinds and shelves holding file boxes in the background. The image contrasts the states of working and relaxing.

text:
WORLD CHEESE
TAXONOMY:
MOISTURE VS
MATURATION
This bivariate distribution illustrates the
fundamental relationship between water activity
and enzymatic aging in the five primary cheese
families. As moisture content decreases through
drainage, pressing, and evaporation, the shelf
stability increases, allowing for complex
proteolysis and lipolysis during long-term
maturation cycles ranging from weeks to several
years.
1. FRESH (HIGH MOISTURE)
Unripened curd with moisture levels often exceeding
60%. These cheeses are consumed immediately after
production to maintain delicate lactic acid profiles. No rind
formation.
2. SOFT-RIPENED
Moisture 50–60%. Surface-ripened with Penicillium
candidum (white mold), creating a creamy interior and a
thin, edible bloom. Aged typically 2–8 weeks.
3. SEMI-HARD
Moisture 40–50%. Pressed curds aged 3–12 months.
This category develops elastic textures and nutty profiles.
Examples include Gouda and traditional Cheddar.
4. HARD (GRATING)
Low moisture (~30%). Aged 12–36 months. High protein
concentration leads to tyrosine crystallization and intense
savory umami. Highly shelf-stable.
5. BLUE-VEINED
Internal mold maturation using Penicillium roqueforti.
Moisture varies but remains high enough to support mold
growth within internal air pockets.

prompt_en: This image is an infographic about cheese taxonomy, primarily illustrating the relationship between cheese moisture and maturation time. The main part of the chart is a scatter plot, with the Y-axis labeled "AGING DURATION (MONTHS)" and the X-axis labeled "MOISTURE CONTENT (PERCENTAGE WATER)". prompt_cn: 这是一张手机相机应用的用户界面截图。界面以深色背景为主，UI元素采用深灰、黑色，并点缀有粉色和红色。主视图显示一张女性面部的特写肖像，其面部有光泽，涂有红色口红。女性脸颊上有一个黄色小点和围绕它的圆形虚线，可能指示焦点或美颜区域。主视图下方是美颜调整区域，包含三个带有粉色进度条的滑块，分别对应“细腻磨皮”、“自然瘦脸”和“灵动大眼”功能，并显示85%、42%和60%的百分比数值。再下方是滤镜选择区域，展示了四个带有缩略图的滤镜选项，分别为“胶片”、“冷氧”、“落日”和“森系”。界面的最底部是导航栏，包含“录像”、“拍照”、“人像”和“专业”四个模式按钮，其中“拍照”模式被选中并以粗体粉色下划线高亮显示。底部左侧有一个圆形缩略图，显示一张人脸照片；底部中央是一个大的白色圆形快门按钮；底部右侧是一个循环箭头图标。界面左上角显示“RAW 12-BIT”字样，主视图底部中央有一个半透明深色背景框，内有“AI 实时美颜已开启”的提示信息。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile camera application user interface. The interface primarily features a dark background with UI elements in dark gray and black, accented with pink and red. The main view displays a close-up portrait of a woman's face, which appears glossy and has red lipstick. On the woman's cheek, there is a small yellow dot surrounded by a circular dashed line, possibly indicating a focus point or a beauty enhancement area. Below the main view is the beauty adjustment section, featuring three sliders with pink progress bars, corresponding to "细腻磨皮" (Delicate Skin Smoothing), "自然瘦脸" (Natural Face Slimming), and "灵动大眼" (Vivid Eye Enlargement) functions, displaying percentage values of 85%, 42%, and 60% respectively. Further down is the filter selection area, showing four filter options with thumbnails, labeled "胶片" (Film), "冷氧" (Cold Oxygen), "落日" (Sunset), and "森系" (Forest Style). At the very bottom of the interface is a navigation bar, containing four mode buttons: "录像" (Video), "拍照" (Photo), "人像" (Portrait), and "专业" (Pro), with "拍照" mode selected and highlighted by a bold pink underline. In the bottom left, there is a circular thumbnail displaying a person's face; in the bottom center, there is a large white circular shutter button; and in the bottom right, there is a circular arrow icon. The top left of the interface shows "RAW 12-BIT", and at the bottom center of the main view, there is a semi-transparent dark background box containing the prompt "AI 实时美颜已开启" (AI Real-time Beauty is On).

On the top right, there are Chinese date "五月初五" and event name "端午时节", with a slogan "仲夏之月· 龙舟竞渡" in an orange background box below them. The center of the poster features an aerial photograph of a dragon boat race, showing multiple dragon boats competing on the water, stirring up splashes. White text is overlaid on the photo, including "OFFICIAL TRACK", "500M 水上标准赛道", and on the right, "24°C WATER" and "1.2M/S FLOW" providing track information. Along the right edge of the image, the white English text "DRAGON BOAT FESTIVAL 2024" is arranged vertically. At the bottom of the poster are three side-by-side rectangular information cards, numbered with orange digits "01", "02", "03" respectively. Each card contains a white title and body text or list items, introducing the cultural heritage of dragon boats, the aesthetics of racing, and track specifications. At the very bottom center is the white English footer "TRADITIONAL SOLAR TERM VISUAL SYSTEM".

prompt_cn: 这是一张医疗诊断系统的用户界面截图。界面顶部是标题栏，显示“远程会诊报告生成系统 v4.2.0”和专家信息“专家: 林建国教授 主任医师”，以及“云端同步”和“新病例”按钮。界面主体内容分为三个垂直排列的面板：左侧是“患者档案”，显示患者姓名、性别、年龄“王建国 / 男 / 62岁”、门诊编号“ID-20231024-0089”和主诉情况，底部有日期“2023-10-24”和“完整病历”按钮。中间是“AI 辅助诊断”面板，其中包含一张图片，图中一名医务人员背对镜头，正在查看多个显示器上的医学影像，其中一个显示器上可见CT扫描图像，图像右下角有一个红色背景的标签“异常结节 (8.2mm)”。图片下方显示“冠脉狭窄概率 88%”和一个进度条，底部是建议文本。右侧是“会诊结论”面板，包含“诊断意见”的三个列表项和“治疗建议”的文本，底部有两个按钮“暂停”和“生成签名”。所有面板的标题都以深蓝色粗体显示，并带有左侧的蓝色竖线装饰。界面底部是页脚，包含系统响应时间、加密协议、备案信息和版权声明。整体配色方案以白色/浅灰色背景为主，搭配深蓝色、深灰色文字和按钮，以及绿色和红色作为强调色。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a medical diagnostic system user interface. The top of the interface features a title bar displaying "远程会诊报告生成系统 v4.2.0" (Remote Consultation Report Generation System v4.2.0) and expert information "专家: 林建国教授 主任医师" (Expert: Professor Lin Jianguo, Chief Physician), along with "云端同步" (Cloud Sync) and "新病例" (New Case) buttons. The main content of the interface is divided into three vertically arranged panels: The left panel, titled "患者档案" (Patient Archive), displays the patient's name, gender, age "王建国 / 男 / 62岁" (Wang Jianguo / Male / 62 years old), outpatient number "ID-20231024-0089", and chief complaint. At the bottom of this panel are the date "2023-10-24" and a "完整病历" (Complete Medical Record) button. The middle panel, titled "AI 辅助诊断" (AI Assisted Diagnosis), contains an image showing a medical professional with their back to the camera, viewing medical images on multiple monitors, with a CT scan visible on one screen. In the lower right of this image is a red-background label "异常结节 (8.2mm)" (Abnormal Nodule (8.2mm)). Below the image, "冠脉狭窄概率 88%" (Coronary Artery Stenosis Probability 88%) and a progress bar are displayed, with recommendation text at the very bottom. The right panel, titled "会诊结论" (Consultation Conclusion), includes three list items under "诊断意见" (Diagnosis Opinion) and text under "治疗建议" (Treatment Suggestions). At the bottom of this panel are two buttons, "暂停" (Pause) and "生成签名" (Generate Signature). All panel titles are displayed in dark blue bold text with a blue vertical bar to their left. The interface footer at the bottom includes system response time, encryption protocol, filing information, and copyright notice. The overall color scheme primarily uses white/light gray backgrounds, complemented by dark blue and dark gray text and buttons, with green and red as accent colors.

Next to them are a white squeeze bottle, several spray cans (the yellow can has "LAYA STAY OUD ROFESSION 65" text, and the blue can has "foam Chaum" text), a white tissue box (printed with "斯耐 COTTON SOFT FACE TOWEL 超厚质感加 柔软亲肤"), and a red and black electric tool. Two silver wrenches hang from hooks on the left side of the shelf. Below the shelf, a roll of blue paper towels is suspended. The entire scene is set against a light gray wall.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于计算机处理器架构和内存层次结构的详细信息图。图片顶部有一个红色的五角星图标，标题为“AUTHOR'S CERTIFICATE”，下方是编号“№ 074-CPU-2024”。右侧有一个方框，标有“USSR STATE STANDARD”和“GOST 28147-89”。图片主体分为左右两部分，左侧列出了“CORE ARCHITECTURE”、“EXECUTION PIPELINE”和“FABRICATION NODE”的详细信息，包括控制单元、算术逻辑单元、寄存器文件、指令获取、解码、执行、内存访问、写回等步骤，以及晶体管类型、光刻技术和密度。右侧是“MICROARCHITECTURE SCHEMATIC OVERVIEW”的示意图，其中包含一个标有“INSTRUCTION”的白色方框，下方有关于缓存容量的描述。右侧底部有四个黑色背景的方框，分别展示了“CLOCK SPEED (5.2 GHZ)”、“TDP RATING (125 WATTS)”、“IPC GAIN (+19% GEN)”和“THREADS (16 CORE)”等性能指标。图片中部是一个标题为“MEMORY HIERARCHY LATENCY SPECTRUM (CYCLES)”的条形图，展示了不同内存层级的延迟，Y轴表示周期数，X轴包含“REG”、“L1”、“L2”、“L3”、“RAM”等标签，并用红色和黑色条形图表示数据。条形图下方是一个表格，详细列出了不同内存层级（L1 INSTRUCTION, L1 DATA, L2 UNIFIED, L3 SHARED, SYSTEM RAM, STORAGE (NVME)）的容量、延迟、带宽和一致性信息。图片底部左侧是“TECHNICAL ENDORSEMENT”的声明，中间是“INSPECTOR ID”及其编号“REF-9920-X”，右侧是“DATE OF ISSUE (19.05.1984)”和一个红色的椭圆形印章，印章内有“APPROVED”和“DEPT. 04”字样。
prompt_en: This is a detailed infographic about computer processor architecture and memory hierarchy. At the top left, there is a red star icon, with the main title "AUTHOR'S CERTIFICATE" and the number "№ 074-CPU-2024" below it. To the right, a box displays "USSR STATE STANDARD" and "GOST 28147-89". The main body of the image is divided into two sections. The left section lists detailed information on "CORE ARCHITECTURE", "EXECUTION PIPELINE", and "FABRICATION NODE", including control unit, arithmetic logic unit, register file, instruction fetch, decode, execute, memory access, write-back steps, as well as transistor type, lithography, and density. The right section presents a "MICROARCHITECTURE SCHEMATIC OVERVIEW" diagram, featuring a white box labeled "INSTRUCTION" and a description of cache capacity below it. At the bottom right of this section, four black-background boxes display performance metrics: "CLOCK SPEED (5.2 GHZ)", "TDP RATING (125 WATTS)", "IPC GAIN (+19% GEN)", and "THREADS (16 CORE)". In the middle of the image, a bar chart titled "MEMORY HIERARCHY LATENCY SPECTRUM (CYCLES)" illustrates the latency of different memory levels. The Y-axis represents cycles, and the X-axis includes labels like "REG", "L1", "L2", "L3", and "RAM", with data represented by red and black bars. Below the bar chart, a table provides detailed information on capacity, latency, bandwidth, and coherence for various memory levels (L1 INSTRUCTION, L1 DATA, L2 UNIFIED, L3 SHARED, SYSTEM RAM, STORAGE (NVME)). The bottom left of the image contains a "TECHNICAL ENDORSEMENT" statement, the middle shows "INSPECTOR ID" with its number "REF-9920-X", and the bottom right displays "DATE OF ISSUE (19.05.1984)" and a red oval stamp containing "APPROVED" and "DEPT. 04".

prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the anatomy of a black hole. The image features a dark blue background, with the main content presented on a black area, and text primarily in white and orange. On the left, there are vertically arranged Chinese and English titles, "黑洞解剖" and "ANATOMY", along with "ATLAS PLATE NO. 084" and "OBJECTIVE / 目标" descriptions. The center of the image displays a schematic diagram of a black hole, illustrating the accretion disk, event horizon, and relativistic jet, indicated by white lines and red arrows. The right section contains formulas and detailed explanations under titles such as "SCHWARZSCHILD RADIUS", "TEMPERATURE / 霍金辐射", and "PHYSICAL DATA". Below, a "CORE STRUCTURE / 核心构造" title introduces the detailed internal structure of a black hole, including the central singularity and event horizon, accompanied by a table listing the types, mass ranges, and examples of stellar, intermediate-mass, and supermassive black holes. The far right features a vertically arranged English title, "EXTREME PHYSICS". The entire infographic systematically explains the physical characteristics and structure of black holes through a combination of text and graphics.

At the top center of the poster is the main title "夢在海潮那邊" (Dream on the other side of the tide) in black, calligraphic brushstrokes, with the English subtitle "THE TIDE IN HER DREAM" below it. Vertically arranged text on the left side lists cast and crew information and ticket prices, while promotional text is on the right. The bottom right corner displays the date "2025 10.16 Thu.-19 Sun." and location "國家戲劇院 National Theater", along with three organizational logos. The overall color palette is soft, creating a classical and poetic atmosphere.

苏联与美国巨大的工业产能是赢得战争的关键。即使德国坦克在技术指标上领先，但面对 10:1 的数量劣势，这种技术优势无法转化为战果。
05
战地维护与勤务性 / FIELD MAINTENANCE
T-34: 设计极为简练，适宜在极端恶劣环境下由低技术士兵操作维护。
M4 SHERMAN: 极佳的通用性，不仅可以通过起重机轻松吊运，其机械可靠性也远超德国坦克。
TIGER I: 维护噩梦，由于交错式路轮设计，更换内侧轮子需拆卸多个外轮。耗时巨大。
记住：一辆坏在路边无法启动的虎式坦克，甚至不如一辆能开动的日本 97 式。可靠性就是生命。

The content is divided into five numbered sections (01-05). Section 01 illustrates sloped versus vertical armor with diagrams of T-34 and Tiger I tanks. Section 02 presents a data matrix table detailing tank models such as Soviet T-34/85, German Tiger I, American M4 Sherman, and German Panther, comparing their weight, main gun, speed, and frontal armor. Section 03 displays a bar chart showing penetration depth references for different artillery. Section 04 lists the total production figures for the T-34 series, M4 Sherman, and Tiger I/Panther. Section 05 discusses the field maintenance and serviceability of the T-34, M4 Sherman, and Tiger I. Each section is accompanied by detailed textual explanations. The text in the image is predominantly white, with some numbers and key data highlighted in red.

prompt_cn: 这是一张网页浏览器的截图，展示了苹果公司关于M2芯片和MacBook Air的宣传页面。页面顶部是浏览器地址栏，显示“apple.com”。网页内容以白色背景为主，左上角有“M2 chip model”和“MacBook Air”字样。右上角是导航栏，包含“Overview”、“Why Mac”、“Tech Specs”和蓝色按钮“View Pricing”。页面中央展示了一块黑色的芯片图片，上面有银色的苹果标志和“M2”字样。芯片下方是小标题“Performance”，接着是蓝色渐变的大字标题“Prepare for take-off.”。下方是关于M2芯片性能的详细描述文本。页面底部并列展示了三组数据，分别是“Up to 1.4x faster than M1 model¹”、“Up to 15x faster than Intel-based”和“Up to 18 hrs battery life²”，每组数据都以蓝色大字突出显示。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a web browser displaying an Apple promotional page for the M2 chip and MacBook Air. The browser's address bar at the top shows "apple.com". The webpage content is primarily on a white background, with "M2 chip model" and "MacBook Air" in the top left. The top right features a navigation bar with "Overview", "Why Mac", "Tech Specs", and a blue "View Pricing" button. Centered on the page is a black chip image with a silver Apple logo and "M2" text. Below the chip is the subtitle "Performance", followed by a large, blue gradient title "Prepare for take-off.". Further down, there is a detailed descriptive text about the M2 chip's performance. The bottom of the page presents three sets of comparative data side-by-side: "Up to 1.4x faster than M1 model¹", "Up to 15x faster than Intel-based", and "Up to 18 hrs battery life²", with each data point highlighted in large blue text.

SAN-SENKE GENEALOGY

THE FOUR PRINCIPLES
WA

KEI
敬 RESPECT
SEI
清 PURITY
JAKU
寂 STILLNESS

The heavy iron kettle used to heat water. Positioned over charcoal.

Fresh water container used to replenish the kama and rinse bowls.

左上区域（01）标题为“SAN-SENKE GENEALOGY”，下方是一段关于千家流派起源的文字，以及一个包含“SCHOOL”、“ESTABLISHED”、“CHARACTERISTIC”和“FOAM TEXTURE”四列的表格，详细列出了表千家、裏千家和武者小路千家三个流派的信息。

右上区域（02）标题为“THE FOUR PRINCIPLES”，列出了茶道的四个核心原则：“WA 和 HARMONY”、“KEI 敬 RESPECT”、“SEI 清 PURITY”和“JAKU 寂 STILLNESS”，每个原则都配有中英文对照。下方是一段关于这些原则由千利休确立的描述。

左下区域（03）标题为“INSTRUMENTAL TAXONOMY: THE DOGU”，介绍了六种茶道器具，包括“CHAWAN”、“CHASEN”、“CHASHAKU”、“NATSUME”、“KAMA”和“MIZUSASHI”，每种器具都配有英文描述和黄绿色的线稿图。

右下区域（04）标题为“SPACE & MEASURE”，列出了茶室空间和仪式时间的要素，如“TATAMI MODULE”、“ENTRANCE”、“FOCAL POINT”和“RITUAL TIME”。下方是一个黄绿色线条绘制的茶室平面示意图，中心标有“RO (HEARTH)”，并附有说明“SCHEMATIC: 4.5 TATAMI TEA ROOM LAYOUT WITH CENTRAL HEARTH (RO)”。

页面底部左侧是页脚信息“DOCUMENTATION REF”和“CHADO-092-2024”。整体设计简洁，信息结构清晰，主要文字为白色，部分关键信息和图示使用黄绿色突出显示。

This is an infographic on a dark background, presenting detailed information about "CHADO: THE THREE SEN HOUSES" and related concepts in Japanese tea ceremony. The page features a header "ATLAS OF CULTURAL TAXONOMY // VOL 04" at the top left and a main title "CHADO: THE THREE SEN HOUSES" at the top center. The page is clearly divided into four main sections, numbered 01, 02, 03, and 04, arranged in a 2x2 grid layout.

The top-left section (01) is titled "SAN-SENKE GENEALOGY," followed by a paragraph describing the origin of the Sen schools and a table with four columns: "SCHOOL," "ESTABLISHED," "CHARACTERISTIC," and "FOAM TEXTURE," detailing information for Omotesenke, Urasenke, and Musha-Kouji Senke.

The top-right section (02) is titled "THE FOUR PRINCIPLES," listing the four core principles of the tea ceremony: "WA 和 HARMONY," "KEI 敬 RESPECT," "SEI 清 PURITY," and "JAKU 寂 STILLNESS," each with both Japanese and English text. Below this is a description stating these principles were established by Sen no Rikyu.

The bottom-left section (03) is titled "INSTRUMENTAL TAXONOMY: THE DOGU," introducing six tea ceremony instruments, including "CHAWAN," "CHASEN," "CHASHAKU," "NATSUME," "KAMA," and "MIZUSASHI." Each instrument is accompanied by an English description and a yellow-green line art illustration.

The bottom-right section (04) is titled "SPACE & MEASURE," listing elements of the tea room space and ritual time, such as "TATAMI MODULE," "ENTRANCE," "FOCAL POINT," and "RITUAL TIME." Below this is a yellow-green line drawing schematic of a tea room layout, with "RO (HEARTH)" marked in the center, and a caption "SCHEMATIC: 4.5 TATAMI TEA ROOM LAYOUT WITH CENTRAL HEARTH (RO)."

At the bottom left of the page are footer details "DOCUMENTATION REF" and "CHADO-092-2024." The overall design is clean, with a clear information structure, featuring predominantly white text, with key information and illustrations highlighted in yellow-green.

On the left side of the poster, white text "维护国家安全 人人有责" (Everyone is responsible for safeguarding national security) is arranged vertically. The lower half of the image shows golden silhouettes of two figures in uniform, standing in profile. At the bottom left is a bold white contact number "001-12345678", and on the right, white address information "地址: 深圳市南山区金色 商业街001号商铺" (Address: Golden Commercial Street 001, Nanshan District, Shenzhen) is displayed in two lines, next to a fingerprint-shaped QR code. 感恩
母亲节
亲爱的妈妈：
在这个充满暖意的节日里，我想为您写下这些文字。感谢您多年来无私的爱与包容，您的温柔如春日和煦的阳光，照亮了我成长路上的每一个角落。
无论世界如何变迁，您始终是我心灵最宁静的港湾。那些细碎的叮咛与长久的陪伴，是我生命中最珍贵的财富。愿岁月温柔待您，愿您笑靥常在。
祝您母亲节快乐，身体健康，岁岁平安。
爱您的孩子
二零二四年·孟夏
With Eternal Gratitude

prompt_en: This is a digital Mother's Day greeting card with a light beige gradient background. In the top right corner, there is an oval frame with a light orange border, containing the deep brown text "感恩 母亲节" (Gratitude Mother's Day) arranged vertically. The upper half of the card is decorated with a central illustration of light-colored flowers, showing clear petal details. Below the flowers is the main content of the card, presented in deep brown text. It begins with the left-aligned salutation "亲爱的妈妈：" (Dear Mom:), followed by three paragraphs of left-aligned body text expressing love, gratitude, and blessings for Mother's Day. In the bottom right corner are the signature "爱您的孩子" (Your loving child) and the date "二零二四年·孟夏" (2024 · Early Summer), both right-aligned. At the bottom center of the card, there is also a line of light brown English text "With Eternal Gratitude". The overall layout is simple and warm, combining text and graphics to convey holiday wishes.

Multiple small winter-themed images are overlaid in the center, including a cat walking in the snow, a vast snowy landscape, a frozen bubble, a snow-covered cabin, cracked ice, and a window with falling snow. Dark tree silhouettes frame the left and right edges of the background. Decorative elements such as golden hanging stars, white snowflakes, a Christmas tree shape formed by light dots, a gingerbread man, Santa Claus, and a cartoon snowman are scattered throughout the image. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark blue, white, gold, and brown. In the bottom left, the white handwritten text "Plog" is visible. In the mid-right, overlaid on the snowy window image, is the white text "STORY OF MY LIFE". In the bottom right, superimposed on the dark tree silhouette, are the white bold text "@CANVA" and a quote below it: "Life is made of small, repeating days, each one a gift."

The Silk Road was not a single path
but an interconnected network of
Eurasian trade routes. Initiated during the
Han Dynasty in 114 BCE, these paths
facilitated the exchange of goods, ideas, and
technologies across thousands of miles. The
Oasis Route traversed the Hexi Corridor and
the Taklamakan Desert. Over this harsh
terrain, Chinese silk, porcelain, and tea
moved westward, transforming Roman and
Byzantine elite consumption. Meanwhile,
valuable warhorses, glass vessels, and new
religious systems flowed eastward,
fundamentally altering the Chinese cultural
landscape.
Control of these routes shifted over fifteen
centuries. The Tang Dynasty expanded
Chinese influence deep into Central Asia,
securing the vital Kashgar and Samarkand
nodes. The primary currency of
trade shifted from silk bolts to silver sycee.
Peak trade occurred during the Pax
Mongolica, when unified political control
minimized tariffs and banditry. By the mid-
fifteenth century, Ottoman control of
Constantinople and the rise of maritime
routes led to the decline of overland
passages.
The matrix of exchange operated on a high-
value, low-weight principle. Only luxury
goods justified the immense cost and risk of
trans-continental caravans. Spices
from the East Indies, precious stones from
India, and frankincense from Arabia met
Northern furs and Byzantine gold in the
markets of Samarkand and Baghdad. These
transactions established the first global
economic system, proving that integration
transcends political borders.

The main title "THE SILK ROAD: AN EXCHANGE MATRIX" and its subtitle "CORE OVERLAND PASSAGES AND COMMODITY FLOW METRICS [ 114 BCE – 1450 CE ]" are centered. The left side of the page lists "PRIMARY ROUTES & HISTORICAL EPOCHS", detailing various route names and their corresponding historical periods. Below this, three columns of English body text elaborate on the background, evolution, and trade characteristics of the Silk Road. Towards the mid-left, a map titled "SCHEMATIC OF CORE EURASIAN EXCHANGE NODES" depicts the Eurasian continent, marking cities like Constantinople, Baghdad, Samarkand, Kashgar, Dunhuang, and Chang'an, with lines and text indicating trade routes such as "Steppe Route" and "Oasis Silk Road", along with latitude and longitude coordinates. On the right side of the page, a table titled "COMMODITY MATRIX" presents four columns: "REGION", "PRIMARY EXPORT", "INDEX", and "FLOW", where the "FLOW" column is represented by green horizontal bars indicating trade volume for different regions. Below the table is a list of historical events under "KEY TRANSITIONS". Source information and page number "Page 182" are at the bottom of the page.

prompt_cn: 这是一张俯视角度的静物摄影图片，展示了一个打开的黑色活页集邮册，其中包含三张设计精美的邮票。集邮册右侧是透明塑料内页，每页一个口袋，从上到下依次放置着编号为No.1、No.2和No.3的邮票。No.1邮票描绘了山水景色，No.2邮票是拱桥流水，No.3邮票则呈现了帆船日落的景象。每张邮票都带有金色边框，并印有“ROYAL POST - LIMITED EDITION”字样、年份以及包含“Face Value”、“Mintage”和“Perforation”的表格数据。集邮册左侧是空白页。图片背景是棕色木质桌面，桌面上还散落着一支黑色钢笔、一叠白色信封、一个深灰色马克杯和一枚金色放大镜。
prompt_en: This is a top-down still life photograph featuring an open black ring binder containing three elaborately designed stamps. The right side of the binder holds transparent plastic sheets, each with a pocket, displaying stamps labeled No.1, No.2, and No.3 from top to bottom. Stamp No.1 depicts a mountain and water landscape, No.2 shows an arched bridge over flowing water, and No.3 illustrates a sailboat at sunset. Each stamp has a golden border and is inscribed with "ROYAL POST - LIMITED EDITION", a year, and tabular data including "Face Value", "Mintage", and "Perforation". The left side of the binder shows blank pages. The image is set against a brown wooden tabletop, where a black pen, a stack of white envelopes, a dark gray mug, and a golden magnifying glass are also scattered.

中间层是大气层中最寒冷的区域，温度可降至零下90摄氏度。大多数进入地球的流星在此处因摩擦而焚毁。而进入热层后，受太阳高能辐射影响，分子动能激增，尽管空气极其稀薄，其等效温度可达1500摄氏度。这是极光舞动的舞台，也是国际空间站巡航的轨道。最外层的散逸层则是地球与深空的交界，大气分子在此挣脱引力，逃逸入恒星间的寂静。
卡门线 (Kármán Line)，被国际航空联合会定义为外层空间的起始点。在此高度以上，空气动力学升力已不足以支撑飞行器，必须达到第一宇宙速度方能维持轨道。
研究大气层的垂直分层不仅是气象学的基石，更是人类探索航天科技的指南。每一层都是天然的实验室，展示了压力、辐射与重力如何共同塑造这颗行星的保护壳。从对流层的复杂垂直对流，到平流层极其稳定的水平气流，再到热层电离产生的无线电反射层，大气的每一个米都蕴含着影响全球通讯、气候与生态的关键变量。在这个跨越千公里的垂直梯度中，人类感受到的不仅仅是气压的降低，更是生命对物理极限的优雅跨越。

At the bottom is the "BOUNDARY / 临界" section, explaining the Kármán Line and the significance of the atmosphere for human exploration. The overall layout is clear and informative, visually presenting the complex structure and key data of the atmosphere through a combination of text and graphics.

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个企业管理系统的用户界面截图，界面被清晰地划分为三个垂直面板：左侧导航区、中间内容区和右侧信息/建议区。左侧面板标题为“组织架构预览”，以层级树状结构展示了多个部门，其中“销售管理部”以蓝色背景高亮显示，其下属的“华北销售组”则以红色背景高亮显示。顶部导航栏显示了“组织管理 / 删除确认”的面包屑路径，右侧还标注有“ID: DEPT-089”。中间面板是一个“删除部门确认”的对话框，顶部有“删除部门确认”的标题，下方以红色字体突出显示“高风险操作”警告，并提示“确定删除 华北销售二组？此操作将导致所有职级、汇报关系及绩效存档被移入回收站。”对话框还列出了部门相关数据，包括“正式员工 24 位”、“关联子项 0 个”、“待办流程”和“资产统计”，底部是“取消”和红色的“确认并删除”按钮。右侧面板标题为“处理建议”，内容为“存在 12 项待办，建议先转交流程。”，并配有一张背景图，图中一位女性站在现代办公室中，前景叠加了一个由人物图标和线条组成的网络关系图。整个界面设计简洁，左侧和中间面板采用浅色背景，右侧面板采用深色背景，并巧妙地运用红色和蓝色作为强调色。
prompt_en: This image displays a screenshot of an enterprise management system's user interface, clearly divided into three vertical panels: a left navigation area, a central content area, and a right information/suggestion area. The left panel, titled "组织架构预览" (Organizational Structure Preview), presents a hierarchical tree structure of departments. "销售管理部" (Sales Management Department) is highlighted with a blue background, and its subordinate "华北销售组" (North China Sales Group) is highlighted with a red background. The top navigation bar shows a breadcrumb path "组织管理 / 删除确认" (Organization Management / Delete Confirmation), with "ID: DEPT-089" displayed on the right. The central panel is a "删除部门确认" (Delete Department Confirmation) dialog box, featuring a title of the same name. Below it, a "高风险操作" (High-Risk Operation) warning is highlighted in red, stating: "确定删除 华北销售二组？此操作将导致所有职级、汇报关系及绩效存档被移入回收站。" (Are you sure you want to delete North China Sales Group 2? This operation will move all ranks, reporting relationships, and performance archives to the recycle bin.) The dialog also lists department-related data, including "正式员工 24 位" (24 Regular Employees), "关联子项 0 个" (0 Associated Sub-items), "待办流程" (Pending Processes), and "资产统计" (Asset Statistics). At the bottom are "取消" (Cancel) and a red "确认并删除" (Confirm and Delete) button. The right panel, titled "处理建议" (Processing Suggestions), contains the text "存在 12 项待办，建议先转交流程。" (There are 12 pending items, it is recommended to transfer processes first.), accompanied by a background image. This image depicts a woman standing in a modern office, with a network diagram of human icons and lines overlaid in the foreground. The overall interface design is clean, with light backgrounds for the left and central panels and a dark background for the right panel, effectively using red and blue as accent colors.

prompt_en: This is an illustration-style infographic sharing learning experiences. The main subject of the image is a beige grid notebook page with blue spiral binding on the left. At the top of the page are the titles "EXPERIENCE SHARING" and "学习经验分享" (Learning Experience Sharing). The left side of the page lists three learning tips, each consisting of a blue rounded rectangular title and dark gray body text. The titles are "整合知识点" (Integrate Knowledge Points), "做题会反思" (Reflect on Practice Questions), and "总结归纳" (Summarize and Conclude). The right side of the image depicts a cartoon-style young female student, wearing a blue jacket and pants, carrying a red backpack, holding a red book, and raising her right hand. A light blue curved arrow points from the text area on the left towards the student's head. In the bottom left corner, there is light blue text that reads "建议收藏!" (Recommended for Collection!). The overall composition is clear, with colors predominantly blue, beige, and red.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以白色和浅棕色为主色调的公益宣传海报。画面被垂直分为左右两部分，左侧是白色背景的文字区域，右侧是浅棕色边框内的一张儿童照片。海报顶部左侧有“SPECIAL EDUCATION SCHOOL”和“启智特殊教育学校校区”字样，右侧是橙色数字“05.19”和“全国助残日”。左侧文字区域的主标题为“让爱 无碍 共筑未来”，其中“无碍”二字为橙色。下方是关于“每一个生命都像一颗独特的星”的中文正文。正文下方并列排布着三组短语，分别是“专业康复 个性化教育方案”、“融合教育 打破隔阂走进社会”和“志愿同行 加入我们传递温暖”。右侧照片中，一个面部和衣服沾有彩色颜料的儿童，面带笑容，仰头看向画面上方，背景是模糊的绿色植物。儿童照片下方有一个橙色方块，内含一个红色心形图标。海报底部中央是英文“SUPPORT & CARE SYSTEM”。
prompt_en: This is a public service announcement poster primarily in white and light brown tones. The image is vertically divided into two main parts: the left side is a text area with a white background, and the right side features a child's photograph within a light brown frame. At the top left of the poster, there are the English words "SPECIAL EDUCATION SCHOOL" and the Chinese "启智特殊教育学校校区". On the top right, there is the orange number "05.19" and the Chinese "全国助残日". The main title in the left text area reads "让爱 无碍 共筑未来" (Let Love Be Unhindered, Build the Future Together), with "无碍" (Unhindered) in orange. Below it is a Chinese body text about "every life being like a unique star". Further down, three sets of phrases are arranged in parallel: "专业康复 个性化教育方案" (Professional Rehabilitation Individualized Education Program), "融合教育 打破隔阂走进社会" (Inclusive Education Breaking Barriers Entering Society), and "志愿同行 加入我们传递温暖" (Volunteer Together Join Us to Spread Warmth). The photograph on the right shows a child with colorful paint on their face and clothes, smiling and looking upwards, against a blurred green plant background. Below the child's photo, there is an orange square containing a red heart icon. At the bottom center of the poster, the English text "SUPPORT & CARE SYSTEM" is displayed.

prompt_en: This is a digital user interface (UI) screenshot, displaying a rectangular warning/status panel on a dark red background. The interface's main colors are red and white, supplemented by a few green status indicator dots. The background features a light grid pattern. The top of the main panel shows the title "系统核心访问冲突" (System Core Access Conflict) and the error code "错误代码: ERR_SYS_CRITICAL_VOID_092" (Error Code: ERR_SYS_CRITICAL_VOID_092). The left area displays "事件详情 / INCIDENT LOG" (Event Details / INCIDENT LOG), with a red label "严重" (Severe) and text "实时阻断中" (Real-time Blocking in Progress) below it. The right side is a dark sub-area with a server rack image in the background, showing "SECURITY LEVEL" with its value "MAX-01", and "TIMESTAMP" with its value "2023-10-27 14:02:11". At the bottom of the main panel are two action buttons: the left one is "强制终止进程" (Force Terminate Process) with red text on a white background, and the right one is "忽略警告" (Ignore Warning) with white text on a red background. The very bottom displays three status or version information items, including "ENC-ACTIVE" indicated by a green dot, "FIREWALL-BLOCKED", and "GLOBAL SECURITY PROTOCOL v4.8.2".

Along the right edge of the page, two lines of vertically arranged English keywords, "RELIABILITY" and "EFFICIENCY", are visible. The middle-right part of the page contains a grayscale photograph of a man sitting by a window, looking downwards. To the left of the photo, there's a Chinese body text: "在熟悉的校园里，开启你的第一份事业。" (Start your first career in a familiar campus environment.). The bottom section is divided into multiple columns, detailing recruitment information such as "薪资待遇 / PAY" (Salary / PAY), "工作时间 / TIME" (Working Hours / TIME), and "招募要求 / REQ" (Recruitment Requirements / REQ), along with "面试地点：校内快递服务中心 2F" (Interview Location: Campus Express Service Center 2F) and "咨询电话：400-888-9999" (Inquiry Phone: 400-888-9999). At the bottom right, there is a dark square next to the text "立即扫码加入" (Scan to Join Now). The person and background (trees outside the window) in the photo are consistent with a "campus" theme.

prompt_cn: 这是一张AI语音识别模型控制台的软件界面截图，采用深色主题，背景模糊。界面主要内容区域由多个半透明、圆角矩形面板组成。顶部标题栏显示“AI 语音识别模型控制台”和“系统运行正常”的状态。左侧面板展示“实时性能指标”，包括“识别准确率 (WER)”为“98.42%”和“推理延迟 (Latency)”为“124 ms”两项数据，以及“当前负载: 低负载模式”信息。右侧面板显示“活跃识别模型”，列出了三个模型：Transformer-XL 增强版（“适用于长文本会议转写”，状态“运行中”）、Conformer 实时流式（“极低延迟语音助手”，状态“待命”）和Whisper Large V3（“多语言混合识别”，状态“待命”）。左下角面板显示“4.2k 并发请求”和“16bit 采样深度”两组数据。右下角面板包含一个动态的音频波形图，旁边标注“AUDIO_INPUT_ACTIVE”。界面底部是页脚，包含“版本: v4.5.0-stable”、“GPU 加速”和日期时间“2024-05-20 14:30”。文字颜色主要为白色、浅蓝色或浅绿色，部分描述性文字为灰色，重要的数值使用更大、更粗的字体显示。
prompt_en: This is a software interface screenshot of an AI speech recognition model control panel, featuring a dark theme with a blurred background. The main content area consists of multiple translucent, rounded rectangular panels. The top title bar displays "AI 语音识别模型控制台" (AI Speech Recognition Model Control Panel) and the status "系统运行正常" (System running normally). The left panel shows "实时性能指标" (Real-time Performance Metrics), including "识别准确率 (WER)" (Recognition Accuracy (WER)) at "98.42%" and "推理延迟 (Latency)" (Inference Latency (Latency)) at "124 ms", along with "当前负载: 低负载模式" (Current Load: Low Load Mode) information. The right panel displays "活跃识别模型" (Active Recognition Models), listing three models: "Transformer-XL 增强版" (Transformer-XL Enhanced Version, "适用于长文本会议转写" - suitable for long text conference transcription, status "运行中" - running), "Conformer 实时流式" (Conformer Real-time Streaming, "极低延迟语音助手" - ultra-low latency voice assistant, status "待命" - standby), and "Whisper Large V3" ("多语言混合识别" - multilingual mixed recognition, status "待命" - standby). The bottom-left panel shows two sets of data: "4.2k 并发请求" (4.2k concurrent requests) and "16bit 采样深度" (16bit sampling depth). The bottom-right panel contains a dynamic audio waveform visualization, labeled "AUDIO_INPUT_ACTIVE". The interface footer includes "版本: v4.5.0-stable" (Version: v4.5.0-stable), "GPU 加速" (GPU Acceleration), and the date and time "2024-05-20 14:30". Text colors are primarily white, light blue, or light green, with some descriptive text in gray, and important numerical values displayed in larger, bolder fonts.

The "Blade Profiles" section shows the side profiles and dimensions of three knife types: Chef's Knife, Yanagiba, and Nakiri. A "[维护指南 Maintenance ]" section at the bottom provides knife care advice. The bottom right corner features golden footer text: "1932" and "SHANGHAI GRAND THEATER ATLAS PROJECT".

prompt_cn: 这是一张招聘海报，整体背景为米白色，所有文字均为黑色。海报左侧以超大字号垂直排布着标题“招賢納士”。海报中央有一条细长的垂直分隔线，将版面分为左右两部分。左侧分隔线旁，从上到下依次显示日期“2025”、“03.10”和“05.20”。右侧垂直排布着标语“期待着您的加入,共同書寫事業的新篇章!”。海报右侧主体部分列出了三个职位及其职责描述，包括“【圖書編輯】”、“【期刊項目經理】”和“【市場營銷專員】”。底部区域包含“简历请投递至: cnsupport@canva.com”的联系方式，左下角是公司信息“可画文艺出版社”和地址“深圳市南山区金色商业街001号”。右下角有版权信息“@2025”、“RECRUITMENT”以及品牌标识“Canva 可画”及其图形标志。

A thin vertical dividing line runs down the center of the poster, splitting the layout into left and right sections. To the left of this line, dates "2025", "03.10", and "05.20" are displayed from top to bottom. On the right side, the slogan "期待着您的加入,共同書寫事業的新篇章!" is vertically arranged. The main section on the right lists three job positions and their responsibilities, including "【圖書編輯】" (Book Editor), "【期刊項目經理】" (Journal Project Manager), and "【市場營銷專員】" (Marketing Specialist). The bottom area includes contact information "简历请投递至: cnsupport@canva.com". In the bottom-left corner are the company details "可画文艺出版社" (Canva Arts Press) and the address "地址:深圳市南山区金色商业街001号" (Address: No. 001, Jinse Commercial Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen). The bottom-right corner features copyright information "@2025", "RECRUITMENT", and the brand identity "Canva 可画" along with its graphic logo.

The top-left panel shows an unhappy Shiba Inu with the text "别理我" (Don't bother me); the top-middle panel depicts a Shiba Inu lying on its back, exposing its belly, with the text "摸我~" (Pet me~); the top-right panel features a surprised Shiba Inu with an open mouth, and the text "真的吗?!" (Really?!); the bottom-left panel shows a Shiba Inu running with its tongue out, accompanied by the text "出去玩!" (Let's go play!); the bottom-middle panel presents a Shiba Inu holding a bone with both paws, with the text "给你" (For you); and the bottom-right panel illustrates a Shiba Inu covering its mouth while laughing, with the text "嘿嘿嘿" (Hehehe). The background is light beige.
