prompt_cn: 这是一张科幻主题的书籍封面或宣传海报。画面以深蓝色调为主，背景是抽象的电路板或未来城市网格图案。画面中央偏上是一个巨大的蓝色星球，其表面有纹理和光影。星球下方，画面中央是一个由发光线条和电路板元素构成的金字塔形结构，散发出金黄色的光芒，与背景的蓝色形成对比。文字信息分布在画面的不同区域。顶部偏左有小字“北京科普创作出版专项资金资助”。星球上方是白色中大字号的副标题“藏在科幻里的世界”。画面中央偏上，星球前方，是特大号粗体主标题“运行到时间尽头”。主标题下方是作者信息“周忠和 王晋康 主编 吕默默 编著”。金字塔结构下方，画面中央偏下，是英文副标题“TILL THE END OF THE TIME”。画面底部是白色大字号的标语“只有未来才是值得一谈之事”，其下方是出版商信息“北京理工大学出版社”及其英文名称“BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY PRESS”。整个画面通过科幻元素和文字排版，共同营造出一种未来感和科技感。
prompt_en: This is a science fiction-themed book cover or promotional poster. The image is dominated by a dark blue hue, with an abstract circuit board or futuristic city grid pattern in the background. In the upper-central part of the image is a large blue planet with a textured surface and light and shadow. Below the planet, in the center of the image, is a pyramid-shaped structure composed of glowing lines and circuit board elements, emitting golden light that contrasts with the blue background. Textual information is distributed across different areas of the image. In the top-left, there is small text "北京科普创作出版专项资金资助" (Beijing Popular Science Creation and Publication Special Fund Grant). Above the planet is the white, medium-large subtitle "藏在科幻里的世界" (The World Hidden in Science Fiction). In the upper-central part of the image, in front of the planet, is the extra-large, bold main title "运行到时间尽头" (Run to the End of Time). Below the main title is the author information "周忠和 王晋康 主编 吕默默 编著" (Zhou Zhonghe, Wang Jinkang, Editor-in-Chief; Lü Momo, Author). Below the pyramid structure, in the lower-central part of the image, is the English subtitle "TILL THE END OF THE TIME". At the bottom of the image is a large white slogan "只有未来才是值得一谈之事" (Only the Future is Worth Talking About), followed by the publisher information "北京理工大学出版社" (Beijing Institute of Technology Press) and its English name "BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY PRESS". The entire image, through its science fiction elements and text layout, collectively creates a sense of futurism and technology.

Surrounding this large image are four smaller stills: the top right shows a group of people climbing a ship's mast; the middle left depicts Jackie Chan in a white T-shirt with a slightly pained expression; the bottom left shows a large crowd in uniform lined up in front of a building; and the bottom right is a close-up of a man with a monocle, smiling. The textual information on the poster is mainly distributed above and below the images, with titles and promotional slogans in red, blue, and gold, while cast and production details are mostly in white. The overall layout combines a large central image with smaller surrounding images, and the text-image relationship is clear, aiming to promote the movie.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于云属分类与大气对流圈高度分布的信息图表。图片以深色背景为主，白色文字清晰呈现。顶部是标题“十大云属分类与大气对流圈高度分布图”。主体内容分为八个编号区块，并包含一个垂直分布模型图表和一个分类索引数据表。左上角“01 / 概述概括”介绍了世界气象组织定义的十个基本云属及其分布。右上角的“02 / 垂直分布模型”图表展示了云族在0-15公里高度范围内的分布，Y轴标注高度（KM），并区分了高云族、中云族和低云族，其中“积雨云 Cb”区域以红色边框和文字突出显示。左中部的“03 / 相态演变”解释了云层组成随海拔的变化，并列出了“冰晶相 (ICE)”、“混合相 (MIXED)”和“水滴相 (WATER)”，其中水滴相旁有一个红色圆点。右中部的“04 / 分类索引数据表”详细列出了云族类型、代码、云属名称、典型高度区间和主要物理组成，涵盖了高云族、中云族、低云族和直展云族。底部左侧的“05 / 观测笔记”和“06 / 动力学特征”提供了卷云和积雨云的描述。底部右侧的“07 / 光学效应”描述了卷层云的光学现象，而“08 / 记录规范”则包含编号、坐标系统、比例尺信息，并以红色文字警示“▲严禁将层云与平流雾混淆”。图片底部页脚显示“ATLAS OF METEOROLOGY / VOL. 12”和“PAGE 184 / 对流层观测手册”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about cloud classification and the height distribution of cloud genera in the troposphere. The image features a dark background with clear white text. The top displays the title "十大云属分类与大气对流圈高度分布图" (Ten Cloud Genera Classification and Atmospheric Troposphere Height Distribution Map). The main content is divided into eight numbered sections, including a vertical distribution model chart and a classification index data table. The top-left section "01 / 概述概括" (01 / Overview) introduces the ten basic cloud genera defined by the World Meteorological Organization and their distribution. The top-right section "02 / 垂直分布模型 (高度单位:KM)" (02 / Vertical Distribution Model (Height Unit: KM)) chart illustrates the distribution of cloud families within the 0-15 km height range, with the Y-axis labeled for height (KM), distinguishing high, middle, and low cloud families. The "积雨云 Cb" (Cumulonimbus Cb) area is highlighted with a red border and text. The middle-left section "03 / 相态演变" (03 / Phase Evolution) explains the change in cloud composition with altitude and lists "冰晶相 (ICE)" (Ice Crystal Phase), "混合相 (MIXED)" (Mixed Phase), and "水滴相 (WATER)" (Water Droplet Phase), with a red dot next to the water droplet phase. The middle-right section "04 / 分类索引数据表" (04 / Classification Index Data Table) details cloud family types, codes, cloud genera names, typical height ranges, and main physical compositions, covering high, middle, low, and vertical cloud families. The bottom-left sections "05 / 观测笔记" (05 / Observation Notes) and "06 / 动力学特征" (06 / Dynamic Characteristics) provide descriptions of cirrus and cumulonimbus clouds. The bottom-right section "07 / 光学效应" (07 / Optical Effects) describes the optical phenomena of cirrostratus clouds, while "08 / 记录规范" (08 / Recording Specifications) includes numbering, coordinate system, and scale information, with a red warning text "▲严禁将层云与平流雾混淆" (▲Strictly prohibit confusing stratus clouds with advection fog). The footer at the bottom of the image shows "ATLAS OF METEOROLOGY / VOL. 12" and "PAGE 184 / 对流层观测手册" (PAGE 184 / Troposphere Observation Manual).

In the middle of the card, there is the word "迟到" with a right-pointing arrow. A QR code is located at the bottom right of the card, partially covered by a red circular stamp that reads "全民健康" and "下乡下乡". The bottom of the card also contains small text information and a verification code. The background behind the card is blurred, showing a train window, a light brown wooden table, and a black backpack.

STAY SAFE. PREPAREDNESS SAVES LIVES。”

At the top, there is a large English title "EARTHQUAKE PREPAREDNESS," with "2024 PROTOCO" and an orange-backed "TYPE-A SAFETY" label on the right. Below these are the Chinese text "公共安全・防震减灾・应急避险" and coordinate information "COORD: 39.9042° N, 116.4074° E". The middle section of the poster displays a grayscale image of a park lawn. Overlaid on the top-left of this image are orange text "STATUS: SAFE ZONE" and white text "公园应急避险草坪," while "EMERGENCY GATHERING POINT" is centered at the bottom of the image. The bottom section features the title "EMERGENCY KIT LIST / 应急准备," followed by two lists of emergency items, numbered "01 Survival Essentials" and "02 Communication and Lighting," with specific items detailed under each. The very bottom of the poster contains the English slogan "ALWAYS READY. STAY SAFE. PREPAREDNESS SAVES LIVES."

prompt_cn: 这是一张以米色为底色的中式婚礼请柬。请柬顶部中央是深棕色的特大“囍”字，下方是“结婚请柬”字样。请柬中部横向嵌入一张黑白照片，照片中一只手持一把展开的折扇，背景隐约可见一位身着传统服饰的人物。照片下方是婚礼的具体信息，包括“谨定于公历 二〇二四年十月十八日 农历 甲辰年九月十六 星期五”的日期。接着是新人姓名“周慕云 & 苏丽珍”，下方分别标注“先生”和“女士”。再下方是“举行 结婚典礼 敬备喜酌”，以及地点“上海市和平饭店·龙凤厅”和地址“席设: 南京东路20号”。请柬底部中央是“恭请 光临”。请柬右侧边缘垂直排列着装饰性文字“岁在甲辰·檀香盈袖”。所有文字均为深棕色，与背景形成对比。
prompt_en: This is a Chinese wedding invitation card with a beige background. At the top center of the invitation, there is a large, dark brown "囍" character, followed by "结婚请柬" (Wedding Invitation). A horizontal black and white photograph is embedded in the middle of the card, showing a hand holding an open folding fan, with a figure in traditional attire vaguely visible in the background. Below the photo are the specific wedding details, including the date: "谨定于公历 二〇二四年十月十八日 农历 甲辰年九月十六 星期五" (Scheduled for Gregorian calendar October 18, 2024, Lunar calendar September 16, Year of Jia Chen, Friday). This is followed by the names of the couple, "周慕云 & 苏丽珍", with "先生" (Mr.) and "女士" (Ms.) indicated below their respective names. Further down, it states "举行 结婚典礼 敬备喜酌" (Hold wedding ceremony, respectfully prepare wedding banquet), and the venue "上海市和平饭店·龙凤厅" (Shanghai Peace Hotel · Dragon & Phoenix Hall) with the address "席设: 南京东路20号" (Venue: 20 Nanjing East Road). At the bottom center of the invitation, it reads "恭请 光临" (Cordially invite your presence). Along the right edge of the card, decorative text "岁在甲辰·檀香盈袖" (Year of Jia Chen · Sandalwood fragrance fills sleeves) is arranged vertically. All text is dark brown, contrasting with the background.

PERIODICITY LAW
电负性是原子在分子中吸引电子能力的标准。鲍林电负 性标准中，氟被定义为最高值3.98。同一周期的主族元 素从左到右，由于有效核电荷增加且原子半径减小，原 子核对外层电子的吸引力增强，电负性依次增大。

prompt_cn: 这张信息图表或海报展示了化学元素周期表的相关信息。图片整体背景为深灰色，主要内容区域为浅米色。页面布局分为顶部标题区和下方两列内容区。顶部左侧是标题“化学元素周期表”和副标题“PERIODIC SYSTEM”，以及关于族群分类和原子属性周期律的简要说明。顶部右侧配有一个抽象的圆形多层原子模型图，由黄色、橙色和深灰色构成。左侧内容区包含两段关于元素分类和性质的正文，以及一张“轨道分区示意图”，该示意图由橙色、黄色、深灰色方块和底部的白色“f-block”方块组成，并标注了s、d、p区对应的族群范围。右侧内容区包含一个“TECHNICAL LAB DATA”表格，列出了部分元素族群的名称及其英文对应，以及一个显示“TOTAL ELEMENTS”为“118”的橙色大数字。下方还有两段关于周期律的正文，以及一个“属性递变规律”的趋势图，图中标示了电负性增强和原子半径增大的方向，并用黄色方块突出显示了元素“F”及其电负性值“3.98”。图片底部是页脚，包含“DESSAU ARCHIVE / PLATE 18”等档案信息。
prompt_en: This infographic or poster presents information related to the periodic table of chemical elements. The overall background of the image is dark gray, with the main content area in light beige. The page layout is divided into a top title section and two columns of content below. The top left features the main title "化学元素周期表" and subtitle "PERIODIC SYSTEM", along with a brief description of elemental group classification and atomic property periodicity. The top right displays an abstract circular multi-layered atomic model diagram, composed of yellow, orange, and dark gray. The left content column includes two paragraphs of text on element classification and properties, and a "BLOCK CLASSIFICATION SCHEMATIC" diagram. This diagram consists of orange, yellow, and dark gray blocks, with a white "f-block" at the bottom, and labels indicating the group ranges for s, d, and p blocks. The right content column contains a "TECHNICAL LAB DATA" table listing names and English equivalents for some element groups, and a large orange number "118" for "TOTAL ELEMENTS". Below this are two paragraphs of text on periodicity law, and a "PROPERTY GRADIENT" trend diagram. This diagram illustrates the increasing electronegativity and atomic radius directions, highlighting element "F" and its electronegativity value "3.98" in a yellow block. The bottom of the image features a footer with archive information like "DESSAU ARCHIVE / PLATE 18".

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于史瓦西黑洞的科学信息图表，背景为深灰色。图表顶部是中英文主标题“史瓦西黑洞剖面：从吸积盘到奇点”，以及关于度规、坐标和引力常数的元数据。图表主体分为四个主要区域。左上方展示了黑洞的几何剖面示意图，标示出相对论性喷流、事件视界、吸积盘和奇点。右上方是一个表格，详细定义了史瓦西黑洞的物理性质和分类归属。右侧中部是另一个表格，对黑洞不同空间分层的临界半径、逃逸速度和等效速度进行了定量测绘。左下方是一个引力红移比率的函数图，显示了红移与距离的关系，并给出了计算公式。右下方表格比较了恒星级黑洞和超大质量黑洞的典型质量、视界半径、霍金辐射温度和平均密度。所有文字均为白色或浅灰色，清晰可辨，图表底部还有页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the Schwarzschild black hole, set against a dark gray background. The top of the chart features the main title in Chinese and English, '史瓦西黑洞剖面：从吸积盘到奇点' (Schwarzschild Black Hole: Cross-Section from Accretion Disk to Singularity), along with metadata on metric, coordinates, and gravitational constant. The main body of the chart is divided into four primary sections. The top-left displays a geometric schematic cross-section of the black hole, labeling relativistic jets, event horizon, accretion disk, and singularity. The top-right contains a table detailing the physical properties and classification of the Schwarzschild black hole. The middle-right presents another table with quantitative measurements for different spatial layers of the black hole, including critical radius, escape velocity, and equivalent temperature. The bottom-left shows a function graph of the gravitational redshift ratio, illustrating the relationship between redshift and distance, accompanied by its calculation formula. The bottom-right table compares stellar-mass black holes and supermassive black holes, listing their typical mass, event horizon radius, Hawking radiation temperature, and average density. All text is white or light gray and clearly legible. Footer information is also present at the bottom of the chart.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影宣传海报。海报的主体是一位男性，他身穿白色衬衫和黑色马甲，俯身在红色的台球桌上，专注地准备击球。背景中，一位女性坐在楼梯上，低头沉思。海报顶部有“Hard Rock”、“温尚翊/五月天”、“黄姵嘉”、“CCR”、“潘晓婷”等文字。海报标题“逆转胜”以大号白色艺术字体呈现，其上方是“9月25日 一击即中”，下方是英文副标题“Second Chance”，右侧标注“孔玟燕 导”。主画面底部有一句宣传语“给我一个支点 我就能翻转地球”。海报底部包含三张小画面，左侧是一位女性在台球桌旁，中间是一位女性俯身击球，右侧是一位男性坐在沙发上。下方还有多行极小的白色文字，列出了制作公司和演职人员名单。海报左下角有垂直排布的日期“2017/02/26”。右下角有红色的“孔夫子旧书网”及其网址“www.kongfz.com”水印。海报整体色调偏暖，以红色和棕色为主。
prompt_en: This is a movie promotional poster. The main subject of the poster is a man wearing a white shirt and a black vest, leaning over a red billiard table, intently preparing to strike a ball. In the background, a woman sits on a staircase, deep in thought. At the top of the poster, there are texts such as "Hard Rock", "Wen Shangyi / Mayday", "Huang Peijia", "CCR", and "Pan Xiaoting". The main title "逆转胜" (Nìzhuǎn Shèng, meaning "Comeback Victory") is displayed in large white artistic characters. Above it is "9月25日 一击即中" (September 25th, Hit in one shot), and below it is the English subtitle "Second Chance". To the right of the title, "孔玟燕 导" (Kong Wenyan, Director) is noted. At the bottom of the main image, there is a slogan: "给我一个支点 我就能翻转地球" (Give me a fulcrum, and I shall move the Earth). The bottom part of the poster features three smaller scenes: on the left, a woman by a billiard table; in the middle, a woman leaning over to strike a ball; and on the right, a man sitting on a sofa. Below these, there are multiple lines of very small white text listing production companies and cast/crew members. The date "2017/02/26" is vertically arranged in the bottom left corner. In the bottom right corner, there is a red watermark "孔夫子旧书网" (Kongfuzi Old Books) and its website "www.kongfz.com". The overall color scheme of the poster is warm, predominantly red and brown.

prompt_cn: 这是一张在室内拍摄的图片，展示了四张并排的立式宣传海报，它们由银色金属框架支撑，背景是浅色瓷砖墙面。左侧两张海报为绿色背景，内容完全相同，宣传微信支付支持医保电子凭证。海报顶部有“微信支付 现已支持医保电子凭证”字样，主标题为“一码在手 医保无忧”。下方通过六个手机图标展示了“使用流程”，包括“微信”、“搜索”、“医保电子凭证”、“激活”、“刷码”和“支付”。海报底部有一个二维码，并配有“扫码进入小程序”的说明，以及“国家医疗保障局”和“微信支付”的标识。右侧两张海报为蓝色背景，内容也完全相同，宣传支付宝刷医保。海报顶部标有“国家医疗保障局监制”，主标题为“医保支付不带卡 支付宝 刷医保”。下方展示了“领取后使用方法”，包括一个二维码及“扫码领取医保码”的文字，以及“点击付钱”、“选择下方 医保码”、“立即使用”三个步骤图标。海报中央有一只手持手机的图案，手机屏幕上显示“医保电子凭证”。海报底部有“CHS 中国医疗保障”、“淮安医保”和“支付宝”的标识。所有海报上的文字均为白色。
prompt_en: This indoor photograph displays four identical vertical promotional posters arranged side-by-side, supported by silver metal frames against a light-colored tiled wall. The two posters on the left have a green background and promote WeChat Pay's support for electronic medical insurance certificates. The top of these posters reads "微信支付 现已支持医保电子凭证" (WeChat Pay now supports electronic medical insurance certificates), with the main title "一码在手 医保无忧" (One code in hand, worry-free medical insurance). Below, six phone icons illustrate the "使用流程" (Usage process), detailing steps like "微信" (WeChat), "搜索" (Search), "医保电子凭证" (Electronic medical insurance certificate), "激活" (Activate), "刷码" (Scan code), and "支付" (Pay). At the bottom, a QR code is accompanied by "扫码进入小程序" (Scan to enter mini-program), along with logos for "国家医疗保障局" (National Healthcare Security Administration) and "微信支付" (WeChat Pay). The two posters on the right have a blue background and promote Alipay for medical insurance payments. The top of these posters states "国家医疗保障局监制" (Supervised by National Healthcare Security Administration), with the main title "医保支付不带卡 支付宝 刷医保" (Medical insurance payment without card, Alipay for medical insurance). Below, "领取后使用方法" (How to use after collection) is shown, including a QR code with "扫码领取医保码" (Scan to collect medical insurance code), and three step icons: "点击付钱" (Click to pay), "选择下方 医保码" (Select medical insurance code below), and "立即使用" (Use immediately). In the center, a hand holds a phone displaying "医保电子凭证" (Electronic medical insurance certificate). The bottom of these posters features logos for "CHS 中国医疗保障" (CHS China Healthcare Security), "淮安医保" (Huai'an Medical Insurance), and "支付宝" (Alipay). All text on the posters is white.

She is wearing a blue denim jacket and a khaki backpack, holding a white paper with both hands. The woman has a serious expression and is looking directly forward. The paper she holds is a "Withdrawal Notice" (退学通知书), with a prominent title, followed by detailed body text. It includes the recipient's name "Zhao Gangqiang" (赵刚强), and the issuing unit "Some Provincial Education Department" (某省教育厅) with the date "June 27, 2019" (2019年6月27日). A blurry red seal is stamped on the bottom right of the paper. In the background, there is a beige multi-story building with "Tong Xue Ji" (同学技) visible on its facade. A wide gray paved ground extends in front of the building. On both sides and in the background, there are several trees with yellow and orange leaves, indicating an autumn scene.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑白灰为主色调的活动宣传海报，辅以红色作为强调色。海报顶部左侧是“BEAUTY GROUP”品牌名称及其下方的“INTERNAL ACCESS ONLY”字样，右侧黑色矩形框内标有“CONFIDENTIAL”。海报中央是巨大的黑色粗体标题“STAFF SALE”，其背景处有半透明的“EHSU”水印。标题下方是中文副标题“集团内购特卖会”，两侧有横线装饰。再下方是一张黑白照片，展示了零售或仓库内部的货架，照片上叠加着白色文字“INVITATION REQUIRED / 凭工号入场”。海报中部右侧有一个醒目的红色矩形框，内有白色大字“1-3”和“折起”，表示折扣信息。海报底部区域分为左右两栏，左栏列出了“LOCATION”（地点）为“集团总部”和“1号物流自动化仓库”，以及“DATE & TIME”（日期和时间）为“11.24 - 11.26”和“09:00 - 20:00”。右栏标题为“INVENTORY”（库存），下方是三条带圆点符号的列表项，描述了商品信息，如“护肤套装限量 500 份”。右栏底部还有“#INTERNAL_2024”和“NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY”字样，旁边是一个空白的方形边框图标。海报最底部是一条黑色横幅，上面有白色文字“LIMITED QUANTITY / WHILE STOCKS LAST”。
prompt_en: This is an event promotional poster primarily in black, white, and gray, with red used as an accent color. At the top left of the poster are the brand name "BEAUTY GROUP" and "INTERNAL ACCESS ONLY" below it, while a black rectangular box on the right displays "CONFIDENTIAL". The center of the poster features a large, black, bold title "STAFF SALE", with a semi-transparent "EHSU" watermark in the background. Below the title is the Chinese subtitle "集团内购特卖会" (Group Internal Special Sale), flanked by horizontal lines. Further down is a black and white photograph showing shelves inside a retail store or warehouse, overlaid with white text "INVITATION REQUIRED / 凭工号入场" (Entry with Employee ID Required). On the mid-right side of the poster, a prominent red rectangular box contains large white text "1-3" and "折起" (discount from), indicating discount information. The bottom section of the poster is divided into two columns: the left column lists "LOCATION" as "集团总部" (Group Headquarters) and "1号物流自动化仓库" (No. 1 Logistics Automated Warehouse), and "DATE & TIME" as "11.24 - 11.26" and "09:00 - 20:00". The right column is titled "INVENTORY", followed by three bulleted list items describing product information, such as "护肤套装限量 500 份" (Skincare sets limited to 500 units). At the bottom right, there are "#INTERNAL_2024" and "NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY" texts, next to a blank square outline icon. The very bottom of the poster features a black banner with white text "LIMITED QUANTITY / WHILE STOCKS LAST".

THE OLFACTORY PYRAMID (EVAPORATION CHRONOLOGY)
Top Notes: The Prelude
0 – 15 Minutes
Highly volatile molecules. Citrus rinds (Lemon, Bergamot), aromatic herbs (Lavender, Mint), and synthetic aldehydes. They define the initial “hook” of the fragrance.
TOP
EVAPORATION RATE
Heart Notes: The Soul
15 Minutes – 4 Hours
The core theme. Heavy florals (Rose, Jasmine), spices (Cardamom, Cinnamon), and fruits. Provides character and rounds out the initial sharpness.
HEART
Base Notes: The Anchor
4 Hours – 24 Hours
Large, slow-moving molecules acting as fixatives. Precious woods (Sandalwood, Cedar), resins (Amber, Benzoin), and animalic musks.
BASE
MICHAEL EDWARDS FRAGRANCE WHEEL
Classification of Scent
The Fragrance Wheel groups scents by olfactory similarity. Floral encompasses fresh cut flowers and powdery notes. Oriental (Ambery) focuses on rich resins and spices. Woody contains dry woods and mosses. Fresh spans citrus, green, and aquatic accords.

The relationship between families is navigational; adjacent families share chemical traits, while opposite families (e.g., Woody vs. Floral) provide maximum contrast in a blend.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于香水调香学的英文信息图表，以深蓝色为背景，搭配白色和红色的文字。图片顶部是主标题“THE SCENT ARCHITECT'S MAP”，副标题为“Western Perfumery Pyramid & Olfactory Classification Systems”，右侧有垂直排列的中文标签“调香学 西方科学”。图表内容分为四个主要部分。第一部分是“CONCENTRATION & POTENCY SPECTRUM”表格，详细列出了不同香水类型（如Parfum、EDP）的香精浓度、持久度和主要用途。第二部分是“THE OLFACTORY PYRAMID (EVAPORATION CHRONOLOGY)”，通过一个三层金字塔图展示了香水的前调、中调和基调，并配有详细的文字描述，解释了各层香调的挥发时间、分子特性和典型成分。第三部分是“MICHAEL EDWARDS FRAGRANCE WHEEL”，一个菱形香水轮图，用于香气分类，并附有关于香调家族关系的说明。第四部分是底部的“AROMATIC RAW MATERIALS”列表，展示了八种芳香原材料的名称标签。图片右下角还包含页脚信息，如“Cartographic Data: Olfactory Standard v.4.0”。
prompt_en: This is an English infographic about perfumery, set against a dark blue background with white and red text. The top of the image features the main title "THE SCENT ARCHITECT'S MAP" and the subtitle "Western Perfumery Pyramid & Olfactory Classification Systems," with vertically arranged Chinese labels "调香学 西方科学" on the right. The infographic is divided into four main sections. The first section is the "CONCENTRATION & POTENCY SPECTRUM" table, detailing the essence concentration, persistence, and primary use for different fragrance types (e.g., Parfum, EDP). The second section, "THE OLFACTORY PYRAMID (EVAPORATION CHRONOLOGY)," uses a three-tiered pyramid diagram to illustrate the top, heart, and base notes of a fragrance, accompanied by detailed text explaining the evaporation time, molecular characteristics, and typical components of each note. The third section is the "MICHAEL EDWARDS FRAGRANCE WHEEL," a diamond-shaped fragrance wheel used for scent classification, with an "OBSERVATION" box explaining the relationships between fragrance families. The fourth section at the bottom is the "AROMATIC RAW MATERIALS" list, displaying eight labels for aromatic raw materials such as "Vetiver" and "Patchouli." The bottom right corner of the image also includes footer information, such as "Cartographic Data: Olfactory Standard v.4.0."

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影宣传海报，主色调为深蓝色、紫色和黑色，背景是浩瀚的星空，点缀着星星和模糊的星云。海报下方偏左侧，一对年轻男女亲密地坐在一起。男子身穿浅粉色条纹衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤，左臂环绕着身旁的女子，目光望向左上方。女子身穿白色背心和浅米色开衫，搭配蓝色牛仔裤，依偎在男子身旁，右手指向右上方，两人手牵手。海报上方三分之二区域被多行垂直排列的白色与浅紫色渐变文字占据，这些文字是电影的宣传语和评论。右下角是电影标题“不能错过的 Nobody 只有你-2”及其副标题“but you”，以及“正在热映”的字样。左下角列出了演职员姓名。整体构图将人物置于星空下，文字叠加其上，营造出浪漫而富有情感的氛围。

The man, wearing a light pink striped shirt and blue jeans, has his left arm around the woman beside him, gazing towards the upper left. The woman, dressed in a white tank top and light beige cardigan with blue jeans, leans against the man, pointing her right hand towards the upper right, and they are holding hands. The upper two-thirds of the poster are filled with multiple lines of vertically arranged text in white and light purple gradients, which are promotional slogans and reviews for the movie. In the bottom right corner are the movie title "不能错过的 Nobody 只有你-2" and its subtitle "but you", along with the text "正在热映" (Now Showing). The bottom left corner lists the cast and crew names. The overall composition places the figures under the starry sky with text overlaid, creating a romantic and emotional atmosphere.

Timely. Free.”。左侧下部是“法律咨询”板块，标题左侧有一条蓝色竖线，内容为“针对民事、刑事、行政案件提供专业解答”。海报左下角是一个蓝色矩形按钮，上面写着“司法局法律援助窗口”，按钮下方是“一站式·零距离·专业化服务”的描述。画面右侧深蓝色背景上，垂直排列着浅灰色的英文“PUBLIC WELFARE”。右侧中部是中文标题“援助指南”，下方是“符合条件的人员可申请免费法律代理”的说明文字。右下角是“咨询热线”及其电话号码“12348”。

In the middle left of the screen, the large characters "法律" (Law) are black, and "援助" (Aid) are blue, forming the main title. Below it is the English text "Legal Aid Window: Professional. Timely. Free.". The lower left section features a "法律咨询" (Legal Consultation) block, with a blue vertical line to the left of the title, and content stating "针对民事、刑事、行政案件提供专业解答" (Providing professional answers for civil, criminal, and administrative cases). At the bottom left of the poster is a blue rectangular button labeled "司法局法律援助窗口" (Justice Bureau Legal Aid Window), with the description "一站式·零距离·专业化服务" (One-stop, zero-distance, professional service) below it. In the middle right, there is a Chinese title "援助指南" (Aid Guide), followed by the text "符合条件的人员可申请免费法律代理" (Eligible persons can apply for free legal representation). 凡捕捉风之技，肇始于手之磨坊，及至当代，化为巍峨之塔筒。此物立于荒野旷间，叶轮广布如巨翼，捕捉天地流转之动能。其内构精微，机舱重逾百吨，负荷千钧而转旋自如。当清风拂过，变桨系统调适角度，以承风力，使叶片徐徐而动，虽转速仅十余周，然其力雄浑不可当。经由齿轮箱百倍增速，激荡电磁，遂生万家之灯火。此所谓借造化之伟力，辅以格物之巧思，乃现代工业与自然相和谐之典范。

prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the structure of a large wind turbine. The image has a plain white background and a clear layout divided into three main sections. The top section features the title "大型风力发电机之构造" (Structure of Large Wind Turbines) and a detailed descriptive text in Chinese, with the first character "凡" highlighted in a larger brown font, and a brown underline beneath the title. The middle section displays a side view of a large wind turbine, with its main components such as rotor blade, hub, nacelle, and tower labeled in both Chinese and English. The left side of the diagram also indicates "高度 80-150m" (Height 80-150m), and the right side shows vertically arranged text "水平轴风力发电机 (HAWT) 之工程图解" (Engineering Diagram of Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine). The bottom section contains a table with four columns and five rows, detailing the physical specifications, functionality descriptions, and material elements of the wind turbine's core components, with the table header row having a brown background. Below the table are a note about the data source and the page number "页码：壹佰叁拾柒" (Page Number: One Hundred Thirty-Seven).

prompt_en: This is a public safety infographic or dashboard interface predominantly in dark blue. The top of the screen displays "SYSTEM LOGIC v 4.0" and coordinate information "COORD: 31.2304 / 121.4737". The left section prominently features the title "公共安全 治安巡逻" (Public Safety Patrol) in large white and blue characters, followed by two data points: "01 响应时效 180 SEC" (01 Response Time 180 SEC) and "02 覆盖密度 100% 全天候无死角覆盖" (02 Coverage Density 100% All-weather, no-dead-angle coverage). prompt_cn: 这是一张杂志或宣传页面的排版设计图，整体采用黑白灰与深蓝色调。页面顶部是标题区域，左侧是英文标题“THE ANCHOR”及其副标题“SPECIAL EDITION / 2024”，右侧是中文标题“父亲节致辞”及其副标题“社交礼仪·节日感谢信”。页面最右侧边缘垂直排布着浅灰色的装饰性英文文字“GRATITUDE PROTOCOL / SOCIAL ETIQUETTE”。主内容区采用左右两栏布局。左栏是一张黑白照片，前景是岸边的一枚锚，背景是停靠着多艘船只的港口。照片左下角叠加有白色中文引用文字““稳如磐石，爱如深海。””。照片下方是一个深蓝色矩形框，框内居中显示白色中文文字“定 海 神 针”。右栏是中文正文，顶部有粗体标题“致：”和“生命中的锚点”，下方是三段正文内容，最后是浅灰色的小字签名“你 们 的 孩 子 敬 上”。页面底部是页脚区域，左侧是一个黑色方块内嵌白色大写字母“A”，旁边是黑色粗体英文“STABILITY & STRENGTH”。右侧是灰色英文标签“#FathersDay2024”和黑色粗体页码“PAGE 01”。
prompt_en: This is a layout design for a magazine or promotional page, primarily featuring a black, white, gray, and dark blue color scheme. The top section of the page contains the title area; on the left are the English title "THE ANCHOR" and its subtitle "SPECIAL EDITION / 2024", while on the right are the Chinese title "父亲节致辞" (Father's Day Address) and its subtitle "社交礼仪·节日感谢信" (Social Etiquette · Festival Thank You Letter). Along the far right edge of the page, light gray decorative English text "GRATITUDE PROTOCOL / SOCIAL ETIQUETTE" is arranged vertically. The main content area is divided into two columns. The left column features a black and white photograph depicting an anchor on the shore in the foreground, with a harbor filled with multiple boats in the background. White Chinese quotation text "“稳如磐石，爱如深海。”" (Stable as a rock, deep as the sea in love.) is overlaid on the bottom left of the photo. Below the photo is a dark blue rectangular box containing centered white Chinese text "定 海 神 针" (Sea-stabilizing Needle). The right column contains the main Chinese text, starting with bold titles "致：" (To:) and "生命中的锚点" (Anchor in Life), followed by three paragraphs of body text, and concluding with a light gray, small-font signature "你 们 的 孩 子 敬 上" (From your children, respectfully). The bottom section of the page serves as the footer. On the left, there is a large white letter "A" enclosed within a black square, accompanied by bold black English text "STABILITY & STRENGTH". On the right, there is a gray English hashtag "#FathersDay2024" and a bold black page number "PAGE 01".

prompt_cn: 这是一幅充满活力的涂鸦风格数字插画，描绘了宝可梦角色超梦（Mewtwo）在释放能量的动态场景。画面中央，超梦以其标志性的紫色身躯和修长造型出现，左臂前伸，仿佛正在施展攻击。其周围环绕着黄色星爆、白色烟雾和黑色速度线，以及带有箭头指示的能量流，共同营造出强烈的动感。背景是一面色彩斑斓、充满涂鸦艺术元素的墙壁，上面有红色、绿色、蓝色、黄色等多种颜料的飞溅、滴落和高度风格化的抽象图案。画面右侧，一个橙色爆炸团呈现出尖叫的表情，下方一个蓝色球体则露出愤怒的神情，两者似乎都在回应超梦的攻击。整幅作品构图大胆，色彩鲜明，充满街头艺术的张力和能量。
prompt_en: This is a vibrant, graffiti-style digital illustration depicting the Pokémon character Mewtwo in a dynamic scene of energy release. Centered in the frame, Mewtwo appears with its iconic purple body and slender form, its left arm extended forward as if unleashing an attack. Surrounding it are yellow starbursts, white smoke, black speed lines, and energy flows indicated by arrows, collectively creating a strong sense of motion. The background is a colorful wall filled with graffiti art elements, featuring splatters, drips, and highly stylized abstract patterns in red, green, blue, and yellow paints. On the right side of the image, an orange explosion cloud displays a screaming expression, while a blue sphere below it shows an angry face, both seemingly reacting to Mewtwo's attack. The overall composition is bold, with vivid colors, conveying the tension and energy of street art.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于压水堆（PWR）与沸水堆（BWR）结构对比的信息图表。图表背景为浅灰色，大部分文字为深灰色，部分表格标题为绿色。页面左侧是垂直排列的主标题“压水堆与沸水堆结构对比”。顶部有三个编号为“01”、“02”、“03”的章节，分别对应“燃芯基础与控制”、“压水反应堆 PWR”和“沸水反应堆 BWR”。每个章节下方都有详细的文字描述，其中“燃芯基础与控制”章节还包含一个圆形抽象图形和三个列表项。压水堆和沸水堆章节下方各有一个示意图，并配有图例说明。页面右侧是一个详细的比较表格，包含“对比维度”、“PARAMETER”、“压水反应堆 (PWR)”、“沸水反应堆 (BWR)”和“关键技术说明”五列，对比了全球装机占比、运行压力与温度、回路设计和控制棒引入方向等多个方面。图表底部左右两侧是页脚信息，包含中英文的标题和页码。
prompt_en: This is an infographic comparing the structures of Pressurized Water Reactors (PWR) and Boiling Water Reactors (BWR). The chart has a light gray background, with most text in dark gray and some table headers in green. On the left side, there is a vertically arranged main title "PWR vs BWR Structural Comparison". At the top, there are three numbered sections "01", "02", and "03", corresponding to "Fuel Core Basics and Control", "Pressurized Water Reactor PWR", and "Boiling Water Reactor BWR" respectively. Each section includes detailed text descriptions; the "Fuel Core Basics and Control" section also features a circular abstract graphic and three list items. The PWR and BWR sections each have a schematic diagram with captions. On the right side of the page, there is a detailed comparison table with five columns: "Comparison Dimension", "PARAMETER", "Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR)", "Boiling Water Reactor (BWR)", and "Key Technical Explanation", comparing aspects such as global installed capacity share, operating pressure and temperature, loop design, and control rod insertion direction. The bottom left and right sides of the chart contain footer information, including bilingual titles and page numbers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于黑洞分类与结构的专业信息图。图片顶部是中文标题“黑洞分类图谱”及其英文副标题“MASS CLASSIFICATION & STRUCTURE SPECIFICATION”。标题下方左侧是一段中文引言，阐述了黑洞的物理性质由质量、自旋与电荷决定。右侧是“SECTION 01 分类体系与定义”的标签。图片中部包含一个表格，标题为“黑洞质量分级指标 / SPECIFICATION GRID”，列出了原初黑洞、恒星级黑洞、中等质量黑洞和超大质量黑洞四种类型，并详细说明了它们的质量界限、视界半径和天体范例。表格下方是一个黑洞结构示意图，以黑色圆形为中心，周围有虚线和实线圆环，并用箭头和文字标注了“奇点”、“相对论性喷流”、“吸积盘”、“光子球”和“事件视界”等组成部分。示意图右侧是“STRUCTURE SPEC”部分，对相对论性喷流、光子球和事件视界进行了编号和简要描述。图片底部左侧是关于史瓦西半径（Rs）的定义和计算公式的中文解释，右侧是“CONSTANTS”部分，列出了物理常数G、c的数值以及Rs的计算公式。所有文字均为深灰色，背景为浅色。
prompt_en: This is a professional infographic about black hole classification and structure. At the top, the image features a Chinese title "黑洞分类图谱" with its English subtitle "MASS CLASSIFICATION & STRUCTURE SPECIFICATION". Below the title, on the left, is an introductory paragraph in Chinese explaining that a black hole's physical properties are determined by its mass, spin, and charge. On the right, there's a label "SECTION 01 分类体系与定义". The middle section of the image contains a table titled "黑洞质量分级指标 / SPECIFICATION GRID", which lists four types of black holes: Primordial, Stellar, Intermediate, and Supermassive, detailing their mass limits, event horizon radii, and astronomical instances. Below the table is a schematic diagram of a black hole, centered around a black circle with dashed and solid rings, labeled with arrows and text indicating components such as "奇点" (Singularity), "相对论性喷流" (Relativistic Jet), "吸积盘" (Accretion Disk), "光子球" (Photon Sphere), and "事件视界" (Event Horizon). To the right of the diagram, the "STRUCTURE SPEC" section provides numbered and brief descriptions of the relativistic jet, photon sphere, and event horizon. The bottom left of the image offers a Chinese explanation of the Schwarzschild radius (Rs) definition and its calculation formula, while the bottom right features a "CONSTANTS" section listing the values for physical constants G, c, and the formula for Rs. All text is dark gray on a light background.

prompt_en: This is an informational graphic illustrating the structural anatomy of classical architectural orders. Presented on a dark gray background, the top features the title "CLASSICAL ORDERS" and the subtitle "STRUCTURAL ANATOMY OF GREEK & ROMAN ANTIQUITY". prompt_cn: 这是一张以深蓝绿色为背景的展览海报。海报的主体是一幅写实风格的油画，占据了画面下方约三分之二的区域。画中描绘了多艘小船在水面上航行，每艘船上载有数人，背景是古老的石拱桥和郁郁葱葱的河岸。画作的色彩以绿色、棕色和浅色调为主，与海报的深色背景形成对比。海报左侧中部是大型中文标题“跨越时空的守护”，下方是英文副标题“GUARDIANSHIP ACROSS TIME & SPACE”以及中文“艺术品保护与修复专题展”和对应的英文副标题。海报右侧列出了展览的日期“2024 7.23-10.8”和地点“广东美术馆 二沙岛馆区 一楼展厅”。海报的右上角和右下角详细列出了指导单位、主办单位、支持机构以及展览团队的各项人员名单。左下角是“广东美术馆”的标志及其英文名称，下方是开放时间、咨询电话和网址等详细信息。
prompt_en: This is an exhibition poster set against a dark blue-green background. The main subject of the poster is a realistic oil painting, occupying approximately two-thirds of the lower part of the image. The painting depicts several small boats navigating on water, each carrying a few people, with ancient stone arch bridges and lush riverbanks in the background. The painting's colors are predominantly green, brown, and light tones, contrasting with the poster's dark background. In the mid-left section of the poster is the large Chinese title "跨越时空的守护" (Guardianship Across Time and Space), with the English subtitle "GUARDIANSHIP ACROSS TIME & SPACE" below it, followed by the Chinese "艺术品保护与修复专题展" (A Special Exhibition on the Conservation & Restoration of Art Works) and its English equivalent. The right side of the poster lists the exhibition dates "2024 7.23-10.8" and location "Guangdong Museum of Art, Ersha Island Branch, First Floor Exhibition Hall". The top-right and bottom-right sections of the poster detail the guiding unit, organizers, supporting institutions, and various personnel involved in the exhibition team. The bottom-left corner features the "Guangdong Museum of Art" logo and its English name, with detailed information such as opening hours, inquiry phone number, and website below.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影海报，背景由大面积的白色羽毛构成，底部左侧有深蓝色/灰色羽毛区域。画面中央是竖向排列的绿色电影标题“喜千年”，其右侧是竖向顺时针旋转90度的白色英文副标题“DANCE STILL”。海报中上部偏左，两名小人坐在一个木质平台上，平台由细绳悬挂，绳子延伸至海报左下角的深色羽毛区域。海报左上角和右上角是蓝色的演职员表信息，包括监制人、主演、摄影指导和导演。导演信息下方还有一行白色英文“A FILM BY QIN MUQIU ZHAN HANQI”。海报右侧有一列垂直排列的黑色文字，列出了电影获得的奖项和入围的电影节信息，如“藏龙单元”、“费穆荣誉”、“评审荣誉”、“青年评审荣誉”、“特别表扬”以及“北京展映”等，并附有“2023第七届平遥国际电影展”和英文对应信息。海报右下角是竖向排列的绿色上映日期“4月8日”和宣传语“一起找鸽子吧!”。海报左下角是横向排列的黑色赞助商和出品公司信息，包括“特别赞助”、“马吴”、“出品公司”、“猫比乌斯”、“简单地”以及“全国艺联专线上映”等文字和相关Logo。
prompt_en: This is a movie poster with a background composed of large white feathers, featuring a dark blue/grey feathered area at the bottom left. The center of the image displays the vertically arranged green movie title "喜千年", with a white English subtitle "DANCE STILL" to its right, rotated 90 degrees clockwise. In the upper-middle left of the poster, two small figures are seated on a wooden platform, suspended by thin ropes that extend to the dark feathered area in the bottom-left. The top-left and top-right corners of the poster show blue cast and crew information, including the producer, lead actors, cinematography director, and director. Below the director's information, there is a line of white English text "A FILM BY QIN MUQIU ZHAN HANQI". On the right side of the poster, a vertically arranged column of black text lists the film's awards and festival entries, such as "藏龙单元" (Hidden Dragons), "费穆荣誉" (Fei Mu Honor), "评审荣誉" (Jury Award), "青年评审荣誉" (Youth Jury Honor), "特别表扬" (Special Mention), and "北京展映" (Beijing Film Panorama), along with "2023第七届平遥国际电影展" (7th Pingyao International Film Festival 2023) and corresponding English details. The bottom-right of the poster features the vertically arranged green release date "4月8日" and the slogan "一起找鸽子吧!". The bottom-left of the poster displays horizontally arranged black sponsor and production company information, including "特别赞助" (Special Sponsorship), "马吴" (Ma Wu), "出品公司" (Production Company), "猫比乌斯" (Mobius), "简单地" (Jiandan Di), and "全国艺联专线上映" (National Arthouse Alliance Exclusive Screening), along with their respective logos.

The top-right section displays a large Chinese character "法" (fǎ, method/law) and the subtitle "THE CANON: 4 KEY RECIPES", followed by four classic cocktail recipes (Dry Martini, Manhattan, Margarita, Mojito), each with ingredients, techniques, and characteristics. generator walls to the secondary cycle, driving the
turbine. The tertiary loop provides condenser cooling.

All components are built to withstand high neutron
flux and thermal stresses. The reactor pressure
vessel is forged from low-alloy carbon steel, lined with
stainless steel. The containment structure acts as the
final boundary against radioactive release.
Redundant safety systems guarantee continuous
core cooling in all emergency shutdown modes,
including total station blackout scenarios.
SECTION VII: SYSTEM CONTROLS
Safety instrumentation relies on continuous neutron
flux monitoring, core exit thermocouple mapping, and
primary pressure sensing. Automated reactor trip
triggers if coolant pressure drops below 13.6 MPa or
if core outlet temperature exceeds 338 degrees.
Control rods drop via gravity within 2.5 seconds upon
power supply interruption, securing subcriticality.

prompt_cn: 这是一张卡通风格的活动海报，画面描绘了向日葵、儿童和一位成年女性围绕着书籍，共同参与一场爱心义卖活动。海报顶部有品牌名称“小葵花”。主标题“小葵花阳光关爱 爱心义卖”以红色粗体字突出显示，下方是活动信息“主营：书籍类”和“活动时间：周五上午”。画面中部左右两侧的横幅上分别写有宣传标语“为有需要的人 分享你的爱”和“爱心传递温暖”。海报背景以蓝绿色调为主，点缀着大片金黄色的向日葵，营造出温暖明亮的氛围。画面中央，一名成年女性和三名儿童或坐或站，手捧书籍阅读，周围堆满了各式各样的书籍。整体构图和谐，文字信息清晰地传达了义卖的主题和细节，与插画内容紧密结合。
prompt_en: This is a cartoon-style event poster, depicting sunflowers, children, and an adult woman gathered around books, participating in a charity book sale. The brand name "小葵花" (Little Sunflower) is at the top of the poster. The main title "小葵花阳光关爱 爱心义卖" (Little Sunflower Sunshine Care Charity Sale) is prominently displayed in bold red text, with event details "主营：书籍类" (Mainly: Books) and "活动时间：周五上午" (Event Time: Friday Morning) below it. Slogans "为有需要的人 分享你的爱" (For those in need, share your love) and "爱心传递温暖" (Love spreads warmth) are on banners in the middle left and right of the image, respectively. The poster's background is dominated by blue-green tones, adorned with large golden sunflowers, creating a warm and bright atmosphere. In the center of the image, an adult woman and three children are sitting or standing, holding and reading books, with various books piled around them. The overall composition is harmonious, and the textual information clearly conveys the theme and details of the charity sale, closely integrated with the illustration.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的晚宴邀请函。画面主体为垂直居中的文字信息，并以一张银色餐具的黑白照片作为视觉分隔。顶部是一个细白色圆圈环绕的字母“S”标志，下方是白色大字“尊享晚宴”。接着是邀请正文“鉴于您在行业内的卓越影响力 我们诚挚邀请您出席这场私享盛宴”。餐具照片中，一把刀、一把叉和两把勺子斜放在深色布料上。照片下方是活动详情，包括日期“二零二四年十二月二十日”、时间“下午七时入场 · 晚宴正式开始”和地点“银座大酒店 · 顶层星幕宴会厅”，日期和地点文字两侧各有一条短横线。底部左右两侧分别列出了“着装要求 / DRESS CODE”和“确认出席 / RSVP”及其具体内容“黑色领结 (Black Tie)”和“请于十二月十日前回复”。最下方是浅灰色小字“SILVER & SOPHISTICATION · PRIVATE GALA”。整个邀请函被细长的白色边框包围。
prompt_en: This is a dark-themed dinner invitation. The main content consists of vertically centered text information, visually separated by a black and white photograph of silver cutlery. At the top, there is a letter "S" logo enclosed in a thin white circle, followed by the large white text "尊享晚宴" (Exclusive Dinner). Below this is the invitation body text: "鉴于您在行业内的卓越影响力 我们诚挚邀请您出席这场私享盛宴" (Given your outstanding influence in the industry, we sincerely invite you to attend this private gala). The cutlery photograph shows a knife, a fork, and two spoons diagonally placed on dark fabric. Below the photo are the event details, including the date "二零二四年十二月二十日" (December 20, 2024), time "下午七时入场 · 晚宴正式开始" (Entry at 7 PM · Dinner officially begins), and location "银座大酒店 · 顶层星幕宴会厅" (Ginza Hotel · Top Floor Starry Sky Ballroom). The date and location texts are each flanked by short horizontal lines. At the bottom, on the left and right sides, are "着装要求 / DRESS CODE" (Dress Code) and "确认出席 / RSVP" (Confirm Attendance / RSVP) respectively, along with their specific details: "黑色领结 (Black Tie)" (Black Tie) and "请于十二月十日前回复" (Please reply by December 10th). The very bottom features small, light grey text "SILVER & SOPHISTICATION · PRIVATE GALA". The entire invitation is framed by thin white borders.

拉斐尔·桑西
天才的解剖研究。他首创晕涂法 (Sfumato)，通过极细腻的色彩渐变模糊物体的轮廓，创造出一种朦胧而富有大气感与内在心理的深度刻画，代表了盛期文艺复兴对自然真理的追求。
以雕塑家的视角审视绘画，强调解剖结构的张力与英雄主义的体魄，其风格被誉为“Terribilita”（力量与敬畏），作品中人体动态展现了灵魂的静止。他将教廷艺术推向了宏伟与壮丽的巅峰。
天才的构图大师，擅长将复杂的元素整合为和谐的秩序。他发展了“统合法”（Unione），融合了达芬奇的色彩与米开朗基罗的形体。其画作代表了古典人文主义所追求的平衡、宁静与理想美学。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于文艺复兴时期三位艺术大师——达·芬奇、米开朗基罗和拉斐尔的对比分析信息图。图片顶部是标题“文艺复兴风格与传世巨作对比分析”及红色日期“1452 – 1564”，右侧有一个红色实心三角形图案。左侧有巨大的竖排文字“文艺复兴”。标题下方，页面被分为三个主要区域，分别介绍了这三位艺术家的英文名、中文名及其艺术风格特点。中部是一个四列表格，详细对比了三位艺术家在“核心特质”、“视觉语言”、“关键技术”和“代表巨作”等维度上的异同。图片底部左侧是一个时间轴图表，展示了三位艺术家的生卒年份和年龄。底部右侧是一个几何构图分析图，配有文字说明“拉斐尔式的金字塔构图分析：展示了圣母像中极其稳定的几何平衡。”页面底部还有页脚信息，包括“EUROPEAN ART HISTORY SERIES”、“PLATE NO. 087”和“FLORENCE / ROME / MILAN”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic providing a comparative analysis of three Renaissance masters: Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, and Raphael. At the top, the image features the title "文艺复兴风格与传世巨作对比分析" (Renaissance Style and Masterpiece Comparative Analysis) with the red date range "1452 – 1564", and a solid red triangle graphic on the right. A large vertical text "文艺复兴" (Renaissance) is on the left. Below the main title, the page is divided into three sections, each introducing one artist with their English and Chinese names and a paragraph describing their artistic characteristics. The middle section contains a four-column table that details the similarities and differences among the three artists across dimensions such as "核心特质" (Core Traits), "视觉语言" (Visual Language), "关键技术" (Key Techniques), and "代表巨作" (Representative Works). The bottom left of the image shows a timeline chart illustrating the artists' lifespans and ages. The bottom right features a geometric composition analysis diagram with the text "拉斐尔式的金字塔构图分析：展示了圣母像中极其稳定的几何平衡。" (Raphael's Pyramid Composition Analysis: Demonstrating the extremely stable geometric balance in Madonna paintings). Footer information including "EUROPEAN ART HISTORY SERIES", "PLATE NO. 087", and "FLORENCE / ROME / MILAN" is at the very bottom.

prompt_cn: 这是一张由四个独立场景组成的2x2网格拼贴图，共同展现了中国春节的庆祝活动。左上角的场景描绘了一条古老街道上的舞龙表演，街道两旁是传统建筑，上方悬挂着大量红色灯笼，其中一个灯笼上印有黄色的“福”字。舞龙队伍身着红色和黄色服装。右上角的场景中，一个家庭在传统房屋前庆祝，两位老人、两位成人和两位儿童围坐在摆满食物的红色圆桌旁。门上贴有红色对联“春意盎然”、“福满乾坤”、“财源广进”、“喜气盈门”和横批“吉星高照”，一名男子正在门上粘贴红色的“春”字。家庭成员穿着红色或带有红色元素的传统服装。左下角是一个繁忙的年货市场，人们在红色棚顶的摊位前购物，摊位上挂着肉制品和香肠，上方悬挂着“新春大吉”和“年货市场”的红色横幅。右下角是夜晚的江南水乡，河道两岸的建筑被红色灯笼照亮，夜空中绽放着绚丽的烟花。所有四个场景均以红色为主色调，灯笼、对联、服装和市场摊位等元素共同营造出浓厚的节日氛围。
prompt_en: This is a 2x2 grid collage composed of four independent scenes, collectively showcasing Chinese New Year celebrations. The top-left scene depicts a dragon dance performance on an ancient street lined with traditional buildings, with numerous red lanterns hanging overhead. One lantern features a yellow "福" (fú) character. The dragon dance team is dressed in red and yellow costumes. In the top-right scene, a family celebrates in front of a traditional house, with two elderly individuals, two adults, and two children gathered around a red round table laden with food. Red couplets reading "春意盎然" (chūnyì'àngrán), "福满乾坤" (fúmǎnqiánkūn), "财源广进" (cáiyuánguǎngjìn), "喜气盈门" (xǐqìyíngmén) and a horizontal banner "吉星高照" (jíxīnggāozhào) are pasted on the door. A man is seen pasting a red paper with the character "春" (chūn) on the door. Family members are wearing red or red-accented traditional clothing. The bottom-left scene shows a bustling New Year's market, where people are shopping at stalls with red canopies. Meat products and sausages hang from the stalls, and red banners displaying "新春大吉" (xīnchūndàjí) and "年货市场" (niánhuòshìchǎng) are visible above. The bottom-right scene is a night view of a Jiangnan water town, with buildings along the riverbanks illuminated by red lanterns, and vibrant fireworks exploding in the night sky. All four scenes predominantly feature red, with elements such as lanterns, couplets, clothing, and market stalls collectively creating a strong festive atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的海洋科学信息图表，展示了全球海洋环流系统。图表顶部是标题“全球五大洋流环流系统 / OCEAN GYRES”和时间戳“T+ 04:12:08:55”。左侧区域包含一个罗盘状的姿态感应器，显示N、E、S、W和0°、90°刻度；下方是四个主要洋流的流速矢量数据，如“GULF STR 2.04 m/s”；底部是传感器观测状态，显示“UNIT: DEEP-SEA-09”和“STATUS: NOMINAL”。中间区域上方是一幅简化的世界地图，标注了纽芬兰、北海道、秘鲁等渔场和北大西洋、太平洋、南太平洋等环流区域；下方是一个详细的表格，列出了六个渔场的名称、主要洋流、成因类型和海域产出数据。右侧区域上方是“垂直断面分析”图，用橙色和蓝色线条表示混合层和深水层；图下方有关于墨西哥湾暖流的文字描述；再下方是“系统参数”，显示盐度、表面水温、含氧量和酸碱度等实时数据。图表底部是四个独立的线图，分别展示北太平洋、北大西洋、南印度洋和南大西洋环流的趋势。整个图表以白色文字为主，辅以橙色、蓝色等颜色突出显示关键信息和图例。
prompt_en: This is an ocean science infographic dashboard with a dark background, illustrating the global oceanic circulation system. The top of the chart features the title '全球五大洋流环流系统 / OCEAN GYRES' and a timestamp 'T+ 04:12:08:55'. The left section includes a compass-like attitude indicator showing N, E, S, W, and 0°, 90° markings; below it are velocity vector data for four major currents, such as 'GULF STR 2.04 m/s'; at the bottom is the sensor probe status, displaying 'UNIT: DEEP-SEA-09' and 'STATUS: NOMINAL'. The upper part of the middle section shows a simplified world map, marking fishing grounds like Newfoundland, Hokkaido, and Peru, and circulation regions such as the North Atlantic, Pacific, and South Pacific; below it is a detailed table listing the names, dominant currents, formation types, and biomass yield data for six fishing grounds. The upper part of the right section presents a 'VERTICAL SECTION' chart, using orange and blue lines to represent the mixed layer and deep water; below the chart is a textual description about the Gulf Stream; further down are 'SYSTEM PARAMETERS', showing real-time data for salinity, surface temperature, oxygen saturation, and pH level. The bottom of the chart features four independent line graphs, displaying trends for the North Pacific, North Atlantic, South Indian, and South Atlantic gyres. The entire chart primarily uses white text, with orange and blue colors highlighting key information and legends.

prompt_en: This is a public service poster against financial fraud, set on a dark blue background. The prominent main title in the center of the poster consists of two lines: "守住" (Shou Zhu) in white brush-stroke style, and "钱袋子" (Qian Dai Zi) in yellow brush-stroke style. Below the main title, there is a white slogan "护好 幸福家" (Hu Hao Xing Fu Jia) flanked by two short grey lines. The bottom section of the poster presents anti-fraud tips in three columns. Each column includes a bold title and two lines of smaller text, such as "01. 不轻信" (Do not easily trust), "陌生来电要警惕" (Be wary of unfamiliar calls), and "中奖信息莫当真" (Do not take prize-winning information seriously). At the bottom left, there is a yellow circular icon next to the white text "中国建设银行" (China Construction Bank). The bottom right displays white text "服务热线: 95533" (Service Hotline: 95533). 福寿康宁。愿岁岁重阳，今又重阳，您皆能笑口常开，岁岁
平安。
吉祥
农历癸卯年九月初九
晚辈敬上

prompt_cn: 这是一张以白色为背景的数字贺卡或信件，四周环绕着深红色的边框。图片右侧中部是竖向排列的深红色大字标题“重阳安康”。卡片中央区域是多列竖排的黑色正文，从右向左依次展开，内容是一封写给长辈的重阳节祝福信。信中表达了对长辈的敬爱、教诲的感念以及对健康长寿的祝愿。图片左下角有一簇盛开的白色菊花图案，其左上角叠加了一个红色方框，框内有白色横排文字“吉祥”。菊花图案的右侧，竖向排列着小字体的落款信息，包括“农历癸卯年九月初九”的日期和“晚辈敬上”的署名。整张卡片设计简洁，文字排版传统，充满节日祝福的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a digital greeting card or letter set against a white background, framed by a dark red border. In the middle right section of the image, a large, dark red title "重阳安康" (Chongyang An Kang) is arranged vertically. The central area of the card features multiple columns of black body text, arranged vertically and read from right to left, forming a letter of blessing for elders on the Chongyang Festival. The letter expresses respect for the elders, gratitude for their teachings, and wishes for health and longevity. In the bottom left corner, there is an illustration of a cluster of white chrysanthemums. Overlaid on the upper left of the chrysanthemum illustration is a small red square containing white horizontal text "吉祥" (Ji Xiang). To the right of the chrysanthemum illustration, vertically arranged small text provides the closing information, including the date "农历癸卯年九月初九" (Lunar Calendar Guimao Year, Ninth Day of Ninth Month) and the signature "晚辈敬上" (Respectfully from a junior). The card features a simple design and traditional text layout, conveying a festive and blessing atmosphere.

The main subject of the image is an interior scene of a deep blue space station, where a person in a spacesuit stands with their back to the viewer, gazing out of a large panoramic window at the vast Earth and starry sky. Outside the window, the blue oceans and white clouds of Earth are visible, along with distant twinkling stars and a bright halo of light, suggesting a sunrise or energy burst. The left side of the image is dedicated to text, featuring multiple levels of titles and information. At the top is the "Canva" brand logo. The main title "智造有数" is in large, bold, cyan-blue characters, followed by a white English subtitle "TECHNOLOGY EMPOWERS THE FUTURE OF INTELLIGENCE". Below that is another large, bold, white title "云启未来". At the bottom is the event description "可画人工智能的南风窗春季高峰论坛", and in the bottom-left corner, within a dark blue rounded rectangle, is "汇报人:张小可". The content of the board is divided into three columns. Each column features a large light blue numerical title (01, 02, 03) at the top, followed by a Chinese main title and an English subtitle. The left column, themed "序章:企业之魂 历久弥新" (Prologue: The Soul of the Enterprise Remains Fresh Over Time), includes a textual introduction to the company's development history, three images with "20xx年" labels and descriptions, and text about "文化铸魂,凝聚力量" (Cultural Soul-Forging,凝聚力量). The middle column, themed "使命:实业兴企 担当为先" (Mission: To Develop the Enterprise Through Industry and Take Responsibility First), contains a textual introduction to "深耕实业,产业兴邦" (Deep Cultivation of Industry, Prospering the Nation), three images, and text about "创新驱动,引领未来" (Innovation-Driven, Leading the Future) along with three data points (annual R&D investment growth 25%, 500 accumulated authorized invention patents, 20 national industry standards led). The right column, themed "优势:核心能力 领跑行业" (Advantages: Core Capabilities Leading the Industry), includes text about "技术壁垒,筑牢根基" (Technological Barriers, Solidifying Foundation) with three percentage data points (65%, 82%, 50%), and text about "全产业链,协同发展" (Full Industry Chain, Collaborative Development) with a diagram illustrating the "原材料采购,生产加工,销售服务" (Raw Material Procurement, Production Processing, Sales Services) process.

02 观色：将酒杯倾斜45度，在白色背景下观察边缘色带，判断陈年程度。
03 摇杯：逆时针轻晃，增加酒液与空气接触面积，促进香气分子释放。
04 闻香：将鼻尖探入杯口，深吸气感受一级果香与二级陈酿香。
05 啜饮：小口吸入并同时吸入空气，使酒液覆盖全舌，感受酸涩平衡。

注意：清洗与存放禁忌

prompt_en: This is a page from a technical guide manual on wine glass typology and tasting fluid mechanics. The page has a white background and primarily features text, schematic diagrams of six different wine glass shapes, and a detailed table. At the top of the page is the main title, "葡萄酒杯型学：6款经典酒杯与品鉴流体力学" (Wine Glass Typology: 6 Classic Wine Glasses and Tasting Fluid Mechanics), followed by a subtitle, a serial number, and confidentiality level information. The main body of the page is laid out in two columns. The left column displays geometric schematic diagrams of six wine glass types, with each diagram labeled with its Chinese name and English model number below. The right column presents five steps of "品鉴操作规程" (Tasting Procedures) in a numbered list, each preceded by a dark blue square as a visual guide. Below the two columns, there is a horizontal section titled "注意：清洗与存放禁忌" (Attention: Cleaning and Storage Taboos), which includes a red exclamation mark icon and corresponding explanatory text. The bottom of the page features a "核心杯型技术规格参数表" (Core Glass Type Technical Specifications Table), detailing the number, name, standard capacity, bowl-to-rim ratio, liquid landing point, and applicable wine types for the six glass types. The very bottom of the page contains footer information, including copyright, document number, and batch level.

text:
Collected at the Castra Devana, mid-spring, anno domini eighty-five. Observations on the organizational structures and standard armaments of the Legio Secunda Adiutrix.
On the Order and Accoutrements of the Roman Legion in the First Century
The Roman legionary of the first century stood as a testament to disciplined coordination and meticulous organization. In this study, we observe the structured layers of the military machine alongside the standard equipment carried by each foot soldier. From the intimate tent-group of the contubernium to the massive deployment of the complete legion, every element was calibrated for collective resilience and precise execution on the field. Each item of gear was born of practical necessity, engineered to balance mobility with absolute protection. Through these simple tools, the Roman state cast its long shadow across the known world.
I. THE HIERARCHY OF ASSEMBLY
Contubernium: The foundational unit of eight soldiers sharing a single leather tent, dining and marching as one. They formed the bedrock of daily companionship and shared labor.
Centuria: Consisting of eighty combatants led by a Centurion, supplemented by twenty non-combatant camp followers who managed logistical duties.
Cohort: The primary tactical division, merging six centuriae into a force of four hundred and eighty men, allowing for versatile field maneuvers.
Legion: A grand force of ten cohorts, comprising forty-eight hundred heavy infantry and one hundred and twenty horsemen, acting under the Legate.
II. THE STANDARD INFANTRY EQUIPAGE
Lorica Segmentata: Segmented iron plate armour, providing flexible protection over the shoulders and torso, fastened with leather straps and brass hooks.
Scutum: A heavy semi-cylindrical shield of plywood and leather, weighing ten kilograms, bound in brass and fitted with a central iron boss.
Gladius: The short thrusting sword of fifty centimetres, carried on the right hip for close combat within the tight shield wall formation.
Pilum: A two-metre heavy javelin featuring a soft iron shank designed to bend upon impact, rendering enemy shields useless and un-throwable.

Fig. 2. The standard array of the imperial infantryman.
III. TACTICAL DEPLOYMENT & LIFE ON THE MARCH
Under the blistering sun or in the damp northern forests, the soldier carried his own survival. The contubernium was not merely a tactical block, but a household; they shared a mule, a grindstone, and a cooking pot. In battle, the cohort acted as a self-sustaining unit, flexible enough to pivot on uneven terrain yet dense enough to withstand cavalry charges. The first cohort, bearing the sacred eagle standard, always held double the standard strength, representing the heart and honour of the entire legion.
IV. CASTRAMETATION AND THE MARCHING CAMP
Every afternoon, the legion constructed a fortified marching camp. Using the groma for sighting, surveyors laid out a grid of streets. Soldiers dug a trench, piling the earth to form a rampart topped with wooden stakes. This ritual ensured that, even in hostile territory, the soldier slept within a familiar, structured city.

Each item of gear was born of practical necessity, engineered to balance mobility with absolute protection. Through these simple tools, the Roman state cast its long shadow across the known world.

The bottom right contains a table listing the combatants, support staff, and commanders for each unit. The entire infographic systematically explains the Roman military organization and equipment details through text, illustrations, and data tables.

The Baltimore classification system, established by Nobel laureate David Baltimore, provides a rigorous structural framework for categorizing viruses based on their mechanism of mRNA synthesis. Unlike classical biological taxonomies that rely on morphology or host range, this architectural approach prioritizes the flow of genetic information. By placing mRNA at the center (the "plus" strand), every virus is defined by the specific technical steps required to transform its genomic material into a functional template for protein synthesis. This modular logic accounts for seven distinct pathways, spanning double-stranded DNA to single-stranded RNA with reverse transcription. This system remains the primary engineering standard for virology, allowing researchers to predict the replication strategy and genetic stability of newly discovered viral agents through the analysis of their primary nucleic acid sequence.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于病毒分类学的科学信息图表，主要展示了巴尔的摩分类系统。图表背景为浅灰色，大部分文字为深灰色。页面左侧设有一个窄边栏，列出了“TAXONOMY”、“VIRAL GENOMICS”等标签。主内容区顶部是标题“VIRAL TAXONOMY”及其副标题“巴尔的摩分类法 / SYSTEM VII”。右上角有“REF. TYPE: NUCLEIC ACID”和“TRANSCRIPTION: 5' → 3'”的标签，并有一个半透明的“VIRUS”水印。图表中央是一个圆形辐射状图，中心标有“mRNA”，蓝色线条向外连接至“G-I”、“G-II”、“G-V”、“G-VII”等节点，下方配有图例“FIG 01. CENTRAL DOGMA INFORMATION FLOW”。图表下方是一段详细的英文正文，解释了巴尔的摩分类系统的原理。底部是两个表格，第一个表格详细列出了七种病毒分类（Group I至Group VII）的基因组结构、复制模板和代表性样本。第二个表格则比较了病毒的包膜状态、对称性、稳定性和极性。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about viral taxonomy, primarily illustrating the Baltimore classification system. The chart has a light gray background, with most text in dark gray. A narrow sidebar on the left lists labels such as "TAXONOMY" and "VIRAL GENOMICS". The main content area features the title "VIRAL TAXONOMY" and its subtitle "巴尔的摩分类法 / SYSTEM VII" at the top. In the upper right corner, there are labels "REF. TYPE: NUCLEIC ACID" and "TRANSCRIPTION: 5' → 3'", along with a semi-transparent "VIRUS" watermark. At the center of the main area is a circular radial diagram with "mRNA" at its core, and blue lines radiating outwards to nodes labeled "G-I", "G-II", "G-V", "G-VII", etc. Below it is the caption "FIG 01. CENTRAL DOGMA INFORMATION FLOW". A detailed English paragraph explaining the principles of the Baltimore classification system is located below the diagram. At the bottom, two tables are presented: the first table details the genomic architecture, replication template, and representative specimens for seven viral groups (Group I to Group VII). The second table compares viral envelope status, symmetry, stability, and polarity.

text:
BORDEAUX & BURGUNDY
波尔多 与 勃艮第 : 产区系统研究
PLATE NO. 042
FRANCE : VITICULTURE ATLAS
EDITION MMXIV
PHILOSOPHICAL DIVERGENCE
GEOGRAPHIC CONTEXT
The narrative of French viticulture is a dialogue between two distinct architectures: the commercial grandeur of Bordeaux and the spiritual pedology of Burgundy. One worships the Estate (the Château), the other worships the specific dirt (the Climat). This plate examines the systemic contrasts between maritime blending and continental purity.
Bordeaux thrives under the tempering Atlantic influence, fostering thick-skinned varieties that require heat. Burgundy, positioned in the continental heart, battles erratic frost and hail, finding salvation in the fragile elegance of the single varietal.

VILLAGE / REGIONAL
In Bordeaux, the master winemaker is an alchemist, balancing the power of Cabernet with the flesh of Merlot. In Burgundy, the winemaker is a transparent vessel, ensuring that the unique geology of a 1-acre plot is expressed without interference.
LEFT BANK

CÔTE D'OR
Limestone-Marl / Pinot Noir
"Bordeaux is a wine of man, shaped by the architecture of the cellar; Burgundy is a wine of the earth, dictated by the fracture of the stone."

THE SEVENFOLD ORDER OF NETWORKS
A Comparative Exposition of the OSI Reference Model and the TCP/IP Stack with their Method of Encapsulation
Before a message may travel across the physical ether, it must descend through a series of formal transformations, a process known unto the network scribes as encapsulation. In the year 1984, the International Organization for Standardization did codify the seven-layer reference model, establishing a peerless hierarchy from the lofty Application down to the humble Physical wire. Yet, in practical execution, the simpler four-fold architecture of the TCP/IP suite governs the actual movement of packets. As data descends this ladder, each successive layer wraps the payload in its own protective header, adding instructions for routing, delivery, and integrity, until the entire assembly is cast into the void as raw electromagnetic impulses.
OSI REFERENCE MODEL

Figure II. Structural Anatomy of the Primary Headers. A detailed representation of the minimum twenty-octet headers appended during transit. The Transport layer utilizes the TCP header (left) for flow regulation and port targeting, while the Internet layer prepends the IP header (right) for logical routing across nodes.
Concerning the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU)
Be it known that the typical Ethernet link restricts the maximum size of a single frame to 1500 octets. Should the payload and its accumulated headers exceed this limit, the network layer must perform fragmentation, carving the packet into smaller fragments to be reassembled at the journey's end.
ON THE TRAVERSAL OF NODES
As the frame journeys across the physical media, intermediate nodes such as switches read only the Link Header to direct the frame to its next immediate destination. Only routers inspect the IP Header to determine the path across networks. The inner TCP Header and User Data remain sealed, unread by intermediary devices, until they reach the destination host, ensuring end-to-end integrity.

The Global Carbon Cycle: Reservoirs & Annual Fluxes
The Cyclus Carbonis represents the fundamental engine of life on Earth. Carbon atoms migrate continuously between the atmosphere, the terrestrial biosphere, and the vast depths of the Oceanus. In its natural state, this system maintains a delicate equilibrium, regulated by the opposing forces of Photosynthesis and cellular respiration.

prompt_cn: 这张信息图表以深蓝绿色为背景，展示了全球碳循环的储量与年通量。页面布局分为左右两栏，左栏较宽，右栏较窄。大部分文字为浅色，而主标题“The Global Carbon Cycle: Reservoirs & Annual Fluxes”和副标题“The Anthropogenic Perturbation”为深色。左栏顶部是标题和一段关于碳循环基本原理的英文正文。下方是一个示意图，描绘了大气、陆地生物圈和海洋水库之间的碳交换通量，并标有具体的GtC（十亿吨碳）数值。示意图下方是另一段关于人为扰动的英文正文，以及一个表格，列出了不同活动（如植物光合作用、化石燃料燃烧）的类型、年通量和净影响。右栏则列出了四个主要碳储量（深海、化石储量、陆地土壤、大气质量）的数值数据及其描述，以及一个同心圆图表，从外到内依次标注为“OCEAN”、“FOSSIL”和“ATMOS”，表示碳储量的相对规模。图表底部还有关于GtC的注释。页面底部有一条细水平线，将主要内容与页脚分开，页脚左侧是“MUSEUM OF NATURAL HISTORY — DEPT. OF GEOPHYSICS”，右侧是“ANNO DOMINI MCMX”。
prompt_en: This infographic, set against a dark blue-green background, illustrates the global carbon cycle's reservoirs and annual fluxes. The page layout is divided into two columns, with the left column being wider than the right. Most text is light-colored, while the main title "The Global Carbon Cycle: Reservoirs & Annual Fluxes" and the subtitle "The Anthropogenic Perturbation" are dark. The top of the left column features the title and a paragraph of English text explaining the fundamental principles of the carbon cycle. Below this is a schematic diagram depicting carbon exchange fluxes between the atmosphere, terrestrial biosphere, and oceanic reservoir, with specific GtC (Gigatons of Carbon) values indicated. Following the diagram is another paragraph of English text on anthropogenic perturbation, and a table listing various activities (e.g., Plant Photosynthesis, Fossil Fuel Combustion) with their type, annual flux, and net impact. The right column presents numerical data and descriptions for four major carbon reservoirs (Deep Ocean, Fossil Reserves, Terrestrial Soils, Atmospheric Mass), along with a concentric circle chart labeled "OCEAN," "FOSSIL," and "ATMOS" from outer to inner, representing the relative scale of carbon reservoirs. A note on GtC is also present at the bottom of the chart. A thin horizontal line separates the main content from the footer at the bottom of the page, which reads "MUSEUM OF NATURAL HISTORY — DEPT. OF GEOPHYSICS" on the left and "ANNO DOMINI MCMX" on the right.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a character customization interface from a video game. In the center of the screen, a female character model is displayed, wearing an ornate red, black, and gold costume. The background is a dark gradient. At the top of the interface, there is a navigation bar containing multiple category tabs such as "外观" (Appearance), "搭配" (Matching), "时装" (Fashion), "挂饰" (Accessories), "面容" (Face), "发型" (Hairstyle), "近战" (Melee), "远程" (Ranged), "展示" (Show), "表情" (Emote), "沟通" (Communicate), and "胜利标记" (Victory Mark), with "发型" (Hairstyle) being selected and highlighted. The left area shows a list of thumbnail options for various hairstyles; some are marked with a green check indicating unlocked status, while others have a red lock indicating locked status. The right panel displays detailed information for the currently selected hairstyle, including the name "女性发型09" (Female Hairstyle 09) and "收藏值: 20" (Collection Value: 20). The character model holds a complex weapon or prop, primarily in gold and gray, on its right side. At the bottom left of the screen, there is a prompt "Enter ↵ 按下回车键开始聊天" (Enter ↵ Press Enter to chat), and on the bottom right, there is a functional button "隐族秘宝解锁【已过期】" (Hidden Clan Treasure Unlock [Expired]) and a prompt "Esc 返回" (Esc Return).

prompt_cn: 这是一张婚礼请柬，整体呈竖向长方形，以米色或浅金色为背景，四周环绕着深金色的边框。请柬顶部和底部有斜切的金色装饰角。画面中央偏上位置，是一个黑白照片，展示了凡尔赛宫镜厅的宏伟景象，其中包含雕塑和镜面反射。照片上方是浅金色的新人首字母“L & S”。照片下方，深棕色粗体字写着“皇家盛典 · 镜厅之约”，其下方是浅金色的英文副标题“ROYAL WEDDING AT VERSAILLES”。再下方是深棕色的新人姓名“陆云深 & 沈若薇”，以及一段关于婚礼日期、地点和邀请的中文正文。请柬中部下方，以三列形式呈现了婚礼的时间、日期和地点信息，标题为浅金色，内容为深棕色。最下方是一个带有圆形边框的红色“囍”字装饰，以及一行深棕色的中文提示语“请凭此函及正装出席 · 期待您的莅临”。
prompt_en: This is a wedding invitation, presented as a vertical rectangle with a beige or light gold background, framed by a darker gold border. The invitation features diagonal gold decorative corners at the top and bottom. Centered in the upper part of the image is a black and white photograph depicting the grand interior of the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, complete with sculptures and mirrored reflections. Above the photo, the light gold initials "L & S" represent the couple. Below the photograph, a dark brown bold title reads "皇家盛典 · 镜厅之约" (Royal Ceremony · Hall of Mirrors Rendezvous), followed by a light gold English subtitle "ROYAL WEDDING AT VERSAILLES". Further down are the couple's names "陆云深 & 沈若薇" (Lu Yunshen & Shen Ruowei) in dark brown, and a Chinese main text detailing the wedding date, location, and invitation. In the lower middle section, wedding details including time, date, and venue are presented in three columns, with light gold headings and dark brown content. At the very bottom, a red "囍" (double happiness) character, enclosed in a circular border, serves as a decorative symbol, accompanied by a dark brown Chinese message "请凭此函及正装出席 · 期待您的莅临" (Please attend with this invitation and in formal attire · We look forward to your presence).

At the top left, the brand name "AURA PARIS" is displayed, with "FRAGRANCE POP-UP" below it. On the top right, the event dates "05.20 – 06.15" and location "SHANGHAI PLAZA 66" are shown. The central part of the poster features the main title "SCENT IDENTITY," with "SCENT" in white and "IDENTITY" in yellow, accompanied by the Chinese subtitle "穿香 建议 & 寻味 指南" (Fragrance Advice & Scent Guide) below. The lower-middle section of the poster presents two parallel content cards. The left card is titled "晨间清冽" (Morning Freshness) with the time "08:00 – 16:00" and an English label "Morning Citrus & Neroli." The right card is titled "午夜深邃" (Midnight Depth) with the time "19:00 – LATE" and an English label "Midnight Oud & Amber." Both cards include specific fragrance application suggestions. At the bottom left of the poster, there is a Chinese description "品牌香氛限时快闪店" (Brand Fragrance Limited-Time Pop-up Store) and the English text "Discover your signature aura at our exclusive scent bar." On the bottom right, there is a call to action "RSVP NOW" and a black button with the Chinese text "扫码预约" (Scan to Reserve).

prompt_cn: 这是一张数字感谢信或贺卡。页面背景为浅米色，整体布局居中。顶部左侧横向排布着日期“二零二四 · 甲辰中秋”，右侧竖向排布着文字“诚以待人”。页面中央是一个圆形插图，描绘了夜晚的景象：一轮明月高悬，下方有两只猫状生物和远处的建筑剪影。插图下方是醒目的标题“感 · 谢”，字体较大且加粗。标题下方是多段正文，以“尊敬的合作伙伴:”开头，内容表达了对合作伙伴的感谢与祝福。正文部分包含左对齐和居中对齐的段落。页面右下角是公司名称“某某实业有限公司”和落款日期“二零二四年·仲秋”，旁边有一个红色的矩形框，框内有白色文字“致谢”。除红色框内的文字为白色外，其余主要文字均为深棕色。
prompt_en: This is a digital thank-you letter or greeting card. The page has a light beige background with a centered layout. At the top left, the date '二零二四 · 甲辰中秋' is arranged horizontally, while on the right, the text '诚以待人' is arranged vertically. In the center of the page is a circular illustration depicting a night scene: a bright moon hangs high, with two cat-like creatures and distant building silhouettes below. Below the illustration is the prominent title '感 · 谢', in a larger and bolder font. Below the title are multiple paragraphs of body text, starting with '尊敬的合作伙伴:', expressing gratitude and good wishes to partners. The body text includes both left-aligned and center-aligned paragraphs. In the bottom right corner are the company name '某某实业有限公司' and the signing date '二零二四年·仲秋', next to which is a red rectangular box with white text '致谢'. All main text, except for the white text within the red box, is dark brown.

世界红十字会1948年国际红十字会第二十届理事会确定每年的5月8日为世界红十字日。

The main visual is a red three-dimensional square with rounded corners, resembling a button or icon, featuring a white cross in its center, symbolizing the Red Cross emblem. The entire background is plain white. Below the Red Cross emblem, the date "5.8" is prominently displayed in large red characters on the left, separated by a thin vertical line from the black text "World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day" on the right. Further below is the large black Chinese title "世界红十字日" (World Red Cross Day). Beneath the title, a detailed Chinese body text explains the origin and significance of World Red Cross Day. At the very bottom of the poster, the text "东乡县融媒体中心" (Dongxiang County Media Center) is present, accompanied by a green abstract logo on its left.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于柯本气候分类法的科学信息图。图片左上方是主标题“柯本气候分类法”及其英文副标题“KÖPPEN CLIMATE CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM — 1884 TYPE SPECIFICATION”。图片右侧有红色圆形印章“特”和方形印章“正”，以及一列竖排的传统中文文字，包括“气候分类学”、“明治七年 地球物理考證”、“第3卷: 地球物理考證”、“柯本”和“專利實用新案”，下方还有一个红色椭圆形印章“气候”。图片内容分为四个主要部分。第一部分“壹 气候分布图 / Climate Distribution”包含一个左侧的圆形气候分布图，标示了本初子午线、北回归线、赤道和南回归线，右侧是“图例说明 / Key”。第二部分“贰 五大主要气候带 / Primary Bands”展示了A、B、C、D、E五种主要气候带的中文和英文名称。第三部分“参 详细技术指标 / Technical Metrics”是一个表格，列出了编码、分类描述、最冷月气温和降水特征。第四部分“肆 水热平衡图 / Hydro-Thermal Index”是一个坐标图，横轴为“年平均气温 (Celsius Scale)”，纵轴为“降水量”，图中标示了“A区: 湿热”、“C/D区: 湿温”和“E区”。图片底部是出版信息，包括“明治十七年 專利局刊印 / BUREAU OF PATENTS”和“壹壹壹零號 气候圖譜 / No. 1110 ATLAS PLATE”。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the Köppen Climate Classification System. The top-left of the image features the main title "柯本气候分类法" and its English subtitle "KÖPPEN CLIMATE CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM — 1884 TYPE SPECIFICATION". On the right side, there are red circular and square seals with the characters "特" and "正" respectively, along with a vertical column of traditional Chinese text including "气候分类学", "明治七年 地球物理考證", "第3卷: 地球物理考證", "柯本", and "專利實用新案". Below this, there is a red oval seal with "气候". The image content is divided into four main sections. The first section, "壹 气候分布图 / Climate Distribution", includes a circular climate distribution map on the left, indicating the Prime Meridian, Tropic of Cancer, Equator, and Tropic of Capricorn, with a "图例说明 / Key" on the right. The second section, "贰 五大主要气候带 / Primary Bands", displays five primary climate bands (A, B, C, D, E) with their Chinese and English names. The third section, "参 详细技术指标 / Technical Metrics", is a table listing codes, classification descriptions, coldest month temperatures, and precipitation characteristics. The fourth section, "肆 水热平衡图 / Hydro-Thermal Index", is a coordinate graph with "年平均气温 (Celsius Scale)" on the horizontal axis and "降水量" on the vertical axis, showing regions labeled "A区: 湿热", "C/D区: 湿温", and "E区". The bottom of the image contains publication information, including "明治十七年 專利局刊印 / BUREAU OF PATENTS" and "壹壹壹零號 气候圖譜 / No. 1110 ATLAS PLATE".

prompt_en: This is a color photograph showing a red, yellow, and blue helicopter hovering against a backdrop of snow-capped mountains. The helicopter's nose is painted with a cartoon expression, and its left fuselage bears the white text "实习飞行员，请多包涵" (Intern Pilot, please be tolerant). On the blue section of its tail boom, there is the white identifier "L-01". Below the helicopter is a metal helipad covered in snow, with green netting along its edges. A group of people in various colored winter clothing are running excitedly from the snow-covered ground on the right towards the helicopter, smiling and some waving their arms. Majestic snow-capped mountains form the background under a cloudy sky.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深棕红色为背景的中国传统色谱系信息图表，所有文字和主要图表元素均以白色呈现。图表顶部是中文主标题“中国传统色谱系：五行五色与自然意象密码”及其英文副标题。下方横向排列着五个色块，分别代表“GREEN WOOD”、“RED FIRE”、“YELLOW EARTH”、“WHITE METAL”和“BLACK WATER”，每个色块下方配有中文颜色名称和简短描述。图片左侧中部是一个表格，标题为“颜色分类与自然意象”，详细列出了颜色类别、色名、物料来源和意象说明，共包含六行数据。表格下方是一个水平条形图，标题为“五行色系数值”，展示了五种元素的数值。图片右侧中部是一个圆形图解，标题为“五行相生相克图解”，描绘了“青、黑、白、黄、赤”五种颜色之间的关系，并附有文字说明。图片底部横向排列着三个文本块，分别以“天青 CELADON”、“玄色 XUAN”和“东方既白 DAWN”为标题，每个标题下方有详细的中文描述。图片最下方是页脚信息。
prompt_en: This infographic, set against a dark reddish-brown background, presents the traditional Chinese chromatic system, with all text and major graphic outlines in white. At the top, there is a main Chinese title "中国传统色谱系：五行五色与自然意象密码" and its English subtitle. Below, five color blocks are arranged horizontally, representing "GREEN WOOD", "RED FIRE", "YELLOW EARTH", "WHITE METAL", and "BLACK WATER", each accompanied by Chinese color names and a brief description. In the middle-left section, a table titled "颜色分类与自然意象" (Color Classification and Natural Symbolism) details color categories, names, material sources, and symbolic meanings across six rows of data. Below the table is a horizontal bar chart, titled "五行色系数值" (Five Elements Color System Values), displaying numerical values for the five elements, with the bars themselves colored to match the elements. In the middle-right, a circular diagram titled "五行相生相克图解" (Diagram of Five Elements Inter-promotion and Inter-restriction) illustrates the relationships between five colors: "青" (Cyan), "黑" (Black), "白" (White), "黄" (Yellow), and "赤" (Red), accompanied by a textual explanation. At the bottom, three text blocks are arranged horizontally, titled "天青 CELADON", "玄色 XUAN", and "东方既白 DAWN" respectively, each with a detailed Chinese description. The very bottom of the image contains footer information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张杂志封面，画面主体是两名面部经过模糊处理的女性模特，她们站在一条铺满金黄色银杏落叶的小径上，背景是模糊的秋季银杏树林，整体呈现金黄色调。左侧的模特身穿酒红色上衣和米色半身裙，手提一个酒红色叶子造型的包；右侧的模特则穿着白色衬衫和印有银杏叶图案的橙色半身裙，手提一个米色与酒红色拼接的包。图片顶部中央是深红色的英文主标题“Feuille d'Or”，上方有日文“フェリル・ダオ”和副标题“(秋の金色、銀杏の葉から)”。左侧区域包含杂志信息，如“11”、“2026年11月”、“第180期”、“2026年11月刊”，以及多个专题标题，包括“銀杏の秋、紅の装い”、“清らかな優雅さで伝統美を継承”、“五十代からの定番とアップデート”和“秋の暖色 メイクアップ特集”。左下角有一个金色椭圆形区域，标有“特別紅葉ガイド付録”。右侧区域则列有“カバー・ストーリー”及其描述“金色の落葉の中で輝く、控えめなエレガンス”，以及“秋風に揺れるコンサバティブな輝き”和“読者贈品”下的“ラグジュアリーブランド 新作バッグ＆小物 プレゼント”。图片底部中央是白色大字，阐明本期主题为“黄金色の秋、銀杏葉にインスパイアされたファッション特集”。整幅画面以金黄色、酒红色和米色为主，营造出浓郁的秋日氛围。
prompt_en: This is a magazine cover featuring two female models, whose faces are blurred, standing on a path covered with golden ginkgo leaves. The background is a blurred autumn ginkgo forest, presenting an overall golden hue. The model on the left wears a wine-red top and a beige skirt, carrying a wine-red leaf-shaped bag. text:
CLASSIFICATION SYSTEMA VIRALE
Viro-
On the architecture of obligate intracellular parasites.
Viruses exist at the threshold of biological definition. They are not cells, but rather sophisticated assemblages of organic matter designed for the singular purpose of horizontal genetic transfer. A virion consists of a nucleic acid genome—either DNA or RNA—encapsulated by a proteinaceous shell termed the capsid. The Baltimore system, established by David Baltimore in 1971, remains the definitive taxonomy, categorizing viruses by their mechanism of mRNA synthesis. This hierarchy dictates the fundamental strategy of infection and replication within the host cell machinery.
I DS DNA VIRUSES
Replicate in the nucleus using host polymerases. Examples: Adenoviridae, Herpesviridae, Poxviridae.
II SS DNA VIRUSES
Must synthesize a complementary strand before transcription. Example: Parvoviridae (B19).
III DS RNA VIRUSES
Genomes are segmented. Transcription occurs via viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase. Example: Reoviridae.
IV (+)SSRNA VIRUSES
Genome acts directly as mRNA. Infectious upon entry. Examples: Coronaviridae, Flaviviridae, Picornaviridae.
Fig. A: Icosahedral Symmetry with Lipid Envelope
V (-)SSRNA VIRUSES
Template for mRNA synthesis. Must carry polymerase in virion. Examples: Orthomyxoviridae, Rhabdoviridae.
STRUCTURAL COMPONENTS
VI SSRNA-RT VIRUSES
RNA genome is reverse-transcribed into DNA for integration. Example: Retroviridae (HIV).
The capsid geometry is typically icosahedral or helical. Icosahedral capsids are constructed from 20 equilateral triangular faces, providing the most efficient volume-to-surface ratio for housing genetic cargo. Helical capsids involve protein subunits (capsomers) bound directly to the nucleic acid, forming a nucleocapsid. In many animal viruses, this structure is further shrouded in a lipid bilayer envelope derived from host cell membranes, studded with viral glycoproteins for receptor binding.
VII DSDNA-RT VIRUSES
DNA genome is filled in, then transcribed to pre-genomic RNA. Example: Hepadnaviridae (HBV).
ATLAS PLATE 002
SCALE
20 — 300 nm
SYMMETRY
T = 1, 3, 4, 7, 13
CODING CAPACITY
2kb — 2.5Mb
STATUS
Non-Living
Note: The boundary between large mimiviruses and small parasitic bacteria remains a subject of significant phylogenetic debate within the contemporary virological community.
© 1982 SUBTERRANEAN PRESS
