prompt_cn: 这是一张数字插画，描绘了两个动漫风格的男性角色及其个人信息。画面左侧是人物插画，右侧是文字信息区域，中间由一个大型竖排艺术字标题“得雪歌”分隔。前景角色拥有一头白色长发，身着蓝色长袍，配有黑色袖口和金色腰带，呈坐姿，右手持一深色长条状物品。背景角色是前景角色的侧影，同样拥有白色长发，身着深色服装并戴有帽子。画面背景为深棕色，带有古典纹理和图案。右侧文字信息区域背景为浅棕色，模拟卷轴或纸张质感，包含“姓名：白知闲”、“性别：男”、“年龄：二十七”、“身高：一米八二”、“身份：金吾卫”等基本信息，以及四段关于其家庭背景、性格特点、工作能力和社交习惯的详细描述。画面中还包含两个红色方形印章图案，分别位于“得雪歌”标题左侧和“身份”标签上方。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration depicting two anime-style male characters and their personal information. The left side of the image features character illustrations, while the right side contains text information, separated by a large vertical artistic title "得雪歌" (De Xue Ge) in the center. The foreground character has long white hair, wears a blue robe with black cuffs and a gold belt, is seated, and holds a dark, elongated object in his right hand. The background character is a silhouette of the foreground character, also with long white hair, wearing dark clothing and a hat. The overall background is dark brown with classical textures and patterns. The text information area on the right has a light brown background, simulating a scroll or paper texture, and includes basic details such as "姓名: 白知闲" (Name: Bai Zhixian), "性别: 男" (Gender: Male), "年龄: 二十七" (Age: Twenty-seven), "身高: 一米八二" (Height: One meter eighty-two), "身份: 金吾卫" (Identity: Jinwuwei), along with four paragraphs detailing his family background, personality traits, work abilities, and social habits. The image also features two red square seal patterns, one to the left of the "得雪歌" title and another above the "身份" label.

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内摄影照片，前景中一只手持着一本博物馆宣传册。宣传册封面设计独特，左侧是深色崎岖的岩石景观，右侧是璀璨的星空或银河图案，两者交织在一起。封面上的白色文字“Heard Museum”和“VISITOR GUIDE”呈倾斜排布，叠加在岩石和星空背景之上。宣传册以一定角度倾斜，占据了图片前景偏右侧的位置。背景是博物馆或画廊的内部空间，墙壁为白色，地面呈橙棕色，深色天花板上嵌有射灯。左侧墙壁上可见一个白色的矩形展示牌。图片左下角有白色水印文字“HEARD MUSEUM - PIPI @ PHOENIX”。
prompt_en: This is an indoor photograph, featuring a hand holding a museum brochure in the foreground. The brochure's cover has a distinctive design, with a dark, rugged rock landscape on the left and a brilliant starry sky or galaxy pattern on the right, intertwined. White, tilted text "Heard Museum" and "VISITOR GUIDE" are superimposed on the rock and starry background. The brochure is held at an angle, positioned slightly to the right in the foreground. The background shows the interior of a museum or gallery, with white walls, an orange-brown floor, and a dark ceiling fitted with recessed spotlights. A white rectangular display is visible on the left wall. White watermark text "HEARD MUSEUM - PIPI @ PHOENIX" is located at the bottom left corner of the image.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的数字宣传海报，主题为短视频作品征集。海报顶部左侧是品牌名称“VISION ART”及其副标题“影像艺术工作室”，右侧标有“2024 EDITION”字样，位于一个黑色矩形框内。海报中部左侧以白色大字突出显示主标题“SHORT VIDEO COLLECTION”，其中“COLLECTION”为灰色。图片右侧边缘垂直排列着装饰性英文关键词“CREATIVE • CINEMATIC • DIGITAL • ART”，带有圆点分隔符。海报中下部显示“征集进度 / PROGRESS”字样，下方是一个蓝色的进度条，右侧显示“85%”的进度。底部左侧是起始日期“01.OCT”和结束日期“30.NOV”，中间标有“STATUS: FINAL CALL”。左下角有中文说明文字“寻找具有独特视角的影像创作者。在线报名通道现已全面开启。”右下角是一个二维码，上方是英文“SCAN TO JOIN”，下方是中文“立即报名”，引导用户扫码参与。
prompt_en: This is a digital promotional poster with a dark background, themed around a short video submission call. At the top left of the poster is the brand name "VISION ART" with its subtitle "影像艺术工作室" (Image Art Studio), while the top right features "2024 EDITION" inside a black rectangular box. The main title "SHORT VIDEO COLLECTION" is prominently displayed in large white letters on the middle left, with "COLLECTION" in gray. Along the right edge of the image, decorative English keywords "CREATIVE • CINEMATIC • DIGITAL • ART" are arranged vertically with bullet point separators. The mid-lower section of the poster shows "征集进度 / PROGRESS" (Submission Progress), with a blue progress bar below it indicating "85%" completion on the right. The bottom left displays the start date "01.OCT" and end date "30.NOV", with "STATUS: FINAL CALL" in the center. The bottom left corner contains Chinese descriptive text: "寻找具有独特视角的影像创作者。在线报名通道现已全面开启。" (Seeking image creators with unique perspectives. Online registration channel is now fully open.) The bottom right corner features a QR code, with "SCAN TO JOIN" in English above it and "立即报名" (Register Now) in Chinese below, guiding users to scan and participate.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以“世界无烟日”为主题的公益宣传海报。海报背景为深灰色至黑色的渐变，并带有烟雾状纹理。画面中央是一个巨大的禁止吸烟标志，由一个红色圆圈和一条红色斜线组成，斜线覆盖着一支正在燃烧并冒着烟的香烟。香烟主体为白色，过滤嘴呈黄色。海报顶部左侧是白色的“Canva ®”品牌标识，顶部中央是超大白色字体“世界无烟日”及其下方稍小的英文“World No Tobacco Day”。禁止吸烟标志下方是中文“尽早戒烟,是对家人最好的保护”和对应的英文“Quitting smoking as soon as possible is the best protection for your family”，这些文字均居中对齐。海报底部左侧是联系电话“联 / 系 / 电 / 话”和号码“0123-4567890”，右侧是网址“网址: www.canva.cn”和地址“地址: 深圳市南山区商业街66号”，这些联系信息均左对齐排列。右下角还有一个白色的方形二维码，内部包含一个黑色的指纹图标。
prompt_en: This is a public service announcement poster themed "World No Tobacco Day". The poster features a dark gray to black gradient background with smoke-like textures. At the center of the image is a large no-smoking sign, consisting of a red circle and a red diagonal line crossing over a lit cigarette emitting smoke. The cigarette itself is white with a yellow filter. At the top left of the poster is the white "Canva ®" brand logo, and at the top center are the extra-large white Chinese characters "世界无烟日" (World No Tobacco Day) with the slightly smaller English text "World No Tobacco Day" below it. Below the no-smoking sign, there is the Chinese text "尽早戒烟,是对家人最好的保护" (Quitting smoking as soon as possible is the best protection for your family) and its English equivalent "Quitting smoking as soon as possible is the best protection for your family", both centrally aligned. At the bottom left of the poster are the contact phone label "联 / 系 / 电 / 话" (Contact Phone) and the number "0123-4567890". To the bottom right are the URL "网址: www.canva.cn" and the address "地址: 深圳市南山区商业街66号", with all these contact details left-aligned within their respective columns. In the bottom right corner, there is also a white square QR code containing a black fingerprint icon.

The upper left section displays an image and the name of the product to be reviewed, "Studio Display." Below it, a dark-background rating area shows an "Overall Rating" of 4.5 stars (four solid yellow stars and one half-solid yellow star), along with "Satisfaction: Very Satisfied." At the bottom left, there is a checked checkbox for "Anonymous Review." The upper right section is the review content input area, titled "Experience," containing a detailed review text about the display's color performance, anti-reflective effect, and resolution. Below this, it shows "128 / 500 words" and an "Automatically saved" prompt. The lower right section is an image upload area with a dashed border, prompting "Add unboxing photos (up to 9)." At the bottom of the page are action buttons: a light-background "Cancel" button on the left, and a dark-background "Post Review" button with white text on the right.

prompt_cn: 这是一张古风奇幻风格的数字插画海报。画面中央描绘了一对年轻男女，他们身着华丽精致的古装，手牵着手，面带微笑，眼神交流。男性角色拥有一头银白色长发，身穿深色长袍，领口和袖口饰有白色毛领及金色纹样，手持一根细长的杆状物。女性角色同样是银白色长发，头戴精美发饰，身穿浅色与橙色相间的飘逸长裙，裙摆和袖子点缀着金色和蓝色图案。背景是夜晚的古建筑群，屋檐下挂着灯笼，远处有朦胧的灯光，天空呈现深蓝色。画面的下方有金色的光效和几条红色的鱼在水中游动，营造出梦幻的氛围。海报左上角有“逆水寒”的金色文字和其下方白色的“新时代”字样。画面中央偏左，以白色描边金色渐变的大字垂直排布着“笙月灯影”四个字，作为主要标题。整体色调以金色、橙色、蓝色和白色为主，色彩鲜明且富有层次感。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration poster in an ancient fantasy style. The center of the image features a young man and woman in elaborate, exquisite ancient costumes, holding hands, smiling, and exchanging glances. The male character has long silver-white hair, wears a dark robe with a white fur collar and golden patterns on the collar and cuffs, and holds a slender rod-like object. The female character also has long silver-white hair, wears intricate hair ornaments, and a flowing light-colored and orange dress with golden and blue patterns on the skirt and sleeves. The background depicts an ancient architectural complex at night, with lanterns hanging under the eaves, distant hazy lights, and a dark blue sky. The bottom of the image shows golden light effects and several red fish swimming in the water, creating a dreamy atmosphere. In the upper left corner of the poster, there is the golden text "逆水寒" (Nishuihan) and below it, the white text "新时代" (New Era). The main title "笙月灯影" (Sheng Yue Deng Ying) is vertically arranged in large, white-outlined, golden gradient characters on the central-left side of the image. The overall color palette is dominated by gold, orange, blue, and white, with vibrant and rich layers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深绿色到黑色渐变为背景的运动主题宣传海报。画面中央偏右是一名处于拳击或格斗姿势的男性运动员，其面部处于阴影中。海报顶部左侧有一个黄色方框，内有白色文字“LIVE NOW”，右侧是白色文字“DATE”和“2024/08”。画面左上方是亮绿色大字“LIMITLESS”和白色大字“CHALLENGE”，构成主标题。右侧边缘垂直排列着白色标语“PUSH YOUR BOUNDARY”。画面中部有一个亮绿色边框的圆形区域，内部显示白色背景的黑色文字“CHECKED”、白色文字“DAY”和白色大数字“21”。左侧区域包含“ASSESSMENT”、“体质监测 评估中心”以及“通过高精度传感数据 重构你的运动基因”等白色文字。右侧区域有“BUDDY SYSTEM”、“运动伙伴”和“匹配进度”等白色文字，其中“98%”为亮绿色。海报左下角列出了“STRENGTH”、“ENDURANCE”、“RECOVERY”等白色英文标签，下方对应有“A++”、“S-LEVEL”、“92%”等评级和百分比。右下角是两行标语，上方为白色“DON'T STOP WHEN YOU'RE TIRED.”，下方为亮绿色“STOP WHEN YOU'RE DONE.”。

The upper left of the image displays the main title, with large bright green text "LIMITLESS" above large white text "CHALLENGE". Along the right edge, the white slogan "PUSH YOUR BOUNDARY" is arranged vertically. In the middle of the image, there is a circular area with a bright green border, containing black text "CHECKED" on a white background, white text "DAY", and a large white number "21". The left section includes white text such as "ASSESSMENT", "体质监测 评估中心" (Physical Monitoring Assessment Center), and "通过高精度传感数据 重构你的运动基因" (Reconstruct your sports genes through high-precision sensor data). The right section contains white text like "BUDDY SYSTEM", "运动伙伴" (Sports Partner), and "匹配进度" (Matching Progress), with "98%" in bright green. The bottom left of the poster lists white English labels such as "STRENGTH", "ENDURANCE", and "RECOVERY", with corresponding ratings and percentages like "A++", "S-LEVEL", and "92%" below them. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark blues, grays, and whites, creating a tense and majestic atmosphere. Two fighter jets fly in the upper part of the sky, one silhouetted on the left, and the other with clearer details on the right. The bow of a large warship emerges from the waves on the right side, with the number "16" visible on its hull. The lower half of the image is filled with violently churning dark blue waves. In the middle-left of the image, below the fighter jets and above the waves, the prominent blue gradient artistic text "海天雄鹰" (Sea Sky Eagle) is displayed.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色照片，展示了一群建筑工人在一个未完工的建筑工地进行安全检查或培训的场景。画面中央是五名身穿蓝色工作服、黄色或白色安全帽、黄色或绿色反光背心的工人。其中一名穿黄色反光背心的工人面向其他工人，用右手指向右侧混凝土柱上的安全标志，似乎正在讲解安全规定。他手中的平板电脑屏幕显示着“Safety Checklist”标题和多个列表项，包括“Safety Checklist”、“Safety Anh Management”、“Safety Renai Checklist”和“Safety Corporation Nonostate”，与现场的安全主题相呼应。左侧的白色和红色屏障上贴有多个安全警示牌，文字包括“WARNING”、“FALL HAZARD”、“NO ENTRY”、“NO HARD HAT”、“MANDATORY SAFETY HARNESS”、“PPE INSPECTION”、“CHECKLIST”、“OBSERVE GENERAL”和“SAFETY”。右侧的混凝土柱上贴有“SAFETY FIRST”、“NO SMOKING PROHIBITED”和“FIRE EXTINGUISHER”等安全标志。柱子底部放置着三个红色灭火器，分别标有“ABC 4 KG”、“4 KG BC”和“4 KG ABC”。背景是未完工的建筑结构，有裸露的混凝土柱和楼板。图片中的文字信息是工地安全管理的重要组成部分，直接传达了现场的安全规范和设备信息。
prompt_en: This is a color photograph depicting a group of construction workers conducting a safety inspection or training session at an unfinished construction site. In the center of the frame are five workers dressed in blue work uniforms, yellow or white hard hats, and yellow or green reflective vests. One worker, wearing a yellow reflective vest, faces the others and points with his right hand to safety signs on the concrete pillar to the right, seemingly explaining safety regulations. The tablet he holds displays a 'Safety Checklist' title and several list items, including 'Safety Checklist', 'Safety Anh Management', 'Safety Renai Checklist', and 'Safety Corporation Nonostate', echoing the safety theme of the scene. On the left, a white and red barrier features multiple safety warning signs with text such as 'WARNING', 'FALL HAZARD', 'NO ENTRY', 'NO HARD HAT', 'MANDATORY SAFETY HARNESS', 'PPE INSPECTION', 'CHECKLIST', 'OBSERVE GENERAL', and 'SAFETY'. The concrete pillar on the right has safety signs displaying 'SAFETY FIRST', 'NO SMOKING PROHIBITED', and 'FIRE EXTINGUISHER'. At the base of the pillar, three red fire extinguishers are placed, labeled 'ABC 4 KG', '4 KG BC', and '4 KG ABC' respectively. The background shows an unfinished building structure with exposed concrete pillars and floor slabs. The textual information in the image forms a crucial part of site safety management, directly conveying on-site safety norms and equipment details.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于包豪斯设计运动的信息图表，以深色背景呈现，搭配白色、青色和黄色的文字与图形。图表顶部是标题“BAUHAUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM”及其中文副标题“包豪斯设计运动：演进史与 6 大核心原则”，右侧显示了系统状态、时间线和地点信息。中部是一条水平时间轴，标注了1919年魏玛、1925年德绍、1933年柏林和1933年关闭等关键节点，并配有奠基人、鼎盛时期负责人和最终负责人等信息。图表下方分为三列：左列展示了包豪斯的六大核心原则及其标签；中列是年代数据和系统日志，详细记录了运动发展的重要事件；右列列举了经典作品及其型号，并阐述了包豪斯对全球的深远影响。左下角还展示了方形、三角形和圆形三种几何图形。底部是页脚信息，包含编号、数据来源和编码。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the Bauhaus design movement, presented on a dark background with white, cyan, and yellow text and graphics. The top of the chart features the title "BAUHAUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM" and its Chinese subtitle "包豪斯设计运动：演进史与 6 大核心原则", with system status, timeline, and location information on the right. The middle section contains a horizontal timeline marking key nodes such as 1919 Weimar, 1925 Dessau, 1933 Berlin, and 1933 Close, accompanied by information about founders and directors during different periods. The bottom part of the chart is divided into three columns: the left column displays six core Bauhaus principles with their tags; the middle column presents chronological data and system logs detailing important events in the movement's development; the right column lists classic artifacts with their model numbers and explains the profound global impact of Bauhaus. The bottom left also shows three geometric shapes: square, triangle, and circle. Footer information including plate number, data source, and encoding is at the very bottom.

prompt_en: This is a festive color photograph showing a group of adults dressed in red traditional Chinese attire, smiling and raising their hands to greet the audience. In the center of the frame, about ten men and women stand side by side, wearing red tops with gold patterns and matching long skirts or trousers. The background features a red archway or stage structure decorated with red lanterns and gold patterns. Above the archway, a red banner hangs with "欢度春节" (Celebrate Spring Festival) written in gold characters. On the left side of the image, one person holds up a large red peony-shaped sign with big black characters "新年好" (Happy New Year). Below, four individuals each hold smaller red peony-shaped signs, with the black characters "新" (New), "年" (Year), "快" (Happy/Fast), and "乐" (Joy/Happy) written sequentially, collectively forming the greeting "新年快乐" (Happy New Year). The entire photograph is dominated by red and gold tones, creating a strong festive atmosphere.

prompt_en: This is a digital illustration depicting a mysterious character. Slightly to the left of the center, a figure with white short hair, wearing a black mask and a strange smile, is shown. The character is dressed in a dark blue robe with white tassels and a red circular ornament on the shoulders and chest. Above the mask are a pair of black horn-like decorations, resembling those of a bird or demon. Behind the character, a pair of large black wings spread out, their edges glowing with red light, as if burning in the darkness. The background is a dark blue night sky with sparse clouds and scattered red light spots, creating a dim yet tense atmosphere. On the right side of the image, there is a vertical block of Chinese dialogue enclosed in square brackets, which reads: "Why bother? You should know that what binds you is not just this prison. Whether it's the overconfident or the stubborn, let them all vanish." At the bottom of the image, there is another horizontal block of Chinese narration: "As if to confirm the other's resemblance, no sooner had the other's words fallen than the patriarch stumbled a few steps. Seeing this, the other's smile deepened." The overall color scheme of the image is dominated by dark blue, black, red, and white, with a dark tone that emphasizes the character's mystery and power.

text:
English
HAPPY LEARNING
CAMPUS WHISPERS
The oak tree by the playground has
grown a little taller, as if stretching
to hear our stories. The cafeteria
hums with the scent of warm
cookies and chatter.
CHAPTER UNFOLDS
The bell rings, chasing away the
summer haze. Our backpacks, once
filled with sand and sunscreen,
now cradle fresh notebooks and
sharpened pencils.
ABL
MOVING TARGET
Morning dew glistens on the
track, where new personal
bests are waiting. The
whiteboard in math class is
clean, ready for equations
adventures.
CHEERS!
TOGETHER WE GROW
Laughs will echo louder than hallway noise, and late-night study
sessions will taste like instant noodles and camaraderie. We'll stumble,
but we'll pick each other up—because no one climbs the ladder of
success alone.
This term isn't just about grades; it's about the courage to raise your
hand, the joy of new friendships, and the magic of becoming a little
wiser, one day at a time.

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个深色主题的软件界面，整体布局分为顶部导航栏和三个主要内容面板。顶部导航栏左侧显示应用标题“模型评估：样本深度分析”及其版本号“v2.4.0-Stable”，右侧则展示了两个性能指标：“准确率 94.28%”（绿色文字）和“异常样本 12/1,024”（红色文字）。左上角有一个紫色的圆形图标，内部是白色的“O”形图案。左侧面板标题为“样本队列”，列出了三个样本项，每个包含一个ID（如“#ID-9928”）、一个状态标签（“失败”为红色背景，“待校验”为橙色背景，“通过”为绿色背景）和一段描述。中间面板标题为“样本详情 #ID-9929”，右侧显示“置信度: 0.42”，下方依次是“Prompt 输入”、“预期输出”和“模型输出”三个部分，分别展示了相关的文本内容。右侧面板标题为“特征归因”，包含“数学逻辑权重 88%”和“指令遵循度 45%”两个带有进度条的指标，以及一个“错误根因定位”列表，列出了两项错误原因。面板底部有一个紫色的“加入微调数据集”按钮。界面中的主要文字为白色或灰色。
prompt_en: This image displays a dark-themed software interface, structured into a top navigation bar and three main content panels. The top navigation bar on the left shows the application title "模型评估：样本深度分析" (Model Evaluation: Sample Deep Analysis) and its version "v2.4.0-Stable". On the right, two performance metrics are displayed: "准确率 94.28%" (Accuracy 94.28%, in green text) and "异常样本 12/1,024" (Abnormal Samples 12/1,024, in red text). In the top-left corner, there is a purple circular icon with a white 'O' shape inside. The left panel, titled "样本队列" (Sample Queue), lists three sample items, each including an ID (e.g., "#ID-9928"), a status label ("失败" (Failed) with a red background, "待校验" (To Be Verified) with an orange background, "通过" (Passed) with a green background), and a description. The middle panel is titled "样本详情 #ID-9929" (Sample Details #ID-9929), with "置信度: 0.42" (Confidence: 0.42) on the right. Below it are three sections: "Prompt 输入" (Prompt Input), "预期输出" (Expected Output), and "模型输出" (Model Output), each displaying relevant text content. The right panel, titled "特征归因" (Feature Attribution), includes two metrics with progress bars: "数学逻辑权重 88%" (Mathematical Logic Weight 88%) and "指令遵循度 45%" (Instruction Adherence 45%), along with an "错误根因定位" (Error Root Cause Location) list detailing two error reasons. At the bottom of this panel is a purple button labeled "加入微调数据集" (Add to Fine-tuning Dataset). The main text in the interface is white or gray.

In the foreground, there are tree leaves, blurry crowds, and vehicles. A circular white logo in the upper left corner, partially obscured by leaves, contains the Chinese text "城市漫步" and the English text "STAMPED WALK". The right text panel features a large deep brown title "OLD DAYS" at the top, followed by a Chinese description: "探索隐匿于街角巷弄的艺术灵感，在复古滤镜下重拾城市温度.". Below this are three numbered list items, each with a Chinese and an English description. The list item numbers are enclosed in rectangular boxes, alternating between deep brown and light brown backgrounds. At the bottom right of the panel, the deep brown texts "LIMITED EDITION" and "FREE" are displayed, with "FREE" in a larger font.

Along the right edge, a vertical warning reads "DANGER HIGH VOLTAGE KEEP OUT" in white. The central part of the poster features large white English text "KEEP CLEAR", with "CLEAR" rendered in an outline font. Below this, a Chinese warning states "配电箱前通道 严禁堆物" (Passageway in front of distribution box, piling up items strictly forbidden), where "严禁堆物" is highlighted in cyan. To the right of the central warning, "VOLTAGE" and "STATUS" are shown in gray, with corresponding values "380V" and "220V" in white, and "SECURE" in green. The bottom left section provides a detailed Chinese explanation about maintaining a clean environment around electrical facilities. At the bottom right, a red rectangular button features "预防电火" (Prevent Electrical Fires) and "守护平安" (Guard Safety) in white. Three small colored squares (white, blue, and dark blue) are located at the very bottom right.

prompt_en: This is a digital housewarming invitation with a simple layout on a light beige grid background. At the top center of the page are the English word "INVITATION" and the Chinese title "乔迁之喜" (Housewarming Celebration), with a short horizontal line below as decoration. The central part features a black and white photograph of a rustic stone villa with multiple windows and a courtyard. Below the photo is the main body of the invitation, starting with "致: 亲爱的亲朋好友" (To: Dear Friends and Family), followed by a Chinese description of the villa's completion and the invitation to guests. Below the main text, specific details are listed, including "时间" (Time), "地点" (Location), and "席设" (Arrangement), each preceded by a red or green square icon. The bottom right of the page shows "主人家:" (Host:) and the signature "张府敬邀" (Sincerely invited by the Zhang family), while the bottom left has the small text "谨以此邀请" (With this invitation).

Mass production of integrated circuits at the atomic scale. Silicon atoms are roughly 0.2nm wide; a 5nm gate is only 25 atoms across.

SILICON

PURITY

The journey begins with sand (Quartzite), purified to Electronic Grade Silicon (EGS) with a purity level of 99.9999999%.
THE PROCESS

300 mm

Wafer Thickness

OXIDATION
02

04

05
ION
DOPING
06

Chemical or plasma removal of material not protected by resist.
Injecting Boron or Phosphorus to change electrical conductivity.
Depositing Copper layers for vertical & horizontal wiring.
PLANAR (2D)
FINFET (3D)
GAAFET (NS)
LITHOGRAPHY CORE: ASML EUV
Transitioning from FinFET to Gate-All-Around (GAA) for sub-3nm control.
Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) light is generated by hitting tin droplets with CO2 lasers 50,000 times per second.
13.5 NM
10B+
TRANSISTOR DENSITY
A modern smartphone chip contains over 10 to 15 billion transistors in a space the size of a fingernail. Maximum precision is mandatory: One dust particle ruins the entire die.
WAFER YIELD
Percentage of functional chips per 300mm wafer. 7nm processes often target 80%+ yield.
VACUUM ENV
EUV light is absorbed by air. All lithography must happen in a total vacuum.
CLEANROOM
ISO Class 1 environment: Less than 10 particles per cubic meter of air.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于超大规模集成电路制造的信息图。图片背景为深紫色，顶部左侧有“ULTRA SCALE FAB”的白色大字标题，右侧标有“CURRENT STANDARD: 5NM/7NM”并配有关于原子级生产的说明文字。图片主体是一个大型白色矩形区域，分为左右两部分。左侧区域介绍了“RAW MATERIAL: SILICON”的原材料信息，包括硅的纯度（9N PURITY）和提纯过程，以及一个包含晶圆直径、晶锭生长方法、晶圆厚度和晶格类型等参数的表格。下方是“TRANSISTOR EVOLUTION”部分，展示了平面（PLANAR (2D)）、鳍式场效应晶体管（FINFET (3D)）和全环栅晶体管（GAAFET (NS)）三种晶体管的演变示意图，并附有文字说明。右侧区域详细阐述了“6-STEP FABRICATION CYCLE”的六个制造步骤，包括氧化、涂覆、曝光、刻蚀、离子掺杂和金属化，每个步骤都有编号和简要描述。该区域还包含“LITHOGRAPHY CORE: ASML EUV”部分，介绍了极紫外光刻技术（EUV）的工作原理，并配有一个标有“13.5 NM”的波形图。图片底部是一个横贯的粉色条带，突出显示“10B+ TRANSISTOR DENSITY”并解释了现代芯片的晶体管密度和制造精度要求。粉色条带下方并列排布着三个浅紫色矩形框，分别介绍了“WAFER YIELD”（晶圆良率）、“VACUUM ENV”（真空环境）和“CLEANROOM”（洁净室）的相关信息。图片中的关键数字和术语常以粉色粗体字突出显示。

Below the pink band, three light purple rectangular boxes are arranged side-by-side, providing information on "WAFER YIELD", "VACUUM ENV", and "CLEANROOM" respectively. Slightly below the center of the image, a hunter in an orange top, holding a rifle, stands between the bear and the dogs. At the top of the poster, the orange text "IN COLOR-WIDE SCREEN" is displayed, with the black subtitle "ACTION FILLED WILD LIFE ADVENTURE FILM FOR THE ENTIRE FAMILY" to its right. On the left side, "Featuring..." and the orange text "VICTOR JORY" are present. In the middle of the poster, the large orange wood-grain effect font forms the main title "TRAIL OF THE HUNTER," with "OF THE" in smaller black letters. The bottom of the poster features four small, side-by-side illustrations, each accompanied by black text descriptions, including "Elk by the 1,000's," "Fishing Thrills," "Giant Mule Deer," and "Jaguar & Crocodile Fight." The bottom left corner contains the black copyright information "COPYRIGHT 1970 THEATRE MANAGEMENT COMPANY," and the bottom right corner shows the numerical code "70/323."

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a health science popularization website. The page features a light-colored background, with the main content areas presented as white cards. The top navigation bar displays the brand name "MEDICAL INSIGHT" and the main title "健康科普资讯中心" (Health Science Popularization Information Center), with the date "2024.05.20" and a "实时更新" (Real-time Update) tag on the right. The main body of the page is divided into two columns: a wider left column and a narrower right column. The top of the left column features an image with a "深度专题" (In-depth Special) tag, showing a bowl of healthy food including salmon, berries, nuts, and vegetables. Below the image are the article title "科学饮食：如何通过微量元素精准提升免疫系统效能" (Scientific Diet: How to Precisely Enhance Immune System Efficacy Through Trace Elements) and a summary of its main text. At the bottom of the article are the author's information "李明远 博士 首席医学顾问" (Dr. Li Mingyuan, Chief Medical Advisor) and a "阅读全文 →" (Read Full Article →) link. The upper part of the right column is a dark-background card containing a "每日健康金句" (Daily Health Quote) with the quote "预防医学的本质，是让健康成为一种可管理的数据资产。" (The essence of preventive medicine is to make health a manageable data asset.) and its source "《现代预防医学导论》" (Introduction to Modern Preventive Medicine). Below this is a "热门科普分类" (Popular Science Categories) list, which includes "心血管健康管理" (Cardiovascular Health Management), "神经科学与睡眠" (Neuroscience and Sleep), and "临床营养学指南" (Clinical Nutrition Guidelines), each with an icon and article count. The footer at the bottom of the page displays information such as "系统运行正常" (System Running Normally), "数据来源: 国家卫生健康委员会" (Data Source: National Health Commission), and "SECURE CONNECTION: AES-256".

prompt_cn: 这是一张摄影照片，展示了一张木质课桌，上面摆放着一本打开的教科书、三支铅笔、一块橡皮擦和一个一次性咖啡杯。课桌和椅子呈现木质棕色，教科书页面为白色。铅笔分别有蓝色、黄色和绿色，橡皮擦上的文字是蓝色，咖啡杯为黑色和棕色。课桌位于画面前景，略微倾斜。教科书在课桌中央打开，左页标题为“微积分基础: 导数的应用”，右页标题为“牛顿第二定律与运动学”，两页均有“问题分类解析”副标题。铅笔和橡皮擦散落在教科书周围。咖啡杯位于课桌的右上角。课桌右侧可见窗户。画面背景和前景部分可见木质椅子。教科书页面采用单栏布局，包含编号的问题和相关的数学或物理图示，图示内容与文本描述的问题直接相关。
prompt_en: This is a photographic image showing a wooden desk with an open textbook, three pencils, an eraser, and a disposable coffee cup. The desk and chairs are wooden brown, and the textbook pages are white. The pencils are blue, yellow, and green, the text on the eraser is blue, and the coffee cup is black and brown. The desk is in the foreground, slightly tilted. The textbook is open in the center of the desk, with the left page titled "微积分基础: 导数的应用" (Calculus Fundamentals: Applications of Derivatives) and the right page titled "牛顿第二定律与运动学" (Newton's Second Law and Kinematics), both pages also featuring the subtitle "问题分类解析" (Problem Classification Analysis). Pencils and the eraser are scattered around the textbook. The coffee cup is in the upper right corner of the desk. A window is visible to the right of the desk. Wooden chairs are visible in both the background and foreground. The textbook pages feature a single-column layout, containing numbered problems and related mathematical or physical diagrams, where the diagrams are directly associated with the described problems.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于设计沙龙的宣传海报。画面被垂直分为左右两部分，整体色调为深灰、棕和白色。左侧区域以深色背景为主，叠加了棕色和灰色块状抽象图形，其上是白色大字“MATERIAL SPLICING”和“SPACE & TEXTURE”，以及中文描述“重构空间美学，探索材质与建筑的深度对话。”左侧边缘有垂直排列的装饰文字“ESTABLISHED 2024”。左下角标明了活动地点“LOCATION 上海·滨江艺术中心”。右侧区域展示了一个现代室内设计场景，包含一张白色沙发、两盏落地灯、置物架、百叶窗和网格状天花板。右上方是活动标题“2024 DESIGN SALON 品牌体验中心”。右侧边缘有垂直排列的装饰文字“ARCHITECTURE”。画面中部偏右有三个并列的小方块，颜色分别为白色、棕色和浅棕色。右下角标明了活动日期“DATE Nov. 28 - Dec. 01”，并有一个白色边框按钮“JOIN THE SALON”。背景中隐约可见半透明的“MATERIALITY”字样。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a design salon. The image is vertically divided into two main parts, with an overall color scheme of dark grey, brown, and white. The left section features a dark background overlaid with abstract brown and grey block shapes, on which large white text "MATERIAL SPLICING" and "SPACE & TEXTURE" are displayed, along with the Chinese description "重构空间美学，探索材质与建筑的深度对话。" (Reconstruct spatial aesthetics, explore a deep dialogue between materials and architecture.) Along the left edge, decorative vertical text reads "ESTABLISHED 2024". The bottom left indicates the event location: "LOCATION 上海·滨江艺术中心" (Shanghai Binjiang Art Center). The right section showcases a modern interior design scene, including a white sofa, two floor lamps, shelves, blinds, and a grid ceiling. The top right features the event title "2024 DESIGN SALON 品牌体验中心" (Brand Experience Center). Along the right edge, decorative vertical text reads "ARCHITECTURE". Towards the middle right, there are three small side-by-side squares in white, brown, and light brown. The bottom right specifies the event date: "DATE Nov. 28 - Dec. 01", and a white-bordered button "JOIN THE SALON". Faint, semi-transparent text "MATERIALITY" is subtly visible in the background.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色摄影照片，展示了日落时分海滩上的夏日景象。画面中，橙红色的天空与蓝绿色的海水相接，远处海面上空有烟花绽放。金黄色的沙滩占据了图片的中下部和前景，沙滩中央堆砌着一个带有小红旗的沙堡，沙堡前方还装饰着一个白色贝壳。沙堡上方沙地上刻有中文“你好夏日”，下方则刻有“王小明老婆我爱你老婆,我爱你”。沙滩上散布着几组人物，有的坐在沙滩巾上休息，有的在海边散步，还有人坐在沙滩椅上，旁边立着绿色和蓝白色的沙滩伞。整个场景充满了夏日海滨的休闲与浪漫氛围。
prompt_en: This is a color photographic image depicting a summer beach scene at sunset. In the picture, an orange-red sky meets blue-green ocean water, with fireworks blooming in the distance above the sea. The golden sand beach occupies the middle-lower part and foreground of the image. In the center of the beach, there is a sandcastle with a small red flag, and a white seashell decorates the front of the sandcastle. Above the sandcastle, the Chinese text "你好夏日" (Hello Summer) is carved into the sand, and below it, "王小明老婆我爱你老婆,我爱你" (Wang Xiaoming's wife, I love you, wife, I love you) is carved. Several groups of people are scattered on the beach; some are resting on beach towels, some are strolling by the sea, and others are sitting on beach chairs with green and blue-and-white beach umbrellas nearby. The entire scene is filled with a relaxed and romantic summer seaside atmosphere.

I. KINETIC FLOW

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的风险监控系统仪表盘界面。界面顶部显示系统名称“RISKSENTINEL V4.2”，系统状态“运行正常 / 实时监控中”以及当前时间“2024-05-24 14:30:02”。主内容区域分为三列：左侧是“综合风险评分”，中央显示一个绿色圆环图，其中包含大字号数字“84”和“低风险”标签，下方有“环比变化 ↓ 4.2%”和“置信度 99.8%”。中间列是“实时风险预警流”，列出了最近60分钟内的四条预警信息，包括时间、事件描述和风险等级（如“14:28 异常大额跨境转账”标记为“高风险”，“14:25 多设备频繁登录”标记为“中风险”）。右侧列是“评分维度分析”，展示了“身份真实性 92%”、“行为稳定性 78%”和“履约能力 85%”的进度条，下方是“24小时风险趋势”的柱状图。界面底部显示系统信息“引擎: 活跃”和“负载: 24%”，以及安全协议“SECURE_PROTOCOL_AES_256”。
prompt_en: This is a dashboard interface of a risk monitoring system with a dark background. The top of the interface displays the system name "RISKSENTINEL V4.2", system status "运行正常 / 实时监控中" (Running Normally / Real-time Monitoring), and the current time "2024-05-24 14:30:02". The main content area is divided into three columns: The left column shows "综合风险评分" (Comprehensive Risk Score), with a large green circular gauge displaying the number "84" and the label "低风险" (Low Risk), below which are "环比变化 ↓ 4.2%" (Month-on-month Change ↓ 4.2%) and "置信度 99.8%" (Confidence 99.8%). The middle column is "实时风险预警流" (Real-time Risk Alert Stream), listing four alert messages from the last 60 minutes, including time, event description, and risk level (e.g., "14:28 异常大额跨境转账" (Abnormal Large Cross-border Transfer) marked as "高风险" (High Risk), "14:25 多设备频繁登录" (Frequent Login from Multiple Devices) marked as "中风险" (Medium Risk)). The right column is "评分维度分析" (Scoring Dimension Analysis), presenting progress bars for "身份真实性 92%" (Identity Authenticity 92%), "行为稳定性 78%" (Behavior Stability 78%), and "履约能力 85%" (Performance Capability 85%), below which is a bar chart for "24小时风险趋势" (24-hour Risk Trend). The bottom of the interface displays system information "引擎: 活跃" (Engine: Active) and "负载: 24%" (Load: 24%), along with the security protocol "SECURE_PROTOCOL_AES_256".

prompt_cn: 这是一张漫画书封面，画面中央是身穿深色战衣的蝙蝠侠，他蹲伏在建筑物边缘，手持一根细绳。背景中，透过窗户可以看到三个人物，分别是戴礼帽的男子（Mad Hatter）、叼雪茄的男子（Penguin）和面部模糊的男子（Scarecrow）。封面上方有超人标志和“MAN OF STEEL”、“IN THEATERS AND IMAX 6.14.13”、“THE NEW 52!”等文字。左上角是DC Comics标志、“ANNUAL”和“#1”。中央标题为“BATMAN THE DARK KNIGHT”。左下角列出了作者“GREGG HURWITZ”、“SZYMON KUDRANSKI”，以及日期“JUL 2013”和分级“RATED T TEEN”。底部有“FEATURING”字样，并列出了反派角色“THE Mad HatTER,”、“THE PENGUIN,”和“AND SCARECROW!”。右下角是网址“DCCOMICS.COM”。画面整体色调阴暗，以灰色、蓝色和棕色为主，文字部分有亮色点缀，共同构成一张信息丰富的漫画封面。
prompt_en: This is a comic book cover featuring Batman in a dark suit, crouching on a building ledge and holding a thin rope, positioned centrally. In the background, three figures are visible through windows: a man in a top hat (Mad Hatter), a man smoking a cigar (Penguin), and a man with a blurred face (Scarecrow). At the top of the cover are the Superman logo and texts like “MAN OF STEEL,” “IN THEATERS AND IMAX 6.14.13,” and “THE NEW 52!”. The top left features the DC Comics logo, “ANNUAL,” and “#1.” The central title reads “BATMAN THE DARK KNIGHT.” The bottom left lists the authors “GREGG HURWITZ,” “SZYMON KUDRANSKI,” the date “JUL 2013,” and the rating “RATED T TEEN.” The bottom section includes “FEATURING” followed by the villain names “THE Mad HatTER,” “THE PENGUIN,” and “AND SCARECROW!”. The bottom right displays the website “DCCOMICS.COM.” The overall color scheme is dark, dominated by grays, blues, and browns, with bright accents in the text, collectively forming an informative comic book cover.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以中国传统水墨画为主题的展览海报。海报背景为浅米色，四周有深棕色边框。画面中央是一幅高窄的抽象水墨画，以黑白灰为主色调，笔触粗犷有力。画作右下角有一个红色方框，内有白色竖排文字“博物”。海报左侧竖排着黑色大字标题“墨影华章”，其左侧是较小的副标题“历届书法获奖作品特展”。右侧竖排有红色小字“一零二四 仲秋之月·启幕 笔墨横姿气韵生动 传承经典艺道长青”，下方是黑色竖排文字“国家博物馆”和一个圆形图案。海报底部中央是黑色英文“MUSEUM SPECIAL EXHIBITION HALL”，下方是红色中文“壹号展”和“厅”，并由短横线分隔。左下角是浅米色英文“EXHIBITION OF AWARD-WINNING WORKS”，右下角是浅米色编号“NO. 082-2024”。
prompt_en: This is an exhibition poster themed around traditional Chinese ink painting. The poster features a light beige background with a dark brown border. Centrally placed is a tall, narrow abstract ink painting, primarily in black, white, and gray, characterized by bold and vigorous brushstrokes. In the bottom right corner of the painting, there is a red rectangular box containing white vertically arranged text "博物". On the left side of the poster, the main title "墨影华章" is vertically displayed in large black characters, accompanied by a smaller subtitle "历届书法获奖作品特展" to its left. On the right side, there is vertically arranged red text "一零二四 仲秋之月·启幕 笔墨横姿气韵生动 传承经典艺道长青", with the black vertically arranged text "国家博物馆" and a circular graphic below it. The bottom center of the poster shows black English text "MUSEUM SPECIAL EXHIBITION HALL", beneath which are red Chinese characters "壹号展" and "厅", separated by short horizontal lines. The bottom left features light beige English text "EXHIBITION OF AWARD-WINNING WORKS", and the bottom right displays the light beige number "NO. 082-2024".

In the middle of the screen is a flowchart, with the title "六大创新举措" (Six Major Innovative Initiatives) in a blue background box. Below it are six icons, including a folder with a magnifying glass, a document with a magnifying glass, a computer monitor with a line chart, a person's head icon, a document, and a gear, connected by blue arrows. In front of the screen are four individuals wearing white lab coats or doctor's coats, two on the left and two on the right, either facing the screen or turned sideways. The hall background features tall glass windows and white columns.

prompt_cn: 这是一张俯视拍摄的照片，展示了八本平铺在蓝色和灰色木板拼接而成的木质表面上的书籍。这些书籍以不同的角度散落，部分相互重叠，几乎覆盖了整个木质背景。书本封面颜色多样，包括蓝色、白色、橙色、浅绿色、灰色等，文字多为白色或黑色。每本书的封面都包含标题、作者、副标题等文字信息，并配有插图或抽象设计。例如，左上角的蓝色书封面印有一个浅蓝色的人形剪影，左侧白色书封面有蓝色波浪图案，中间偏上的彩色书封面是插画，左下角的橙色书封面有食物插画，中间偏下的浅绿色书封面是抽象几何图案，右下角的灰色书封面描绘了一棵绿色大树，最右侧的白色书封面则画有一只拿着红色气球的松鼠。
prompt_en: This is a top-down photograph showing eight books laid flat on a wooden surface composed of blue and grey planks. The books are scattered at various angles, partially overlapping each other, and almost cover the entire wooden background. The book covers feature diverse colors, including blue, white, orange, light green, and grey, with text predominantly in white or black. Each book cover contains textual information such as titles, authors, and subtitles, accompanied by illustrations or abstract designs. For instance, the blue book cover in the top-left features a light blue human silhouette, the white book cover on the left has a blue wave pattern, the colorful book cover in the top-middle is an illustration, the orange book cover in the bottom-left displays food illustrations, the light green book cover in the bottom-middle has abstract geometric patterns, the grey book cover in the bottom-right depicts a large green tree, and the white book cover on the far right shows a squirrel holding a red balloon.

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示数字化情绪板的图片。图片顶部有一个红色的横幅，上面用白色粗体字写着“我的情绪板”。主体部分是白色背景，上面散布着多张图片和便利贴。左侧有两张黄色主题的图片，一张是黄色菊花特写，另一张是两根香蕉。图片左侧有黑色文字“杂志封面 照片风格”。一张黄色便利贴位于香蕉图片右侧，上面写着“香蕉很受欢迎!”。另一张黄色便利贴位于黄色菊花图片下方，写有“大量的负空间 效果很好!”。中部有一张黄色背景上停放着一辆黄色玩具车的图片。右侧有一张黄色气球狗的图片，旁边有一张粉色便利贴，上面写着“让它更有趣!”。图片右侧还有三个圆形色块（黑色、黄色、黄色），旁边有黑色文字“调色板”。页面底部有三列编号的说明文字，编号为红色，文字为黑色。第一列说明文字为“1 贴贴你最喜欢或最有灵感的物品的图片。将它们散布排列在你的白板上。”。第二列说明文字为“2 使用便利贴来添加对任何视觉素材的评论或想法。”，其下方并列有两个粉色矩形框，每个框内写有“在此处添加你的 想法”。第三列说明文字为“3 用箭头或圈圈来吸引人们对图像的注意或将想法连接在一起。”，旁边有一个黑色箭头指向“这个!”字样。整体布局清晰，文字和图片元素之间有明确的视觉关联。
prompt_en: This image displays a digital mood board. At the top, a red banner features the title "我的情绪板" (My Mood Board) in bold white text. The main area has a white background, scattered with various images and sticky notes. On the left, there are two yellow-themed images: a close-up of a yellow chrysanthemum and two bananas. To the left of these images, black text reads "杂志封面 照片风格" (Magazine Cover Photo Style). A yellow sticky note to the right of the banana image says "香蕉很受欢迎!" (Bananas are very popular!). Another yellow sticky note below the chrysanthemum image states "大量的负空间 效果很好!" (Lots of negative space works well!). In the center, there's an image of a yellow toy car on a yellow background. To the right, an image of a yellow balloon dog is accompanied by a pink sticky note that reads "让它更有趣!" (Make it more interesting!). Also on the right are three circular color swatches (black, yellow, yellow) next to the black text "调色板" (Color Palette). The bottom section presents three numbered instructions. The first instruction, numbered "1" in red, says "贴贴你最喜欢或最有灵感的物品的图片。将它们散布排列在你的白板上。" (Paste pictures of your favorite or most inspiring items. Arrange them scattered on your whiteboard.). The second instruction, numbered "2" in red, says "使用便利贴来添加对任何视觉素材的评论或想法。" (Use sticky notes to add comments or ideas to any visual material.). Below this, two pink rectangular boxes are side-by-side, each containing "在此处添加你的 想法" (Add your ideas here). The third instruction, numbered "3" in red, says "用箭头或圈圈来吸引人们对图像的注意或将想法连接在一起。" (Use arrows or circles to draw attention to images or connect ideas together.). Next to this, a black arrow points to the text "这个!" (This one!). The overall layout is clear, with distinct visual connections between text and image elements.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅多格漫画，描绘了“羊教授”因考试作弊被抓而狂笑，以及“牛学长”对此感到愤怒和无奈的场景。图片顶部是黑色粗体标题“因考试作弊被抓而狂笑的羊教授与愤怒的牛学长”。下方是六个主要漫画分格，呈两行三列布局，最下方还有一个较小的“番外”分格。漫画的主角是两位拟人化的角色：一位是白发、戴羊角、穿白色长袍的羊教授，另一位是棕发、戴牛角、穿深色校服的牛学长。在左上角的分格中，牛学长手持手机，屏幕显示“学校论坛 - 考试作弊曝光区”，列出了三条关于羊教授作弊的帖子。羊教授在所有分格中都保持着狂笑或愉悦的表情，而牛学长则从愤怒、指责逐渐变得沮丧和无力。在右下角的“番外”分格中，一位保安出现，牛学长瘫坐在地，羊教授则继续嘲笑他体力不支。漫画通过对话气泡和拟声词展现了两人之间的激烈互动。
prompt_en: This is a multi-panel comic depicting "Professor Sheep" laughing hysterically after being caught cheating on an exam, while "Senior Bull" expresses anger and helplessness. The image features a bold black title at the top: "Professor Sheep Laughing Hysterically After Being Caught Cheating on an Exam, and Angry Senior Bull". Below the title are six main comic panels arranged in two rows and three columns, with an additional smaller "Extra" panel at the bottom right. The main characters are two anthropomorphic figures: Professor Sheep, with white hair, ram horns, and a white robe, and Senior Bull, with brown hair, bull horns, and a dark school uniform. In the top-left panel, Senior Bull holds a smartphone displaying a "School Forum - Exam Cheating Exposure Zone" interface, listing three posts about Professor Sheep's cheating. Professor Sheep maintains a laughing or joyful expression throughout all panels, while Senior Bull's emotions range from anger and accusation to frustration and powerlessness. In the bottom-right "Extra" panel, a security guard appears, Senior Bull is slumped on the ground, and Professor Sheep continues to mock his lack of stamina. The comic uses speech bubbles and onomatopoeia to illustrate the intense interaction between the two characters.

prompt_cn: 这是一张报告或演示文稿的幻灯片，采用简洁现代的设计风格，背景为浅灰色网格纹理。顶部区域作为页眉，左侧显示“GOVERNMENT DISCLOSURE”和“政务公开 · 2024”，右侧显示“官方政务社交平台监测”和“官方微博 / 公众号”。左侧有一个黑色矩形条，内含英文单词“REPORT”。页面左侧主体部分以大号深灰色字体突出显示主标题“履职评估”，其下方是一段描述性文字，阐述了构建透明政府和评估新媒体履职效能的目标。页面右侧是一张黑白抽象的建筑立面图片。图片下方是一个黑色区域，其中包含白色文字：“EFFICIENCY”、“01 / 03”（页码）、“效能优先”以及“数据驱动，精准评估政务影响力”。左下角区域展示了三个关键领域：“透明度评估”、“互动回应”和“服务效能”，每个领域前都有一个彩色方块图标（红色、灰色、空心），并配有简短的成就描述，包括具体的百分比和时间数据。右下角显示“2024-Q3 REPORT”和“#EVAL-7749-X”作为报告标识。
prompt_en: This is a slide from a report or presentation, featuring a clean, modern design with a light gray grid background. The top section serves as a header, displaying "GOVERNMENT DISCLOSURE" and "政务公开 · 2024" on the left, and "官方政务社交平台监测" and "官方微博 / 公众号" on the right. A black rectangular bar on the left contains the English word "REPORT". The main title "履职评估" (Performance Evaluation) is prominently displayed in large, dark gray characters on the left side. Below it, a descriptive paragraph explains the goal of building a transparent government and evaluating new media performance. The right side features a black and white abstract image of a building facade. Below this image, a black section contains white text: "EFFICIENCY", "01 / 03" (page number), "效能优先" (Efficiency First), and "数据驱动，精准评估政务影响力" (Data-driven, precise evaluation of government influence). The bottom left section presents three key areas: "透明度评估" (Transparency Evaluation), "互动回应" (Interactive Response), and "服务效能" (Service Efficiency), each with a colored square icon (red, gray, hollow) and a brief description of achievements, including specific percentages and hours. The bottom right corner shows "2024-Q3 REPORT" and "#EVAL-7749-X" as report identifiers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张数字生日贺卡，整体采用垂直居中布局。卡片背景为浅色渐变，中央是一个白色的矩形区域。顶部有两行文字，上方是小号英文“DREAMY BIRTHDAY”，下方是紫粉渐变色的大号中文“生日快乐”。卡片中部是一幅灰度或单色调的插画，描绘了一只大的独角兽造型生物和一只小的独角兽，周围环绕着球体和植物状装饰物。插画下方是深紫色的祝福语，首先是“愿你的世界 永远闪耀珍珠光芒”，接着是多行小字正文，内容为“在这个充满奇迹的时刻，愿独角兽的星辉守护你的纯真。愿你岁岁平安，在如梦似幻的时光里，活出最璀璨、最温柔的自己。”卡片底部左侧是浅紫色的“TO: 亲爱的朋友”，中间是一个粉色虚线圆框内的“限量 祝福”字样，右侧是深紫色的“梦幻礼仪工坊”及其下方的“二〇二四年.盛夏”。文字内容与独角兽插画共同传达生日祝福。
prompt_en: This is a digital birthday greeting card with a vertically centered layout. The card features a light gradient background and a central white rectangular area. At the top, there are two lines of text: "DREAMY BIRTHDAY" in smaller English text above, and "生日快乐" (Happy Birthday) in large, purple-pink gradient Chinese text below. The middle section of the card contains a grayscale or monochromatic illustration depicting a large unicorn-like creature and a smaller unicorn, surrounded by spherical and plant-like decorative elements. Below the illustration, there is a dark purple blessing message, starting with "愿你的世界 永远闪耀珍珠光芒" (May your world always shine with pearl-like brilliance), followed by multi-line smaller text: "在这个充满奇迹的时刻，愿独角兽的星辉守护你的纯真。愿你岁岁平安，在如梦似幻的时光里，活出最璀璨、最温柔的自己." (In this moment full of wonders, may the starlight of the unicorn guard your innocence. May you be safe and sound year after year, and live out your most brilliant and gentle self in the dreamlike time.) At the bottom left of the card is "TO: 亲爱的朋友" (TO: Dear Friend) in light purple, in the center is "限量 祝福" (Limited Blessing) within a pink dashed circle, and on the bottom right is "梦幻礼仪工坊" (Dreamy Etiquette Workshop) in dark purple, with "二〇二四年.盛夏" (2024. Midsummer) below it. The text content and the unicorn illustration collectively convey birthday wishes.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一个产品宣传页面，左侧是产品介绍区域，右侧展示了一个手机应用界面。左侧背景为深灰色，右侧背景为浅灰色，手机屏幕为白色。左侧顶部有一个黑色的卡通汽车图标，下方是白色大字号的标题“Carea”和中等字号的副标题“Car Marketplace App”。标题下方列出了六项应用功能，每项前都有一个绿色的圆形对勾图标。列表底部是“160+ Screens”字样，旁边有一个彩色图标。右侧的手机屏幕由一个白色的机械手托举着。屏幕顶部显示系统时间“9:41”，用户问候语“Good Morning 👋”和用户名“Andrew Ainsley”，以及铃铛和爱心图标。中部有一个搜索栏，显示占位符“Search”，右侧是筛选图标。下方是“Special Offers”标题和“See All”链接，以及一个优惠卡片，卡片上显示“20% Week Deals!”和“Get a new car discount. only valid this week”的文字，并配有一辆白色汽车图片。再下方展示了八个汽车品牌图标及其名称，包括“Mercedes”、“Tesla”、“BMW”、“Toyota”、“Volvo”、“Bugatti”、“Honda”和“More”。底部是“Top Deals”标题和“See All”链接，以及一排筛选按钮，其中“All”按钮被选中，显示为黑色背景白色文字。手机屏幕底部是一个导航栏，包含“Home”、“Orders”、“Inbox”、“Wallet”、“Profile”五个图标和标签。
prompt_en: This image is a product promotion page, with a product introduction area on the left and a mobile application interface displayed on the right. The left background is dark gray, the right background is light gray, and the phone screen is white. At the top left, there is a black cartoon car icon, below which is the large white title "Carea" and the medium-sized subtitle "Car Marketplace App". Below the title, six application features are listed, each preceded by a green circular checkmark icon. At the bottom of the list is the text "160+ Screens", next to a colorful icon. The mobile phone screen on the right is held by a white robotic hand. The top of the screen shows the system time "9:41", the user greeting "Good Morning 👋" and username "Andrew Ainsley", along with bell and heart icons. In the middle, there is a search bar displaying the placeholder "Search", with a filter icon to its right. Below that are the "Special Offers" title and "See All" link, followed by a discount card. The card features the text "20% Week Deals!" and "Get a new car discount. only valid this week", accompanied by an image of a white car. Further down, eight car brand icons and their names are displayed, including "Mercedes", "Tesla", "BMW", "Toyota", "Volvo", "Bugatti", "Honda", and "More". At the bottom are the "Top Deals" title and "See All" link, along with a row of filter buttons, where the "All" button is selected with a black background and white text. The bottom of the phone screen features a navigation bar with five icons and labels: "Home", "Orders", "Inbox", "Wallet", and "Profile".

prompt_cn: 这是一张现代风格的室内渲染图，展示了一个服务中心或零售店的内部空间。画面中央是一个长条形的灰色服务台，台面上摆放着显示器和各种小型电子设备。服务台前方有两把白色圆凳。服务台后方是一面大型墙壁展示柜，由三排八列共24个带灯光的储物格组成。每个储物格上方都标有蓝色的数字标签，从上到下依次是17-24、09-16和01-08。最上排储物格内的白色产品包装盒上清晰可见“SAMSUNG”品牌名称和品牌标志。中间和下排储物格内的产品包装盒上清晰标有Galaxy手机、平板和配件型号。展示柜上方墙壁上写有“Service Centre”字样。画面右侧的灰色墙板上挂着一个蓝色背包和多副白色耳机。左侧有一扇大窗户，窗外景色模糊。
prompt_en: This is a modern-style interior rendering depicting the inside of a service center or retail store. In the center of the image is a long, grey service counter, with a monitor and various small electronic devices placed on its surface. Two white round stools are in front of the counter. Behind the service counter is a large wall-mounted display cabinet, consisting of three rows and eight columns, totaling 24 illuminated compartments. Each compartment is labeled with a blue number above it, sequentially from top to bottom: 17-24, 09-16, and 01-08. The white product packaging boxes in the top row compartments clearly show the "SAMSUNG" brand name and logo. The product packaging boxes in the middle and bottom row compartments also are clearly labeled with Galaxy phone, tablet, and accessory model names. Above the display cabinet, the wall bears the text "Service Centre". On the right side of the image, a blue backpack and multiple white headphones are hung on a grey wall panel. A large window on the left shows a blurry outdoor scene.

prompt_cn: 这是一张医疗系统中的手术取消申请界面截图。界面背景为深蓝色，顶部标题栏左侧显示“取消手术申请”及其单据号“OR-20231024-082”，右侧显示当前状态“CURRENT STATUS”为橙色的“待审核 (Pending)”。界面主体分为左右两栏。左栏包含“患者基本信息”和“原定手术安排”两个区域，详细列出了患者姓名、性别、年龄、住院号、床位、临床诊断，以及原定手术的名称、主刀医生和手术间。其中，“全膝关节置换术 (TKA)”以蓝色字体显示。右栏是“取消原因确认”区域，提示用户选择核心原因并填写详细说明。此处提供了四个单选选项，其中“术前检查指标异常”被选中并以红色边框突出。下方文本框内预填了详细的取消原因说明。界面底部是状态栏，左侧显示“系统已连接：手术管理中心 V4.2”，中间显示“操作员：陈静 (主任护师)”，右侧显示当前日期时间“2023-10-24 14:20:35”。底部右侧有两个操作按钮，左侧是浅色的“返回修改”，右侧是红色的带有“×”图标的“确认取消手术”。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a surgery cancellation application interface within a medical system. The interface has a dark blue background. The top title bar on the left displays "取消手术申请" (Cancel Surgery Application) and its document number "OR-20231024-082". On the right, the current status "CURRENT STATUS" is shown as "待审核 (Pending)" in orange. The main body of the interface is divided into two columns. The left column contains two sections: "患者基本信息" (Patient Basic Information) and "原定手术安排" (Original Surgery Schedule), detailing the patient's name, gender, age, hospitalization number, bed number, clinical diagnosis, as well as the original surgery's name, chief surgeon, and operating room. Among these, "全膝关节置换术 (TKA)" (Total Knee Arthroplasty (TKA)) is displayed in blue font. The right column is the "取消原因确认" (Cancellation Reason Confirmation) area, prompting the user to select the core reason and provide a detailed explanation. Four radio button options are provided here, with "术前检查指标异常" (Preoperative Examination Indicators Abnormal) selected and highlighted with a red border. A detailed explanation for the cancellation is pre-filled in the text box below. The bottom of the interface features a status bar, with "系统已连接：手术管理中心 V4.2" (System Connected: Surgery Management Center V4.2) on the left, "操作员：陈静 (主任护师)" (Operator: Chen Jing (Chief Nurse)) in the middle, and the current date and time "2023-10-24 14:20:35" on the right. On the bottom right, there are two action buttons: a light-colored "返回修改" (Return to Modify) on the left, and a red "× 确认取消手术" (× Confirm Surgery Cancellation) on the right.

日本茶道：三大流派与十件核心道具
SADO: THE THREE SCHOOLS & TEN CORE UTENSILS
流派传承 / Main Schools
日本茶道承袭千利休之规制，流布至今以“三千家”为尊。各派点茶之法虽有殊异，然其旨归一致，皆在一方茶席间践行禅之真谛。

茶事进行时，点茶道具之摆放均依照严密的几何秩序，风炉在左，水指在右，茶器与茶碗置于主线，动静结合，主宾互敬。

单位：毫升 (ml) / 克 (g)
浓茶 / Koicha
4.0g : 30ml
薄茶 / Usucha
1.5g : 70ml
核心点茶道具十友 / The Ten Utensils
I
茶碗 / Chawan
盛茶之器，多为乐烧或萩烧，有正面之分。
II
茶筅 / Chasen
竹制，80至120根，用于击拂抹茶出泡。
III
茶勺 / Chashaku
抹茶粉之匙，多为竹制，一勺约1.5克。
IV
枣 / Natsume
薄茶木质漆罐，因其形似红枣而得名。
V
茶入 / Chaire
浓茶陶罐，通常配套牙盖与织锦仕覆。
VI
水指 / Mizusashi
盛放清水，用于补充茶釜水及清洗茶具。
VII
釜 / Kama
铸铁煮水锅，水沸之时，音声如松风鸣。
VIII
建水 / Kensui
盛放废水、废茶水，用以保持席面整洁。
IX
柄杓 / Hishaku
竹制长柄水勺，分寸考究，取水、分水。
X
帛纱 / Fukusa
丝绸抹巾，用于擦拭茶杓、茶器等关键道具。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于日本茶道的信息图，标题为“日本茶道：三大流派与十件核心道具”，副标题为“SADO: THE THREE SCHOOLS & TEN CORE UTENSILS”。图片整体背景为深灰色，文字以白色为主，部分关键元素使用红色。左上角有一个红色方框，内有“和敬清寂”字样。信息图分为三个主要区域。左侧栏上方是“流派传承 / Main Schools”部分，包含一段描述性文字和一个四列表格，详细列出了三个茶道流派、其创始人、泡沫特征和风格。下方是“点茶规制与比例 / Preparation Ratios”部分，包含副标题“浓茶与薄茶配比图 / Volumetric Standard”以及两个杯状图，分别展示了“浓茶 / Koicha”（4.0g : 30ml）和“薄茶 / Usucha”（1.5g : 70ml）的配比。右侧栏上方是“点茶道具空间布局 / Space & Utensils Layout”部分，包含一段文字和一个“茶席平面图 / Tatami Layout Schema”图示，该图示展示了“釜 / Kama”、“水指”、“茶碗”和“建水”等茶道道具的摆放位置，并用箭头指示“主客视线方向”。底部区域标题为“核心点茶道具十友 / The Ten Utensils”，以网格形式展示了十件核心茶道工具，每件工具都标有红色罗马数字编号（I至X），中英文名称（如“茶碗 / Chawan”）和一段简短的中文描述。
prompt_en: This infographic is about the Japanese tea ceremony, titled "日本茶道：三大流派与十件核心道具" (SADO: THE THREE SCHOOLS & TEN CORE UTENSILS). The overall background is dark gray, with most text in white and some key elements in red. A red box in the top left corner displays the text "和敬清寂" (Harmony, Respect, Purity, Tranquility). The infographic is structured into three main sections. The upper part of the left column, under "流派传承 / Main Schools", includes a descriptive paragraph and a four-column table detailing three tea schools, their founders, foam characteristics, and aesthetic styles. Below this, the "点茶规制与比例 / Preparation Ratios" section features a subtitle "浓茶与薄茶配比图 / Volumetric Standard" and two cup-shaped diagrams illustrating the ratios for "浓茶 / Koicha" (4.0g : 30ml) and "薄茶 / Usucha" (1.5g : 70ml). The upper part of the right column, titled "点茶道具空间布局 / Space & Utensils Layout", contains a paragraph and a "茶席平面图 / Tatami Layout Schema" diagram. This diagram shows the arrangement of tea ceremony utensils such as "釜 / Kama", "水指", "茶碗", and "建水", with an arrow indicating the "主客视线方向" (Master-Guest Axis). The bottom section, titled "核心点茶道具十友 / The Ten Utensils", is a grid presenting ten essential tea ceremony tools. Each tool is identified by a red Roman numeral (I to X), its name in both Chinese and English (e.g., "茶碗 / Chawan"), and a concise Chinese description.

prompt_cn: 这是一张动漫风格的游戏活动宣传图，主题为“夏日音乐节”。画面顶部中央是紫色渐变的主标题“夏日音乐节”，下方配有说明文字：“帮助超弦体们找到混音架上的灵感专辑，完成主打歌概念，点亮主打歌舞台即可获得奖励！”。前景左右两侧各有一名主要女性角色，左侧角色戴蓝色帽子，穿蓝色泳装；右侧角色戴墨镜，穿黑色泳装，手持冰淇淋。她们身后是几名较小的动漫角色。图片前景下方散落着五张卡片，呈扇形展开，其中三张展示了武器外观，分别标有“璃黛”、“夏日海滩”、“卓越品质 武器外观”等文字；一张是雨伞图标卡片，标有“喷漆”、“描绘天气”；另一张是音乐播放器图标卡片，标有“记忆序列 × 2”和“(可用于与意识重构，进行高品质外观表现)”。背景中散布着多张唱片封面，上面印有“BALLAD”、“ROCK”、“CLASSICAL”、“ELECTRON”、“SELECTED POP SONGS”、“ZZR”等英文文字。整个画面色彩明亮，以紫色、蓝色、橙色、黄色和棕色为主，背景可见棕榈树和串灯，营造出夏日节日的氛围。
prompt_en: This is an anime-style game event promotional image, themed "Summer Music Festival". At the top center of the image is the main title "夏日音乐节" (Summer Music Festival) in a purple gradient, accompanied by descriptive text below: "帮助超弦体们找到混音架上的灵感专辑，完成主打歌概念，点亮主打歌舞台即可获得奖励！" (Help the superstring bodies find inspirational albums on the mixing rack, complete the main song concept, and light up the main song stage to receive rewards!). In the foreground, on the left and right sides, are two main female characters; the left character wears a blue hat and swimsuit, while the right character wears sunglasses, a black swimsuit, and holds an ice cream. Behind them are several smaller anime characters. Five cards are scattered in a fan shape across the bottom foreground of the image; three of them display weapon skins, labeled with texts such as "璃黛" (Li Dai), "夏日海滩" (Summer Beach), and "卓越品质 武器外观" (Excellent Quality Weapon Skin). One card features an umbrella icon, labeled "喷漆" (Spray Paint) and "描绘天气" (Depict Weather); another is a music player icon card, labeled "记忆序列 × 2" (Memory Sequence × 2) and "(可用于与意识重构，进行高品质外观表现)" (Can be used for consciousness reconstruction to achieve high-quality appearance). Multiple record covers are scattered in the background, printed with English texts like "BALLAD", "ROCK", "CLASSICAL", "ELECTRON", "SELECTED POP SONGS", and "ZZR". The overall image is brightly colored, predominantly purple, blue, orange, yellow, and brown, with palm trees and string lights visible in the background, creating a summer festival atmosphere.

text:
端午节民俗文化手抄报
赛龙舟
端午节民俗文化手抄报，遂文化赛龙舟，是端午节的传统习俗。赛龙舟追逐嬉闹，喧嚣的赛龙舟，阿在利赛龙舟，就川泰生生，端午雄黄赛正流过。
包粽子
端午节觅伙料的重合原则，包着包粽子一树作
替粽子，粥鼓鼓耐饿，却伴清文侯身
子吗入于包粽子，卷成薯个吃冰激
一样“如此”短停歇
赢好的水果。
挂艾草、饮雄黄
挂艾草是口感，屈原传说，加入至任何处失传，挂艾草
草、佩者饮浓酒。橘子过大了的子之物，味一条酒酿皮，佩艾
草、饮雄黄。给宗大家草药料，挂艾草与杂草的
的会味。
屈原传说
屈原传说，是汨罗江，永远流传水泽，端
遗世俗迷，屈原于楚的水泽中，
养满泉、时沉溺和泽中丧生
汨水的人物，怀抱发流
风浪和的屈原传说。

prompt_en: This is a hand-drawn style Dragon Boat Festival folk culture handwritten newspaper, featuring a black, white, and gray color scheme with an off-white background, mimicking old paper. The main title "端午节民俗文化手抄报" (Dragon Boat Festival Folk Culture Handwritten Newspaper) is at the top center of the image. The main content of the poster is presented in a 2x2 grid structure, with each section containing a theme title, body text, and illustration. The top-left section depicts a dragon boat race scene with paddlers and dragon boats, accompanied by the title "赛龙舟" (Dragon Boat Race) and related text. The top-right section shows the process of making Zongzi, with hands wrapping Zongzi, finished Zongzi, and a bowl, along with the title "包粽子" (Making Zongzi) and related text. The bottom-left section illustrates mugwort plants, a jar of realgar wine, and two sachets, with the title "挂艾草、饮雄黄" (Hanging Mugwort, Drinking Realgar Wine) and related text. The bottom-right section portrays the figure of Qu Yuan, a river, and a small boat, accompanied by the title "屈原传说" (Legend of Qu Yuan) and related text. Traditional Chinese patterns adorn the edges of the poster and between the sections.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的活动邀请函。邀请函顶部中央是“尊 启”字样，下方是中文标题“秘境·假面盛宴”和英文副标题“MASQUERADE DINNER GALA”。标题下方嵌入一张黑白照片，展示了夜晚灯光下的喷泉雕塑和一座古典建筑。照片下方是两段中文描述性文字，阐述了活动的主题和邀请意图。图片下半部分采用两栏布局，左侧列出“时间 / TIME”为“二零二四年十二月二十一日 下午八时三十分”，右侧列出“地点 / VENUE”为“翡冷翠庄园·喷泉中庭 云影路十八号”。底部左侧是两项带有菱形图标的列表项：“着装要求: 正装与面具”和“敬请于十二月十日前确认出席”。底部右侧是“主办方”及其名称“雅颂艺术基金会”。所有文字均为金色艺术字体，整体设计典雅。
prompt_en: This is an event invitation card with a dark background. At the top center of the invitation, there is the text "尊 启" (Respectfully Open). Below it are the Chinese title "秘境·假面盛宴" (Secret Realm·Masquerade Feast) and the English subtitle "MASQUERADE DINNER GALA". Embedded below the titles is a black and white photograph depicting a fountain sculpture and a classical building illuminated at night. Below the photo are two paragraphs of descriptive Chinese text, explaining the event's theme and invitation purpose. The lower half of the image features a two-column layout: the left column lists "时间 / TIME" (Time) as "二零二四年十二月二十一日 下午八时三十分" (December 21, 2024, 8:30 PM), and the right column lists "地点 / VENUE" (Venue) as "翡冷翠庄园·喷泉中庭 云影路十八号" (Emerald Estate·Fountain Atrium, No. 18 Yunying Road). The bottom left features two list items with diamond icons: "着装要求: 正装与面具" (Dress Code: Formal Attire and Mask) and "敬请于十二月十日前确认出席" (Please confirm attendance by December 10). The bottom right shows "主办方" (Organizer) and its name "雅颂艺术基金会" (Yasong Art Foundation). All text is in golden artistic font, and the overall design is elegant.

prompt_en: This is an infographic on marathon runner energy system metabolism and heart rate zone mapping, set against a dark gray grid background. The top of the chart features the main Chinese title "马拉松跑者能量系统代谢与心率区间映射" and its English subtitle. The left side of the image includes a "测试参数 / SPECS" section, listing runner type, reference number, and environmental parameters; below it is the "校准矩阵 / MATRIX" table, showing data such as VT1 and VT2 ventilation thresholds, lactate threshold, fat max, and maximum heart rate. The bottom left contains "数据来源" (Data Source) and "注" (Note) sections. The main part on the right is a line graph, with the X-axis representing "强度 / INTENSITY (% MAX HR)" and the Y-axis representing "能量贡献比 / ENERGY CONTRI-BUTION %", plotting two curves for "脂肪氧化峰值 (FAT MAX)" and "乳酸阈值 (LT)". Below the line graph is the "燃料储备容量 / FUEL STORAGE CAPACITY" table, detailing the mass, energy, and duration for different fuel types (e.g., blood glucose, liver glycogen, muscle glycogen, adipose tissue, total glycogen, and protein). At the very bottom is the "心率区间映射表 / HR ZONE MAPPING", categorizing heart rate zones by zone, intensity, metabolic mode, and primary substrate. The bottom of the image also includes chart number, institution name, and page number information.

The painting depicts a young woman wearing a green vine wreath and a light-colored robe, smiling at the viewer while holding a golden goblet in her left hand. The background of the painting is light-colored, with red flowers and green plants on the left side. A white Fibonacci spiral or golden ratio grid, composed of white lines, is overlaid on the bottom left of the cover, covering a gray ceramic pot held by the woman's right hand. The cover text is distributed across several areas: the top left purple rectangle contains "细致解读" (Detailed Interpretation) and "随处可见的设计原理" (Ubiquitous Design Principles); the top right purple rectangle vertically displays the author "[韩]金持勋 著" (Authored by Kim Ji-hoon [Korean]) and translator "吴婉茹 译" (Translated by Wu Wanru); the center right features the extra-large, vertical main title "平衡与简化" (Balance and Simplification); below it is the subtitle "艺术鉴赏达人养成法" (Method for Becoming an Art Appreciation Master); and the bottom left purple rectangle vertically shows "重庆出版社" (Chongqing Publishing House). Most of the text is white, contrasting with the background, and its layout direction and font sizes vary, creating a rich visual hierarchy.

text:
大平洋商標
大改用西洋
此大西洋色布
乃本廠經多年
之研究用純良
化合色所染成
質料堅固經久
耐用顏色鮮艷
皂洗日晒水久
不退可稱世界
罕見之色布如
蒙 惠顧務請
認明布邊上蓋
有本廠大西洋

The overall image is rich in color, with a full composition, and decorative borders at both the top and bottom.

text:
太阳能电池效率极限：多结电池与材料光谱吸收
THERMODYNAMIC LIMITS & ARCHITECTURAL SCHEMATICS OF MULTI-JUNCTION PHOTOVOLTAICS
第一纪元：光谱划分之法
/ The Division of Light
第二纪元：多重结界层叠
/ Stacked Sanctuary
第三纪元：能带与极限法典
/ Ledger of Limits
单结电池受制于物理屏障，即肖克利-奎伊瑟极限 (Shockley-Queisser Limit -33.7%)。高能光子之余热散失，低能光子则穿透无效。唯有划分光谱，筑起多重阶梯，方能阻断熵增之耗损。
多结电池 (Multi-junction) 如通天宝塔，逐层叠置。上层吸高能，下层纳低能。各层间以隧穿结 (Tunnel Junction) 相连，犹如攀障中的密道，使电荷得以自由通行，效能突破 47%。
各层界之能量阈值，以电子伏特 (eV) 为衡。光谱之能流自天穹降临，越过防壁，于各结界中激发出电子空穴对，终汇于基底背电极。

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的数字宣传海报或信息图，背景由深蓝色到黑色的渐变构成，并点缀着发光的蓝色和紫色抽象几何块状结构。图片顶部左侧有“LEVEL 01”和“DATA CENTER”标签，右侧显示经纬度“40.7128° N”和“74.0060° W”。画面中央是主标题“MULTI VERSE ANALYSIS”，其中“MULTI”为白色，“VERSE”为浅蓝色空心字，“ANALYSIS”为蓝色。主标题下方是副标题“EMPOWERING ENTERPRISE DECISIONS”，为白色文字。背景中还隐约可见半透明的深灰色水印文字“CLOUD”。图片右侧边缘垂直排列着浅蓝色的装饰文字“ELLIGENCE SYSTEM”。底部有两个信息方框，左侧方框标题为“INFRASTRUCTURE”，内容为中文“分布式云端计算架构，实现毫秒级数据吞吐。”以及数据“99.9% Accuracy”。右侧方框标题为“REAL-TIME”，包含一个三行英文表格，分别为“Processing Active”、“Latency < 2ms”和“Stability Tier 4”。
prompt_en: This is a digital promotional poster or infographic with a dark background, featuring a gradient from deep blue to black, adorned with glowing blue and purple abstract geometric block structures. At the top left, there are "LEVEL 01" and "DATA CENTER" labels, while the top right displays coordinates "40.7128° N" and "74.0060° W". The main title "MULTI VERSE ANALYSIS" is centered, with "MULTI" in white, "VERSE" in light blue hollow text, and "ANALYSIS" in blue. Below the main title is the white subtitle "EMPOWERING ENTERPRISE DECISIONS". A semi-transparent, dark gray watermark "CLOUD" is faintly visible in the background. Along the right edge of the image, light blue decorative text "ELLIGENCE SYSTEM" is arranged vertically. At the bottom, there are two information boxes: the left box is titled "INFRASTRUCTURE" and contains Chinese text "分布式云端计算架构，实现毫秒级数据吞吐。" (Distributed cloud computing architecture, achieving millisecond-level data throughput.) along with "99.9% Accuracy". The right box is titled "REAL-TIME" and includes a three-row English table: "Processing Active", "Latency < 2ms", and "Stability Tier 4".

The background shows a coastal town landscape nestled between mountains and the sea, with scattered buildings, lush mountains, and a blue sea visible in the distance. The left side of the image is dedicated to text, while the right side features the woman and some architectural elements. At the top center is the golden "VOGUE" logo, with "ITALIA" below it on the left and "COSTA AMALFITANA" on the right. At the bottom left are "EDIZIONE SPECIALE" in quotes and the location and date "POSITANO GIUGNO 2025". The text is primarily gold and white, using a serif font. The overall composition combines fashion with natural scenery.

The image features a dark gray background with a golden mountain-like or wavy graphic at the top, displaying the year "1969". Below it are the Chinese title "阿波罗 11 号" (Apollo 11) and the English subtitle "APOLLO 11 MISSION PROFILE". In the upper right corner, there is a red rectangular box with the Chinese text "静海" (Sea of Tranquility). The main content of the infographic is divided into four major phases, each containing a numbered step, bilingual titles (Chinese and English), key numerical values, and detailed Chinese descriptions. The left two columns present 8 specific steps across four phases: "DEPARTURE", "MANEUVERS", "POWERED DESCENT", and "EVA & RETURN". A separate column on the right provides "LUNAR COORDINATES" and "任务总时长" (Mission Duration) information. The "POWERED DESCENT" phase is visually represented by a dotted line chart with yellow start and red end points, illustrating the descent trajectory. Key numerical values such as "7.5M", "1.5", and "10.9" are highlighted in large yellow font, while the step numbers (01-08) are shown as white numbers within yellow borders. The bottom of the image contains light gray footer information.

prompt_en: This is an illustration-style image, displaying an antique scroll paper spread out on a dark brown wooden tabletop. The scroll paper is beige with a golden decorative border, and it features a story titled "The Fisherman and the Merchant". The main title "渔夫与商人的故事" (The Fisherman and the Merchant's Story) is at the top center, and the content below is divided into two columns. The left column is subtitled "渔夫的智慧" (The Fisherman's Wisdom), accompanied by the text "捕鱼足够生活, 享受阳光, 与家人共度时光。知足常乐。" (Fishing enough for life, enjoying the sun, spending time with family. Contentment is happiness.) It also includes two illustrations: the upper one shows a fisherman alone fishing in a small boat, and the lower one depicts the fisherman enjoying fishing time with his family in a small boat. The right column is subtitled "商人的焦虑" (The Merchant's Anxiety), accompanied by the text "追求更多财富, 扩张生意, 擔憂未來。永無止境。" (Pursuing more wealth, expanding business, worrying about the future. Endless.) It also includes two illustrations: the upper one shows a merchant sitting at a desk reading, surrounded by clocks and gold coins; the lower one depicts the merchant holding his head in distress, with a yacht in the background, surrounded by scattered gold coins, a calculator, and clocks. At the bottom center of the scroll paper, a concluding remark reads "真正的富有, 是内心的寧靜。— 智者之言" (True wealth is inner peace. — Words of the wise). All text is black. A quill pen is placed on both the left and right sides of the tabletop, and an ink bottle is positioned on the upper right side.

text:
江户前寿司图鉴
INDEX SPECIMINUM ET METHODI EDOMAE SUSHI
江户前寿司，不仅是旬鱼与舍利（醋饭）的结合，更是一门关于「时间与防腐」的古老手艺。手握之温传递至米粒，使米饭维持于最佳体温36℃，与经由熟成、温腌之鱼生水乳交融，展现出食材最极致的旨味与质地。
握寿司结构学说 / Nigiri Structura
Pressure Point
鱼生 / Neta (3:2 比例)
舍利 / Shari (36℃醋饭)
十五种经典鱼生名录 / Index Speciminum
01. 赤身 Akami (深红瘦肉) ------ 熟成 / Aging
02. 中腹 Chutoro (脂肪相宜) ------ 微炙 / Aburi
03. 大腹 Otoro (油脂即化) ------ 熟成 / Aging
04. 真鲷 Tai (白身之王) ------ 昆布渍 / Kobujime
05. 比目鱼 Hirame (清雅弹韧) - 昆布渍 / Kobujime
06. 小肌 Kohada (尤物代表) ------ 盐醋渍 / Su-zuke
07. 青花鱼 Saba (发光鱼王) ------ 盐醋渍 / Su-zuke
08. 星鳗 Anago (熟煮甘甜) ------ 煮酱 / Nitsume
09. 海胆 Uni (马粪海胆) ------ 鲜生 / Recens
10. 车虾 Kuruma Ebi (鲜甜弹牙) ------ 汤灼 / Boiled
11. 墨乌贼 Sumi-Ika (爽脆清甜) ------ 醋渍 / Su-zuke
12. 贝柱 Kaibashira (鲜嫩多汁) ------ 鲜生 / Recens
13. 赤贝 Akagai (鲜活弹爽) ------ 砧板击 / Beat
14. 鲅鱼 Sawara (脂香微熏) ------ 烟熏 / Smoked
15. 鲣鱼 Katsuo (千草烟熏) ------ 草烧 / Warayaki
传统处理工艺 / Methodi Trajectio
昆布渍 Kobujime
熟成脱水，使昆布的谷氨酸钠缓缓渗入鱼肉，增加白身鱼风味的深邃层次。
盐醋渍 Shio-su
盐脱水、醋定味，以强酸压制青皮发光鱼的腥气，转化并平衡其多余油脂。
煮付 Nitsume
浓油赤酱慢熬，温和软化星鳗与贝类的结缔组织，淋上特制浓汁，入口即化。
温熟成 Aging
严格控制温度与湿度，利用鱼肉自身的内源酶分解蛋白质，提炼游离氨基酸。
东都寿司保存会 监修
No. 15 of 350 Plates — Edomae Codex

prompt_cn: 这是一张深绿色背景的江户前寿司信息图。顶部是浅黄色的主标题“江户前寿司图鉴”和英文副标题“INDEX SPECIMINUM ET METHODI EDOMAE SUSHI”，下方有一段白色中文介绍性文字，阐述了江户前寿司是“时间与防腐”的古老手艺。图片中部展示了一个握寿司的结构示意图，标明了“Pressure Point”、“鱼生 / Neta (3:2 比例)”和“舍利 / Shari (36℃醋饭)”等组成部分。示意图下方是“十五种经典鱼生名录 / Index Speciminum”，以两列形式列出了15种鱼生及其处理方式。再下方是“传统处理工艺 / Methodi Trajectio”部分，详细解释了昆布渍、盐醋渍、煮付和温熟成四种工艺。图片底部左侧是“东都寿司保存会 监修”，右侧是“No. 15 of 350 Plates — Edomae Codex”的页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about Edomae Sushi on a dark green background. At the top, there is a light yellow main title "江户前寿司图鉴" and an English subtitle "INDEX SPECIMINUM ET METHODI EDOMAE SUSHI". Below them, a white introductory paragraph in Chinese explains Edomae Sushi as an ancient craft of "time and preservation". The middle section of the image displays a structural diagram of nigiri sushi, labeling components such as "Pressure Point", "鱼生 / Neta (3:2 比例)" (fish topping), and "舍利 / Shari (36℃醋饭)" (vinegared rice). Below the diagram is "十五种经典鱼生名录 / Index Speciminum", listing 15 types of fish toppings and their processing methods in two columns. Further down, the "传统处理工艺 / Methodi Trajectio" section provides detailed explanations for four techniques: Kobujime (kelp curing), Shio-su (salt and vinegar curing), Nitsume (simmering), and Aging (maturation). The bottom left of the image shows "东都寿司保存会 监修" (supervised by Toto Sushi Preservation Society), and the bottom right displays "No. 15 of 350 Plates — Edomae Codex" as footer information.

Below each job title is a "岗位要求" (Job Requirements) section, with specific requirements listed as bullet points marked by pink star symbols. The bottom left of the poster provides application information, including the text "简历作品集请发邮箱:" (Please send resume and portfolio to email:) with an envelope icon, and the email address "cnsupport@canva.com" displayed within a gray capsule-shaped background below it. Structure of Nigiri
A single nigiri represents a precise biological and culinary equilibrium. The base, or Shari, consists of approximately 250 grains of rice seasoned with red vinegar (Akazu) and sea salt. The top of the image features the main title "THE GRAND CANYON" with the subtitle "STRATIGRAPHY & GEOCHRONOLOGY", accompanied by a decorative red Chinese character "峡" in the top-left corner. The image is structured into three columns. The left column presents a "PRIMARY STRATIGRAPHIC SEQUENCE" table, listing formation names, ages (Ma), and lithology. The central column displays a "GEOLOGICAL CROSS-SECTION (SCHEMATIC)" diagram, illustrating the rock layers from the Kaibab Plateau down to the Colorado River, with labels such as "REDWALL ESCARPMENT", "THE GREAT UNCONFORMITY", and "VISHNU BASEMENT COMPLEX". Below the diagram is a descriptive text about the canyon's geological history. The right column includes a "PALEONTOLOGICAL ARCHIVE" listing fossils found in different strata with their ages; "OROGENIC & EROSIONAL STATS" providing data on maximum depth, maximum width, erosion rate, and river length; and a "GEOLOGIC ERA DISTRIBUTION" list. Footer information, including plate number, data source, and system details, is located at the bottom of the image.

In the upper part of the poster, the prominent main title "工业园区 招商洽谈处" (Industrial Park Investment Promotion Office) is on the left. The center features a black and white photograph of two hands shaking firmly, symbolizing cooperation, with the English word "COOPERATION" and Chinese slogans "智造未来 价值共生" (Intelligent Manufacturing for the Future, Value Co-creation) below it. The lower part of the poster presents a list of four cooperation directions under the titles "合作名录" (Cooperation Directory) and "DIRECTORY 01-04". These include "智能制造产业集群" (Smart Manufacturing Industrial Cluster), "新能源技术研发" (New Energy Technology R&D), "生物医药创新基地" (Bio-Tech Innovation Base), and "航空航天配套中心" (Aerospace Support Center), each with both Chinese and English names and a number. The bottom left provides "地点: A1展厅 洽谈区" (Location: A1 Exhibition Hall Discussion Area) and "时间: 09:00 - 18:00" (Time: 09:00 - 18:00), while the bottom right features a black button with white text "立即预约 →" (Book Now →). The overall poster design is clean with clear information hierarchy.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用的用户界面截图，展示了一个物流详情与商品评价页面。界面顶部是标题栏，显示“物流详情”和订单号“8829402103”。下方内容区域由多个卡片组成。第一个深蓝色卡片显示订单已“已签收”，并有“感谢您对品质的选择”的文字和收货地址“上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2555号艺术中心”，右侧配有一个礼盒图标。第二个卡片是“配送轨迹”部分，显示配送状态为“已送达”，具体信息为“您的订单已由前台代收, 请及时取件”，时间是“今天 14:30”，左侧有一个卡车图标。第三个卡片展示商品信息，包括“匠心系列·尊享版腕表”及其规格“黑色 / 鳄鱼皮表带”，左侧是手表图标。第四个卡片是配送服务评分区域，提示“为配送服务评分”，下方有四颗黄色实心星和一颗灰色空心星，并显示“非常满意”。第五个卡片是用户评价文本框，内含一段评价文字“宝贝收到啦, 包装非常精致, 物流速度超出预期, 配送员态度特别好, 非常有礼貌...”。评价文本框下方是图片上传区，包含一个带有相机图标的“上传”按钮，以及两个已上传的商品相关图片缩略图。页面底部是一个深蓝色圆角矩形按钮，文字为“发布评价”，最下方则显示“评价已加密保护”并配有绿色对勾图标。
prompt_en: This is a mobile application UI screenshot, presenting a logistics details and product review page. The top title bar shows "物流详情" (Logistics Details) and "订单号: 8829402103" (Order No.: 8829402103). The main content is structured into several cards. The first dark blue card indicates "已签收" (Signed), with text "感谢您对品质的选择" (Thank you for choosing quality) and the address "上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2555号艺术中心" (Shanghai Xuhui District Longteng Avenue No. 2555 Art Center), alongside a gift box icon. The second card, titled "配送轨迹" (Delivery Tracking), details the status as "已送达" (Delivered), with "您的订单已由前台代收, 请及时取件" (Your order has been received by the front desk, please pick it up promptly) and "今天 14:30" (Today 14:30), accompanied by a truck icon. The third card displays product information: "匠心系列·尊享版腕表" (Craftsmanship Series · Exclusive Edition Watch) and "黑色 / 鳄鱼皮表带" (Black / Crocodile Leather Strap), with a watch icon. The fourth card is a delivery service rating section, showing "为配送服务评分" (Rate delivery service), four solid yellow stars, one hollow gray star, and "非常满意" (Very Satisfied). The fifth card is a user review text box containing "宝贝收到啦, 包装非常精致, 物流速度超出预期, 配送员态度特别好, 非常有礼貌..." (Baby received, packaging is exquisite, logistics speed exceeded expectations, delivery person's attitude is very good, very polite...). Below this, an image upload area features an "上传" (Upload) button with a camera icon and two uploaded thumbnail images. A dark blue rounded rectangular button at the bottom reads "发布评价" (Post Review), and the very bottom displays "评价已加密保护" (Review encrypted protection) with a green checkmark.

The larger left section displays a piece of meat grilling on a grate, with charcoal visible below, creating an atmosphere of charcoal cooking. At the end of the pathway, there is an arch made of green plants and white flowers, with a glowing blue neon sign displaying "Marry Me" suspended in its center. Several white balloons float above the arch and along the sides of the pathway. Lush green plants and white flowers line both sides of the pathway, with glowing white LED light strips placed at their base, illuminating the light brown wooden floor. In front of the neon sign, a bouquet of white flowers wrapped in white paper is placed in the center of the pathway. The entire scene creates a romantic and warm atmosphere, suggesting a marriage proposal or wedding theme.

TOPOLOGY OF THE USB TYPE-C INTERFACE
An Engraved Representation of the Twenty-Four Pin Symmetric Receptacle and the Historical Evolution of Its Signal Capacity
Plate XII. USB-C 接口24针脚对称与协议图解
The implementation of the twenty-four pin symmetric layout marks a significant advance in physical interface architecture. By positioning two rows of identical pathways in an inverted configuration, host systems can dynamically detect alignment and establish logic channels regardless of plug orientation. The design replaces rigid dedicated lines with software-defined pathways capable of routing power, native video, and multi-gigabit protocols. This layout operates as a unified medium. High-speed lanes are dynamically remapped to transport PCI Express, DisplayPort, or USB4 packets. Meanwhile, legacy compatibility is maintained via central differential lines, ensuring that older equipment coexists seamlessly with modern, high-power systems.

IV. PROTOCOL ARCHITECTURES & MECHANISMS
Reversibility & CC Logic
The interface achieves orientation independence using two Configuration Channel lines, CC1 and CC2. A pull-up or pull-down resistor circuit terminates only one line upon insertion. The controller identifies the active pin to dynamically align internal routing lines.
Power Delivery 3.1 EPR
The Extended Power Range (EPR) protocol facilitates dynamic negotiation between devices. Step-up voltage profiles permit negotiation at 28V, 36V, and 48V. This system ensures efficient power delivery at 5.0A while preventing connector arcing.
Alternate Mode Mapping
The system reassigns its high-speed lanes to transmit alternative protocols. In DisplayPort Alternate Mode, the system directs video lanes through TX/RX pins, while utilizing SBU1 and SBU2 to carry secondary control commands.

prompt_cn: 这张技术信息图表以复古工程图风格展示了USB Type-C接口的拓扑结构。图表顶部是标题“TOPOLOGY OF THE USB TYPE-C INTERFACE”及其副标题，下方是关于其对称布局和动态信号路由的英文介绍。右侧附有“KEY SPECIFICATIONS”表格，列出了工作电压、最大电流、功率上限等关键参数。图表主体包含一个USB-C插座的24针脚分配图，详细标注了每个引脚的名称和位置，并用不同颜色区分。下方是一个折线图，展示了从1996年USB 1.1到2024年USB4 2.0的带宽和功率容量增长趋势。再下方是一个详细的表格，分类列出了信号通路的功能组、分配引脚、工作电压、信号带宽及核心协议。底部是关于可逆性、功率传输3.1 EPR和替代模式映射的三个简短说明段落。页脚注明了其“雕刻与印刷”的历史背景。
prompt_en: This technical infographic, presented in a vintage engineering drawing style, illustrates the topology of the USB Type-C interface. The top features the main title "TOPOLOGY OF THE USB TYPE-C INTERFACE" and its subtitles, followed by an English introduction explaining its symmetric layout and dynamic signal routing. To the right, a "KEY SPECIFICATIONS" table lists critical parameters like operating voltage, maximum current, and power ceiling. The main body includes a 24-pin allocation diagram for a USB-C receptacle, detailing each pin's name and position, color-coded for distinction. Below this, a line chart depicts the growth trend of bandwidth and power capacity from USB 1.1 in 1996 to USB4 2.0 in 2024. Further down, a detailed table categorizes signal pathways by functional group, assigned pins, operational voltage, signal bandwidth, and core protocols. The bottom section provides three brief explanatory paragraphs on reversibility, Power Delivery 3.1 EPR, and Alternate Mode Mapping. A footer notes its historical "Engraved & Printed" origin.

问题详情
已解决
数学小达人
提问于 2023-10-24
关于二次函数 y=ax²+bx+c 的对称轴公式推导过程，希望能有详细的步骤说明。
#高一数学
#函数基础
张老师
认证名师
已帮助 1.2W+ 学生
最佳采纳
【解析过程】
你好！推导对称轴公式最常用的方法是“配方法”。步骤如下：
1. 提取系数：y=a(x² + b/a x) + c
2. 配方：在括号内加上并减去 (b/2a)²
3. 整理：y=a(x + b/2a)² + (4ac-b²)/4a
由此可见，当 x=-b/2a 时，函数取得最值。因此，抛物线的对称轴方程即为：x=-b/2a。
2,481 人觉得有用
感谢老师

寿司经济学图鉴
二〇二四年十一月十四日・东京丰洲
江户前鱼介:从筑地传统到全球商品化下的
季节性价值波动与保鲜技术矩阵
本报记者 佐藤健一 | 丰洲市场特派编辑部
技法演变/EVOLUTION
市场季度指数/QUARTERLY MARKET INDEX
构造分析/ANATOMY
江户前寿司(Edomae Sushi)最初并非单纯追求鲜度。在制冷技术普及前,职人利用醋渍(Su-jime)、酱油渍(Zuke)与昆布渍(Konbu-jime)等技法进行物理防腐。这些技法不仅延长了赏味期,更意外地促进了蛋白质分解,释放出大量谷氨酸。
当代的江户前定义已从地理限制转向技法核心。其核心逻辑在于针对不同脂肪含量的鱼肉进行精准的时间管理,从而实现“旨味”的最大化呈现。

醋渍
针对青鱼类(小肌、鯖鱼),利用乙酸改变蛋白质结构,抑制腐败。
酱油渍
经典用于赤身金枪鱼,通过渗透压使酱汁渗入鱼肉表层3毫米。
注:顶级熟成金枪鱼需在0.5°C环境下放置14-21天,使其肌纤维断裂,口感如黄油般丝滑。
