prompt_cn: 这是一张关于寿司经济学的专业信息图表或报告页面。页面顶部是标题“寿司经济学图鉴”和日期“二〇二四年十一月十四日・东京丰洲”，下方是主标题“江户前鱼介:从筑地传统到全球商品化下的季节性价值波动与保鲜技术矩阵”及作者信息。页面主体内容分为三列：左侧是“技法演变/EVOLUTION”的文字描述，介绍了江户前寿司的传统保鲜技法和当代定义；中间是“市场季度指数/QUARTERLY MARKET INDEX”折线图，展示了“金枪鱼(油脂)”和“白身鱼(鲜度)”在春、夏、秋、冬四季的走势；右侧是“构造分析/ANATOMY”的鱼肉解剖示意图，标示了“赤身(AKAMI)”、“中腹(CHUTORO)”和“大腹(OTORO)”三个部分。图表下方是一个详细的表格，列出了多种核心种类鱼的产地来源、技法、指数和走势，表格右侧还配有“昆布渍”、“醋渍”和“酱油渍”三种技法的具体描述及一个关于熟成金枪鱼的注释。页面底部是深灰色信息栏，展示了多个地名及其对应的百分比数据，其中正增长用绿色显示，负增长用红色显示。页脚包含数据来源和版权信息。
prompt_en: This is a professional infographic or report page about the economics of sushi. At the top, the page features the main title "寿司经济学图鉴" (Sushi Economics Illustrated) and the date "二〇二四年十一月十四日・东京丰洲" (November 14, 2024, Tokyo Toyosu), followed by the subtitle "江户前鱼介:从筑地传统到全球商品化下的季节性价值波动与保鲜技术矩阵" (Edomae Fish: Seasonal Value Fluctuations and Preservation Technology Matrix from Tsukiji Tradition to Global Commodification) and author information. The main content is divided into three columns: the left column provides a textual description under "技法演变/EVOLUTION" (Technique Evolution), detailing traditional Edomae sushi preservation techniques and modern definitions; the middle column displays a line chart titled "市场季度指数/QUARTERLY MARKET INDEX" (Quarterly Market Index), illustrating the seasonal trends of "金枪鱼(油脂)" (Tuna (Fat)) and "白身鱼(鲜度)" (White Fish (Freshness)) across spring, summer, autumn, and winter; the right column presents a fish anatomy diagram under "构造分析/ANATOMY" (Anatomy), labeling "赤身(AKAMI)" (Lean Meat), "中腹(CHUTORO)" (Medium Fatty Tuna), and "大腹(OTORO)" (Fatty Tuna). Below the chart, a detailed table lists various core fish species, their origins, techniques, indices, and trends. To the right of the table, descriptions for three techniques—"昆布渍" (Konbu-jime), "醋渍" (Su-jime), and "酱油渍" (Zuke)—are provided, along with a note on aged tuna. The bottom of the page features a dark gray information bar showing several place names with corresponding percentage data, where positive growth is indicated in green and negative growth in red. The footer includes data sources and copyright information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张数字插画，描绘了赛博朋克风格的潮流人物和科技背景。画面中央站立着一男一女两名年轻人物，他们穿着荧光黄和黑色的潮流服饰。男性角色留着蓬松的黑色卷发，身穿荧光黄色连帽夹克和白色工装裤，佩戴银色项链。女性角色留着黑色齐刘海长直发，身穿黑色露脐上衣（印有荧光黄色“X”字样）和迷彩工装裤，肩挎荧光黄色小包，手持荧光黄色喷漆罐。背景由复杂的电路板图案、霓虹线条、像素艺术图标和多段代码片段构成，呈现出强烈的科技感和未来感。左上角有一个黑色矩形标签，上面写有“SHIBUYA”。画面中还点缀着荧光黄色的喷溅涂鸦效果，增强了街头艺术的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration depicting trendy figures and a technological background in a cyberpunk style. In the center of the image stand two young individuals, a male and a female, dressed in fluorescent yellow and black fashionable attire. The male character has voluminous black curly hair, wears a fluorescent yellow hooded jacket and white cargo pants, and accessorizes with a silver necklace. The female character has straight black hair with bangs, wears a black crop top (featuring a fluorescent yellow "X" symbol) and camouflage cargo pants, carries a fluorescent yellow shoulder bag, and holds a fluorescent yellow spray can. The background is composed of intricate circuit board patterns, neon lines, pixel art icons, and multiple code snippets, creating a strong sense of technology and futurism. In the top left corner, there is a black rectangular label with "SHIBUYA" written on it. The image is also adorned with fluorescent yellow spray paint graffiti effects, enhancing the street art atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张抽象背景图。画面中央为大面积白色区域，四周边缘分布着柔和的渐变色块。左侧和底部区域呈现黄色和橙色的渐变，而右侧和顶部区域则为浅绿色和青色的渐变。背景中还点缀着细长、半透明的波浪形线条，颜色为灰色或淡蓝色，增加了画面的流动感。图片右上角有一个圆形品牌标识，其中包含白色的“Canva”字样，圆形背景从青色渐变到紫色。整张图片呈现出流畅、柔和且富有层次感的视觉效果。

The left and bottom areas display yellow and orange gradients, while the right and top areas show light green and teal gradients. The background is also adorned with slender, translucent wavy lines in grey or light blue, adding a sense of fluidity to the image. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a circular brand logo containing the white text 'Canva', with the circular background transitioning from teal to purple. The overall image presents a fluid, soft, and layered visual effect.

He is wearing a dark blue military-style uniform with gold braiding, a red collar, and a gold breastplate. The man has dark short hair, blue eyes, a mustache, and a goatee. The background is a blurry, dark city or architectural complex, possibly at night or dusk, with faint red sparks or embers scattered in the foreground and midground. The overall color palette is dominated by dark blue, gray, and black, accented with gold, red, and the subject's skin tones. Compositionally, the man's face and upper body occupy most of the frame, centrally displayed. Multiple lines of white text are concentrated at the bottom of the image, including the movie title "EXORCISM ST GROUP" and several lines of cast and crew credits, along with company logos.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深蓝色为背景的京剧脸谱色彩学信息图表。图表顶部是标题“京剧脸谱色彩学 / LIANPU CHROMA”及其副标题“TECHNICAL SCHEMATIC OF CHARACTER-COLOR CORRELATION IN PEKING OPERA”，右侧有“STARLAPT TOCT 2.104-2006 / AI-04-BJ”的标识。左侧有一段关于京剧脸谱视觉语言系统的描述性文字。图表内容分为三个主要部分。第一部分“01 脸谱分区结构 / ZONAL SCHEMATIC”展示了一个简化的脸谱轮廓，并用A、B、C标注了“脑门 / FOREHEAD”、“眼窝 / ORBIT”和“口腔 / MOUTH”，右侧垂直标注“SIZE: 24mm”。右侧信息块包含“SPECIFICATION NO. 800+”和“脸谱种类超400种”的文字，以及一个关于脸谱谱式（繁脸、三块瓦、十字门、碎脸）的表格。接着是“色彩象征系统”，列出了五种颜色及其代表的性格特征。第二部分“02 典型人物分析 / CHARACTER DATASET”是一个表格，列出了关羽、包拯、曹操等六位人物的底色、谱式和性格。右侧有“CRITICAL NOTE / 注意”提示，说明了紫色脸谱的象征意义。第三部分“03 色彩频率分布 / CHROMA FREQUENCY CHART”是一个条形图，显示了红色（28%）、黑色（35%）和白色（15%）的频率分布，以及蓝色、黄色、金色和“OTHER”的条形，但未标明具体百分比。图表底部左侧是“文化遗产数字化保护与传承 / CULTURAL HERITAGE TECH STANDARD”字样，右侧是一个包含校对、设计、比例和日期的表格，以及“BJ-OP-24”、“LIANPU-04”、“OTHER”等代码。
prompt_en: This is an infographic on Peking Opera facial makeup (Lianpu) color theory, set against a dark blue background. The top features the main title "京剧脸谱色彩学 / LIANPU CHROMA" and subtitle "TECHNICAL SCHEMATIC OF CHARACTER-COLOR CORRELATION IN PEKING OPERA", with an identifier "STARLAPT TOCT 2.104-2006 / AI-04-BJ" on the right. A descriptive paragraph on the visual language system of Lianpu is on the left. The infographic is divided into three main sections. The first, "01 脸谱分区结构 / ZONAL SCHEMATIC", displays a simplified facial outline with areas labeled A ("脑门 / FOREHEAD"), B ("眼窝 / ORBIT"), and C ("口腔 / MOUTH"), and a vertical "SIZE: 24mm" label on the right. A right-side information block includes "SPECIFICATION NO. 800+" and text stating "脸谱种类超400种", followed by a table detailing Lianpu patterns (Full, Tiles, Cross, Frag). Below this is the "色彩象征系统" (Color Symbolism System), listing five colors and their associated character traits. The second section, "02 典型人物分析 / CHARACTER DATASET", presents a table with six characters like Guan Yu, Bao Zheng, and Cao Cao, showing their primary color, pattern, and personality traits. A "CRITICAL NOTE / 注意" on the right explains the symbolism of purple facial makeup. The third section, "03 色彩频率分布 / CHROMA FREQUENCY CHART", is a bar chart illustrating the frequency distribution of red (28%), black (35%), and white (15%), with bars for blue, yellow, gold, and "OTHER" but without specified percentages. The bottom left of the chart shows "文化遗产数字化保护与传承 / CULTURAL HERITAGE TECH STANDARD", while the bottom right contains a table for "校对 / CHECKED", "设计 / DESIGN", "比例 / SCALE", and "日期 / DATE", along with codes like "BJ-OP-24", "LIANPU-04", and "OTHER".

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于日本武士具足铠甲的深色主题信息图。图片顶部有标题“日本武士具足铠甲”和英文副标题“TACTICAL SCHEMATIC: SAMURAI GUSOKU ARMOR”，右侧标有“SPEC_ID: 808-TK”。图片主体分为左右两栏，左侧是四个编号为01至04的文字描述区域，分别介绍了头部防御系统、躯干与下摆组件、四肢护具与配套武器以及材料配比分析。每个区域都包含中英文标题和详细说明。右侧上方是铠甲的结构投影图，用线条勾勒出铠甲轮廓，并用“KABUTO / 兜”、“SODE / 袖”、“KUSAZURI”、“DO / 胴”等标签指示不同部位，下方有“AUTO-SCAN ACTIVE”字样。右侧下方是“SPECIFICATION SHEET // 参数指标”表格，列出了铠甲自重、系绳编织、打刀规格、胁差规格、核心涂层和防护等级等参数。左侧的材料配比分析部分还通过带有百分比的进度条展示了铁片、生牛皮、丝绳和生漆的比例。
prompt_en: This is a dark-themed infographic about Japanese Samurai Gusoku Armor. At the top, there is a main title "日本武士具足铠甲" and an English subtitle "TACTICAL SCHEMATIC: SAMURAI GUSOKU ARMOR", with "SPEC_ID: 808-TK" on the right. The main body of the image is divided into two columns. The left column contains four numbered text description sections, from 01 to 04, detailing the head defense system, torso and skirt components, limb protectors and accompanying weapons, and material composition analysis, respectively. Each section includes Chinese and English titles with detailed explanations. The upper right side features a structural blueprint diagram of the armor, outlining its silhouette with lines and labeling different parts such as "KABUTO / 兜", "SODE / 袖", "KUSAZURI", and "DO / 胴", with "AUTO-SCAN ACTIVE" below. The lower right side presents a "SPECIFICATION SHEET // 参数指标" table, listing parameters like system weight, lacing style, katana size, wakizashi size, lacquer type, and defense class. The material composition analysis section on the left also visually displays the percentages of iron, rawhide, silk lace, and lacquer using progress bars.

屋顶形制等级
结构全图解
正吻
脊部走兽 (排列顺序: 龙、凤、狮子、天马、海马...)
垂脊
下檐

中国古代建筑的屋顶不仅是结构性的遮蔽物,更是等级社会中最为显著的视觉符号。从屋脊的数量到瓦片的色彩,从出檐的深度到脊兽的个数,每一个几何细节都受到严格的礼制的约束。重檐庑殿顶作为至高无上的权力象征,仅允许在皇家主题或孔庙等极少数场合使用。这种由木构框架支撑的庞大体量,通过斗拱的层层传递,将皇权的重量转化为飞动的檐口曲线。这是一场关于秩序、木材与天际线的政治实验,每一座屋顶都是一座立体的法典。
最大走兽数量
10+1
(太和殿独有: 行什)
主要构件
09
(九脊五坡结构)

礼制
(等级化思想秩序)

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于中国古代建筑屋顶形制等级的信息图表。图表以深灰色为背景，大部分文字为白色，标题、编号和关键信息则使用红色突出显示。顶部是主标题“中国古代建筑”、“屋顶形制等级”和“结构全图解”。图表左侧中部是一个简化的屋顶结构示意图，用红色线条标示出“正吻”、“脊部走兽”、“垂脊”和“下檐”等构件，并配有文字说明。右侧中部是一个编号为01至08的列表，详细列举了八种屋顶形制，包括重檐庑殿顶、重檐歇山顶、单檐庑殿顶、单檐歇山顶、悬山顶、硬山顶、攒尖顶和卷棚顶，每种屋顶都附有其等级、应用场景或特点的简要描述。图表下方是一段关于中国古代建筑屋顶作为等级符号的详细阐述。最底部并列展示了三个数据框，分别以“最大走兽数量”、“主要构件”和“建筑逻辑”为主题，其中包含“10+1”、“09”和“礼制”等红色数字或文字。图表最下方是关于走兽排列、建筑色彩等级和资料来源的脚注。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the hierarchy of roof forms in ancient Chinese architecture. The chart features a dark gray background, with most text in white, while titles, numbers, and key information are highlighted in red. At the top are the main titles "中国古代建筑" (Ancient Chinese Architecture), "屋顶形制等级" (Roof Form Hierarchy), and "结构全图解" (Structural Diagram). In the middle-left, there is a simplified line drawing of a roof structure, with components like "正吻" (Chiwen), "脊部走兽" (Ridge Beasts), "垂脊" (Diagonal Ridge), and "下檐" (Lower Eave) indicated by red lines and accompanying text descriptions. The middle-right section presents a numbered list from 01 to 08, detailing eight roof forms, including Double-eaved Wudian Roof, Double-eaved Xieshan Roof, Single-eaved Wudian Roof, Single-eaved Xieshan Roof, Xuanshan Roof, Yingshan Roof, Zuanjian Roof, and Juanpeng Roof. Each roof type is accompanied by a brief description of its rank, application, or characteristics. Below this, a paragraph elaborates on the significance of ancient Chinese architectural roofs as symbols of hierarchy. At the very bottom, three data boxes are displayed side-by-side, themed "最大走兽数量" (Maximum Number of Ridge Beasts), "主要构件" (Main Components), and "建筑逻辑" (Architectural Logic), containing red numbers or text such as "10+1", "09", and "礼制" (Ritual System). The very bottom of the chart provides footnotes regarding the arrangement of ridge beasts, the hierarchy of architectural colors, and data sources.

prompt_cn:
这是一张关于阿波罗11号登月任务的技术信息图表。图表以深灰色为背景，采用白色、绿色和紫色文字及图形展示了任务的各项关键数据和结构。

图表顶部左侧是标题“APOLLO 11 登月任务剖面”，下方有关于任务发射日期、历时和性质的简要说明。顶部右侧是核心跨度数据“38.4万 KM 地球至月球平均轨道距离”，并附有英文“TOTAL TRANSLUNAR DISTANCE”。

中部左侧是“SPACECRAFT SCHEMATIC / 航天器舱段结构”标题，下方展示了服务舱SM（紫色）、指令舱CM（白色）和登月舱LM（绿色）的示意图，并标注了“舱体总长: 11.0M”。中部右侧是“FLIGHT PHASES / 关键飞行阶段数据”表格，列出了“阶段”、“速度”、“高度”和“历时”等信息，详细记录了从驻留轨道到轨道对接的六个飞行阶段数据。

图表底部左侧是“SATURN V THRUST / 土星5号各级推力对比”的水平条形图，用绿色和紫色条形展示了S-IC第一级、S-II第二级和S-IVB第三级的推力数据。底部中间区域分为两部分，左侧是“SATURN V / 土星5号”的详细参数，包括高度、起飞质量、运载能力和发动机型号；右侧是“CSM / 指令服务舱”的参数，包括舱体质量、服务舱长、指令舱长和乘员人数。底部右侧是“LM / 登月舱段”和“PAYLOAD / 载荷样本”的数据，分别列出了登月舱的总质量、下降级质量、上升级质量、舱外停留时间，以及载荷样本的月石采集量、月表仪器、首批样本地点和返回舱重量。

图表底部是页脚信息：“国家航空航天局阿波罗11号任务技术剖面图 | 内部参考数据手册 | 密级:公开”。
prompt_en:
This is a technical infographic about the Apollo 11 lunar landing mission. The chart features a dark gray background, using white, green, and purple text and graphics to display key mission data and structures.

At the top left, the title reads "APOLLO 11 登月任务剖面" (Apollo 11 Lunar Mission Profile), with a brief description below detailing the mission's launch date, duration, and nature. The top right presents the core metric data "38.4万 KM 地球至月球平均轨道距离" (384,000 KM Earth to Moon Average Orbital Distance), accompanied by the English text "TOTAL TRANSLUNAR DISTANCE".

The middle-left section is titled "SPACECRAFT SCHEMATIC / 航天器舱段结构" (Spacecraft Section Structure), showing a schematic diagram of the Service Module (SM) in purple, Command Module (CM) in white, and Lunar Module (LM) in green, with "舱体总长: 11.0M" (Total Module Length: 11.0M) indicated. The middle-right features the "FLIGHT PHASES / 关键飞行阶段数据" (Key Flight Phase Data) table, listing "阶段" (Phase), "速度" (Speed), "高度" (Altitude), and "历时" (Duration) for six flight phases from orbital insertion to orbital rendezvous.

The bottom-left of the chart displays a horizontal bar chart titled "SATURN V THRUST / 土星5号各级推力对比" (Saturn V Stage Thrust Comparison), using green and purple bars to illustrate the thrust data for the S-IC First Stage, S-II Second Stage, and S-IVB Third Stage. The bottom-middle area is divided into two sections: the left details "SATURN V / 土星5号" (Saturn V) parameters, including height, liftoff mass, payload capacity, and engine types; the right provides "CSM / 指令服务舱" (Command/Service Module) parameters, such as module mass, service module length, command module length, and crew size. The bottom-right section presents data for "LM / 登月舱段" (Lunar Module Section) and "PAYLOAD / 载荷样本" (Payload Samples), listing the Lunar Module's total mass, descent stage mass, ascent stage mass, and extravehicular stay time, as well as payload sample details like lunar rock collection amount, lunar surface instruments, initial sample location, and return capsule weight.

The footer at the very bottom reads: "国家航空航天局阿波罗11号任务技术剖面图 | 内部参考数据手册 | 密级:公开" (National Aeronautics and Space Administration Apollo 11 Mission Technical Profile | Internal Reference Data Manual | Classification: Public).

前中后调的挥发动力学与香料谱 • 伦敦香氛科学指南
一、瞬时之美：前调的爆发
警
示：前调由超轻分子组成，挥发仅需五至十五分钟。柠檬与薄荷以极高蒸气压迅速充盈鼻腔，奠定转瞬即逝的第一印象。此乃诱惑感官之首要元素。

二、核心载体：中调的演变
核
心：中调维持二十分钟至一小时，乃香氛之主体。玫瑰、胡椒与肉桂在此阶段徐徐展开，其分子量适中，既不似前调般轻浮，亦不似后调般沉重，是为整瓶香水之灵魂叙事。
三、终极宿命：后调之驻留
魂
定：后调富含大分子定香剂，留香可达数天。檀香、香草与麝香结构极重，紧锁皮肤表面。缺乏后调者，香气将如幻影般迅速消散，毫无根基可言。

01 菌盖 (CAP): 含有菌肉与角质层，形态有平展、钟形或伞形。
02 菌褶 (GILLS): 担子果产孢组织，孢子印颜色是分类核心。
03 菌环 (ANNULUS): 菌幕残留，位于菌柄中上部。
04 菌柄 (STIPE): 支撑结构，内部可能实心或中空。
05 菌托 (VOLVA): 常见于鹅膏属，为外菌幕残余。
06 孢子 (SPORE): 微米级繁殖单元，淀粉反应呈阳性。
毒素机制 A1
分类与鉴定 B2
野外鉴别 C3
鹅膏毒素 (Amatoxins) 是目前已知最致命的真菌毒素。其主要作用于核细胞的 RNA 聚合酶 II，直接阻断信使 RNA 的转录过程。
摄入后会有 6-24 小时的潜伏期。此后出现剧烈呕吐与脱水，随后进入假愈期。最终导致急性肝肾功能衰竭，致死率高达 50% 以上。
鹿花毒素 (Gyromitrin) 在人体内代谢为甲基联氨。这种物质具有强烈的神经毒性，并能破坏红细胞。中毒表现为眩晕、抽搐及溶血性贫血。
毒蕈碱 (Muscarine) 则主要刺激副交感神经系统，导致流涎、流泪、多汗及心动过速。症状通常在摄入后 30 分钟内迅速出现。
传统的“银针试毒”或“颜色鲜艳”判断法毫无科学依据。致命的鹅膏菌 (如白毒鹅膏) 外观洁白如玉，极具欺骗性。
唯一可靠的鉴定方法是依靠菌托、菌环的完整性检查，以及在显微镜下观察孢子的形态与化学反应。民间辨识法往往导致惨剧。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于致命毒菇的科普信息图。图片以浅米色为背景，左侧边缘垂直排布着一行设计元数据。左上角有一个巨大的深蓝色字母“M”作为标识。图的右上方是主标题“致命毒菇”，下方有红色下划线，接着是副标题“鹅膏毒素”以及“鹿花毒素”、“毒蕈碱分类”、“裸盖菇素致幻”等相关毒素名称。图片中部绘制了一个蘑菇的线稿图，其右侧用红色数字和黑色文字详细标注了菌盖、菌褶、菌环、菌柄、菌托和孢子等六个主要部位及其特征。图片底部是一个三列表格，分别以“毒素机制 A1”、“分类与鉴定 B2”和“野外鉴别 C3”为标题，详细介绍了不同毒素的作用机制、中毒症状、鉴定方法和关键特征等信息，并配有“半数致死量”、“主要目标”、“潜伏期”、“代谢物”、“关键特征”、“致死品种”等数据。图片底部还有三行页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about deadly poisonous mushrooms. The image features a light beige background with a line of design metadata vertically arranged along the left edge. A large, dark blue letter "M" serves as an identifier in the top-left corner. The top-right section displays the main title "致命毒菇" (Deadly Poisonous Mushrooms), underlined in red, followed by the subtitle "鹅膏毒素" (Amatoxins) and related toxin names like "鹿花毒素" (Gyromitrin), "毒蕈碱分类" (Muscarine Classification), and "裸盖菇素致幻" (Psilocybin Hallucinogenic). In the middle of the image, a line drawing of a mushroom is presented, with its six main parts—cap, gills, annulus, stipe, volva, and spore—detailed with red numbers and black text on the right, describing their characteristics. The bottom of the image contains a three-column table, titled "毒素机制 A1" (Toxin Mechanism A1), "分类与鉴定 B2" (Classification and Identification B2), and "野外鉴别 C3" (Field Identification C3). This table provides detailed information on the mechanism of action of different toxins, symptoms of poisoning, identification methods, and key characteristics, accompanied by data such as "半数致死量" (LD50), "主要目标" (Main Target), "潜伏期" (Incubation Period), "代谢物" (Metabolite), "关键特征" (Key Features), and "致死品种" (Lethal Species). Three lines of footer information are also present at the very bottom of the image.

prompt_en: This image displays a baby's 100-day celebration invitation card set against a film strip border background. The main body of the invitation is a rounded rectangle with an off-white background and a light brown border. Dark gray film perforations are visible along the top and bottom edges of the overall composition. Inside the invitation, the upper part features a black and white photograph of a carousel. Overlaid in the center of the photo is a semi-transparent dark gray oval background with the white, bold text "百日之喜" (100-Day Celebration). Below the photo is the main text of the invitation, starting with the greeting "致： 亲爱的亲朋好友" (To: Dear Friends and Family), where "亲爱的亲朋好友" has a decorative line underneath. The body text describes the 100-day celebration of a baby named "子安" and invites guests to a carousel-themed party. Below the main text, there are two information boxes side-by-side. The left box contains "邀请时间 / TIME" (Invitation Time / TIME) followed by "2024年11月18日 中午 12:00 准时入席" (November 18, 2024, 12:00 PM sharp). The right box contains "邀请地点 / VENUE" (Invitation Venue / VENUE) followed by "半岛酒店 · 凡尔赛厅 上海市黄浦区中山东一路32号" (The Peninsula Hotel · Versailles Hall, No. 32 Zhongshan East 1st Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai). The overall background of the image is dark gray. At the top left, it reads "ISO 400 / KODAK PORTRA", and at the top right, "2024.10.24 / NO. 100". At the bottom left, it says "印 沈氏夫妇 敬邀" (The Shen Couple cordially invites), and at the bottom right, "MEMORIES CAPTURED BY FILM".

NETWORK ARCHITECTURES
A comparative study of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) and the Transmission Control Protocol / Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) frameworks. These models define the standards for communication across heterogeneous hardware systems, ensuring the reliable transfer of data packets from origin to destination across the global digital landscape.
I. The Stack Comparison
III. Field Notes
7. Application Layer
Application Layer (TCP)
6. Presentation Layer
5. Session Layer
4. Transport Layer
Transport Layer
3. Network Layer
Internet Layer
2. Data Link Layer
Network Interface
1. Physical Layer
01 Physical Layer (L1): The foundation of all transit. It encompasses the raw transmission of bits over physical media including copper wires, fiber optics, or radio waves.
02 Network Layer (L3): Responsible for packet forwarding and routing. It utilizes logical IP addresses to find paths across multiple network nodes.
03 Transport Layer (L4): Manages end-to-end communication. TCP provides reliable delivery via handshakes, whereas UDP prioritizes speed over integrity.
04 Application (L7): The interface for users. HTTP for web browsing, SMTP for mail, and SSH for secure remote management operate here.

prompt_cn: 这是一张数字贺卡或海报，整体以白色为背景，搭配粉色和浅灰色调。图片顶部左侧是粉色大字“HBD”和浅灰色小字“TO YOU”，右侧有一个粉色菱形图标。卡片中央嵌入一张摄影图片，展示了四款装饰有花朵和绿植的多层蛋糕，图片呈低饱和度或黑白效果，但蛋糕上的花朵略带色彩。蛋糕图片下方是中文祝福语“亲爱的朋友：在这个充满粉色浪漫气息的日子里，愿你如星辰般闪耀，如花朵般绽放。愿所有的美好与你不期而遇，岁岁年年，万事胜意。”，接着是粉色英文标语“Stay Sweet & Shine”。底部左侧是浅灰色“日期 / DATE”和黑色“二零二四年·盛夏”，右侧是浅灰色“致礼 / BEST WISHES”和粉色“你的挚友”，旁边有一个粉色圆形印章，内含白色“印”字。整个卡片由一个粉色细边框包围。
prompt_en: This is a digital greeting card or poster, featuring a white background with pink and light gray accents. At the top left, there's large pink text "HBD" and smaller light gray text "TO YOU", with a pink diamond icon on the right. The center of the card contains a photographic image displaying four multi-tiered cakes decorated with flowers and greenery. The photo has a desaturated or black-and-white effect, though the flowers on the cakes retain some color. Below the cake image is a Chinese blessing: "亲爱的朋友：在这个充满粉色浪漫气息的日子里，愿你如星辰般闪耀，如花朵般绽放。愿所有的美好与你不期而遇，岁岁年年，万事胜意." (Dear friend: On this day filled with pink romantic atmosphere, may you shine like the stars and bloom like flowers. May all good things meet you unexpectedly, year after year, and may all your wishes come true.), followed by a pink English slogan "Stay Sweet & Shine". The bottom left features light gray text "日期 / DATE" and black text "二零二四年·盛夏" (Year 2024 · Midsummer), while the bottom right has light gray text "致礼 / BEST WISHES" and pink text "你的挚友" (Your close friend), next to a pink circular seal with white text "印" (Seal). The entire card is framed by a thin pink border.

prompt_cn: 这是一张软件界面截图，展示了一个文档编辑和版本管理系统。界面顶部是导航栏，左侧显示文件名“2024 核心产品升级方案.docx”和一个文档图标，右侧有“退出”和“还原版本”两个按钮，其中“还原版本”按钮为紫色背景。文件名下方是文件信息区，包含“历史版本预览”和带有浅橙色背景的“只读”标签。界面主体分为左右两部分，左侧是文档主内容区，右侧是版本记录侧边栏。主内容区显示文档标题“一、AI 引擎深度集成计划”和正文“本阶段核心目标是实现文档内容的智能语义分析，提供实时摘要与知识关联。”下方有两个信息卡片，分别以绿色标题“技术栈”和“预期收益”开头，内容为“向量数据库优化”和“效率提升 35%”。主内容区底部嵌入一张抽象的蓝色和绿色调网络状图案。右侧版本记录侧边栏标题为“版本记录”，下方列出多个历史版本，每个版本包含版本号、日期和编辑者姓名，如“版本 4.2”、“2023-11-15”、“王经理”，其中“版本 4.2”被紫色“当前预览”标签高亮显示。界面底部是状态栏，左侧显示“字数: 4,280”和“已同步”，右侧显示带有绿色圆点的“云端加密”。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a software interface, displaying a document editing and version management system. The top of the interface features a navigation bar, with the filename "2024 核心产品升级方案.docx" and a document icon on the left, and "退出" (Exit) and "还原版本" (Restore Version) buttons on the right, with the "还原版本" button having a purple background. Below the filename is a file information area, including "历史版本预览" (Historical Version Preview) and a "只读" (Read-only) label with a light orange background. The main body of the interface is divided into two parts: the left is the main document content area, and the right is the version history sidebar. The main content area displays the document title "一、AI 引擎深度集成计划" (I. AI Engine Deep Integration Plan) and body text "本阶段核心目标是实现文档内容的智能语义分析，提供实时摘要与知识关联。" (The core objective of this phase is to achieve intelligent semantic analysis of document content, providing real-time summaries and knowledge associations.). Below this are two information cards, titled in green "技术栈" (Technology Stack) and "预期收益" (Expected Benefits), with content "向量数据库优化" (Vector Database Optimization) and "效率提升 35%" (Efficiency Improvement 35%) respectively. The bottom of the main content area embeds an abstract blue and green network-like pattern. The right version history sidebar is titled "版本记录" (Version History) and lists multiple historical versions, each including a version number, date, and editor's name, such as "版本 4.2" (Version 4.2), "2023-11-15", and "王经理" (Manager Wang), with "版本 4.2" highlighted by a purple "当前预览" (Current Preview) label. The bottom of the interface is a status bar, showing "字数: 4,280" (Word Count: 4,280) and "已同步" (Synced) on the left, and "云端加密" (Cloud Encryption) with a green dot on the right.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以浅黄色为背景的团建露营活动宣传海报。海报顶部左侧的黄色圆形区域内，有黑色英文“Team Building”。顶部中央偏右是黑色大字“团建露营”，其下方是橙色弧形文字“Camping”，右侧则有黑色文字“{氛围感拉满}”。海报左侧有一个黑色箭头图形，下方列出了四项活动内容：篝火晚会、户外烧烤、野外探险和水上项目。海报右侧和底部大部分区域展示了一张露营场景照片，照片中有一辆白色和黄色的露营拖车，上方撑着黄色格纹遮阳篷。拖车前摆放着一张折叠桌和两把条纹椅子。照片左下角有一个圆形裁剪的野餐场景，展示了铺有绿色格纹野餐布的草地上摆放着食物、水果和野餐篮。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a team building camping event, set against a light yellow background. In the top left corner of the poster, a yellow circular area contains the black English text "Team Building". Towards the top center-right, the large black Chinese characters "团建露营" (Team Building Camping) are displayed, with the orange curved English text "Camping" below them. To the right of the main title, there is black text "{氛围感拉满}" (Atmosphere full/maxed out). On the left side of the poster, a black arrow graphic points downwards, below which four activity items are listed: "篝火晚会" (Bonfire Party), "户外烧烤" (Outdoor BBQ), "野外探险" (Wilderness Exploration), and "水上项目" (Water Activities). The right and bottom parts of the poster feature a photograph of a camping scene, showing a white and yellow camper trailer with a yellow checkered awning. In front of the trailer, there is a foldable table and two striped chairs. In the bottom left of the photo, a circular cutout reveals a picnic scene on a green checkered picnic blanket, displaying food, fruits, and a picnic basket.

The center of the interface displays a grayscale rendered 3D model of a mechanical component, possibly a turbocharger assembly. Above the model is a cube indicator showing "上" (Up) and "前" (Front) directions, while below and to the left is a coordinate system indicator with X, Y, Z axes and a "WCS" label. The top of the interface includes the software name "PrecisionCAD Pro", project number "工程编号: A-742-X105 / 涡轮增压器组件" (Project No: A-742-X105 / Turbocharger Assembly), rendering mode "渲染模式: 光线追踪" (Render Mode: Ray Tracing), and a "保存更改" (Save Changes) button. The left panel lists "视图预设" (View Presets), including the selected "等轴测视图" (Isometric View) and options like "顶视图 (X-Y)" (Top View (X-Y)), "前视图 (X-Z)" (Front View (X-Z)), "右视图 (Y-Z)" (Right View (Y-Z)), with "当前相机焦距" (Current Camera Focal Length) displayed as "50.00 mm" at the bottom. The right panel is an interactive tools area, containing "环绕" (Orbit), "平移" (Pan), "缩放" (Zoom, selected), and "窗口" (Window) buttons. The bottom status bar shows "坐标: X:1420.5 Y:892.1 Z:0.0" (Coordinates: X:1420.5 Y:892.1 Z:0.0), "比例: 1:25" (Scale: 1:25), "加速开启" (Acceleration On) status, and the unit "MM".

The upper right side features a yellow banner with black text: "电视剧《生万物》杀青" (The TV series "This Thriving Land" wraps up filming), "在日照等地取景!" (Filmed in Rizhao and other locations!), and "杨幂、欧豪领衔主演" (Starring Yang Mi and Ou Hao), with a red circular icon preceding the last line. The central right section shows a still from the TV series, depicting several actors in ancient costumes standing in front of an old building, with some seated on chairs. Overlaid in the center of the still are the white artistic Chinese title "生万物" and its English subtitle "THIS THRIVING LAND". The lower right section contains a dark gray background text area, listing the main cast and special appearances, including Yang Mi, Ou Hao, and Ni Dahong.

The left column is a sidebar view, containing four functional entries: '核心组件' (Core Components), '资产浏览器' (Asset Browser), '版本控制' (Version Control), and '控制台' (Console), with each entry displaying its current status (e.g., '已固定' (Pinned), '显示' (Display), '自动' (Auto), '异常' (Error)). The middle column is a status tag detector, listing four projects under '6 活跃项目' (6 Active Projects): 'VS-Code', 'Node.js', 'UI Kit', and 'Logger'. Each project shows its name, running status tag (e.g., 'RUN', 'UPDT', 'ACTV', 'OFF'), data volume or progress bar, and version number. The right column provides semantic color specifications, explaining the meanings and applicable scenarios for three statuses: 'Success / 运行正常' (green), 'Warning / 等待响应' (yellow), and 'Danger / 连接断开' (red). The top of the interface features the title '工作区插件管理系统' (Workspace Plugin Management System) and a '系统运行正常' (System Running Normally) status prompt, while the bottom displays 'SYSTEM V4.2' version information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于柯本气候分类法的规范卡片或信息图表。图片顶部深灰色区域显示英文标题“METEOROLOGICAL SPECIFICATION DATA SHEET”、中文主标题“柯本气候分类法”及其副标题“地球五大气候带与降水特征参数表”，右侧有标识符“KOP-1918”和批号。中部浅灰色主内容区分为左右两栏。左栏包含一个表格，详细列出A至E五大气候带的带区、气候带名称、核心温度与降水特征及代表植被型。表格下方是一个流程图，展示了气候带的级联判定逻辑。右栏上方是“系统概述”的文字说明，下方是一个示意图，描绘了纬度、气压带和气候带的理想化分布。右侧还有一个黄色背景的“注意”方框，强调B带判定的优先级。图片底部有两个黄色背景的方框，分别提供了“干旱极限公式”和“降水次级编码”的详细说明。最下方是深灰色页脚，标有“地理科学基础标准规范卡”及修订信息。整张图表结构清晰，图文并茂，系统地阐释了柯本气候分类法的核心内容。
prompt_en: This is a specification card or infographic about the Köppen climate classification system. The top dark gray area of the image displays the English title 'METEOROLOGICAL SPECIFICATION DATA SHEET', the main Chinese title '柯本气候分类法' (Köppen Climate Classification), and its subtitle '地球五大气候带与降水特征参数表' (Table of Earth's Five Major Climate Zones and Precipitation Characteristics Parameters), with the identifier 'KOP-1918' and batch number on the right. The central light gray main content area is divided into two columns. The left column contains a table detailing the zone, climate zone name, core temperature and precipitation characteristics, and representative vegetation types for the five major climate zones (A to E). Below the table is a flowchart illustrating the cascading logic for climate zone determination. The upper right column features a '系统概述' (System Overview) text description, and below it is a schematic diagram depicting the idealized distribution of latitudes, pressure belts (such as polar easterlies, westerlies, trade winds), and climate zones (E, C/D, A). There is also a yellow-background '注意' (Note) box on the right, emphasizing the priority of B zone determination. The bottom of the image features two yellow-background boxes, providing detailed explanations for the '干旱极限公式' (Aridity Limit Formula) and '降水次级编码' (Secondary Precipitation Codes) respectively. The very bottom is a dark gray footer, labeled '地理科学基础标准规范卡' (Geographical Science Basic Standard Specification Card) and revision information. The entire chart is clearly structured, combining text and graphics to systematically explain the core content of the Köppen climate classification.

text:
诸位亲友：谢忱
家严告别仪式已于近日在家族内部静谧举行。在这段悲恸沉重的日子里，承蒙各位亲友的深情厚意、至诚慰问与慷慨襄助，令我们在哀思中感受到了莫大的温暖与慰藉。
遵照先辈遗愿，仪式仅限至亲参加，未能邀请诸位同仁亲临送别，深感歉疚。诸位寄托的哀思与关怀，我们已悉数心领并铭记于心。
在此，谨代表全体家属向各位致以最诚挚的谢意。愿逝者安息，生者坚强，亦祈愿诸位岁岁平安，福寿康宁。
[姓氏]氏家族 众孤哀子 敬谢
二〇二四年·仲秋

The top of the interface displays the title "报警详情分析: 核心动力组压力异常" (Alarm Details Analysis: Core Power Unit Pressure Anomaly), with "紧急级别: 一级" (Emergency Level: Level One) and "设备编号: EQP-7702-BF" (Device Number: EQP-7702-BF) on the right. The central area features a bar chart titled "压力波动趋势 (PSI)" (Pressure Fluctuation Trend (PSI)), indicating a "阈值: 850" (Threshold: 850), with time markers (14:00 to 16:00) on the X-axis. The right panel presents "实时参数监控" (Real-time Parameter Monitoring), listing "进气压力" (Intake Pressure), "排气温度" (Exhaust Temperature), "润滑油位" (Lubricant Level), and "振动频率" (Vibration Frequency) with their respective values, some highlighted in red, green, or yellow. Below this is a black-and-white industrial equipment image labeled "现场实时监控画面 (CAM-04)" (Live Monitoring Screen (CAM-04)). The bottom section shows "响应状态" (Response Status) with "已派单" (Dispatched) and "处理中" (In Progress) buttons, along with "值班工程师: 张建国" (Duty Engineer: Zhang Jianguo), "联系电话: 138-****-8888" (Contact Number: 138-****-8888), and "系统运行正常 - 数据同步延迟 < 10ms" (System Running Normally - Data Sync Delay < 10ms) status information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色主题的移动应用界面截图，可能是一个城市轨道交通应用。界面顶部显示应用标题“智慧出行 · 城市轨道”和当前时间“14:42”。下方是当前线路信息，包括蓝色胶囊内的“11号线”和“机场快线”，右侧显示“下一站 航站楼北”。界面中央是一张黑白色的地铁站台图片，上面叠加了英文“TERMINAL STATION”和中文“国际机场”字样。图片下方左侧是“预计到达时间 08 min”，右侧是一个白色椭圆形按钮“准点运行”。中部区域展示“线路进度”，右侧标明“剩余 4站 / 12.5km”，下方是蓝色进度条，显示“碧海湾”、“当前站”、“机场北”和“终点站”四个站点。底部有两个信息面板，左侧是“出口信息”，列出黄色胶囊“A”的“T3航站楼”和黄色胶囊“B”的“交通中心”；右侧是“换乘线路”，列出绿色胶囊“1”的“罗宝线”和红色胶囊“20”的“会展快线”。最下方是一个带有图标的宽大蓝色按钮，文字为“查看站内全景地图”。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed mobile application interface, likely for an urban rail transit app. The top of the interface displays the application title "智慧出行 · 城市轨道" (Smart Travel · Urban Rail) and the current time "14:42". Below this, current line information is shown, including "11号线" (Line 11) in a blue capsule and "机场快线" (Airport Express), with "下一站 航站楼北" (Next Stop Terminal North) on the right. The central part features a large black-and-white image of a subway station platform, overlaid with the English text "TERMINAL STATION" and Chinese text "国际机场" (International Airport). Below the image, "预计到达时间 08 min" (Estimated Arrival Time 08 min) is on the left, and a white oval button "准点运行" (On-time Operation) is on the right. The middle section presents "线路进度" (Line Progress), with "剩余 4站 / 12.5km" (Remaining 4 stations / 12.5km) indicated on the right, and a blue progress bar below showing four stations: "碧海湾" (Bihaiwan), "当前站" (Current Station), "机场北" (Airport North), and "终点站" (Terminal Station). The bottom section contains two information panels: "出口信息" (Exit Information) on the left, listing "A T3航站楼" (A T3 Terminal) with a yellow 'A' capsule and "B 交通中心" (B Transportation Hub) with a yellow 'B' capsule; and "换乘线路" (Transfer Lines) on the right, listing "1 罗宝线" (Line 1 Luobao Line) with a green '1' capsule and "20 会展快线" (Line 20 Convention & Exhibition Express) with a red '20' capsule. At the very bottom, a wide blue button with an icon reads "查看站内全景地图" (View Station Panorama Map).

prompt_cn: 这是一张宣传海报，画面中一男一女面对面站立，手牵着手，深情对视。男子身穿深色西装，系着领带，神情专注地看着女子。女子则穿着米色与黑色拼接的无袖连衣裙，戴着手表和耳环，眼神中带着一丝惊讶和期待。两人身后是现代化的办公室，透过巨大的落地窗，可以看到窗外繁华的城市夜景，高楼林立，灯火璀璨。前景有一张木质办公桌，上面摆放着一台笔记本电脑和一些文件。图片下方中央位置有金色艺术字体“霸道总裁爱上我”，作为海报的标题，点明了主题。整张图片构图饱满，人物情感表达清晰，营造出浪漫而紧张的氛围，像是一部都市爱情剧的剧照或宣传图。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster featuring a man and a woman standing face to face, holding hands, and gazing intently at each other. The man is dressed in a dark suit with a tie, looking at the woman with a focused expression. The woman is wearing a beige and black spliced sleeveless dress, adorned with a watch and earrings, her eyes conveying a mix of surprise and anticipation. Behind them is a modern office setting with large floor-to-ceiling windows, offering a view of a bustling city nightscape with numerous illuminated high-rise buildings. In the foreground, there is a wooden office desk with a laptop and some documents. At the bottom center of the image, the golden artistic text "霸道总裁爱上我" (Overbearing CEO Falls in Love with Me) serves as the poster's title, highlighting the theme. The overall composition is rich, and the characters' emotions are clearly expressed, creating a romantic yet intense atmosphere, resembling a still or promotional image for an urban romance drama.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深绿色为背景的活动邀请函或海报。顶部中央是“SC”标志和“圣安德鲁斯乡村俱乐部”的名称。下方是一个横向的矩形图片区域，其中展示了一座被秋季树木环绕的建筑，图片上叠加着白色大字“私享晚宴”和较小的英文“AUTUMN PRIVATE DINNER”。图片下方有一个棕色、带有竖线和横条的矩形装饰性图标。主体文字部分以“尊贵的阁下：”开头，接着是一段关于私享盛宴的中文描述。下方是两列并排的活动详情，左侧是“时间 / TIME”和“2024年10月18日 18:30”、“着装 / DRESS CODE”和“英式正装 / 乡村绅士”；右侧是“地点 / VENUE”和“庄园主楼·橡木厅”、“席位 / CAPACITY”和“仅限十六席尊享”。底部左侧是“请于10月10日前确认出席”和“RSVP: 010-8888-9999”，右侧是英文落款“Sincerely Yours,”和“The Club Committee”。所有文字均为白色，排版整洁。
prompt_en: This is an event invitation or poster with a dark green background. At the top center, there is an "SC" logo and the name "圣安德鲁斯乡村俱乐部" (St. Andrews Country Club). Below this is a horizontal rectangular image area featuring a building surrounded by autumn trees, overlaid with large white text "私享晚宴" (Private Dinner) and smaller English text "AUTUMN PRIVATE DINNER". Below the image, there is a brown rectangular decorative icon with a vertical line and a horizontal bar. The main text section begins with "尊贵的阁下：" (Dear Sir/Madam:), followed by a Chinese description of the private dinner. Below this are two columns of event details: on the left, "时间 / TIME" (Time / TIME) and "2024年10月18日 18:30" (October 18, 2024 18:30), along with "着装 / DRESS CODE" (Dress Code / DRESS CODE) and "英式正装 / 乡村绅士" (English Formal / Country Gentleman); on the right, "地点 / VENUE" (Location / VENUE) and "庄园主楼·橡木厅" (Manor Main Building · Oak Hall), along with "席位 / CAPACITY" (Capacity / CAPACITY) and "仅限十六席尊享" (Limited to Sixteen Exclusive Seats). At the bottom left, it reads "请于10月10日前确认出席" (Please confirm attendance by October 10) and "RSVP: 010-8888-9999". On the bottom right, there is the English closing "Sincerely Yours," and "The Club Committee". All text is white and neatly arranged.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于超高层建筑抗风抗震结构的技术信息图。图片以浅灰色网格为背景，顶部有中英文双语标题“超高层建筑抗风抗震结构：核心筒与外伸桁架 SYSTEM”和“STRUCTURAL WIND & SEISMIC RESISTANCE”，以及文档参考信息。页面内容分为三列布局，左侧列包含“SYSTEM OVERVIEW”的文字描述和“SUPERTALL CASE STUDIES”的表格，表格列出了多座超高层建筑的高度、核心筒类型、外伸桁架数量和是否使用调谐质量阻尼器（TMD）。中间列展示了“ELEVATION & JOINT ANALYSIS”的建筑结构示意图，图中标注了风荷载、拉力、压力方向以及编号的结构部件，并附有图注。右侧列上方是“PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS”的线形图，显示了高度与漂移的关系，并用不同颜色的曲线表示了“Core Only”、“Outrigger”和“+Outr.+TMD”三种结构配置的性能。线形图下方是“SYSTEM LEGEND”列表，详细解释了中间示意图中编号部件的含义。最右侧下方是“MECHANICAL PARAMETERS”区域，以蓝色粗体数字和黑色小字描述了四项性能参数。页面底部有页脚信息，包含文档系列名称和版权信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic about wind and seismic resistance structures for supertall buildings. The image features a light gray grid background, with a bilingual title at the top, "超高层建筑抗风抗震结构：核心筒与外伸桁架 SYSTEM" and "STRUCTURAL WIND & SEISMIC RESISTANCE," along with document reference information. The page content is arranged in a three-column layout. The left column contains a text description under "SYSTEM OVERVIEW" and a table under "SUPERTALL CASE STUDIES," which lists several supertall buildings with their height, core type, number of outriggers, and whether they use Tuned Mass Dampers (TMD). The middle column displays a schematic elevation of a structural stabilizer assembly under "ELEVATION & JOINT ANALYSIS," indicating wind load, tension, compression directions, and numbered structural components, accompanied by a figure caption. The upper right column presents a line graph under "PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS," showing the relationship between height and drift, with different colored lines representing the performance of three structural configurations: "Core Only," "Outrigger," and "+Outr.+TMD." Below the line graph is a "SYSTEM LEGEND" list, detailing the meaning of the numbered components in the central schematic. The bottom right section is the "MECHANICAL PARAMETERS" area, which describes four performance parameters using bold blue numbers and small black text. The page footer contains the document series title and copyright information.

The top left features the main title, including "PROVINCIAL TALENT EXCHANGE" in English and "省级人才交流大厅" in Chinese, both in large, prominent fonts. The content is divided into three main sections, numbered "01", "02", and "03" in light blue, with vertical lines separating them. Section one is titled "简历准备" (Resume Preparation), with "RESUME PREPARATION" in English below it, followed by a Chinese description on resume preparation. Section two is titled "精准投递" (Precise Delivery), with "PRECISE DELIVERY" in English below it, and includes a dark rounded rectangular box. Inside this box are the titles "简历投递盒" (Resume Drop Box) and "RESUME DROP BOX", along with three rounded rectangular buttons labeled "A区: 综合管理" (Area A: Comprehensive Management), "B区: 技术研发" (Area B: Technology R&D), and "C区: 市场营销" (Area C: Marketing). Section three is titled "后续跟进" (Follow Up), with "FOLLOW UP" in English below it, followed by a Chinese description about interview notifications. The bottom left of the image displays "LOCATION" in English and the Chinese address "省级人才交流大厅·二层东侧" (Provincial Talent Exchange Hall · Second Floor East). The bottom right features blue text "智汇省城·筑梦" (Wisdom Gathers in the Provincial Capital · Building Dreams) and white text "2024届毕业生春季招" (2024 Graduates Spring Recruitment). Faint, semi-transparent white text "TALENT" and "POP" are visible in the background as decorative elements.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑色背景为底的拼贴艺术图片，整体呈现出电影胶片般的视觉效果。画面被分割成一个2x2的网格，由四张照片组成，照片之间有黑色边框，右侧和中间的垂直边框上带有胶片孔和文字标记。左上角和右下角的照片中，一位留着棕色短发、身穿白色高领衬衫的女性，侧身面对灰色背景，姿态优雅。右上角的照片展示了两个深色线轴、一个相机镜头和一个放大镜，它们共同置于一张复古风格的地图上。左下角的照片则呈现了一台复古的“ZENIT-E”相机，旁边散落着三张拍立得照片，其中两张清晰可见，一张印有罗马斗兽场和“BEST WISHES”、“PONY BROWN”、“Always smile”字样，另一张印有埃菲尔铁塔和“PARIS”、“PONY BROWN”字样。图片底部中央叠加了一张撕裂的纸片，上面印有部分英文句子“was signs of the island being brought back t”。胶片边框上还可见“TX 5063”、“Wu Chengze”、“28A”、“29”、“29A”、“30”等文字。整幅作品色调柔和，以棕色、灰色和白色为主。

The picture is divided into a 2x2 grid, composed of four photographs separated by black borders, with film perforations and text markings on the right and central vertical borders. The top-left and bottom-right panels feature a woman with short brown hair, wearing a white high-neck shirt, posing elegantly against a gray background. The top-right panel displays two dark spools of thread, a camera lens, and a magnifying glass, all resting on a vintage-style map. The bottom-left panel shows a vintage "ZENIT-E" camera, surrounded by three instant photos; two are clearly visible, one depicting the Colosseum with "BEST WISHES", "PONY BROWN", and "Always smile" text, and another showing the Eiffel Tower with "PARIS" and "PONY BROWN" text. A torn piece of paper is overlaid at the bottom center of the image, bearing a partial English sentence: "was signs of the island being brought back t". Text such as "TX 5063", "Wu Chengze", "28A", "29", "29A", and "30" are also visible on the film strip borders. The overall color palette of the work is soft, primarily consisting of browns, grays, and whites.

2018年:

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于南美白对虾养殖产业发展历程的信息展示板。背景为木纹，顶部中央是标题“南美白对虾·从探索到引领的十年深耕之路”。板面中央绘制了一只大型南美白对虾的插画。展示板内容以时间轴形式从左到右分为三个阶段，分别由绿色椭圆形标签标示：“创业初心与破冰探索 (2016-2018)”、“技术突破与规模扩张 (2020-2023)”和“产业示范与社会影响 (2024-2025)”。每个阶段下方列出具体年份和对应的发展事件，并配有小型插图或照片，如虾苗、养殖池、科研团队和报纸报道。展示板左侧边缘标有“4m”高度，右侧边缘标有“3m”高度。左下角设有一个白色展示台，上面放置着可触摸的水质样本盒和养殖技术手册展示架，其上方有五个带有英文缩写（如OTRINE）的圆形图标。底部中央是副标题“底部标语”及其下方的大字标语“匠心育好虾，以创新兴产业”。右下角是“数据亮点墙”，列出亩产提升、规模扩张、技术辐射和产业带动等数据；旁边是“荣誉墙”，展示了南方农村报报道版面和合作基地授牌陈列。底部页脚处有一段总结性文字，阐述了公司作为水产标准化养殖推动者的愿景。
prompt_en: This is an information display board detailing the development history of the South American white shrimp farming industry. The background features a wood grain texture, with the central top displaying the title "South American White Shrimp: A Decade of Deep Cultivation from Exploration to Leadership". A large illustration of a South American white shrimp is depicted in the center of the board. The content is structured as a timeline, divided into three phases from left to right, each marked by a green oval label: "Entrepreneurial Ambition and Breakthrough Exploration (2016-2018)", "Technological Breakthroughs and Scale Expansion (2020-2023)", and "Industrial Demonstration and Social Impact (2024-2025)". Below each phase, specific years and corresponding development events are listed, accompanied by small illustrations or photos such as shrimp larvae, aquaculture ponds, research teams, and newspaper reports. The left edge of the display board is marked with "4m" and the right edge with "3m", indicating height. In the bottom left, there is a white display stand holding touchable water quality sample boxes and a rack for aquaculture technical manuals, with five circular icons bearing English acronyms (e.g., OTRINE) above it. The bottom center features a subtitle "Bottom Slogan" followed by a large slogan "Cultivating quality shrimp with ingenuity, revitalizing industry through innovation". The bottom right section includes a "Data Highlights Wall" presenting metrics like yield improvement, scale expansion, technology outreach, and industry driving force; next to an "Honors Wall" showcasing newspaper report layouts and cooperative base plaques. A concluding text at the bottom footer outlines the company's vision as a promoter of standardized aquaculture.

text:
重阳安康
如吉意祥
岁岁重阳，今又重阳
敬爱的长辈：
金秋送爽，丹桂飘香。值此九九重阳佳节之际，晚辈谨以此信向您致以最诚挚的节日问候与深切的感激之情。
感谢您多年来的言传身教，您的智慧如高山般沉稳，指引着我们前行的方向；您的关怀如秋菊般淡雅，温暖了岁月的每一个角落。
愿此佳节，您能登高望远，舒怀畅饮。衷心祝愿您福寿康宁，岁岁平安，生活如重阳美酒般醇厚香甜。
传统礼仪·节日致辞
晚辈 敬上
庚子年 九月初九
二〇二四年·重阳

prompt_cn: 这是一张以重阳节为主题的电子贺卡或信件图片。图片整体采用深棕红色边框，内部是米白色背景。顶部左侧是深红色的主标题“重阳安康”，下方有金色装饰线。标题右侧有一个红色方形印章，内有白色竖排文字“如吉意祥”。主标题下方是黑色的副标题“岁岁重阳，今又重阳”。图片中部嵌入了一张黑白的山林景观照片。照片下方是信件正文，以“敬爱的长辈：”开头，包含三段黑色文字的正文内容。正文下方有一条细线分隔。底部左侧是“传统礼仪·节日致辞”和日期“庚子年 九月初九”，右侧是落款“晚辈 敬上”和日期“二〇二四年·重阳”。
prompt_en: This is an image of an electronic greeting card or letter themed around the Double Ninth Festival. The image features a dark reddish-brown border with an off-white background for the main content. At the top left, the main title "重阳安康" (Double Ninth Festival Health) is in dark red, with a golden decorative line beneath it. To the right of the title, there is a red square seal containing white vertically arranged text "如吉意祥" (Auspicious and Propitious). Below the main title is the black subtitle "岁岁重阳，今又重阳" (Double Ninth Festival every year, Double Ninth Festival again today). A black and white landscape photograph of a forest or mountains is embedded in the middle of the image. Below the photograph is the body of the letter, starting with "敬爱的长辈：" (Respected Elders:), followed by three paragraphs of black text. A thin line separates the main text from the bottom section. At the bottom left are "传统礼仪·节日致辞" (Traditional Etiquette · Festival Address) and the date "庚子年 九月初九" (Gengzi Year, Ninth Day of the Ninth Month), while at the bottom right are the closing "晚辈 敬上" (Your Junior, Respectfully) and the date "二〇二四年·重阳" (2024 · Double Ninth Festival).

prompt_cn: 这是一张以米白色为背景的乔迁邀请函。顶部中央有一个棕色圆角矩形标签，上面用白色粗体字写着“NEW CHAPTER”。下方是主标题“乔迁之喜”，字体为深棕色粗体，再下方是副标题“诚邀亲友·暖房小聚”。邀请函中部嵌入了一张黑白照片，展示了多种干燥花卉的特写。照片下方是正文，用黑色文字详细描述了新家落成和邀请亲友共度时光的意愿。正文下方并列着两个浅米色圆角矩形信息框，左侧框内是“聚会时间 / TIME”及其具体日期“2024年10月26日”和时间“下午 14:30 开启”。右侧框内是“聚会地点 / PLACE”及其地址“林语溪谷 8号院 自然美学生活馆”。邀请函底部左侧标明“主人家: 陈叙 & 林悦”，旁边有一个棕色圆形装饰。底部右侧是“RSVP”字样和提示“请于周五前确认出席”。整个邀请函设计简洁，带有自然温馨的风格。
prompt_en: This is a housewarming invitation card with an off-white background. At the top center, a brown rounded rectangular label displays "NEW CHAPTER" in white bold text. Below it, the main title "乔迁之喜" (Housewarming Celebration) is in dark brown bold font, followed by the subtitle "诚邀亲友·暖房小聚" (Sincerely invite friends and family for a cozy gathering). The middle section features a black and white photograph of various dried flowers. Below the photo, the main body text, in black, describes the new home's completion and invites guests for a warm gathering. Two light off-white rounded rectangular information boxes are arranged side-by-side below the main text. The left box details "聚会时间 / TIME" (Gathering Time / TIME) with the date "2024年10月26日" (October 26, 2024) and time "下午 14:30 开启" (Starts at 2:30 PM). The right box shows "聚会地点 / PLACE" (Gathering Place / PLACE) with the address "林语溪谷 8号院 自然美学生活馆" (Linyu Xigu No. 8 Courtyard, Natural Aesthetics Life Hall). At the bottom left, "主人家: 陈叙 & 林悦" (Hosts: Chen Xu & Lin Yue) is stated, next to a brown circular decoration. The bottom right features "RSVP" and the instruction "请于周五前确认出席" (Please confirm attendance by Friday). The invitation's design is simple, with a natural and warm aesthetic.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深红色为主色调的招聘海报。画面顶部左侧是“Canva 可画”的品牌标识，背景有白色和浅红色几何图形装饰及白色网格线。海报主体是一位身穿白色厨师服、黑色裤子，手持平底锅和锅铲的3D卡通厨师角色，他位于画面右侧中部，与一个巨大的深红色艺术字体“招聘”字样融合。画面左侧中部垂直排列着金色的英文“RECRUITMENT”和中文“可画餐厅厨师招聘”标题。厨师角色左侧有金色的“JOIN US”口号。海报下方区域详细列出了招聘岗位信息，包括“招聘岗位”及其英文“Recruitment”副标题。具体岗位有“中餐厨师”和“行政总厨”，分别标明了“6k-8k”和“8k-12k”的薪资范围，并配有详细的职责描述。海报底部左侧是联系方式，包含“地址: 深圳市南山区金色商业街001号商铺”和“电话: 001-12345678”。右下角有一个带有指纹图标的方形图形元素。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster predominantly in dark red. At the top left, there is the "Canva 可画" brand logo, with white and light red geometric decorations and a white grid pattern in the background. The main subject of the poster is a 3D cartoon chef character, wearing a white chef's uniform and black pants, holding a frying pan and spatula. He is positioned in the middle right of the image, integrated with a large, dark red artistic Chinese character "招聘" (Recruitment). On the middle left, vertically arranged golden text reads "RECRUITMENT" and "可画餐厅厨师招聘" (Canva Restaurant Chef Recruitment). To the left of the chef character, there is a golden "JOIN US" slogan. The bottom section of the poster details the job openings, including the main title "招聘岗位" (Job Openings) and its English subtitle "Recruitment". Specific roles listed are "中餐厨师" (Chinese Cuisine Chef) and "行政总厨" (Executive Chef), with salary ranges of "6k-8k" and "8k-12k" respectively, accompanied by detailed job descriptions. At the bottom left, contact information is provided: "地址: 深圳市南山区金色商业街001号商铺" (Address: Shop 001, Golden Commercial Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen) and "电话: 001-12345678" (Phone: 001-12345678). In the bottom right corner, there is a square graphic element with a fingerprint icon.

邻里互助 · 节日致礼

极简的生活方式，不仅是物质的克制，更是精神的丰盈。感谢您用行动诠释了“远亲不如近邻”的含义，让互助成为我们共同的生活美学。
您的邻里委员会
二〇二四年·仲春
COMMUNITY HARMONY

The upper section features a close-up photograph of a clear water droplet on a grayish-white background, with blurred textures beneath the droplet. prompt_cn: 这是一张以米色、浅棕色和深棕色为主色调的文学社招新海报。画面背景是淡雅的山峦和竹叶剪影，营造出古朴宁静的氛围。前景有四根木柱呈门廊状排列，其中左侧木柱上刻有模糊的文字“而其”以及一些特别不明显的文字，右侧木柱上刻有非常不明显的“惑之不解”三个字。画面中央，一个身穿学士服的剪影人物背对观众，面向远处的木柱和山峦，仿佛踏上求学或探索之路。海报左侧垂直排布着深棕色大字标题“月升沧海”和“只等你来”，下方是浅灰色水印“Canva ©”。左侧中部和偏下区域，以带有浅棕色边框的深棕色标签形式列出“招新人员”、“招新方式”和“招新要求”，并配有相应的深棕色正文，内容包括“写手,文编,美编,新媒体运营”、“线上笔试,通过邮箱发送至我社审核”和“热爱文学创作的大一新生”。海报右侧垂直排布着深棕色副标题“文学社招贤纳士”。左下角有一个方形二维码，旁边是“扫码报名 9.25 中午12:00报名截止”和“社团负责人:张学长 001-1234567”的深棕色文字。地面上还有一些非常模糊的浅棕色装饰文字。
prompt_en:
This is a recruitment poster for a literary society, designed primarily in beige, light brown, and dark brown tones. The background features subtle silhouettes of distant mountains and bamboo leaves, creating a traditional and tranquil atmosphere. In the foreground, four wooden pillars are arranged like a gateway. Faint carved characters are visible on the pillars: the left pillar appears to include “而其” along with additional indistinct writing, while the very faint inscription “惑之不解” can be made out on the right pillar.
At the center, a silhouetted figure wearing an academic gown stands with their back to the viewer, facing the distant pillars and mountains, as if setting out on a journey of learning or exploration. On the left side, the main titles “月升沧海” (“The Moon Rises Over the Vast Sea”) and “只等你来” (“We Are Waiting for You”) are vertically arranged in large dark brown characters. A light gray “Canva ©” watermark appears below them.
The middle and lower-left sections contain dark brown labels outlined in light brown, including “招新人员” (“Positions Open”), “招新方式” (“Application Method”), and “招新要求” (“Applicant Requirements”). The accompanying text lists “写手,文编,美编,新媒体运营” (“Writers, Copy Editors, Visual Editors, and New Media Operations Staff”), “线上笔试,通过邮箱发送至我社审核” (“Complete an online written test and submit it by email for review”), and “热爱文学创作的大一新生” (“First-year students who are passionate about literary writing”).
On the right side, the subtitle “文学社招贤纳士” (“The Literary Society Is Seeking New Talent”) is vertically arranged in dark brown. A square QR code appears in the bottom-left corner, accompanied by the text “扫码报名 9.25 中午12:00报名截止” (“Scan the code to register; registration closes at 12:00 noon on September 25”) and “社团负责人:张学长 001-1234567” (“Society Contact: Senior Zhang, 001-1234567”). Several extremely faint light brown decorative inscriptions are also visible across the ground.

text:
THE TERRESTRIAL GAZETTE
VOL. CCCL — LONDON, SATURDAY, DECEMBER 1894 — PRICE ONE PENNY
THE INFERNAL ENGINE
The terrestrial sphere is not a solid monument of stillness but a fractured assembly of seven gargantuan plates. Driven by the unrelenting heat of the mantle, these lithospheric fragments drift upon the asthenosphere like rafts upon a boiling sea. Scientists now conclude that the mechanism of this motion is mantle convection—a process where heated rock ascends, cools, and descends in a perpetual cycle of tectonic violence. This movement dictates the very geography of our civilization, tearing continents asunder and raising mountains to the heavens. The crust we inhabit is but a thin veil over a furnace of geological activity that has operated for eons before man and will continue long after his works have crumbled into the dust of the ages.
BIRTH AND SUBDUCTION
Divergent boundaries represent the terrestrial laboratory of creation. Along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, the earth splits wide, allowing basaltic magma to surge forth and solidify into new seafloor. This expansion proceeds at a rate of roughly 2.5 centimeters per annum, a slow but inexorable widening of the Atlantic basin that separates the Old World from the New. Conversely, convergent boundaries are sites of destruction. Where oceanic crust meets continental mass, it is forced downward into the crushing heat of the subduction zone. This collision births the volcanic arcs of the Andes and the deep trenches of the Pacific. Where two continents collide, as seen in the Himalayas, the crust buckles and folds, thrusting the earth upward at a rate of 5 millimeters every year.
THE GRINDING FAULTS
Transform boundaries offer a different horror: the horizontal grinding of crustal blocks. Unlike the birth of new land or the recycling of old, these margins witness plates sliding past one another in a fitful, jerky motion. The San Andreas Fault in California stands as the preeminent example of this geological friction. For decades, the plates remain locked by immense pressure, storing energy until the breaking point is reached. The resulting release is a catastrophic earthquake, a sudden shifting of the earth that can displace entire landscapes by several meters in a matter of seconds. These faults do not create mountains or oceans; they merely scar the surface and wait to unleash their stored fury upon the unsuspecting inhabitants above.
SPECIAL DISPATCH: THE MANTLE FLOW
The heat engine of the Earth operates at depths unreachable by any drill. It is a slow, viscous churning—hot plumes rise at the ridges while cold slabs are dragged into the depths at the trenches. The scales of time involved dwarf the history of empires.

text_4:
内容: The terrestrial sphere is not a solid monument of stillness but a fractured assembly of seven gargantuan plates. Driven by the unrelenting heat of the mantle, these lithospheric fragments drift upon the asthenosphere like rafts upon a boiling sea. Scientists now conclude that the mechanism of this motion is mantle convection—a process where heated rock ascends, cools, and descends in a perpetual cycle of tectonic violence. This movement dictates the very geography of our civilization, tearing continents asunder and raising mountains to the heavens. The crust we inhabit is but a thin veil over a furnace of geological activity that has operated for eons before man and will continue long after his works have crumbled into the dust of the ages.
语言: 英文
位置: 左列正文
字体/排版: 小号、衬线字体、两端对齐、首字母下沉

语言: 英文
位置: 中列顶部
字体/排版: 中等大小、粗体、衬线字体、左对齐
作用: 文章标题

text_6:
内容: Divergent boundaries represent the terrestrial laboratory of creation. Along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, the earth splits wide, allowing basaltic magma to surge forth and solidify into new seafloor. This expansion proceeds at a rate of roughly 2.5 centimeters per annum, a slow but inexorable widening of the Atlantic basin that separates the Old World from the New. Conversely, convergent boundaries are sites of destruction. Where oceanic crust meets continental mass, it is forced downward into the crushing heat of the subduction zone. This collision births the volcanic arcs of the Andes and the deep trenches of the Pacific. Where two continents collide, as seen in the Himalayas, the crust buckles and folds, thrusting the earth upward at a rate of 5 millimeters every year.
语言: 英文
位置: 中列正文
字体/排版: 小号、衬线字体、两端对齐、首字母下沉
作用: 正文

语言: 英文
位置: 右列顶部
字体/排版: 中等大小、粗体、衬线字体、左对齐
作用: 文章标题

text_8:
内容: Transform boundaries offer a different horror: the horizontal grinding of crustal blocks. Unlike the birth of new land or the recycling of old, these margins witness plates sliding past one another in a fitful, jerky motion. The San Andreas Fault in California stands as the preeminent example of this geological friction. For decades, the plates remain locked by immense pressure, storing energy until the breaking point is reached. The resulting release is a catastrophic earthquake, a sudden shifting of the earth that can displace entire landscapes by several meters in a matter of seconds. These faults do not create mountains or oceans; they merely scar the surface and wait to unleash their stored fury upon the unsuspecting inhabitants above.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于半导体制造核心工艺控制的信息图表。图表以深蓝色为背景，大部分文字为白色，部分关键信息如“准点”、“就绪”和底部的安全指令则以黄色或黄色背景突出显示。顶部居中是主标题“半导体制造核心工艺控制表 / SEMICO FABRICATION”，右上方标有“控制器: CLASS 1 级别 洁净室”。图表左侧上方是一个工艺流程航线示意图，展示了从“SI-101 单晶”到“PK-108 封装”的八个主要步骤。其下方是一个大型表格，详细列出了这八个工艺的代号、核心环节、标准工时、工艺控制指标、主导厂商和状态。图表右侧上方是一个“EUV 光刻线路控制系统 (13.5nm)”的示意图，标有“真空运行腔”、“光源”、“反射式对准光路”和“3nm 晶圆”。右侧下方是“摩尔定律工艺演进里程碑”表格，列出了不同工艺代号、物理节点和达产年份。底部横幅是重要的安全指令。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about semiconductor manufacturing core process control. The chart has a dark blue background, with most text in white, while some key information like "准点" (On Time), "就绪" (Ready), and the safety instructions at the bottom are highlighted in yellow or with a yellow background. At the top center is the main title "半导体制造核心工艺控制表 / SEMICO FABRICATION", and the top right indicates "控制器: CLASS 1 级别 洁净室" (Controller: CLASS 1 Level Cleanroom). The upper left of the chart features a process routing flowmap, illustrating eight main steps from "SI-101 单晶" (SI-101 Single Crystal) to "PK-108 封装" (PK-108 Packaging). Below it is a large table detailing the code, core stage, standard working hours, process control indicators, leading manufacturers, and status for each of these eight processes. The upper right of the chart shows a diagram of the "EUV 光刻线路控制系统 (13.5nm)" (EUV Lithography Line Control System (13.5nm)), labeled with "真空运行腔" (Vacuum Chamber), "光源" (Light Source), "反射式对准光路" (Reflective Alignment Optical Path), and "3nm 晶圆" (3nm Wafer). The lower right contains a "摩尔定律工艺演进里程碑" (Moore's Law Process Evolution Milestones) table, listing different process codes, physical nodes, and production years. A prominent safety instruction banner is at the very bottom.

prompt_cn: 这张电影海报以恐怖题材为主题。画面中央是一位面色苍白、双眼泛红、嘴巴张开的女性，她的手腕被粗重的铁链束缚，脸上带有血迹和裂纹，身穿红色上衣。背景是昏暗阴森的石墙空间，暗示着地牢或密室。女性角色左右两侧和后方还有其他被铁链束缚或表情痛苦的人物。海报顶部中央是中文标题“缚灵”，采用艺术字体，白色字迹带有红色血迹效果和黑色描边。其下方偏右是英文副标题“BINDING DESTINY”。海报右侧垂直排列着三个金色的月桂叶奖项图案，每个图案下方都列出了具体的奖项信息，包括“OFFICIAL SELECTION”和电影节名称。海报底部是多行排列的演职员表，文字为白色，详细列出了出品人、导演、编剧、制片人、主演等信息，以及出品单位和合作伙伴。整体色调以深蓝色和灰色为主，红色和白色作为对比色突出。
prompt_en: This movie poster features a horror theme. At the center is a pale-faced woman with red eyes and an open mouth, her wrists bound by heavy chains, and her face marked with bloodstains and cracks, wearing a red top. The background is a dark, eerie stone-walled space, suggesting a dungeon or secret chamber. Other figures, also bound by chains or showing signs of distress, are visible to the left, right, and behind the central female character. The Chinese main title "缚灵" (Binding Spirit/Soul) is at the top center, rendered in an artistic font with white characters, red bloodstain effects, and black outlines. Below and slightly to the right is the English subtitle "BINDING DESTINY". On the right side of the poster, three golden laurel wreath award emblems are vertically arranged, each listing specific award information including "OFFICIAL SELECTION" and the film festival name. The bottom of the poster contains a multi-line credit list in white text, detailing information such as producers, directors, screenwriters, cinematographers, and main actors, as well as production companies and partners. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark blues and grays, with red and white serving as prominent contrasting colors.

The upper part of the image displays a modern living room scene, predominantly in black, white, and grey tones, featuring a sofa, coffee table, floor lamp, and windows with blurred outdoor scenery. In the top left corner, there is white text "HELLO NEW LIFE". On the right side, a red circular area contains white, tilted text "PARTY". The lower part of the image is a text area with a beige background. At the top, there is a large, dark grey title "乔迁之喜" (Housewarming Joy), decorated with a yellow horizontal line below it. Below the title is the invitation message: "从一个房间到一个空间，改变的是地址，不变的是对生活的热爱。" (From one room to a space, what changes is the address, what remains unchanged is the love for life.). The bottom left features the invitees "诚挚邀请: 林木木 & 苏小北" (Sincerely invite: Lin Mumu & Su Xiaobei) and a closing message "期待与你共同开启这段新旅程" (Looking forward to starting this new journey with you). In the bottom right corner, there is a dark grey rectangular button with white text "RSVP", and below it, dark grey text "扫码确认" (Scan code to confirm).

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的高速铁路系统监控仪表盘界面。界面顶部显示系统识别码、实时同步时间以及一条滚动状态快报。主体内容由一个3x3的面板网格构成，每个面板都有一个带彩色背景的标题。左上角面板展示“核心动力状态”，包括当前运行速度350.00 KM/H、性能提升百分比和牵引电机频率，并配有关于高速铁路系统复杂性的详细描述。右上角面板列出“供电参数”及其具体数值，下方是一个“牵引力/建议值”的折线图。左中面板是“轨道结构示意图”，展示了无砟轨道的组成部分和相关文字说明。右中面板是一个“全球主流高速铁路轨道标准对比”表格，详细列出了不同轨道型号的基准厚度、适用速度、波动趋势（以波浪线图形表示）和状态。左下角面板显示“受电弓几何参数”，包含接触网高度、接触压力和碳滑板信息，并配有受电弓的示意图。中下方面板是“制动能量回收”部分，突出显示85.4%的再生制动效率，并解释了其工作原理。右下角面板则列出了“技术规范”的各项参数。界面底部是系统执行日志和状态信息。
prompt_en: This is a dark-themed dashboard interface for a high-speed rail system. The top of the interface displays a system ID, real-time synchronization time, and a scrolling status news ticker. The main content consists of a 3x3 grid of panels, each with a colored background title. The top-left panel shows 'Core Power Status', including the current operating speed of 350.00 KM/H, performance increase percentage, and traction motor frequency, accompanied by a detailed description of the high-speed rail system's complexity. The top-right panel lists 'Power Supply Parameters' with specific values, and below it is a line graph for 'Traction Force/Recommended Value'. The middle-left panel features a 'Track Structure Diagram', illustrating the components of a ballastless track and related textual explanations. The middle-right panel presents a table for 'Global Mainstream High-Speed Rail Track Standard Comparison', detailing different track models' base thickness, applicable speed, fluctuation trends (represented by wavy line graphics), and status. The bottom-left panel displays 'Pantograph Geometric Parameters', including contact wire height, contact pressure, and carbon slide plate information, along with a pantograph schematic. The bottom-middle panel is the 'Braking Energy Recovery' section, highlighting an 85.4% regenerative braking efficiency and explaining its working principle. The bottom-right panel lists various 'Technical Specifications' parameters. The bottom of the interface shows system execution logs and status messages.

Below the main title is the body text, starting with "尊敬：" (Dear:), detailing the theme and purpose of this business cocktail party. At the bottom of the page is the event agenda, divided into three time slots: "18:30 数字签到" (18:30 Digital Check-in), "19:30 贸易洽谈" (19:30 Trade Negotiation), and "20:30 主题配会" (20:30 Thematic Cocktail Party). The bottom left corner shows "主办单位：全球贸易数字化协作委员会" (Organizer: Global Trade Digital Collaboration Committee) and the website "WWW.DIGITAL-TRADE-LINK.COM". prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一块银色边框的智能手表，它被放置在一个深色、粗糙的表面上。手表的方形屏幕亮着，显示着黑色的背景和多种颜色的信息。屏幕顶部左侧显示日期“7-4 周五”，右侧显示电池电量“46%”。屏幕中央以白色粗体大字显示时间“11:04:11”，下方左侧是农历日期“六月初十”，右侧是“午时”和提醒“午饭勿忘”。屏幕右侧显示天气信息，包括“今天”的温度“31°C”和温度范围“26/32”。屏幕左侧有活动环和数字“420”及“14”。屏幕下方排列着多个彩色小组件图标，分别带有“BPM”、“心率”、“2 小时”、“站立”、“0.35 km”、“距离”、“睡眠”和“支付”等文字标签。手表的右侧有一个红色的圆形表冠。表带是浅灰色编织材质，下方有一个红色的标签，上面印有白色的“HUAWEI”和“VT”品牌及型号字样。
prompt_en: This image displays a smartwatch with a silver-colored bezel, placed on a dark, rough surface. The watch's square screen is illuminated, showing a black background with information in various colors. The top left of the screen shows the date "7-4 周五" (Friday, July 4th), and the top right shows the battery percentage "46%". The center of the screen displays the time "11:04:11" in large, bold white text. Below it, on the left, is the lunar date "六月初十" (sixth month, tenth day), and on the right are "午时" (noon) and the reminder "午饭勿忘" (don't forget lunch). The right side of the screen shows weather information, including "今天" (today's) temperature "31°C" and a temperature range of "26/32". The left side of the screen features activity rings with numbers "420" and "14". At the bottom of the screen, several colorful widget icons are arranged, labeled with text such as "BPM", "心率" (Heart Rate), "2 小时" (2 Hours), "站立" (Stand), "0.35 km", "距离" (Distance), "睡眠" (Sleep), and "支付" (Pay). The watch has a red circular crown on its right side. The strap is made of light gray woven material, with a red tag below it bearing the white brand and model text "HUAWEI" and "VT".

人类视网膜 10 层细胞解剖
CELLULAR ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN RETINA
光感受器层包含约1.2亿个视杆细胞与600万个视锥细胞。视杆细胞负责暗视觉与周边视力，视锥细胞集中于黄斑中心凹，负责明视觉与三原色感知。
双极细胞、水平细胞和无长突细胞在内核层进行复杂的信号预处理。最终由约120万个神经节细胞的轴突汇聚成视神经纤维层，向大脑传送视觉电信号。

01 色素上皮层 RPE
单层上皮细胞，吸收杂散光并提供代谢支持。
02 光感受器层 PL
1.2亿视杆细胞与600万视锥细胞，进行光电转换。
03 外界膜 ELM
由米勒细胞突起形成的屏障，支撑光感受器。
04 外核层 ONL
光感受器细胞体所在处，主要包含其细胞核。
05 外丛状层 OPL
光感受器与双极细胞、水平细胞的突触连接处。
06 内核层 INL
包含双极细胞、水平细胞和无长突细胞的胞体。
07 内丛状层 IPL
双极细胞、无长突细胞与节细胞的突触连接处。
08 神经节细胞层 GCL
约120万个节细胞胞体，输出视网膜最终信号。
09 神经纤维层 NFL
节细胞无髓鞘突汇聚成束，穿出巩膜筛板。
10 内界膜 ILM
视网膜的最内层边界，隔绝视网膜与玻璃体。
黄斑中心凹 / FOVEA
黄斑中心凹仅分布有高密度的视锥细胞（无视杆细胞）。这里是人类视觉最敏锐的区域，负责高分辨率的中心视觉以及明亮环境下的三原色 (RGB) 色彩感知。
视神经乳头 / BLIND SPOT
视神经乳头是视网膜神经纤维汇聚并穿出眼球的通道。由于此处没有任何光感受器细胞（视杆或视锥细胞），因此在视野中形成生理性盲点。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类视网膜细胞解剖的科普信息图。图片以深绿色为背景，顶部有“RETINA”、“RETINAL”、“RETINAE”、“RETINEX”等层叠的英文标题，其中“RETINAL”为灰色，其余为黄色。主标题“人类视网膜 10 层细胞解剖”及其英文副标题“CELLULAR ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN RETINA”位于中央，下方是两段关于视网膜基本功能的中文介绍。图片中部是一个视网膜分层示意图，左侧标有“L01-L10”的层数编号，右侧对应各层的英文缩写（如RPE, PL, ELM等）。示意图下方是一个表格，列出了视杆细胞、视锥细胞、神经节细胞的数量以及黄斑区域直径等参数。表格下方是两列详细的列表，编号01-10，分别解释了视网膜十个分层的名称、英文缩写及其功能。图片底部左右两侧各有一个方框，分别介绍了“黄斑中心凹 / FOVEA”和“视神经乳头 / BLIND SPOT”的特点。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic illustrating the cellular anatomy of the human retina. The image features a dark green background with layered English titles at the top, including "RETINA," "RETINAL," "RETINAE," and "RETINEX," where "RETINAL" is gray and the others are yellow. The main title, "人类视网膜 10 层细胞解剖" (Human Retina 10-Layer Cellular Anatomy), and its English subtitle, "CELLULAR ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN RETINA," are centrally located, followed by two paragraphs in Chinese introducing the basic functions of the retina. The middle section displays a diagram of the retinal layers, with layer numbers "L01-L10" on the left and corresponding English abbreviations (e.g., RPE, PL, ELM) on the right. Below the diagram, a table presents parameters such as the number of rod photoreceptors, cone photoreceptors, ganglion cells, and the macula lutea diameter. Further down, two detailed lists, numbered 01-10, explain the name, English abbreviation, and function of each of the ten retinal layers. At the bottom, two side-by-side boxes describe the characteristics of the "黄斑中心凹 / FOVEA" (Macula Lutea / Fovea) and "视神经乳头 / BLIND SPOT" (Optic Disc / Blind Spot), respectively.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以浅蓝色为背景，点缀白色圆点的活动宣传海报。海报顶部，红色文字“音樂劇社區推廣計劃”位于左侧，黑色文字“音樂劇普及講座及演出示範”位于右侧。下方是红色的“沙沙”和橙色的“返嚟油尖旺啦!”，构成主标题。标题下方列出了活动日期和时间，包括“2025”年，以及“7.10”、“17.10”、“21.11”三个日期，每个日期下方对应有具体时间段。再下方是活动地点“梁顯利油麻地社區中心禮堂”。海报中部描绘了四只卡通风格的猫咪在米白色和深棕色相间的多层建筑物顶部跳跃玩耍，建筑物右侧有一棵枝繁叶茂的绿色大树。海报右侧中部有红色文字“現可於 art-mate 網上平台 報名”，旁边点缀着猫爪图案。左下角是红色的“政府資助 計劃”及其英文“Government-funded programme”标识。底部左侧是“主辦”方“演戲家族”及其英文“ACTORS FAMILY”和“香港原創音樂劇”的文字，右侧是“油尖旺 民政事務處贊助”信息。
prompt_en: This is an event promotion poster with a light blue background adorned with white polka dots. At the top of the poster, the red text "音樂劇社區推廣計劃" is on the left, and the black text "音樂劇普及講座及演出示範" is on the right. Below them, the red "沙沙" and orange "返嚟油尖旺啦!" form the main title. Below the title, the event dates and times are listed, including the year "2025", and three dates "7.10", "17.10", "21.11", each with corresponding time slots below. Further down is the event venue "梁顯利油麻地社區中心禮堂". The middle of the poster depicts four cartoon-style cats jumping and playing on top of a multi-story building with alternating off-white and dark brown sections. To the right of the building is a lush green tree. In the middle right of the poster, there is red text "現可於 art-mate 網上平台 報名", accompanied by cat paw icons. The bottom left features a red "政府資助 計劃" (Government-funded programme) logo and its English translation. The bottom left also shows the organizer "主辦" (Organizer) "演戲家族" (ACTORS FAMILY) and "香港原創音樂劇" (Hong Kong Original Musical) text, while the bottom right displays the sponsor information "油尖旺 民政事務處贊助" (Yau Tsim Mong Home Affairs Department Sponsorship).

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于中国五岳的地理信息图表，整体布局分为三个垂直区域。顶部是主标题“中国五岳地理分诊图”及其英文副标题“FIVE PEAKS OF CHINA: CLINICAL GEOGRAPHIC FLOOR PLAN”，右侧有“FLOOR / 层级 L1 地表宏观”和“ZONE / 区域 东亚构造带”的标签。左侧区域是“科室索引 / DIRECTORY”，列出了泰山、华山、衡山、恒山四个山峰的编号、中英文名称、海拔及地质特征描述，其中编号01和02为红色，03为绿色，04为深蓝色。中间区域是一个流程图，以方框形式展示了五岳（北岳恒山、西岳华山、中岳嵩山、东岳泰山、南岳衡山）及其海拔和岩性信息，并用不同颜色的线条连接，表示“南北构造主通道”、“东西向主通道”和“中枢转换疏散道”，其中“中岳嵩山”上方标有“YOU ARE HERE / 您在此”。右侧上方是一个折线图，标题为“海拔生命体征监护 / ELEVATION VITAL SIGN”，显示了五岳的海拔数据点。右侧下方是一个表格，标题为“核心地质参数 / GEOLOGY SPECS”，详细列出了五岳的“科室/山”、“海拔”和“核心岩性”信息。图表背景为白色，文字主要为深蓝色。
prompt_en: This is a geographic information chart about China's Five Great Mountains, with an overall layout divided into three vertical sections. At the top is the main title "中国五岳地理分诊图" and its English subtitle "FIVE PEAKS OF CHINA: CLINICAL GEOGRAPHIC FLOOR PLAN". To the right, there are labels "FLOOR / 层级 L1 地表宏观" and "ZONE / 区域 东亚构造带". The left section is the "科室索引 / DIRECTORY", listing four mountains (Mount Tai, Mount Hua, Mount Heng South, Mount Heng North) with their numbers, Chinese and English names, elevation, and geological descriptions. Numbers 01 and 02 are red, 03 is green, and 04 is dark blue. The central section is a flowchart, displaying the Five Great Mountains (Mount Heng North, Mount Hua, Mount Song, Mount Tai, Mount Heng South) in boxes, along with their elevations and rock types. Different colored lines connect them, representing "南北构造主通道" (North-South Structural Pathway), "东西向主通道" (East-West Outpatient Route), and "中枢转换疏散道" (Central Transfer Exit Link). Above Mount Song, it is marked "YOU ARE HERE / 您在此". The upper right section features a line chart titled "海拔生命体征监护 / ELEVATION VITAL SIGN", showing the elevation data points for the Five Great Mountains. The lower right section is a table titled "核心地质参数 / GEOLOGY SPECS", detailing the "科室/山" (Department/Mountain), "海拔" (Elevation), and "核心岩性" (Core Lithology) for the Five Great Mountains. The chart has a white background, and the text is primarily dark blue.

一、呼吸与脊柱耦合机制
拜日式 A 通过呼吸控制 (Vinyasa) 精确引导脊 柱的屈伸运动。吸气时, 胸廓收缩下降, 腹压 升高, 胸腔扩张, 促使胸椎向上伸展; 呼气 时, 腹肌收缩, 协助胸廓回弹, 骨盆后倾, 引 导脊柱安全屈曲。此种耦合有助于最大化椎间 盘的营养液代谢, 缓解椎间压力。
二、动力链与肌肉协同
该序列体现了人体从体侧链 (如山式、下犬式) 到开链运动的动态转换。手掌与足底的三点支 撑建立起稳定的地面反作用力通道。力由末梢 向上关节传递, 激活前锯肌与盆底肌的共鸣, 在维持躯干刚性的同时, 保障了四肢末端的运 动幅度与关节安全。
三、神经调控与循环效益
体位的快速转换对驱动脉泵压力感受器产生温 和刺激, 调和植物神经系统。前屈与倒立姿势 增加回心血量, 降低心率, 激活副交感神经; 而后弯体式则适度兴奋交感神经, 提高皮质醇 敏感度。此序列在动态重塑肌肉长度的同时, 显著改善全身血液循环。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于瑜伽拜日式A的运动生物力学与呼吸解剖学图谱页面。页面顶部有页眉“ANATOMICAL PLATE VII”和“呼吸动力学序列”，主标题为“SURYA NAMASKAR A / 拜日式十二式流”，副标题是“经典阿斯汤加(Ashtanga)热身序列之运动生物力学与呼吸解剖学图谱”。页面主体分为上下两部分。上半部分包含两个图表：左侧是“图一: VINYASA 呼吸循环环路”，一个圆形示意图，用红色和蓝色弧线分别表示“吸气 (Inhale) - 脊柱伸展”和“呼气 (Exhale) - 脊柱屈曲”，并标注了“起点/终”和“前屈极限”；右侧是“图二: 下犬式支撑力学结构”，一个三角形力学模型，标示了“脊柱驱动力”、“躯干角 90°”、“手部支撑力”和“足部支撑力”。每个图表下方都配有详细的文字描述。下半部分包含一个表格和三列文本。表格标题为“表一: 拜日式 A 七大核心体式解剖指标”，列出了七个瑜伽体式的序号、名称、呼吸控制、主动肌群和拮抗肌群。表格下方是三段带有标题的解释性文本，分别阐述了“一、呼吸与脊柱耦合机制”、“二、动力链与肌肉协同”和“三、神经调控与循环效益”。页面底部有版权信息、编纂单位和版次。所有文字均为黑色，背景为白色。
prompt_en: This is an anatomical plate page illustrating the biomechanics and respiratory anatomy of the Surya Namaskar A yoga sequence. The page header at the top includes "ANATOMICAL PLATE VII" and "呼吸动力学序列" (Respiratory Dynamics Sequence). The main title reads "SURYA NAMASKAR A / 拜日式十二式流" (Sun Salutation Twelve-Pose Flow), followed by the subtitle "经典阿斯汤加(Ashtanga)热身序列之运动生物力学与呼吸解剖学图谱" (Classic Ashtanga Warm-up Sequence Biomechanics and Respiratory Anatomy Atlas). The main content of the page is divided into two sections. The upper section features two diagrams: on the left, "图一: VINYASA 呼吸循环环路" (Figure 1: VINYASA Breathing Cycle Loop) is a circular diagram using red and blue arcs to represent "吸气 (Inhale) - 脊柱伸展" (Inhale - Spinal Extension) and "呼气 (Exhale) - 脊柱屈曲" (Exhale - Spinal Flexion), with labels "起点/终" (Start/End) and "前屈极限" (Forward Bend Limit); on the right, "图二: 下犬式支撑力学结构" (Figure 2: Downward-Facing Dog Support Mechanics Structure) is a triangular mechanical model indicating "脊柱驱动力" (Spinal Driving Force), "躯干角 90°" (Torso Angle 90°), "手部支撑力" (Hand Support Force), and "足部支撑力" (Foot Support Force). Each diagram is accompanied by a detailed textual description below it. The lower section contains a table and three columns of text. The table, titled "表一: 拜日式 A 七大核心体式解剖指标" (Table 1: Surya Namaskar A Seven Core Poses Anatomical Indicators), lists the sequence number, pose name (English/Chinese), breath control, prime movers, and antagonist muscles/stretched areas for seven yoga poses. Below the table are three explanatory text blocks, each with a bold title, discussing "一、呼吸与脊柱耦合机制" (I. Respiration and Spinal Coupling Mechanism), "二、动力链与肌肉协同" (II. Kinetic Chain and Muscle Synergy), and "三、神经调控与循环效益" (III. Neuroregulation and Circulatory Benefits). The page footer includes copyright information, the editorial committee, and the edition. All text is black on a white background.

prompt_en: This is a color photograph showing a group of people protesting in front of a beige building. The building's top is marked with "法務部" and its English equivalent, "MINISTRY OF JUSTICE". In the center of the frame, several protesters are jointly holding a large purple banner. The banner features three white icons (cigarette, globe, trash can) and three lines of Chinese slogans: "上修四氢大麻容许值" (Increase the allowable limit for tetrahydrocannabinol), "比照国际公约管制大麻" (Regulate cannabis in accordance with international conventions), and "将大麻从反毒宣导中移除" (Remove cannabis from anti-drug campaigns). The bottom left of the banner displays "社团法人 台湾大麻合法化 改革协会" (Taiwan Cannabis Legalization Reform Association). A person wearing a white hat holds a red sign, which reads "伴侣盟" (Partners Alliance), "4/18 大麻游行在立法院" (4/18 Cannabis March at the Legislative Yuan), and "GREEN REVOLUTION". On the right side of the frame, a woman is speaking into a microphone. On the far right, a green flag stands, bearing reversed white text: "GREEN TAIWAN 大麻合法化" (GREEN TAIWAN Cannabis Legalization) and the website "www.green.tw". Some protesters are also holding small plant-like objects.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类眼球光学系统与视网膜结构的科学信息图。图片整体布局清晰，分为六个编号区域（01-06），呈两列排布。主要颜色方案为白色背景、深灰色文字，以及蓝色和红色作为图表中的线条和标签的强调色。图片顶部右侧提供了参考ID、比例尺和坐标信息。区域01包含一个表格，详细列出了眼球各组成部分（如角膜、房水、晶状体、玻璃体）的折射率和屈光度。区域02展示了一个人眼可见光谱响应的曲线图，横轴标注了波长范围（380nm至750nm），并标示了“Sensitivity”。区域03包含一个眼球的横截面示意图，清晰标注了角膜、晶状体、玻璃体腔、黄斑中心凹和视网膜等主要部位，其下方还列出了视网膜的神经层级结构（光感受器细胞、双极细胞、神经节细胞）。区域04包含一个表格，对比了视杆细胞（RODS）和视锥细胞（CONES）在数量、亮度感知、色觉、响应速度、分布和分辨率等方面的特性。区域05展示了一个线图，描绘了视杆细胞和视锥细胞密度随离心度（从0°黄斑中心凹到80°）的变化趋势。区域06提供了一个数据摘要，列出了总轴突数量、盲点位置、数据传输速率和折射率变化等关键信息。图片底部有页脚，包含出版物名称、章节、页码、修订版本和版权信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic detailing the human eye's optical system and retinal structure. The image features a clear layout, divided into six numbered sections (01-06) arranged in two columns. The primary color scheme consists of a white background, dark grey text, with blue and red used as accent colors for lines and labels within the charts. The top right of the image provides reference ID, scale, and coordinate information. Section 01 contains a table detailing the refractive indices and powers of various eye components (e.g., cornea, aqueous humor, lens, vitreous humor). Section 02 displays a curve graph illustrating the human eye's visible spectral response, with the x-axis marked with a wavelength range (380nm to 750nm) and labeled "Sensitivity". Section 03 includes a cross-sectional diagram of the eyeball, clearly labeling key parts such as the cornea, lens, vitreous chamber, fovea, and retina; below it, the retinal neural layers (photoreceptors, bipolar cells, ganglion cells) are listed. Section 04 presents a table comparing the characteristics of rods and cones in terms of quantity, light perception, color vision, response speed, distribution, and acuity. Section 05 shows a line graph depicting the density changes of rods and cones with eccentricity (from 0° fovea to 80°). Section 06 provides a data summary, listing key information such as total axons, blind spot location, data rate, and refractive index change. The bottom of the image features a footer with publication name, section, page number, revision version, and copyright information.

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于国际象棋棋子效能与机理的技术文档或手册页面。页面背景为深灰色，内容区域为白色，整体采用黑白灰为主色调，辅以少量红色进行视觉强调。页面主体内容分为三大部分，编号为01、02、03。每部分左侧展示了国际象棋的兵、马、象、车、后、王六种棋子的简化白色剪影图，右侧为对应的放大视图或说明，其中包含棋子移动轨迹的虚线箭头，如马的L型轨迹。“象的无限斜线”标题文字为红色，以示强调。页面底部包含一个详细的表格，列出了棋子的名称、参考价值、移动规则特性、特殊机械规程和机动性评级，表格标题行文字为粗体，内容行文字为常规字体。页脚部分包含页码、版权信息和表格编号等内容。
prompt_en: This is a technical document or manual page detailing the effectiveness and mechanics of chess pieces. The page features a dark gray background with a white content area, primarily using a black, white, and gray color scheme, accented with a small amount of red for visual emphasis. The main content is divided into three sections, numbered 01, 02, and 03. Each section's left side displays simplified white silhouette diagrams of six chess pieces: Pawn, Knight, Bishop, Rook, Queen, and King. The right side provides corresponding magnified views or explanations, including dashed arrows illustrating piece movement trajectories, such as the Knight's L-shaped path. The title "象的无限斜线" (Bishop's Infinite Diagonals) is in red for emphasis. At the bottom of the page is a detailed table listing the piece names, reference values, movement rules, special mechanical procedures, and maneuverability ratings. The table's header row text is bold, while the content rows use regular font. The footer includes page numbers, copyright information, and table numbering.

prompt_cn: 这是一张宣传海报，用于推广一场名为“POETIC DANCE THE JOURNEY OF A LEGENDARY LANDSCAPE PAINTING”的舞蹈表演。海报主体是七位身着传统中国风格服装的舞者，她们的服饰以浅绿色和深蓝色为主，头戴黑色发髻。舞者们姿态各异，仿佛在水面上翩翩起舞，下方清晰地映照出她们的倒影。背景是抽象的浅蓝色水墨画风格笔触，营造出山水意境。海报左上方是橙色和青绿色的主标题和副标题，字体醒目。图片中下部是白色粗体字“PERFORMED BY: CHINA ORIENTAL SONG AND DANCE TROUPE”。海报底部以白色小字列出了详细的制作人员名单、赞助商和合作伙伴信息，采用多栏布局，信息量较大。整体色调以浅蓝色、绿色、白色和橙色为主，画面构图简洁而富有诗意。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a dance performance titled "POETIC DANCE THE JOURNEY OF A LEGENDARY LANDSCAPE PAINTING". The main subject of the poster is seven dancers dressed in traditional Chinese-style costumes, primarily in light green and dark blue, with black hair buns. The dancers are in various poses, appearing to dance on water, with their clear reflections visible below. The background features abstract light blue ink wash painting-style brushstrokes, creating a landscape ambiance. The main title and subtitle, in orange and teal, are prominently displayed in the upper left. In the lower middle of the image, "PERFORMED BY: CHINA ORIENTAL SONG AND DANCE TROUPE" is shown in bold white text. The bottom of the poster lists detailed production staff, sponsors, and partners in small white text, arranged in a multi-column layout, indicating a large amount of information. The overall color scheme is dominated by light blue, green, white, and orange, presenting a simple yet poetic composition.
