prompt_cn: 这是一张用于庆祝婴儿百日的电子邀请函。邀请函整体采用浅色渐变背景，顶部中央是中文标题“百日之喜”，下方配有英文副标题“THE 100 DAYS CELEBRATION”。邀请函上半部分展示了一张浅色调的婴儿房照片，其中包含婴儿床、摇椅、落地灯和储物柜等家具。照片下方是邀请函的正文部分，以“见证成长的喜悦”为主题，两侧装饰有粉色和蓝色圆点，接着是关于初见惊喜和百日温情的文字，以及诚邀宾客参加百日礼的说明。邀请函下半部分分为左右两栏，左栏列出了日期“2024.10.20”和时间“12:00 PM (午宴)”，右栏则提供了地点“悦榕庄酒店·宴会厅”和地址“上海市黄浦区中山东一路”。底部左侧是“谨启 / Best Regards”和邀请人姓名“陈先生 & 林女士”，右侧是“RSVP”及“请于10月10日前确认”的提示。底部中央偏右处有一个粉色圆形图案，内含英文“LOVE”字样。
prompt_en: This is an electronic invitation card for a baby's 100-day celebration. The invitation features a light gradient background. At the top center is the Chinese title "百日之喜", followed by the English subtitle "THE 100 DAYS CELEBRATION". The upper half of the invitation displays a light-toned photograph of a baby room, furnished with a crib, rocking chair, floor lamp, and storage cabinet. Below the photo is the main text section of the invitation, themed "见证成长的喜悦" (Witnessing the Joy of Growth), flanked by pink and blue dots. This is followed by text about the surprise of the first meeting and the warmth of the hundred days, along with an invitation to guests for the 100-day ceremony. The lower half of the invitation is divided into two columns: the left column lists the date "2024.10.20" and time "12:00 PM (午宴)", while the right column provides the venue "悦榕庄酒店·宴会厅" (Banyan Tree Hotel · Ballroom) and address "上海市黄浦区中山东一路" (Zhongshan East 1st Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai). At the bottom left are "谨启 / Best Regards" and the hosts' names "陈先生 & 林女士" (Mr. Chen & Ms. Lin). On the right side, "RSVP" is displayed with the instruction "请于10月10日前确认" (Please confirm before October 10). A pink circular pattern containing the English word "LOVE" is located towards the bottom center-right.

The main content area begins with a lecturer information card, featuring a circular avatar of the lecturer in the center, with a blue star icon overlaid on the bottom right of the avatar. Below the avatar is the lecturer's name "张慕白", followed by their title "资深全栈架构师/数字化转型专家" (Senior Full-stack Architect/Digital Transformation Expert). The bottom of the card shows three sets of statistics arranged horizontally: "12 在线课程" (12 Online Courses) on the left, "8.5w+ 累计学员" (8.5w+ Cumulative Students) in the middle, and "4.9 综合评分" (4.9 Overall Rating) on the right. Below the lecturer information card is the content area, divided into two sections: "关于讲师" (About Lecturer) and "主讲课程" (Main Courses). Each section title has a blue vertical line decoration on its left. The "关于讲师" section provides a textual introduction. The "主讲课程" section lists three courses, each including a thumbnail image, course title, the current price displayed in orange, and the original price with a strikethrough. At the bottom of the page is a fixed action bar with two buttons: "关注讲师" (Follow Lecturer) with a light blue background on the left, and "立即咨询" (Consult Now) with a dark blue background on the right.

prompt_en: The image displays a dark-themed operations monitoring dashboard interface. The top section shows the system name "CORE-OS", region information "REGION: ASIA-EAST-PRODUCTION-01", system time "14:20:45 UTC+8", and system health status "SYSTEM HEALTHY" with "Uptime: 1,240h". The bottom section displays "SECURE_CHANNEL: ENCRYPTED", "OPERATOR: ADMIN_01", and "SYSTEM_READY" statuses. The main content of the dashboard is divided into three columns. The left column includes a "资源占用率" (Resource Utilization) panel, showing percentage usage for CPU, Memory, and Storage (78.4%, 62.1%, 44.9%), as well as "ACTIVE PODS" and "SERVICES" panels, displaying values 1,428 and 312 respectively. The middle column features a "全球流量分发拓扑" (Global Traffic Distribution Topology) panel, with a background image of a computer screen showing the time "16:45" and date "Mittwoch, 20. Februar", along with "IN: 1.2 GB/s" and "OUT: 840 MB/s" traffic data. Below this, "LATENCY: 24ms avg" and "ERROR RATE: 0.02%" metrics are shown. The right column contains a "实时告警队列" (Real-time Alert Queue) panel, listing alerts of "CRITICAL", "WARNING", and "INFO" levels with their timestamps, such as "Node-04 内存溢出风险" (Node-04 Memory Overflow Risk). The bottom right features a panel displaying the version number "DEPLOY v2.4.0" and a "ROLLBACK" button. The interface primarily uses a dark background, with most text in white, complemented by blue, green, red, orange, and yellow to highlight key information and statuses.

In the top left corner is the release date "8月3日 正式上映" (August 3rd Officially Released). The top right displays cast and crew information, including "导演/张可" (Director/Zhang Ke), "监制/ 李小画" (Producer/Li Xiaohua), and "领衔主演/张小可 李画" (Lead Actors/Zhang Xiaoke Li Hua), all in white vertical text. In the center left, the large white character "年" (Year) is positioned above the light brown English phrase "TIME GOES BY", which is then above another large white character "华" (Splendor), together forming the title. The lower right half of the image features a vintage alarm clock with Roman numerals and minute markers, its hands pointing to approximately 10:10. A QR code with a fingerprint icon is in the bottom right corner. The bottom left contains two lines of quotes: the Chinese "既然未来无法回答,不如先抓住似水年华。" (Since the future cannot answer, it's better to seize the fleeting years.) followed by its English translation "If the future cannot give you the answer, keep the present.". The poster emphasizes the theme of time's passage through both the clock and the text.

All focal lengths are standardized to 35mm full-frame format (36mm x 24mm). Crop factors must be applied for APS-C (1.5x) or Micro Four Thirds (2.0x) systems to determine equivalent FOV.
CALCULATED FOV
Horizontal FOV = 2 * arctan(h / (2 * f)), where h is sensor width and f is focal length. Diagonal measurements are significantly wider but less critical for composition.

LIGHT PHYSICS: THE F-STOP
The aperture scale follows an inverse-square law. Each full “stop” represents a doubling or halving of the light reaching the sensor surface.
Sequence: f/1.4 > f/2 > f/2.8 > f/4 > f/5.6 > f/8 > f/11 > f/16 > f/22.
A lens at f/1.4 transmits 200% the light volume of a lens at f/2.0. This ratio is critical for high-shutter speed industrial and athletic capture.
PERSPECTIVE COMPRESSION
Distortion is a function of subject distance, not glass geometry. Wide lenses require proximity, causing near-field expansion. Long lenses require distance, causing far-field compression.
In technical drafting, this is visualized as the convergence rate of parallel lines towards the frame's anchor points. Standard 50mm lenses maintain the most linear structural integrity.
ENGINEERING WARNING
All measurements assume rectilinear projection. Fisheye lenses utilize curvilinear mapping, providing up to 180° FOV through intentional barrel distortion, which violates the standard FOV calculation matrix. For precision architectural documentation, only zero-D (aspherical corrected) optics should be employed to ensure line straightness across the image plane. Reflection and refraction indices vary by glass element coating (multi-coating / nano-crystal).

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于相机焦距和视场角（FOV）的技术信息图表。图片背景为深蓝色，带有细微的网格图案。顶部有浅蓝色的页眉“OPTICAL SPECIFICATION // ATLAS SECTION 8.42”，下方是白色的主标题“CAMERA FOCAL LENGTHS & FIELD OF VIEW (FOV)”。图表内容分为多个区域，标题以红色、绿色或蓝色背景条突出显示。顶部区域标题为“SENSOR BASIS”，包含一个名为“FIG 01: RADIAL FIELD OF VIEW PROJECTION”的示意图，以及关于焦距标准化、裁剪系数和水平视场角计算公式的文字说明。中部区域标题为“DATA MATRIX: FOCAL RANGE CATEGORIZATION”，包含一个表格，列出了不同焦距范围（如超广角、广角、标准、短远摄、远摄）的类别、焦距范围、对角线视场角（部分数值以红色显示）及其机械特性描述。左下角区域标题为“LIGHT PHYSICS: THE F-STOP”，解释了光圈刻度、反平方定律、光线增减与F值序列（f/1.4到f/22）的关系。右下角区域标题为“PERSPECTIVE COMPRESSION”，阐述了畸变与主体距离的关系，以及广角镜头和长焦镜头造成的近场扩张和远场压缩现象。底部区域标题为“ENGINEERING WARNING”，提供了关于直线投影、鱼眼镜头、桶形畸变以及建筑文档中光学选择的工程警告。图片右侧有一个垂直排布的浅蓝色侧边栏，文字内容为“DESIGN BUREAU VKHUTEMAS // 1924 REV”。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic or diagram about camera focal lengths and field of view (FOV). The image features a dark blue background with a subtle grid pattern. At the top, there is a light blue header "OPTICAL SPECIFICATION // ATLAS SECTION 8.42", followed by the main white title "CAMERA FOCAL LENGTHS & FIELD OF VIEW (FOV)". The content of the diagram is divided into several sections, with titles highlighted by red, green, or blue background bars. The top section, titled "SENSOR BASIS", includes a diagram labeled "FIG 01: RADIAL FIELD OF VIEW PROJECTION" and textual explanations regarding focal length standardization, crop factors, and a formula for calculating Horizontal FOV. The middle section, titled "DATA MATRIX: FOCAL RANGE CATEGORIZATION", presents a table. It categorizes different focal ranges (such as Ultra-Wide, Wide-Angle, Standard, Short Tele, Telephoto) with their respective focal ranges, diagonal FOV values (some displayed in red), and mechanical characteristic descriptions. The bottom-left section, titled "LIGHT PHYSICS: THE F-STOP", explains the aperture scale, inverse-square law, the doubling or halving of light, and a sequence of f-stops (from f/1.4 to f/22). The bottom-right section, titled "PERSPECTIVE COMPRESSION", discusses the relationship between distortion and subject distance, as well as near-field expansion and far-field compression caused by wide and long lenses. The bottommost section, titled "ENGINEERING WARNING", provides engineering warnings concerning rectilinear projection, fisheye lenses, barrel distortion, and optical choices for architectural documentation. On the right side of the image, there is a vertically arranged light blue sidebar with the text "DESIGN BUREAU VKHUTEMAS // 1924 REV".

国立包豪斯学院核心准则
魏玛与德绍校区设计标准化指令集
第一部分: 形式追随功能
设计必须从基本的实用需求出发。任何装饰如果不具备功能性，即被视为对工业生产力的亵渎。机器时代的美学应建立在几何纯粹性与材料诚实性的基础之上。所有构件应暴露其生产逻辑，而非通过掩饰来伪造手工感。

瓦西里·康定斯基提出形状与色彩存在内在的情感共鸣。这种关联是普世的心理反射，构成了设计语言的基础语法。下表定义了包豪斯视觉传达的基石。

prompt_en: This is an infographic document detailing the core principles of the National Bauhaus College. The page features a two-column layout. At the top center is a red star-shaped emblem, below which are the title "国立包豪斯学院核心准则" (National Bauhaus College Core Principles) and the subtitle "魏玛与德绍校区设计标准化指令集" (Weimar and Dessau Campus Design Standardization Directives). The top right corner displays the document number "ФОРМА NO. 1919-DE-1933". The content is divided into four sections: the left column contains "第一部分: 形式追随功能" (Part One: Form Follows Function) and "第二部分: 艺术与技术统一" (Part Two: Unity of Art and Technology); the right column contains "第三部分: 康定斯基形状理论" (Part Three: Kandinsky's Theory of Shapes) and "第四部分: 现代排版规范" (Part Four: Modern Typography Standards). Below "Part One" in the left column is a diagram illustrating industrial modular space stress structures, accompanied by a caption. Below "Part Two" in the left column is a four-column table listing workshop categories, core materials, technical standards, and guiding principles. Below "Part Three" in the right column is a diagram showing the emotional correlation between shapes and colors, featuring a blue circle, a yellow triangle, and a red square, labeled with concepts like "蓝色-无限" (Blue-Infinity), "黄色-尖锐" (Yellow-Sharpness), and "红色-稳定" (Red-Stability). Below "Part Four" in the right column are four typography directives. The bottom left of the page shows "学院院长签字: 沃尔特·格罗皮乌斯" (Signed by College Director: Walter Gropius), and the bottom right shows "日期: 1933年4月12日" (Date: April 12, 1933). A circular emblem at the bottom center contains the text "国立包豪斯学院" (National Bauhaus College) and the date range "1919-1933". All text is black against a light-colored background.

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个深色背景的移动应用界面，用于车辆智能诊断。界面顶部是标题栏，左侧有一个绿色圆点图标，并显示应用名称“OBD-II 智能诊断系统”和版本号“V4.2.0-STABLE”。下方是一个车辆信息卡片，其中包含一辆汽车的线框图、车型名称“2024 智己 LS6 Max”、VIN码“LS6-A928-KO12-2024”，以及里程“12,480 KM”和电池电量“98%”的标签。接着是一个车辆健康分数卡片，显示分数“68”，周围环绕着红色的圆形进度条，下方文字提示“发现严重故障”。再下方是三个故障/状态列表项，每个项都包含一个标题、描述和一个右侧的按钮。第一个列表项标题为“PO171 - 系统混合气过稀”，描述为“传感器 1 检测到燃油修正值异常”，右侧是红色背景的“严重”按钮。第二个列表项标题为“C0040 - 右前轮速传感器”，描述为“检测到信号电路开路或电压过低”，右侧是橙色背景的“警告”按钮。第三个列表项标题为“B1202 - 辅助约束系统”，描述为“安全气囊控制模块通信正常”，右侧是蓝色背景的“正常”按钮。界面的底部是两个横向排列的圆角矩形按钮，左侧是带有扳手图标的深灰色“清除故障码”按钮，右侧是带有显示“July 17”的日历图标的蓝色“预约维修”按钮。
prompt_en: This image displays a mobile application interface with a dark background, used for intelligent vehicle diagnostics. At the top of the interface is a title bar, featuring a green dot icon on the left, the application name "OBD-II 智能诊断系统" (OBD-II Smart Diagnostic System), and the version number "V4.2.0-STABLE". Below this is a vehicle information card, which includes a wireframe illustration of a car, the model name "2024 智己 LS6 Max", the VIN "LS6-A928-KO12-2024", and labels for mileage "12,480 KM" and battery level "98%". Next, there is a vehicle health score card showing a score of "68", encircled by a red circular progress bar, with the text "发现严重故障" (Serious Fault Detected) below it. Further down are three fault/status list items, each containing a title, a description, and a button on the right. The first list item's title is "PO171 - 系统混合气过稀" (System Too Lean), with the description "传感器 1 检测到燃油修正值异常" (Sensor 1 detected abnormal fuel trim), and a red-background "严重" (Severe) button on the right. The second list item's title is "C0040 - 右前轮速传感器" (Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor), with the description "检测到信号电路开路或电压过低" (Detected open circuit or low voltage in signal circuit), and an orange-background "警告" (Warning) button on the right. The third list item's title is "B1202 - 辅助约束系统" (Supplemental Restraint System), with the description "安全气囊控制模块通信正常" (Airbag control module communication normal), and a blue-background "正常" (Normal) button on the right. At the bottom of the interface are two horizontally arranged rounded rectangular buttons: a dark gray "清除故障码" (Clear Fault Codes) button with a wrench icon on the left, and a blue "预约维修" (Schedule Maintenance) button with a calendar icon displaying "July 17" on the right.

Beneath the title is a black subtitle, "拼筑精彩·开启无限可能" (Build Brilliance · Unlock Infinite Possibilities), followed by a left-aligned Chinese blessing message. In the bottom right corner of the card, there is an orange rectangular button with the white text "OK". prompt_cn: 这是一张音乐会宣传海报。海报中央是主要视觉元素，描绘了多种具有中国传统绘画风格的动物，包括一只大型凤凰、一只鹰、一只蝴蝶、一只仙鹤、一对鸳鸯、一只孔雀、一条锦鲤、一只燕子和一只戴胜鸟。这些动物色彩鲜艳，细节丰富。背景是分层的山水画风格，有绿色的山峦和蓝色的水波，形成一个圆形构图。画面中有一个明亮的黄色圆形图案。整体色调以绿色、红色、橙色、蓝色和黄色为主，色彩饱和度高。文字信息分布在海报的顶部、左侧、右侧和底部。顶部有“北京音乐厅”和“北京听音乐”。左侧竖排文字为“国乐 二零二四年 初心”。右侧主要信息包括“动物总动员 Animals United”、“家庭亲子音乐会 Family Concert”、“中国歌剧舞剧院民族乐团管乐声部专场 Woodwind Ensemble of China National Opera & Dance Drama Theatre Chinese Orchestra”，以及日期“2024/03/31”、时间“10:00”和地点“北京音乐厅”。海报底部有北京音乐厅和中国歌剧舞剧院的标志，以及“演出票价: 199/149/99 元”和“购票热线: 010-66513145”等票务信息。

The central visual element of the poster depicts various animals in a Chinese traditional painting style, including a large phoenix, an eagle, a butterfly, a crane, a pair of mandarin ducks, a peacock, a koi fish, a swallow, and a hoopoe. These animals are brightly colored and richly detailed. The background features a layered landscape painting style with green mountains and blue waves, forming a circular composition. A bright yellow circular pattern is visible in the image. The overall color scheme is dominated by green, red, orange, blue, and yellow, with high color saturation. Text information is distributed across the top, left, right, and bottom of the poster. At the top are "北京音乐厅 (Beijing Concert Hall)" and "北京听音乐 (Beijing Listen to Music)". Vertical text on the left reads "国乐 (National Music) 二零二四年 (2024) 初心 (Original Aspiration)". The main information on the right includes "动物总动员 Animals United", "家庭亲子音乐会 Family Concert", "中国歌剧舞剧院民族乐团管乐声部专场 Woodwind Ensemble of China National Opera & Dance Drama Theatre Chinese Orchestra", along with the date "2024/03/31", time "10:00", and location "北京音乐厅 (Beijing Concert Hall)". The bottom of the poster features logos for Beijing Concert Hall and China National Opera & Dance Drama Theatre, as well as ticketing information such as "演出票价: 199/149/99 元 (Ticket Price: 199/149/99 Yuan)" and "购票热线: 010-66513145 (Ticketing Hotline: 010-66513145)".

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个深色主题的软件仪表盘界面，用于任务调度管理。界面顶部是标题栏，左侧显示“Matrix 任务调度中心”及其版本“DISTRIBUTED TASK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM V4.2.0”，右侧有当前日期时间“2023-10-27 14:30:05”、系统状态“SYSTEM OPERATIONAL”、“节点: 12”以及一个“+ 新建”按钮。界面主体分为三列：左侧是“运行统计”面板，显示“正在执行任务”数量1,284（↑ 12%）、“今日失败预警”数量03（稳定）和“系统负载”82.4%（带进度条）。中间是“活动任务列表”面板，顶部有“筛选”和“排序”按钮，下方列出三个任务：第一个任务“DataSync_Global_User_Profile”状态为“RUNNING”并显示88.5%进度；第二个任务“Report_Gen_Monthly_Financial”状态为“PENDING”并显示“Q: 02”；第三个任务“Cache_Purge_Edge_Nodes”状态为“FAILED”并显示“Retry: 3”。右侧是“系统实时日志”面板，显示多条日志信息，如“14:29 [INFO] TASK-99281 启动成功”和红色的错误信息“14:27 [ERR] TASK-99301 连接超时”，底部有“Real-time monitoring...”字样。整体界面采用深色背景，文字以白色、浅灰色为主，重要状态和信息通过绿色、蓝色和红色进行区分。
prompt_en: This image displays a dark-themed software dashboard interface for task scheduling management. The top bar shows the title "Matrix 任务调度中心" and its version "DISTRIBUTED TASK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM V4.2.0" on the left. On the right, it presents the current date and time "2023-10-27 14:30:05", system status "SYSTEM OPERATIONAL", "节点: 12" information, and a "+ 新建" (New) button. The main interface is divided into three columns: The left panel is "运行统计" (Operation Statistics), showing "正在执行任务" (Tasks in Progress) count 1,284 (↑ 12%), "今日失败预警" (Today's Failure Alerts) count 03 (稳定/Stable), and "系统负载" (System Load) at 82.4% with a progress bar. The middle panel is "活动任务列表" (Active Task List), with "筛选" (Filter) and "排序" (Sort) buttons at the top. It lists three tasks: the first task "DataSync_Global_User_Profile" is "RUNNING" with 88.5% progress; the second task "Report_Gen_Monthly_Financial" is "PENDING" with "Q: 02"; the third task "Cache_Purge_Edge_Nodes" is "FAILED" with "Retry: 3". The right panel is "系统实时日志" (System Real-time Log), displaying multiple log entries such as "14:29 [INFO] TASK-99281 启动成功" (started successfully) and a red error message "14:27 [ERR] TASK-99301 连接超时" (connection timeout). "Real-time monitoring..." is visible at the bottom. The overall interface uses a dark background, with text primarily in white and light gray, and important statuses and information highlighted in green, blue, and red.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张以米色为背景的商务酒会邀请函，四周环绕着金色边框。邀请函顶部有“ESTABLISHED 2004”字样，下方是醒目的深棕色数字“20”，其下方金色矩形内嵌有白色文字“周年庆典”。主体部分居中显示“盛德律师事务所”的名称，以及金色艺术字体书写的“商务酒会邀请函”。正文部分阐述了邀请目的，提及“见证二十载律政荣光”和“共话行业未来”。邀请函中部采用两栏布局，左侧列出“时间 / TIME”和“着装 / DRESS CODE”及其具体信息，包括日期“2024年12月28日”和时间“18:30 - 21:30”。右侧列出“地点 / VENUE”和“流程 / AGENDA”及其详细内容，如“半岛酒店·顶层宴会厅”和“致辞·颁奖·晚宴”。左下角是“RSVP”信息，包括确认出席日期和联系方式。右下角有一张黑白小图，描绘了一只海豹，其左侧金色竖条上垂直写有“盛德律所 周年志庆”，下方则有“盛德律师事务所董事会”和“二零二四年十月”的署名和日期。
prompt_en: This image is a business reception invitation card set against a beige background with a golden border. At the top, it features "ESTABLISHED 2004", followed by a prominent dark brown "20", and then "周年庆典" (Anniversary Celebration) in white text within a golden rectangle. The central part displays the name "盛德律师事务所" (Shengde Law Firm) and "商务酒会邀请函" (Business Reception Invitation) in golden artistic script. The main body text explains the invitation's purpose, mentioning "witnessing two decades of legal glory" and "discussing the future of the industry". The middle section of the invitation is laid out in two columns; the left column lists "时间 / TIME" (Time) and "着装 / DRESS CODE" (Dress Code) with specific details like the date "2024年12月28日" and time "18:30 - 21:30". The right column presents "地点 / VENUE" (Venue) and "流程 / AGENDA" (Agenda) with details such as "半岛酒店·顶层宴会厅" (Peninsula Hotel · Top Floor Ballroom) and "致辞·颁奖·晚宴" (Keynote · Awards · Dinner). The bottom left corner contains "RSVP" information, including the confirmation date and contact details. The bottom right features a small black and white image of a seal, with "盛德律所 周年志庆" (Shengde Law Firm Anniversary Celebration) written vertically on a golden bar to its left, and below it, the signature "盛德律师事务所董事会" (Board of Directors of Shengde Law Firm) and the date "二零二四年十月" (October 2024).

This document details the physical assembly of the millimeter-wave (FR2) RF front-end module and its logical interface with the 5G Core (5GC) Service-Based Architecture (SBA).
Dynamic control and user-plane separation (CUPS) routing is executed via AMF and SMF pathways directly to the user-plane hardware interface.

The top of the image features a dark gray header bar with white text reading "5G NR RF FRONT-END & SBA CORE" and a subtitle "TECHNICAL REPAIR MANUAL • SECTION 12: SUB-ASSEMBLY EXPLOSION & LOGIC FLOW". The top right corner displays gray text "TOPIC SPECIMEN REFERENCE" and its Chinese translation "5G 网络架构: 从终端到核心网". The main content area has a light gray grid background and is organized into three columns. The left column contains three sections: "1.0 MODULE OVERVIEW", "WARNING: RF RADIATION", and "2.0 SBA CORE LOGIC". Each section has a dark gray or red background title bar with white text, followed by relevant English body text or diagrams. The "2.0 SBA CORE LOGIC" section shows a logical interface routing diagram with interconnected boxes labeled "AMF", "SMF", "SBA BUS", "gNodeB", "UPF", "User Plane", and "DN", with the caption "FIG. 2: LOGICAL INTERFACE ROUTING" below. The middle column is the "3.0 EXPLODED ASSEMBLY — RF FRONT-END STACK" section, presenting an exploded view of an RF front-end stack with components numbered 01 to 06, where "MODULE SHIELD" and "RFIC" are labeled. The diagram is captioned "FIG. 1: EXPLODED FRONT-END STACK Y-AXIS". The right column contains two tables: "KEY TO EXPLODED VIEW" and "4.0 OPERATIONAL SPECS", both with dark gray background titles and white text. The first table details the number, part designation, quantity, and material/spec for each component in the exploded view; the row for "Copper Gasket Seal" (number 05) is highlighted with a red background, and its corresponding component in the exploded view is outlined in red. The second table compares operational parameters for FR1 and FR2 bands, including Frequency, BW Max, Latency, Capacity, and Peak Rate.

prompt_cn: 这是一张公益宣传海报，画面主体是两名身穿荧光黄绿色反光背心的交警在漫天风雪中合力推一辆被雪覆盖的黑色汽车。背景是白雪皑皑的街道，远处可见其他被雪掩盖的车辆和建筑物。海报顶部是深蓝色渐变背景，印有英文“POLICE”，下方是白色粗体中文标题“中国人民警察节”，再下方是副标题“没有生而英勇 唯有信念如山”。左侧警员背部和右侧警员胸前均印有“大连交警”字样。海报底部同样是深蓝色渐变背景，左侧有两行金色手写体文字：“迎着风和雪 背影就是最美‘雪警’”。右下角是一个蓝色矩形标志，内有白色垂直文字“堡垒”。整张海报通过图文结合，展现了人民警察在恶劣天气下坚守岗位、服务人民的感人场景，表达了对他们的敬意。
prompt_en: This is a public service poster, featuring two traffic police officers in fluorescent yellow-green reflective vests, working together to push a black car covered in heavy snow amidst a snowstorm. The background shows a snow-covered street with other vehicles and buildings obscured by snow in the distance. The top of the poster has a dark blue gradient background, displaying the English word "POLICE", followed by the white bold Chinese title "中国人民警察节" (China's People's Police Day), and then the subtitle "没有生而英勇 唯有信念如山" (No one is born brave, only faith is like a mountain). The words "大连交警" (Dalian Traffic Police) are printed on the back of the left officer's vest and on the front of the right officer's vest. The bottom of the poster also has a dark blue gradient background, with two lines of golden handwritten text on the left: "迎着风和雪 背影就是最美‘雪警’" (Facing the wind and snow, their backs are the most beautiful 'snow police'). In the bottom right corner, there is a blue rectangular logo with white vertical text "堡垒" (Fortress). The entire poster, through the combination of image and text, portrays the touching scene of people's police adhering to their duties and serving the public in harsh weather, expressing respect for them.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的校友聚会活动海报。海报顶部是白色大字“REUNION”和“CLASS OF 2024”，右侧有蓝色文字“十年一会”，下方是白色副标题“时光不老·我们不散”。海报主体分为三个内容区域：上方是一个横向卡片，展示了绿树成荫的校园小径，配有“PART 01 母校巡礼”及其详细描述。左下方是一个模糊的室内空间图片，配有“主题包间”、“私密社交”和“沉浸体验”等白色文字。右下方是一个白色卡片，顶部有黑色菱形图标，下方是黑色粗体“EXCLUSIVE EVENT”以及“定制化聚会空间”、“重温同窗情谊”等文字。海报底部列出了活动地点“LOCATION”（时光里·艺术中心 3F 翡翠厅）和时间“DATE & TIME”（2024.10.05 14:00 - 21:00），右侧是一个蓝色“立即预约”按钮。最底部是小字页脚“ALUMNI GATHERING // 2024”和“MEMORIES 10TH”。
prompt_en: This is an alumni reunion event poster with a dark background. At the top, the poster features large white text "REUNION" and "CLASS OF 2024", with blue text "十年一会" (Ten-Year Gathering) on the right, and a white subtitle "时光不老·我们不散" (Time never grows old, we never part) below. The main body of the poster is divided into three content areas: the upper part is a horizontal card displaying a tree-lined campus path, accompanied by "PART 01 母校巡礼" (Campus Tour) and its detailed description. The lower-left part shows a blurred indoor space image, with white text such as "主题包间" (Themed Rooms), "私密社交" (Private Social), and "沉浸体验" (Immersive Experience). The lower-right part is a white card with a black diamond icon at the top, followed by bold black text "EXCLUSIVE EVENT" and descriptions like "定制化聚会空间" (Customized Party Space) and "重温同窗情谊" (Rekindle Classmate Friendship). The bottom of the poster lists the event location "LOCATION" (时光里·艺术中心 3F 翡翠厅) and "DATE & TIME" (2024.10.05 14:00 - 21:00), with a blue "立即预约" (Book Now) button on the right. The very bottom features small footer text "ALUMNI GATHERING // 2024" and "MEMORIES 10TH".

CRITICAL OBSERVATION: PIGMENT STABILITY
The extraction of traditional pigments follows a rigorous geological methodology. Minerals such as Cinnabar (朱砂) and Malachite (石绿) are recovered from deep sedimentary layers, where pressure and time have stabilized their crystalline structures. These inorganic compounds provide a permanence that vegetable dyes cannot achieve. Our findings suggest that the use of Orpiment (雌黄) was concentrated in the upper silt regions, likely due to its lower thermal stability compared to the deep-vein Shale Grey (石青) compounds.
The ancient Chinese color system is not merely aesthetic but biological. Every solar term corresponds to a shift in natural illumination and chemical availability. The transition from "Sky Blue" to "Moon White" mirrors the increase in atmospheric humidity and particulate scattering recorded in the geological core samples of the Late Holocene. Colors like 绿沈 (Deep Green) represent a saturation point in plant life that is effectively captured by a mixture of mineral malachite and botanical indigo.

text_36:
内容: The extraction of traditional pigments follows a rigorous geological methodology. Minerals such as Cinnabar (朱砂) and Malachite (石绿) are recovered from deep sedimentary layers, where pressure and time have stabilized their crystalline structures. These inorganic compounds provide a permanence that vegetable dyes cannot achieve. Our findings suggest that the use of Orpiment (雌黄) was concentrated in the upper silt regions, likely due to its lower thermal stability compared to the deep-vein Shale Grey (石青) compounds.
语言: 英文/中文
位置: 左侧内容区正文
字体/排版: 小字号，黑色，无衬线，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_37:
内容: The ancient Chinese color system is not merely aesthetic but biological. Every solar term corresponds to a shift in natural illumination and chemical availability. The transition from "Sky Blue" to "Moon White" mirrors the increase in atmospheric humidity and particulate scattering recorded in the geological core samples of the Late Holocene. Colors like 绿沈 (Deep Green) represent a saturation point in plant life that is effectively captured by a mixture of mineral malachite and botanical indigo.

The bottom-left section is titled "BOTANICAL SURVEY NOTES," with text explaining botanical dyes. The footer includes "PLATE 350 / 24 SOLAR TERMS," "1924 GOBI SURVEY / PALEONTOLOGY LEDGER," and "DOCUMENT REF: 449-CN-COL."

The left phone interface uses a light theme with a white background and mostly black text, while the right phone interface uses a dark theme with a dark blue background and mostly white text. Both screens show identical content layout and textual information, differing only in theme colors and some button colors. At the top of the screens is a status bar showing the time "11:34" and notifications "99+". Below that is the title "Today", followed by four navigation tabs: "SELECTED", "RECOMMEND", "FUTURE", and "BROWSE", with "RECOMMEND" highlighted. Next is a featured content area, including an illustration and an English description: "This massage method is not recommended for anyone who is very ticklish.". Below this is an "APP - Game" application list title, followed by two app entries. Each entry includes a small image, an English description, a date (e.g., "2017-10-23"), like/comment/view counts, and a "Download" button. The download button on the left phone is red, while on the right phone it is orange. At the bottom of the screens is a navigation bar with five icons and text: "Home", "Game", "Apps", "Search", and "Mine", with "Home" highlighted in red.

text:
PLATE CLXVII
GLACIER GEOMORPHOLOGY
An Analysis of Structural Stratification and Morainic Deposition in Alpine Systems
KINGDOM: Geomorphologica
CLADE: Cryospherica
ORDER: Glacialis
FAMILY: Morainidae
GENUS: Glacis
SPECIES: G. perennis
1
Horn ¹
A pyramidal peak formed by the headward erosion
of multiple cirques. Characterized by sharp arêtes
and steep rock walls.
3
2
Equilibrium Line ²
The climatic boundary where annual accumulation
equals ablation. This line fluctuates based on
regional precipitation.
The glacier acts as a kinetic agent of landscape
modification. In the upper Accumulation Zone,
snow-fall exceeds melting, pressurized into Firn
and eventually crystalline ice. The Equilibrium
Line marks the transition to the Ablation Zone,
where melting dominates.
Crevasses ³
Deep fissures resulting from differential flow
velocities. Transverse crevasses form where the
valley floor steepens.
4
Fig. 1 — Longitudinal section of an alpine glacier illustrating mechanical stress zones and resultant landforms.
Terminal Moraine ⁴
A ridge of unsorted glacial drift or till marking the
furthest advance of the ice margin.
Vertical stresses produce Crevasses ³, brittle
fractures in the uppermost fifty meters of the ice
body. Below this depth, the ice deforms
plastically, flowing over the bedrock in a process
of basal sliding.
CLASSIFICATION
PRIMARY LOCATION
CONSTITUENT MATERIAL
Erratics
Large boulders of lithology foreign to their current
location, transported by ice over vast distances.
Lateral Moraine
Parallel to ice flank
Supraglacial debris, scree
Medial Moraine
Center of merged flow
Joined lateral sediments
Terminal Moraine
Glacial snout (maximum)
Unsorted Till, boulders
Ground Moraine
Subglacial floor
Compacted Lodgement Till
Vertical exaggeration 2.5:1
Metric Reference: 5000 Yards / 4.5 Kilometres

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于冰川地貌学的科学文档页面，背景为浅米色。页面顶部居中是页眉“PLATE CLXVII”，主标题“GLACIER GEOMORPHOLOGY”及其副标题“An Analysis of Structural Stratification and Morainic Deposition in Alpine Systems”。左侧有一个分类信息框，列出了冰川的分类学信息。页面中央是一个冰川剖面图，用浅绿色阴影表示冰川的不同区域，并用数字1、2、3、4标注了关键地貌特征。图下方有图例文字。图的左侧和右侧分布着多段解释性文本，左侧文本描述了冰川的动力作用和区域划分，右侧文本则详细解释了“Horn”、“Equilibrium Line”、“Crevasses”、“Terminal Moraine”和“Erratics”等概念，这些概念的标题部分均为粗体。页面下方是一个三列表格，标题分别为“CLASSIFICATION”、“PRIMARY LOCATION”和“CONSTITUENT MATERIAL”，列出了不同冰碛物的分类、位置和组成。页面底部左右两侧分别有关于垂直夸张比例和度量衡参考的页脚信息。所有文字均为深灰色。
prompt_en: This is a scientific document page about glacier geomorphology, set against a light beige background. At the top center of the page are the header "PLATE CLXVII", the main title "GLACIER GEOMORPHOLOGY" and its subtitle "An Analysis of Structural Stratification and Morainic Deposition in Alpine Systems". On the left side, there is a classification information box listing the taxonomic details of glaciers. In the center of the page is a cross-section diagram of a glacier, using light green shading to indicate different glacier zones, with key geomorphological features labeled by numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4. Below the diagram is a figure caption. To the left and right of the diagram are multiple blocks of explanatory text; the text on the left describes the kinetic action and zonal division of glaciers, while the text on the right provides detailed explanations for concepts such as "Horn," "Equilibrium Line," "Crevasses," "Terminal Moraine," and "Erratics," with the titles of these concepts in bold. At the bottom of the page, there is a three-column table with headers "CLASSIFICATION," "PRIMARY LOCATION," and "CONSTITUENT MATERIAL," listing the classification, location, and composition of various moraines. The bottom left and right corners of the page contain footer information regarding vertical exaggeration and metric reference, respectively. All text is dark gray.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黄色为背景的生物信息图表，详细介绍了水熊虫的各项生物学特性。图表顶部左侧是“SPECIES ID / 谱系物门”标签，中央是巨大的标题“水熊虫”，右侧是页码“01”。图表主体分为左右两栏。左栏包含“ANATOMICAL SUMMARY / 解剖学概览”部分，描述了水熊虫的体长、足部、生理系统和口器结构；“CRYPTOBIOSIS / 隐生机制”部分，列出了含水量、代谢率等数据，并解释了其休眠机制；“DATA LOG / 系统日志”部分，显示了REF_ID、LOC和TS等信息；以及“THERMAL TOLERANCE / 温度耐受域 (CELSIUS)”部分，通过彩色条形图和刻度展示了水熊虫的温度耐受范围。右栏上方是“GEOMETRIC SCHEMATIC / 几何解剖图”，展示了水熊虫的简化轮廓，并标注了“头部区域”、“钙质口针”和“足部/爪结构”，旁边有“TYPE: TARDIGRADA”标签。右栏下方是“SURVIVAL MATRIX / 生存矩阵数据”表格，详细列出了水熊虫在不同极端环境（如高压深海、电离辐射、真空环境、极低温、极高温、脱水状态）下的极限数值、持续时间和存活率。图表左下角有“REV.02”、“BIO-DATA”、“SECTOR-7”标签及数据来源说明，右下角是页码“350 / 082”和“NIKO - ANATOMY OF LIFE”水印。
prompt_en: This is a biological infographic with a yellow background, detailing various biological characteristics of tardigrades. At the top left of the chart is the "SPECIES ID / 谱系物门" label, with the large title "水熊虫" (Tardigrade) in the center, and page number "01" on the right. The main body of the chart is divided into two columns. The left column includes the "ANATOMICAL SUMMARY / 解剖学概览" section, describing the tardigrade's body length, legs, physiological systems, and mouth structure; the "CRYPTOBIOSIS / 隐生机制" section, listing data such as water content and metabolic rate, and explaining its dormancy mechanism; the "DATA LOG / 系统日志" section, showing information like REF_ID, LOC, and TS; and the "THERMAL TOLERANCE / 温度耐受域 (CELSIUS)" section, which uses colored bar charts and scales to display the tardigrade's temperature tolerance range. The upper right column features a "GEOMETRIC SCHEMATIC / 几何解剖图", showing a simplified outline of a tardigrade with labels for "头部区域" (Head Region), "钙质口针" (Calcareous Stylets), and "足部/爪结构" (Foot/Claw Structure), alongside a "TYPE: TARDIGRADA" label. The lower right column contains the "SURVIVAL MATRIX / 生存矩阵数据" table, detailing the extreme values, duration, and survival rates of tardigrades in various extreme environments (such as deep-sea high pressure, ionizing radiation, vacuum, extreme low temperature, extreme high temperature, and dehydration). The bottom left of the chart has "REV.02", "BIO-DATA", "SECTOR-7" labels and a data source description, while the bottom right shows page number "350 / 082" and a "NIKO - ANATOMY OF LIFE" watermark.

The very bottom includes footer information with plate number, sector, era, and a data verification statement.

WEEKLY INTELLIGENCER FOR THE EDIFICATION OF THE TEA TRADE
THE TEA SPECTACULAR
OR, THE SIX GREAT EMPIRE LEAVES IN THEIR NATURAL DEGREES OF OXIDATION
NO. 402. VOL. XV.
LONDON, SATURDAY, OCTOBER 13, 1888
PRICE ONE PENNY
THE SIX HISTORICAL DEGREES OF OXIDATION
THE TAXONOMIC SYSTEM OF TWENTY-FOUR CLASSICS
ADULTERATION WARNING!
The green leaf of the Camellia undergoes marvelous alterations when plucked. By application of direct heat, the cellular juices are fixed, retaining their emerald purity. Without heat, the leaf withers and oxidizes, turning dark as copper. BARKER'S TEA CORDIAL”的广告。整体版面设计清晰，信息丰富，文字与图表结合，以科普形式呈现茶叶知识。

The middle column introduces the taxonomic system of tea, including the "CAMELLIA SINENSIS" chart, categorizing tea into Green, Oolong, and Dark teas, and listing representative varieties. The right column contains an "ADULTERATION WARNING!" and a "CONSTITUENT TABLE" that details the oxidation percentage, processing methods, and specimen names for various tea classes. The bottom of the page includes brief descriptions of different tea types and an advertisement for "DR. BARKER'S TEA CORDIAL". The overall layout is clear and information-rich, combining text and charts to present tea knowledge in an educational format.

In the center of the image, a dark blue passport, an orange air ticket, a blue air ticket, and a blue boarding pass are stacked and overlapping. The passport cover features a golden globe icon and the text "PASSPORT". Both air tickets and the boarding pass have airplane icons and are labeled with "AIR TICKET" and "BOARDING PASS" respectively, along with the airline name "INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES". The documents also include fields for information such as "NAME OF PASSENGER", "FROM", "TO", "DATE", "TIME", "CLASS", "FLIGHT", "GATE", and "SEAT". Scattered around the main elements are line-art icons of several famous world landmarks, including the Leaning Tower of Pisa, the Great Wall, the Sydney Opera House, the Statue of Liberty, the Colosseum, the Giza Pyramids, the Eiffel Tower, the Taj Mahal, Christ the Redeemer, and a Japanese torii gate. These landmark icons are drawn with orange or blue lines and are set against white circular backgrounds.

The scene features dark wooden flooring, grey and black walls, and a curved ceiling with integrated lighting strips. On the left wall, there is a brand history display area with the "Cadillac" brand logo at the top. Below it, along a horizontal line, are the years "2021", "1999", "1971", "1948", and "1902", with captions describing the LYRIQ electric era, the debut of Escalade, modern brand design, classic tailfin styling, and the founding of Cadillac. The central part of the hall features an immersive display area with a large screen showing a close-up of a car, including the "Cadillac" logo. In front of the screen are two seats and a human-like figure. The right side of the hall is more open, with several display stands and a distant city skyline visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark brown, grey, black, and white, complemented by the blue sky and city landscape outside the windows.

A man stands on each side of her. The man on the left wears black-rimmed glasses, a light-colored T-shirt printed with cartoon bees and faces, dark pants, and a white wristband printed with "VIP" in black on his left wrist. The man on the right wears a black T-shirt and dark pants; his T-shirt features a pink square graphic on the chest with white handwritten text "You look good, girl!" and an image of a woman (possibly a drag queen) in a black outfit. All three are smiling, with the men's arms resting on the drag queen's shoulders. The background is white, repeatedly printed with black "FIVE SENSES" and "REELING" text and its reflection, forming a pattern.

The man to his left wears a black vest with "大高雄 里長主席聯誼會" (Greater Kaohsiung Ward Chiefs and Chairpersons Association) printed on it. Surrounding them are many supporters, mostly middle-aged and elderly individuals, most of whom are raising their fists and holding white promotional fans. There are two main styles of white promotional fans they are holding: one features a candidate's photo and reads "第一名立委 高雄拼第一 賴瑞隆" (Number One Legislator Kaohsiung Strives for Number One Lai Rui-long); the other features a yellow duck icon and reads "第一名立委 高雄拼第一 立委候選人 賴瑞隆" (Number One Legislator Kaohsiung Strives for Number One Legislator Candidate Lai Rui-long). In the background, three large colorful banners are hung. From left to right, there is a green banner with "人民 信賴 賴清德" (People Trust Lai Ching-te); a yellow banner with "信賴 賴清德" (Trust Lai Ching-te); and a blue banner with "邁向 陳其邁" (Moving Towards Chen Chi-mai). 下方的白色卡片区域包含主要正文。它以粗体黑色的称谓“亲爱的女性同仁：”开头，随后是两段黑色正文。第一段表达了对贡献的感谢，第二段则传递了对美好和绽放的祝愿。

This is a digital greeting card or poster for International Women's Day. The background features a soft gradient, transitioning from light pink at the top left to pale orange with hints of purple towards the bottom right. The overall layout is vertically structured, with text and image elements arranged in a clear hierarchy.
At the top left, there is a pink text label "2024 WOMEN'S DAY". Below this, the prominent main title "致 闪闪发光 的你" is displayed, with "致" and "的你" in black, and "闪闪发光" in a pink-orange gradient.
Below the title, there are two white, rounded rectangular card-like areas. The upper card contains a black and white close-up photograph of a cluster of blooming flowers. Beneath the photo, within the same card, is a black quote: "“温柔有光，自有力量”".
The lower white card area contains the main body text. It begins with a bold black salutation "亲爱的女性同仁：", followed by two paragraphs of black body text. The first paragraph expresses gratitude for contributions, and the second conveys wishes for brightness and flourishing.
At the bottom of the poster, there are two distinct text blocks. On the left, in light gray, are the English words "INTERNATIONAL WOMEN'S DAY" stacked vertically. On the right, in black, is the sender's name "某某集团人力资源部" (bold), followed by the date "二〇二四年三月八日" (regular font).

On the right side of the image, a bird perches on a persimmon branch, while two birds fly on the left, with faint distant mountains and clouds visible in the background. prompt_cn: 这是一张以红色为主色调的宣传海报，背景分为上下两部分，上方为红色，下方为深红色。海报顶部左右两侧分别有中英文标签，左侧是“党群服务中心礼堂”及其英文“COMMUNITY SERVICE CENTER”，右侧是“政务法律专场”和“2024 SERIES”。海报中部是核心内容，以特大白色字体突出显示“廉洁自律”，下方是“清风润初心 正气贯乾坤”的对联。右侧有一段竖排的白色文字：“加强党性修养·严守纪律底线 构建清廉政务环境·服务人民群众”。背景中隐约可见一个半透明的汉字“廉”。海报底部深红色区域左侧是“党建专题活动”的标题，下方列出了“地点: 市党群服务中心三楼礼堂”和“时间: 2024年10月15日 14:30”。右侧是“先锋红系列海报”及其英文“PIONEER RED DESIGN v1.0”。海报最下方左右角分别有浅灰色英文“JUSTICE INTEGRITY SERVICE”和白色文字红色背景框的“NO.085-2024”。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster predominantly in red, with the background divided into two parts: the upper part is red, and the lower part is dark red. At the top left and right sides of the poster are bilingual labels. On the left, it reads "党群服务中心礼堂" with its English translation "COMMUNITY SERVICE CENTER". On the right, it displays "政务法律专场" and "2024 SERIES". The central part of the poster features the core content, highlighting "廉洁自律" (Integrity and Self-discipline) in very large white font, followed by the couplet "清风润初心 正气贯乾坤" (Pure wind nourishes the original aspiration, upright spirit pervades the universe). To the right, there is a vertical block of white text: "加强党性修养·严守纪律底线 构建清廉政务环境·服务人民群众" (Strengthen Party spirit cultivation · Strictly adhere to disciplinary bottom lines Build a clean government environment · Serve the people). A semi-transparent Chinese character "廉" (Lian, meaning integrity) is faintly visible in the background. In the dark red section at the bottom of the poster, the left side features the title "党建专题活动" (Party Building Special Activity), below which are listed "地点: 市党群服务中心三楼礼堂" (Location: Third Floor Auditorium of the Municipal Party-Mass Service Center) and "时间: 2024年10月15日 14:30" (Time: October 15, 2024, 14:30). The right side shows "先锋红系列海报" (Pioneer Red Series Poster) and its English "PIONEER RED DESIGN v1.0". At the very bottom corners of the poster, the left displays light gray English text "JUSTICE INTEGRITY SERVICE", and the right shows "NO.085-2024" in white text within a red background box.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于海洋深度分层的科学信息图。深蓝色的背景上，顶部中央是黄色粗体大字标题“PELAGIC DEPTH LAYERS”，下方是白色副标题“OCEANIC STRATIFICATION SYSTEM #350”和一行关键统计数据，包括覆盖范围、最大深度、平均温度和草稿信息。图片左侧有一大段白色正文，详细描述了海洋水柱生态系统及其分层。正文右侧是一个白色三角形图形，中间有一条横线，下方标有“OPL”字样。正文下方左右两侧各有一个图表：左侧是标题为“VERTICAL LIGHT EXTINCTION GRADIENT”的垂直堆叠条形图，展示了不同深度区域的光线穿透率，区域颜色从黄色、蓝色到深蓝色渐变；右侧是标题为“HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE (ATMOSPHERES)”的折线图，用红线表示水压随深度增加的变化。图表下方是一个表格，标题为“CAREER DEPTH STATISTICS & ENVIRONMENTAL THRESHOLDS”，包含“ZONE CLASSIFICATION”、“DEPTH RANGE”、“TEMP RANGE”、“PRESSURE MAX”和“BIOMASS %”五列，以及五行海洋深度区域的数据。图片底部是页脚信息，包括数据来源说明和两个标签：“CERTIFIED DEEP SEA”（红色背景）和“GLOSS”。整体布局清晰，信息以文字、图表和表格形式呈现。

Against a dark blue background, the top center features the large, bold yellow title "PELAGIC DEPTH LAYERS," followed by the white subtitle "OCEANIC STRATIFICATION SYSTEM #350" and a line of key statistics, including coverage, maximum depth, average temperature, and draft information. On the left side of the image, there is a large block of white text detailing the oceanic water column ecosystem and its stratification. To the right of the main text is a white triangular graphic with a horizontal line in the middle, labeled "OPL" below it. Below the main text, there are two charts: the left one is a vertical stacked bar chart titled "VERTICAL LIGHT EXTINCTION GRADIENT," illustrating light penetration rates across different depth zones with colors gradually changing from yellow, blue, to dark blue; the right one is a line chart titled "HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE (ATMOSPHERES)," showing how hydrostatic pressure increases with depth via a red line. Below the charts is a table titled "CAREER DEPTH STATISTICS & ENVIRONMENTAL THRESHOLDS," which includes five columns: "ZONE CLASSIFICATION," "DEPTH RANGE," "TEMP RANGE," "PRESSURE MAX," and "BIOMASS %," along with five rows of data for oceanic depth zones. The bottom of the image contains footer information, including data source details and two labels: "CERTIFIED DEEP SEA" (on a red background) and "GLOSS." The overall layout is clear, presenting information through text, charts, and a table.

prompt_cn: 这是一张彩色摄影图片，展示了一个位于传统中式园林庭院中央的艺术化“寿”字雕塑。雕塑主体由多种材质构成，包括形似树根的棕色木质部分、银色金属条、浅绿色雕花玉石状部分以及红色珐琅状装饰，其上点缀着红色的花朵和几只小鸟。整个雕塑造型独特，将“寿”字融入自然元素之中，寓意吉祥。雕塑下方是一个灰色的石质底座。背景是一座古朴的园林建筑，具有白墙、深色木质柱子和屋檐，以及带有镂空花纹的窗户。地面铺设着石板，并大面积覆盖着绿色的苔藓，营造出古老而宁静的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a color photograph featuring an artistic "Shou" (寿) character sculpture positioned in the center of a traditional Chinese garden courtyard. The main body of the sculpture is composed of multiple materials, including brown wood-like sections resembling tree roots, silver metal strips, light green carved jade-like parts, and red enamel-like decorations, adorned with red flowers and several small birds. The sculpture's unique design integrates the "Shou" character with natural elements, symbolizing longevity and good fortune. Below the sculpture is a gray stone base. In the background stands an ancient garden building with white walls, dark wooden pillars and eaves, and windows featuring intricate openwork patterns. The ground is paved with stone slabs and largely covered with green moss, creating an old and tranquil atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于黑洞分类与结构解剖的信息图，整体采用深色背景和白色文字，呈现出技术手册或文档的风格。页面被清晰地划分为三个垂直列，顶部是主标题“黑洞分类与结构解剖 / BLACK HOLE ORD MANUAL”。左列包含一个表格，详细列出了黑洞的四种分类（恒星级、中等质量、超大质量、原初）及其质量和典型位置。表格下方是一个红色背景的“危险/WARNING”警告框，提示“面条化风险”，并给出了史瓦西半径的计算公式及其参数说明。中列展示了一个黑洞的简化解剖图，标示了事件视界、吸积盘、相对论性喷流和奇点等结构，并附有技术备注。右列则分步描述了黑洞的形成演化过程（引力坍缩、视界确立、物质吸积、喷流发射），并列出了黑洞的核心属性（质量、角动量、电荷），最后以“无毛定理”总结了外部观测的局限性。底部是页脚“CONFIDENTIAL // TOP SECRET // ASTROPHYSICS COMMAND”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about black hole classification and anatomical structure, presented in the style of a technical manual or document with a dark background and white text. The page is clearly divided into three vertical columns, topped by the main title "黑洞分类与结构解剖 / BLACK HOLE ORD MANUAL". The left column features a table detailing four black hole classifications (Stellar, Intermediate-Mass, Supermassive, Primordial) along with their masses and typical locations. Below the table is a red-background "危险/WARNING" box, highlighting "SPAGHETTIFICATION HAZARD" and providing the Schwarzschild radius calculation formula with parameter explanations. The middle column displays a simplified anatomical diagram of a black hole, labeling structures such as the event horizon, accretion disk, relativistic jet, and singularity, accompanied by technical notes. The right column describes the step-by-step formation and evolution of black holes (Gravitational Collapse, Horizon Establishment, Accretion, Jet Emission), lists their core attributes (Mass, Spin, Charge), and concludes with the "NO-HAIR THEOREM" summarizing the limitations of external observation. The footer at the bottom reads "CONFIDENTIAL // TOP SECRET // ASTROPHYSICS COMMAND".

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于罗马军团编制与行政层级的信息图。图片以深灰色为背景，左侧有巨大的垂直蓝色标题“LEGIO I”，下方是“军团历史与组织”等信息。图表主体分为左右两部分。左侧上方是中文标题“军团编制与行政层级”及其英文副标题，下方是一段关于罗马军团精密组织系统的介绍文字。文字下方是一个蓝色圆圈，内含数字“5200”，旁边标注“全员兵力编制”。再下方是一个三列表格，详细列出了军团、大队、百人队和帐篷小队等编制单位的标准人数和指挥官。右侧上方是“大队内部百人队结构”图，由六个标有“CENTURIA”和“80 Milites”的方框组成，下方配有文字说明。右侧下方是“战术装备几何比例”条形图，展示了短剑、方盾和重标枪的长度，并配有文字解释其协同作用。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing the organization and administrative hierarchy of a Roman Legion. The image features a dark gray background. On the left, there is a large vertical blue title "LEGIO I", with additional information like "军团历史与组织" (Legion History and Organization) below it. The main body of the chart is divided into two sections. The upper left section presents the Chinese title "军团编制与行政层级" (Organization and Administrative Hierarchy of the Roman Legion) and its English subtitle, followed by a paragraph introducing the intricate organizational system of the Roman Legion. Below this text, a blue circle contains the number "5200", labeled as "全员兵力编制" (Standard Heavy Infantry Complement). Further down, a three-column table details the standard strength and commanders for units such as Legion, Cohort, Century, and Contubernium. The upper right section displays the "大队内部百人队结构" (Cohort Schematic) diagram, consisting of six boxes labeled "CENTURIA" and "80 Milites", accompanied by a textual explanation. The lower right section features a "战术装备几何比例" (Tactical Equipment Metrics) bar chart, illustrating the lengths of the Gladius (short sword), Scutum (shield), and Pilum (heavy javelin), with text explaining their coordinated use.

Below this is the body text, starting with "尊敬的合作伙伴:" (Dear Partners:), followed by a detailed invitation message in light gray text. Further down are the event details, including "【时间·TIME】" (Time), "2024年12月28日 18:30 - 21:30", "【地点·VENUE】" (Venue), "丽思卡尔顿酒店·58层星空宴会厅" (The Ritz-Carlton Hotel · 58th Floor Starlight Ballroom), and "【着装·DRESS CODE】" (Dress Code), "商务正装 / 晚礼服 (建议佩戴粉色元素)" (Business formal / Evening gown (pink elements recommended)). These information labels are in light pink-purple, and their content is in white. text:
谢 忱
致各位亲爱的邻里：
家事维艰，感念厚情。在这段艰难的治丧期间，承蒙各位邻里守望相助，给予了我们莫大的支持与关怀。
无论是忙前忙后的鼎力协助，还是一句句真诚的温言慰藉，都如同冬日暖阳，照亮了我们心中的阴霾。这份邻里深情，我们全家铭记于心。
远亲不如近邻，特备此卡聊表谢意。愿大家岁岁平安，阖家幸福。
XXX 阖家敬谢
“草木有情，邻里有爱”
二零二二年 · 仲秋

prompt_cn: 这是一张以浅米色为背景的致谢信数字卡片。卡片边缘和照片周围均有细双线边框。卡片顶部中央是深棕色大字标题“谢 忱”。标题下方居中放置一张黑白照片，照片中是几束干燥的植物或花朵，枝条纤细，花头呈球状或蓬松状。照片下方是致谢信的正文，以深棕色文字左对齐排版，段落首行缩进。正文内容表达了对邻里在治丧期间给予支持与关怀的感谢。卡片底部左侧是小字标语““草木有情，邻里有爱””，右侧是署名“XXX 阖家敬谢”及其下方的日期“二零二二年 · 仲秋”。整张卡片设计简洁，文字与图片共同传达了庄重而真挚的感谢之情。
prompt_en: This is a digital thank-you card set against a light beige background. Both the card's edges and the photo within have thin double-line borders. At the top center of the card is the dark brown, large-font title "谢 忱" (Gratitude). Below the title, a black and white photograph is centrally placed, featuring several bunches of dried plants or flowers with slender stems and spherical or fluffy flower heads. Below the photo is the main body of the thank-you letter, presented in dark brown text, left-aligned with indented paragraphs. The text expresses gratitude to neighbors for their support and care during a period of mourning. At the bottom left of the card is a small-font slogan, "“草木有情，邻里有爱”" (Plants have feelings, neighbors have love), and on the bottom right is the signature "XXX 阖家敬谢" (The XXX family respectfully thanks) with the date "二零二二年 · 仲秋" (Autumn of 2022) below it. The overall design of the card is simple, with text and image together conveying a solemn and sincere message of thanks.

prompt_cn: 图片展示了一个智能家居APP的自动化规则设置界面。界面顶部是标题“自动化规则”，左侧有一个蓝色方块图标，右侧是蓝色背景白色文字的“运行中”状态标签。标题下方显示场景信息：“场景: 晚归模式 · 执行顺序优化已开启”。界面主体分为“触发条件”和“执行动作”两大部分。在“触发条件 (IF)”区域，左侧有一个橙色圆点图标，具体条件为“当 智能门锁 被打开”，下方注明“生效时间: 19:00 - 05:00 · 仅限工作日”。“执行动作 (THEN)”区域左侧有一个蓝色圆点图标，右侧有蓝色的“按序执行”文字链接。下方列出了四个编号的自动化动作：1. “开启 玄关及客厅灯光”，详情为“亮度: 80% · 色温: 暖白”，右侧显示“立即”执行，并有一个未选中的灰色方框。2. “关闭 全屋遮光窗帘”，详情为“状态: 完全关闭”，右侧显示“延时 2s”，并有一个未选中的灰色方框。3. “启动 空气净化器”，详情为“模式: 强力净化”，右侧显示“延时 5s”，并有一个未选中的灰色方框。4. “播放 欢迎背景音乐”，详情为“音量: 35% · 歌单: 爵士”，右侧显示“延时 10s”，并有一个未选中的灰色方框。界面中部有一个浅黄色背景的提示框，包含“执行冲突检测”标题和提示信息：“当前顺序可能与“节能模式”产生设备占用冲突，已自动优化。”底部是两个操作按钮：左侧是浅灰色背景蓝色文字的“取消修改”，右侧是蓝色背景白色文字的“保存执行顺序”。
prompt_en: The image displays an automation rule setting interface for a smart home app. At the top of the interface is the title "自动化规则" (Automation Rules), with a small blue square icon on the left and a "运行中" (Running) status tag with white text on a blue background on the right. Below the title, scene information is shown: "场景: 晚归模式 · 执行顺序优化已开启" (Scene: Late Return Mode · Execution Order Optimization Enabled). The main body of the interface is divided into two major sections: "触发条件" (Trigger Conditions) and "执行动作" (Execute Actions). In the "触发条件 (IF)" (Trigger Conditions (IF)) area, there is an orange dot icon on the left, and the specific condition is "当 智能门锁 被打开" (When Smart Door Lock is Opened), with "生效时间: 19:00 - 05:00 · 仅限工作日" (Effective Time: 19:00 - 05:00 · Weekdays Only) noted below. In the "执行动作 (THEN)" (Execute Actions (THEN)) area, there is a blue dot icon on the left, and a blue text link "按序执行" (Execute in Order) on the right. Below, four numbered automation actions are listed: 1. "开启 玄关及客厅灯光" (Turn on Foyer and Living Room Lights), with details "亮度: 80% · 色温: 暖白" (Brightness: 80% · Color Temperature: Warm White), showing "立即" (Immediately) on the right, and an unchecked gray square checkbox. 2. "关闭 全屋遮光窗帘" (Close All Blackout Curtains), with details "状态: 完全关闭" (Status: Fully Closed), showing "延时 2s" (Delay 2s) on the right, and an unchecked gray square checkbox. 3. "启动 空气净化器" (Start Air Purifier), with details "模式: 强力净化" (Mode: Powerful Purification), showing "延时 5s" (Delay 5s) on the right, and an unchecked gray square checkbox. 4. "播放 欢迎背景音乐" (Play Welcome Background Music), with details "音量: 35% · 歌单: 爵士" (Volume: 35% · Playlist: Jazz), showing "延时 10s" (Delay 10s) on the right, and an unchecked gray square checkbox. In the middle of the interface, there is a light yellow-beige background alert box containing the title "执行冲突检测" (Execute Conflict Detection) and the alert message: "当前顺序可能与“节能模式”产生设备占用冲突，已自动优化。" (Current order may conflict with "Energy Saving Mode" for device usage, automatically optimized). At the bottom are two action buttons: on the left is "取消修改" (Cancel Changes) with blue text on a light gray background, and on the right is "保存执行顺序" (Save Execution Order) with white text on a blue background.

| 色轮几何构筑
伊顿十二色相环基于传统RYB(红黄蓝)减色混
合法模型,将可见色相规范化为12等分区域。通
过同心圆与内置几何多边形的嵌套关系,揭示色
彩的内在数理秩序。
三原色定位于三角形顶点,依次派生出间色与复
色。此映射系统为数字化界面与工业设计中的配
色选择提供了严谨的拓扑学依据。
| 经典调和机制
方案
夹角特征
视觉效应
单色调和
0°(单轴)
统一、秩序感极强
相似色
30° - 60°
过渡自然、视觉平稳
互补色
180°(直径)
高对比度、动态张力
分裂互补
Y型非对称
保留对比而画面柔和
三角调和
120°(正三角)
平衡感、色彩信息量大
四角调和
90°/180°(矩形)
双重互补、层次最丰富
色彩调和不仅用于设计美化,更能科学平衡人类视网膜生理残
像,提升感知体验。
| 算法与数字化映射
在数字色彩空间中,调和关系被定义为基于HUE
维度的模运算。基本色相设为H(范围0-359),
映射矩阵如下:
# 互补映射 Complementary
H_comp = (H + 180) % 360
# 分裂互补 Split-Comp
H_split_1 = (H + 150) % 360
H_split_2 = (H + 210) % 360
# 三角色 Triadic
H_triad = [H, (H+120)%360,
(H+240)%360]

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于色彩理论的信息图表，以深紫色为背景。图表顶部是标题“色彩学: 6种经典色彩调和方案与伊顿色相环”及其英文副标题。核心内容包括一个位于左侧的伊顿十二色相环，其中标示了黄、绿、蓝、紫、红、橙等12种颜色及其缩写，并用绿色三角形和蓝色圆点标示了三原色和间色。右侧是一个2x3的网格区域，展示了六种经典的色彩调和方案，每种方案都配有中文标题、英文副标题、一个简化的色轮图示和中文描述。图表下方分为三列文本区域。左下角是“色轮几何构筑”的文字说明，解释了伊顿色相环的构成原理。中下角是“经典调和机制”的表格，列出了六种调和方案的夹角特征和视觉效应，下方还有一段补充说明。右下角是“算法与数字化映射”的文本，提供了色彩调和关系的数学公式代码示例。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about color theory, set against a dark purple background. The top of the chart features the main title "色彩学: 6种经典色彩调和方案与伊顿色相环" and its English subtitle. The central content includes an Eithen 12-color wheel on the left, labeled with 12 colors like yellow, green, blue, purple, red, and orange, along with their abbreviations. Primary and secondary colors are highlighted with green triangles and blue dots. To the right, a 2x3 grid displays six classic color harmony schemes, each with a Chinese title, English subtitle, a simplified color wheel illustration, and a Chinese description. The bottom part of the infographic is divided into three text columns. The bottom-left section, titled "色轮几何构筑", explains the geometric structure of the Eithen color wheel. The bottom-middle section, titled "经典调和机制", presents a table detailing the angular characteristics and visual effects of the six harmony schemes, followed by an additional explanatory paragraph. The bottom-right section, titled "算法与数字化映射", provides mathematical formulas and code examples for digital color mapping.

To its right is the smaller sans-serif English subtitle "Night at the Museum", also vertically arranged. At the bottom of the text area is a Chinese body text about the film's content, in a small sans-serif font arranged horizontally. Below the Chinese title and above the body text are three square dots serving as decorative elements. The overall composition features black L-shaped decorative borders at the top-right and bottom-left corners. The photograph on the right depicts the grand interior hall of a museum, featuring high arched ceilings, walls, and columns adorned with ornate carved details, along with large windows. A massive grey-blue whale skeleton model is suspended in the center of the hall. Multiple visitors are visible on the floor and the wide staircases. The main colors of the architecture are warm brown and gold.

At the center is a life-size anime-style female character standee with purple long hair, wearing an elaborate red gown, and holding a folding fan. The background consists of red velvet drapes and golden sheer curtains, adorned with beaded strings. On either side of the standee, there is a vintage-style floor lamp emitting warm light. To the left, a round table draped with a golden tablecloth holds bouquets of red and beige roses and a candelabra; next to it is a white wrought-iron side table with two champagne glasses, decorated with greenery and roses. To the right, a white square pedestal features a square sign with the Japanese text "れな" and English text "RENA"; beside it is a white wrought-iron flower stand holding a large floral arrangement with red, beige, and blue flowers. A decorative sign hangs above the left side, displaying "VINTAGE ELEGANCE" and "LIFE-SIZE FIGURE PHOTO BOOTH". The floor is covered with light-colored tiles.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface with a dark background, displaying a dashboard for vehicle health diagnostics or maintenance. The top section shows the product name "TITAN-V8 PRO" and system status "SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC: ACTIVE", with "上次同步" (Last Sync) and the date "2023.10.24" on the right. In the center of the interface is a large circular progress chart labeled "H E A L T H", showing "85%" in the middle, and "状态: 优良" (Status: Excellent) in a capsule-shaped area below. Below this are four rectangular information cards arranged in a 2x2 grid, presenting data for "机油" (Engine Oil) with "剩余" (Remaining) 3240 KM, "过滤器" (Filter) with "寿命" (Life) 15%, "制动液" (Brake Fluid) with "含水" (Water Content) 1.2%, and "胎压" (Tire Pressure) with "当前" (Current) 2.4 BAR. Each card has a serial number (01-04) in the top right and a progress bar at the bottom. Further down is the "里程路线图" (Mileage Roadmap) section, featuring a horizontal slider labeled "MILESTONE" with three mileage points: "4.0w", "5.2w", and "6.0w", with "5.2w" highlighted. At the bottom of the interface are two horizontal buttons, "详情" (Details) on the left and "立即预约 →" (Book Now →) on the right.

text:
SHINKANSEN
N700 SERIES
HIGH-SPEED RAIL AERODYNAMICS / PRODUCTION PLAN 2007-N
SECTION 01: NOSE GEOMETRY & FLOW SUPPRESSION
AERO DOUBLE-WING NOSE: 10.7M LENGTH
PRESSURE WAVE COMPRESSION ZONE
-30% DRAG
The N700 Series utilizes an advanced "Aero Double-Wing" nose design, measuring exactly 10.7 meters. This specific geometric profile is engineered to counteract the piston effect when entering narrow tunnels at speeds of 300 km/h. By precisely managing air displacement, the design suppresses the micro-pressure wave—an explosive sonic boom phenomenon occurring at tunnel exits—improving environmental compliance and structural longevity of the rail infrastructure. Drag reduction is calculated at 30% compared to previous 700 Series iterations.
DATA SET: PROPULSION
17080
KILOWATTS TOTAL OUTPUT
Power distribution follows the 14M2T configuration. In a 16-car formation, 14 cars are motorized (M) and 2 are trailers (T). This high motor-to-trailer ratio ensures rapid acceleration of 2.6 km/h/s, essential for maintaining tight schedules on the Tokaido Shinkansen corridor. Total installed capacity equals 17,080 kW, drawing 25KV AC at 60Hz.
PRODUCTION STATISTICS
PARAMETER
VALUE / UNIT
Formation
16 Cars (14M2T)
Top Speed
300 KM/H
Total Mass
715 TONS
Acceleration
2.6 KM/H/S
Length
404.7 METERS
Voltage
25 KV AC
Massive industrial flow is regulated by the Centralized Traffic Control (CTC) system. Every unit is a mobile power plant, delivering state-optimized transport efficiency.
SECTION 02: ACTIVE TILT SUSPENSION
1.0° TILT
The N700 introduces air spring active tilt technology. By inflating air springs on the outer side of a curve, the car body tilts inward by up to 1 degree. This allows the train to negotiate curves with a 2500m radius at 270 km/h without reducing speed or compromising passenger comfort. This mechanical advantage eliminates the 15 km/h deceleration required by older rolling stock, optimizing the national transit flow.
SAFETY PROTOCOL: SEISMIC P-WAVE DETECTION
The "UrEDAS" earthquake early warning system monitors primary seismic waves (P-waves). Upon detection of critical ground motion, the system triggers an immediate power cutoff to the overhead lines. Within 3.0 seconds, emergency braking is applied. At a speed of 300 km/h, the N700 is engineered to achieve a full stop within 2,500 meters, ensuring absolute security for the industrial collective. This is the highest standard of state protection in rail logistics.
3.0s
RESPONSE TIME
2500M
BRAKE DISTANCE
TECHNICAL MANUAL: ATLAS PLATE 089
N700 SERIES / CENTRALIZED RAIL AUTHORITY

prompt_en: This is a motivational poster set against a blue sky. In the center of the image, a person wearing a grey hoodie and black athletic pants is seen from behind, running upwards on a wide outdoor staircase. To the right of the stairs, the railing of a white arched bridge is visible. In the top left of the image, there is black handwritten text that reads "早安朋友" (Good morning friend), and on the top right, vertically stacked black English text reads "GOOD MORNING". In the middle of the frame, above the person, is a large, silver-white artistic rendering of "早安" (Good morning), with two lines of smaller text to its right: "致敬奋斗者" (Salute to strivers) and "致敬追梦人" (Salute to dream chasers). At the bottom of the image, on the stairs, large white 3D letters spell out "COMEON", below which are three lines of white text: "顺着自己的目标一点点的" (Follow your goals little by little), "去奋斗,去前行,去拼搏" (Go fight, go forward, go strive), and "直到达成目的" (Until you achieve your purpose). The entire image, through the upward posture of the person and the textual content, collectively conveys a theme of positivity and striving for goals.

text:
中秋团圆
月饼福
中秋习俗
中秋团圆的团伙约习俗，中秋习俗
比较的大族商家，月饼楼要有着也鲜明的团
锥，而商铺方不秋旭因洽谈，使用了遭欺负
来的张燕迈援，整个座仟拒银饿倒梯，在用虚的
上挣，中秋习俗，周能秤蒋派中秋拜物，月饼
的半很畏趴的措花的花棒。月秋习俗，趋人
能着的时师，常欲甜饼事情，中秋越变
荣僧疲俗。
月饼种类
月饼种类：古昔昔糕水能功良以7咬饼、
月饼楼有淹荒形C3类，2的7种种类、经谛选
的中主续，爱丰糖窝真的豆饼。
月饼种类：85山种、36论种模录秋、颗
的食良豆饼、、月饼提页豆饼。
月饼种类：蟹食丹种类、月饼种类，
皆味、爱饼、月饼种类，月饼是嘴等。
饼饼大贡苗，提饼柴、梨饼眼箱
朵等的模模等。
水调歌头
水调歌头，酬览光的错山，秋儿做已糖歌
传统，在老线代持未克要萧，四翠巫亩海怪，道鲜
的湿周，因示鸣吵泪调志，望苇的乡的则用时结，
谐数上有笑朗，的师有辛幕。
合伐馋忙耗赶赴的很墨，望是为坐开
在平秤一作有接到的生净意志，充德天涅，车。
未采有用铜楼？是美华人人伯德果，
寺刻先的中的怕景。
水调歌头
代传夜饭宾要请泽事纸缸丸。
虚时朗恨，乾是哈司主情9离港情增。
水山的凉搜明悟，孙者苦固铁、卢的
楼墙，水财族挺进争，益总青明赋心
花耽，香香甲友番的侧译。
建妹室惜的福强，爱灵提。
港中生茂的佳避。
水调歌头
水调歌头，演让生博。
水调歌间，遭润众奈。
生荫院蒸，生撑先辰。
渝山柳胆，湾湾真谈。
河道提头，水脑头惜。
枝足德志，夫桩鬼。
道满措歪，辆藏辛营。
——月饼秋

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一张以中秋节为主题的宣传页或海报，平铺在深棕色木质桌面上。宣传页呈米白色，顶部中央有毛笔书法风格的黑色大字“中秋团圆”，右侧伴有红色印章“月饼福”。页面内容分为多个区域，左侧有“中秋习俗”和“月饼种类”两个标题，下方是相应的段落文字。右侧有三处以“水调歌头”为标题的段落文字。页面中央和右侧穿插有描绘中秋场景的彩色插画，包括一家人围坐赏月、儿童提灯笼以及嫦娥奔月等传统元素。文字内容虽然清晰，但其组合方式不符合现代汉语语法，可能为古体或高度风格化的表达，具体含义难以理解。宣传页周围散落着干枯的叶子和白色小花作为装饰。桌面上还摆放着三个月饼和两杯茶。
prompt_en: This image displays a promotional page or poster themed around the Mid-Autumn Festival, laid flat on a dark brown wooden table. The off-white page features large black calligraphic characters "中秋团圆" (Mid-Autumn Reunion) at the top center, accompanied by a red seal "月饼福" (Mooncake Blessing) on its right. The page content is divided into multiple sections. On the left, there are two headings, "中秋习俗" (Mid-Autumn Customs) and "月饼种类" (Mooncake Types), followed by corresponding text paragraphs. On the right, there are three sections titled "水调歌头" (Shuidiao Getou, a classical poem title), each with its own text. prompt_cn: 这是一张京剧作品演唱会的宣传海报。画面背景为浅灰色渐变，左上角装饰有深色梅花枝和两只小鸟。海报主体由两部分人物肖像组成：右上方是一位面部朝左的老年男性肖像，其下方有关于他的介绍文字“中国著名音乐教育家 作曲家 京胡名家 万瑞兴”；图片下半部分是一群年轻男女的合影，其中一位女性（张火丁教授）位于前景中央。海报左侧是主要文字信息，包括标题“万瑞兴 先生 京剧作品演唱会”，下方是日期“2018年12月10日19:30”和地点“北京保利剧院”。左侧还竖向排列着多部作品名称，如“红色娘子军”、“一条大河”等。合影中的每个人物旁都标注了白色或红色的姓名，如“马凤凤”、“郑潇”等，下方还有“主持人 白燕升”和“指挥: 汪珅”等信息。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a Peking Opera works concert. The background of the image is a light gray gradient, adorned with dark plum branches and two small birds in the upper left corner. The main body of the poster consists of two parts of character portraits: in the upper right is a portrait of an elderly man facing left, with introductory text below him stating "China's renowned music educator, composer, and Jinghu master Wan Ruixing"; the lower half of the image features a group photo of young men and women, with one woman (Professor Zhang Huoding) in the central foreground. The left side of the poster contains the main textual information, including the title "Mr. Wan Ruixing Peking Opera Works Concert", below which are the date "December 10, 2018, 19:30" and the venue "Beijing Poly Theatre". On the left, several work titles are arranged vertically, such as "The Red Detachment of Women" and "A Big River". Next to each person in the group photo, their names are labeled in white or red, such as "Ma Fengfeng" and "Zheng Xiao", with additional information like "Host: Bai Yansheng" and "Conductor: Wang Shen" below.

prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a children's summer care class, set against a light blue background. In the top left corner, there is a dark blue rounded rectangle containing the "Canva 可画" brand logo. prompt_cn: 这是一张关于哥特式建筑系统的信息图，标题为“THE GOTHIC SYSTEM”。图片背景为深灰色，内容分为左右两栏。左栏上方是关于哥特式建筑结构转型的文字描述，下方是一个几何图形“AD TRIANGULUM”及其标签。右栏分为上下两部分。上半部分详细解释了哥特式建筑的结构骨架，包括“Ribbed Vault”、“Flying Buttress”和“Outer Pier”等组件，并用红色箭头示意力的传导方向；下方还分别介绍了“POINTED ARCH”、“RIBBED VAULT”、“FLYING BUTTRESS”和“ROSE WINDOW / GARGOYLE”的特点。右栏下半部分展示了“THE HEIGHT COMPETITIONS (VAULTS VS. SPIRES)”，包含一个柱状图和一张表格。柱状图以教堂轮廓表示高度，并标注了巴黎、亚眠、博韦和科隆四座教堂的拱顶或尖顶高度。表格详细列出了这四座教堂的名称、年份、测量类型和具体高度，其中博韦大教堂的数据（48.5m）和“LIMIT REACHED”字样以红色突出显示，科隆大教堂的“TOWER HEIGHT”则以灰色背景突出。图片右上角有一个红底白字的标志。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the Gothic architectural system, titled "THE GOTHIC SYSTEM". The image has a dark gray background and is divided into two columns. The upper part of the left column contains a textual description of the structural transition of Gothic architecture, while the lower part features a geometric diagram labeled "AD TRIANGULUM". The right column is divided into upper and lower sections. The upper section details the structural skeleton of Gothic architecture, including components like "Ribbed Vault", "Flying Buttress", and "Outer Pier", with red arrows indicating the direction of force transmission; below this, it separately introduces the characteristics of "POINTED ARCH", "RIBBED VAULT", "FLYING BUTTRESS", and "ROSE WINDOW / GARGOYLE". The lower part of the right column presents "THE HEIGHT COMPETITIONS (VAULTS VS. SPIRES)", which includes a bar chart and a table. The bar chart uses cathedral silhouettes to represent height, labeling the vault or spire heights of four cathedrals: Paris, Amiens, Beauvais, and Cologne. The table details the name, year, measurement type, and specific height for these four cathedrals. Data for Beauvais Cathedral (48.5m) and the text "LIMIT REACHED" are highlighted in red, while "TOWER HEIGHT" for Cologne Cathedral is highlighted with a gray background. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a red logo with white text.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于力量训练的信息图表，标题为“力量训练黄金五大项与目标肌肉群解剖”。图表整体采用白色背景，以黑色文字为主，红色用于强调标题、大字和图示中的关键元素。页面布局清晰，顶部是主副标题，右侧有“摹本其五·动作轨迹”和“重力矩与关节载荷分析”的标签。中部区域分为三列，展示了“蹲”、“拉”、“推”三个核心动作的汉字图示，每个图示下方配有动作名称（如“杠铃深蹲 (Squat)”）和简要描述。下方是两个生物力学分析图，分别解释了“深蹲生物力学几何分析”和“硬拉力矩与重心轴线”，并标注了“重力载荷”、“股骨”、“髋力臂”、“胫骨”、“脊柱载荷”、“重心线”等专业术语。图表底部包含一个四列五行的表格，详细列出了五大动作的“动作名称”、“基本运动模式”、“主导肌肉群”和“协同肌肉群”。表格下方还有两段关于“多关节协同募集机制”和“渐进性负荷适应原则”的文本说明。页脚处标有“国家体育科学教学标准规范·动作轨迹字帖”和“版次:2024.12·编号: SC-05”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about strength training, titled "力量训练黄金五大项与目标肌肉群解剖" (Strength Training Golden Five Major Items and Target Muscle Group Anatomy). The chart features a white background with predominantly black text, while red is used to highlight titles, large characters, and key elements within the diagrams. The page layout is clear, with main and sub-titles at the top, and labels "摹本其五·动作轨迹" (Copy No. 5 · Movement Trajectory) and "重力矩与关节载荷分析" (Gravity Moment and Joint Load Analysis) on the right. The middle section is divided into three columns, displaying large Chinese character diagrams for three core movements: "蹲" (Squat), "拉" (Pull), and "推" (Push). Each diagram is accompanied by the movement's name (e.g., "杠铃深蹲 (Squat)") and a brief description. Below these are two biomechanical analysis diagrams, explaining "深蹲生物力学几何分析" (Squat Biomechanics Geometric Analysis) and "硬拉力矩与重心轴线" (Deadlift Moment and Center of Gravity Axis), with labels such as "重力载荷" (Gravity Load), "股骨" (Femur), "髋力臂" (Hip Lever Arm), "胫骨" (Tibia), "脊柱载荷" (Spinal Load), and "重心线" (Center of Gravity Line). The bottom of the chart includes a four-column, five-row table detailing the "动作名称" (Movement Name), "基本运动模式" (Basic Movement Pattern), "主导肌肉群" (Primary Muscle Group), and "协同肌肉群" (Synergistic Muscle Group) for five major exercises. Below the table are two text blocks explaining "多关节协同募集机制" (Multi-Joint Synergistic Recruitment Mechanism) and "渐进性负荷适应原则" (Progressive Overload Adaptation Principle). The footer displays "国家体育科学教学标准规范·动作轨迹字帖" (National Sports Science Teaching Standard Specification · Movement Trajectory Calligraphy) and "版次:2024.12·编号: SC-05" (Edition: 2024.12 · No.: SC-05).

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内摄影照片，画面中三名年轻人（两女一男）并排站在白色墙壁前，每人手持一幅装裱好的海报。左侧墙上挂有多幅黑色边框的画作。画面顶部中央偏左位置有黑色俄语文字“C12”和“Солидарность культур”。右侧有一个大型立式展板，顶部有黑色俄语文字“АНО «Солидарность культур»”，中部有白色俄语标题“ПАТРИОТИЧЕСКИЙ ПЛАКАТ В СОВЕТСКОМ СТИЛЕ”，下方还有多行白色俄语描述性文字。左侧的女性手持的海报描绘了一辆红色电车和烟花，电车上有人挥舞旗帜，海报右上角有白色俄语文字“ДА ЗДРАВСТВУЕТ ПОБЕДА!”，电车侧面有数字“2465”。中间的女性手持的海报呈米色调，上面有黑色俄语文字“ЗАШИФРОВАНО В НАШЕЙ ИСТОРИИ, РАСШИФРОВАНО В НАШИХ СЕРДЦАХ”和“НИКТО НЕ ЗАБЫТ”，下方有红色镰刀锤子图案。右侧的男性手持的海报描绘了多个人物，右侧有白色俄语文字“СИЛА ДУХА В НАШЕЙ ПАМЯТИ!”。三位年轻人穿着不同颜色的休闲服装，表情自然。
prompt_en: This is an indoor photographic image featuring three young people, two females and one male, standing side by side in front of a white wall, each holding a framed poster. On the left wall, several framed artworks with black borders are hung. At the top center-left of the image, there are black Russian texts "C12" and "Солидарность культур". On the right, a large vertical display stand features black Russian text "АНО «Солидарность культур»" at the top, a white Russian title "ПАТРИОТИЧЕСКИЙ ПЛАКАТ В СОВЕТСКОМ СТИЛЕ" in the middle, and multiple lines of white Russian descriptive text below. The female on the left holds a poster depicting a red tram and fireworks, with a person waving a flag on the tram. The poster's top right corner shows white Russian text "ДА ЗДРАВСТВУЕТ ПОБЕДА!", and the tram's side has the number "2465". The female in the middle holds a beige-toned poster with black Russian texts "ЗАШИФРОВАНО В НАШЕЙ ИСТОРИИ, РАСШИФРОВАНО В НАШИХ СЕРДЦАХ" and "НИКТО НЕ ЗАБЫТ", with a red hammer and sickle emblem below. The male on the right holds a poster depicting multiple figures, with white Russian text "СИЛА ДУХА В НАШЕЙ ПАМЯТИ!" on its right side. The three young people are dressed in casual clothes of various colors and have natural expressions.

text:
MUSHROOM SAFETY
TOXIC VS EDIBLE
IDENTIFICATION CARD
01 BASIC MORPHOLOGY STRUCTURE
CAP (PILEUS)
GILLS (LAMELLAE)
ANNULUS (RING)
STIPE (STEM)
VOLVA (CUP)
ALL COMPONENTS MUST BE INSPECTED. THE PRESENCE OF BOTH AN ANNULUS AND A VOLVA INDICATES HIGH LETHALITY RISK (AMANITA GENUS).
02 THE AMANITA DANGER PROFILE
DO NOT CONSUME
IF THE SPECIMEN EXHIBITS WHITE WARTS OR SPOTS ON THE CAP SURFACE, THESE ARE REMNANTS OF THE UNIVERSAL VEIL.
CRITICAL: AMATOXINS DESTROY
LIVER RNA POLYMERASE II. NO
ANTIDOTE EXISTS.
1. CHECK FOR RING BELOW CAP.
2. DIG BASE TO FIND HIDDEN CUP.
3. OBSERVE COLOR CHANGES WHEN CUT.
03 COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS TABLE: COMMON SPECIMENS
SPECIMEN TYPE
COMMON NAME
MORPHOLOGY KEY
RISK LEVEL
Agaricus bisporus
Button Mushroom
Pink/Brown Gills, No Volva
SAFE / EDIBLE
Amanita phalloides
Death Cap
White Gills, Ring + Cup Base
LETHAL (100%)
Boletus edulis
Porcini
Pores (Sponge) instead of Gills
SAFE / EDIBLE
Amanita muscaria
Fly Agaric
Red Cap with White Warts
TOXIC / HALLUC.
Chlorophyllum molybdites
False Parasol
Green Spore Print, Large Ring
SEVERE GI TOXIC
04 VERIFICATION PROCEDURES
STEP A: SPORE PRINT TEST
PLACE CAP GILLS-DOWN ON PAPER. WAIT 6 HOURS. AMANITA SPECIES PRODUCE WHITE SPORES. CHLOROPHYLLUM PRODUCES GREEN.
STEP B: THE CUT REACTION
SLICE STIPE VERTICALLY. SOME BOLETES TURN BLUE INSTANTLY. BLUE STAINING IS A WARNING SIGNAL FOR TOXICITY IN MANY GENERA.
05 FINAL SAFETY CHECK-LIST
PULL: UP FROM ROOT
Always extract the full base to check for volva.
LOOK: UNDER THE CAP
Identify if spores are released from gills, pores, or teeth.
EXIT: THE SEARCH AREA
If identification is uncertain, discard specimen immediately.
WHEN IN DOUBT — THROW IT OUT
ATLAS OF MYCOLOGY // PLATE 82
EMERGENCY REFERENCE ONLY

这张图片是一张关于蘑菇安全识别的信息卡片。卡片背景为深黑色，顶部和底部有黄色条带。标题“MUSHROOM SAFETY”为黄色大字，右侧副标题“TOXIC VS EDIBLE IDENTIFICATION CARD”为白色。卡片内容分为五个编号部分（01-05），从左到右、从上到下排列。
第一部分“01 BASIC MORPHOLOGY STRUCTURE”展示了一个蘑菇的剖面图，并标注了其主要结构，如菌盖、菌褶、菌环、菌柄和菌托。
第二部分“02 THE AMANITA DANGER PROFILE”警告不要食用，并详细说明了鹅膏菌属的危险特征，包括一个红色的禁止蘑菇图标和关于鹅膏毒素的警告。
第三部分“03 COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS TABLE: COMMON SPECIMENS”是一个比较分析表格，列出了五种常见蘑菇的学名、俗名、形态特征和风险等级，其中安全可食用的风险等级用绿色标示，有毒或致命的用红色标示。
第四部分“04 VERIFICATION PROCEDURES”介绍了两种验证方法：孢子印测试和切口反应，每个步骤前都有一个橙色箭头图标。
第五部分“05 FINAL SAFETY CHECK-LIST”提供了最终安全检查清单，包括“PULL”、“LOOK”和“EXIT”三个要点，底部有一个蓝色按钮，上面写着“WHEN IN DOUBT — THROW IT OUT”。
页脚包含“ATLAS OF MYCOLOGY // PLATE 82”、“EMERGENCY REFERENCE ONLY”和“REF: 毒草 VS 食用菌”等信息。
prompt_en:
This image is an information card about mushroom safety identification. The card has a dark black background with yellow bands at the top and bottom. The main title "MUSHROOM SAFETY" is in large yellow text, while the subtitle "TOXIC VS EDIBLE IDENTIFICATION CARD" on the right is in white. The card's content is divided into five numbered sections (01-05), arranged from left to right and top to bottom.
Section 01, titled "BASIC MORPHOLOGY STRUCTURE," displays a cross-section diagram of a mushroom with its main structures labeled, such as cap, gills, annulus, stipe, and volva.
Section 02, "THE AMANITA DANGER PROFILE," warns against consumption and details the dangerous characteristics of the Amanita genus, including a red "no mushroom" icon and a warning about amatoxins.
Section 03, "COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS TABLE: COMMON SPECIMENS," is a comparative table listing the scientific name, common name, morphology key, and risk level for five common mushroom specimens. Safe/edible risk levels are marked in green, while toxic or lethal ones are marked in red.
Section 04, "VERIFICATION PROCEDURES," presents two verification methods: the spore print test and the cut reaction, each preceded by an orange arrow icon.
Section 05, "FINAL SAFETY CHECK-LIST," provides a final safety checklist with three key points: "PULL," "LOOK," and "EXIT." At the bottom, there is a blue button with the text "WHEN IN DOUBT — THROW IT OUT."
The footer includes information such as "ATLAS OF MYCOLOGY // PLATE 82," "EMERGENCY REFERENCE ONLY," and "REF: 毒草 VS 食用菌."

DE PISCIBUS EDOMAENSIBUS: OCTO GENERA
A Renaissance Typographical Codex of the Classical Preservation & Sushi Arts of Yedo
TOMUS IV
DISTRIBUTIO
ELEMENTORUM
Tempore Edo (1603-
1867)
observatum.
S
INCE THE TEMPO ERA, the preservation of marine life in the
Bay of Yedo has demanded rigorous chemical transformation.
Raw flesh, naturally prone to swift decay, is stabilized by the
strategic application of sea-salt and brewed rice-vinegar. The resulting
substrate, known as 醋饭 (Shari), must be maintained at human body
temperature (circa 36°C) to properly volatilize the organic esters of dark
red vinegar (赤醋 Akazu). Through this foundation, the ocean's raw
harvest undergoes transmutation: proteins are denatured, fats rendered,
and volatile oils neutralized.
T
HE SYSTEM IS GOVERNED by eight distinct families of
ingredients (寿司料 Neta), each treated with specialized
preservation techniques. From the deep, iron-rich cuts of the
Bluefin Tuna to the kelp-cured tissues of white-fleshed coastal species,
the master practitioner acts as a chemist. Moisture is drawn out,
glutamate is concentrated, and physical structures are mechanically
tenderized. Below, we provide the anatomical division of the subject
and the precise actions required to achieve perfect equilibrium between
acidity, salt, and temperature.
FOLIO CXLII
NIHONBASHI
PRESERVATION
Thermodynamics of
Vinegar
& Proteins.
FIG. I.
The Geometric Fish
CURA ET PROCURATIO
FIG. II.
Anatomy of Nigiri
Techniques refined in the old markets of Yedo.
Dorsal: Akami (赤身)
I. Neta (Flesh Slab)
II. Wasabi Interface
Ventral: Otoro (大腹)
III. Shari Substrate (36°C)
FIG. I. THE SUBJECT SEGMENTED
FIG. II. SYSTEM OF ASSEMBLY
Figure I shows the division of a typical pelagic specimen into dorsal (lean) and ventral (fatty) regions. Figure II illustrates the mechanical alignment of the vinegared
rice substrate with the seasoned flesh overlay.
CATEGORY &
SPECIMEN
CURING & PREPARATION METHOD
CHEMICAL & SENSORY OBJECTIVE
赤身 Akami (Red Fish)
Steeped in soy sauce and Mirin (Shouyu-zuke).
Dehydrates tissue, concentrates iron-rich umami flavors.
白身 Shiromi (White Fish)
Pressed between kelp sheets (Kombu-jime).
Infuses glutamic acids, extracts excess surface moisture.
光物 Hikarimono (Silver Fish)
Aggressive dry salting, followed by rice-vinegar wash.
Denatures strong oils, controls bacteria, firms skin texture.
煮物 Nimon (Simmered)
Poached in sweet dashi, finished with reduced soy glaze
(Tsume).
Collagen dissolution; turns tough tissues gelatinous and
sweet.
软体 Mollusks (Squid/Octopus)
Surface scored with fine cross-hatching (Kanoko-giri).
Severs tough elastic fibers to yield a creamy, sweet
mouthfeel.
虾蟹 Crustaceans (Prawn)
Parboiled whole on skewers, immediately shocked in ice
water.
Locks in sweetness, solidifies amino acids, retains curved
posture.
贝类 Shellfish (Ark Shell)
Flung vigorously against the wood board prior to mounting.
Triggers muscular contraction to ensure maximum crispness.
煎蛋 Tamagoyaki (Omelet)
Egg whipped with white fish paste (Shimi) and baked
slowly.
Creates a sponge-like, custard-sweet finishing bite.
EDO SUSHI CODEX - VOL. IV
IMPRIMATUR NIHONBASHI TYPOGRAPHY INC.
ANNO DOMINI MDCCCXXX
