text_7:
内容: INCE THE TEMPO ERA, the preservation of marine life in the
Bay of Yedo has demanded rigorous chemical transformation.
Raw flesh, naturally prone to swift decay, is stabilized by the
strategic application of sea-salt and brewed rice-vinegar. The resulting
substrate, known as 醋饭 (Shari), must be maintained at human body
temperature (circa 36°C) to properly volatilize the organic esters of dark
red vinegar (赤醋 Akazu). Through this foundation, the ocean's raw
harvest undergoes transmutation: proteins are denatured, fats rendered,
and volatile oils neutralized.

prompt_cn: 这是一张仿古风格的信息图表页面，详细介绍了江户时代寿司的鱼类保存和制作艺术。页面顶部是拉丁文主标题“DE PISCIBUS EDOMAENSIBUS: OCTO GENERA”及其英文副标题。主体内容分为两栏，每栏以一个大型装饰性首字母开头，阐述了江户湾海鲜的化学转化和八种食材的特殊处理技术。左右两侧设有窄边栏，提供额外信息。页面中部有一条横线分隔，下方是标题“CURA ET PROCURATIO”和副标题。接着是两个并排的图表，分别展示了鱼的分割（Dorsal: Akami, Ventral: Otoro）和握寿司的组成（Neta, Wasabi Interface, Shari Substrate），并配有详细说明。页面底部是一个三列表格，列出了八种鱼类/食材（如赤身、白身、软体等）的名称、固化与制备方法以及化学与感官目标。表格中的部分日文和中文文字以及图表中的部分文字以红色突出显示。页脚包含出版信息。整体版式设计精美，呈现出古典文献的风格。
prompt_en: This is an antique-style infographic page detailing the art of fish preservation and sushi preparation from the Edo period. At the top, there is a Latin main title "DE PISCIBUS EDOMAENSIBUS: OCTO GENERA" with its English subtitle. The main content is divided into two columns, each beginning with a large decorative initial letter, explaining the chemical transformation of seafood in the Bay of Yedo and the specialized treatment techniques for eight ingredient families. Narrow sidebars on the left and right provide additional information. A horizontal line separates the middle section, below which is the title "CURA ET PROCURATIO" and its subtitle. Following this are two side-by-side diagrams, illustrating fish segmentation (Dorsal: Akami, Ventral: Otoro) and the assembly of nigiri sushi (Neta, Wasabi Interface, Shari Substrate), accompanied by detailed captions. At the bottom of the page is a three-column table listing eight categories of fish/ingredients (e.g., Akami, Shiromi, Mollusks), their curing and preparation methods, and chemical and sensory objectives. Some Japanese and Chinese characters in the main text and table, as well as some text in the diagrams, are highlighted in red. The footer contains publication information. The overall layout is elegantly designed, resembling a classical document.

岁岁重阳，今又重阳。值此金秋佳节，晚辈谨向您致以最深切的敬意与祝福。
您的教诲如温润之玉，历经岁月洗礼而愈发璀璨，指引着我们前行的方向。感恩您多年来的慈爱与守护，这份恩情我们始终铭记于心。
愿您如南山之寿，松柏长青；愿您的生活如美玉般圆满无瑕，福寿绵长，岁岁安康。
晚辈 敬叩
二零二四年·重阳
礼仪之邦 喜事

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深绿色为主色调的重阳节数字贺卡。卡片顶部左侧是金色大字“重阳安康”，下方配有白色英文“CHONG YANG FESTIVAL”。卡片顶部右侧有一个金色的抽象装饰图形，形似带有光晕的符号。中部是贺词正文，以白色文字呈现，包括“| 尊崇的长辈：”的称谓，以及三段祝福语。正文右下角是落款“晚辈 敬叩”和日期“二零二四年·重阳”。卡片底部叠加了一张半透明的模糊山水风景图片作为装饰，图片中央隐约可见“礼仪之邦 喜事”的浅色文字。
prompt_en: This is a digital greeting card for the Chongyang Festival, predominantly in dark green. The top left of the card features large golden characters "重阳安康" (Chongyang An Kang), with white English text "CHONG YANG FESTIVAL" below. On the top right, there is a golden abstract decorative graphic, resembling a symbol with a halo. The central part contains the main greeting text in white, including the salutation "| 尊崇的长辈：" (Respected Elders:), followed by three paragraphs of blessings. The bottom right of the main text area shows the sign-off "晚辈 敬叩" (Junior respectfully bows) and the date "二零二四年·重阳" (2024 · Chongyang). The bottom of the card is overlaid with a semi-transparent, blurred landscape image as decoration, with faint light-colored text "礼仪之邦 喜事" (Land of Courtesy, Happy Events) vaguely visible in the center of the image.

The top of the image features the main title "UNIVERSAL SERIAL BUS: TECHNICAL ANATOMY" and the subtitle "Standardized Interconnect Architecture Evolution (1996—2024)". The page layout is clear, divided into several logical sections. The top-left area provides detailed descriptions of "SIGNAL SYSTEMS" and "PIN FUNCTIONALITY INDEX", including VBUS, TX/RX, and CC pin functionalities. The top-middle section displays a connector cross-section diagram labeled "PLATE 01: CONNECTO SECTION" with details on its gold plating layer, and below the diagram, "VBUS ENERGY BUS" and "DATA TRANSMISSION CORE" are noted. The top-right area presents information on "MECHANICAL LIFECYCLE" and "POWER DELIVERY (EPR)", with "240W" highlighted in large red text. The middle of the image features a bar chart titled "QUANTITATIVE EVOLUTION: BANDWIDTH GROWTH (LOG SCALE)", illustrating the bandwidth growth from USB 1.1 (12 Mbps) to USB4 (80 Gbps). Below the bar chart, four boxes describe the characteristics of TYPE-A, TYPE-B, MICRO-B, and TYPE-C connectors. The bottom section contains a table titled "COMPARATIVE SPECIFICATION MATRIX", which lists the commercial release dates, maximum data rates, standard voltages, and signal encodings for various USB versions. The footer includes legends for "P Power Delivery Pathway", "D Differential Data Pair", "C Control / Logic Channel", and reference information.

The invitation is a rounded rectangle with a light green border, and its background features a gradient from off-white to very light green. At the top center is the main title "婚礼请柬" (Wedding Invitation) in dark green, with the English subtitle "WEDDING INVITATION" below it. To the right, "SAVE THE DATE" in light green is enclosed within a dashed circular frame. The middle of the invitation features a circular image displaying a black and white close-up of succulent plants. Below the image are the names of the couple, "林木森 & 苏沁沁", rendered in an artistic font. Further down are the "时间" (Time) and "地点" (Location) details: "时间" is "2024年10月26日 (星期六) 12:00" (October 26, 2024 (Saturday) 12:00), and "地点" is "云端植物园·翡翠玻璃暖房" (Cloud Garden Botanical Garden · Emerald Glass Greenhouse). These labels are in light green, while their content is in dark green. At the bottom, there is an italicized quote, "“多肉之约，见证永恒的萌发”" (A succulent rendezvous, witnessing the eternal sprouting), followed by three small decorative dots, and finally the invitation text "诚挚邀请您莅临现场分享我们的喜悦" (Sincerely invite you to join us and share our joy).

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于宇宙黑洞演化的科学信息图，背景为深灰色。图片顶部包含中文主标题“宇宙黑洞演化图谱”和英文副标题，以及右侧的坐标、比例尺等参考信息。图片主体分为四个主要区域：左侧中部是一个黑洞吸积系统的剖面示意图，用编号和文字详细标注了奇点、事件视界、吸积盘等组成部分。右侧中部列出了黑洞的四种演化路径，每条路径都有编号和详细的英文描述。左侧底部是一个表格，分类展示了微型、恒星级、中等质量和超大质量黑洞的质量范围、史瓦西半径、霍金温度及主要演化起源，并列举了M87*和Sgr A*两个具体样本的数据。右侧底部是一个对数尺度的质量谱分布图，以深红、橙色和黄绿色条形图展示了不同类型黑洞的相对密度，并标记了M87*和Sgr A*的位置。图片底部是数据来源和分类信息。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about the evolution of cosmic black holes, set against a dark gray background. The top of the image features a Chinese main title "宇宙黑洞演化图谱" and an English subtitle, along with reference information like coordinates and scale on the right. The main body of the image is divided into four primary sections: The middle-left shows a cross-sectional schematic of an active accreting black hole system, with numbered labels detailing components such as the singularity, event horizon, and accretion disk. The middle-right lists four evolutionary pathways for black holes, each with a number and detailed English description. The bottom-left presents a table classifying micro, stellar-mass, intermediate-mass, and supermassive black holes by their mass range, Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, and primary evolutionary origin, also including data for specific specimens like M87* and Sgr A*. The bottom-right displays a mass spectrum distribution chart on a log scale, using dark red, orange, and yellow-green bar graphs to illustrate the relative density of different black hole types, with M87* and Sgr A* marked. The bottom of the image provides data source and classification information.

text:
钻石圆明亮式
标准切割解剖与 4C 评级指南
圆明亮式切割 (Round Brilliant Cut) 是现代珠宝工艺的巅峰之作。它由 57 或 58 个精心排列的切面组成，旨在通过完美的光线全反射展现钻石的“火彩”与“亮度”。本页详述其几何结构与全球通用的 4C 价值分级矩阵。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于钻石知识的教育性信息图表。图片背景为白色，左侧带有一条垂直的浅黄色装饰边栏。页面顶部是红色矩形背景上的白色标题“钻石圆明亮式”及其副标题“标准切割解剖与 4C 评级指南”。标题下方是一段关于圆明亮式切割的介绍性文字。页面主体内容分为两大部分：上半部分采用两列布局，左侧是“切割解剖结构”章节，展示了钻石的线稿图及其各部分的名称标签（如台面、腰冠、亭部、底尖等）；右侧是“最佳比例标准”章节，以列表形式列出了台面百分比、全深比和冠角的推荐数值，其中数值部分以红色粗体字突出，冠角数值为34-35°。下半部分是“4C 价值矩阵分析”章节，包含颜色分级和净度分级两个表格，表格的标题行均有黄色背景。页面底部左侧是“切工评级 CUT”的列表，右侧是“重量克拉 CARAT”的说明，其中重量换算“1.00 ct = 200 mg”也用红色粗体字标示。图片最下方是页脚，提供了来源信息。
prompt_en: This is an educational infographic about diamond knowledge. The image has a white background with a vertical light yellow decorative sidebar on the left. At the top of the page, the white title "钻石圆明亮式" (Diamond Round Brilliant Cut) and its subtitle "标准切割解剖与 4C 评级指南" (Standard Cut Anatomy and 4C Grading Guide) are set against a red rectangular background. Below the title is an introductory paragraph about the round brilliant cut. The main content of the page is divided into two major sections: the upper part features a two-column layout, with the "切割解剖结构" (Cut Anatomy) section on the left, displaying a line drawing of a diamond with labeled parts (such as Table, Crown, Pavilion, Culet); on the right is the "最佳比例标准" (Optimal Proportion Standards) section, listing recommended values for table percentage, total depth, and crown angle in a list format, with the numerical values highlighted in bold red text, including "34-35°" for the crown angle. prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张电影海报或宣传图，画面中央是两位人物：左侧是一位成年男性，右侧是一位儿童。两人都面向前方，并伸出右手食指指向前方，姿势相似。成年男性穿着米色外套和白色内搭，儿童穿着黑白相间的夹克。背景模糊，可见绿色黑板上的涂鸦、环形灯光和手机屏幕等元素，暗示可能与游戏或直播相关的现代场景。画面中央叠加着醒目的白色主标题“老爹带我上A大”，文字带有橙黄色描边和阴影效果。主标题下方是其拼音“LAODIEDAIWOSHANGADA”。图片左侧有多行小字，排布类似聊天信息或评论，包括“家有神兽: 爹带儿子打游戏这合理吗”、“小胖: 哈”、“君君: 来”等。右下角有一个粉色的礼物盒图标。左下角有“说点什么...”的输入提示。
prompt_en: This image is a movie poster or promotional graphic, featuring two figures in the center: an adult male on the left and a child on the right. Both face forward and extend their right index fingers pointing ahead in similar poses. The adult male wears a beige jacket and a white inner top, while the child wears a black and white striped jacket. The background is blurred, showing elements like green blackboard graffiti, ring lights, and mobile phone screens, suggesting a modern setting possibly related to gaming or live streaming. A prominent white main title "老爹带我上A大" (Old Dad Takes Me to A University/Level A) is overlaid in the center, with orange-yellow outlines and shadow effects. Below the main title is its Pinyin transcription "LAODIEDAIWOSHANGADA". The left side of the image contains multiple lines of small text, arranged like chat messages or comments, including "家有神兽: 爹带儿子打游戏这合理吗" (Family has a divine beast: Is it reasonable for dad to play games with his son?), "小胖: 哈" (Xiao Pang: Ha), "君君: 来" (Jun Jun: Come). A pink gift box icon is in the bottom right corner. An input prompt "说点什么..." (Say something...) is in the bottom left.

Slightly below the center of the poster, the large red calligraphic characters "奉献" (Dedication/Contribution) are prominently displayed. To its upper right, there is a block of smaller text, including a red "精神 社会公益" (Spirit Public Welfare) label, followed by black English text "SPIRIT OF UTTER DEVOTION" and Chinese text "奉献是一种智慧，更是一种精神所在" (Dedication is a kind of wisdom, and even more, a spirit). At the bottom center of the poster, there is a black Chinese slogan "当/今/社/会/紧/缺/奉献/美/德/也" (Today's society lacks the virtue of dedication), with a line of smaller black English text below it: "POPULAR GOURMET FEAST WAITING FOR YOU TO TASTE". In the bottom left corner, there is a small black watermark "素材天下 sucaisucai.com 编号:00631486". The overall composition is simple, combining imagery and text to convey the theme of dedication.

prompt_cn: 这是一张宣传现代民乐演出的海报。画面主体分为左右两部分：左侧为深色背景，带有抽象的乐器弦乐器局部特写，右侧为纯红色背景。左上角有“POSITION: ORCHESTRA_01”标签，下方是白色大字标题“现代民乐动态”及其英文副标题“MODERN FOLK DYNAMIC”。标题下方是关于演出的介绍性文字“以丝竹管弦勾勒时代轮廓，在律动中重塑民族音乐的灵魂共鸣。”，再下方是四个深灰色背景、白色文字和边框的乐器标签：“琵琶”、“二胡”、“古筝”、“打击乐”。海报右侧红色区域垂直排布着白色大字标题“民族魂韵”及其英文副标题“SOUL OF THE NATION”。海报底部左侧是白色文字的演出团体名称“华夏民族乐团”及其英文“HUAXIA NATIONAL ORCHESTRA”，右侧是红色文字的日期“2024.12.28”和地点“国家大剧院·音乐厅”。
prompt_en: This is a poster promoting a modern folk music performance. The main visual is divided into two vertical sections: the left side features a dark background with an abstract close-up of musical instrument strings, while the right side has a solid red background. In the upper left, there is a label "POSITION: ORCHESTRA_01", below which is the main title "现代民乐动态" (Modern Folk Dynamic) in large white characters, followed by its English subtitle "MODERN FOLK DYNAMIC". Below the title is introductory text about the performance: "以丝竹管弦勾勒时代轮廓，在律动中重塑民族音乐的灵魂共鸣。" (Using strings and winds to outline the era, reshaping the soul resonance of national music in rhythm.). Further below are four instrument tags with dark gray backgrounds, white text, and borders: "琵琶" (Pipa), "二胡" (Erhu), "古筝" (Guzheng), and "打击乐" (Percussion). On the right red section of the poster, the large white vertical title "民族魂韵" (Soul of the Nation) is displayed, along with its English subtitle "SOUL OF THE NATION". At the bottom left of the poster is the performance group's name "华夏民族乐团" (Huaxia National Orchestra) in white text, with its English translation "HUAXIA NATIONAL ORCHESTRA". On the bottom right, the date "2024.12.28" and location "国家大剧院·音乐厅" (National Centre for the Performing Arts · Concert Hall) are shown in red text.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的西文字体解剖学信息图，标题为“西文字体解剖学”及其英文副标题。图片右上角有“| T-1040”标识和一个红色方框，内含俄文“ОДОБРЕНО”和中文“控制局核准”字样。右侧红色区域内是“排版指令 NO. 09”及其说明文字，下方附有一个参数表格，列出了“标准栅格跨度”、“小写字高比例”等项目及其“标准数值”。图片主体分为三个编号部分。第一部分“垂直度量体系与基准线规范”包含文字说明和一个图示，展示了字符“h”和“p”在升部线、大写线、主线、基线和降部线上的垂直度量。第二部分“笔画终止端与衬线局部解剖”包含文字说明和一个图示，解剖了衬线、托脚和主干的结构。第三部分“历史分类技术特性表”包含文字说明和一个表格，按“分类标准”、“典型字形”、“衬线几何特征”和“笔画粗细对比”对五种西文字体进行了分类。图片底部有版权信息、稿件编号和秘密等级。
prompt_en: This is an infographic on the structural anatomy of Latin typefaces, featuring the title "西文字体解剖学" and its English subtitle. The top right corner displays an identifier "| T-1040" and a red box with "ОДОБРЕНО" in Russian and "控制局核准" in Chinese. A red sidebar on the right contains "排版指令 NO. 09" with explanatory text, followed by a parameter table listing items like "标准栅格跨度" (Standard Grid Span) and "小写字高比例" (Lowercase Height Ratio) with their "标准数值" (Standard Values). The main content is divided into three numbered sections. Section 01, "垂直度量体系与基准线规范" (Vertical Measurement System and Baseline Specification), includes descriptive text and a diagram illustrating the vertical metrics of characters 'h' and 'p' across ascender, cap height, x-height, baseline, and descender lines. Section 02, "笔画终止端与衬线局部解剖" (Anatomy of Stroke Terminals and Serifs), provides text and a diagram dissecting the structure of serif foot, bracket, and stem. Section 03, "历史分类技术特性表" (Historical Classification Technical Characteristics Table), presents text and a table classifying five types of Latin typefaces by "分类标准" (Classification Standard), "典型字形" (Typical Typeface), "衬线几何特征" (Serif Geometric Characteristics), and "笔画粗细对比" (Stroke Weight Contrast). The bottom of the image includes copyright information, a document number, and a security classification.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以粉色为主色调的婚礼邀请函。图片顶部和底部有波浪状的粉色装饰边。邀请函主体是一个浅粉色圆角矩形卡片，背景是柔和的粉色渐变。卡片顶部中央是红色的“囍”字，右侧有“甜蜜限定”字样。下方是标题“童话梦幻·婚礼盛典”，以及英文副标题“PREMIUM LOVE & SWEET ETERNITY”。卡片中部显示“新郎 & 新娘”，下方是新人的名字“盛星阑 ❤️ 洛梦瑶”，名字之间有一个红色心形图标。再下方是“诚邀您见证我们的幸福时刻”的邀请语。卡片下半部分分为左右两栏。左栏标题为“幸福成分表”，包含“真爱含量 100%”、“浪漫指数 999mg”、“甜蜜期限 永久”三项内容，下方有小字说明“* 每日推荐摄入量: 无限。本产品包含极高浓度的多巴胺与幸福感。”右栏包含“婚礼日期”和“婚礼地点”信息，具体为“2024年10月20日 农历九月十八 11:58”和“幻镜森林·糖果城堡 梦幻大道888号 宴会厅”。日期和地点信息旁分别配有日历和定位图标。右栏底部有一个条形码图案和编码“LOVE-20241020-5201314”。卡片底部有一条虚线，线上写着“沿此虚线 开启 幸福 之 旅”，两侧各有一个三角形箭头图标。图片中还散布着糖果和棒棒糖等装饰性小图标。
prompt_en: This is a wedding invitation primarily in pink tones. The top and bottom edges of the image feature wavy pink decorative borders. The main body of the invitation is a light pink rounded rectangular card set against a soft pink gradient background. At the top center of the card is a red "囍" character, with "甜蜜限定" (Sweet Limited) to its right. Below this is the main title "童话梦幻·婚礼盛典" (Fairytale Dream · Wedding Ceremony), followed by the English subtitle "PREMIUM LOVE & SWEET ETERNITY". The middle section of the card displays "新郎 & 新娘" (Groom & Bride), and below that are the names of the couple, "盛星阑 ❤️ 洛梦瑶", with a red heart icon between them. Further down is the invitation phrase "诚邀您见证我们的幸福时刻" (Sincerely invite you to witness our happy moment). The lower half of the card is divided into two columns. The left column is titled "幸福成分表" (Happiness Ingredient List), containing three items: "真爱含量 100%" (True Love Content 100%), "浪漫指数 999mg" (Romance Index 999mg), and "甜蜜期限 永久" (Sweetness Duration Permanent). Below these is a small note: "* 每日推荐摄入量: 无限。本产品包含极高浓度的多巴胺与幸福感。" (* Daily recommended intake: Unlimited. This product contains extremely high concentrations of dopamine and happiness.). The right column provides "婚礼日期" (Wedding Date) and "婚礼地点" (Wedding Venue) information: "2024年10月20日 农历九月十八 11:58" and "幻镜森林·糖果城堡 梦幻大道888号 宴会厅" (Fantasy Forest · Candy Castle, Dream Avenue No. 888, Banquet Hall). Calendar and location icons accompany the date and venue information, respectively. At the bottom of the right column, there is a barcode pattern and the code "LOVE-20241020-5201314". A dashed line runs across the bottom of the card with the text "沿此虚线 开启 幸福 之 旅" (Follow this dashed line to start the journey of happiness), flanked by triangular arrow icons. Small decorative icons like candies and lollipops are also scattered throughout the image.

Overlaid on the bottom left of this image are white Chinese characters "静谧 · 悦鉴" (Serene · Appreciation). Below the image, the main Chinese title of the event, "邻里见面鸡尾酒会" (Neighborhood Cocktail Party), is presented in a large, bold font. Following the main title is a paragraph of Chinese text describing the purpose and atmosphere of the invitation. Below this text, the information is divided into two columns: the left column lists "时间 / TIME" (Time) with the specific date "2024年11月18日" (November 18, 2024) and time "19:00 - 21:30"; the right column lists "地点 / VENUE" (Venue) with the address "翡翠云邸 8号楼 顶层私人露台" (Emerald Cloud Mansion Building 8, Top Floor Private Terrace). At the bottom left of the page, there is a closing remark "期待您的光临" (Looking forward to your presence) and the signature "林语堂 夫妇 敬约" (Sincerely, Lin Yutang and Wife). The bottom right corner features a circular icon with vertically arranged Chinese characters "橄榄枝" (Olive Branch).

这是一张宣传学术活动的深色海报。海报背景是模糊的图书馆书架图像，营造出学术氛围。版面采用左右两栏布局，左侧为纯深灰色背景，右侧背景是半透明覆盖在书架图像之上。海报整体以深灰色为主色调，文字为白色，并以红色作为点缀色。
左侧区域，顶部有一个红色方框，框内垂直排列着白色汉字“座谈”。下方是超大号白色汉字“话硕博对”，同样垂直排列。再下方是四行小字“未来 研路 同行 智启”，也呈垂直排列。
右侧区域，顶部有一条红色横线，旁边是英文“EDUCATION & RESEARCH”。下方是两行大号白色中文标题“跨学科视野下的 学术创新与科研范式变革”。中部列出了“对话嘉宾 / GUESTS”和“核心议题 / TOPICS”两个小节，分别包含“国家重点实验室博士生讲师团 优秀硕士研究生代表”和带有项目符号的“科研思维的构建与突破 跨学科协作的实践路径”。右下角有一个红色菱形符号，后跟地点信息“大学礼堂二楼”，下方是活动日期和时间“2024年11月20日 (周三) 14:30 - 17:00”。最右下角是大型数字“02”和英文“ACADEMIC FORUM”。

This is a dark poster promoting an academic event. The background features a blurred image of library bookshelves, creating an academic atmosphere. The layout is divided into two columns: the left column has a solid dark gray background, while the right column's background is semi-transparent, overlaid on the bookshelf image. The poster's overall color scheme is dark gray, with white text and red accents.
In the left section, at the top, there is a red box containing the vertically arranged white Chinese characters "座谈". Below this, the large white Chinese characters "话硕博对" are also vertically arranged. Further down, four lines of smaller text, "未来 研路 同行 智启", are vertically stacked.
In the right section, at the top, there is a red horizontal line next to the English text "EDUCATION & RESEARCH". Below it are two lines of large white Chinese characters forming the main title: "跨学科视野下的 学术创新与科研范式变革". The middle part lists two sections, "对话嘉宾 / GUESTS" and "核心议题 / TOPICS", which include "国家重点实验室博士生讲师团 优秀硕士研究生代表" and bulleted items "科研思维的构建与突破 跨学科协作的实践路径" respectively. In the bottom right, a red diamond symbol precedes the location information "大学礼堂二楼", followed by the event date and time "2024年11月20日 (周三) 14:30 - 17:00". The very bottom right features a large number "02" and the English text "ACADEMIC FORUM".

prompt_cn: 这是一张以红色为主色调的新年祝福海报。画面中央是一个米白色的矩形区域，上面用书法字体写着主要的祝福语。顶部是金色的“海永谨祝哥哥”，下方是红色的“马年新春愉快,”和“身体健康万事如意”。“万事如意”前有一个红色的祥云图案。海报背景是红色纹理，四周装饰着丰富的春节元素。左上角悬挂着两盏红灯笼。右上角有粉色梅花枝和一片红色折扇，以及一个红色菱形框内的白色“福”字。右侧边缘垂下一串红色鞭炮，下方有一匹棕色骏马向左奔跑，右下角堆叠着几枚金色铜钱。左侧中部有一个红色方形框内的白色“福”字。左下角有几片红色折扇，其中一个扇面上印有马的剪影和“福”字。整体画面喜庆，充满节日气氛。

At the top, in gold, are the characters "海永谨祝哥哥" (Haiyong sincerely wishes brother), followed below by red characters "马年新春愉快," (Happy New Year of the Horse,) and "身体健康万事如意" (Good health and all wishes come true). A red auspicious cloud pattern precedes "万事如意". The poster's background features a red texture, adorned with rich Spring Festival elements. Two red lanterns hang in the upper left corner. The upper right corner features pink plum blossoms, a red folding fan, and a white "福" (Fu, meaning blessing) character within a red rhombus frame. A string of red firecrackers hangs down the right edge, below which a brown horse gallops to the left, and several gold coins are stacked in the lower right corner. In the middle left, there is a white "福" character within a red square frame. The lower left corner has several red folding fans, one of which features a horse silhouette and a "福" character. The overall image is festive and full of holiday spirit.

Constituent Profiles
Fragrance is defined by the kinetic energy of molecules. Top notes consist of small molecules (citrus, aldehydes) that escape rapidly. Heart notes form the core identity, while heavy-molecule fixatives (woods, resins) anchor the scent.
HIGH VOLATILITY (TOP)
Limonene, Linalool, Bergamot, Neroli, Peppermint. These provide the initial "hook" and sharp freshness.
MEDIUM VOLATILITY (HEART)
Geraniol (Rose), Eugenol (Clove), Jasmine Absolute, Ylang-Ylang. These dictate the perfume's family classification.
LOW VOLATILITY (BASE)
Ambroxan, Vanillin, Cedrol (Cedarwood), Oakmoss, Musk. High molecular weight allows for long-term skin adhesion.
Evaporation Intensity Curve
Technical Specifications
Intensity
The persistence of a fragrance is quantified by its evaporation coefficient. Fixatives, such as resins or synthetic musk, are added to lower the vapor pressure of more volatile components, effectively slowing their release. The "Heart" of the perfume serves as the bridge, smoothing the transition between the fugitive head and the heavy base. In professional perfumery, the balance is achieved through the calculation of molecular weights and boiling points. Modern compositions often utilize 'linear' structures, but the classical pyramid remains the authoritative standard for fine fragrance design.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于经典香水金字塔结构的信息图。图片顶部是主标题“THE CLASSICAL FRAGRANCE PYRAMID”及其副标题“Structural Dynamics of Volatility & Olfactory Classification”。主体内容分为左右两列，并由金色线条分隔。左侧上半部分展示了一个香水挥发结构金字塔图，标示了前调、中调和基调及其持续时间。金字塔下方是一段关于香水分子动能的解释性文字。右侧上半部分是一个表格，标题为“Concentration Standards”，列出了不同香水类型（如Parfum、Eau de Parfum）的提取物浓度和持续时间。右侧中部是“Constituent Profiles”部分，详细描述了高、中、低挥发性香料的成分及其特点。左侧下半部分是“Evaporation Intensity Curve”曲线图，描绘了香水前调、中调和基调的挥发强度随时间的变化，X轴为时间（0到24小时），Y轴为强度。右侧下半部分是“Technical Specifications”部分，包含一段关于香水持久性、挥发系数和专业调香平衡的详细说明。图片底部是页脚信息，包括“Imperial Perfumery Archives”、“PLATE NO. 084 — CLASSIFICATION”和“Strictly Academic • MDCCXCI”。整张图以米色背景为主，搭配深红色和金色元素，布局清晰，信息丰富。
prompt_en: This is an infographic illustrating the classical fragrance pyramid structure. The top of the image features the main title "THE CLASSICAL FRAGRANCE PYRAMID" and its subtitle "Structural Dynamics of Volatility & Olfactory Classification". The main content is divided into two columns, separated by golden lines. The upper left section displays a fragrance volatility architecture pyramid diagram, indicating top, heart, and base notes along with their durations. prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个粉丝管理后台的用户界面截图。界面布局清晰，主要分为顶部导航栏、左侧边栏和右侧主内容区。顶部导航栏包含“粉丝管理”标题、一个带有“搜索粉丝...”占位符的搜索框以及一个蓝色的“新建分组”按钮。左侧边栏是粉丝分组列表，其中“全部粉丝”项被蓝色背景高亮选中，并显示数量“12.8k”。下方还有“特别关注”、“新晋粉丝”和“黑名单”等分组及其对应的数量。左侧边栏底部是一个蓝色背景的统计区域，显示“本月新增”数据为“+2,431”。右侧主内容区以两列三行的网格布局展示了六个粉丝的用户卡片。每个卡片都包含用户头像、用户名（如“极客先锋_Alex”、“设计美学馆”）、一个彩色标签（如“互粉”、“特关”、“关注”、“新粉”）、简短描述以及“发消息”和“管理”两个操作按钮。界面底部是一个状态栏，显示“全部粉丝 (12,840)”的总数、更新时间“更新于 14:30”以及带有绿色圆点的“实时同步”状态。整体界面以白色背景为主，蓝色作为主要强调色，灰色用于普通文本和未选中项。
prompt_en: This image displays a user interface screenshot of a fan management backend. The interface has a clear layout, primarily divided into a top navigation bar, a left sidebar, and a right main content area. The top navigation bar includes the title "粉丝管理" (Fan Management), a search bar with the placeholder "搜索粉丝..." (Search Fans...), and a blue "新建分组" (Create Group) button. The left sidebar contains a fan group list, where "全部粉丝" (All Fans) is highlighted with a blue background and shows a count of "12.8k". Below it are other groups like "特别关注" (Special Follows), "新晋粉丝" (New Fans), and "黑名单" (Blacklist), each with their respective counts. At the bottom of the left sidebar is a blue-background statistics area, displaying "本月新增" (New this Month) data as "+2,431". The right main content area presents six fan user cards in a two-column, three-row grid layout. Each card includes a user avatar, username (e.g., "极客先锋_Alex", "设计美学馆"), a colored tag (e.g., "互粉" (Mutual Follow), "特关" (Special Follow), "关注" (Follow), "新粉" (New Fan)), a brief description, and two action buttons: "发消息" (Send Message) and "管理" (Manage). The bottom of the interface features a status bar, showing the total count "全部粉丝 (12,840)" (All Fans (12,840)), the update time "更新于 14:30" (Updated at 14:30), and a "实时同步" (Real-time Sync) status with a green dot. The overall interface uses a white background, with blue as the primary accent color, and gray for regular text and unselected items.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于全球火山类型分布与内部解剖的信息图表。图表以深蓝色为背景，大部分文字为白色或浅灰色。顶部是主标题“全球火山类型分布与内部解剖图”及其英文副标题。下方内容分为三个主要区域：左侧列出了火山相关的统计数据，如活跃火山数量、板块边界分布比例、最高爆发指数和基性岩浆温度；中间是一个极坐标图，标题为“喷发强度与频率极坐标图”，用不同颜色区域（如蓝色、绿色、红色）表示火山喷发的强度和频率，并标注了“VEI 0-2 (Frequent)”和“Catastrophic”等信息；右侧是一个火山内部结构剖面图，展示了火山口、侧喷口、中央岩喉和岩浆房等组成部分，并配有关于岩浆粘稠度与火山形态关系的文字说明。图表下方进一步详细介绍了三种火山类型：成层火山、盾状火山和火山渣锥，每种类型都包含坡度、成分、特征和范例。最底部是一个表格，列出了六个具体火山的名称、地理位置、类型、海拔、历史最大VEI和最近活动时间。图表底部还注明了数据来源。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing global volcanic classification and internal anatomy. The chart features a dark blue background with most text in white or light gray. At the top, there is a main title "全球火山类型分布与内部解剖图" and its English subtitle. The content below is divided into three main sections: the left column presents statistical data related to volcanoes, such as the number of active volcanoes, plate boundary alignment percentage, maximum explosivity index, and basaltic magma temperature; the middle section displays a polar chart titled "喷发强度与频率极坐标图 / ERUPTION INTENSITY DISTRIBUTION," using different colored areas (e.g., blue, green, red) to represent eruption intensity and frequency, with labels like "VEI 0-2 (Frequent)" and "Catastrophic"; the right section shows an internal anatomy diagram of a volcano, illustrating components such as the crater, vent, conduit, and magma chamber, accompanied by text explaining the relationship between magma viscosity and volcano morphology. Below these sections, the infographic further details three volcano types: Stratovolcano, Shield Volcano, and Cinder Cone, each including information on slope, composition, characteristics, and examples. At the very bottom, a table lists six specific volcanoes with their names, locations, types, elevations, historical maximum VEI, and last active dates. The data source is also provided at the bottom of the chart.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张以浅米色为背景的百日宴邀请函，背景上带有规则的浅色点状图案。邀请函中央是一个圆角矩形边框，其中包含一张黑白照片，照片中两只白色小兔子在草地上。图片右下角的照片上叠加有白色文字“100 DAYS”。邀请函的文字内容结构清晰，分为顶部标题区、照片下方的正文区、中部的事件详情区和底部的联系信息区。顶部标题包括浅棕色的英文“CELEBRATION”和中文“百日之喜”，以及浅棕色的副标题“兔宝宝温馨百日宴邀请函”。照片下方是深棕色的“初见惊喜·百日欢愉”，接着是浅棕色“我们的小兔子”和深棕色“沐沐”以及浅棕色“满百天啦！”，随后是浅棕色的“诚邀您共赴这场梦幻的童话派对”和“分享这份成长的喜悦与甜蜜”。事件详情区采用左右两栏布局，左侧是浅棕色的标签“时间”、“地点”、“地址”，右侧是深棕色的对应信息：“2024年11月18日 (周日) 12:00”、“云端童话酒店·3楼星光厅”和“北京市朝阳区 梦幻路88号”。底部信息区同样是左右两栏布局，左侧是浅棕色的“席设:”和深棕色的“张先生 & 李女士 敬邀”，右侧是浅棕色的“RSVP:”和深棕色的电话号码“138-0000-8888”。
prompt_en: This image is a 100-day celebration invitation card with a light beige background featuring a regular light-colored dotted pattern. At the center of the invitation is a rounded rectangular frame containing a black and white photograph of two white bunnies on grass. The white text "100 DAYS" is overlaid on the bottom right of the photo. The text content of the invitation is clearly structured, divided into a top title area, a body text area below the photo, a central event details area, and a bottom contact information area. The top title includes the light brown English text "CELEBRATION" and the Chinese "百日之喜", followed by the light brown subtitle "兔宝宝温馨百日宴邀请函". Below the photo is the dark brown text "初见惊喜·百日欢愉", followed by the light brown "我们的小兔子", the dark brown "沐沐", and the light brown "满百天啦！", then the light brown "诚邀您共赴这场梦幻的童话派对" and "分享这份成长的喜悦与甜蜜". The event details section uses a two-column layout, with light brown labels "时间" (Time), "地点" (Location), "地址" (Address) on the left, and corresponding dark brown information on the right: "2024年11月18日 (周日) 12:00", "云端童话酒店·3楼星光厅", and "北京市朝阳区 梦幻路88号". The bottom information section also uses a two-column layout, with the light brown "席设:" (Hosted by:) and dark brown "张先生 & 李女士 敬邀" (Mr. Zhang & Ms. Li cordially invite) on the left, and the light brown "RSVP:" and dark brown phone number "138-0000-8888" on the right.

A circular area in the center of the poster displays a close-up of an exquisite embroidery piece, featuring pink flowers, yellow centers, green leaves, and small yellow beads on a blue fabric with lighter blue patterns. The bottom-left section provides detailed event information, including an introductory text about embroidery, followed by "时间 / TIME 每周六 14:00 - 17:00" (Time / TIME Every Saturday 14:00 - 17:00) and "地点 / VENUE 青花艺术空间 3F" (Location / VENUE Qinghua Art Space 3F). prompt_cn: 这是一张数字插画，画面中央是一只可爱的卡通猫咪。猫咪拥有棕白相间的毛发，大而圆的眼睛，头上戴着一个镶有闪亮装饰的红色蝴蝶结。它身穿一件华丽的红色礼服，礼服带有泡泡袖，裙摆上装饰着金色的复杂花纹和闪烁的亮片。背景简洁，上半部分是白色到浅灰色的渐变，下半部分是深灰色。图片顶部居中位置有两行深红色中文文字，内容是“永远不要相信运气会从天降，时刻牢记脚踏实地努力才能收获免得后悔”。整个画面构图简洁，文字与猫咪形象共同传达出一种积极向上的氛围。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration featuring a cute cartoon cat in the center. The cat has brown and white striped fur, large round eyes, and wears a red bow adorned with sparkling embellishments on its head. It is dressed in an elaborate red gown with puff sleeves, and the skirt is decorated with intricate golden patterns and shimmering sequins. The background is simple, with a gradient from white to light gray in the upper part and dark gray in the lower part. At the top center of the image, there are two lines of dark red Chinese text that read: '永远不要相信运气会从天降，时刻牢记脚踏实地努力才能收获免得后悔' (Never believe that luck will fall from the sky; always remember that only through down-to-earth effort can you achieve success and avoid regret). The overall composition is simple, with the text and the cat's image jointly conveying a positive and uplifting atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张手机游戏活动宣传图，画面中央是一个深灰色木纹质感的UI面板，展示了每日登录奖励列表。面板顶部是标题“每日登录,好礼相送!”，下方显示“活动剩余时间:5天5小时”。奖励列表分为五行，每行左侧标有“第 X 天”，中间是两个奖励物品图标，分别标有数量“10”和“100”，右侧是“领取”按钮。UI面板左侧有一名深色短发、身着白色上衣和蓝色裙子的动漫风格女性角色，其部分身体被面板遮挡。面板右侧有一名金色短发、戴飞行眼镜、穿黄色外套的动漫风格女性角色，其手臂部分遮挡了面板边缘。图片底部是金色大字标题“新手必送”和副标题“连抽狂欢 登录即送”，左下角还有一个带有金色羽毛和徽章的装饰性图标。整体色调偏暖，以棕色、金色、黄色为主，辅以白色和蓝色，文字内容清晰地传达了游戏登录奖励活动信息。
prompt_en: This is a promotional image for a mobile game event. In the center of the image is a dark gray wood-textured UI panel, displaying a daily login reward list. The panel's top features the title '每日登录,好礼相送!' (Daily Login, Great Gifts!), and below it shows '活动剩余时间:5天5小时' (Event Remaining Time: 5 Days 5 Hours). The reward list is divided into five rows, each labeled '第 X 天' (Day X) on the left, with two reward item icons in the middle, marked with quantities '10' and '100' respectively, and a '领取' (Claim) button on the right. To the left of the UI panel is an anime-style female character with dark short hair, wearing a white top and a blue skirt, with part of her body obscured by the panel. To the right of the panel is another anime-style female character with golden short hair, wearing flight goggles and a yellow jacket, with her arm partially obscuring the panel's edge. At the bottom of the image are a large golden title '新手必送' (Newbie Must-Have) and a subtitle '连抽狂欢 登录即送' (Continuous Draws Carnival, Login to Get), along with a decorative icon featuring a golden feather and a badge in the bottom left. The overall color scheme is warm, predominantly brown, gold, and yellow, complemented by white and blue, and the text clearly conveys information about the game's login reward event.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑色为背景的音乐剧演唱会宣传海报。海报顶部左侧是“上海东方艺术中心”及其英文名称和标志。海报中央上方，金色手写体英文“Classic Edition Rock Version”与白色大字“酣畅 伦敦西区 音乐剧明星演唱会”共同构成了主标题。标题下方，左右两侧各有一个黄色爆炸形状的横幅，分别标示“六大明星”和“原班乐队”，中间是“MUSICAL STAR CONCERT”字样，并有“经典版”和“摇滚版”的垂直标签。海报中部列出了演出信息：2024年11月1日至2日19:30，地点为上海东方艺术中心·音乐厅，票价从180元到680元不等。海报下半部分展示了六位表演者的彩色半身肖像，从左至右依次为乔艾娜·莫西斯、露西·奥伯恩、迈克·斯特林、肖娜·林赛、蒂姆·奥克斯布罗和斯蒂芬·约翰·戴维斯。每位表演者肖像上方都垂直标注了其英文名、中文名及其代表角色（如《狮子王》娜拉、《悲惨世界》芳汀等）。海报底部居中是售票热线、售票网址和详细地址。右下角是“STARS OF THE WEST END SING THE ROCK MUSICALS”的活动系列标志。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a musical concert, set against a black background. At the top left, the poster features the logo and name of "上海东方艺术中心" (Shanghai Oriental Art Center) in both Chinese and English. In the upper central part of the poster, the main title is formed by the golden, handwritten English text "Classic Edition Rock Version" and the large white Chinese characters "酣畅 伦敦西区 音乐剧明星演唱会" (Uninhibited West End Musical Star Concert). Below the main title, two yellow starburst banners on the left and right highlight "六大明星" (Six Stars) and "原班乐队" (Original Band), respectively. Between them, the text "MUSICAL STAR CONCERT" is displayed, along with vertical labels "经典版" (Classic Edition) and "摇滚版" (Rock Version). The middle section of the poster provides event details: November 1-2, 2024, at 19:30, held at the Shanghai Oriental Art Center Concert Hall, with ticket prices ranging from 180 to 680 yuan. The lower half of the poster showcases six color half-body portraits of the performers, arranged from left to right: Joelle Moses, Lucy O'Byrne, Mike Sterling, Shona Lindsay, Tim Oxbrow, and Stephen John Davis. Above each performer's portrait, their English name, Chinese name, and representative role (e.g., Nala from The Lion King, Fantine from Les Misérables) are vertically listed. At the bottom center of the poster, contact information including a ticketing hotline, website, and detailed address is provided. In the bottom right corner, the event series logo "STARS OF THE WEST END SING THE ROCK MUSICALS" is visible.

They are dressed in futuristic suits or spacesuits, with their hands clasped together in the middle of the image. The male character, with silver hair, is on the right, gazing gently down at the female character on the left; the female character, with black hair, looks up, meeting his gaze. The background is minimalist, composed of semi-transparent light brown rectangular and light gray circular geometric patterns. The dominant colors are white, light gray, blue (for the man's uniform), and the characters' skin tones. Three pieces of text information are overlaid on the image: "GM | Elena" in small white text is in the mid-right, "Aurora & Orion" in large dark blue script font is at the bottom right, and "©SpaceExploration" in small white text is at the bottom left.

prompt_cn: 这是一张地质学手册页面，深色背景上展示了关于中国五岳地质构造的详细信息。页面顶部是标题“FIVE GREAT MOUNTAINS: GEOTECTONIC MANUAL”和副标题，右上角红色方框内标有“SEC. 05 CHINA ATLAS”。页面包含两个主要图表。图1题为“EXPLODED BLOCK DIAGRAM OF OROGEN ASSEMBLY”，展示了五个编号的立体块状地质结构，通过红色箭头和虚线指示其分解关系。图1右侧的表格列出了五座山脉的名称、海拔和地质特征。表格下方是一个红色标题的警告框“WARNING: SHEAR SLIP RISK”，提供了关于华山地质稳定性的具体说明。图1下方还有三段编号的文字说明，阐述了地质构造的锚定、花岗岩侵入和地层暴露等步骤。图2题为“NORMAL AND THRUST FAULT MECHANICS”，描绘了一个地质断层剖面图，并标注了“HANGING WALL”、“FOOTWALL”和“FAULT PLANE”。图2右侧的表格详细列出了剪切模量、摩擦系数、抬升速度和抗压强度等多种地质力学参数。页面底部是页脚信息，包括手册编号、出版部门和页码。部分标题、编号和箭头使用红色突出显示。
prompt_en: This is a geology manual page, set against a dark background, presenting detailed information about the geotectonic structures of China's Five Great Mountains. The page features a top title "FIVE GREAT MOUNTAINS: GEOTECTONIC MANUAL" and a subtitle, with "SEC. 05 CHINA ATLAS" in a red box at the top right. The page contains two main figures. Figure 1, titled "EXPLODED BLOCK DIAGRAM OF OROGEN ASSEMBLY", illustrates five numbered three-dimensional block geological structures, with red arrows and dashed lines indicating their exploded view relationships. To the right of Figure 1, a table lists the names, elevations, and tectonic features of the five mountains. Below the table, a warning box with a red title "WARNING: SHEAR SLIP RISK" provides specific instructions regarding the geological stability of Hua Shan. Below Figure 1, there are also three numbered text blocks explaining steps such as anchoring the basement, granite intrusion, and strata exposure. Figure 2, titled "NORMAL AND THRUST FAULT MECHANICS", depicts a geological fault cross-section diagram, labeled "HANGING WALL", "FOOTWALL", and "FAULT PLANE". To the right of Figure 2, a table details various geomechanical parameters, including shear modulus, friction coefficient, uplift velocity, and compressive strength. The page footer at the bottom includes the manual number, publishing department, and page number. Some titles, numbers, and arrows are highlighted in red.

In the center of the interface is a candlestick chart composed of green and red bars. The top-left corner of the chart indicates the specific values for Open (O), High (H), Low (L), and Close (C) prices. To the right of the interface is an "Order Book" panel, listing prices in red and green, and corresponding quantities in white. The bottom-left corner features time period selection buttons, including "1H", "4H", and "1D", with the "1H" button highlighted in blue. The bottom-middle section contains a zoom control area, showing the current zoom level as "165%", along with "MIN", "MAX" labels, and plus/minus buttons. Additionally, there are "Auto" and "Reset" function buttons in the bottom-right corner.

中列标题为“02 / INTERMEDIATE SPECTRUM (间色)”，下方是“>>> MIXING COEFFICIENTS”及两个“>>>”符号。一个表格列出了“JIANSE”、“COMPOSITION”、“SEASON”和“STATUS”，其中“STATUS”列的单元格背景色有绿色（ACTIVE）和红色（DANGER）。表格下方是“>>> VALVE SCHEMATIC >>>”标题和一个简单的流程图，显示“CHI”和“HEI”流入“MIX”，然后流向“ZI”。图例为“FIG 2.0: JIANSE MIXING & VALVE ROUTING SEQUENCE”。
右列标题为“03 / CRITICAL CORRESPONDENCES”，下方深色框内是“EMERGENCY DIRECTION ALIGNMENT”文本。接着是三个编号的描述，分别关于“HUANG (黄 / Yellow)”、“BAI (白 / White)”和“HEI (黑 / Black)”。底部有两个图标框，左侧是“LIFE RING DEPLOYMENT”和一个救生圈图标，右侧是“LIFE VEST PROTOCOL”和一个救生衣图标。最下方是一个黄色背景的“NOTICE”文本框。

The left column is titled '01 / ORTHOGONAL SYSTEM (正色)', with a critical system directive text in an orange box below it. A circular concentric axis diagram displays the correspondence between the five elements and directions. The center is orange 'HUANG', surrounded by green 'HEI' (NORTH [WATER]), yellow 'BAI' (WEST [METAL]), green 'QING' (EAST [WOOD]), and red 'CHI' (SOUTH [FIRE]). Below the diagram is the caption 'FIG 1.0: CONCENTRIC AXIS AND ELEMENT STATIONS' and two numbered descriptions about 'QING (青 / Azure)' and 'CHI (赤 / Crimson)'.
The middle column is titled '02 / INTERMEDIATE SPECTRUM (间色)', followed by '>>> MIXING COEFFICIENTS' and two '>>>' symbols. A table lists 'JIANSE', 'COMPOSITION', 'SEASON', and 'STATUS', with 'STATUS' column cells having green ('ACTIVE') and red ('DANGER') backgrounds. Below the table is the title '>>> VALVE SCHEMATIC >>>' and a simple flowchart showing 'CHI' and 'HEI' flowing into 'MIX', then to 'ZI'. The caption is 'FIG 2.0: JIANSE MIXING & VALVE ROUTING SEQUENCE'.
The right column is titled '03 / CRITICAL CORRESPONDENCES', with 'EMERGENCY DIRECTION ALIGNMENT' text in a dark box below it. This is followed by three numbered descriptions about 'HUANG (黄 / Yellow)', 'BAI (白 / White)', and 'HEI (黑 / Black)'. At the bottom, there are two icon boxes: 'LIFE RING DEPLOYMENT' with a lifebuoy icon on the left, and 'LIFE VEST PROTOCOL' with a life vest icon on the right. The very bottom features a yellow-background 'NOTICE' text box.

text:
Abbott
HOW CORONAVIRUS
(SARS-COV-2) MOLECULAR
TESTING WORKS
Molecular testing helps detect the presence of a SARS-CoV-2
or coronavirus infection. Here's how it works.
1
An upper respiratory tract
swab collects a mucus
sample for testing
2
The sample is mixed with
reagents, which break open
the virus and release its genetic
material, the viral RNA
3
The reagents recognize a unique section
of the coronavirus genome, while ignoring
other viruses even if they're similar strains
4
The virus genome is replicated
from a few target molecules up
to a billion, making the virus
more detectable
5
Abbott's molecular test
provides results to the
healthcare provider
TEST RESULTS
2020
12:00pm
Patient ID: 2450000
P
User ID: admin
Negative
Negative
Procedural
Control Valid
New Test
Print
IMPORTANT TEST INFORMATION
The Abbott RealTime SARS-CoV-2 EUA has not been FDA cleared or approved. It has been authorized by FDA under an emergency use authorization for use by authorized laboratories. The test has been authorized only for the detection of nucleic acid from SARS-CoV-2, not for any other viruses or pathogens, and is only authorized for the duration of the declaration that circumstances exist justifying the authorization of emergency use of in vitro diagnostic tests for detection and/or diagnosis of COVID-19 under Section 564(b) (1) of the Act, 21 U.S.C. § 360bbb-3(b)(1), unless the authorization is terminated or revoked sooner.
ABBOTT.COM
@ABBOTTNEWS
@ABBOTTGLOBAL
ABBOTT

Each of the five steps (1-5) includes an illustration and a text description, covering the process from sample collection to result delivery. The commemorative coin is placed slightly above the center of the packaging box, and the certificate is in the bottom right corner of the image, partially obscured. At the center of the poster is a dark hotpot filled with red spicy soup, containing ingredients like chili peppers and blood tofu, with a slice of raw meat falling into it from the left. The background features flame and smoke effects. At the top, there is a brand logo "稿定" and header text "(人间美味) GAO DING (香辣美味) HUO GUO {2025}". The main titles "热辣开场 尽享美味" are displayed in white, bold, handwritten style, followed by the slogan "热气腾腾烟火气" and promotional text "指定鲜货菜品第2份半价!". In the mid-left, a golden oval label contains promotion details: "XIAN SHI YOU HUI *2025* 消费满200元 即赠冰粉一碗!". To the right of the hotpot are descriptive texts "藏不住的牛油香, 忘不掉的老味道". The bottom of the poster features large decorative texts "红红火火 SO HOT 热辣", along with footer information "GAO DING HUO HUO JI 2025" and a "稿定" watermark below a QR code in the bottom right.

The right panel is titled "RGB Parameters", accompanied by three small red, green, and blue dots. Inside, it displays sliders for red, green, and blue primary colors with corresponding values "255", "107", and "069". The bottom also lists CMYK color values "0, 58, 73, 0" and HSL color values "12°, 100%, 64%", with a "View History Log" link in the bottom right corner.

Leaning against a light-colored brick wall, she gently strokes her hair with her right hand, her head slightly lowered, looking towards the lower right. The photo is surrounded by a thin white border. To the left of the photo is a decorative element composed of several blue and brown dried leaves and a torn piece of lined paper, which appears to be taped to the background. In the lower right corner, a circular wax seal-like graphic partially covers the photo frame, containing the artistic English word "Moon". The lower left corner features the white "Canva" text and a brand logo.

0-200

Epipelagic Zone
The ocean is not a uniform mass of water but a structured environment divided into distinct layers based on light penetration, temperature, and hydrostatic pressure. As depth increases, the environment shifts from a sun-drenched nursery to a crushing, freezing void.
Known as the Sunlight Zone. This is the only layer where photosynthesis occurs, supporting 90% of all marine life. Primary inhabitants include phytoplankton, dolphins, and great white sharks. Temperature varies by latitude but remains the warmest of all layers.
200-1k
METERS
Mesopelagic Zone
The Twilight Zone. Only faint blue light reaches here. The thermocline—a region of rapid temperature decrease—is located in this layer. Many creatures, such as the Giant Squid and various lanternfish, possess bioluminescent organs for communication and hunting.
PHOTIC
DYSPHOTIC
1k-4k
METERS
Bathypelagic Zone
APHOTIC
The Midnight Zone. A world of perpetual darkness and immense pressure reaching 400 atmospheres. Temperature is constant at approximately 4°C. Predators like the Anglerfish use sit-and-wait tactics. Most organisms here are black or red for camouflage.
FIG 1.1: LIGHT ATTENUATION
GRADIENT ACROSS LAYERS.
extreme depths
Hadalpelagic Facts
Beyond the reach of the continental slope lie the vast plains and deep trenches of the inner earth. Here, life relies on “marine snow”— organic detritus falling from the upper layers— or chemosynthesis near hydrothermal vents.
Named after Hades, this zone consists of deep- sea trenches. The pressure at the bottom of the Mariana Trench exceeds 1,100 atmospheres— equivalent to an elephant standing on a human thumb.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于海洋深度分层的科普信息图，标题为“the deep blue descent”。图片采用深蓝色、白色、橙色和深灰色为主色调，整体布局分为上下两大部分。上半部分主要展示了远洋水体的垂直分层，左侧包含“VERTICAL PROFILE”副标题、一段关于海洋分层的介绍性文字，以及一个名为“FIG 1.1: LIGHT ATTENUATION GRADIENT ACROSS LAYERS.”的图表，该图表用不同深度的色块和文字（PHOTIC、DYSPHOTIC、APHOTIC）表示光线衰减。右侧则详细介绍了三个主要海洋区域：Epipelagic Zone（0-200 METERS）、Mesopelagic Zone（200-1k METERS）和Bathypelagic Zone（1k-4k METERS），每个区域都配有深度范围和详细描述。下半部分标题为“extreme depths”，左侧包含一段关于深海环境的文字和一张列出Abyssal和Hadal区域深度（4000-6000m, >6000m）及代表性生物（Tripod Fish, Snailfish）的表格。右侧有两个信息框，一个深绿色框标题为“Hadalpelagic Facts”，另一个橙色框标题为“The 4°C Constant”，分别提供了关于深海海沟和海洋温度稳定性的额外信息。图片底部是页脚，左侧显示“PLATE NO. 42 / VOL. III”，右侧是一句引言““The weight of the world is measured in fathoms.””。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about ocean depth stratification, titled "the deep blue descent". The image primarily uses deep blue, white, orange, and dark gray, with the overall layout divided into two main sections. The upper part mainly displays the vertical stratification of the pelagic water column. The left side includes a "VERTICAL PROFILE" subtitle, an introductory text about ocean stratification, and a diagram titled "FIG 1.1: LIGHT ATTENUATION GRADIENT ACROSS LAYERS.", which uses color blocks and text (PHOTIC, DYSPHOTIC, APHOTIC) at different depths to illustrate light attenuation. The right side details three main ocean zones: Epipelagic Zone (0-200 METERS), Mesopelagic Zone (200-1k METERS), and Bathypelagic Zone (1k-4k METERS), each accompanied by its depth range and a detailed description. prompt_cn: 这是一张以森林防火为主题的公益宣传海报。画面背景为深色粗糙纹理，可能模拟树皮或岩石，整体色调以红、白、黑为主。海报被一条垂直的隐形线分为左右两部分。左侧区域，顶部有白色英文“FOREST PROTECTION”，下方是巨大的白色中文主标题“森林防火”，标题下方有一条红色横线。左下角并列着两个白色边框的方块，分别写有白色中文标语“重于泰山”和“守法护林”。右侧区域，顶部是红色英文“FORESTRY BUREAU”和白色中文“林业局防火宣传站”，下方是红色副标题“法律法规告知”和一个红色圆点。其下方列出了三条编号的白色中文法律法规内容。右下角并列有白色英文标语“NO FIRE IN THE WILD”和“24HRS STANDBY”，下方是醒目的红色中文警告语“严禁野外用火 违法必究”。海报底部有一行红色页脚文字，包含中英文的防火提示信息。四个角落均有L形白色边框装饰。
prompt_en: This is a public service poster themed around forest fire prevention. The background features a dark, rough texture, possibly resembling tree bark or rock, with a dominant color scheme of red, white, and black. The poster is vertically divided into two main sections by an invisible line. On the left side, the top displays white English text "FOREST PROTECTION," followed by the large white Chinese main title "森林防火" (Forest Fire Prevention), with a red horizontal line beneath it. At the bottom left, two white-bordered boxes are arranged side-by-side, containing white Chinese slogans "重于泰山" (Heavier than Mount Tai, implying extreme importance) and "守法护林" (Abide by laws to protect forests). The right side features red English text "FORESTRY BUREAU" at the top, followed by white Chinese text "林业局防火宣传站" (Forestry Bureau Fire Prevention Publicity Station). Below this is a red subtitle "法律法规告知" (Legal Regulations Notice) accompanied by a red dot. Underneath, three numbered white Chinese legal provisions are listed. On top of the table sits a silver-grey metal planter, embossed with dark grey English text "FLOWERS & GARDEN", containing green plants. Beside it are a white ceramic pitcher and a wooden caddy holding gardening tools. To the left of the table, one drawer is slightly open, and a white cloth is draped over the right drawer. Below the table, on the shelf, there is a white round box, next to which is a black wire basket containing a cushion with a floral pattern. Behind the basket, on the ground, are a pair of green short boots. To the left of the frame, a small olive tree is planted in a corrugated metal bucket. The background features a light blue wooden plank wall, with a beige stone wall to its left. In the bottom left foreground, there is a brown woven rug. Light enters from the upper right, casting clear shadows on the table and the ground.

text:
风力发电机
HORIZONTAL AXIS WIND TURBINE (HAWT)
| 现代工业纪元 • 二十一世纪 / Modern Industrial Era, 21st Century
风力发电机乃是将大自然之动能转化为电能之巨型机械装置。其构造融合了流体力学与精密机械工程之精粹，是人类利用自然伟力之典范。
The wind turbine is a colossal mechanical apparatus designed to convert kinetic energy from the atmosphere into electrical power, representing a pinnacle of fluid dynamics and precision engineering.

100—400t

25 m/s

59.3% (Betz Limit)
输出电压 VOLTAGE
690 V — 35 kV
内部构造 / Mechanism
机舱内含增速齿轮箱，将低速转轴提升至每分钟1500转，驱动异步发电机产生电流。偏航系统确保机头始终对准主风向。
The nacelle houses a gearbox that increases shaft speed to 1500 RPM to drive the generator. A yaw system ensures the rotor faces the wind.

双馈式
变桨 Pitch
液压
贝茨极限理论 / The Betz Law
物理学家阿尔伯特•贝茨于1919年推导得出，风能转换机械能之理论效率极限为 16/27 (即 59.3%)。此为能量守恒定律在流体力学中之必然约束，现代风机之实际效率已逼近 45% 至 50%。
Albert Betz concluded in 1919 that no turbine can capture more than 59.3% of the kinetic energy in wind. Modern high-performance turbines reach 75% to 85% of this theoretical limit.

At the top, there is the title "风力发电机" with its English subtitle, followed by Chinese and English introductions to the principles of wind turbines. The center of the chart displays a simplified schematic side view of a wind turbine, labeling its main components such as rotor blades, nacelle, tower, and foundation, along with their dimensions or weight ranges. The lower part of the chart is divided into left and right columns and a bottom-centered section. The left column presents "技术规格 / Specifications," listing parameters like rotational speed, cut-in/cut-out wind speed, maximum efficiency, and output voltage. The right column provides a textual description of "内部构造 / Mechanism" and a table detailing the types of hub, generator, and pitch. The bottom-centered section introduces "贝茨极限理论 / The Betz Law" in both Chinese and English. In the upper right corner of the chart, there is a red square icon containing a white stylized Chinese character "田". The footer at the bottom includes a collection number and the atlas title.

OPTICS & FOCAL PROJECTIONS
A GEOMETRICAL SURVEY OF THE FIVE PRIMARY OPTICAL SEGMENTS IN 35MM CARTOGRAPHY
I. PROJECTION PRINCIPLES
Optical mapping systems divide the physical horizon into precise angular sectors. By plotting projection fields against a standard 35mm sensor plane, we translate spatial relationships into geometric coordinate systems. As focal length decreases, peripheral fields expand outwards, accelerating convergence toward the margins.
Conversely, narrow projection fields isolate linear paths along the central meridian. This spatial alignment reduces the visual scale disparity between foreground boundaries and background horizons.

II. SPATIAL PROFILES
Each lens class generates distinct geographic relationships across the focal frame. Modern survey maps rely on these properties to control distortion and establish spatial accuracy.
Ultra-wide (<24mm): Extreme peripheral expansion. Amplifies spatial depth, causing immediate/foreground items to appear monumentally large compared to distant elements.
Wide (24-35mm): Retains critical environmental context without severe peripheral distortion. Ideal for documenting structures within their surrounding terrain.
Standard (50mm): Simulates the linear perspective of a single human eye. Features neutral magnification and minimal geometric aberration.
Telephoto (85-135mm): Isolates target subjects from their backgrounds. Compression forces the depth axis to shorten, isolating planes.
Super Telephoto (>200mm): Extreme compression of spatial elements. Background features appear scaled up, rendering distant planes flat.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅多格漫画，描绘了两位男性厨师在一次活动中的对比。画面整体色调温暖柔和，背景中漂浮着可颂面包和鱼等食物图案，暗示着一个与美食相关的场合。漫画分为三行，其中中间一行包含一个占据两列的大幅场景。左侧面板主要聚焦于一位头发灰白的年长厨师，他身穿白色厨师服，背部印有“传统料理 法式大餐 米其林”字样。他的思想气泡中流露出被忽视和沮丧的情绪，例如“Watching him...”、“Everyone just flocks to that molecular chef.”、“I'm more classic. Purer.”、“...So why do they always choose him?”以及“Maybe I'm destined to stay in the background.”，旁边还有日文拟声词“ぽつん...”。右侧面板和中间的大幅场景则主要展现一位头发乌黑的年轻厨师，他同样身穿白色厨师服，背部印有“分子料理 液氮 Food Art”字样。年轻厨师在人群中备受瞩目，人们围着他，对话气泡中出现“You always get the attention!”、“You're amazing, molecular chef!”和“Thank you so much!”等赞美。在右中面板，年轻厨师手持一个蓝色烧瓶，与年长厨师对话，年长厨师的思想气泡中则有“...It's unfair...”。漫画通过人物的表情、姿态、对话和思想气泡，对比了传统与现代烹饪方式的受欢迎程度。
prompt_en: This is a multi-panel comic strip depicting a contrast between two male chefs at an event. The overall color palette is warm and soft, with floating croissant and fish motifs in the background, suggesting a culinary-themed occasion. The comic is structured in three rows, with the middle row featuring a large panel spanning two columns. The left panels primarily focus on an older chef with gray hair, dressed in a white chef's uniform, whose back is printed with "传统料理 法式大餐 米其林" (Traditional Cuisine, French Feast, Michelin). His thought bubbles convey feelings of being overlooked and dejected, such as "Watching him...", "Everyone just flocks to that molecular chef.", "I'm more classic. Purer.", "...So why do they always choose him?", and "Maybe I'm destined to stay in the background.", accompanied by the Japanese onomatopoeia "ぽつん...". The right panels and the large central panel mainly feature a younger chef with black hair, also in a white chef's uniform, whose back is printed with "分子料理 液氮 Food Art" (Molecular Cuisine, Liquid Nitrogen, Food Art). The younger chef is the center of attention among the crowd, with people gathered around him, and dialogue bubbles containing praises like "You always get the attention!", "You're amazing, molecular chef!", and "Thank you so much!". In the middle-right panel, the younger chef holds a blue flask and converses with the older chef, whose thought bubble reads "...It's unfair...". The comic contrasts the popularity of traditional versus modern culinary approaches through the characters' expressions, postures, dialogues, and thought bubbles.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的软件界面截图，展示了一个名为“AI Vision Pro”的物体检测引擎。界面顶部是状态栏，左侧显示应用名称“AI Vision Pro”和版本“物体检测引擎 v4.2”，应用名称前有一个绿色指示点。右侧显示“置信度阈值 0.85”和“处理延迟 12ms”，其中数值0.85为绿色，12ms为蓝色。界面中央是一个大矩形区域，显示一个由方框和圆点组成的抽象图标，下方是白色粗体大字“未检测到目标物体”，以及浅灰色正文：“深度视觉引擎已完成全帧扫描，当前环境下未发现符合模型定义的特征点。请尝试调整拍摄角度或改善光照条件。”界面底部并列显示三个建议卡片，每个卡片标题前都有蓝色竖线装饰，内容分别为“| 建议 01 增强环境光照 确保目标物体表面无剧烈反光或阴影遮挡。”、“| 建议 02 调整识别阈值 在设置面板中适当降低置信度以捕获模糊目标。”和“| 建议 03 切换检测模型 尝试使用针对低分辨率优化的轻量化模型。”
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a software interface with a dark background, displaying an object detection engine named "AI Vision Pro". The top of the interface features a status bar; on the left, it shows the application name "AI Vision Pro" and version "物体检测引擎 v4.2" (Object Detection Engine v4.2), with a green indicator dot before the application name. On the right, it displays "置信度阈值 0.85" (Confidence Threshold 0.85) and "处理延迟 12ms" (Processing Delay 12ms), with the value 0.85 in green and 12ms in blue. The central area of the interface contains a large rectangular region showing an abstract icon composed of a square frame and dots. Below it, in large white bold text, is "未检测到目标物体" (No Target Object Detected), followed by light gray body text: "深度视觉引擎已完成全帧扫描，当前环境下未发现符合模型定义的特征点。请尝试调整拍摄角度或改善光照条件。" (The deep vision engine has completed a full-frame scan, but no feature points matching the model definition were found in the current environment. Please try adjusting the shooting angle or improving lighting conditions.) At the bottom of the interface, three suggestion cards are displayed side-by-side. Each card's title is preceded by a blue vertical line decoration, and their contents are: "| 建议 01 增强环境光照 确保目标物体表面无剧烈反光或阴影遮挡." (| Suggestion 01 Enhance ambient lighting Ensure the target object's surface is free from strong reflections or shadow obstructions.), "| 建议 02 调整识别阈值 在设置面板中适当降低置信度以捕获模糊目标." (| Suggestion 02 Adjust recognition threshold Appropriately lower the confidence in the settings panel to capture blurry targets.), and "| 建议 03 切换检测模型 尝试使用针对低分辨率优化的轻量化模型." (| Suggestion 03 Switch detection model Try using a lightweight model optimized for low resolution.).

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一款名为“Pirate Legend パイレーツチップス”的薯片产品包装袋。包装袋以深蓝色为主色调，背景印有航海地图图案，边缘呈锯齿状。左侧描绘了一个手持弯刀、戴着眼罩和海盗帽的海盗插画，其手臂上写有“Pirate”字样。包装左上角有一个金色的竖向标签，标示“期間限定”。包装中央是金色的产品名称“パイレーツチップス”，上方有英文“Pirate Legend”及其日文音译“パイレーツレジェンド”。包装底部散落着几片金黄色的薯片，下方有一条横向缎带，上面写着标语“海の冒険者のスナック”。左下角是一个船锚形状的标签，内有“国産じゃがいも100%使用”字样，表明产品使用100%国产土豆。右侧有一个圆形标签，突出显示“海の旨さになう味わさ シーソルト味”，下方红色缎带上写着“海の旨味!”。包装右下角还配有大蒜和黑胡椒粒的实物图，暗示产品风味。
prompt_en: This image displays the packaging bag for a potato chip product named "Pirate Legend パイレーツチップス". The packaging is predominantly dark blue with a nautical map pattern in the background and serrated edges. On the left, there is an illustration of a pirate holding a cutlass, wearing an eye patch and a pirate hat, with the word "Pirate" on his arm. A golden vertical label in the top left corner indicates "期間限定" (Limited Edition). The golden product name "パイレーツチップス" is prominently featured in the center, with the English "Pirate Legend" and its Japanese transliteration "パイレーツレジェンド" above it. Several golden potato chips are scattered at the bottom of the packaging, below which a horizontal ribbon bears the slogan "海の冒険者のスナック" (Snack for Sea Adventurers). In the bottom left, an anchor-shaped label states "国産じゃがいも100%使用" (100% domestic potato used). On the right, a circular label highlights "海の旨さになう味わさ シーソルト味" (Sea Salt Flavor with the deliciousness of the sea), with "海の旨味!" (Deliciousness of the Sea!) on a red ribbon below. The bottom right of the packaging also features realistic images of garlic and black peppercorns, suggesting the product's flavor.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以黑色为背景的数字海报，整体分为三个主要区域。顶部是黑色背景上的德语标题“Weg von der Stadt und der Menge”（远离城市和人群）和右侧的“Canva”品牌标识。中部是三张横向排列的自然风光照片，每张照片中都有一位背对镜头、面向自然景观的女性：第一张是她在森林中眺望树林，第二张是她在山顶张开双臂眺望山脉，第三张是她坐在湖边眺望水面和远山。底部是黑色背景上的多段德语文字，从上到下依次是五个并列的短语，分别为“Erster Schritt Hör zu!”（第一步 倾听！）、“Zweiter Schritt Schreien”（第二步 呐喊）、“Dritter Schritt Riechen”（第三步 嗅闻）、“Vierter Schritt Laufen”（第四步 奔跑）和“Fünfter Schritt Denke nach”（第五步 思考）。下方是超大字号的主标题“Hör auf dein Herz”（倾听你的心），接着是中等字号的副标题“Leeren Sie das Gehirn und entspannen Sie sich”（清空大脑，放松自己），以及一段小字号的正文，内容是关于带书、去计划之地、听音乐、享受时光和联系旧友的建议。海报通过文字和图片共同传达了亲近自然、放松身心、回归自我的主题。
prompt_en: This is a digital poster with a black background, divided into three main sections. The top section features a German title "Weg von der Stadt und der Menge" (Away from the city and the crowd) and a "Canva" brand logo on the right, both against a black background. The middle section displays three horizontally arranged natural landscape photographs, each featuring a woman with her back to the camera, facing a natural scene: the first shows her looking out at a forest, the second shows her with arms outstretched on a mountaintop overlooking mountains, and the third shows her sitting by a lake gazing at the water and distant mountains. The bottom section contains multiple blocks of German text on a black background. From top to bottom, there are five parallel phrases: "Erster Schritt Hör zu!" (First step Listen!), "Zweiter Schritt Schreien" (Second step Scream), "Dritter Schritt Riechen" (Third step Smell), "Vierter Schritt Laufen" (Fourth step Run), and "Fünfter Schritt Denke nach" (Fifth step Think). Below these is a large main title "Hör auf dein Herz" (Listen to your heart), followed by a medium-sized subtitle "Leeren Sie das Gehirn und entspannen Sie sich" (Empty your brain and relax), and a small-sized body text offering advice on bringing a favorite book, going to a long-planned place, listening to calm music, enjoying personal time, and calling someone you can't forget. The poster collectively conveys themes of connecting with nature, relaxing the mind, and returning to oneself through both text and imagery.

prompt_cn: 这是一张展示一本打开的纪念册或画册页面的图片。页面主体由三幅并列的插画构成，每幅插画都带有金色边框和深色背景，风格统一。页面顶部有主标题“明成祖纪念册”和一段引文“明相史：“成祖雄才大略，远迈汉唐””，旁边还有红色印章文字“福艺龙南”。页面右侧边缘有一列红色竖排文字“明朝纪事”。左侧插画描绘了一艘巨大的宝船在海上航行，船帆上写有“宣德化而柔远人”，左下角标有“1405年”，插画下方配有文字“宝船扬帆下西洋”。中间插画展示了宏伟的宫殿建筑群（类似紫禁城），画面中央有醒目的“皇权”二字，顶部标题为“紫禁城彰显国威”，下方配文“紫禁城铸就国威”，前景有一本打开的书籍，书页上写着“永乐大典”。右侧插画呈现了夜间运河的景象，有船只、发光的金元宝和远处的长城与宫殿，水面上可见“永乐通宝”和“通商”字样，插画下方配文“运河通脉贯南北”。三幅插画的边框内侧均装饰有金色竖排小字。
prompt_en: This image displays a page from an open commemorative album or picture book. The main body of the page consists of three side-by-side illustrations, each framed with a golden border and set against a dark background, maintaining a consistent style. At the top of the page, there is a main title "明成祖纪念册" and a quote "明相史：“成祖雄才大略，远迈汉唐”", alongside red seal characters "福艺龙南". The right edge of the page features a vertical column of red text "明朝纪事". The left illustration depicts a large treasure ship sailing on the sea, with "宣德化而柔远人" written on its sails and "1405年" marked at the bottom left. Below this illustration, the caption reads "宝船扬帆下西洋". The middle illustration showcases a magnificent palace complex (resembling the Forbidden City), with the prominent characters "皇权" in the center. Its top title is "紫禁城彰显国威", and the caption below is "紫禁城铸就国威". In the foreground, there is an open book bearing the title "永乐大典". The right illustration presents a night scene of a canal, featuring boats, glowing gold ingots, and distant Great Wall and palaces. The words "永乐通宝" and "通商" are visible on the water. The caption below this illustration reads "运河通脉贯南北". The inner borders of all three illustrations are decorated with vertical golden small characters.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色背景衬托的电子感谢卡片。卡片呈米白色矩形，略微倾斜并居中放置。卡片顶部有模糊的白色物体，形似蜡烛或玻璃器皿，营造出柔和的光影效果。卡片主体内容为中文感谢信，采用手写字体。标题“衷心感谢”位于卡片顶部中央，字体较大，颜色为深棕色。正文分为两段，详细表达了对亲友在丧礼期间慰问和帮助的感激之情，字体为深棕色中等字号。正文下方右侧是落款“孝眷：全体家属 泣谢”和日期“二零二四年·岁在甲辰”，字体较小。卡片底部中央还有一行浅棕色小字“礼谢亲友·德泽长存”。整张卡片设计简洁，文字排版清晰，情感真挚。
prompt_en: This is a digital thank-you card set against a dark background. The card itself is an off-white rectangular shape, slightly tilted and centrally placed. The top portion of the card features blurry white objects, resembling candles or glass vessels, creating a soft, diffused light effect. The main content of the card is a thank-you letter in Chinese, rendered in a handwritten style. The title "衷心感谢" (Heartfelt Thanks) is prominently displayed at the top center of the card in a large, dark brown font. The body text, divided into two paragraphs, expresses deep gratitude to relatives and friends for their condolences and support during a funeral, presented in a medium-sized, dark brown font. Below the main text, on the right side, is the signature "孝眷：全体家属 泣谢" (Filial Descendants: The entire family, weeping with gratitude) followed by the date "二零二四年·岁在甲辰" (2024 · Year of Jia Chen), both in a smaller font. At the very bottom center of the card, there is a line of small, light brown text that reads "礼谢亲友·德泽长存" (Thanking relatives and friends · Virtue and kindness endure). The overall design of the card is simple, with clear text layout conveying sincere emotion.

prompt_en: This is a document or report themed around the Bauhaus Design System, featuring a clean black, white, and gray color scheme with an off-white background and predominantly black text. At the top center, a large bold title reads "BAUHAUS DESIGN SYSTEM," with a subtitle "FORM FOLLOWS FUNCTION • ART & TECHNOLOGY" below it. The document is clearly structured, divided by horizontal and vertical lines into six numbered sections, along with supplementary information at the top and bottom. The top left includes "0.1 DEPARTMENT CODE" and "GER-WEIMAR-1919," while the top right features "0.2 SYSTEM REFERENCE NO." and a tilted red stamp with "查验放行 / CLEARED," "BAUHAUS WEIMAR," and "DATE: 12 APR 1919." The content covers sender/exporter information, consignee/destination details, geometric blueprints (showing a triangle, square, and circle), structural schematics (displaying a bent tubular frame with H=800 and W=600 dimensions), and a registered design cargo manifest table. The table lists four classic design works with their ID, designer, product specification, core materials, and year. The bottom section contains customs declaration and regulatory compliance notices, along with an authorized signature "Walter Gropius," department, and status information.

BIVALVIA
ANATOMY & SYSTEMATIC CLASSIFICATION OF MAJOR TAXA
Class Bivalvia comprises over 9,200 species of marine and freshwater mollusks defined by a shell with two valves. Held together by a resilient hinge ligament, these valves are controlled by powerful adductor muscles. The underlying mantle secretes the calcium carbonate shell, while specialized siphons facilitate filter feeding, respiration, and waste expulsion.
SECRETORY MANTLE
HINGE LIGAMENT
ADDUCTOR MUSCLE
CALCAREOUS SHELL
INCURRENT SIPHON
EXCURRENT SIPHON
SESSILE & ANCHORED EPIFAUNA
MOTILE & BURROWING INFAUNA
Oysters (Ostreidae) represent a highly specialized lineage of sessile filter feeders. The adult shell is profoundly asymmetrical, with the left valve permanently cemented to a hard substrate. Lacking a functional foot or byssal system in maturity, they rely on a singular massive adductor muscle to seal their calcified valves against predators and desiccation during low tides.
Clams (Veneridae) exploit soft sedimentary habitats. They possess robust, equivalent, and symmetrical valves, which house a large, muscular, wedge-shaped foot. This specialized organ extends into sand or mud, expands to form an anchor, and contracts to pull the animal downward. Siphons extend upward to the water column to feed while remaining buried.
Mussels (Mytilidae) adapt to turbulent intertidal environments through anchorage. Rather than cementation, they produce strong, flexible protein strands called byssal threads. Secreted by a gland in the vestigial foot, these threads self-assemble and secure the shell to rocky substrates, enabling the organism to absorb impact forces from powerful wave action.
Scallops (Pectinidae) are the only bivalves capable of active swimming. By rapidly clapping their symmetric, lightweight shells, they expel water to propel themselves backward. Their mantle edge features dozens of complex, bright blue eyes (ocelli) with double-layered retinas, enabling them to detect motion and shadows of approaching predators.

prompt_cn:
这是一张以Google Cloud为主题的动漫风格角色设计图。画面左侧是名为GCP的男性角色立绘，他拥有绿色头发和眼睛，身穿白色短款外套、蓝色裤子和绿色运动鞋，并佩戴一条半透明的绿色披风，服装上多处可见GCP标志。角色立绘旁有引语“别担心，GCP 帮你找到最优解。”。左下角的信息框详细列出了角色的“数据”，包括名字GCP、职业、性格、特征、爱好和主题（云、搜索、AI、数据、网络）。图片顶部左侧是“Google Cloud”品牌标识，下方是“GCP”、“(グーグル - クラウド)”以及中文口号“智能驱动世界，数据照亮未来。”。
画面右侧和下方区域被多个绿色标题划分成不同模块。右上方是角色的“三视图”，展示了正面、侧面和背面。其右侧是“服装细节”模块，包含GCP标志元素、AI数据表现和可扩展性的图标及文字说明。下方是“表情”模块，展示了通常、微笑、思考、惊讶、自信五种表情。右下角是“Q版角色”的迷你形象。
画面中央下方是“配色方案”模块，展示了六个颜色方块及其对应的十六进制颜色代码，如#4285F4、#34A853等。其右侧是“设计理念”模块，包含智能、开放、可扩展、可持续、协作五个图标及文字。左侧是“标志性元素”模块，展示了搜索、AI、数据、云、安全五个图标及文字。图片底部有一条绿色横幅，上面写着口号“智能。协作。可持续。共筑数字世界。”。整个设计图以浅绿色和白色为背景，带有抽象的云朵图案。
prompt_en:
This is an anime-style character design sheet themed around Google Cloud. On the left side of the image is a full-body illustration of a male character named GCP, who has green hair and eyes, wearing a white short jacket, blue pants, green sneakers, and a translucent green cape. GCP logos are visible in several places on his clothing. Next to the character illustration is a quote: "Don't worry, GCP will help you find the optimal solution." A data box in the bottom left details the character's "Data," including his name GCP, profession, personality, characteristics, hobbies, and themes (Cloud, Search, AI, Data, Network). The top left of the image features the "Google Cloud" brand identity, followed by "GCP," "(グーグル - クラウド)," and the Chinese slogan "智能驱动世界，数据照亮未来。" (Intelligence drives the world, data illuminates the future.).
The right and bottom areas of the image are divided into different modules by green titles. The top right shows the character's "三视图" (Three Views), presenting front, side, and back perspectives. To its right is the "服装细节" (Clothing Details) module, which includes icons and text descriptions for GCP logo elements, AI data representation, and scalability. Below this is the "表情" (Expressions) module, displaying five expressions: normal, smiling, thinking, surprised, and confident. In the bottom right is a chibi version of the "Q版角色" (Chibi Character).
The bottom center of the image features a "配色方案" (Color Scheme) module, showing six color blocks with their corresponding hexadecimal color codes, such as #4285F4, #34A853, etc. To its right is the "设计理念" (Design Concepts) module, containing five icons and text for intelligence, openness, scalability, sustainability, and collaboration. To its left is the "标志性元素" (Iconic Elements) module, displaying five icons and text for search, AI, data, cloud, and security. A green banner at the very bottom of the image reads the slogan "智能。协作。可持续。共筑数字世界。" (Intelligence. Collaboration. Sustainability. Building a digital world together.). The entire design sheet is set against a light green and white gradient background with abstract cloud patterns.

prompt_cn: 这是一张动漫游戏风格的数字插画宣传图。画面前景中央，两位女性角色跪地相视，其中一位黑发，另一位金发。她们身后是占据画面上半部分的巨大阿努比斯神像机器人。中景和远景散布着古埃及风格的遗迹，包括方尖碑、柱子、破碎的建筑和陶罐。画面主色调为暖色调的沙漠黄和棕色，天空湛蓝，机器人和部分文字点缀着金色，角色服装和部分文字为白色。文字内容分布在画面的左上角、右上角、左侧中部、底部中央和右下角，提供了游戏标题、副标题、类型描述、发布日期、品牌信息和宣传语，与画面中呈现的古埃及神话、科幻和角色互动主题相符。
prompt_en: This is a digital illustration promotional image in an anime game style. In the central foreground, two female characters kneel facing each other, one with black hair and the other with blonde hair. Behind them, a giant Anubis-like robot statue occupies the upper half of the image. Ancient Egyptian-style ruins, including obelisks, columns, broken structures, and pottery, are scattered in the midground and background. The main color scheme of the image is warm desert yellow and brown, with a clear blue sky. The robot and some text are accented with gold, while character clothing and some text are white. Text content is distributed in the top left, top right, mid-left, bottom center, and bottom right of the image, providing the game title, subtitle, genre description, release date, brand information, and promotional slogans, which align with the ancient Egyptian mythology, sci-fi, and character interaction themes presented in the image.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于中国六大茶类制作工艺与冲泡条件的科普信息图。图片以白色为背景，整体结构清晰，分为三个主要部分。顶部是主标题“中国六大茶类制作工艺谱系 / GENEALOGY OF TEA”，下方有副标题和右侧的编号信息。第一部分“发酵物理标尺”通过一段文字解释了茶多酚氧化反应的核心原理，并用一个水平彩色条形图展示了六大茶类的氧化程度，从0%（绿茶）到POST（黑茶），颜色渐变，并标注了不发酵、半发酵、全发酵和后发酵的分类。第二部分“六大茶类工艺路径”采用2x3的网格布局，详细介绍了绿茶、白茶、黄茶、青茶、红茶和黑茶各自的制作工艺步骤和关键信息。每种茶类标题旁都有一个彩色方框，显示其氧化百分比，颜色与第一部分条形图中的茶类颜色相对应。第三部分“正确冲泡物理条件”分为左右两栏，左侧以绿色对勾图标和“CORRECT / 正确”标题，说明绿茶的适宜冲泡温度（80-85°C）；右侧以红色叉号图标和“INCORRECT / 错误”标题，警示绿茶忌用100°C沸水及其危害。图片底部是页脚“REFERENCE ATLAS OF TEA SCIENCE 2024”。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic detailing the processing techniques and brewing conditions of China's six major tea types. Set against a white background, the image is clearly structured into three main sections. The top features the main title "中国六大茶类制作工艺谱系 / GENEALOGY OF TEA," followed by a subtitle and plate information on the right. The first section, "01 / 发酵物理标尺 PHYSICAL OXIDATION SCALE," explains the core principle of polyphenol oxidation in tea and presents a horizontal colored bar chart illustrating the oxidation levels of the six tea categories, ranging from 0% (Green Tea) to POST (Dark Tea). The chart uses a color gradient and labels for non-fermented, semi-fermented, fully-oxidized, and aged classifications. The second section, "02 / 六大茶类工艺路径 GENEALOGY BY PROCESSING STEPS," uses a 2x3 grid layout to detail the processing steps and key information for Green Tea, White Tea, Yellow Tea, Oolong, Black Tea, and Dark Tea. Each tea type's title is accompanied by a colored box indicating its oxidation percentage, with colors corresponding to those in the first section's bar chart. The third section, "03 / 正确冲泡物理条件 TEMPERATURE SAFETY CHECK," is divided into two columns. The left column, marked with a green checkmark icon and "CORRECT / 正确" title, advises on the appropriate brewing temperature for green tea (80-85°C). The right column, with a red cross icon and "INCORRECT / 错误" title, warns against using 100°C boiling water for green tea and its detrimental effects. The bottom of the image includes the footer "REFERENCE ATLAS OF TEA SCIENCE 2024."

The bottom right card is a quote widget, featuring a female avatar, the text "Life is what happens when you'r...", and the name "Jane Park". Icons are used throughout the widgets to represent weather, devices, and checkboxes. The overall color scheme is bright, predominantly white, light blue, and light pink, with black text.

text:
世界五大桥梁结构
力学剖析与转换
05
■基础构型:梁与桁架
■力的转向:拱桥
■跨度巅峰:悬索
梁桥(BEAM)是基建的原子级单元。其力学逻辑极为纯粹:桥面荷载直接导致梁体下弯,产生上缘受压、下缘受拉的弯矩效应。
拱桥通过几何形态将垂直重力转换为侧向推力。卢浦大桥550米的跨度依赖于拱肋的纯压缩状态。
当跨度超过1000米,主缆受拉成为唯一方案。
力学模拟:简支梁
拉力传递链(TENSION CHAIN)
荷载 LOAD
拱座受力分解 (ARCH COMPRESSION)
纯压缩状态
桁架桥(TRUSS)通过三角形框架将弯矩转化为构件的轴向拉压效应。福斯桥的主体桁架展示了钢材在分配521米跨度压力时的极端效率。
悬索桥利用锚碇(Anchorage)的巨大自重对抗主缆的总拉力。明石海峡大桥的主缆由290根钢绞线组成,每根承受张力可达数万吨。
典型跨度区间
技术核心:跨度极限统计
■斜拉桥 (STAYED)
50-110M
结构类型
代表工程
主跨(M)
悬索桥
明石海峡大桥
1991
斜拉桥
苏通大桥
1088
拱桥
卢浦大桥
550
桁架桥
福斯桥
521
斜拉索将桥面荷载直接传回主塔。塔柱承担垂直轴压力,索具则处于高应力受拉状态。苏通大桥正是此结构的全 球标杆。
结构最大理论跨度
3000M+
材料极限:碳纤维/超强钢
ATLAS OF CIVIL ENGINEERING // SECTION 04: BRIDGES
DATA VERIFIED: 2024 EDITION

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于桥梁结构的信息图表，背景为深蓝色。图表顶部有青色大字标题“世界五大桥梁结构 力学剖析与转换”，下方有粉色横线分隔。主体内容分为三列，每列介绍一种或两种桥梁类型及其力学原理。左侧列介绍了“梁与桁架”两种基础构型，配有简支梁受力模拟图和“荷载 LOAD”标签，并展示了“典型跨度区间 50-110M”。中间列介绍了“拱桥”，配有拱桥受力分解示意图和“纯压缩状态”标签，下方是“技术核心:跨度极限统计”表格，列出了悬索桥、斜拉桥、拱桥、桁架桥的代表工程及其主跨（M）。右侧列介绍了“悬索”和“斜拉桥”，配有悬索桥的“拉力传递链(TENSION CHAIN)”示意图，并展示了“结构最大理论跨度 3000M+”和“材料极限:碳纤维/超强钢”。图表底部有粉色横线，并显示页脚信息“ATLAS OF CIVIL ENGINEERING // SECTION 04: BRIDGES”和“DATA VERIFIED: 2024 EDITION”。图中的关键文字以白色为主，部分专业术语和标题使用青色，强调部分使用红色。
prompt_en: This is an information graphic about bridge structures, set against a dark blue background. At the top, there is a large cyan title "世界五大桥梁结构 力学剖析与转换" (World's Five Major Bridge Structures Mechanical Analysis and Transformation), separated by a pink horizontal line below. The main content is divided into three columns, each introducing one or two bridge types and their mechanical principles. The left column describes the basic configurations of "梁与桁架" (Beam and Truss), accompanied by a diagram simulating the forces on a simply supported beam with a "荷载 LOAD" (Load) label, and displays "典型跨度区间 50-110M" (Typical Span Range 50-110M). The middle column introduces "拱桥" (Arch Bridge), with a diagram illustrating arch abutment force decomposition and a "纯压缩状态" (Pure Compression State) label. Below this is a table titled "技术核心:跨度极限统计" (Technical Core: Span Limit Statistics), listing representative projects and their main spans (M) for suspension, cable-stayed, arch, and truss bridges. The right column covers "悬索" (Suspension) and "斜拉桥" (Cable-Stayed Bridge), featuring a "拉力传递链(TENSION CHAIN)" diagram for suspension bridges, and displaying "结构最大理论跨度 3000M+" (Maximum Theoretical Span) and "材料极限:碳纤维/超强钢" (Material Limit: Carbon Fiber/Ultra-high Strength Steel). The bottom of the graphic has another pink horizontal line, displaying footer information "ATLAS OF CIVIL ENGINEERING // SECTION 04: BRIDGES" and "DATA VERIFIED: 2024 EDITION". Key text in the graphic is primarily white, with some technical terms and titles in cyan, and emphasized parts in red.

Within the central panel, a large golden Chinese title "钻 石 婚 至 臻 纪 念" is at the top, followed by "The Eternal Radiance of Sixty Years" in white English text. Below the titles is a black and white photograph depicting a necklace with a pear-shaped diamond pendant, resting on white and dark rose petals. Further down the central panel, there is a two-line golden Chinese poem "六十载风雨同舟，一甲子情深似海." and a longer paragraph of golden Chinese text. The bottom section of the card, on the golden background, displays white text "工艺: 24K 哑光金箔" and "编号: NO. 2024-060-8888" on the left. A circular emblem with golden Chinese text "至臻\n典藏" is in the bottom center. On the bottom right, white English text "With Eternal Love" and white Chinese text "二零二四年·盛夏" are visible. The overall design is elegant and commemorative, likely for a diamond jubilee or a 60th-anniversary celebration.

A black and white photo of two smiling individuals is embedded in the center of the image. The background features a blurred indoor scene with windows and furniture. Below the photo is the gold salutation "尊启者:" and a white body text inviting guests to the celebration and expressing gratitude for their long-term support. The bottom section provides event details, with gold labels "时间 / TIME" and "地点 / VENUE". The specific date "2024年12月18日" and time "18:30 - 21:30" are listed on the left, while the venue "丽思卡尔顿酒店·宴会厅 北京市朝阳区建国路83号" is on the right. The bottom left includes two bulleted items with diamond symbols: "着装建议: 商务正装 / 礼服" (Dress code: business formal / evening wear) and "敬请于12月10日前确认出席" (Please confirm attendance by December 10th). The bottom right shows the signatory "诚恒律师事务所·筹备委员会" (Chenheng Law Firm · Preparatory Committee) and its English "Sincerely Yours".
