prompt_cn:
这是一张关于极紫外光刻机（EUV Lithography）的科技信息图。图片整体采用红、黑、白三色为主的配色方案。顶部是红色横幅，包含标题“极紫外光刻机 INTERNAL OPTICS”及副标题“SYSTEM STRUCTURE: ASML NXE SERIES / HIGH-NA EXE”。底部是黑色横幅，显示“ASML HOLDING N.V.”等公司信息和安全标语。主体内容区域采用两栏布局，分为三个主要章节，分别用红色大数字“01”、“02”、“03”标记。

左栏包含“OPERATING ENVIRONMENT”和“曝光系统 / EXPOSURE”两个部分。在“OPERATING ENVIRONMENT”下，详细介绍了“高真空 / VACUUM”环境的重要性，并列出了“WAVELENGTH”、“FREQUENCY”、“POWER”等规格参数。在“曝光系统 / EXPOSURE”部分，描述了光束通过掩膜版进入投影物镜系统，并提及了High-NA技术及其对分辨率的提升，下方附有公式“RESOLUTION = k1 × λ / NA”。

右栏包含“激光等离子体光源 / LPP SOURCE”和“蔡司反射镜组 / ZEISS OPTICS”两个部分。在“激光等离子体光源”部分，详细解释了LPP光源的工作原理，并配有简化的图示，标有“COLLECTOR”、“PLASMA”和“CO2 LASER”等组件。在“蔡司反射镜组”部分，说明了全反射光学设计和反射镜的材料组成。右栏底部还有一个“技术对比 / COMPARISON”表格，对比了不同型号（NXE:3400C, NXE:3600D, EXE:5000）的数值孔径（NA）和工艺节点（PROCESS）。
prompt_en:
This is a technology infographic about Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Lithography. The image primarily uses a red, black, and white color scheme. The top features a red banner with the main title "极紫外光刻机 INTERNAL OPTICS" and subtitles "SYSTEM STRUCTURE: ASML NXE SERIES / HIGH-NA EXE". The bottom has a black banner displaying company information like "ASML HOLDING N.V." and safety slogans. The main content area is arranged in a two-column layout, divided into three main sections, each marked with large red numbers "01", "02", and "03".

The left column includes sections on "OPERATING ENVIRONMENT" and "曝光系统 / EXPOSURE". Under "OPERATING ENVIRONMENT", the importance of a "高真空 / VACUUM" environment is detailed, along with specifications such as "WAVELENGTH", "FREQUENCY", and "POWER". The "曝光系统 / EXPOSURE" section describes the light beam's path through the reticle into the projection optics system, mentioning High-NA technology and its role in improving resolution, followed by the formula "RESOLUTION = k1 × λ / NA".

The right column contains sections on "激光等离子体光源 / LPP SOURCE" and "蔡司反射镜组 / ZEISS OPTICS". The "激光等离子体光源" section explains the working principle of the LPP source in detail, accompanied by a simplified diagram labeled with components like "COLLECTOR", "PLASMA", and "CO2 LASER". The "蔡司反射镜组" section describes the all-reflective optical design and the material composition of the mirrors. At the bottom of the right column, there is a "技术对比 / COMPARISON" table, comparing different models (NXE:3400C, NXE:3600D, EXE:5000) by their Numerical Aperture (NA) and Process nodes.

prompt_en: This is a photograph taken at a press conference or presentation event. In the center of the frame, a male speaker in a dark blue suit stands on a stage, facing the audience with his hands raised, seemingly explaining something. Behind him is a large display screen that occupies most of the background. The screen displays an abstract pattern with red, orange, and yellow gradients, featuring glowing lines and dark areas, creating a dynamic and powerful visual effect. On the left side of the screen, four large white calligraphic Chinese characters "脱胎换骨" (tuō tāi huàn gǔ), meaning "to be reborn" or "to undergo a complete transformation," are vertically arranged, serving as the theme or slogan for the event. The stage background is white or light gray, and the ceiling is black. The back of an audience member's head is visible at the bottom of the frame, indicating the presence of attendees.

The top of the page features a navigation bar with the brand name "FARMIGA" on the left and navigation links such as "HOME," "ABOUT," "GALLERY," "PRICES," and "CONTACT" on the right, with "HOME" highlighted in pink. The central visual area displays the brand name "FARMIGA" in bold black text within a black square frame, set against a colorful paint splash background, with the tagline "alternative beauty salon" below it. Following this are four service display sections, showcasing "NAILS," "STYLING," "MAKE UP," and "HAIR" services, each with a pink label at the bottom left of its image. Below these is the slogan "A HAIR SALON FOR THOSE BORED OF HAIR SALONS" and a pink "BOOK NOW" button. The middle section of the page presents three circular portraits of team members, with their names "GYPSY LEE," "LILLY HUNT," and "MANDY MYERS" and social media icons below. Further down is the heading "THE WAY WE FEEL" followed by text about the team's philosophy. The bottom of the page is the footer, which includes contact information (address, phone number), the brand name "FARMIGA," and social media icons. On the right side of the footer is the title "JOIN OUR NEWSLETTER!" and an email subscription input field with "ENTER YOUR EMAIL" as placeholder text. The overall page background features white and holographic gradient effects.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深蓝色背景的招聘海报，顶部和底部颜色较深，中部略浅。海报左上角是英文标题“MANAGEMENT TRAINEE PROGRAM”，下方是中文主标题“集团全球管理培训生计划”。右上角有一个深蓝色矩形框，内有白色文字“2024 校园招聘”。主标题下方有一条短横线和“核心培养环节”字样。海报中部是醒目的艺术字“轮岗学习”，其中“轮岗”为白色，“学习”为蓝色，蓝色“学习”被一个蓝色线条构成的圆形图形部分环绕。下方有一行白色文字描述：“在跨职能的实战中打破边界，以多维视角重构商业逻辑。”海报下半部分是三列信息，每列包含一个浅蓝色序号（01、02、03）、一个白色小标题和一段白色正文，分别介绍“全业务链”、“双导师制”和“择优定岗”。海报底部左侧是“DURATION”和“18-24 Months”，中间是“LOCATION”和“Global Offices”，右侧是“智汇集团·官网管培专页”和“JOIN THE FUTURE LEADERS”。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster with a dark blue background, darker at the top and bottom, and slightly lighter in the middle. In the upper left corner, there is an English title "MANAGEMENT TRAINEE PROGRAM", followed by the main Chinese title "集团全球管理培训生计划". In the upper right corner, a dark blue rectangular box contains the white text "2024 校园招聘". Below the main title, there is a short horizontal line and the text "核心培养环节" (Core Training Stages). The middle of the poster features prominent artistic characters "轮岗学习" (Rotation Learning), with "轮岗" in white and "学习" in blue, the blue "学习" being partially encircled by a blue line graphic. Below this, a line of white text reads: "在跨职能的实战中打破边界，以多维视角重构商业逻辑。" (Break boundaries in cross-functional practical experience, reconstruct business logic with multi-dimensional perspectives.) The lower half of the poster presents three columns of information, each containing a light blue serial number (01, 02, 03), a white subtitle, and white body text, introducing "全业务链" (Full Business Chain), "双导师制" (Dual Mentorship System), and "择优定岗" (Optimal Placement). At the bottom of the poster, the left side shows "DURATION" and "18-24 Months", the middle shows "LOCATION" and "Global Offices", and the right side shows "智汇集团·官网管培专页" (Zhihui Group·Official Website Management Trainee Page) and "JOIN THE FUTURE LEADERS".

Multiple lines of text are arranged on the left side of the picture, including the English "RECOMMENDED BOOKS ON HEALING" and the Chinese "治愈系" (Healing Series), "好书推荐" (Good Book Recommendations), "治愈" (Healing), and "低谷" (Low Point). The overall illustration features soft colors, predominantly beige, brown, dark gray, yellow, and light blue.

prompt_en: This is a music festival poster with a light blue background and a dark green organic-shaped border. The main design features a lake or river landscape with a canoe carrying a person, and a small cabin behind the lake. The lake is flanked by plants, mushrooms, and two large Bigfoot-like creatures. At the top of the poster are the sponsor "GRIZZLY CANNA CO PRESENTS" and the event dates "7/30 - 8/2", followed by a list of activities: "RIVER FLOATS - LIVE MUSIC - 100+ VENDORS - FOOD TRUCKS - LIVE TERPS". Towards the upper center, the main title "TERP FLOAT" is displayed in large green artistic font, with the pink handwritten subtitle "Festival" and a white label "2026 LINEUP" below it. The middle section of the poster lists multiple artist names; "SUNSQUABI" and "EAZYBAKED" are highlighted in large artistic fonts, while other artist names are presented in white sans-serif font, some displayed side-by-side. At the bottom of the poster is the orange event website "WWW.TERPFLOATOKLAHOMA.COM" and the white location information "DIAMONDHEAD RESORT - TAHLEQUAH OKLAHOMA".

A white, rounded rectangular dialog box appears in the center of the screen, with the title "是否保存本次编辑?" (Save this edit?). The explanatory text below reads: "保存后可在“草稿箱”中找回并继续编辑，动态内容不会丢失。" (After saving, you can retrieve and continue editing in "Drafts", and the post content will not be lost.). At the bottom of the dialog box are three action buttons, from top to bottom: a blue "保存草稿" (Save Draft), a red "不保存" (Don't Save), and a black "取消" (Cancel). The very bottom of the interface has a toolbar containing four icons: an outline circle, a solid square, a hash symbol, and an at symbol.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以深色为背景的科技风格活动海报，宣传“2024 GLOBAL DEVELOPER CONFERENCE”中的“PRODUCT DEMO”和“HACKATHON FINALS”。海报顶部左侧是浅蓝色的“2024 GLOBAL”和白色的“DEVELOPER CONFERENCE”字样，右侧有紫色背景框内的“LIVE STREAM”和“STAGE_01”标签。海报中央是巨大的白色“PRODUCT”字样，其后方叠印着半透明的浅紫色“DEMO”，下方是浅蓝色的“DEMO”。“PRODUCT DEMO”下方是浅蓝色和白色的“HACKATHON FINALS”。海报中下部并列着两个内容框，左侧框标题为浅紫色的“THE CHALLENGE”，正文描述了48小时编程挑战；右侧框标题为浅蓝色的“THE VISION”，正文介绍了AI和云原生解决方案。底部左侧列出了活动地点和时间，右侧是一个黑底白字的“JOIN THE FUTURE”按钮。海报底部还有网址、话题标签和二进制数字。
prompt_en: This is a technology-themed event poster with a dark background, promoting the "PRODUCT DEMO" and "HACKATHON FINALS" within the "2024 GLOBAL DEVELOPER CONFERENCE". At the top left, the poster features "2024 GLOBAL" in light blue and "DEVELOPER CONFERENCE" in white. On the top right, there are "LIVE STREAM" and "STAGE_01" labels within purple background boxes. The center of the poster displays a large white "PRODUCT" text, overlaid by a semi-transparent light purple "DEMO" behind it, and a light blue "DEMO" below it. Below "PRODUCT DEMO" are "HACKATHON FINALS" in light blue and white. In the lower-middle section, two content boxes are arranged side-by-side: the left box has a light purple title "THE CHALLENGE" with text describing a 48-hour coding challenge; the right box has a light blue title "THE VISION" with text introducing AI and Cloud-Native solutions. The bottom left lists the event location and time, while the bottom right features a black-background, white-text button reading "JOIN THE FUTURE". The very bottom of the poster includes a website address, a hashtag, and binary numbers.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于江户前寿司的图鉴信息图。图片整体呈浅灰色背景，采用左右两栏布局。左侧栏是主视觉区域，包含“江户前寿司图鉴 / EDOMAE SUSHI”的大字标题，下方依次展示了三幅寿司的抽象几何图示，分别是“FIG. 01: ZUSHI (握寿司)”、“FIG. 02: MAKI-MONO (卷寿司)”和“FIG. 03: OSHI-ZUSHI (押寿司)”，每幅图下方配有图例。右侧栏是详细信息区域，从上到下分为六个部分，包括“标本基本信息”、“四大分类体系 / TAXONOMY”、“舍利规格 (SHARI SPECS)”、“鱼料时令分布 / SEASONALITY”、“鲔鱼部位鉴定 (TUNA GRADES)”和“采集记录 (COLLECTION NOTES)”。每个部分都包含标题和具体的文字描述或数据，如寿司的种类、制作特点、舍利（寿司饭）的温度和酸度、不同季节的鱼料以及金枪鱼不同部位的特征等。图片左上角有“INDEX NO. ED-S-1923 / TOKYO BAY REGION”的索引信息，右上角是“EDO TOKYO ICHIBAN ARCHIVE”的标题。左下角是“帝國水産研究所”和“APPROVED: 1923.10.12”、“東京湾採集局”的页脚信息，右下角是“VERIFIED BY ARCHIVIST J.S.”的署名。
prompt_en: This is an infographic document illustrating Edomae sushi. The image features a light gray background and is laid out in two columns. The left column is the main visual area, featuring a large title "江户前寿司图鉴 / EDOMAE SUSHI". Below it, three abstract geometric illustrations of sushi are displayed sequentially: "FIG. 01: ZUSHI (握寿司)", "FIG. 02: MAKI-MONO (卷寿司)", and "FIG. 03: OSHI-ZUSHI (押寿司)", each accompanied by a caption. The right column is the detailed information area, divided into six sections from top to bottom: "标本基本信息" (Specimen Basic Information), "四大分类体系 / TAXONOMY" (Four Major Classification Systems), "舍利规格 (SHARI SPECS)" (Shari Specifications), "鱼料时令分布 / SEASONALITY" (Fish Ingredient Seasonality Distribution), "鲔鱼部位鉴定 (TUNA GRADES)" (Tuna Part Identification), and "采集记录 (COLLECTION NOTES)" (Collection Notes). Each section includes a title and specific textual descriptions or data, such as sushi types, preparation characteristics, shari (sushi rice) temperature and acidity, seasonal fish ingredients, and characteristics of different tuna parts. The top left corner of the image displays index information "INDEX NO. ED-S-1923 / TOKYO BAY REGION", and the top right corner shows the title "EDO TOKYO ICHIBAN ARCHIVE". The bottom left corner contains footer information "帝國水産研究所" (Imperial Fisheries Research Institute), "APPROVED: 1923.10.12", and "東京湾採集局" (Tokyo Bay Collection Bureau). The bottom right corner has the signature "VERIFIED BY ARCHIVIST J.S.".

The top and bottom of the poster feature red wavy sections, separating them from the central photo area. In the top left, there is a golden "@" symbol, next to which are white texts "2022 中国正能量" and "网络精品征集展播活动". On the left side of the poster, the main title "凡人微光 照亮征程" is displayed in gold. To the right of the photo, the name "段金龙" is arranged vertically in gold. Below the person's left arm in the photo, there is very small white placeholder text "你的段落文字". In the bottom left of the poster, the golden subtitle "责任" is present, followed by white body text: "河北保定神仙山林区的护林员段金龙，一个人守护3000多亩山林，每天巡山要走20公里以上。他坚守了30余年，事故发生率为零.". The overall color scheme of the poster includes red, gold, white, and the natural colors of the forest.

prompt_en: This is a game promotional image or screenshot, depicting a cross-section of a multi-story castle or building interior, along with a cartoon character. The castle interior features multiple rooms, each furnished with different equipment and decorations. Some rooms have "zZz" icons above them, indicating rest or idle status, while others have lock icons, suggesting they are locked or undeveloped. On the right side of the image is a cartoon character wearing goggles, with a red beard and work attire, holding a glowing small object in his right hand. In the bottom left corner, there are three circular UI buttons, featuring an exclamation mark, an upward arrow, and a crown icon respectively. The background is a dark night sky with bat silhouettes. In the bottom right corner, two lines of Chinese text are overlaid: "随心布局" (Customize Layout) in a white-to-gold gradient, and "打造专属家园" (Create Exclusive Home) in white, together describing the game's core gameplay.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface, displaying a form for entering new asset information. The top of the interface features the title "NEW ASSET ENTRY" and a breadcrumb navigation "系统管理 / 资产数据库 / 新增记录". On the right, "管理员 ID: 8829" and the date and time "2023-10-24 14:20" are shown. The main area is divided into two columns. The left column contains input fields for "资产全称 / ASSET NAME", "采购金额 / VALUATION", and "备注说明 / REMARKS", with placeholders like "请输入设备名称", "¥ 0.00", and "输入资产详细配置...". The right column includes input fields for "唯一识别码 / SERIAL NO." and "存放地点 / LOCATION", which are pre-filled with "ASSET-2023-00912" and "核心机房 A-01". A right sidebar displays "录入状态" (Entry Status), featuring a progress bar showing "当前进度 75%" (Current Progress 75%) and a tip "* 请确保所有必填字段 已通过系统校验." (Please ensure all required fields have passed system validation.). Below this is an "上传资产照片" (Upload Asset Photo) area with an image icon and instructions "支持 JPG/PNG 格式 最大 50MB" (Supports JPG/PNG format Max 50MB). A status bar at the bottom of the interface shows "DATA_SYNC 0x882F STABLE VERIFIED". At the very bottom, there are three action buttons: "取消返回" (Cancel Return), "重置表单" (Reset Form), and a blue "确认提交记录" (Confirm Submit Record) button, next to which is an "AUTO_SAVE 14:19:02" prompt.

prompt_cn: 这是一张食物配送应用的用户界面截图，界面主体是一个白色圆角矩形卡片，置于黄色渐变背景之上。界面分为左右两栏：左栏显示餐厅列表和分类筛选，右栏显示订单摘要。顶部导航栏包含一个汉堡菜单图标、应用名称“Chukwudi”、一个搜索框和一个用户图标及通知数字“3”。左栏顶部有一个促销横幅，显示“$0 delivery for 30 days!”，并配有插画。左栏下方是“Restaurants”标题，旁边有一个汉堡表情符号。左栏包含一排食物类别筛选按钮，带有图标和文字，如“All”、“Pizza”、“Asian”等，其中“All”按钮被黄色高亮。左栏下方展示了三家餐厅的卡片，每张卡片包含一张食物图片、配送时间、餐厅名称、星级评分和简要描述。右栏标题为“My Order”，旁边有一个戴墨镜的表情符号。右栏订单摘要包含配送地址“625 St Marks Ave”和配送时间“35 min”，以及编辑和选择时间按钮。订单列表显示了三项商品：“Beach BBQBurger”、“French Fries”和“Cheese Sauce”，每项都包含数量、名称和价格。订单摘要底部显示“Delivery”费用为“$0.00”，总计“Total: $25.97”。订单摘要底部有人数选择器（“-”、“1”、“+”）和一个黄色的“Checkout →”按钮。界面设计简洁，主要使用白色、黄色、深灰色和少量紫色、橙色作为配色。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a food delivery application user interface. The main interface is a white rounded rectangular card placed on a yellow gradient background. The interface is divided into two columns: the left column displays a list of restaurants and category filters, while the right column shows an order summary. The top navigation bar includes a hamburger menu icon, the application name "Chukwudi", a search box, a user icon, and a notification number "3". The top of the left column features a promotional banner displaying "$0 delivery for 30 days!" with an illustration. Below that, the left column has a "Restaurants" title next to a hamburger emoji. The left column also contains a row of food category filter buttons with icons and text, such as "All", "Pizza", "Asian", etc., with the "All" button highlighted in yellow. Below these, three restaurant cards are displayed, each containing a food image, delivery time, restaurant name, star rating, and a brief description. The right column is titled "My Order" next to a sunglasses emoji. The order summary in the right column includes the delivery address "625 St Marks Ave" and delivery time "35 min", along with edit and choose time buttons. The order list shows three items: "Beach BBQBurger", "French Fries", and "Cheese Sauce", each with quantity, name, and price. The bottom of the order summary shows a "Delivery" fee of "$0.00" and a "Total: $25.97". At the very bottom of the order summary, there is a quantity selector for persons ("-", "1", "+") and a yellow "Checkout →" button. The interface design is clean, primarily using white, yellow, dark gray, and small amounts of purple and orange for its color scheme.

prompt_cn: 这是一张静物摄影照片，展示了放置在木质架子上的物品。画面左侧有三本书籍，其中最左边一本是金色浮雕封面，书脊上垂直印有“ENCYCLOPEDIA”字样。紧邻其右侧是两本深色书，其中第三本书的书脊上垂直印有白色文字，从上到下依次是书名“THE LOST PLEIADES”、“SEVEN SISTERS AND THE SIBYLS”以及作者名“ROSELLA TESTA”。书籍右侧放置着一块不规则的深色石头。再往右是一个黑色的长方体茶罐，其正面标签为白色文字，顶部是“A SOCIAL LEADER TEA”，中间是“THE LOST PLEIADES: SEVEN SISTERS AND THE SIBYLS”，下方是“Organic herbal remedy tea”，最底部是网址“socialleaderhaus.com”。茶罐标签中央还描绘了一只手握着点燃蜡烛的图案。茶罐右后方隐约可见一个木制雕像。整个背景是一面米色墙壁。
prompt_en: This is a still life photograph featuring items arranged on a wooden shelf. On the left side of the image are three books; the leftmost one has a gold embossed cover with "ENCYCLOPEDIA" vertically printed on its spine. To its immediate right are two dark-colored books, with the third book's spine displaying white text vertically, reading "THE LOST PLEIADES" at the top, followed by "SEVEN SISTERS AND THE SIBYLS", and "ROSELLA TESTA" at the bottom. To the right of the books, an irregular dark stone is placed. Further to the right is a black rectangular tea tin, whose front label features white text: "A SOCIAL LEADER TEA" at the top, "THE LOST PLEIADES: SEVEN SISTERS AND THE SIBYLS" in the middle, "Organic herbal remedy tea" below that, and the website "socialleaderhaus.com" at the very bottom. The center of the tea tin's label also depicts a hand holding a lit candle. A wooden statue is partially visible behind and to the right of the tea tin. The entire background is a beige wall.

prompt_cn: 这是一张招聘海报，整体背景为淡紫色。海报顶部左侧是“Canva”品牌标识，中央是醒目的主标题“非你莫属”，采用白色描边粗体字。右侧有一个绿色的3D按钮，上面写着“JOIN US”，并配有一个手指点击的图标。海报左侧是一个白色的圆角矩形信息卡片，顶部有黄色背景的“招聘职位”标签。卡片内列出了三个职位：直播运营、内容运营和平面设计师，每个职位都包含数量和具体职责描述。卡片底部有指纹识别图标和两个卡通眼睛图形，下方是“扫码查看详情”的提示文字。海报右侧描绘了一个可爱的卡通男孩，他戴着蓝色帽子和黄色T恤，背着蓝色背包，手持麦克风，另一只手指向左侧的招聘信息，呈现出邀请的姿态。海报底部是深蓝色的条带，左侧标有电话号码“001-12345678”，右侧是地址“深圳市南山区金色商业街001号”。
prompt_en: This is a recruitment poster with a light purple background. At the top left of the poster is the "Canva" brand logo, and in the center is the prominent main title "非你莫属" (Fēi Nǐ Mò Shǔ), rendered in white outlined bold text. To the right, there is a green 3D button with "JOIN US" written on it, accompanied by a finger-tapping icon. On the left side of the poster is a white rounded rectangular information card, topped with a "招聘职位" (Recruitment Positions) label on a yellow background. The card lists three positions: Live Operations, Content Operations, and Graphic Designer, each including a quantity and specific job responsibilities. At the bottom of the card, there is a fingerprint recognition icon and two cartoon eye graphics, with the text "扫码查看详情" (Scan to view details) below them. The right side of the poster features a cute cartoon boy wearing a blue cap and a yellow T-shirt, carrying a blue backpack. He holds a microphone in one hand and points towards the recruitment information on the left with the other, adopting an inviting posture. The bottom of the poster has a dark blue strip, with the phone number "001-12345678" on the left and the address "深圳市南山区金色商业街001号" on the right.

In the upper right corner of the wall, two air conditioner outdoor units are installed, one of which has the green brand name "GREE" printed on it. Below the air conditioner units, white graffiti texts "ASR" and "VOYDER" are visible on the wall. The staircase is located on the right side and in the foreground of the image, extending from the bottom right to the upper left, with dark steps and silver handrails. He has dark, fluffy short hair, wears glasses, a purple suit jacket, a white shirt, and a striped tie, paired with black trousers, appearing in a floating posture. The character holds a small device with a glowing screen in his left hand, displaying the text "HAKUA". The background is dark, adorned with smoky white and gray swirls, floating spade and club playing cards, and some golden bullet-shaped objects. The entire image is framed by a textured border, with a yellow circular emblem marked with the Roman numeral "IX" in the top-left corner, and a curved yellow ribbon at the bottom right, bearing the text "The Hermit". The dominant colors of the image are dark black, gray, and deep purple, accented with yellow and white.

这是一个深色主题的软件界面截图，展示了系统设置中的显示（DISPLAY）选项。界面顶部导航栏包含“SYSTEM SETTINGS”标题和“DISPLAY”、“GRAPHICS”、“AUDIO”、“CONTROLS”四个标签页，“DISPLAY”被选中。左侧分类侧边栏标题为“CATEGORY”，下方列出“RESOLUTION”、“REFRESH RATE”、“DISPLAY MODE”、“V-SYNC”等菜单项，“RESOLUTION”项被选中。侧边栏底部有描述文字：“Adjust the screen resolution to balance visual clarity and performance.”
主要内容区域显示“SELECT RESOLUTION”标题和“RECOMMENDED”标签。下方列出多个分辨率选项，包括“3840 × 2160 UHD (4K)”、“2560 × 1440 QHD (2K)”、“1920 × 1080 FHD (1080P)”以及“CUSTOM MANUAL”，其中“3840 × 2160”选项被选中。接着是“ASPECT RATIO”设置，显示“16:9 Widescreen”，旁边“AUTO”和“21:9”两个按钮中“AUTO”被选中。再下方是“UI SCALING”设置，显示“100%”并带有一个蓝色滑块。界面底部有“BACK”、“RESET”和“APPLY CHANGES”三个操作按钮，“APPLY CHANGES”按钮被选中。
prompt_en:
This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface, displaying the "DISPLAY" options within "SYSTEM SETTINGS". The top navigation bar includes the "SYSTEM SETTINGS" title and four tabs: "DISPLAY", "GRAPHICS", "AUDIO", and "CONTROLS", with "DISPLAY" being selected and underlined in blue. On the left side is a category sidebar with the title "CATEGORY", listing menu items such as "RESOLUTION", "REFRESH RATE", "DISPLAY MODE", and "V-SYNC", with "RESOLUTION" highlighted with a blue background as the selected item. At the bottom of the sidebar, there is a descriptive text: "Adjust the screen resolution to balance visual clarity and performance."
The main content area shows the title "SELECT RESOLUTION" next to a blue-background "RECOMMENDED" tag. Below it are several resolution options, including "3840 × 2160 UHD (4K)", "2560 × 1440 QHD (2K)", "1920 × 1080 FHD (1080P)", and "CUSTOM MANUAL". The "3840 × 2160" option is selected, indicated by a blue dot. Following this is the "ASPECT RATIO" setting, showing "16:9 Widescreen", with "AUTO" and "21:9" buttons next to it, and "AUTO" being selected. Further down is the "UI SCALING" setting, displaying "100%" with a blue slider. At the bottom of the interface are action buttons: "BACK", "RESET", and a blue-background "APPLY CHANGES" button, which is also selected.

prompt_cn:
这是一张关于海洋深度的科学信息图表，整体分为三列，背景为浅米色。每列顶部有一个深红色船形横幅作为主标题。

第一列标题为“PART I: HYDROSTATICS”，下方有副标题、一段关于太阳辐射和静水压的文字，以及一个装饰性分隔符。接着是一个表格，列出了不同远洋带（如Epipelagic、Mesopelagic）的深度、温度、压力和盐度范围。底部是一个“LIGHT ATTENUATION CURVE”的线形图，展示了光线随深度衰减的情况。

第二列标题为“PART II: ZONATION”，下方有副标题。主体是一个垂直的海洋分层图，从0米到11000米深，用不同深浅的蓝色表示，并标注了各个区域的名称（如EPIPELAGIC [SUNLIGHT]、MESOPELAGIC [TWILIGHT]）。图中还包含鱼类和水母的剪影。

第三列标题为“PART III: ADAPTATIONS”，下方有副标题和一段关于生物发光的文字。接着是一个发光器（photophore）的示意图，标有REFLECTOR、LENS等部件。下方是关于“TECTONIC TRENCH GEOGRAPHY”的副标题、一段文字，以及一个条形图，展示了马里亚纳海沟等多个海沟的名称和深度。

每列底部都有一个深红色三角形图标。
prompt_en:
This is a scientific infographic about ocean depths, divided into three vertical columns against a light beige background. Each column is topped with a dark red, boat-shaped banner serving as the main title.

The first column, titled "PART I: HYDROSTATICS", includes subtitles, a paragraph explaining solar radiation and hydrostatic pressure, and a decorative separator. Below this is a table detailing the depth, temperature, pressure, and salinity ranges for various pelagic zones (e.g., Epipelagic, Mesopelagic). At the bottom, a line graph titled "LIGHT ATTENUATION CURVE" illustrates light attenuation with depth.

The second column, titled "PART II: ZONATION", features subtitles and a large vertical diagram depicting oceanic depth zones. Ranging from 0m to 11000m, these zones are represented by varying shades of blue and labeled with their names (e.g., EPIPELAGIC [SUNLIGHT], MESOPELAGIC [TWILIGHT]). Silhouettes of marine life, such as fish and jellyfish, are placed within their respective zones.

The third column, titled "PART III: ADAPTATIONS", contains subtitles and a paragraph on bioluminescence. An illustration of a photophore, labeled with components like REFLECTOR and LENS, is also present. Further down, under the subtitle "TECTONIC TRENCH GEOGRAPHY", there is a paragraph and a bar chart displaying the names and depths of several ocean trenches, including the Mariana Trench.

Each column concludes with a dark red triangular icon at the bottom.

prompt_en: This is an event poster with an environmental protection and energy saving theme. The poster is vertically divided into two main sections. The left section has a light green background, featuring "ECO-TECH CENTER" and a green diamond icon at the top. The top right corner displays "98% Recyclability". In the middle, there is a prominent title "节能减排 绿色未来" (Energy Saving and Emission Reduction, Green Future), followed by descriptive text "探索高效能设备的无限可能，重塑城市生活的碳足迹边界。" (Explore the infinite possibilities of high-efficiency equipment, reshape the carbon footprint boundary of urban life.). Below this, a dark rectangular box contains "碳足迹实时查询" (Carbon Footprint Real-time Query), "0.42 kg CO₂", "CARBON FOOTPRINT TRACKING", and a description "当前设备运行每小时减排量" (Current equipment's hourly emission reduction). The bottom left lists "体验中心地址 科技创新园 A1 展厅" (Experience Center Address: Technology Innovation Park A1 Exhibition Hall) and "开放时间 09:00 - 18:00" (Opening Hours: 09:00 - 18:00). A green "立即预约体验" (Book an experience now) button is in the bottom right. The right section has a dark blue background, showcasing a tall building covered with lush green plants. "ENERGY SAVING" is vertically arranged at the top of this section. Below the building, white text reads "每一度电 皆为自然" (Every kilowatt-hour of electricity is for nature), and "Sustainable Development Goals" is at the very bottom.

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内场景照片，展示了一个具有传统中式风格的建筑入口或舞台布景，其上方悬挂着“天桥艺术中心”的牌匾，并装饰有多盏红色灯笼。建筑内部墙壁上挂有花卉画作。画面左侧墙壁上垂直悬挂着一张红色宣传横幅，上面印有“第三届 北京·天桥 音乐剧演出季”和“TIANQIAO TH MUSICAL PERFORMANCE SEASON”等文字。左下角水平放置着另一张红色横幅，内容为“2025 北京·天桥 音乐剧盛典高峰对话”及其英文“BEIJING TIANQIAO MUSICAL ANNUAL CEREMONY SUMMIT FORUM”。画面右侧立有一个橙蓝拼接的立牌，橙色部分显示“音乐剧盛典 高峰对话”和“由此进入”字样，并带有一个二维码；蓝色部分顶部有“今日”字样，下方是模糊的文字列表。右侧边缘还有一面由金色亮片组成的装饰墙。整体色调以红色、深木色、金色和白色为主。

Inside the structure, the walls are decorated with floral paintings. On the left wall, a vertical red banner hangs, displaying text such as "第三届 北京·天桥 音乐剧演出季" (The Third Beijing·Tianqiao Musical Performance Season) and "TIANQIAO TH MUSICAL PERFORMANCE SEASON". Another horizontal red banner is placed on the lower left, featuring "2025 北京·天桥 音乐剧盛典高峰对话" (2025 Beijing·Tianqiao Musical Grand Ceremony Summit Dialogue) and its English counterpart "BEIJING TIANQIAO MUSICAL ANNUAL CEREMONY SUMMIT FORUM". To the right, there is an orange and blue standee; the orange part shows "音乐剧盛典 高峰对话" (Musical Grand Ceremony Summit Dialogue) and "由此进入" (Enter Here) with a QR code, while the blue part at the top reads "今日" (Today) with a blurry text list below. A decorative wall made of golden sequins is visible on the far right edge. The overall color scheme is dominated by red, dark wood, gold, and white.

韦伯空间望远镜 (JWST) 是一项耗资约 100 亿美元的国际合作项目，由 NASA、ESA 和 CSA 共同管理。其轨道位于日地拉格朗日 L2 点，通过巨大的五层遮阳板实现极高的热隔离性能。这种“千佛阵”般的精密结构使其能够探测来自宇宙深处的微弱红外信号，观测第一批恒星与星系的诞生。所有数据均基于 NASA 公布的最新技术手册。

text_59:
内容: 韦伯空间望远镜 (JWST) 是一项耗资约 100 亿美元的国际合作项目，由 NASA、ESA 和 CSA 共同管理。其轨道位于日地拉格朗日 L2 点，通过巨大的五层遮阳板实现极高的热隔离性能。这种“千佛阵”般的精密结构使其能够探测来自宇宙深处的微弱红外信号，观测第一批恒星与星系的诞生。所有数据均基于 NASA 公布的最新技术手册。
语言: 混合
位置: 图片底部通栏
字体/排版: 白色，小字号，左对齐
作用: 页脚
prompt_cn: 这是一张关于詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）结构解剖的信息图。图片以深灰色为背景，整体布局清晰，分为上下两大部分。顶部是望远镜的中英文标题。紧接着是一个红色背景的信息条，展示了望远镜的发射质量、轨道位置、工作寿命和波长范围等核心参数。下方主体内容分为左右两列，详细介绍了望远镜的三个主要组成部分：光学望远镜组件（OTE）、遮阳层系统（Sunshield）、近红外设备（NIR Suite）和中红外仪器（MIRI），每个部分都列出了多项具体技术指标。左下角配有一张主镜六边形阵列的拓扑图，并附有图例。右下角是关于光学系统组件、科学仪器模块和集成科学平台的文字描述。图片底部通栏是关于JWST项目背景和数据来源的详细说明。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing the structural anatomy of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). The image features a dark gray background with a clear layout, divided into two main sections. At the top, the telescope's title is presented in both Chinese and English. Below this, a red-background information bar displays core parameters such as the telescope's launch mass, orbit, operational life, and wavelength range. The main content below is organized into two columns, providing detailed information on three primary components of the telescope: the Optical Telescope Element (OTE), Sunshield, Near-Infrared Suite (NIR Suite), and Mid-Infrared Instrument (MIRI), each listing multiple specific technical specifications. The bottom left features a topological diagram of the primary mirror's hexagonal array, accompanied by a caption. The bottom right contains textual descriptions of the optical system components, scientific instrument module, and spacecraft bus. A full-width footer at the bottom of the image provides detailed background information on the JWST project and data sources.

prompt_en: This is a real-life photo of a car interior, taken from a rear-seat perspective. The image primarily shows the cockpit, including a driver, steering wheel, digital instrument cluster, central touchscreen, front passenger seat, and sun visor. The interior is mainly dark gray and black, with yellow stitching accenting the seat edges. The driver is on the left side of the frame, holding the steering wheel with both hands. The central screen displays a car graphic and a row of function icons at the bottom; the "Peugeot" brand name is visible on the top left of the screen and below the car graphic. The instrument cluster on the left shows a "P" gear indicator, speed "0 km/h", and an "AIRBAG" indicator light, while the right side displays "0 km". The exterior scenery is blurred due to the moving vehicle, revealing a winding road with trees on both sides. The car roof features a panoramic sunroof. The front passenger sun visor has an "AIRBAG WARNING" label, with detailed instructions below. A "易车" watermark is present in the bottom right corner of the image.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于现代公路自行车机械学与传动比的详细信息图。图片以深灰色背景为主，文字和关键元素采用白色和浅绿色高亮显示。顶部是标题“现代公路自行车机械学与传动比解剖 BICYCLE MECHANICS & GEAR RATIO ANATOMY [VER. 2024.01]”。图片主体内容分为三列：左侧展示车架几何布局，包含一个自行车车架的线稿图，并标注了REACH、STACK等尺寸以及头管角度、座管角度、轴距、前叉偏移等参数，底部还有[UCI_COMPLIANT: YES]和[MIN_WT: 6.80KG]的标签。中间列聚焦于传动系统核心，配有牙盘和飞轮的示意图，并附有关于传动效率的文字说明，下方是一个列出不同配置（Standard、Semi-Compact、Compact、Super Compact）下牙盘和飞轮齿数（如53/39T, 11-28T）的表格。右侧列是齿比计算矩阵，以表格形式详细列出了不同飞轮齿数下大盘和小盘的齿比，并对应了不同的骑行状态（如下坡/冲刺、高速巡航、陡坡等）。右下角是机械性能分析部分，提供了在90 RPM踏频下的理论时速和爬坡速度，并提及了碳纤维复合材料的使用。底部是页脚，包含DATA LOG、MATERIAL和DATE信息。
prompt_en: This image is a detailed infographic about modern road bicycle mechanics and gear ratios. The image features a dark gray background with text and key elements highlighted in white and light green. At the top is the title "现代公路自行车机械学与传动比解剖 BICYCLE MECHANICS & GEAR RATIO ANATOMY [VER. 2024.01]". The main content is divided into three columns: The left column displays frame geometry, including a line drawing of a bicycle frame with dimensions like REACH and STACK, as well as parameters such as head angle, seat angle, wheelbase, and fork rake. At the bottom are labels "[UCI_COMPLIANT: YES]" and "[MIN_WT: 6.80KG]". The middle column focuses on the drivetrain dynamics, featuring a schematic diagram of chainrings and cassettes, accompanied by text explaining transmission efficiency. Below this is a table listing chainring and cassette tooth counts (e.g., 53/39T, 11-28T) for different configurations (Standard, Semi-Compact, Compact, Super Compact). The right column presents a gear ratio matrix, detailing the gear ratios for large and small chainrings at various cassette tooth counts in a table format, corresponding to different riding conditions (e.g., Downhill, Cruise, Steep). The bottom right section provides a mechanical analysis, offering theoretical speeds for downhill and climbing at 90 RPM cadence, and mentioning the use of carbon fiber composite materials. The bottom footer includes DATA LOG, MATERIAL, and DATE information.

prompt_cn: 图片展示了一个桌面上的计算机视觉项目设置。画面中央是一个黑色显示器，其屏幕上显示着一个终端窗口和一个视频流窗口。视频流中，一个微缩道路模型上的多辆玩具车被绿色和红色边框标记，视频窗口标题显示“Zoom at 100% x 100%”。显示器下方叠加有蓝色文字“Parking Meter program w/ YOLO Pro model”。桌面上铺着深蓝色桌面布，上面放置着一个灰色的微缩道路模型，模型上有五辆不同颜色的玩具车（白色、红色、橙色、黄色、红色）。道路模型旁立有三个微型交通标志牌，其中两个是蓝色背景白色文字的停车牌，分别标有“P 30”和“P 120”，另一个是红圈斜杠的禁止停车标志。道路模型左侧有一个黑色收纳盒，里面装有额外的玩具车。右侧是一个透明白色外壳的电子设备，下方叠加蓝色文字“Rubik Pi 3”。左下角可见一个网络摄像头，其下方叠加蓝色文字“Camera (web cam)”，摄像头正对着道路模型。
prompt_en: The image displays a computer vision project setup on a desk. In the center of the frame is a black monitor, showing a terminal window and a video stream window on its screen. In the video stream, multiple toy cars on a miniature road model are marked with green and red bounding boxes, and the video window title reads "Zoom at 100% x 100%". Below the monitor, blue overlay text states "Parking Meter program w/ YOLO Pro model". The desk is covered with a dark blue tablecloth, on which a gray miniature road model is placed. Five toy cars of different colors (white, red, orange, yellow, red) are on the model. Beside the road model, there are three miniature traffic signs: two blue-background white-text parking signs marked "P 30" and "P 120" respectively, and one red circle with a diagonal line indicating a no-parking zone. To the left of the road model is a black storage box containing additional toy cars. To the right is an electronic device with a transparent white casing, with blue overlay text "Rubik Pi 3" below it. A webcam is visible in the bottom left, with blue overlay text "Camera (web cam)" below it, pointing towards the road model.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以纯白色为背景的工程机械产品渲染图或摄影图。画面主体是一辆黄黑相间的轮式物料抓取机，从右前方视角展示。该机械配备了一个长而多节的黄色机械臂，其末端连接着一个黑色的多爪抓斗。机械臂上可见黄色的三角形警告标志。车辆的驾驶室被黑色格栅保护，车身中部和机械臂上均印有黑色的“CAT”品牌标识。车辆底部有四个黑色车轮，整体结构坚固。
prompt_en: This is a product render or photograph of an engineering machine set against a pure white background. The main subject is a yellow and black wheeled material handler, shown from a front-right perspective. The machine is equipped with a long, multi-jointed yellow mechanical arm, which connects to a black multi-claw grapple at its end. Yellow triangular warning signs are visible on the mechanical arm. The vehicle's cab is protected by a black grille, and black "CAT" brand logos are printed on both the middle of the vehicle body and the mechanical arm. The vehicle has four black wheels at the bottom, presenting a robust overall structure.

prompt_en: This is a collage set against a light olive green background. The center of the image features an irregular grid composed of approximately 20 small photographs. The photos display a diverse range of subjects, including natural landscapes (such as mountains, fields, leaves, flowers, ducks, and a butterfly), objects (like shoes, a camera, a mirror, a straw hat, and a cup), and partial human figures (such as a hand). The collage is framed by a border with a green, red, and brown plaid pattern. At the top center of the image, the title "GOODBYE(2025)" is displayed in a large, textured, deep olive green font. At the bottom, there are two lines of deep olive green text: "2025 flashed by like a book filled with growth." on the left, and "--End" on the right. The overall collage exhibits a natural, soft palette of green, brown, and warm tones.

prompt_en: This is a digital invitation with a dark background, adorned with glowing purple and green geometric lines. At the top left, there are light gray text "贰零贰肆" and white text "年度盛典", while on the right is light gray text "智启未来 · 聚力同行". In the middle of the image, the large, bold white text "尊享晚宴" is centered, with the English "GALA DINNER INVITATION" below it. The main body text begins with "尊敬的嘉宾:", followed by two paragraphs of Chinese invitation, discussing the year-end grand ceremony and the symphony of technology and art. The bottom section is divided into three columns, titled with light blue text "盛典时间" (Event Time), "盛典地点" (Event Location), and "着装要求" (Dress Code). The time information is "2024.12.28" and "18:00 PM", the location is "星际艺术中心" (Interstellar Art Center) and "三层 极光大厅" (Third Floor Aurora Hall), and the dress code is "正式晚礼服" (Formal Evening Gown) and "Black Tie". At the bottom left of the invitation are the number "NO. 2024-0889-VIP" and "凭此函入场 · 贵宾专属" (Admission by this invitation · VIP Exclusive), and on the right are "未来科技集团有限公司" (Future Technology Group Co., Ltd.) and "董事会 敬邀" (Board of Directors cordially invites).

prompt_cn: 这是一张美食宣传海报，以深色背景衬托出一份精致摆盘的甜点或菜肴。画面中央是一道色彩丰富的创意料理，置于白色圆形餐盘上，包含棕色块状物、红色果肉、白色球状物和黄色酱汁等。海报顶部左侧有“COLLECTION 2024”、“时令新菜”和橙色的“EXPERIENCE”字样，右侧对应有“季节菜品”、“体验区”和编号“NO. 082-2024”。画面中央偏左位置，白色超大字体“惊艳 味蕾”垂直排列，右侧有竖向的“MODERN GASTRONOMY”装饰文字。主标题下方橙色斜体字写着“A Symphony of Seasonal Tastes”。底部左侧是编号“01”和“极致.鲜活”的小标题，配有描述性文字“跨越山海,只为那抹瞬即逝的自然原力。”；右侧是编号“02”和“匠心.重塑”的小标题，配有文字“精准至0.1度的温控,重构食材分子结构。”。右下角是一个白色矩形按钮，内含黑色文字“立即预览”、“RESERVE NOW”和“解锁五感盛宴”。
prompt_en: This food advertisement poster showcases an exquisitely plated dessert or dish against a dark background. A colorful, creative culinary creation, featuring brown blocks, red fruit pulp, white spheres, and yellow sauce, is presented on a white round plate at the image's center. The top left of the poster displays "COLLECTION 2024", "时令新菜" (Seasonal New Dishes), and orange "EXPERIENCE" text. The top right has "季节菜品" (Seasonal Dishes), "体验区" (Experience Area), and the identifier "NO. 082-2024". The main title "惊艳 味蕾" (Stunning Taste Buds) is vertically arranged in large white font on the center-left, with vertical decorative text "MODERN GASTRONOMY" to its right. Below the main title, orange italic text reads "A Symphony of Seasonal Tastes". The bottom section is divided into two parts: the left features "01" and "极致.鲜活" (Ultimate.Vibrant) with descriptive text "跨越山海,只为那抹瞬即逝的自然原力。" (Crossing mountains and seas, just for that fleeting natural essence.); the right features "02" and "匠心.重塑" (Ingenuity.Reshape) with text "精准至0.1度的温控,重构食材分子结构。" (Precise temperature control to 0.1 degrees, reconstructing the molecular structure of ingredients.). A white rectangular button in the bottom right corner contains black text "立即预览" (Preview Now), "RESERVE NOW", and "解锁五感盛宴" (Unlock a Feast for the Five Senses).

The main body of the interface is divided into three vertical panels. The left panel shows progress bars for "CPU LOAD 42%" and "MEMORY 68%", with detailed information below them including "Temp 54°C", "Clock 4.8 GHz", and "Used: 43.5 GB", "Total: 64.0 GB" respectively. The middle panel is titled "ACTIVE PROCESSES" with a "CPU Sort" button on the right. Below it is a table with columns for "PROCESS", "PID", "CPU %", and "STATUS", listing processes such as "System UI Renderer", "Data Analytics", "Network Daemon", and "Kernel Task" along with their running statuses. The right panel contains a "SETTINGS" area with an "Auto Refresh" toggle and three refresh interval buttons "1s", "5s", "30s", with the "5s" button currently selected. Below this is the "EVENT LOG" area, displaying log messages like "[14:20] Refreshing...", "[14:20] Operational.", and "[14:20] High Memory.". The bottom of the interface shows "CPU: I9-13900K", "GPU: RTX 4090", and "SYSTEM SECURE" status.

The middle section features a light-colored rectangular area with rounded corners, containing two black and white photographs: the left one shows footprints on sand, captioned "左足印记" (Left Footprint); the right one is a close-up of an adult hand holding a baby's small hand, with the faint, tilted, light gray English word "BABY" visible in the background, captioned "右足印记" (Right Footprint). At the bottom center of the card, the dark gray artistic Chinese text "诚邀参加满月礼" (Sincerely Invite You to the Full Moon Ceremony) is presented, followed by the body text "家中宝贝 [宝宝姓名] 满月啦" (Our baby [Baby's Name] is one month old!) and "诚挚邀请您与我们共同分享这份喜悦与幸福。" (We sincerely invite you to share this joy and happiness with us.). The left side of the page presents a list of detailed technical parameters and weight distribution data for the wind turbine, such as rated power, rotor diameter, and tower weight. The right side displays a cross-sectional view of the main wind turbine structure, clearly showing its internal components and major parts, including the rotor blade, rotor hub, gearbox, generator, yaw drive, tower, and foundation, all labeled with numbers and text. Dimensions like a rotor diameter of 120 meters and a tower height of 100 meters are also indicated. The bottom section is divided into two parts, detailing the "机舱传动系统 / TRANSMISSION" and "气动控制与并网 / POWER CONTROL" with descriptive text and key operational data. The image primarily uses black text and lines, with some titles and data highlighted by a yellow background, while indicator lines and specific data are in red and blue. The footer includes project information, scale, and an archive number.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于微塑料来源和分布的科学信息图。图片分为A、B、C三个主要部分。A部分位于左上方，通过六组插图展示了微塑料的来源，包括宏观塑料、油漆、塑料颗粒、合成纺织品、轮胎和个人护理产品。B部分位于右上方，是一个柱状图，标题为“Leakage by source in Kt”，显示了不同来源的微塑料泄漏量，从左到右依次为个人护理产品（57Kt）、塑料颗粒（254Kt）、轮胎（973Kt）、合成纺织品（211Kt）、油漆（1301Kt）和宏观塑料（7568Kt）。C部分占据图片下方，是一个等距透视图，描绘了微塑料在各种环境介质中的分布，包括海鸟、农田、土壤、河流、大气、珠穆朗玛峰、湖泊、海岸线、海面、海冰、深海和深海沉积物，并为每个介质提供了具体的微塑料浓度或数量数据。图中的文字主要为黑色，标题为大字号粗体，其他标签和数据为较小字号。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic illustrating the sources and distribution of microplastics, divided into three main sections: A, B, and C. Section A, located in the upper left, presents six illustrated sources of microplastics, including macro plastic, paint, plastic pellets, synthetic textiles, tires, and personal care products. Section B, in the upper right, is a bar chart titled "Leakage by source in Kt," displaying the leakage amounts of microplastics from different sources. From left to right, these are personal care products (57Kt), plastic pellets (254Kt), tires (973Kt), synthetic textiles (211Kt), paint (1301Kt), and macro plastic (7568Kt). Section C, occupying the lower part of the image, is an isometric perspective view depicting the distribution of microplastics across various environmental media, such as seabirds, agricultural land, soil, rivers, atmosphere, Mount Everest, lakes, shorelines, sea surface, sea ice, deep sea water, and deep sea sediment, with specific microplastic concentration or quantity data provided for each medium. The text in the image is predominantly black, with the title in large bold font, and other labels and data in smaller fonts.

In the lower-middle part of the poster is the movie's Chinese main title "紫蝴蝶", rendered in an artistic purple-white gradient font, with the English title "PURPLE BUTTERFLY" in white italic serif font below it. In the lower-middle right, there is a light-colored, stylized butterfly pattern. The bottom right of the poster features a silhouette of a black car with its headlights on, suggesting a scene in the rainy night. The top left corner contains multiple lines of white promotional text, describing the film's plot and Zhang Ziyi's breakthrough performance. The top right corner displays the palm leaf logo of the 56th Cannes International Film Festival, with "唯一入围华语片" (the only Chinese film selected) written below it. His left leg is a green prosthesis, and his skin is covered with colorful geometric patches in red, yellow, blue, and green. The boy's white T-shirt has the colorful word "FAMILY" printed on the chest. Most of the image area is occupied by large, multi-colored, and stylistically varied English text, scattered around the boy, forming the thematic message "A COLORFUL LIFE DOES NOT AFFECT OUR BIG FAMILY BECAUSE OF DEFECTS". Specifically, the letter "E" in "LIFE", "AFFECT", "BECAUSE", and "DEFECTS" incorporates a wheelchair icon, while the letter "F" in "DEFECTS" incorporates a white cane and sunglasses icon. In the upper right corner, a small block of black English text repeats the main title content. At the bottom center of the image are the author's name "FAN YU" and "CHINA". The entire illustration, through the boy's image and the text content, collectively conveys a theme about defects and a colorful life.

The left section presents the main title and detailed information for the event, including the "2024 FOREST PROTECTION" identifier, and prominent large Chinese characters "护林员 巡逻室 知识竞赛" (Forest Ranger Patrol Room Knowledge Contest). Below this is a subtitle "提升岗位技能·筑牢森林防火安全防线" (Enhance job skills, build a strong forest fire prevention safety line) with its English translation. 秩序与复调
1600 - 1820
巴洛克与古典时期奠定了西方音乐的基石。巴洛克音乐强调情绪对位，古典主义时期则通过合理的理性调和确立了以钢琴和交响乐团为载体的音乐形式规则。
1711
键盘革命
加里莱斯托弗里在佛罗伦萨发明第一台强弱钢琴 (Pianoforte)，宣告羽管键琴时代的终结与现代键盘音乐的诞生。
情感与扩张
1820 - 1900
随着工业革命的发展，浪漫主义时期把主观情感与诗性叙事推向极致。钢琴结构钢骨化改革大幅拓宽了音域，使得交响乐的张力与体量空前扩张。
1830
标题音乐
柏辽兹首演《幻想交响曲》，通过“固定乐思”将文学性叙事引入器乐曲，彻底确立了十九世纪标题音乐的范式。
瓦解与重建
1900 - 2000
二十世纪见证了传统调性体系的瓦解。印象派的和声色彩化、十二音技法以及噪音美学的出现，打破了西方长达数百年对于“和”与“不和”的判断与定义。
1913
节奏颠覆
斯特拉文斯基《春之祭》在巴黎首演，其不协和和弦与前瞻的旋律主义复杂节奏引发观众骚乱，改写了现代音乐史。
ENCYCLOPÆDIA ACADEMICA • HISTORIA MUSICAE CLASSICAE • PLATE XIV

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于西方古典音乐历史演变的信息图表。图表顶部是中文主标题“西方古典音乐 4 大时期时间轴”及其英文副标题。主体部分包含一个从1600年到2000年的水平时间轴，详细标注了巴洛克、古典、浪漫和现代四个主要音乐时期及其代表作曲家如巴赫、莫扎特、贝多芬等。时间轴下方左侧是一个条形图，展示了管弦乐团编制人数在不同时期的演变；右侧是一个流程图，解释了古典交响乐的奏鸣曲式结构。图表中部是一个详细的表格，比较了不同时期作曲家的活跃时期、主导乐器、创作特征和代表作品。底部则分为三列，分别以“秩序与复调”、“情感与扩张”和“瓦解与重建”为主题，结合具体年份和事件，阐述了各时期的音乐发展特点。整个图表以深棕色和金色为主色调，结构清晰，信息丰富。
prompt_en: This is an infographic detailing the historical evolution of Western classical music. At the top, the chart features a main Chinese title "西方古典音乐 4 大时期时间轴" (Chronology of Classical Music: Eras, Instruments & Composers) and its English subtitle. The main body includes a horizontal timeline spanning from 1600 to 2000, marking four major music periods—Baroque, Classical, Romantic, and Modern—along with representative composers such as Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven. Below the timeline, a bar chart on the left illustrates the evolution of orchestra sizes across different periods, while a flowchart on the right explains the sonata-allegro form structure of classical symphonies. The middle section presents a detailed table comparing composers from various eras, including their active periods, dominant instruments, creative characteristics, and representative works. The bottom part is divided into three columns, themed "Order and Polyphony," "Emotion and Expansion," and "Disintegration and Reconstruction," each elaborating on the musical development characteristics of its respective period with specific years and events. The entire infographic is predominantly in dark brown and gold tones, featuring a clear structure and rich information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人眼解剖学的深色背景信息图，详细介绍了眼球的屈光系统和视网膜的十层结构。图片顶部标题为“OCULAR REFRACTION & RETINAL STRATA”，下方有中文副标题“人眼眼球解剖学：光学屈光系统与视网膜10层结构”。图表分为上下两大部分。上半部分是“屈光系统”，包含一段英文描述、一个简化的眼球横截面图（标示了光线输入、角膜、晶状体、视网膜中央凹和视神经）以及一个列出眼球各组成部分折射率和屈光力的表格。下半部分是“视网膜分层”，包含一段英文描述、一个详细的视网膜十层结构图（标示了从L1到L10的各层名称和光线方向）以及一个列出视网膜各层名称和组成的表格。部分标题、章节标识和表格数据以红色突出显示，所有文字均为白色。底部有来源信息和页脚。
prompt_en: This is a dark-themed infographic detailing human eye anatomy, specifically the ocular refractive system and the ten-layered retinal structure. The top of the image features the main title "OCULAR REFRACTION & RETINAL STRATA," with a Chinese subtitle "人眼眼球解剖学：光学屈光系统与视网膜10层结构" below it. The infographic is divided into two main horizontal sections. The upper section, titled "REFRACTIVE SYSTEM," includes an English descriptive paragraph, a simplified cross-section diagram of the eye (labeled with light input, cornea, lens, fovea, and optic nerve), and a table listing the refractive index and power of various eye components. The lower section, titled "RETINA STRATA," contains an English descriptive paragraph, a detailed diagram of the ten retinal layers (labeled L1 to L10 with their names and light direction), and a table outlining the name and composition of each retinal stratum. Some titles, section indicators, and table data are highlighted in red, while all other text is white. Source information and footers are present at the bottom.

The game environment is predominantly dark blue and cyan, with glowing line patterns on the floor. To the left is a large, blue glowing square cage-like structure, and to the right, a character is climbing a ladder. The user interface is located at the screen's edges: a circular minimap showing partial areas and icons is in the top right. The bottom left features the player character's avatar, health bar (green) and energy bar (purple) with corresponding numbers '125' and '0', and player level '1'. The bottom right displays a team icon with quantities '27/44' and '2', and a weapon icon with ammunition '2/2' and '1'. The overall color scheme is dark, but with numerous bright neon light effects.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深蓝色到深紫色渐变背景的演示文稿页面，主题为“荣誉资质”。页面顶部左侧是白色粗体的中文标题“荣誉资质”及其浅蓝色的英文副标题“HONORS AND QUALIFICATIONS”，右侧是浅蓝色的中文标语“见证每一份匠心，载誉前行”。页面主体分为左右两栏。左栏垂直排列着三组数据和描述，包括“15+ 载行业深耕经验”、“280+ 项核心专利技术”和“50+ 国际设计大奖”，数字部分为浅蓝色特大字号，描述为白色。右栏是四个呈2x2网格布局的圆角矩形内容块，每个块包含一张图片和一段文字描述。从上到下、从左到右依次是：一张黑白颁奖照片，配有“高新技术企业”的标题和描述；一张黑白证书照片，配有“ISO9001认证”的标题和描述；一张多个奖杯的照片，配有“红点设计大奖”的标题和描述；一张彩色会议照片，配有“行业领军企业”的标题和描述。页面底部中央是浅蓝色的英文页脚“EXCELLENCE & INNOVATION”。
prompt_en: This is a presentation slide with a dark blue to dark purple gradient background, themed "Honors and Qualifications". The top left of the page features the white bold Chinese title "荣誉资质" (Honors and Qualifications) and its light blue English subtitle "HONORS AND QUALIFICATIONS". On the top right, there is a light blue Chinese slogan "见证每一份匠心，载誉前行" (Witness every craftsmanship, advance with honor). The main body of the page is divided into two columns. The left column vertically displays three sets of data and descriptions: "15+ 载行业深耕经验" (15+ years of industry experience), "280+ 项核心专利技术" (280+ core patented technologies), and "50+ 国际设计大奖" (50+ international design awards). The numerical parts are in large, light blue font, and the descriptions are in white. The right column contains four rounded rectangular content blocks arranged in a 2x2 grid, each with an image and a text description. From top to bottom, left to right, these are: a black and white award ceremony photo with the title "高新技术企业" (High-tech Enterprise) and its description; a black and white certificate photo with the title "ISO9001认证" (ISO9001 Certification) and its description; a photo of multiple trophies with the title "红点设计大奖" (Red Dot Design Award) and its description; and a color meeting photo with the title "行业领军企业" (Industry Leading Enterprise) and its description. At the bottom center of the page is the light blue English footer "EXCELLENCE & INNOVATION".

The evolution of server resource management is defined by the tension between absolute isolation and operational efficiency. Traditional Virtual Machines (VMs) provide a robust boundary by emulating an entire hardware suite, necessitating a full Guest Operating System for every application instance. This "heavy" approach ensures that even a kernel panic in one environment remains strictly contained, yet it consumes vast quantities of memory and storage for redundant system files.
In contrast, the Docker Container Engine leverages the Linux kernel's namespaces and control groups (cgroups) to isolate processes within a shared environment. By eschewing the redundant Guest OS layer, containers achieve a level of density and speed previously unattainable. This transition from hardware emulation to process-level encapsulation represents a fundamental shift in the cloud atlas, enabling microservice architectures to flourish across transient, ephemeral infrastructures.
EDITION 1930 X4 – ATLAS OF CLOUD COMPUTATION

In the middle left, red Chinese text states "城市湖泊竞赛起点站 / 龙舟艺术写生季" (City Lake Race Starting Point / Dragon Boat Art Sketching Season), with corresponding white English text "CITY LAKE COMPETITION / SKETCHING SEASON" on the right, further elaborating on the event content. Below this is a clear table outlining the event's specific times, stages, and statuses. The table headers, "TIME", "EVENT STAGE 赛事进程", and "STATUS", are all white and bold. The table consists of four rows, each detailing a time (e.g., "08:00", "10:30", "14:00", "17:00"), a bilingual event description (e.g., "祭神点睛 / 龙舟入水" and its English translation), and a status label (e.g., "READY", "ON-GOING", "SCHEDULED"). The last event description also includes the location "Xuanwu Lake, Nanjing - Official Race Starting Point". In the bottom right, stylized white text reads "START LINE" with a dashed line below it, mirroring a red dot and dashed line on the left.

prompt_cn: 图片是一张关于阿波罗11号任务的信息图表，采用浅米色背景和深灰色文字。页面垂直分为两个主要部分，每个部分都以一个大型中文汉字作为视觉标识，并配有英文标题和详细描述。上半部分以汉字“矢”为标识，标题为“SATURN V LAUNCH VEHICLE”，左侧是土星五号运载火箭的线稿图，右侧是关于火箭的定义、结构描述以及推进规格表格。表格列出了S-IC、S-II和S-IVB三个阶段的推进剂、平均推力和燃烧时间。火箭线稿图上标注了LES、CSM/LM、S-IVB、S-II和S-IC等部件。下半部分以汉字“月”为标识，标题为“APOLLO 11 FLIGHT PROFILE”，描述了阿波罗11号任务的飞行时间线。时间线以左右交错的两列形式呈现，详细记录了从发射升空到大气层再入的关键事件，包括发射、入轨、地月转移、月球着陆、月面舱外活动和再入大气层等。
prompt_en: The image is an informational graphic about the Apollo 11 mission, featuring a light beige background with dark gray text. The page is vertically divided into two main sections, each marked by a large Chinese character as a visual identifier, accompanied by an English title and detailed descriptions. The poster's overall color scheme is dark, dominated by deep tones and yellowish-browns. At the top, there is a tagline "SOMEONE HAS TO FIX THE PROBLEMS," followed by the actors' names "JASON STATHAM" and "BEN FOSTER." The movie title "THE MECHANIC" is positioned in the lower-central part of the poster, with large typography where the letter 'O' is designed as a target symbol. The bottom section of the poster contains the movie credits, arranged in two small-font columns. A QR code and several film production company logos are visible in the bottom left corner. Below it is a pink, cupcake-shaped 3D cartoon character with large eyes, wearing a purple beret and a red skirt, holding a purple megaphone. In the background behind the character, the light blue English text "DAILI ZHAOMU" is repeated and blurred. Below the character is the subtitle "| 好的副业 千载难逢 |". Underneath the subtitle, three colored rectangular tags with white text are arranged side-by-side, reading "刚毕业好迷茫", "做家务好无聊", and "找工作好绝望". Below these tags is a three-line body text in black: "你还在原地观望? 加入我们,一切都不是难事 可画团队,等的就是你". Below the body text is a line of light blue English text "HAO DE FU YE QIAN ZAI NAN FENG". In the bottom left corner, there is a square icon containing a white fingerprint pattern, surrounded by small squares and dots. To its right are the contact details: "电话: 001-12345678" and "地址: 深圳市南山区金色商业街001号商铺".

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface, displaying an "Aggregation Rule Configuration" page. The interface features a top navigation bar, showing "聚合规则配置 / 策略编辑" (Aggregation Rule Configuration / Policy Editing) on the left, and "规则 ID: AGG-9527" (Rule ID: AGG-9527) with a green "运行中" (Running) status tag on the right. The main content area is divided into left and right columns, with a bottom action bar. The left column contains "基础定义" (Basic Definition) and "收敛效率预估" (Convergence Efficiency Estimation) modules. The "Basic Definition" module displays the rule name "生产环境核心业务聚合" (Production Environment Core Business Aggregation), scope of effect "Cluster: prod-01" and "Namespace: order", and "最后更新: 2023-10-24" (Last Updated: 2023-10-24). The "Convergence Efficiency Estimation" module prominently shows "85.4 %" and "预计减少 1,240 条告警/日" (Estimated reduction of 1,240 alerts/day). The right column features the "聚合逻辑配置" (Aggregation Logic Configuration) module, which includes "聚合维度 (Group By)" (Aggregation Dimension (Group By)) with "alert_name", "service_id", "severity" tags below it, and a "+ 添加" (+ Add) button. Additionally, there are "静默等待 30s" (Silent Wait 30s), "重复间隔 4h" (Repeat Interval 4h), and "抑制条件 (Inhibition)" (Suppression Condition (Inhibition)), where the text "当存在 Critical 告警时，抑制同服务的 Warning 告警。" (When Critical alerts exist, suppress Warning alerts of the same service.) has "Critical" and "Warning" highlighted in yellow. The bottom action bar shows system information "SYS: 0x88291 LATENCY: 12ms" on the left, and "取消" (Cancel) and a blue "保存应用" (Save and Apply) button on the right.

prompt_en: This is an electronic birthday greeting card or poster. The image features a pink gradient background, transitioning from darker pink at the top and bottom to a lighter pink in the middle, with a subtle dotted texture. At the top, there is a dark pink rectangular banner with "CELEBRATION" written in large, white, bold, uppercase letters. Below it is a black and white photograph of a sparkling glitter heart, framed by a glowing white border. Underneath the heart, a pink rounded rectangular box contains the Chinese text "生日快乐" (Happy Birthday) in white, bold font. In the lower-middle part of the image, a light pink rectangular text box holds a multi-line birthday message in dark pink Chinese characters, which reads: "May your world always be filled with pink dreams. On this brilliant day, may you shine like a diamond, possess all beauty and romance, and forever maintain that passionate and pure heart." At the bottom center of the image, there is dark pink text "致最亲爱的你" (To my dearest you). White L-shaped decorative lines are present in all four corners of the image.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以“丝乐风飘 处处闻”为主题的多元音乐文化展海报。海报整体色调为暖色，以金色、橙色和棕色为主。画面顶部右侧是“广州海事博物馆”的中英文名称及一个圆形徽标。海报中央是一个拱形边框，框内背景是沙丘起伏的沙漠景观，上方有古代壁画风格的纹样。拱形框内居中显示着艺术字体的展览标题“丝乐风飘 处处闻”，下方是副标题“多元音乐文化展”。再下方是展览日期“2025 11/29 - 2026 04/06”，其中年份垂直排列，以及展览地点“广州海事博物馆 三层展厅”。画面下半部分，在沙漠景观中，有五位身着古代服饰、演奏不同乐器的金色剪影人物，他们姿态各异，包括击鼓、弹奏琵琶状乐器、吹奏管乐器和弹奏竖琴状乐器。海报左下角列出了“指导单位”和“主办单位”及其具体名称。
prompt_en: This is a poster for a diverse music culture exhibition titled "Silk Music Drifts, Heard Everywhere". The overall color scheme of the poster is warm, predominantly gold, orange, and brown. At the top right, there is the Chinese and English name of "广州海事博物馆" and a circular emblem. The center of the poster features an arch-shaped frame, within which the background depicts a desert landscape with undulating sand dunes and ancient mural-style patterns above. Centered within the arch are the artistic exhibition titles "丝乐风飘 处处闻" (Silk Music Drifts, Heard Everywhere), followed by the subtitle "多元音乐文化展" (Diverse Music Culture Exhibition). Below that are the exhibition dates "2025 11/29 - 2026 04/06", with the years vertically aligned, and the exhibition location "Guangzhou Maritime Museum, Third Floor Exhibition Hall". In the lower half of the image, amidst the desert landscape, there are five golden silhouette figures dressed in ancient attire, playing various musical instruments, including drumming, playing a pipa-like instrument, a wind instrument, and a harp-like instrument. The bottom left of the poster lists the "Guiding Unit" and "Organizing Unit" with their respective names.

prompt_cn: 这是一张浅米色背景的致谢卡片或通知。卡片顶部中央是深灰色大字标题“衷心感谢”，标题上下各有一条短横线装饰。卡片右侧边缘垂直排列着浅棕色的“如意”二字。卡片中部偏上位置有一张黑白照片，展示了五根颜色由浅到深、顶部打着复杂绳结的绳索。照片下方是四行深灰色正文，内容为“承蒙诸位亲友于先人治丧期间 鼎力相助，惠赐赙仪，亲临吊唁 感念之情，铭记于心 特此奉上薄礼，以表谢忱”。卡片底部左侧是两行祝福语“愿 岁岁平安 万事如意”，右侧是落款“孝眷 叩谢”和日期“二零二四年 岁在甲辰”。日期旁边有一个红色方框，框内是白色的“谢”字。
prompt_en: This is a thank-you card or notice with a light beige background. At the top center of the card is the dark gray large-font title "衷心感谢" (Heartfelt Thanks), flanked by short horizontal decorative lines above and below. On the right edge of the card, the light brown characters "如意" (As you wish) are arranged vertically. Slightly above the middle of the card is a black and white photograph showing five ropes, varying in color from light to dark, each with an intricate knot at the top. Below the photo are four lines of dark gray body text, which read: "承蒙诸位亲友于先人治丧期间 鼎力相助，惠赐赙仪，亲临吊唁 感念之情，铭记于心 特此奉上薄礼，以表谢忱" (Thank you to all relatives and friends for your great help, generous condolences, and personal attendance during the funeral of our deceased loved one. Your kindness is deeply appreciated and remembered. We hereby present a small gift to express our gratitude). At the bottom left of the card are two lines of blessings: "愿 岁岁平安 万事如意" (May you be safe and peaceful every year, and may all your wishes come true). On the bottom right are the sign-off "孝眷 叩谢" (Filial family bows in thanks) and the date "二零二四年 岁在甲辰" (Year 2024, Jia Chen year). Next to the date is a red box containing the white character "谢" (Thanks).

[0001] 本专利说明书描述了一种基于奥托循环(Otto Cycle)的内燃机动力输出控制系统。该系统通过精确调节进气门与排气门的相位关系,实现四个独立行程的高效热力学转换。核心在于活塞在气缸内往复运动与曲轴旋转角度的解耦给定。
[0002] 在压缩行程中,活塞由下止点(BDC)向移动至上止点(TDC),此时所有气门均处于密封状态。缸内混合气的体积和热源缩小至原来的十分之一。此过程遭遇绝热压缩方程,缸内压力由常压升高到约1.2MPa。为确保的爆燃点火或无爆震时必须提供强度与压力基础。
[0003] 做功行程是系统唯一的正功输出阶段。当活塞接近上止点时,火花塞释放高压电弧引燃压缩混合气。化学能通过剧烈的氧化反应转化为热能,产生的膨胀压力推动活塞向下运动。通过该行程将能量传输至曲轴转动。
[0004] 排气行程标志着单次循环的结束。排气门在活塞再次上行前开启,利用缸内压力差及活塞的机械推力,将燃烧产生的废气排出气缸空间。该阶段的效率直接影响下一循环的充气系数及整体功率输出稳定性。

text_34:
内容: [0001] 本专利说明书描述了一种基于奥托循环(Otto Cycle)的内燃机动力输出控制系统。该系统通过精确调节进气门与排气门的相位关系,实现四个独立行程的高效热力学转换。核心在于活塞在气缸内往复运动与曲轴旋转角度的解耦给定。
语言: 中文
位置: P-V图右侧
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，水平，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_35:
内容: [0002] 在压缩行程中,活塞由下止点(BDC)向移动至上止点(TDC),此时所有气门均处于密封状态。缸内混合气的体积和热源缩小至原来的十分之一。此过程遭遇绝热压缩方程,缸内压力由常压升高到约1.2MPa。为确保的爆燃点火或无爆震时必须提供强度与压力基础。
语言: 中文
位置: P-V图右侧
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，水平，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_36:
内容: [0003] 做功行程是系统唯一的正功输出阶段。当活塞接近上止点时,火花塞释放高压电弧引燃压缩混合气。化学能通过剧烈的氧化反应转化为热能,产生的膨胀压力推动活塞向下运动。通过该行程将能量传输至曲轴转动。
语言: 中文
位置: P-V图右侧
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，水平，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_37:
内容: [0004] 排气行程标志着单次循环的结束。排气门在活塞再次上行前开启,利用缸内压力差及活塞的机械推力,将燃烧产生的废气排出气缸空间。该阶段的效率直接影响下一循环的充气系数及整体功率输出稳定性。
语言: 中文
位置: P-V图右侧
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，水平，左对齐
作用: 正文

In the lower-left part of the page is an Otto cycle P-V state diagram, with four numbered points and P, V axis labels. Below the P-V diagram is a table listing valve, piston, and state information for different strokes. To the right of the P-V diagram and the table are four numbered paragraphs of explanatory text, along with a structured identifier list. All text is black, and the background is white. The title font is the largest and bold, while other text varies in size and boldness. The flowchart uses rounded rectangles for steps and dashed arrows for flow direction. Statistical data values are displayed in large bold font, with smaller descriptive text below. The P-V diagram is a closed curve in a two-dimensional coordinate system, with P and V as the axes. The table has four columns and six rows of data, including a header row.

prompt_cn: 这是一张移动应用界面截图，展示了燃气用量统计信息。界面背景为浅灰色，整体采用卡片式布局。顶部导航栏包含一个左箭头图标、居中标题“燃气用量统计”和一个齿轮状设置图标。下方是一个主信息卡片，显示“本月累计用量 (m³)”为“42.5”，并标注“↑ 12%”的增长，统计周期为“2023.10.01 - 至今”。中部是三个并列的选项卡：“日视图”、“周视图”、“月视图”，其中“日视图”被选中。再下方是一个“用量趋势”卡片，左上角标题为“用量趋势”，右上角标注“单位: m³”。卡片内是一个柱状图，显示了五天的用量，其中“10.24”、“10.25”和“今日”的柱子为橙色，而“10.27”、“10.28”的柱子为灰色。底部并列显示两个信息卡片，左侧卡片标题为“预计费用”，显示金额“¥148.75”和带有绿色圆点的状态“正常”。右侧卡片标题为“安全监测”，显示蓝色文字“运行中”和带有蓝色盾牌图标的状态“无风险”。橙色和蓝色文字及图标用于突出显示关键信息和状态。
prompt_en: This is a mobile application interface screenshot displaying gas usage statistics. The interface has a light gray background and uses a card-based layout. The top navigation bar includes a left arrow icon, a centered title "燃气用量统计" (Gas Usage Statistics), and a gear-shaped settings icon. Below it is a main information card showing "本月累计用量 (m³)" (Current Month Cumulative Usage) as "42.5", with an "↑ 12%" increase indicated, and a statistical period of "2023.10.01 - 至今" (2023.10.01 - Present). In the middle are three side-by-side tabs: "日视图" (Day View), "周视图" (Week View), and "月视图" (Month View), with "日视图" currently selected. Further down is a "用量趋势" (Usage Trend) card, with "用量趋势" as its title in the top left and "单位: m³" (Unit: m³) in the top right. Inside the card is a bar chart showing five days of usage, where the bars for "10.24", "10.25", and "今日" (Today) are orange, while the bars for "10.27" and "10.28" are gray. At the bottom, two information cards are displayed side-by-side. The left card is titled "预计费用" (Estimated Cost), showing the amount "¥148.75" and a status "正常" (Normal) with a green dot icon. The right card is titled "安全监测" (Safety Monitoring), displaying blue text "运行中" (Running) and a status "无风险" (No Risk) with a blue shield icon. Orange and blue text and icons are used to highlight key information and statuses.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的系统监控界面截图，整体呈现出终端或命令行风格。界面主要以亮绿色等宽字体显示信息，部分图表元素使用洋红色。图片顶部包含一个命令行输入、主标题“SYS_ATMOSPHERE_MATRIX.LOG”和系统状态信息。下方左右两侧是两个大型数据指标，分别显示“75.00%”和“99.00%”，并附有系数标签。界面中部左侧是一个折线图，描绘了海拔（ALT）与温度（TEMP）的关系，图上标注了“ISS ORBIT (400KM)”、“METEOR BURN”、“O3 SHIELD”和“99% H2O”等关键点，并有Y轴（海拔）和X轴（温度）的刻度。中部右侧是四个详细的文本面板，分别介绍了对流层、平流层、中间层和热层的数据范围和特性。图片底部是一个表格，列出了大气层的十六进制地址、系统名称、海拔范围、最高温度和系统状态。表格下方还有两个小型信息面板，分别是“HEX CORE READOUT [ATM]”和“SHIELD_MONITOR”，显示了十六进制数据和防护系统状态。整个界面通过绿色线条进行区域划分，所有文字清晰可辨，共同构成了一个详细的大气数据监测报告。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a system monitoring interface with a dark background, resembling a terminal or command-line style. The interface primarily displays information in bright green monospace font, with some chart elements using magenta. The top of the image includes a command-line input, the main title "SYS_ATMOSPHERE_MATRIX.LOG", and system status information. Below, on the left and right, are two large data indicators showing "75.00%" and "99.00%" respectively, accompanied by coefficient labels. The middle-left section of the interface features a line graph illustrating the relationship between altitude (ALT) and temperature (TEMP). Key points such as "ISS ORBIT (400KM)", "METEOR BURN", "O3 SHIELD", and "99% H2O" are annotated on the graph, along with Y-axis (altitude) and X-axis (temperature) scales. The middle-right section contains four detailed text panels, each describing the data range and characteristics of the troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, and thermosphere. At the bottom of the image, there is a table listing the hexadecimal address, layer system name, altitude range, maximum temperature, and system state for each atmospheric layer. Below the table are two smaller information panels: "HEX CORE READOUT [ATM]" displaying hexadecimal data, and "SHIELD_MONITOR" showing shield system status. The entire interface is divided into sections by green lines, and all text is clearly legible, collectively forming a detailed atmospheric data monitoring report.

prompt_cn: 这是一张街头摄影照片，捕捉了白天城市街道上的一辆复古有轨电车和人群。画面中心偏右是一辆黄色和白色的有轨电车，车头显示目的地为“PRAZERES”和线路号“28”，下方有车辆编号“544”。车身侧面有蓝色手写体文字“Patrocinador Oficial”、“Lisboa”和“Frescante”，以及小字“VIGOR”。有轨电车旁和站台上聚集着一群行人，部分人正在等待或上下车。画面左侧是一个公交车站，其广告牌上展示着一则以蓝色和绿色为主色调的广告。广告内容包括品牌标识“CARRIS”和“EMUSA”，广告语“O teu momento de prazer”，以及瓶装产品“UCAL ate”和署名“Miguel Peixoto Dentista de tubarões”。广告牌上方有红色和黄色的信息牌，显示“TRAM TOUR”、“5”、“HILLS TRAMCAR TOUR”、“4”、“TRAM TOUR”以及“12E 28E”、“C 3481A”、“3599”、“Supermercado”等文字信息。背景是多层建筑和茂密的树木。地面铺设着鹅卵石，整体光线明亮，呈现出繁忙的城市街景。
prompt_en: This is a street photography image capturing a vintage tram and a crowd on a city street during the daytime. Slightly to the right of the center, a yellow and white tram is visible. Its front displays the destination 'PRAZERES' and line number '28', with vehicle number '544' below. The side of the tram features blue handwritten text 'Patrocinador Oficial', 'Lisboa', and 'Frescante', along with smaller text 'VIGOR'. A group of pedestrians is gathered next to the tram and on the platform, with some waiting or boarding/alighting. On the left side of the frame is a bus stop, with an advertisement board featuring a blue and green-toned ad. The ad content includes brand identifiers 'CARRIS' and 'EMUSA', the slogan 'O teu momento de prazer', a bottled product 'UCAL ate', and the signature 'Miguel Peixoto Dentista de tubarões'. Above the advertisement board are red and yellow information signs displaying text such as 'TRAM TOUR', '5', 'HILLS TRAMCAR TOUR', '4', 'TRAM TOUR', '12E 28E', 'C 3481A', '3599', and 'Supermercado'. The background consists of multi-story buildings and lush trees. The ground is paved with cobblestones, and the overall lighting is bright, depicting a bustling urban street scene.

prompt_en: This is a movie promotional poster featuring multiple superhero characters. Iron Man is positioned slightly to the left of the center, extending his right hand with a glowing palm. Thor and Captain America are on the right side of the frame, while the Hulk is in the upper left corner, Hawkeye on the left, and Black Widow and Nick Fury are towards the middle right. The background depicts a damaged city skyline with tall buildings and distant explosions. prompt_cn: 这是一张儿童教材页面，主要用于拼音学习。页面顶部中央是红色的拼音标题“ai ei ui”，左上角有一个绿色圆圈内的页码“9”。页面主体部分是一幅温馨的插画，描绘了一位白发老人坐在树下，手持书籍，正给围坐在他周围的五名儿童讲故事或教学。他们身旁有一张小桌子和一个杯子，背景是浅色的围栏。插画下方是三列黑色的拼音练习内容，分别对应“ai”、“ei”和“ui”的声调变化及与声母的组合，例如“āi ái ǎi ài”、“g-āi → gāi”等。页面左下角标有页码“40”。整页色彩柔和，布局清晰，图文结合，旨在辅助儿童学习拼音。
prompt_en: This is a children's textbook page primarily designed for Pinyin learning. At the top center of the page is the red Pinyin title "ai ei ui", and in the upper left corner, there is a page number "9" enclosed in a green circle. The main part of the page features a warm illustration depicting a white-haired elder sitting under a tree, holding a book, and telling stories or teaching five children gathered around him. Beside them are a small table and a cup, with a light-colored fence in the background. Below the illustration are three columns of black Pinyin exercises, corresponding to the tone variations of "ai", "ei", and "ui", as well as their combinations with initials, such as "āi ái ǎi ài" and "g-āi → gāi". The page number "40" is indicated in the bottom left corner. The overall page features soft colors and a clear layout, combining illustrations and text to aid children in learning Pinyin.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电商产品详情页面的截图。页面背景由左上角的亮绿色和右下角的深蓝色对角线划分。一个半透明的圆角矩形卡片覆盖在背景之上，展示了所有UI元素。卡片中央突出显示一双蓝白相间的阿迪达斯足球鞋，鞋底有发光的蓝色点缀，鞋身有三个白色圆形信息点。卡片左侧是产品信息区，包含“adidas”品牌标志、“ACE 16+PURECONTROL”产品名称、一段产品描述、价格“$ 210”和一个“ADD TO CART”按钮。左下角有Instagram、Facebook、Twitter和LinkedIn的社交媒体图标。卡片右侧是产品选择区，包括“SIZE”标签和八个尺码选项（US1至US8），其中“US1”被选中。下方是“COLOR”标签和三个颜色选项（蓝色选中、绿色、橙色）。页面右上角有搜索、购物车和菜单图标。主产品下方有左右导航箭头。卡片底部并列展示了三张产品缩略图，每张图都显示了产品名称（“ADIDAS PURECONTROL”或“ADIDAS”）、星级评分（五星或四星）、价格“$ 210”和“3 COLORS”标签，以及一个加号图标。
prompt_en: This is a screenshot of an e-commerce product detail page. The page background is diagonally split into a bright lime green on the top-left and a dark blue on the bottom-right. A semi-transparent, rounded rectangular card overlays the background, displaying all UI elements. A blue and white Adidas soccer cleat, with glowing blue accents on its sole and three white circular information points on its body, is prominently featured in the center of the card. The left section of the card presents product information, including the "adidas" brand logo, "ACE 16+PURECONTROL" product name, a product description, the price "$ 210", and an "ADD TO CART" button. Social media icons for Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn are located at the bottom-left. The right section of the card features product selection options, including a "SIZE" label with eight size buttons (US1 to US8), where "US1" is selected. Below this is a "COLOR" label with three color swatches (blue selected, green, and orange). Utility icons for search, shopping bag, and a menu are at the top-right of the page. Navigation arrows are positioned below the main product. At the bottom of the card, three product thumbnails are arranged horizontally, each showing a product name ("ADIDAS PURECONTROL" or "ADIDAS"), star ratings (five or four stars), the price "$ 210", a "3 COLORS" label, and a plus icon.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a dark-themed software interface, showcasing a widget sorting and layout control system named "WIDGET MANAGER". The interface is structured into three columns: the left column is a widget category navigation bar, featuring options like "全部组件" (All Widgets), "系统监控" (System Monitoring), "生产力工具" (Productivity Tools), and "媒体娱乐" (Media Entertainment), with "全部组件" highlighted by a blue background, and "存储空间" (Storage Space) with a progress bar at the bottom. The central area displays the "当前排序视图" (Current Sort View), showing previews of four widgets numbered 1 to 4, including "系统负载监控" (System Load Monitoring), "待办事项清单" (To-Do List), "世界时钟" (World Clock), and "媒体控制器" (Media Controller), each with a title and a brief description. The right column is the "排序规则设置" (Sorting Rule Settings) panel, containing settings such as "自动对齐网格" (Auto-align Grid) and "排序逻辑" (Sorting Logic), with the "开启磁吸对齐" (Enable Snap Alignment) and "按使用频率排序" (Sort by Usage Frequency) buttons having blue backgrounds. At the top, there are "保存布局" (Save Layout) and "重置排序" (Reset Sort) buttons, while at the bottom, there is a red "锁定布局" (Lock Layout) button and an "导出配置" (Export Configuration) link. The status bar at the bottom of the interface shows "SYSTEM ONLINE" and version information "V2.4.0 // 2560X1600_RENDER".

The rocket body is marked with vertical text such as "S-IVB", "S-II", "USA", and "S-IC", and multiple horizontal lines connect to English labels for different parts of the rocket, including "LAUNCH ESCAPE SYS", "APOLLO CSM (P/LOAD)", and "LUNAR MODULE ADAPTER". The right column is divided into three main information sections, each titled with a dark red number. The first section, "MISSION OVERVIEW & SPECIFICATIONS", includes a paragraph of text and a table detailing the propellant, thrust, burn time, and height for each rocket stage. The second section, "STAGE DYNAMICS & PROPULSION", describes the power and propulsion details of the S-IC, S-II, and S-IVB stages in three subsections. The third section, "INJECTION SEQUENCE TIMELINE", contains a paragraph of text and a line graph showing "ORBIT" and "TLI" curves, with key event timestamps like "S-IC SEP" and "S-II SEP" marked. Data source information is provided at the bottom of the image.

prompt_cn: 这是一张以重阳节为主题的活动宣传海报。海报主体是一幅温馨的特写照片，一位戴着眼镜、满头银发的老年女性面带笑容，背景是绿叶和几朵黄色的花朵。照片左侧叠加着巨大的白色中文艺术字“重陽”，下方是金色的英文“CHONGYANG”。照片右下角有一个红色矩形背景，上面写有白色文字“岁月温情 · 影像纪实”。海报右上角有一个倾斜的红色标签，上面写着“敬老”。右侧是垂直排列的文字信息栏，顶部是深棕色的标题“岁久 弥新”，下方是金色的副标题“社区夕阳红活动室”。信息栏中包含“THEME / 主题：长辈人像 专题摄影展”和“VISION / 愿景”等内容。下方深色背景框内列出了“时间 / DATE：农历九月初九”和“地点 / VENUE：社区二楼活动大厅”。海报底部中央是深灰色的引用文字：“‘每一道皱纹，都是岁月亲吻过的勋章。’”，右下角是年份“2024”和英文“Respect for the Elderly”。
prompt_en: This is an event promotion poster themed around the Chongyang Festival. The main part of the poster features a warm close-up photograph of an elderly woman with glasses and white hair, smiling, against a background of green leaves and yellow flowers. On the left side of the photo, large white Chinese artistic characters "重陽" are overlaid, with the golden English "CHONGYANG" below. In the bottom right of the photo, there is a red rectangular background with white text "岁月温情 · 影像纪实". In the top right corner of the poster, there is a tilted red label with "敬老" written on it. The right side features a vertically arranged text information column. At the top, there is a dark brown title "岁久 弥新", followed by a golden subtitle "社区夕阳红活动室". The information column includes "THEME / 主题: 长辈人像 专题摄影展" and "VISION / 愿景". Below, within a dark background box, "时间 / DATE: 农历九月初九" and "地点 / VENUE: 社区二楼活动大厅" are listed. At the bottom center of the poster is a dark gray quote: "‘每一道皱纹，都是岁月亲吻过的勋章。’", and in the bottom right, the year "2024" and the English "Respect for the Elderly".

西文字体解剖学 15 要素
ANATOMY OF TYPOGRAPHY
西文字体解剖学是解析西文字体构造与比例关系的核心方法。通过建立基准线系统（如Baseline、x-height 等）并识别关键笔画特征（如Stem、Serif），设计师能够量化评估字体的视觉重心与灰度分布。以下通过几何构筑模型与维也纳图示法，系统性呈现西文字体的核心空间构成。
观察样本: 拉丁字母经典衬线体与无衬线体
分析维度: 五线四格度量系统与笔画部件
字形度量结构与基准线

Ascender Line 升部线

Descender Line 降部线

Bowl 字碗
结构设计基准
度量五线: 升部线限定小写字母上伸高度，大写高限定大写字母顶端，中线标定小写字母核心高度，基线作为字符底座，降部线则约束笔画下沉边界。
部件关联: 字干提供垂直支撑骨架，字碗包裹出字母内部的负空间（字眼），横梁则作为骨架间的平衡拉力。衬线作为末梢点缀，在视觉上引导阅读视线水平移动。
比例原则: 经典衬线体的 x 字高通常占大写字母高度的 60% 至 68%，高 x 字高有利于小屏幕辨识，而低 x 字高保留了更多的优雅感与阅读节奏。

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于西文字体解剖学的技术信息图表，详细阐述了字体设计的15个核心要素。页面顶部有“图版 04 // 字体系统解剖学”和“ANATOMY OF TYPOGRAPHY”的页眉，以及主标题“西文字体解剖学 15 要素”。下方是引言段落，并列出“观察样本”和“分析维度”。图表主体采用两栏布局，分为三个主要部分。第一部分左侧是“字形度量结构与基准线”标题下的字母“H”和“p”结构图，详细标注了字干、升部线、基线等部件；右侧是“结构设计基准”标题下的文字说明，解释了度量五线、部件关联和比例原则。第二部分左侧是“主要字体解剖要素比重 (ISOTYPE 图示法)”标题下的条形图，比较了不同字体类型中字干、字碗和衬线的比重；右侧是“核心部件解析”标题下的两个表格，分别阐述了升部/降部和字碗/字干的结构与功能。底部是“其余解剖学要素定量分析表”，以表格形式列出横向笔画、字眼、终端、衬线、x字高和基线等要素的中文名、英文名、度量基准、数值范围及视觉作用。页脚包含“ISOTYPE SYSTEM // ATLAS 04”及数据来源、制图方法和版式设计信息。整体以黑白为主，红色方块作为各部分标题前缀。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic about the anatomy of Western typography, detailing 15 core elements of font design. The page header includes "图版 04 // 字体系统解剖学" on the left and "ANATOMY OF TYPOGRAPHY" on the right, with the main title "西文字体解剖学 15 要素" below. An introductory paragraph is followed by labels for "Observation Sample" and "Analysis Dimension". The main body of the infographic adopts a two-column layout, structured into three main sections. The first section on the left features a diagram under the title "字形度量结构与基准线", illustrating the structure of letters 'H' and 'p' with detailed annotations for elements like stem, ascender line, and baseline; the right side presents textual explanations under the title "结构设计基准", covering measurement lines, component relationships, and proportion principles. The second section on the left displays a bar chart under the title "主要字体解剖要素比重 (ISOTYPE 图示法)", comparing the proportions of stem, bowl curve, and serif structure across humanist serif, transitional serif, and geometric sans-serif font types; the right side contains two tables under the title "核心部件解析", detailing the structure and function of ascenders/descenders and bowls/stems. The bottom section, titled "其余解剖学要素定量分析表", is a large table listing the Chinese and English names, measurement benchmarks, typical value ranges, and visual effects of various typographic elements such as crossbar, counter, terminal, serif, x-height, and baseline. The footer includes "ISOTYPE SYSTEM // ATLAS 04" along with information on data source, mapping method, and layout design. The overall color scheme is predominantly black and white, with red squares serving as prefixes for section titles.

UPPER LAYER SPLIT:
The decoupling of the CU and DU allows high-PHY processes to reside closer to the antenna array, minimizing backhaul latency while virtualizing control plane logic.
PROPAGATION DYNAMICS:
FR1 signals exhibit predictable diffraction patterns over complex terrain. FR2 millimeter wave signals require line-of-sight propagation due to atmospheric loss.
HYBRID ALLOCATION:
Coexistence of eMBB and URLLC traffic is managed via dynamic resource grid slicing, ensuring low-latency priority access without starving broadband capacity.
