prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张深灰色背景的技术演示幻灯片或海报，主要内容分为左右两列布局。顶部主标题为“先进半导体体制演进：从 10μM 到 2NM”，右侧有标识信息“SPEC ID: ATLAS-SEMICON-005 REV: 2024.Q4”。左侧栏包含“结构演进”、“节点技术参数矩阵”和“摩尔定律演进曲线”三个部分。右侧栏包含“系统图例”和“先进封装”两个部分。“结构演进”部分展示了FINFET和GAAFET/NANOSHEET两种半导体结构示意图，并配有粉色和蓝色文字标签。“系统图例”部分列出了结构框架、散热、信号、关键等元素，并用绿色方块标识。其下方有三个绿色边框的数据框，显示光刻机波长、数值孔径和晶体管密度的具体数值。“节点技术参数矩阵”是一个表格，详细列出了年份、制程节点、典型处理器、核心技术革新、晶体管密度和工作电压等信息。“摩尔定律演进曲线”是一个橙色折线图，X轴标注年份（1971, 2011, 2025），Y轴标注“密度倍数”。“先进封装”部分介绍了2.5D COWS、3D HYBRID BONDING和CHIPLET 芯粒三种技术。图片底部有页脚信息，包括DATA_SOURCE、CLASSIFICATION和UNIT_SYS。大部分文字为白色，标题较大且粗，部分关键数据和标签使用绿色、粉色、蓝色突出显示。
prompt_en: This image is a technical presentation slide or poster with a dark gray background, primarily laid out in two columns. The main title at the top reads "先进半导体体制演进：从 10μM 到 2NM" (Advanced Semiconductor System Evolution: From 10μM to 2NM), with identification information "SPEC ID: ATLAS-SEMICON-005 REV: 2024.Q4" on the right. The left column includes three sections: "结构演进" (Structural Evolution), "节点技术参数矩阵" (Node Technology Parameter Matrix), and "摩尔定律演进曲线" (Moore's Law Evolution Curve). The right column contains "系统图例" (System Legend) and "先进封装" (Advanced Packaging) sections. The "结构演进" section displays two semiconductor structure diagrams, labeled FINFET and GAAFET/NANOSHEET, accompanied by pink and blue text labels. The "系统图例" section lists elements like structural framework, thermal, signal, and critical, identified by green squares. Below it are three green-bordered data boxes showing specific values for lithography wavelength, numerical aperture, and transistor density estimation. The "节点技术参数矩阵" is a table detailing information such as year, process node, typical processor, core technology innovation, transistor density, and operating voltage. The "摩尔定律演进曲线" is an orange line graph with years (1971, 2011, 2025) on the X-axis and "密度倍数" (Density Multiplier) on the Y-axis. The "先进封装" section describes three technologies: 2.5D COWS, 3D HYBRID BONDING, and CHIPLET 芯粒. Footer information at the bottom of the image includes DATA_SOURCE, CLASSIFICATION, and UNIT_SYS. Most text is white, titles are larger and bold, and some key data and labels are highlighted in green, pink, and blue.

TRADITIONAL EDOMAE SUSHI TAXONOMY
EXPEDITION NOTE: SPECIMEN ANALYSIS // REGION: EDO (TOKYO BAY) // SUBJECT: NIGIRI-ZUSHI & ALLIED FORMS
The primary foundation of the Edomae tradition is Oryza sativa seasoned with red or white vinegar, known as Shari. It is imperative that the temperature remains at 36-37° Celsius, mirroring the human body. This precise thermal state ensures the volatile aromatic compounds of the vinegar are expressed without compromising the structural integrity of the rice grains.
The marriage of Shari and Neta (fish/topping) represents a monumental balance in Japanese culinary architecture. This journal documents the five distinct structural classifications observed in the field, ranging from the singular hand-pressed mound to complex cylinders wrapped in Porphyra (seaweed).
FIG 1.0: ARCHITECTURAL SECTION OF NIGIRI AND GUNKAN ARCHETYPES
LATTITUDINAL SECTION: NIGIRI
NETA (10g)
SHARI (15g)
NORI WALL (3-4CM)
TOPPING
RICE BASE
VERTICAL ELEVATION: GUNKAN
CLASSIFICATIONS
ANALYSIS DATA
01. NIGIRI-ZUSHI: The hand-pressed standard. Requires exactly 15g of vinegar-seasoned rice topped with a 10g slice of seafood. The pressure must be sufficient to hold form but leave air between grains.
02. MAKI-ZUSHI: Cylindrical rolls. Includes Hosomaki (thin) and Futomaki (thick). The seaweed (Nori) forms the exterior chassis, enclosing rice and varied fillings.
03. URAMAKI: The “inside-out” variation. Primarily developed for external markets, the rice forms the outer layer, often decorated with Sesamum indicum (sesame) or fish roe for texture.
TYPE
DIMENSION
KEY COMPONENT

Conical Nori

Cylindrical Core
04. TEMAKI: A conical hand-roll roughly 10cm in length. Designed for immediate consumption to maintain the crispness of the seaweed vessel.
05. GUNKAN-MAKI: The “Warship” roll. A perimeter of seaweed is used to contain loose ingredients such as Uni (sea urchin) or salmon roe.
THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM: 36.5°C

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于传统江户前寿司分类学的米色信息图。图片顶部中央是深棕色标题“TRADITIONAL EDOMAE SUSHI TAXONOMY”，下方是副标题“EXPEDITION NOTE: SPECIMEN ANALYSIS // REGION: EDO (TOKYO BAY) // SUBJECT: NIGIRI-ZUSHI & ALLIED FORMS”。标题下方左右两侧各有一段深棕色正文，介绍江户前寿司的基础和结构分类。图片中部展示了“NIGIRI”和“GUNKAN”两种寿司的结构剖面图，图表标题为“FIG 1.0: ARCHITECTURAL SECTION OF NIGIRI AND GUNKAN ARCHETYPES”。左侧的Nigiri图显示了“NETA (10g)”和“SHARI (15g)”的组成，右侧的Gunkan图则标示了“NORI WALL (3-4CM)”、“TOPPING”和“RICE BASE”。图片底部左右两侧分别有“CLASSIFICATIONS”和“ANALYSIS DATA”两个标题。左侧标题下方列出了01至03项寿司分类的详细描述，包括Nigiri-Zushi、Maki-Zushi和Uramaki。右侧标题下方是一个包含“TYPE”、“DIMENSION”和“KEY COMPONENT”三列的表格，列出了Nigiri、Gunkan、Temaki和Maki的尺寸和关键组成部分，表格下方是04和05项寿司分类的描述，即Temaki和Gunkan-Maki。图片底部中央有一个小图标和页脚文字“THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM: 36.5°C”。
prompt_en: This is a beige informational poster or scientific illustration detailing the taxonomy of traditional Edomae sushi. At the top center of the image is the deep brown title "TRADITIONAL EDOMAE SUSHI TAXONOMY", followed by the subtitle "EXPEDITION NOTE: SPECIMEN ANALYSIS // REGION: EDO (TOKYO BAY) // SUBJECT: NIGIRI-ZUSHI & ALLIED FORMS". Below the title, there are two paragraphs of deep brown body text on the left and right, introducing the foundation and structural classifications of Edomae sushi. The middle section of the image displays architectural section diagrams for "NIGIRI" and "GUNKAN" sushi, with the diagram title "FIG 1.0: ARCHITECTURAL SECTION OF NIGIRI AND GUNKAN ARCHETYPES". The left Nigiri diagram shows the components "NETA (10g)" and "SHARI (15g)", while the right Gunkan diagram labels "NORI WALL (3-4CM)", "TOPPING", and "RICE BASE". At the bottom of the image, there are two headings: "CLASSIFICATIONS" on the left and "ANALYSIS DATA" on the right. Below the left heading, items 01 to 03 provide detailed descriptions of sushi classifications, including Nigiri-Zushi, Maki-Zushi, and Uramaki. Below the right heading, there is a table with three columns: "TYPE", "DIMENSION", and "KEY COMPONENT", listing the dimensions and key components for Nigiri, Gunkan, Temaki, and Maki. Below the table are items 04 and 05, describing Temaki and Gunkan-Maki sushi classifications. At the bottom center of the image, there is a small icon and footer text "THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM: 36.5°C".

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影宣传海报，采用竖向构图。画面主体是前景中一男一女两位年轻演员，他们身着休闲服饰，神情略显忧郁，站在城市天际线前的露台上。背景是深蓝色的傍晚或夜空，城市建筑的轮廓依稀可见。海报顶部有白色宣传语“近年最真实最扎心的爱情电影”，下方是白色歌词“不复相见 不负遇见 和你走过的时光又回到原点 回到相遇那天”。画面中上部，半透明的浅蓝色英文“Almost Love”作为背景元素。中部是白色“电影《遇见你》主题曲”字样，下方是亮绿色手写体“再不见”作为歌曲标题，并标注了演唱者“王靖雯”。海报左下角是导演“落落”的名字，以及电影中文名“遇见你”和英文名“ALMOST LOVE”。右下角列出了主演“李汶翰、徐若晗、赖冠霖”，上映日期“08/04”，以及白色宣传语“只有遇见 才是七夕”。
prompt_en: This is a movie promotional poster with a vertical composition. The main subjects are two young actors, a man and a woman, in the foreground. They are dressed in casual attire, with somewhat melancholic expressions, standing on a terrace in front of a city skyline. The background features a dark blue evening or night sky, with the silhouettes of city buildings faintly visible. At the top of the poster, there is a white promotional slogan "近年最真实最扎心的爱情电影" (The most real and heartbreaking love movie in recent years), followed by white lyrics "不复相见 不负遇见 和你走过的时光又回到原点 回到相遇那天" (Never to meet again, never to regret meeting; the time we spent together returns to the starting point, back to the day we met). In the upper-middle part of the image, a semi-transparent light blue English text "Almost Love" serves as a background element. The middle section displays "电影《遇见你》主题曲" (Theme song of the movie "Meet You") in white, below which is the bright green handwritten title "再不见" (Never See Again) for the song, with the singer "王靖雯" (Wang Jingwen) credited. The bottom left corner shows the director's name "导演 落落" (Director Luo Luo), along with the movie's Chinese title "遇见你" (Meet You) and English title "ALMOST LOVE". The bottom right corner lists the main actors "主演 李汶翰、徐若晗、赖冠霖" (Starring Li Wenhan, Xu Ruohan, Lai Guanlin), the release date "08/04", and a white slogan "只有遇见 才是七夕" (Only meeting makes it Qixi Festival).

prompt_cn:
这是一张关于柯本气候分类系统的详细信息图表。图片整体布局清晰，分为顶部标题区、中间三列内容区和底部六个气候类型示例框。顶部区域包含左上角带有“KÖPPEN 1900”字样的圆形徽章，居中显示主标题“柯本气候分类系统”及其英文副标题“STANDARD CLIMATOLOGICAL CLASSIFICATION”和中文副标题“基于温度与降水量之全球地理分区指标”，右上角则有一个大型半透明数字“1000”作为装饰。

中间内容区由垂直分隔线划分为三列。左侧列提供了“分类准则 A & B”的文字描述，并配有一个名为“图 1.1: 干旱带蒸发临界值示意”的线形图，图中标有“蒸发线”和“年降水量 (mm)”。中间列是“气候带核心指标表”，列出了代码、主要名称、温度指标和降水条件，表格下方是一个带有“GLOBAL ZONES”字样的世界地图轮廓图，以及一段关于指标修正案的说明文字。右侧列则包含“分类准则 C, D & E”的文字描述，下方是一个名为“图 1.2: 全球理想纬度气候带分布”的圆形示意图，图中标注了“极地”、“副极地 (B/C)”和“赤道 (A)”等区域。

图片底部是六个并排的矩形框，每个框代表一种具体的气候类型，如“Af 热带雨林”和“BWk 寒冷沙漠”，并附有简要描述和页脚编号。图表背景为浅米色，大部分文字为黑色，部分标题加粗。中间表格的表头背景和左侧线形图的线条均为浅棕色。
prompt_en:
This is a detailed infographic about the Köppen climate classification system. The overall layout of the image is clear, divided into a top title area, a middle three-column content area, and a bottom section with six climate type examples. The top area includes a circular badge with "KÖPPEN 1900" in the upper left corner, the main title "柯本气候分类系统" (Köppen Climate Classification System) centered with its English subtitle "STANDARD CLIMATOLOGICAL CLASSIFICATION" and Chinese subtitle "基于温度与降水量之全球地理分区指标" (Global geographical division indicators based on temperature and precipitation), and a large, semi-transparent number "1000" as a decorative element in the upper right.

The middle content area is divided into three columns by vertical lines. The left column provides textual descriptions for "分类准则 A & B" (Classification Criteria A & B) and features a line graph titled "图 1.1: 干旱带蒸发临界值示意" (Figure 1.1: Schematic diagram of arid zone evaporation threshold), labeled with "蒸发线" (Evaporation line) and "年降水量 (mm)" (Annual precipitation (mm)). The middle column presents a "气候带核心指标表" (Core Climate Zone Indicator Table) listing codes, main names, temperature indicators, and precipitation conditions. Below the table is an outline map of the world with "GLOBAL ZONES" text, and a descriptive note about the amendment of the indicators. The right column contains textual descriptions for "分类准则 C, D & E" (Classification Criteria C, D & E), below which is a circular diagram titled "图 1.2: 全球理想纬度气候带分布" (Figure 1.2: Distribution of ideal global latitudinal climate zones), labeled with areas like "极地" (Polar), "副极地 (B/C)" (Subpolar (B/C)), and "赤道 (A)" (Equatorial (A)).

The bottom of the image features six side-by-side rectangular boxes, each representing a specific climate type, such as "Af 热带雨林" (Af Tropical Rainforest) and "BWk 寒冷沙漠" (BWk Cold Desert), accompanied by a brief description and a footer number. The chart background is light beige, most text is black, and some titles are bold. The table header background in the middle column and the lines in the left line graph are light brown.

A TECHNICAL EXPOSITION OF GLYPH RECTILINEARITY AND STROKE STANDARDIZATION
I. PATENT SPECIFICATION
NO. I
To all to whom these presents shall come, greeting. I, Her Majesty's Commissioner of Patents, hereby certify this treatise on the structural mechanics of the Chinese character. This specification delineates the rigorous transition of Hanzi glyphs from archaic pictorial incisions of the Oracle Bone epoch to the highly regulated, rectilinear geometries of the Imperial Tang Dynasty. Herein is demonstrated the systematic reduction of curve radii, the mathematical standardization of stroke sequences, and the ultimate transition from organic representation to a standardized grid-based orthography.

The introduction of the hair brush during the Qin-Han transition initiated the "Lidian" (隶变) watershed, converting rounded glyph lines into angular, modular strokes. This mechanical shift facilitated rapid imperial administration across the unified dynasties.

prompt_cn: 这是一张仿古风格的专利文件，标题为“ON THE STRUCTURAL EVOLUTION OF THE SINOGRAPHIC SCRIPT”（汉字书写结构演变）。页面顶部有“PATENT OFFICE”和“A.D. 1856”等字样，底部有“LONDON”的出版信息和“V.R.”标志。文档采用两栏布局，分为五个主要部分。第一部分是专利说明，阐述了汉字从甲骨文到唐代楷书的演变过程。第二部分包含一个折线图，展示了“RECTILINEAR INDEX”（直线度指数）随“CHRONOLOGICAL ERA”（年代）的变化，显示了秦汉时期直线度显著加速。第三部分通过图示分析了汉字“中”的几何结构。第四部分展示了八种历史汉字字体的样本，包括甲骨文、金文、大篆、小篆、隶书、草书、行书和楷书，每种字体都配有名称、朝代和简要描述。第五部分是一个比较分析矩阵表格，列出了不同字体类别的年代、主要几何特征、平均笔画数和直线度。
prompt_en: This is an antique-style patent document titled "ON THE STRUCTURAL EVOLUTION OF THE SINOGRAPHIC SCRIPT". The top of the page features "PATENT OFFICE" and "A.D. 1856", while the bottom includes publication information from "LONDON" and a "V.R." emblem. The document is laid out in a two-column format and divided into five main sections. Section I provides a patent specification, detailing the evolution of Chinese characters from Oracle Bone script to Regular script of the Tang Dynasty. Section II presents a line graph illustrating the "RECTILINEAR INDEX" over "CHRONOLOGICAL ERA", showing a sharp acceleration in rectilinearity during the Qin-Han transition. Section III offers a diagrammatic analysis of the geometric structure of the Chinese character "中". Section IV displays a grid of eight historical Chinese script specimens, including Oracle Bone, Bronze Script, Great Seal, Small Seal, Clerical, Cursive, Running, and Regular scripts, each with its name, dynasty, and a brief description. Section V contains a comparative analysis matrix table, listing different script classes by epoch, dominant geometry, mean strokes, and rectilinearity.

prompt_en: This is a specification sheet or infographic about Japanese tea ceremony spaces and implements. The image features a beige background with a clear layout, divided into a top title section, a middle information section, two diagram sections on the left and right, and a table and notes section at the bottom. At the top center is the main title "军需配给规格书: 日本茶道空间与器具" (Military Supply Specifications: Japanese Tea Ceremony Spaces and Implements), with the English subtitle "NOMENCLATURE: CHADO INFRASTRUCTURE & IMPLEMENTS" below it. To the right, "已检验 / PASSED" is marked in red, bold, italicized text. Below the title is the document information section, including "库存编号 / STOCK NO: JP-TEA-1945-KOTO", "合同编号 / CONTRACT NO: QM-8821-ZEN", and "日期 / DATE: 2024年10月24日". The left panel displays a "茶室空间布局图 (四叠半标准型)" (Tea Room Layout Diagram (Standard Four-and-a-Half Tatami Mat Type)), which includes a floor plan with areas labeled "床之间 (TOKOMA)", "炉 (RO)", and "躏口", along with specifications for the tea room area and entrance dimensions, and their symbolic meaning. The right panel is a "核心流程示意图 (点茶流线)" (Core Process Diagram (Tea Preparation Flow)), illustrating the tea preparation process through four steps: "入场" (Entry), "净手心" (Hand Purification), "点茶/饮" (Tea Preparation/Drinking), and "退场" (Exit), connected by arrows. Below this, the core principles of tea ceremony—"和 (Wa)、敬 (Kei)、清 (Sei)、寂 (Jaku)"—are explained. The lower half of the image features a detailed table listing 15 tea ceremony implements, including "序号 ID" (Item ID), "器具名称 NOMENCLATURE" (Implement Name), "材质 MATERIAL" (Material), and "用途与技术规格 DESCRIPTION / SPECS" (Purpose and Technical Specifications). Below the table is the "备注 / NOTES" section, containing four points of attention, with the second point, "紧急处理 URGENT" (Urgent Handling), also highlighted in red, bold, italicized text. The very bottom of the image contains the footer information "QUARTERMASTER CORPS - ASIA PACIFIC DIVISION - NO. 702".

TECHNICAL MANUAL // ATLAS OF SYSTEM ARCHITECTURES // SECTION 04
SCALE: LOGICAL SCHEMATIC
DATE: 1984 VS 1989 ARCHITECTURES
PLATE 42
SYSTEM: NETWORKING
01 // THE SEVEN LAYERS OF OSI
The ISO developed the Open Systems Interconnection reference model to define structured network protocols. By partitioning communications into discrete functional layers, engineers ensure hardware compatibility and protocol modularity across heterogeneous systems.
OSI LAYER FUNCTIONALITIES:
L7 APP: Interfaces user applications with network services. Protocols: HTTP, DNS, SMTP, FTP.
L6 PRES: Translates, encrypts, and compresses data. Protocols: SSL, TLS, ASCII, JPEG, MPEG.
L5 SESS: Manages sessions between applications. Protocols: RPC, SOCKS, NetBIOS, PPTP.
L4 TRANS: Provides reliable end-to-end data transfer. Protocols: TCP, UDP, SCTP, DCCP.
L3 NET: Handles routing and packet forwarding. Protocols: IPv4, IPv6, ICMP, IPsec.
L2 LINK: Transfers frames between adjacent nodes. Protocols: Ethernet, ARP, PPP, Frame Relay.
L1 PHYS: Transmits raw bit streams over physical media. Mediums: Fiber optics, Copper wires, Radio waves.
02 // TCP/IP & ENCAPSULATION FLOW
During transmission, data flows downward through the protocol stack. Each layer prepends control information known as a header, and sometimes appends a trailer (like the frame check sequence in L2). This process wraps the payload, transforming it from a raw application stream into transport segments, network packets, and finally link frames.

03 // TCP/IP STACK & SPECIFICATIONS
TCP/IP MODEL SPECIFIC FOUR-LAYER STACK:
L4 APPLICATION: Merges OSI L5, L6, and L7. Handles user interaction and application logic directly.
L3 TRANSPORT: Maps to OSI L4. Manages flow control, error correction, and ports.
L2 INTERNET: Maps to OSI L3. Resolves routing paths and handles logical addressing.
L1 NETWORK ACCESS: Merges OSI L1 and L2. Deals with physical hardware, MAC addresses.

On the receiving host, the process is reversed. Each layer decapsulates the incoming data by stripping its respective header, inspecting control values for errors and routing directions, and passing the payload up to the higher layer.
This strict separation ensures that intermediate nodes (like routers) only process data up to the Network layer (L3) to make forwarding decisions, ignoring application-level data.

SYSTEM REFERENCE FOOTNOTES
[01] PORT NUMBERS: Transport layer ports separate traffic flows. Ports are system defined.
[03] MAC ADDRESSES: Flat 48-bit physical addresses assigned by hardware vendors.
[05] RELIABILITY: TCP guarantees delivery via three-way handshakes and sequence numbers.
[02] MTU LIMITS: Maximum Transmission Unit on Ethernet is 1500 bytes. Larger payloads require fragmentation.
[04] IP ROUTING: Routers inspect headers to make hop-by-hop forwarding decisions.
[06] ARQ MECHANISMS: L2 protocols employ Automatic Repeat Request to detect frame corruption.

The top of the image features the main title "TCP/IP SUITE VS OSI REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE" and a subtitle, along with labels such as "SCALE: LOGICAL SCHEMATIC" in the top-left and "PLATE 42", "SYSTEM: NETWORKING" in the top-right. The main body of the diagram is divided into three columns: the left column details the functionalities and protocols of the OSI seven-layer model, including an OSI Layer Overview Matrix table; the middle column explains the TCP/IP data encapsulation process through text and a data encapsulation flowchart; the right column describes the TCP/IP four-layer stack structure, featuring a decorative text block composed of binary numbers and the words "TCP / IP ARCHITECTURE STACK", as well as a table comparing header design specifications for different protocols. The bottom of the image contains system reference footnotes, providing brief explanations on port numbers, MTU limits, MAC addresses, IP routing, reliability, and ARQ mechanisms. prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了一个深色背景下的GIA钻石4C评级与切工遥测系统数字界面。界面顶部显示主标题“GIA 钻石 4C 评级与切工遥测系统”及其英文副标题，右侧有“SYSTEM STATUS: OPTIMAL // 运行正常”的状态信息。主体区域由六个面板组成。左上角面板显示标准圆钻切工剖面图，详细标注了台面、冠角、腰围、亭角和底尖等参数，并配有测量标准说明。右上角面板是一个光学追踪雷达图，中心显示“REFRACT / OK”，下方按钮标有“CRITICAL ANGLE: OPTIMAL (34.5°/40.8°)”。左中面板以表格形式列出钻石的4C核心控制指标，包括克拉、颜色、净度和切工，并提供具体数值和解释。右中面板是切工反射能谱的条形图，展示了从“EXCELLENT (极优)”到“POOR (不良)”的评级百分比。左下角面板详细说明了净度级别划分规范，包含级别、内含物特征、10倍放大观察和折射系数。右下角面板是光学探伤与遥测日志，显示带有时间戳的系统运行记录。界面底部包含系统信息、分类和页码。
prompt_en: This image displays a digital interface for a GIA Diamond 4C Grading and Cut Telemetry System against a dark background. The top of the interface features the main title "GIA 钻石 4C 评级与切工遥测系统" with its English subtitle, and on the right, a status message "SYSTEM STATUS: OPTIMAL // 运行正常". The main content area consists of six panels. The top-left panel shows a standard round brilliant cut diamond profile, with detailed annotations for parameters like table, crown angle, girdle, pavilion angle, and culet, along with measurement standards. The top-right panel is an optical tracking radar graph, with "REFRACT / OK" at its center, and a red-background button below it reading "CRITICAL ANGLE: OPTIMAL (34.5°/40.8°)". The middle-left panel presents a table detailing the diamond's 4C core control metrics, including carat, color, clarity, and cut, providing specific values and explanations. The middle-right panel is a bar chart illustrating the light refraction spectrum for cut, showing grading percentages from "EXCELLENT (极优)" to "POOR (不良)". The bottom-left panel details the clarity grading criteria in a table, covering grade, inclusion characteristics, 10x magnification observation, and refractive index. The bottom-right panel displays an optical flaw detection and telemetry log, showing timestamped system operation records. The bottom of the interface includes system information, classification, and page number.

prompt_cn: 图片类型为信息图表，详细介绍了古罗马军团的编制体系、战术能力和装备。整体背景为深灰色，文字以白色为主，部分标题和强调信息使用红色。顶部是主标题“古罗马军团编制体系”及其英文副标题。内容分为三列：左侧是“组织层级测算”表格和“人员数量分布”柱状图，展示了不同层级的兵力构成。中间部分包括“百人队战术阵型示意”图及其说明，以及“步兵单兵装备”的详细介绍，涵盖了标枪、短剑、大盾和板甲的尺寸、重量、材质和特性。右侧是“核心战术指标”表格，列出了行军速度、负重、工事挖掘等数据，以及“盾牌截面几何学”图，解释了盾牌弧面设计的防御原理。底部是一个大型表格“军团职级与薪酬概览”，详细列出了各级军官的职级、管理跨度、年度薪资和核心职责。图片底部还有来源、保密信息和图版编号。
prompt_en: This infographic details the organizational structure, tactical capabilities, and equipment of the ancient Roman Legion. The overall background is dark gray, with text primarily in white, and some headings and emphasized information in red. At the top is the main title "古罗马军团编制体系" (Ancient Roman Legion Organizational System) and its English subtitle. The content is divided into three columns: the left side features an "组织层级测算" (Organizational Hierarchy Calculation) table and a "人员数量分布" (Personnel Distribution) bar chart, illustrating the troop composition at different levels. The middle section includes a "百人队战术阵型示意" (Centuria Tactical Formation Diagram) with an illustration and explanation, followed by a detailed introduction to "步兵单兵装备" (Infantry Individual Equipment), covering the dimensions, weight, material, and characteristics of the heavy javelin (Pilum), Roman short sword (Gladius), rectangular shield (Scutum), and segmented plate armor (Lorica). The right side presents a "核心战术指标" (Core Tactical Indicators) table, listing data such as march speed, carrying capacity, and excavation rates, along with a "盾牌截面几何学" (Shield Cross-section Geometry) diagram explaining the defensive principles of the shield's curved design. At the bottom, a large table titled "军团职级与薪酬概览" (Legion Ranks and Salary Overview) provides detailed information on various officer ranks, their management scope, annual salary in Denarii, and core responsibilities. The bottom of the image also includes source information, a confidentiality notice, and a plate number.

prompt_cn: 这是一张深色背景的技术信息图，标题为“C 语言家族谱演化图”。图表顶部右侧包含报告元数据，如“国家航空咨询委员会 (NACA)”和“报告号: MEMO-1972-2010”。图表主体是一个折线图，展示了编程语言从 1972 年到 2010 年的演化。Y 轴表示“抽象维度”，分为“托管级”、“系统级”和“物理级”；X 轴是“时间轴 (年)”。图中标注了 C (1972)、C++ (1985)、Java (1995)、Go (2009) 和 Rust (2010) 等语言及其演化路径，并用黄色方框标注了“区A: 托管虚拟机收敛路径”和“区B: 系统级内存安全演进”。图表右侧有两段文字，解释了 C 语言家族的演进历程。图表下方左侧是“特性校准矩阵表”，列出了语言、年份、范式、内存管理和并发模型等信息。右侧是“内存与执行架构对比”表，比较了不同语言在内存、虚拟机和编译检查方面的特性。底部有八个独立的表格，分别展示了 ALGOL、C、C++、Java、C#、Go、Rust 和 LISP 等语言的性能指数、内存效率、语法体积和并发度。页脚提供了数据源信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic with a dark background, titled "C 语言家族谱演化图" (C Language Family Tree Evolution Diagram). The top right of the chart includes report metadata such as "国家航空咨询委员会 (NACA)" (National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics) and "报告号: MEMO-1972-2010". The main body of the chart is a line graph illustrating the evolution of programming languages from 1972 to 2010. The Y-axis represents "抽象维度" (Abstraction Dimension), categorized into "托管级" (Managed Level), "系统级" (System Level), and "物理级" (Physical Level); the X-axis is "时间轴 (年)" (Timeline (Year)). The graph labels languages like C (1972), C++ (1985), Java (1995), Go (2009), and Rust (2010) along their evolutionary paths, with yellow boxes indicating "区A: 托管虚拟机收敛路径" (Area A: Managed Virtual Machine Convergence Path) and "区B: 系统级内存安全演进" (Area B: System-Level Memory Safety Evolution). To the right of the chart are two paragraphs explaining the evolution of the C language family. Below the chart, on the left, is a "特性校准矩阵表" (Feature Calibration Matrix Table) listing information such as language, year, paradigm, memory management, and concurrency model. On the right is a "内存与执行架构对比" (Memory and Execution Architecture Comparison) table, comparing different languages' characteristics in terms of memory, virtual machines, and compile-time checks. At the bottom, there are eight individual tables, each presenting the performance index, memory efficiency, syntax volume, and concurrency degree for languages such as ALGOL, C, C++, Java, C#, Go, Rust, and LISP. Footer information provides the data source.

text:
板块构造与三种边界运
大陆漂移学说
阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳提出联合古陆 (Pangea) 概念，认为大陆在漫长地质年代中发生了水平位移，奠定了现代板块学说的基础。
板块构造统一论
麦肯齐与摩根将岩石圈划分为刚性板块，明确了全球地质活动集中于板块边缘，形成了完整的三维地球动力学模型。

2024. NOW
海底扩张学说
赫斯提出地幔对流驱动洋中脊岩浆涌出，生成新洋壳。这一发现解释了地壳更新机制，解决了大陆漂移的动力学难题。
高精度大地测量
利用GPS与卫星测地技术，实时监测全球板块以每年1-10厘米的速度持续移动，验证了板块边界的应力状态与地震周期。

prompt_cn: 这张信息图表或科学海报以深灰色为背景，展示了板块构造与三种边界运动的相关信息。页面顶部中央是部分被裁剪的主标题“板块构造与三种边界运”。图表中央有一条橙色的水平时间轴，标示了1912年、1960年、1967年和2024年四个时间点及对应的事件缩写。时间轴上方和下方各有两组蓝色背景的文本框，分别介绍了大陆漂移学说、海底扩张学说、板块构造统一论和高精度大地测量。左下角是一个表格，列出了全球七大主要板块的名称、面积、边界类型和平均移动速度。右侧中间有三个图示，分别展示了离散型、汇聚型和转换断层三种板块边界类型及其特征描述。右下角是一个水平条形图，用橙色条形比较了纳斯卡板块、太平洋板块、澳洲板块、非洲板块和亚欧板块的相对移动速度。页面底部包含页脚信息，包括数据来源、地球参考框架说明和坐标参考。
prompt_en: This infographic or scientific poster, set against a dark gray background, presents information related to plate tectonics and three types of boundary movements. The partially cropped main title "板块构造与三种边界运" is at the top center. A horizontal orange timeline runs across the middle, marking four time points: 1912, 1960, 1967, and 2024, along with corresponding event abbreviations. Above and below the timeline are two sets of text boxes with blue backgrounds, introducing the Continental Drift Theory, Seafloor Spreading Theory, Plate Tectonics Unification Theory, and High-Precision Geodesy, respectively. In the bottom left, a table lists the names, areas, boundary types, and average movement speeds of the seven major global plates. In the middle right, three diagrams illustrate divergent, convergent, and transform fault plate boundary types with their characteristic descriptions. The bottom right features a horizontal bar chart, using orange bars to compare the relative movement speeds of the Nazca, Pacific, Australian, African, and Eurasian plates. Footer information at the bottom includes data sources, Earth reference frame details, and coordinate references.

prompt_cn:
这张图片是一张深色背景的科技风格信息图表，详细介绍了必需维生素。图表主要使用白色和黄色文字，布局清晰，通过线条和色块划分区域。顶部左侧是主标题“ESSENTIAL VITAMINS”和副标题“MICRONUTRIENT SPECIFICATION”，右侧有“SYSTEM STATUS: OPTIMAL // 2024 REV”标签。
图表中部被水平虚线分隔为左右两部分。左侧区域聚焦于脂溶性维生素，包含“CATEGORY: LIPID-SOLUBLE”标签、相关储存和风险描述，以及一个名为“ABSORPTION PATHWAY”的示意图。下方列出了“CORE ASSETS”，即维生素A、D、E、K及其主要功能。
右侧区域介绍水溶性维生素，标题为“B-COMPLEX + C”，并描述了其快速排泄和无长期生物储存的特性。该区域还详细列出了B9（叶酸）和B12（钴胺素）的推荐剂量、关键作用，以及维生素C（抗坏血酸）的合成协议和剂量。
图表下方是一个名为“FOOD SOURCE MATRIX // TABLE 01-A”的表格，列出了维生素ID、命名、主要功能和原始来源材料。表格左下方是“DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS”条形图，显示了“RDA RELATIVE SATURATION %”，条形为黄色。右下方是“SYSTEM NOTES”部分，包含四条关于维生素的补充说明。图片底部是页脚信息，包括技术规范结束、图集页码、验证数据和版权声明。
prompt_en:
This image is a tech-style infographic on a dark background, detailing essential vitamins. The chart primarily uses white and yellow text, with a clear layout divided into sections by lines and color blocks. The top left features the main title "ESSENTIAL VITAMINS" and subtitle "MICRONUTRIENT SPECIFICATION," while the top right has a "SYSTEM STATUS: OPTIMAL // 2024 REV" label.
The middle section of the chart is horizontally divided into two parts by a dashed line. The left area focuses on lipid-soluble vitamins, including a "CATEGORY: LIPID-SOLUBLE" label, descriptions of storage and risks, and a diagram titled "ABSORPTION PATHWAY." Below this, "CORE ASSETS" lists vitamins A, D, E, and K with their primary functions.
The right area introduces water-soluble vitamins, with the title "B-COMPLEX + C," describing their rapid excretion and lack of long-term bio-storage capacity. This section also details the recommended dosage and key roles of B9 (Folate) and B12 (Cobalamin), as well as the synthesis protocol and dosage for Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid).
Below the main chart is a table titled "FOOD SOURCE MATRIX // TABLE 01-A," listing vitamin ID, nomenclature, primary function, and raw source material. The bottom left features a "DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS" bar chart, showing "RDA RELATIVE SATURATION %" with yellow bars. The bottom right contains "SYSTEM NOTES," with four supplementary notes about vitamins. The very bottom of the image includes footer information such as "END OF TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION," "ATLAS PAGE," "VERIFIED DATA," and copyright details.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于古罗马军团编制体系的信息图表。图表以浅绿色为背景，深灰色文字为主，整体采用三列布局。顶部中央是主标题“古罗马军团编制体系 / ORDO LEGIONIS ROMANAE”，右上方有垂直排列的“罗马军团”标签。左侧列详细介绍了军团的编制级别与人数统计，包括帐连队、百人队、大队和满编军团的组成结构和兵员数量，并特别说明了第一大队的特殊规格。中间列展示了标准单兵武器装配规格，配有大盾、短剑和重标枪的线描图及其名称，下方是装备技术参数表，列出了环片甲、重标枪和罗马大盾的重量、材质与特性。右侧列则涵盖了官阶与勤务岗位、军团负重数据以及战地防御的备注信息。图片底部是页脚，包含档案编号、出版发行单位和页码。
prompt_en: This image is an infographic detailing the organizational structure of the ancient Roman Legion. Set against a light green background with dark gray text, the infographic is laid out in three columns. The main title, "古罗马军团编制体系 / ORDO LEGIONIS ROMANAE," is at the top center, with a vertically arranged "罗马军团" label in the top right. The left column provides a detailed breakdown of the legion's organizational levels and troop counts, including the composition and number of men for Contubernium, Centuria, Cohors, and Legio, along with special specifications for the First Cohort. The middle column illustrates standard individual weapon configurations with line drawings of a large shield (Scutum), short sword (Gladius), and heavy javelin (Pilum), followed by a technical specifications table for Lorica, Pilum, and Scutum, listing their weight, material, and characteristics. The right column covers officer ranks and duties, legionary load data, and notes on battlefield defense. Footer information, including archive number, publisher, and page number, is located at the bottom of the image.

In the top right corner are labels "LEVEL: ANCIENT/MEDIEVAL" and "MALL DIRECTORY V. 90.1". The main body features a large map containing several purple square blocks representing trade nodes such as "ROME EMPIRE", "BAGHDAD", "DUNHUANG", "CHANG'AN IMPERIAL", "CEYLON", "ALEXANDRIA PORTS", "MALACCA", and "QUANZHOU (ZAYTON)". Pink square blocks represent commodities like "PEPPER", "CINNAMON", "NUTMEG", and "GINGER". Lines and arrows on the map indicate land and maritime trade routes, such as "ROUTE (NORTH)" and "MARITIME SILK ROAD". The right panel is divided into three sections, listing specific commodities under "APPAREL & TEXTILES", "HARD GOODS & TECH", and "JEWELRY & DECOR". At the bottom, there are three side-by-side information panels: the left panel is a "MARKET EXCHANGE RATES" table, detailing commodities, units, and gold equivalents, with "MARKET OPEN: 24H" below; the central panel is an "INTER-CONTINENTAL FLOW LOGIC" diagram, showing commodity flows between "EAST ASIA", "CENTRAL ASIA", and "EUROPE", accompanied by explanatory text; the right panel, titled "ANCHOR PROFILES", provides brief descriptions for "CHANG'AN (A-02)" and "ALEXANDRIA (A-03)", and includes an "ENTRY TAX: 10%" label. The chart's footer contains page information and a copyright statement.

prompt_cn: 这是一张信息图表，包含文字、图表和表格。主要元素包括一个星形平面图、一个线形图、一个横截面图和两个数据表格。整体色调为米色背景，文字和线条多为深棕色，图表中使用了红色和绿色线条。布局分为顶部标题区、左侧文本区、中央和右侧图表区，以及底部三个并列的表格/图表区。中央的星形图表描绘了一个名为“THE FORTRESS OF SOUND: TOPOGRAPHICAL PLAN”的布局，内部有四个区域标签和中心指挥位。右上角的线形图表显示了“ACOUSTIC ENERGY DISTRIBUTION”，Y轴为Decibels (dB)，X轴为Stage Depth (m)，并有“Brass”和“Strings”两条曲线。左下角的图表是“CROSS-SECTION OF THE RAMPARTS”，展示了“Perc.”、“Brass”、“Projection Ray”、“Woodwinds”和“Strings”的相对位置。底部中央的表格列出了“THE PRIMARY BASTIONS”中不同乐器的数量、区域和角色。右下角的表格是“DEPLOYMENT SPECIFICATIONS”，详细说明了乐器家族、数量、声学区域和战术职责。
prompt_en: This is an infographic featuring text, diagrams, and tables. The main elements include a star-shaped topographical plan, a line graph, a cross-section diagram, and two data tables. The overall color scheme consists of a beige background with dark brown text and lines, while the graphs use red and green lines. The layout is divided into a top title area, a left text column, central and right diagram areas, and three parallel table/diagram areas at the bottom. The central star-shaped diagram illustrates a layout titled 'THE FORTRESS OF SOUND: TOPOGRAPHICAL PLAN', with four labeled zones and a central conductor position. The top-right line graph, labeled 'ACOUSTIC ENERGY DISTRIBUTION', shows Decibels (dB) on the Y-axis and Stage Depth (m) on the X-axis, featuring curves for 'Brass' and 'Strings'. The bottom-left diagram, 'CROSS-SECTION OF THE RAMPARTS', displays the relative positions of 'Perc.', 'Brass', 'Projection Ray', 'Woodwinds', and 'Strings'. The bottom-center table, titled 'THE PRIMARY BASTIONS', lists the quantity, zone, and role of various instruments. The bottom-right table, 'DEPLOYMENT SPECIFICATIONS', details instrument families, counts, acoustic zones, and tactical duties.

TABULA HYDROGRAPHICA FLUMINIS
YANGTZE
长江流域干流与水利枢纽全景图
GEOGRAPHICAL PROFILE
THE Yangtze River, designated historically as the Chang Jiang, represents the premier hydrological axis of the East Asian continent. Rising from the glacial massifs of the Tanggula Mountains at elevations exceeding five thousand meters, the torrent traverses the rugged Hengduan mountain corridors, shedding ninety percent of its total descent before debouching into the fertile lowlands of the central basin. Here, the system assumes a winding, lacustrine character before emptying its massive discharge into the East China Sea at Shanghai.
This plate delineates the spatial distribution of its primary tributaries—including the northern arteries of the Min and Jialing, and the southern reservoirs of the Xiang and Gan systems—alongside the monumental engineering projects that regulate its discharge.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于长江流域的详细信息图。图表顶部是英文和中文标题“TABULA HYDROGRAPHICA FLUMINIS YANGTZE”和“长江流域干流与水利枢纽全景图”。图表整体采用米色背景和深绿色文字，布局清晰。中央部分是一幅长江流域的示意图，标注了主要支流和水利枢纽的位置。左侧是“GEOGRAPHICAL PROFILE”的英文地理概况描述，右侧是“SYSTEM TAXONOMY”的表格，列出了长江的科学名称、长度、流域面积等数据。中部下方是一条“LONGITUDINAL ELEVATION PROFILE & KEY IMPOUNDMENTS”海拔剖面线图，展示了长江从源头到入海口的海拔变化和主要水利设施。再下方是“PRIMARY TRIBUTARIES & HYDROPOWER INSTANTIATIONS”部分，包含六个方框，详细介绍了岷江、嘉陵江等主要支流的水文数据和白鹤滩水电站等关键项目。图表左下角是“HYDROLOGICAL STATION METRICS”表格，列出了不同水文站的流域面积、平均流量和海拔。右下角是“HYDROPOWER CAPACITY (GW)”条形图，比较了三峡、白鹤滩等水电站的发电容量。图表底部有出版信息和比例尺。
prompt_en: This is a detailed infographic about the Yangtze River basin. The top of the chart features English and Chinese titles: "TABULA HYDROGRAPHICA FLUMINIS YANGTZE" and "长江流域干流与水利枢纽全景图". The overall chart uses a beige background with dark green text and has a clear layout. The central part is a schematic map of the Yangtze River basin, marking the locations of major tributaries and hydraulic hubs. On the left is an English geographical profile description under "GEOGRAPHICAL PROFILE", and on the right is a "SYSTEM TAXONOMY" table listing data such as the Yangtze River's scientific name, length, and basin area. Below the central part is a "LONGITUDINAL ELEVATION PROFILE & KEY IMPOUNDMENTS" line graph, showing the elevation changes of the Yangtze River from its source to the estuary and key hydraulic facilities. Further below is the "PRIMARY TRIBUTARIES & HYDROPOWER INSTANTIATIONS" section, which includes six boxes detailing hydrological data for major tributaries like the Min River and Jialing River, and key projects such as the Baihetan Hydropower Station. The bottom left of the chart features a "HYDROLOGICAL STATION METRICS" table, listing basin area, mean flow, and elevation for various hydrological stations. The bottom right shows a "HYDROPOWER CAPACITY (GW)" bar chart, comparing the power generation capacities of hydropower stations like Three Gorges and Baihetan. Publication information and a scale are provided at the bottom of the chart.

prompt_en: This is a screenshot of a mobile application interface, displaying a recruitment or team enrollment page. At the top is the system status bar, showing network signal, time "15:30", and battery level "40%". The navigation bar features a "< 返回" (Back) button on the left, the title "JOIN US" in the center, and a more options icon on the right. The main content area features three large emoji icons at the top: a star-eyed smiling face, a party blower face, and a sunglasses-wearing smiling face. In the background, there are large, semi-transparent English text "OVER" and Chinese text "招聘" (Recruitment). The center of the page displays "可画集团梦之队" (Canva Group Dream Team) and its member count "299人" (299 people). Below this, there is a green "加入群聊" (Join Group Chat) button, with a mouse pointer icon hovering over it. Further down are detailed recruitment instructions, including "★入群须知:" (Entry Requirements) with specific roles (graphic designer, system engineer, public relations manager), benefits (six insurances and one housing fund, paid annual leave, weekends off, 13th-month salary), and what they do not offer (996 work schedule, endless meetings, meaningless KPIs). Finally, there is "★简历投递: ✉ cnsupport@canva.com" (Resume Submission). The bottom of the page features a footer with "#2025 WELCOME TO JOIN US" on the left and the "Canva" brand logo on the right.

CCCL — NO. 84" along with "传输速率参考: 100 GBPS+" in the top right. The main content of the page is divided into two columns, connected by a chart spanning both. The bottom left of the page features a "DISPERSION METRICS / 色散与限制" section, explaining the zero-dispersion point and single-mode fiber parameters, with a footnote on data sources. The bottom right contains the "PHYSICAL PERFORMANCE / 物理性能指标" table, listing physical performance indicators such as tensile proof, bending radius, operating temperature, and fiber mass. Copyright information and page number are at the very bottom of the page.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于杠铃运动学的信息图表，主要对比了力量举（Powerlifting）和奥林匹克举重（Olympic Lifting）两种运动。图表背景为米色，所有文字和图形元素均采用深红色。页面顶部是主标题“KINEMATICS OF THE BARBELL”和副标题“PLATE NO. XIV — STRENGTH VS. POWER”。内容分为三列：左列介绍了两种运动的力学原理、力量举的特点及其具体动作（深蹲、卧推、硬拉）和峰值速度；中列通过S曲线轨迹图和人体关节角度图展示了杠铃的运动轨迹和三关节伸展力学；右列则包含一个峰值功率对比柱状图和一张详细的动力学数据矩阵表格。图表下方有关于轨迹分析和峰值功率的文字描述。页面底部是页脚信息，包括坐标、测量仪器和数据记录。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the kinematics of the barbell, primarily comparing Powerlifting and Olympic Lifting. The chart features a beige background with all text and graphic elements in dark red. At the top of the page are the main title "KINEMATICS OF THE BARBELL" and the subtitle "PLATE NO. XIV — STRENGTH VS. POWER". The content is organized into three columns: the left column introduces the mechanics of both sports, the characteristics of Powerlifting, its specific movements (Back Squat, Bench Press, Deadlift), and peak velocity; the middle column displays barbell trajectories using an S-curve diagram and human joint angles for triple extension mechanics; the right column includes a bar chart comparing peak power and a detailed kinetic data matrix table. Text descriptions for trajectory analysis and peak power are provided below their respective charts. The bottom of the page contains footer information, including coordinates, instrumentation, and data records.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于地球大气层垂直分层与物理参数的科学信息图表页面。页面顶部是主标题“地球大气层垂直分层与物理参数”，下方列出了大气总质量、海平面标准气压和海平面标准温度等基本参数。页面主体采用两栏布局，左侧包含一个“高度与温度梯度曲线”折线图，展示了大气高度与温度随海拔的变化，并标注了对流层顶、平流层顶和中间层顶的温度。右侧是“大气圈层结构特征说明”，详细描述了对流层、平流层、中间层、热层与外层的特点。页面底部左侧是“大气参数定量分析表”，以表格形式列出了各圈层的名称、高度范围、温度区间、气压范围和质量占比，其中对流层和平流层的质量占比以红色突出显示。底部右侧是“气体分子密度梯度分布”区域，通过文字说明和一个垂直的条形图示意了各圈层的质量占比。页面底部还有国际标准大气模型参考基准和页码信息。整体文字以黑色为主，背景为白色，部分关键数据和页码使用红色作为强调色。
prompt_en: This is a scientific information chart page detailing the vertical stratification and physical parameters of Earth's atmosphere. At the top of the page is the main title "地球大气层垂直分层与物理参数" (Vertical Stratification and Physical Parameters of Earth's Atmosphere), with basic parameters such as total atmospheric mass, standard sea-level pressure, and standard sea-level temperature listed below. The main body of the page adopts a two-column layout. The left column features a line graph titled "高度与温度梯度曲线" (Altitude and Temperature Gradient Curve), illustrating the change in atmospheric height and temperature with altitude, and marking the temperatures at the tropopause, stratopause, and mesopause. The right column contains "大气圈层结构特征说明" (Description of Atmospheric Layer Characteristics), which details the features of the troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, thermosphere, and exosphere. The bottom left of the page presents "大气参数定量分析表" (Quantitative Analysis Table of Atmospheric Parameters), a table listing the name, altitude range, temperature range, pressure range, and mass percentage for each layer, with the mass percentages for the troposphere and stratosphere highlighted in red. The bottom right section, "气体分子密度梯度分布" (Gas Molecular Density Gradient Distribution), uses text and a vertical bar chart to illustrate the relative mass percentages of each layer. The page also includes a reference to the International Standard Atmosphere model and page number information at the bottom. The text is predominantly black on a white background, with some key data and the page number highlighted in red.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于意大利面形态学与配酱指南的信息图。图片顶部是深灰色的中文大标题“意大利面 几何形态学 配酱图鉴”，右侧有浅灰色英文辅助信息。页面主体内容被清晰地划分为多个矩形区域。左上方区域标题为“形态动力学 / MORPHODYNAMICS”，展示了六种抽象的几何形状，并配有数字标签和一段关于截面几何与挂汁量的中文说明。右上方区域标题为“参数矩阵 / PARAMETERS”，包含一个关于粗糙度、蛋白质、硬度、盐水比和吸水率的表格，以及一段关于杜兰小麦的中文描述。下方区域分为三列，分别以“长直面类 / LONG”、“短管与异形 / SHORT”和“手工与带状 / RIBBON”为标题，每列都详细列举了多种意大利面名称（如SPAGHETTI、PENNE、RAVIOLI），并配有中文描述和建议的配酱。列表项前有红色方块作为项目符号。图片底部是“物理配酱法则 / THE SAUCE RATIO LAW”的中文说明，解释了表面积效应和内部容积对配酱的影响。页脚包含英文“ATLAS OF EDIBLE GEOMETRY”和页码信息。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the morphology and sauce pairings of Italian pasta. The top of the image features a large, dark gray Chinese title "意大利面 几何形态学 配酱图鉴" (Italian Pasta Geometric Morphology Sauce Pairing Guide), with light gray English supplementary information on the right. The main content of the page is clearly divided into several rectangular sections. The top-left section, titled "形态动力学 / MORPHODYNAMICS" (Morphodynamics), displays six abstract geometric shapes with numerical labels and a Chinese explanation about how cross-sectional geometry affects sauce retention. The top-right section, titled "参数矩阵 / PARAMETERS" (Parameter Matrix), contains a table detailing roughness, protein, hardness, salt-to-water ratio, and water absorption, along with a Chinese description of durum wheat. The bottom section is divided into three columns, titled "长直面类 / LONG" (Long Straight Pasta), "短管与异形 / SHORT" (Short Tube and Irregular Pasta), and "手工与带状 / RIBBON" (Handmade and Ribbon Pasta). Each column lists various types of Italian pasta (e.g., SPAGHETTI, PENNE, RAVIOLI), accompanied by Chinese descriptions and suggested sauce pairings. Red squares serve as bullet points for the list items. The bottom of the image presents a Chinese explanation titled "物理配酱法则 / THE SAUCE RATIO LAW" (The Sauce Ratio Law), detailing the effects of surface area and internal volume on sauce pairing. The footer includes the English text "ATLAS OF EDIBLE GEOMETRY" and page number information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于海洋表面环流系统的技术文档或报告页面，背景为深灰色，文字主要为白色。页面顶部左侧是标题“OCEANIC SURFACE CIRCULATION SYSTEMS”，右侧红色背景框内显示序列号“GY-884-02-X”。标题下方有一段关于全球水体运输和热量再分配的简介。页面中部包含一个名为“GLOBAL GYRE REGISTRY”的表格，详细列出了北太平洋、南太平洋、北大西洋、南大西洋和印度洋等主要洋流的名称、旋转方向和主要洋流系统。表格下方是一个“NORTH PACIFIC CIRCULATION VISUALIZER”图表，以圆形箭头表示北太平洋环流，中心标有“GPGP DEBRIS ZONE”，并标注了“KUROSHIO”、“CALIFORNIA”、“NORTH PACIFIC CURRENT”和“NORTH EQUATORIAL CURRENT”等洋流名称。图表右上方有一个倾斜的紫色“VERIFIED / CLEARANCE”印章。图表下方文字解释了太平洋大垃圾带（GPGP）的形成和影响。页面底部是“WASTE INVENTORY / PHYSICAL METRICS”数据部分，以大字号展示了1.6M平方公里、1.8T塑料碎片和80K公吨等关键数据，并配有详细的组成说明。最下方是“TRANSIT CONTROL INSTRUCTIONS”指令列表，包含三条监测和记录海洋数据的指示。页脚显示了表单编号和授权信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical document or report page about oceanic surface circulation systems, with a dark gray background and primarily white text. The top left of the page features the title "OCEANIC SURFACE CIRCULATION SYSTEMS," while the top right displays the serial number "GY-884-02-X" within a red background box. Below the title is a brief introduction about global water transport and heat redistribution. The middle section of the page includes a table titled "GLOBAL GYRE REGISTRY," detailing the names, rotation directions, and primary current systems of major ocean gyres such as the North Pacific, South Pacific, North Atlantic, South Atlantic, and Indian Ocean. Below the table is a "NORTH PACIFIC CIRCULATION VISUALIZER" diagram, illustrating the North Pacific circulation with circular arrows, a central "GPGP DEBRIS ZONE," and labeled currents like "KUROSHIO," "CALIFORNIA," "NORTH PACIFIC CURRENT," and "NORTH EQUATORIAL CURRENT." A tilted purple "VERIFIED / CLEARANCE" stamp overlaps the upper right of this diagram. Text below the diagram explains the formation and impact of the Great Pacific Garbage Patch (GPGP). The bottom of the page presents a "WASTE INVENTORY / PHYSICAL METRICS" data section, prominently displaying key figures such as 1.6M SQUARE KILOMETERS, 1.8T PLASTIC PIECES, and 80K METRIC TONS, accompanied by detailed composition descriptions. The very bottom features "TRANSIT CONTROL INSTRUCTIONS," a list of three instructions for monitoring and recording oceanic data. The footer shows form number and authorization information.

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于十种云属分类的科学信息图，整体采用白色背景，文字以黑色为主，部分重要标签和标题使用红色。图片顶部是主标题“十种云属分类图鉴”，下方有英文副标题。右上角有一个红色矩形框，内含俄文“ОКБ-1 АТЛАС”和“SECRET / СЕКРЕТНО”字样，旁边是系统参考和分类信息。图片主体分为左右两列，包含四个主要信息区域。左上角是“垂直高度分布与气温线”图表，展示了不同高度（0m至12000m）和温度（-50°C至+15°C）下高云区、中云区和低云区中卷云（Ci）、高积云（Ac）和层云（St）的分布。右上角是“十云属核心参数规格表”，详细列出了十种云属的序号、代号、名称、典型高度、物理组成及气象关联与预示。左下角是“直展积雨云物理结构”图，描绘了积雨云的冰晶砧状云顶、上升气流和强降水区。右下角是“形态辨识要点特征”表，用编号和云属代号列举了十种云的形态特征。图片底部是页脚信息，包括项目主题、实验设计局、图纸编号、比例尺和批准人。
prompt_en: This image is a scientific infographic about the classification of ten cloud genera, featuring a white background with mostly black text, and some important labels and titles in red. The top of the image displays the main title "十种云属分类图鉴" with an English subtitle below it. In the upper right corner, there is a red rectangular box containing the Russian text "ОКБ-1 АТЛАС" and "SECRET / СЕКРЕТНО", alongside system reference and classification details. The main body of the image is divided into two columns, comprising four main information areas. The top-left section is a "Vertical Altitude Distribution and Temperature Line" chart, illustrating the distribution of cirrus (Ci), altocumulus (Ac), and stratus (St) clouds within high, mid, and low cloud regions across different altitudes (0m to 12000m) and temperatures (-50°C to +15°C). The top-right section is a "Ten Cloud Genera Core Parameter Specification Table", detailing the serial number, code, name, typical altitude, physical composition, and meteorological associations and indications for ten cloud genera. The bottom-left section is a "Cumulonimbus Physical Structure" diagram, depicting the ice crystal anvil top, updraft, and heavy precipitation zone of a cumulonimbus cloud. The bottom-right section is a "Morphology Identification Keys" table, listing the morphological characteristics of the ten cloud types with corresponding numbers and cloud codes. The bottom of the image contains footer information, including the project subject, experimental design bureau, drawing number, scale, and approver.

注意: 所有乐器必须在环境温度 +5%-55% 条件下运行。
1.0 弦乐组安装规范
弦乐组构成了乐团的机械主体, 总计60套组件。第一小提琴组应安装于舞台左侧前缘 (图示区01), 以确保高频泛音的扩散效率。中提琴与低音提琴作为低频共振单元, 布置于舞台右侧 (图示区04-05)。所有低音音箱均特殊增强舞台底部支撑感。所有座席需保持1.2米最小间距, 以防止声学串扰或啸叫。
2.0 木管组同步要求
木管组 (图示区06) 作为核心调制单元, 采用两排横向排列。前排布置长笛与双簧管, 后排布置单簧管与巴松。该区域要求极高的气密性与灵敏度, 乐手须直接面对指挥轴心线, 以确保相位校准一致。
3.0 铜管与打击乐校准
铜管组 (区域10-12) 具备高压输出特性, 故布置于舞台后部偏左位置。圆号组通常采用双排对齐, 通过向右后方的号口指向性利用反射板增加音厚。打击乐组 (区域13-14) 作为时钟发生器, 应占据舞台后部的最远的平坦区域。定音鼓需固定在不少于4台的配置里, 并在演奏进行时辅助校准。
定期维护手册
• 每周检查 45 分钟静音与尘埃。
• 严禁舞台 5 米范围内使用加湿器以外的液体。
• 乐器必须固定在 15 度倾角。

语言: 数字/中文/混合

text_84:
内容: 弦乐组构成了乐团的机械主体, 总计60套组件。第一小提琴组应安装于舞台左侧前缘 (图示区01), 以确保高频泛音的扩散效率。中提琴与低音提琴作为低频共振单元, 布置于舞台右侧 (图示区04-05)。所有低音音箱均特殊增强舞台底部支撑感。所有座席需保持1.2米最小间距, 以防止声学串扰或啸叫。
语言: 中文/数字/混合
位置: 左下角区域正文
字体/排版: 中等字号，黑色，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_85:

语言: 数字/中文/混合
位置: 左下角区域标题
字体/排版: 中等字号，粗体，黑色，左对齐
作用: 标题

text_86:
内容: 木管组 (图示区06) 作为核心调制单元, 采用两排横向排列。前排布置长笛与双簧管, 后排布置单簧管与巴松。该区域要求极高的气密性与灵敏度, 乐手须直接面对指挥轴心线, 以确保相位校准一致。
语言: 中文/数字/混合
位置: 左下角区域正文
字体/排版: 中等字号，黑色，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_87:

语言: 数字/中文/混合
位置: 右下角区域标题
字体/排版: 中等字号，粗体，黑色，左对齐
作用: 标题

text_88:
内容: 铜管组 (区域10-12) 具备高压输出特性, 故布置于舞台后部偏左位置。圆号组通常采用双排对齐, 通过向右后方的号口指向性利用反射板增加音厚。打击乐组 (区域13-14) 作为时钟发生器, 应占据舞台后部的最远的平坦区域。定音鼓需固定在不少于4台的配置里, 并在演奏进行时辅助校准。

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于交响乐团乐器编制、舞台排位与声学布局的技术手册页面。页面顶部包含标题“交响乐团乐器编制”和副标题“舞台排位与声学布局图 (100人标准全编)”，以及总功率、额定负载和图号等技术信息。页面主体左侧是一个舞台俯视总装图，展示了指挥台和弦乐组、木管组、铜管组、打击乐组等各乐器组的编号和大致位置。右侧是一个“零件清单”表格，详细列出了15种乐器的编号、名称、数量和规格。表格下方有一条关于乐器运行环境温度的注意事项。页面底部左右两栏提供了详细的技术说明，包括“弦乐组安装规范”、“木管组同步要求”、“铜管与打击乐校准”以及“定期维护手册”中的检查和使用要求。页脚包含版权信息、修订号和文件保密声明。
prompt_en: This is a technical manual page detailing the instrument setup, stage positioning, and acoustic layout for a symphony orchestra. The top of the page features the main title "交响乐团乐器编制" (Symphony Orchestra Instrument Arrangement) and subtitle "舞台排位与声学布局图 (100人标准全编)" (Stage Positioning and Acoustic Layout Diagram (100-person Standard Full Arrangement)), along with technical specifications like total power, rated load, and drawing number. The main body on the left presents an "01 A: 舞台俯视总装图 (EXPLODED VIEW)" (Stage Overhead Assembly Diagram), showing the conductor's podium and the numbered positions of various instrument groups, including strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion. On the right, a "零件清单 (PARTS LIST)" (Parts List) table provides a detailed breakdown of 15 instruments, listing their number, name, quantity, and specifications. Below the table is a note regarding the operating temperature conditions for all instruments. The bottom section of the page is divided into two columns, offering detailed technical instructions, including "1.0 弦乐组安装规范" (String Section Installation Specifications), "2.0 木管组同步要求" (Woodwind Section Synchronization Requirements), "3.0 铜管与打击乐校准" (Brass and Percussion Calibration), and a "定期维护手册" (Regular Maintenance Manual) with inspection and usage requirements. The footer includes copyright information, revision number, and a confidentiality statement.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于传统绘画媒介成分配比与干燥成膜特性的技术图表，包含流程图、描述性文本框、表格、柱状图和分层图。图表背景为浅灰色网格图案。顶部标题为“5大传统绘画媒介成分配比与干燥成膜特性”和英文副标题“PAINTING MEDIA COMPONENTS & CURING CHARACTERISTICS”，并有“CORE REACTION SCHEMATIC / 核心反应原理”等辅助信息。流程图展示了色料、黏合剂和溶剂组合形成涂层的过程，其中前三者的框线为红色，涂层框线为黑色且内部填充为黑色，文字为白色。图表中部有五个并列的文本框，详细描述了湿壁画、蛋彩画、油画、水彩和丙烯五种绘画媒介的特性、成膜机制及相关参数。左下角是“TABLE 12-B: 物理化学特性对比表”，以表格形式对比了这五种媒介的黏合剂类型、稀释剂、干燥机制和稳定性。右下角是“FIG 04: 相对干燥周期”柱状图，显示了不同媒介的干燥时间（对数刻度），柱子呈蓝色和红色，X轴标签分别为“TEMPERA”、“OIL PAINT”、“FRESCO”、“ACRYLIC”、“WATERCOLOR”，Y轴为“TIME (LOG SCALE)”，图例标示了“Tmin = 10m”和“Tmax = 2yr”。底部左侧是“DIAGRAM 09: 典型油画层级结构”分层图，从下至上依次为支撑层、底层、颜料层和罩光漆。图片底部页脚包含数据来源、系统时钟和页码信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical diagram illustrating the component ratios and curing characteristics of traditional painting media, featuring a flowchart, descriptive text boxes, a table, a bar chart, and a layered diagram. The background of the diagram is a light gray grid pattern. The top main title reads "5大传统绘画媒介成分配比与干燥成膜特性" with the English subtitle "PAINTING MEDIA COMPONENTS & CURING CHARACTERISTICS", along with auxiliary information like "CORE REACTION SCHEMATIC / 核心反应原理". The flowchart depicts the process of pigment, binder, and solvent combining to form a film; the first three components have red outlines, while the "Film" box has a black outline and black fill with white text. In the middle section, there are five parallel text boxes, detailing the characteristics, film-forming mechanisms, and relevant parameters of five painting media: Fresco, Tempera, Oil, Watercolor, and Acrylic. The bottom left features "TABLE 12-B: 物理化学特性对比表", a table comparing the binder types, thinners, drying mechanisms, and stability of these five media. The bottom right shows "FIG 04: 相对干燥周期", a bar chart illustrating the relative drying periods (log scale) for different media, with blue and red bars. The X-axis labels are "TEMPERA", "OIL PAINT", "FRESCO", "ACRYLIC", "WATERCOLOR", and the Y-axis is "TIME (LOG SCALE)", with legends "Tmin = 10m" and "Tmax = 2yr". The bottom left also includes "DIAGRAM 09: 典型油画层级结构", a layered diagram showing the typical stratigraphy of an oil painting, from bottom to top: Support, Ground, Paint Layer, and Varnish. The image footer contains data source, system clock, and page number information.

图 1.1: 四肢支撑式 (Chaturanga) 矢状面力学示意
01 山式: 骨盆中立位, 脊柱自然生理弯曲。
02 上抬手: 肩胛骨上回旋, 腋窝向内。
03 前屈: 髋关节屈曲, 腘绳肌离心拉伸。
04 四肢支撑: 肱三头肌控制身体重心。
解剖学观察: 肌肉协同
在拜日式A中, 动作与呼吸的频率维持在1:1的黄金比例。吸气时执行扩张性动作 (如上犬式), 打开胸大肌, 激活脊柱伸肌群; 呼气时执行收缩性或折叠动作 (如前屈式), 利用重力拉伸脊柱后侧筋膜。
下犬式作为序列的核心, 是一个倒置的V型结构。此处肩关节需完成180°屈曲, 前锯肌力量用于稳定肩胛骨, 避免挤压颈部空间。腓肠肌与比目鱼肌在后跟下压过程中获得深度伸展。
关键体式
主要激活肌肉
生物力学焦点
呼吸
Uttanasana
腘腰肌、腹直肌
髋屈肌群收缩, 脊柱伸展
呼气

肱三头肌、胸大肌
肘关节屈曲, 核心静力支撑
呼气
Urdhva Mukha
脊柱伸肌、臀大肌
脊柱后弯, 胸腔空间扩张
吸气
Adho Mukha
前锯肌、腓肠肌
肩关节屈曲, 足背屈力
呼气
NOTE: 保持尺骨与桡骨平行, 指基均匀受力以保护腕管。序列重复 3-5 次可有效提升滑液循环。

prompt_cn: 这张图片是一张关于瑜伽拜日式A的解剖学信息图。图片顶部右侧有一个红色标签，显示“解剖学档案 NO.08”。主标题为“瑜伽拜日式 A (Surya Namaskar A)”，下方是副标题“序列流动、呼吸协同与骨骼肌动力学研究”。图片主体分为左右两栏。左栏上方是一个包含“难易度”、“耗时”、“核心肌肉”和“位置”信息的表格，下方是一个名为“图 1.1: 四肢支撑式 (Chaturanga) 矢状面力学示意”的图表，图表中有“SCAPULA STABILITY”和“CORE ENGAGEMENT”的英文标签。图表下方是四个编号的瑜伽体式描述。左栏底部是“解剖学观察: 肌肉协同”的文本段落。右栏上方是“力量需求”、“柔韧度需求”和“平衡感要求”的条形图示，下方是一个详细的表格，列出了“关键体式”、“主要激活肌肉”、“生物力学焦点”和“呼吸”等信息。图片底部是版权和参考信息。
prompt_en: This image is an anatomical information graphic about Yoga Surya Namaskar A. At the top right, there is a red label displaying "解剖学档案 NO.08" (Anatomy Archive NO.08). The main title is "瑜伽拜日式 A (Surya Namaskar A)", followed by the subtitle "序列流动、呼吸协同与骨骼肌动力学研究" (Sequence Flow, Breath Synergy, and Musculoskeletal Dynamics Research). The main content is divided into two columns. The upper part of the left column features a table with information on "难易度 (LEVEL)", "耗时 (TIME)", "核心肌肉 (CORE)", and "位置 (LOC)". Below it is a diagram titled "图 1.1: 四肢支撑式 (Chaturanga) 矢状面力学示意" (Figure 1.1: Chaturanga Sagittal Plane Mechanics Diagram), which includes English labels "SCAPULA STABILITY" and "CORE ENGAGEMENT". Below the diagram are four numbered descriptions of yoga poses. The bottom of the left column contains text paragraphs under the heading "解剖学观察: 肌肉协同" (Anatomical Observation: Muscle Synergy). The upper part of the right column shows bar-like indicators for "力量需求 (POWER)", "柔韧度需求 (FLEX)", and "平衡感要求 (BALANCE)". Below these is a detailed table listing "关键体式" (Key Poses), "主要激活肌肉" (Main Activated Muscles), "生物力学焦点" (Biomechanical Focus), and "呼吸" (Breath). The bottom of the image provides copyright and reference information.

prompt_cn: 这是一张活动海报，整体分为左右两个主要区域。左侧区域是一张照片，画面中一位白发卷曲的老年女性身穿花衬衫，神情专注地用刀处理案板上的一条大鱼，背景模糊，暗示室内环境。照片左下角叠加有两行白色文字，分别是“THE ETERNAL SMILE.”和“记录·时光的重量”。右侧区域是活动详情和宣传文字，底色为浅米色。右上角有一个深棕色背景框，内含“传统时令”字样，下方是“农 历 九 月 初 九”。再下方是醒目的深棕色大字“九九”，以及浅棕色高亮显示的“敬老情暖·影 留芳华”。接着是一段较小的深棕色正文，描述了一项面向长辈的公益摄影活动，下方是“社区文化活动中心 2F”。右下角列有“主办单位”，其下方是“XX街道办事处老龄工作委员会”。旁边是一个带有深棕色边框的红色矩形框，内含白色文字“敬老 尊贤”。最右侧边缘竖向排列着浅棕色文字“九 岁 重 阳 今 又 重 阳”。

The background is blurred, suggesting an indoor setting. Overlaid on the bottom left of the photo are two lines of white text: "THE ETERNAL SMILE." and "记录·时光的重量" (Recording the Weight of Time). The right section contains event details and promotional text on a light beige background. At the top right, a dark brown box contains "传统时令" (Traditional Season), followed by "农 历 九 月 初 九" (Lunar Calendar September Ninth). Below this, the large dark brown characters "九九" (Double Ninth) are displayed, with "敬老情暖·影 留芳华" (Respecting the Elderly, Warmth of Affection · Capturing Youthful Radiance) highlighted in a lighter brown. A block of smaller dark brown text describes a public photography event for seniors, followed by "社区文化活动中心 2F" (Community Cultural Activity Center 2F). prompt_cn: 这是一幅动漫风格的数字插画，描绘了在繁星点点的夜空下，一棵挂满祈愿符的巨大发光树木。画面左侧，这棵树散发出温暖的金色光芒，树枝上挂满了白色和彩色的祈愿纸条。画面右侧，一位身穿红色连帽斗篷的女孩跪坐在地上，双手合十，侧身面向发光树木，神情专注。她身旁坐着一只毛色蓬松的猫咪。深蓝色的夜空中，点缀着无数闪烁的星星，右上角绽放着金色的烟花，旁边是同样金色发光的文字“2026, 您好!”。整个画面营造出一种宁静而充满希望的节日氛围。
prompt_en: This is an anime-style digital illustration depicting a large, glowing tree adorned with prayer slips under a starry night sky. On the left side of the image, the tree emits a warm golden light, with its branches covered in white and colorful prayer papers. On the right, a girl in a red hooded cloak kneels on the ground, hands clasped together, facing the glowing tree with a focused expression. A fluffy cat sits beside her. The deep blue night sky is dotted with countless twinkling stars, and golden fireworks burst in the upper right corner, accompanied by the similarly golden, glowing text "2026, 您好!". The entire scene creates a serene and hopeful festive atmosphere.

To the left of the title, black text reads "天马电影制片厂摄制" (Produced by Tianma Film Studio) and "彩色故事片" (Color Feature Film). Below the title is a plot summary of the film, describing the establishment of the Red Detachment of Women in Hainan Island in 1930 and the story of Wu Qionghua. Below the summary, the names of the screenwriter, director, cinematographer, and military advisor are listed. In the lower part of the image, a group of female soldiers in khaki uniforms and military caps stand side by side, holding rifles. One soldier holds a large red flag, which features a yellow five-pointed star and a hammer and sickle emblem. The flag pole has black text "中国人民解放军" (Chinese People's Liberation Army) written vertically from bottom to top.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影或电视剧的宣传海报。画面主体是一个深邃且具有强烈几何线条感的建筑内部空间，主色调为黑色、深灰色与亮黄色。画面右侧射入的亮黄色光线在地面和墙壁上投射出条状阴影，形成一条引导视线的路径。一名身着西装的男性人物站在长廊尽头，位于画面右侧中下部，面向左侧。海报顶部左侧列有出品人、监制、导演、总策划、制作人、制片人、文学策划等制作人员名单及其所属公司信息，均为白色小字。画面顶部右侧是垂直排列的中文主标题“精英律师”，下方是水平排列的英文副标题“THE BEST PARTNER”。主标题下方偏右侧是黄色大字“靳东”，其下方有白色小字“STARRING”和“领衔主演”。海报左下角是白色中文标语“你的善良 必须有点锋芒”。整个构图呈现出强烈的透视感和明暗对比。
prompt_en: This is a promotional poster for a film or TV series. The main subject of the image is a deep interior architectural space with strong geometric lines, dominated by black, dark gray, and bright yellow. Bright yellow light entering from the right side of the frame casts striped shadows on the floor and walls, forming a path that guides the viewer's eye. A man in a suit stands at the end of the long corridor, positioned in the lower-middle right of the frame, facing left. The top-left of the poster lists production personnel such as producers, executive producers, directors, chief planners, producers, line producers, and literary planners, along with their affiliated companies, all in small white text. The top-right of the frame features the vertically arranged Chinese main title "精英律师" (Elite Lawyer), with the horizontally arranged English subtitle "THE BEST PARTNER" below it. Below the main title and slightly to the right is the large yellow text "靳东" (Jin Dong), with smaller white text "STARRING" and "领衔主演" (Lead Actor) below it. The bottom-left of the poster features the white Chinese slogan "你的善良 必须有点锋芒" (Your kindness must have some edge). The overall composition exhibits strong perspective and sharp contrast between light and shadow.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于日本茶道体系的深蓝色信息图，标题为“日本茶道体系: 抹茶流派与点茶七道具”。图片顶部有技术规范信息，底部右侧有一个包含图册标题、设计人、日期和备注等信息的方框。主体内容分为五个编号部分，以两栏布局呈现。第一部分介绍核心精神与流派，通过“和、敬、清、寂”四个方块及其英文翻译阐述茶道精神，并详细描述了表千家、里千家和武者小路千家三个流派的特点。第二部分通过表格对比了薄茶和浓茶的点茶规格，包括抹茶粉量、注入水量、水温控制、汤质质感和击拂技法。第三部分展示了茶碗和茶筅的结构图，并标注了尺寸。第四部分以表格形式列出了点茶七道具的ID、名称、材质和功能描述。第五部分是一个流程图，展示了点茶的五个步骤：“温碗、置茶、注水、击拂、献茶”，并标注了总时长。
prompt_en: This is a dark blue infographic about the Japanese tea ceremony system, titled "日本茶道体系: 抹茶流派与点茶七道具" (SYSTEM OF JAPANESE TEA CEREMONY: SCHOOLS & SEVEN UTENSILS). The top of the image displays technical specification information, while the bottom right features an information box containing the drawing title, designer, date, and remarks. The main content is divided into five numbered sections, presented in a two-column layout. Section one introduces the core spirit and schools, explaining the tea ceremony's principles through four boxed terms "和, 敬, 清, 寂" (Harmony, Respect, Purity, Tranquil) and detailing the characteristics of the Omotesenke, Urasenke, and Mushakojisenke schools. Section two uses a table to compare the specifications for preparing Usucha (thin tea) and Koicha (thick tea), including matcha powder quantity, water volume, water temperature, texture, and whisking techniques. SEC-01 / PWR SYSTEM
压水堆 (PWR)
压水堆是目前全球应用最广的堆型（约占 68%）。其核心特征是三回路独立系统：一回路维持约 155 个大气压，使冷却水在 300°C 以上仍保持液态，将堆芯热量传递给二回路；二回路产生蒸汽驱动汽轮机。一回路带有放射性的水被完全封闭在安全壳内。

SEC-02 / BWR SYSTEM
沸水堆 (BWR)
沸水堆系统设计更为简洁。冷却水直接在压力容器 (RPV) 内沸腾产生蒸汽。这种带有微弱放射性的蒸汽直接进入汽轮机做功。相比压水堆，其运行压力较低（约 70 个大气压），省去了昂贵的蒸汽发生器，但对汽轮机房的辐射防护要求更高。全球份额约 20%。

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于寿司分类与搭配的信息图表。图表整体背景为浅灰色，文字以黑色为主，部分标题和图表线条使用红色。页面布局分为左侧边栏和右侧主内容区。左侧边栏竖排显示“图谱 第四”和“江户前寿司分类与搭配”。主内容区顶部是标题“寿司分类体系与搭配图谱”，下方有一段介绍性文字，说明江户前寿司以东京湾海产为主，融合多种技法形成独有配搭体系。图表上方中部是一个寿司分类图示，展示了“棒寿司”、“箱寿司”、“握寿司”、“卷寿司”、“军舰卷”和“散寿司”六种寿司类型，并用虚线连接。右侧区域介绍了“三大鲜熟成技法”，包括昆布渍、醋渍和酱油渍及其作用。图表中部左侧是“鲜顺序与风味温度曲线”图，Y轴标有“浓”、“中”、“淡”，X轴标有“白身鱼”、“光物”、“赤身”、“油脂物”、“甜点”，并有“风味浓度”（红色）和“温度变动”（黑色）两条曲线。中部右侧是“寿司解剖与结构要义”图，展示了“鱼生 (Neta)”、“山葵 (Wasabi)”和“醋饭 (Shari) 15g-20g”三个组成部分。图表下方是一个“江户前十贯经典配搭选择”表格，包含序号、经典贯物、处理技法、醋饭克重、建议顺序和风味特征描述六列，列出了10种寿司的详细信息。页脚有“昭和五十二年农林省特别调查图版”、“东京寿司保存会 编纂”和“原元：日本百科”等文字。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about sushi classification and pairing. The overall background of the chart is light gray, with text primarily in black, and some titles and chart lines in red. The page layout is divided into a left sidebar and a right main content area. The left sidebar vertically displays "图谱 第四" (Atlas Part Four) and "江户前寿司分类与搭配" (Edomae Sushi Classification and Pairing). At the top of the main content area is the title "寿司分类体系与搭配图谱" (Sushi Classification System and Pairing Atlas), followed by an introductory text explaining that Edomae sushi primarily uses seafood from Tokyo Bay, integrating various techniques to form a unique system of warm vinegared rice and raw fish pairings. In the upper-middle part of the chart is a sushi classification diagram, showing six types of sushi: "棒寿司" (Bo-sushi), "箱寿司" (Hako-sushi), "握寿司" (Nigiri-sushi), "卷寿司" (Maki-sushi), "军舰卷" (Gunkan-maki), and "散寿司" (Chirashi-sushi), connected by dashed lines. The right section introduces "三大鲜熟成技法" (Three Major Freshness Aging Techniques), including Kombu-jime, Su-jime, and Zuke, along with their functions. In the middle-left of the chart is a "鲜顺序与风味温度曲线" (Freshness Order and Flavor Temperature Curve) graph, with the Y-axis labeled "浓" (Strong), "中" (Medium), "淡" (Light), and the X-axis labeled "白身鱼" (White Fish), "光物" (Silver-skinned Fish), "赤身" (Red Meat Fish), "油脂物" (Fatty Fish), "甜点" (Dessert), featuring two curves labeled "风味浓度" (Flavor Concentration, red) and "温度变动" (Temperature Variation, black). The middle-right shows a "寿司解剖与结构要义" (Sushi Anatomy and Structural Essentials) diagram, illustrating three components: "鱼生 (Neta)" (Fish Topping), "山葵 (Wasabi)" (Wasabi), and "醋饭 (Shari) 15g-20g" (Vinegared Rice). Below the chart is a table titled "江户前十贯经典配搭选择" (Edomae Ten Classic Pairings Selection), which includes six columns: "序号" (No.), "经典贯物" (Classic Nigiri), "处理技法" (Preparation Technique), "醋饭克重" (Shari Weight), "建议顺序" (Suggested Order), and "风味特征描述" (Flavor Characteristics Description), listing detailed information for 10 types of sushi. The footer contains texts such as "昭和五十二年农林省特别调查图版" (Showa 52nd Year Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry Special Survey Plate), "东京寿司保存会 编纂" (Tokyo Sushi Preservation Association Compiled), and "原元：日本百科" (Original Source: Japan Encyclopedia).

奥林匹斯：血脉与权能之解剖
(OLYMPIANS)
GENESIS / 创世溯源
从原始混沌到泰坦统治的终结
在奥林匹斯神族建立之前，宇宙经历了从卡俄斯(Chaos)到盖亚(Gaia)的物质化过程。克洛诺斯(Cronus)与瑞亚(Rhea)的结合诞生了第一代主神，最终通过十年泰坦之战，权力向奥林匹斯山转移。这一过程不仅是家族更替，更是宇宙秩序从原始蒙昧向司法理性的过渡。

BLOODLINE / 核心家谱
奥林匹斯权力核心由宙斯及其兄弟姐妹，以及其主要子女构成。此结构不仅代表血缘，更代表了神职能的细分。雅典娜由头颅诞生，阿佛洛狄忒由海沫诞生，体现了神格产生的非自然特征。

IV - COSMIC ARCHIVE - NO. 8812”。
prompt_en: This is an infographic about the Greek Olympian gods, titled "奥林匹斯：血脉与权能之解剖 (OLYMPIANS)" at the top center in large, bold red text. The chart has a dark gray background, with content areas separated by white or light green rectangular frames. The infographic is divided into four main sections: GENESIS, located in the upper left, describes the process from chaos to the establishment of the Olympian gods, accompanied by a flowchart with four circular nodes labeled "混沌(CHAOS)", "盖亚(GAIA)", "泰坦(TITANS)", and "奥林匹斯(OLYMPUS)". BLOODLINE, situated in the middle left, details the core power structure of the Olympian gods and presents a family tree with connected rectangular boxes showing deities such as "克洛诺斯", "波塞冬", "宙斯", "哈迪斯", "雅典娜", "阿波罗", "阿瑞斯", and "赫尔墨斯". POWER MATRIX, found in the middle right, is a three-column table listing "主神名称" (Deity Name), "司掌领域" (Domain), and "核心象征物" (Core Symbol), covering information for twelve major deities including Zeus, Hera, and Poseidon. TECHNICAL SPEC, positioned in the lower left, uses a numbered list to explain the sovereignty, domains, and balance mechanisms of the Olympian gods. In the lower right, there is a red star-shaped diagram with "核心神权" (Core Divine Authority) inside, and a "技术观察" (Technical Observation) text below it. At the bottom right of the chart, there is footer information: "VOL. IV - COSMIC ARCHIVE - NO. 8812".

prompt_cn: 这是一张以浅绿色为背景、深绿色边框的科学信息图，标题为“海洋的五大深度垂直水层生态图谱”，副标题为“依据光照、温度与水压划分的系统配伍表”。图片主体分为左右两栏。左栏是一个“垂直深度与温度变化梯度仪”图表，Y轴表示深度（0m至11000m），X轴表示温度（0℃至30℃），图上标示了“表层带”、“中层带”、“深层带”、“深渊带”和“超深渊带”五个水层，并用红色曲线展示温度变化，金黄色虚线表示“光穿透极限”。图表下方有关于曲线的注释。右栏包含多项内容：首先是“垂直水层配伍纪要”的文字描述，接着是一个表格，详细列出了五个水层的深度、温度和优势生物群落。表格下方有注释。随后是“深海有机沉积物组配比例”的列表，展示了四种沉积物的百分比。再下方是“垂直生态带之能量处方”的列表。最下方是一个“静水压强比率量规”图，标示了不同深度的大气压强。图片顶部、内容区和底部均有装饰性的叶子或羽毛图标。底部页脚包含三行文字，说明数据来源、监制单位和制作年份。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic with a light green background and a dark green border, titled "海洋的五大深度垂直水层生态图谱" (The Five Major Vertical Water Layers Ecological Map of the Ocean), with the subtitle "依据光照、温度与水压划分的系统配伍表" (System Compatibility Table Divided by Light, Temperature, and Water Pressure). The image content is divided into two main columns. The left column features a "垂直深度与温度变化梯度仪" (Vertical Depth and Temperature Change Gradient Instrument) chart, where the Y-axis represents depth (from 0m to 11000m) and the X-axis represents temperature (from 0℃ to 30℃). The chart labels five water layers: "表层带" (Surface Layer), "中层带" (Mesopelagic Zone), "深层带" (Bathypelagic Zone), "深渊带" (Abyssopelagic Zone), and "超深渊带" (Hadalpelagic Zone). A red curve illustrates temperature changes with depth, and a golden dashed line indicates the "光穿透极限" (Light Penetration Limit). A note below the chart explains the curves. The right column contains multiple sections: first, a textual description titled "垂直水层配伍纪要" (Vertical Water Layer Compatibility Record), followed by a table detailing the depth, temperature, and dominant biota for the five water layers. A note is provided below the table. Next is a list titled "深海有机沉积物组配比例" (Deep Sea Organic Sediment Composition Ratio), showing percentages for four types of sediments. Below that is a list titled "垂直生态带之能量处方" (Energy Prescription for Vertical Ecological Zones). At the bottom of the right column is a "静水压强比率量规" (Hydrostatic Pressure Ratio Gauge) chart, indicating atmospheric pressure at different depths. Decorative leaf or feather icons are present at the top, between sections, and at the bottom of the image. The footer contains three lines of text, indicating the data source, supervising entity, and production year.

内燃机四冲程原理与V型气缸工作时序图
FOUR-STROKE CYCLES & V-ENGINE
TIMING
THE OTTO CYCLE
The reciprocating internal combustion engine operates on the classic four-stroke Otto cycle. A complete thermodynamic loop requires two crankshaft revolutions (720 degrees of rotation) for each cylinder power stroke.
■ INTAKE STROKE: Intake valve opens. The downward piston movement creates a low-pressure area, drawing fuel-air mixture into the cylinder at 0.8 bar.
■COMPRESSION STROKE: Both valves close. The piston ascends, compressing the charge into the combustion chamber. Typical gasoline compression ratios range from 8:1 to 14:1.
■ POWER STROKE: Spark plug ignites the compressed mixture. Rapid thermal expansion drives the piston down, converting chemical energy to torque.
■EXHAUST STROKE: Exhaust valve opens. The piston travels upward, purging spent combustion gases from the cylinder chamber. Gas velocities often reach sonic thresholds.
Thermodynamic cycles in real-world application deviate from the ideal Otto cycle due to pumping losses, blowby, friction, and finite combustion speed.
V-ENGINE CONFIGURATION
V-type configurations arrange cylinders in two angled banks sharing a single crankshaft. This geometry significantly reduces overall engine length and mass compared to inline units, allowing for optimal vehicle packaging and improved structural rigidity.

prompt_cn: 这张信息图以黄色和深灰色为主色调，详细介绍了内燃机四冲程原理和V型气缸的工作时序。顶部有中文副标题“内燃机四冲程原理与V型气缸工作时序图”和英文主标题“FOUR-STROKE CYCLES & V-ENGINE TIMING”。图表主体分为六个区域，呈两行三列布局。左上区域标题为“THE OTTO CYCLE”，包含奥托循环的文字描述和四冲程（进气、压缩、做功、排气）的详细解释。中上区域标题为“V-ENGINE CONFIGURATION”，展示了V型发动机的横截面图，并标注了“LEFT BANK”、“RIGHT BANK”、“ANGLE”和“CRANKCASE SHAFT”，下方有相关文字说明。右上区域标题为“PV DIAGRAM & PERFORMANCE”，包含一个PV图，图中标注了“P”、“V”、“1”、“2”、“3”、“4”和“INDICATED WORK”，下方有图表解释。右侧有一个突出的红色矩形框，内含“2200°C”的温度值和关于峰值燃烧温度的说明。左下区域标题为“STAGE SEQUENCING DIAGRAM”，展示了活塞在四个冲程中的位置图，并标注了“INTAKE 0°-180°”、“COMPRESS 180°-360°”、“POWER 360°-540°”和“EXHAUST 540°-720°”，下方有文字说明。中下区域标题为“BALANCING & FIRING ORDER”，包含一个表格，列出了不同发动机布局（L4 Inline, V6 Engine, V8 Engine, Flat-4 Boxer）的倾角、点火顺序和平衡类型，下方有补充说明。右下区域标题为“OPERATIONAL METRICS”，包含一个表格，列出了压缩比、热效率、BMEP比和排气温度等参数的限制值和关键约束，下方引用了一段关于效率的斜体文字和一段关于多方指数的说明。页脚处有“PLATE 048 // THE OTTO CYCLE & V-ENGINE LAYOUTS”字样和三个彩色小方块。
prompt_en: This infographic, primarily in yellow and dark gray tones, details the principles of the four-stroke internal combustion engine and V-engine timing. At the top, there is a Chinese subtitle "内燃机四冲程原理与V型气缸工作时序图" and an English main title "FOUR-STROKE CYCLES & V-ENGINE TIMING". The main body of the chart is divided into six sections, arranged in two rows and three columns. The top-left section, titled "THE OTTO CYCLE", contains a textual description of the Otto cycle and detailed explanations of the four strokes (intake, compression, power, exhaust). The middle-top section, titled "V-ENGINE CONFIGURATION", displays a cross-section diagram of a V-engine, labeled with "LEFT BANK", "RIGHT BANK", "ANGLE", and "CRANKCASE SHAFT", with accompanying text below. The top-right section, titled "PV DIAGRAM & PERFORMANCE", includes a PV diagram labeled "P", "V", "1", "2", "3", "4", and "INDICATED WORK", with an explanation below. On the right side, a prominent red rectangular box contains the temperature value "2200°C" and a description of peak combustion temperature. The bottom-left section, titled "STAGE SEQUENCING DIAGRAM", shows piston position diagrams for the four strokes, labeled "INTAKE 0°-180°", "COMPRESS 180°-360°", "POWER 360°-540°", and "EXHAUST 540°-720°", with text below. The middle-bottom section, titled "BALANCING & FIRING ORDER", features a table listing bank angle, firing order, and balance type for various engine layouts (L4 Inline, V6 Engine, V8 Engine, Flat-4 Boxer), with additional notes below. The bottom-right section, titled "OPERATIONAL METRICS", contains a table detailing limit values and critical constraints for parameters such as compression ratio, thermal efficiency, BMEP ratio, and exhaust temperature, followed by an italicized quote about efficiency and a note on polytropic exponent values. The footer reads "PLATE 048 // THE OTTO CYCLE & V-ENGINE LAYOUTS" and includes three small colored squares.

The universal interface for the modern era. A
symmetrical, reversible design that consolidates
power, data, and video into a single 8.4mm
standard. This plate examines the internal pin-
mapping and the protocol escalations from USB 2.0
to the 40Gbps era.
Note the rotational symmetry: Rotating the connector 180° maintains VBUS, GND, and D+/D- alignment while switching TX/RX lanes and Configuration Channels (CC).
STANDARD REFERENCE
IEC 62680-1-3
Universal Serial Bus Type-C Cable and Connector
Specification
FUNCTIONAL ANALYSIS
Primary Signal Groups
USB-C separates high-speed data from legacy compatibility and control signals. This division allows the
connector to remain backwards compatible with USB 2.0 while enabling 40Gbps throughput across the
SuperSpeed differential pairs.
VBUS/ GND: 4 pairs for power.
High-Speed: 4 Differential pairs (TX/RX).
Legacy: Central D+/D- for USB 2.0.
Control: CC1/CC2 for PD handshake.
Sideband: SBU1/SBU2 for Alt-Modes.
TECHNICAL DATA // LOGICAL MAPPING
Group
Pin Identifiers
Function
Engineering Notes
Ground
A1, A12, B1, B12
Return Path
All ground pins must be connected within the plug.
Power

VBUS Supply
Standard 5V, or up to 48V under PD 3.1 Extended Power Range.
Data (HS)
A2/A3, A10/A11, B2/B3, B10/B11
TX / RX Pairs
High-speed lanes for USB 3.2, USB4, DisplayPort, and Thunderbolt.
Legacy
A6, A7, B6, B7
D+ / D-
Only one set is active; used for legacy 480Mbps throughput.
Config
A5, B5
CC1 / CC2
Determines cable orientation and handles Power Delivery protocol.

A8, B8
SBU1 / SBU2
Used for non-USB signals in Alternate Mode (e.g., DP Aux Channel).

Power Delivery 3.1

C cable to replace dedicated charging bricks for

prompt_cn: 这张信息图详细展示了USB-C接口的技术规格和功能。图片整体分为多个颜色区域，包括左侧的深红色、顶部和中部的浅灰色、右侧的蓝色、左下角的黄色以及右下角的白色，每个区域承载不同主题的信息。顶部中央是USB-C的24引脚对称排列图，以彩色方框标示各引脚的名称和功能，并配有关于旋转对称性的说明。中部包含“功能分析”部分，解释了USB-C如何分离高速数据和传统信号，并列出了主要的信号组。下方是一个详细的技术数据表格，按功能组（如接地、电源、高速数据等）列出引脚标识、功能和工程注释。右侧蓝色区域介绍了Power Delivery 3.1的协议能力，包括最大240W的功率传输和不同电压电流组合。底部中央偏左的区域展示了带宽演进，通过列表和水平条形图对比了从USB 2.0到USB4/Thunderbolt 4的吞吐量提升，并附有关于USB4动态带宽分配的说明。左下角黄色区域则阐述了USB-C的替代模式，列举了DisplayPort、HDMI和Thunderbolt等非USB协议的传输能力。右下角是USB-C插座的物理轮廓线框图，标示了对称轴。
prompt_en: This infographic details the technical specifications and functionalities of the USB-C interface. The image is divided into several color-coded sections, including dark red on the left, light gray at the top and middle, blue on the right, yellow on the bottom left, and white on the bottom right, with each section presenting information on a different topic. At the top center is a 24-pin symmetrical array diagram of USB-C, with colored boxes indicating the name and function of each pin, accompanied by a note on rotational symmetry. The middle section includes a "Functional Analysis" explaining how USB-C separates high-speed data from legacy signals, listing primary signal groups. Below this is a detailed technical data table, categorizing pin identifiers, functions, and engineering notes by functional groups (e.g., Ground, Power, High-Speed Data). The blue section on the right describes the Power Delivery 3.1 protocol capabilities, including a maximum power transfer of 240W and various voltage-current combinations. The bottom-left central area illustrates bandwidth evolution, comparing throughput improvements from USB 2.0 to USB4/Thunderbolt 4 through a list and horizontal bar graphs, along with a note on USB4's dynamic bandwidth allocation. The bottom-left yellow section explains USB-C's Alternate Modes, listing the transmission capabilities for non-USB protocols like DisplayPort, HDMI, and Thunderbolt. The bottom-right features a wireframe diagram of the USB-C receptacle, indicating its symmetry axis.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于哥特式大教堂结构力学的技术信息图表。图片背景为深灰色，所有文字和图表元素均以白色或浅灰色显示。页面采用多栏和网格布局，将内容划分为多个区域。顶部区域包含主标题“哥特式大教堂结构力学”及其英文副标题，以及一段中文介绍性文字和两个力学公式。中部左侧是一个结构剖面分析图，展示了中殿、飞扶壁和侧廊的结构，下方附有关于力流方向、受力状态和材料密度的表格。中部右侧列出了“三项核心技术”：尖肋拱顶、飞扶壁和尖券，并配有简要描述。下方左侧是一个柱状图，标题为“高度对比 / HEIGHT DATA”，展示了巴黎、沙特尔、兰斯、亚眠、科隆等教堂的高度数据，其中沙特尔的柱子为黄色。下方右侧是一个关于“推力矢量分解”的表格，包含拱角、推力比、载荷和力矩等数据，并附有解释性文字。页面底部是一个大型表格，标题为“主要教堂结构参数 / STRUCTURAL REGISTER”，详细列出了多个大教堂的始建年份、穹顶高度、中殿跨度和飞扶壁层数。最底部还有三个小型表格，分别展示了材料属性、几何常数和目录参考信息，以及版权声明。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic about the structural mechanics of Gothic cathedrals. The image features a dark gray background, with all text and chart elements displayed in white or light gray. The page adopts a multi-column and grid layout, dividing the content into several distinct areas. The top section includes the main title "哥特式大教堂结构力学" (Gothic Cathedral Structural Mechanics) and its English subtitle, along with an introductory Chinese text and two mechanical formulas. The middle-left section presents a structural section analysis diagram, illustrating the nave, flying buttress, and aisle structures, accompanied by a table below detailing force flow direction, stress state, and material density. The middle-right section lists "三项核心技术" (Three Core Technologies): pointed ribbed vault, flying buttress, and pointed arch, each with a brief description. Below that, on the left, is a bar chart titled "高度对比 / HEIGHT DATA" (Height Comparison / HEIGHT DATA), showing height data for cathedrals such as Paris, Chartres, Reims, Amiens, and Cologne, with the bar for Chartres highlighted in yellow. On the right, there is a table on "推力矢量分解" (Thrust Vector Decomposition), including data for arch angle, thrust ratio, load, and moment, followed by explanatory text. The bottom of the page features a large table titled "主要教堂结构参数 / STRUCTURAL REGISTER" (Main Cathedral Structural Parameters / STRUCTURAL REGISTER), detailing the construction year, vault height, nave span, and flying buttress tiers for several cathedrals. At the very bottom, three smaller tables present material properties, geometric constants, and catalogue reference information, along with a copyright statement.

人眼光学系统与感光细胞规格
SPECIFICATION SHEET: BIOLOGICAL OPTICAL & PHOTORECEPTOR SYSTEM
SECTION 01 / 屈光机构及光路
OPTICAL SYSTEM
人眼光学通道由一系列精密的光学元件构成，静态状态下总屈光力约为60屈光度，将入射光线折射至视网膜感光层。
角膜 (Cornea): 贡献约 2/3 屈光度 (40-43D)，折射率恒定为 1.376，提供静态基础聚焦能力。
晶状体 (Lens): 可变焦动力机构 (15-20D)，依靠睫状肌调节曲率以调整焦点距离。
瞳孔/虹膜 (Pupil/Iris): 动态光圈控制阀，调节通光口径，适应不同环境光强。
