VII // HUMAN RETINAL ANATOMY SPECIFICATIONS”。
prompt_en: This infographic, set against a dark blue background, presents specifications for the human eye's optical system and photoreceptor cells. At the top, there is a main title "人眼光学系统与感光细胞规格" and its English subtitle. The image is divided into several sections: The top-left section, titled "屈光机构及光路" (Refractive Mechanism and Optical Path), features a schematic diagram of the human eye's optical structure, with labels for the cornea, lens, iris, retina, and fovea. This section also provides detailed descriptions of the functions of the cornea, lens, and pupil/iris. The right section, titled "光谱响应" (Spectral Response), includes a textual explanation and a curve graph illustrating the relative absorption rates of cone cells (S-type, M-type, L-type) and rod cells. The X-axis represents wavelength (nm), and the Y-axis represents relative absorption. Curve peaks are labeled with 420nm, 500nm, 534nm, and 564nm. Below the graph, three data statistics are presented, showing 120 million total rod cells, 6 million total cone cells, and 70% static refractive contribution. The bottom section features a table titled "感光细胞性能规格对比" (Photoreceptor Specifications Comparison), detailing the cell type, distribution area, photopigment, spectral peak, photosensitivity, and color resolution capabilities for rod cells and S, M, L-type cone cells. At the very bottom, a yellow warning box highlights "强蓝光辐射危险性提示" (Strong Blue Light Radiation Hazard). The footer reads "PLATE NO. VII // HUMAN RETINAL ANATOMY SPECIFICATIONS".

HYDRATION RATE (WATER TO FLOUR)
THE RHEOLOGICAL MATRIX
The physical structure of dough is fundamentally governed by the water absorption ratio. Wheat proteins, specifically gliadin and glutenin, hydrate to establish a cohesive, viscoelastic network. This matrix acts as a gas-retaining membrane, locking in the carbon dioxide produced during fermentation.
VISCOSITY & STRUCTURAL TENSION
Higher water volumes lower viscosity, facilitating rapid enzymatic activity and starch swelling. However, they demand extended structural manipulation-such as autolyse and coil folding-to maintain gas retention without structural collapse. Conversely, low-hydration systems rely on tight, dense gluten bonds that restrict cell expansion but yield high mechanical stability.

THERMOCHEMICAL SEQUENCE
III. OVEN TEMPERATURE TRANSITION MATRIX
THE BAKING SPECTRUM
As thermal energy penetrates the loaf, distinct biochemical transitions dictate the final crumb structure. Below 55°C, yeast metabolic output peaks, generating rapid carbon dioxide expansion known as the oven rise.
GELATINIZATION & COLORATION
At 60°C, yeast death occurs, and starch gelatinization begins, binding free water into a solid gel. Above 140°C, the chemical reactions between amino acids and reducing sugars (Maillard reaction) commence on the outer surface, culminating in the complex pigments and volatile aromas of a mature bake.

prompt_cn: 这张信息图表以深蓝色为背景，所有文字和图表元素均为米色，呈现出复古的风格。图表标题为“TRANSATLANTIC FERMENTED BREADS”，副标题为“世界八大发酵面包种类: 含水量、酵母与烘焙参数”，并注明发布于1884年。页面分为三个主要部分。第一部分位于顶部，左侧是一个散点图，展示了八种面包（如Sourdough、Rye、Ciabatta等）的发酵时长与含水量的关系，Y轴为发酵时长（小时），X轴为含水量（水粉比）。右侧是关于面团流变学稳定性和粘度与结构张力的英文文本描述。第二部分位于中部，是一个详细的表格，列出了八种面包的类型、含水量、发酵剂、烤箱温度、烘烤时长、是否需要蒸汽以及外皮和内部特征。第三部分位于底部，左侧是关于烘焙过程中热化学序列的英文文本描述，包括烘焙光谱、糊化和着色。右侧是一个条形图，显示了不同温度下（从20°C到260°C）酵母活性、酵母死亡、淀粉凝胶、面筋凝固、美拉德反应和焦糖化等热反应的区间。图表底部还有版权信息和出版商信息。
prompt_en: This infographic features a dark blue background with all text and graphic elements in beige, presenting a vintage aesthetic. The main title is "TRANSATLANTIC FERMENTED BREADS," with a subtitle "世界八大发酵面包种类: 含水量、酵母与烘焙参数" (Eight Major Fermented Bread Types: Water Content, Yeast, and Baking Parameters), and indicates it was issued in 1884. The page is divided into three main sections. The first section at the top features a scatter plot on the left, illustrating the relationship between fermentation duration and hydration rate for eight bread types (e.g., Sourdough, Rye, Ciabatta). The Y-axis represents fermentation duration (hours), and the X-axis represents hydration rate (water to flour). On the right, there are English text descriptions regarding the rheological stability of dough and viscosity & structural tension. The second section in the middle is a detailed table, listing eight bread types, their hydration, leavening culture, oven temperature, baking duration, steam requirement, and crust & crumb characteristics. The third section at the bottom has English text descriptions on the left about the thermochemical sequence during baking, including the baking spectrum, gelatinization, and coloration. On the right, there is a bar chart showing the temperature ranges (from 20°C to 260°C) for various thermal reactions such as yeast activity, yeast death, starch gel, gluten set, Maillard reaction, and caramelization. The bottom of the infographic includes copyright and publisher information.

text:
建筑师
民国时期的建筑为中国古 典与西方古典结合的产物 是建筑史发展的时代。
民国时期建筑师多为外国 建筑师而中国古代少有， 民国时期开始以造就了人 民英雄纪念碑、中华人民 共和国国徽方案深化设计 者林徽因、梁思成等为 代表的建筑师逐渐发展。
林徽因
电影演员
民国时期电影开始发展， 电影是大城市主要的娱乐 方式之一，并就此造就了 一大批有成就的电影家。 电影直至现在看，仍然 堪称经典。
民国第一美女胡蝶、天涯 歌女周璇、阮玲玉等著名 影星出现电影事业发展如 火如荼。
胡蝶
作家
民国时期是文学发展的黄 金时期，横眉冷对千夫指 俯首甘为孺子生，兴起一 大批作家等文学从事着， 中国文学蓬勃发展。
民国时期作家张爱玲、胡 兰成、萧红、梁实秋、沈 从文、老舍、鲁迅等知名 人士至今他们的作品仍广 为流畅。
张爱玲
画家
民国时期的绘画艺术蓬勃 发展，画派众多美术社团 涌现，民国是艺术发展的 大时代。
民国时期画家层出不穷潘 玉良、徐悲鸿、张大千、 林风眠、齐白石、丰子恺 等为中国绘画的更好发展 提供了更多可能。
潘玉良

prompt_cn: 这是一幅以深蓝色星空背景为底的插画或数字绘画。画面中央是一个巨大的潘洛斯三角（不可能图形），将图片划分为四个象限并进行视觉连接。画面中描绘了四位身着民国服饰的女性，分别代表不同的职业。她们围绕并置身于潘洛斯三角之上：左上方一位女性手持红色雨伞站立，右上方一位女性斜倚着，左下方一位女性站立，右下方一位女性坐着。每位女性旁边都配有黄色、大号、粗体、垂直排布的职业标题（如“建筑师”、“电影演员”、“作家”、“画家”），以及较小的白色正文，描述了她们的职业特点和代表人物。她们的名字（如“林徽因”、“胡蝶”、“张爱玲”、“潘玉良”）以浅蓝色或白色垂直书写在潘洛斯三角的侧面。画面中还以白色线稿勾勒出椅子、桌子、沙发等家具，与深色背景形成对比。潘洛斯三角的各个面呈现出浅蓝、浅紫和白色/灰色调。整体构图呈四宫格状，中央的不可能图形巧妙地将不同的人物和信息区域联系起来。
prompt_en: This is an illustration or digital painting set against a dark blue, starry background. A large Penrose triangle (impossible figure) occupies the center, dividing and visually connecting the image into four quadrants. The image depicts four women dressed in Republic of China era attire, each representing a different profession. They are positioned around and on the Penrose triangle: one woman in the top left stands holding a red umbrella, one in the top right reclines, one in the bottom left stands, and one in the bottom right sits. Each figure is accompanied by a yellow, large, bold, vertical title (e.g., "建筑师" (Architect), "电影演员" (Film Actress), "作家" (Writer), "画家" (Painter)) and smaller white body text detailing their profession and prominent figures. Their names (e.g., "林徽因" (Lin Huiyin), "胡蝶" (Hu Die), "张爱玲" (Eileen Chang), "潘玉良" (Pan Yuliang)) are inscribed vertically in light blue or white on the sides of the Penrose triangle. White line-art furniture, such as chairs, tables, and sofas, is sketched around the figures, providing a contrast against the dark background. The faces of the Penrose triangle are rendered in shades of light blue, light purple, and white/grey. The overall composition is a four-quadrant layout, with the central impossible figure serving as a unifying element for the distinct character and informational sections.

text:
临夏美食手抄报
东乡手抓羊肉
河沿面片
东乡手抓羊肉就是指将，张掖鸡，叙饲，饮牧通肥膘，长褐细牛，饲养。蒸上手肉，讳菜桂多脂，椒漫湖生进手肉和余扇，大雄的息亮，再耳可疑提甜美的肉熟味。
河沿面片炖炒中不有的流血枯干难流淌，清汤菜的面面和荷叶，在开地上淌淌河沿丝的葱粉，实在河沿面片，汤在叠于河沿面片，撒面中的葱而解，薄的面的椒菜，珠生山弧度丰沃，的肉小食肴。
临夏酿皮
发子面肠
临夏酿皮冷拌吃拌，拌拌只只拌鲜凉凉，拌火拌冷拌，拌细拌，拌淋拌少拌度，拌于拌片的拌夏拌皮。拌未拌肉的拌于拌片，拌夏拌菜拌，拌的拌水拌土，拌沿拌片的拌风拌味。
发子面肠介金饼，普慈的未起过面肠，母子面肠，面面糯，在发子面肠，发的面面的临夏酿皮小辣。

prompt_cn: 这是一张手绘风格的“临夏美食手抄报”海报，放置在木质桌面上。海报顶部中央是卷轴状的主标题“临夏美食手抄报”，下方分为左右两栏，每栏又包含两个美食介绍区域。左上区域介绍“东乡手抓羊肉”，配有清真寺、绵羊和一盘羊肉的插画。右上区域介绍“河沿面片”，配有水车、河流和一碗面片的插画。左下区域介绍“临夏酿皮”，配有绵羊和一碗酿皮的插画。右下区域介绍“发子面肠”，配有绵羊和一盘香肠的插画。每个美食区域都包含一段描述性文字，这些文字内容语义不连贯。海报整体采用暖色调，装饰有花朵和民族风格的图案。桌面上散落着彩色铅笔、剪刀和画笔等文具。
prompt_en: This is a hand-drawn style poster titled "Linxia Food Handout," placed on a wooden tabletop. The main title, "临夏美食手抄报" (Linxia Food Handout), is centrally located at the top on a scroll banner. Below the title, the poster is divided into two columns, each containing two food introduction sections. The upper-left section introduces "东乡手抓羊肉" (Dongxiang Hand-grabbed Mutton), accompanied by illustrations of a mosque, sheep, and a plate of mutton. The upper-right section introduces "河沿面片" (Heyan Noodle Slices), with illustrations of a waterwheel, river, and a bowl of noodles. The lower-left section introduces "临夏酿皮" (Linxia Liangpi), featuring illustrations of sheep and a bowl of liangpi. The lower-right section introduces "发子面肠" (Fazi Noodle Sausage), with illustrations of sheep and a plate of sausages. Each food section includes a descriptive text, though these texts are semantically incoherent. The poster uses warm tones overall and is decorated with floral and ethnic-style patterns. Scattered on the tabletop are colored pencils, scissors, and paintbrushes.

prompt_cn: 这张图片展示了七张以“文明监督局”为主题的宣传海报，它们以两排（上排四张，物排三张）的形式错落有致地排列在深灰色砖墙背景上。每张海报都采用黑白照片或插画作为背景，并辅以鲜明的蓝色和红色几何图形及文字。海报内容围绕公共行为规范展开，包括“请勿喧哗”（Don't make noise）、“勿挤”（Don't crowd）、“勿烟”（Don't smoke）、“请勿高空抛物”（Don't throw objects from height）、“勿乱”（Don't litter）和“闯红灯”（Don't run red lights）等主题。每张海报顶部或底部都标有“文明监督局”字样，作为统一的品牌标识。文字排版多样，有大号蓝色中文竖排标语，也有小号黑色或白色中英文说明文字，图文结合生动地传达了文明行为的倡导。
prompt_en: This image features seven propaganda posters themed "Bureau of Impoliteness Regulation," arranged in two rows (four on the top, three on the bottom) against a dark grey brick wall background. Each poster utilizes black and white photography or illustration as its background, complemented by vivid blue and red geometric graphics and text. The poster content revolves around public conduct norms, covering themes such as "Don't make noise," "Don't crowd," "Don't smoke," "Don't throw objects from height," "Don't litter," and "Don't run red lights." The text "文明监督局" (Bureau of Impoliteness Regulation) is displayed at the top or bottom of each poster, serving as a unified brand identifier. The typography is diverse, featuring large blue vertical Chinese slogans, as well as smaller black or white Chinese and English explanatory texts, vividly conveying the advocacy for civilized behavior through the combination of images and text.

prompt_cn: 这张信息图展示了超高层建筑的结构系统、荷载分布、减震装置及全球案例。图片整体布局分为三列，顶部有三个主要区域，底部是一个横跨三列的表格。左上角标题为“超高层结构系统”，顶部中间是“结构形态 / ARCHITECTURAL MORPHOLOGY”，右侧是“02 减震装置 / DAMPING”。左侧中间区域详细说明了“荷载分布 / LOADING DYNAMICS”，并配有风载和地震荷载随高度变化的对比图。中间区域展示了核心筒、伸臂桁架、框筒结构和巨型斜撑四种结构形态的简化图示。右侧区域介绍了调谐质量阻尼器（TMD）及其660公吨的重量，以及结构效率指标如钢材强度、最大允许位移和自振周期。底部表格列出了哈利法塔、上海中心等六个全球超高层建筑案例，包含其名称、高度、结构系统、关键技术和竣工年份。图片底部有页脚信息。
prompt_en: This infographic illustrates the structural systems, load distribution, damping devices, and global case studies of super-tall buildings. The image is laid out in three columns, with three main sections at the top and a table spanning all three columns at the bottom. The top-left section is titled "SUPER-TALL STRUCTURAL SYSTEMS", the top-middle section is "结构形态 / ARCHITECTURAL MORPHOLOGY", and the top-right section is "02 减震装置 / DAMPING". The middle-left area details "荷载分布 / LOADING DYNAMICS" and includes a comparison chart showing wind and seismic loads varying with height. The central area presents simplified diagrams of four structural typologies: core structure, outrigger, tube system, and mega-bracing. The right-hand section describes the Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) with its 660 metric tons weight, and structural efficiency indicators such as steel strength, maximum allowable displacement, and natural period. The bottom table lists six global super-tall building cases, including Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower, with their names, heights, structural systems, key features, and completion years. Footer information is present at the bottom of the image.

PLATE NO. 042 - HEMATOLOGICAL ATLAS
A Comparative Study of Human
Leukocytes
INNATE IMMUNITY VS. ADAPTIVE RESPONSES
The human immune system is a stratified defense mechanism categorized by its speed and specificity. The Innate system provides the immediate, non-specific response, utilizing physical barriers and generic cellular hunters. In contrast, the Adaptive system offers a highly specialized, memory-based defense that targets specific molecular signatures of pathogens.
Normal Adult Blood Composition: The total White Blood Cell (WBC) count ranges from 4,000 to 11,000 cells per microliter (uL). Deviations from this range often indicate acute infection, bone marrow distress, or chronic inflammatory conditions.

INNATE DEFENSE MECHANISMS
The innate system relies on Pattern Recognition Receptors (PRRs) to detect common microbial features. Macrophages act as scavengers, while Complement Proteins circulate in blood to puncture bacterial walls upon activation.
ADAPTIVE SPECIFICITY
B-lymphocytes originate in the bone marrow. Once activated by an antigen, they differentiate into plasma cells that produce high-affinity antibodies. Memory cells ensure a faster secondary response upon re-exposure.
DIAGNOSTIC THRESHOLDS
Leukocytosis (>11,000/μL) typically signals inflammation or infection. Leukopenia (<4,000/μL) suggests potential bone marrow failure or immunosuppression. Differential counts provide a deeper diagnostic map.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类白细胞的科学信息图表，背景为深青色，所有文字和图表元素均采用浅米色或灰白色。图片整体布局清晰，顶部是标题“A Comparative Study of Human Leukocytes”，副标题为“INNATE IMMUNITY VS. ADAPTIVE RESPONSES”。标题下方左右两侧是关于免疫系统和正常成人血液成分的介绍性文本段落。中部包含两个图表和一个数据摘要区。图1是一个折线图，展示了先天免疫和适应性免疫随时间变化的强度。数据摘要区列出了中性粒细胞优势、B细胞抗体率和最低白细胞计数等关键数值，并附有形态学注释。图2是一个白细胞差异分布图，通过带有百分比的圆圈展示了五种白细胞（中性粒细胞、淋巴细胞、单核细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞、嗜碱性粒细胞）的比例。底部是一个详细的表格，列出了不同细胞类别、亚型、数量、主要功能和寿命。最下方是关于先天防御机制、适应性特异性和诊断阈值的三个文本段落。各部分之间有细线分隔，以组织内容。
prompt_en: This is a scientific infographic about human leukocytes, featuring a dark teal background with all text and graphic elements in light beige or off-white. The overall layout is clear, with the main title "A Comparative Study of Human Leukocytes" and subtitle "INNATE IMMUNITY VS. ADAPTIVE RESPONSES" at the top. Below the title, introductory text paragraphs on the immune system and normal adult blood composition are placed on the left and right, respectively. The central section includes two charts and a data summary area. Figure 1 is a line graph illustrating the kinetic response magnitude (intensity over time) for innate and adaptive immune phases. The data summary area presents key values such as neutrophil dominance, B-cell antibody rate, and minimum WBC count, along with morphology notes. Figure 2 is a leukocyte differential distribution plot, showing the percentages of five types of white blood cells (Neutrophil, Lymphocyte, Monocyte, Eosinophil, Basophil) within circles. At the bottom, a detailed table lists various cell categories, subtypes, counts, primary functions, and lifespans. The very bottom section contains three text paragraphs discussing innate defense mechanisms, adaptive specificity, and diagnostic thresholds. Thin lines separate the different content sections for organization.

prompt_cn: 这张科学信息图表展示了亚马逊雨林的垂直分层与生物多样性分布。图表背景为白色，标题“亚马逊雨林: 垂直分层与生物多样性分布”位于顶部居中，下方是副标题“垂直拓扑系统图 / amazonian vertical stratification system”。图表主体分为左右两部分，左侧是亚马逊雨林的垂直生态系统示意图，从上到下依次标示了露生层（60M）、林冠层（35M）、林下层（15M）和地表层（02M），并配有各层的特征描述。垂直分层图左侧的蓝色和红色线条分别代表光照渗透率和物种丰富度，并用圆点标记了核心生态位节点。右侧包含一个生态位参数表格，列出了环境温度、相对湿度等六项参数的数值范围和波动性。表格下方是关于垂直生物量分配的文字说明，以及一个显示“系统稳定性指数 0.942 PSI”的蓝色大字数值。图表底部是四列物种列表，分别对应四个垂直分层，每种物种都附有中英文名称和分类缩写。页脚提供了图表的来源信息和数据来源。
prompt_en: This scientific infographic illustrates the vertical stratification and biodiversity distribution of the Amazon rainforest. The chart has a white background, with the main title "亚马逊雨林: 垂直分层与生物多样性分布" centered at the top, followed by the subtitle "垂直拓扑系统图 / amazonian vertical stratification system". The main body of the chart is divided into left and right sections. The left section presents a schematic diagram of the Amazon rainforest's vertical ecosystem, indicating the emergent layer (60M), canopy layer (35M), understory layer (15M), and forest floor layer (02M) from top to bottom, each with descriptive characteristics. Blue and red lines on the left side of the vertical stratification diagram represent light penetration rate and species richness, respectively, with dots marking core ecological niche nodes. The right section includes an ecological parameter table, listing the numerical ranges and fluctuations for six parameters such as ambient temperature and relative humidity. Below the table is a textual explanation of vertical biomass allocation, and a large blue numerical value displaying "系统稳定性指数 0.942 PSI". The bottom of the chart features four columns of species lists, corresponding to the four vertical strata, with each species accompanied by its Chinese and English names and classification abbreviations. The footer provides source information and data origin for the chart.

国剧研究系列 / DRAMA STUDY
★ 1948年印行 / ISSUED 1948 ★
京剧脸谱色彩密码与性格对应图鉴
AN ANNOTATED ATLAS OF PEKING OPERA FACIAL MAKEUP & COLOR SYMBOLISM
脸谱溯源与表意机制
Historical Origin & Semiotics
PART I
脸谱起源于南北朝假面戏，借色彩与线条形象人物忠奸善恶，是“寓褒贬、别善恶”的视觉史诗。谱法以色传神，以形定性，使观众瞬息辨明人物忠奸。
Facial makeup originated from ancient military mask plays. It functions as a graphic shorthand, utilizing strict color and line codes to instantly telegraph moral qualities to the audience.
色彩密码与性格映射
Color Matrix & Characteristics
PART II
脸谱构图五式分设
Structural Composition Types
PART III
构图决定脸谱的基准骨架，与性格密码互为表里。主要谱式以脑门与面颊的线条划分与整脸、三块瓦等。
忠勇 (Loyalty)
暴烈 (Ferocity)
刚正 (Integrity)
桀骜 (Audacity)
眉目法度与神态勾画
Eye & Brow Calligraphy
PART IV
双目与眉宇的勾画是体现人物个性的关键。细微的弧度与线条差异，即可传达截然不同的神态气质与忠奸走向。
谱色 / Color
性格与寓意 / Personality Code

■ 红脸 / Red
忠勇正直, 赤胆报国 (Loyal & Righteous)
关羽 (Guan Yu)
■ 黑脸 / Black

包拯 (Bao Zheng)
□ 白脸 / White
阴险奸诈, 多疑凝重 (Treacherous & Crafty)
曹操 (Cao Cao)
□ 黄脸 / Yellow
勇猛暴烈, 彪悍骁勇 (Fierce & Cruel)
典韦 (Dian Wei)
■ 蓝脸 / Blue
刚强桀骜, 豪爽 (Wild & Audacious)
窦尔敦 (Dou Erdun)
整脸 (Unified)
三块瓦 (3-Tiles)
十字门 (Cross-Gate)
卧蚕眉 / Horizontal Sword
代表人物: 关羽 (Indicates Heroism)
蝙蝠眉 / Bat-wing Shape
代表人物: 张飞 (Indicates Fierceness)
勺子眉 / Spoon Outline
代表人物: 包拯 (Integrity)
谱式 / Structure
结构描述 / Geometric Definition
整脸 / Unified
主色单涂脸部，不改五官主型。
三块瓦 / 3-Tiles
眉眼与额头界限分明，分出三块主色。
十字门 / Cross-Gate
黑色鼻梁直通脑门，眼部横涂成十字。
戏曲图谱·识语
Metadata & Epilogue
PART V
The structure of the brow determines temperament. The bat-wing pattern denotes impetuous courage, while the horizontal sword signals unyielding righteousness.
凡梨园开演，必先以谱定色，使观者望其面而知其心。是故红白异路，黑黄异途。大东书局本卷刊行，旨在解析戏剧色彩之法理。

INTERNAL COMBUSTION: THE OTTO
CYCLE
HISTORICAL CONTEXT
The four-stroke engine, codified by Nikolaus Otto in 1876, represents the pinnacle of 19th-century thermodynamics applied to mobile power. Unlike the continuous external combustion of steam, the internal combustion engine (ICE) utilizes a discretized periodic sequence of gas state changes. This "Ideal Otto Cycle" serves as the theoretical benchmark for spark-ignition engines, governed by the principles of isentropic compression and constant-volume heat addition.

"The efficiency of the Otto cycle depends solely on the compression ratio. As r increases, the temperature difference between the heat addition and rejection increases, extracting more work from the same volume of fuel. However, the limit is dictated by the spontaneous ignition of the mixture, known as engine knock."

Where γ is the ratio of specific heats (≈ 1.4 for air) and r is the compression ratio. In practice, pumping losses, friction, and incomplete combustion reduce this theoretical ceiling significantly.
現代のガソリンエンジンにおける最適制御。Modern engines utilize Variable Valve Timing (VVT) to approximate the Atkinson cycle during low-load conditions, effectively varying the expansion ratio independently of the physical compression stroke to minimize throttling losses and improve thermal efficiency across the power band.

The diagram uses orange-red curves and white numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 to mark the four state points of the cycle, with P and V axes labeled in white text. Below the PV diagram, the physical meanings of the 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, and 4-1 processes are explained in detail. The bottom of the right column contains the "ENGINEERING NOTES" section, which includes a mixed Japanese and English engineering note. prompt_cn: 这是一张关于柯本气候分类系统的技术信息图。图片整体采用深色背景，配以白色和灰色文字，并用红色、绿色和橙色突出显示关键信息。顶部和底部是带有系统状态和硬件接口信息的页眉和页脚。主体内容分为三列：左侧列包含对柯本气候分类系统的文字介绍，以及一个展示海拔与纬度衰减关系的线图，图中标注了不同的气候带。中间列是一个详细的表格，列出了主要气候带（如热带、干旱、温带、大陆性、极地和高地）的阈值、限制指标和代表地点。表格下方是一个散点图，描绘了不同气候集群的温度与年降水量关系。右侧列展示了两个“芯片ID”模块，分别对应热带和温带气候的详细参数，以及一个包含多个气候子类别（如Af、Am、BWh、BSk等）及其特征描述的网格。
prompt_en: This is a technical information graphic about the Köppen Climate Classification System. The image features a dark background with white and gray text, accented by red, green, and orange for key information. The top and bottom sections serve as headers and footers, displaying system status and hardware interface details. The main content is organized into three columns: The left column provides a textual introduction to the Köppen system and a line graph illustrating the decay of climate zones with altitude versus latitude, with different climate bands labeled. The middle column contains a detailed table outlining the primary climate bands (e.g., Tropical, Arid, Temperate, Continental, Polar, and Highland) with their thresholds, limiting metrics, and specimen locations. Below the table is a scatter plot depicting climate clusters based on temperature versus annual precipitation. The right column presents two "chip ID" modules, detailing parameters for Tropical and Temperate climates, along with a grid of "micro-regulations" (subclasses) such as Af, Am, BWh, BSk, each with a brief description of its characteristics.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于西文字体解剖学的黑白信息图表。图表顶部是标题“西文字体解剖学图谱 / TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY”，下方有八个带有编号和简短描述的方块，其中前两个方块内是大写字母“Ag”和“Ab”，其余六个方块内是抽象图标（如水平线、方块、加号、圆圈、叉号），分别对应“基准线”、“边界框”、“节点”、“字端”、“错误”和“校准器”。图表主体分为三列。左列是“度量系统 / VERTICAL METRICS”部分，编号为“01”，展示了字符“b”和“i”的垂直度量，包括“上升部 ASCENDER LINE”、“CAP-HEIGHT”、“X-字高 X-HEIGHT”、“基线 BASELINE”和“降部线 DESCENDER LINE”。左下角有一段关于西文字体比例和可读性的说明文字。中列是“字体结构特征 / ANATOMY FEATURES”部分，编号为“02”，以表格形式列出了“字干 STEM”、“衬线 SERIF”、“字碗 BOWL”等十种字体结构特征及其定义。右列是“比对规格参考 / SPECIFICATIONS”部分，编号为“03”，包含一个表格，比较了HELVETICA、GARAMOND、BASKERVILLE和FUTURA四种字体的“X-高度”和“对比度”。表格下方是一个红色背景的“安全警告 / ATTENTION”框，提示排版注意事项。警告框下方有四个带有图标的工具标签，如“节点调整工具”和“网格校准器”。页脚包含“西文字体解剖学手册修订版 V.02 / ATLAS OF TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY”、“页码 084 / 350”和“© 2024 系统排版实验室数字生产”。
prompt_en: This is a black and white infographic about Western typography anatomy. The top of the chart features the title "西文字体解剖学图谱 / TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY". Below it are eight numbered boxes with brief descriptions; the first two boxes contain the uppercase letters "Ag" and "Ab", while the other six contain abstract icons (such as a horizontal line, a square, a plus sign, a circle, and a cross), corresponding to "Baseline", "Bounding Box", "Node", "Terminal", "Error", and "Calibrator" respectively. The main body of the chart is divided into three columns. The left column is the "度量系统 / VERTICAL METRICS" section, numbered "01", illustrating the vertical metrics of characters "b" and "i", including "上升部 ASCENDER LINE", "CAP-HEIGHT", "X-字高 X-HEIGHT", "基线 BASELINE", and "降部线 DESCENDER LINE". A descriptive text about Western typeface proportions and readability is located at the bottom left. The middle column is the "字体结构特征 / ANATOMY FEATURES" section, numbered "02", presenting a table of ten typeface structural features like "字干 STEM", "衬线 SERIF", and "字碗 BOWL" with their definitions. The right column is the "比对规格参考 / SPECIFICATIONS" section, numbered "03", which includes a table comparing the "X-高度" (X-Height) and "对比度" (Contrast) of four typefaces: HELVETICA, GARAMOND, BASKERVILLE, and FUTURA. Below this table is a red-background "安全警告 / ATTENTION" box, providing typesetting precautions. Four tool labels with icons, such as "节点调整工具" (Node Adjustment Tool) and "网格校准器" (Grid Calibrator), are located below the warning box. The footer contains "西文字体解剖学手册修订版 V.02 / ATLAS OF TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY", "页码 084 / 350", and "© 2024 系统排版实验室数字生产".

prompt_cn: 图片是一张关于水电站大坝水力发电的横截面图解。图解采用三栏布局，从左到右依次为“壹·势能集”、“贰·动能转换”和“叁·输电与损耗”，分别对应水力发电的三个主要阶段。左侧栏展示水库和重力坝的横截面示意图，标注了上游水位线、重力坝等组件，并列出了上游设计水位、有效库容、最大水头等数据，以及关于水库势能转化的文字说明。中间栏描绘了水流通过压力钢管冲击水轮机、带动发电机发电的过程，标注了压力钢管、发电机、主轴、混流式水轮机和尾水管等核心部件。下方是一个表格，详细列出了压力钢管、水轮机转轮、发电机定子等核心组件的技术指标和能量转化率。此外，还有一段关于水能转化为机械能的文字说明和一首垂直排列的诗句。右侧栏列出了额定出力、升压变压器、年发电量等电力输出参数。下方是一个能量损耗分布的条形图，显示了水力损失和机械与电磁损失的比例。最下方是“特别核准印记”区域，包含一段认证文字和“工部水利司 · 监制”的签名。图解顶部有标题“水电站大坝水力发电横截面”及其英文副标题，左上角有编号，右上角有日期。底部有数据来源、文件编号和版权声明。右下角有一个红色的矩形印章，上面刻有“永力发电 工程之印”和“ENERGY BUREAU”字样。
prompt_en: The image is a cross-section diagram illustrating hydroelectric power generation from a dam. The diagram employs a three-column layout, titled from left to right as 'I. Potential Energy Collection', 'II. Kinetic Energy Conversion', and 'III. Power Transmission & Loss', corresponding to the three main stages of hydroelectric power generation. The left column displays a cross-section schematic of a reservoir and gravity dam, with labels for the normal water level and gravity dam. It lists data such as upstream design water level, active storage, and maximum head, along with a text description explaining the conversion of potential energy in the reservoir. The middle column illustrates the process of water flowing through a penstock, impacting the turbine, and driving the generator to produce electricity. It labels core components like the penstock, generator, main shaft, Francis turbine, and draft tube. Below this is a table detailing the technical specifications and energy conversion rates for core components such as the penstock, turbine runner, and generator stator. Additionally, there is a text description about the conversion of hydraulic energy to mechanical energy and a vertically arranged poem. The right column lists power output parameters including rated output, step-up transformer, and annual energy generation. Below it is a bar chart showing the energy loss distribution, indicating the proportions of hydraulic loss and mechanical & magnetic loss. At the very bottom is the 'Special Approval Seal' area, containing certification text and the signature 'Ministry of Works Water Resources Department · Supervised'. The top of the diagram features the title 'Hydroelectric Dam Hydropower Cross-Section' and its English subtitle, with an ID in the top left and a date in the top right. The bottom includes data sources, file numbers, and a copyright statement. In the bottom right corner, there is a red rectangular seal engraved with 'Yongli Power Generation Engineering Seal' and 'ENERGY BUREAU'.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于唐诗格律的图谱，标题为“唐诗格律图谱”，副标题为英文“METRICAL SCHEMATICS OF TANG POETRY • REGISTRY DIVISION”。图谱背景为浅米色，顶部右侧标注有“阅读编号: TP-1913-CN”、“分类: 近体诗韵律规范”和“准度校对: 帝国文学研究会”。图谱分为多个信息区域。左上方是“七言律诗‘级段结构’技术侧影”图，展示了首联、颔联、颈联、尾联的结构和对应的平仄要求。右上方是“声调起伏律”线形图，以“仄”、“中”、“平”为Y轴，“二字”、“四字”、“六字”为X轴，图内标注“‘二四六分明’”。中部并列展示了五言绝句、七言绝句、五言律诗和七言律诗四种诗体的排距、结构、对仗和特记信息。下方是一个“四大基础格式配置表”，以表格形式列出了不同诗体的规则级别、标准起步、首句入韵、偶数句对、对仗联位和代表范式。左下方是“‘黏对’规则演算法”示意图，通过方框和连接线展示了联句间的平仄相反关系。右下方是“格律判定说明”，详细解释了“三五不能”、“二四六分明”和“孤平倒拗规则”。图谱底部左侧有“基准比例尺”及“1刻度 = 1音步”的说明，右侧标注“大英帝国诗律审裁司 • 1913年翻印行”。
prompt_en: This is a metrical schematics chart for Tang poetry, titled "唐诗格律图谱" with the English subtitle "METRICAL SCHEMATICS OF TANG POETRY • REGISTRY DIVISION". The chart has a light beige background, and the top right corner displays "阅读编号: TP-1913-CN" (Reading No.), "分类: 近体诗韵律规范" (Category: Metrical Norms of Modern Style Poetry), and "准度校对: 帝国文学研究会" (Accuracy Proofread by: Imperial Literary Research Society). The chart is divided into several information areas. The top left features a "METRICAL PROFILE OF HULL LEVEL" for seven-character regulated verse, illustrating the structure of the opening couplet, second couplet, third couplet, and concluding couplet, along with their corresponding tonal requirements (level and oblique tones). The top right shows a "TONAL OSCILLATION CHART" with "仄" (oblique), "中" (middle), and "平" (level) on the Y-axis, and "二字" (two characters), "四字" (four characters), "六字" (six characters) on the X-axis, with "‘二四六分明’" (clear two, four, six) marked inside. The middle section presents information for four poetic forms: five-character quatrain, seven-character quatrain, five-character regulated verse, and seven-character regulated verse, detailing their line spacing, structure, antithesis requirements, and special notes. Below this is a "STANDARD METRICAL MATRIX" table, listing the rule level, standard opening, first line rhyming, even-numbered line antithesis, antithetical couplet positions, and representative examples for different poetic forms. The bottom left shows an "ADHERENCE & OPPOSING RULE" diagram, using boxes and connecting lines to illustrate the inverse tonal relationship between couplets. The bottom right provides "DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA", explaining "三五不能" (three-five cannot), "二四六分明" (clear two, four, six), and "孤平倒拗规则" (isolated level tone and inverted oblique rule). The bottom left of the chart includes a "基准比例尺" (Base Scale) with "1刻度 = 1音步" (1 scale = 1 foot), and the bottom right states "大英帝国诗律审裁司 • 1913年翻印行" (Imperial British Poetic Metre Adjudication Department • Reprinted in 1913).

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于人类牙齿解剖学的教育性信息图。页面顶部左侧是“DENS”品牌标识和“SYS-ANAT-092”编码，顶部中央是主标题“人类牙齿剖面解剖学”及其副标题“解剖学分类及生理学构造”。页面主体分为左右两部分，左侧展示了“图 1.1: 纵剖面解剖结构示意”的牙齿剖面图，图的右侧是“解剖分区及定义”的编号列表，详细说明了牙釉质、牙本质、牙髓腔等六个部分的名称和描述。页面下方包含两个表格，左侧是“核心硬组织物理指标”表格，列出了牙釉质、牙本质、牙骨质和牙髓的无机物含量、典型厚度和生物学功能；右侧是“牙周支持系统参数”表格，列出了牙龈、牙周膜和牙槽骨的生理宽度和核心解剖作用。页面右侧还列出了“FDI 牙位记录系统”的四个象限。底部左侧是“图 1.2: 羟基磷灰石晶体六方结构”图，旁边是“无机晶体结构参数”的详细信息。页面右下角有一个蓝色背景的信息框，标题为“羟基磷灰石”，内含其化学式、莫氏硬度、恒牙数量及数据来源说明。页面底部有页脚“人类解剖学图谱: 第 92 页”和“DENS HOMINIS”。整体布局清晰，以白色为背景，黑色文字为主，部分标题和信息框使用蓝色突出显示。
prompt_en: This is an educational infographic about human tooth anatomy. The top left of the page features the "DENS" brand logo and "SYS-ANAT-092" code, while the top center displays the main title "人类牙齿剖面解剖学" (Human Tooth Cross-Sectional Anatomy) and its subtitle "解剖学分类及生理学构造" (Anatomical Classification and Physiological Structure). The main body of the page is divided into two sections. The left side presents "图 1.1: 纵剖面解剖结构示意" (Figure 1.1: Schematic Diagram of Longitudinal Sectional Anatomy) showing a tooth cross-section. To the right of the diagram is a numbered list under "解剖分区及定义" (Anatomical Divisions and Definitions), detailing the names and descriptions of six parts, including enamel, dentin, and pulp cavity. The lower part of the page contains two tables: on the left, the "核心硬组织物理指标" (Core Hard Tissue Physical Indicators) table lists the inorganic content, typical thickness, and biological functions of enamel, dentin, cementum, and pulp; on the right, the "牙周支持系统参数" (Periodontal Support System Parameters) table lists the physiological width and core anatomical functions of the gingiva, periodontal ligament, and alveolar bone. The right side of the page also lists the four quadrants of the "FDI 牙位记录系统" (FDI Tooth Numbering System). The bottom left features "图 1.2: 羟基磷灰石晶体六方结构" (Figure 1.2: Hydroxyapatite Crystal Hexagonal Structure) with detailed "无机晶体结构参数" (Inorganic Crystal Structure Parameters) next to it. The bottom right corner has a blue-background information box titled "羟基磷灰石" (Hydroxyapatite), containing its chemical formula, Mohs hardness, number of permanent teeth, and data source. The page footer at the bottom left reads "人类解剖学图谱: 第 92 页" (Human Anatomy Atlas: Page 92) and "DENS HOMINIS" at the bottom right. The overall layout is clear, with a white background, primarily black text, and some titles and information boxes highlighted in blue.

The FCS-90A controllers coordinate fixed-wing flight control surfaces across three orthogonal axes. Roll (longitudinal axis) is governed by differential deflection of wing-tip ailerons. Pitch (transverse axis) is modulated by elevators on the horizontal stabilizer to control the angle of attack. Yaw (vertical axis) is managed by the vertical rudder. Auxiliary surfaces include flaps for lift enhancement during low-speed phases, and spoilers for lift destruction during landing touchdown operations.

prompt_cn: 这是一份关于三轴飞行控制执行器逻辑与操作动力学的技术文档。页面顶部包含公司名称“AERO-LOGIC SYSTEMS”、部门“FLIGHT DYNAMICS DIVISION”、文档编号“AC-90-FCS / REV-D2”和日期“October 1996”。主标题“THREE-AXIS FLIGHT CONTROL ACTUATOR LOGIC & OPERATIONAL DYNAMICS”醒目地位于页面中央。文档内容分为多个部分，每个部分标题都以蓝色背景条突出显示。第一部分是“CONNECTION DIAGRAM & INPUT/OUTPUT MAPPING”，展示了一个带有输入/输出引脚列表的连接图，并附有关于飞行控制面和控制力矩传递方程的详细说明。第二部分是“AERODYNAMIC CONTROL SURFACE SCHEMATIC”，描绘了飞机气动控制面的示意图，并标注了左右副翼、扰流板、襟翼、升降舵、方向舵面板以及俯仰、滚转和偏航轴。第三部分是“FUNCTIONAL TRUTH TABLE”，列出了不同飞行状态下滚转、俯仰、偏航、副翼和升降舵的对应关系。第四部分是“DYNAMIC & ELECTRICAL LIMITS”，以表格形式展示了各种参数的最小、典型和最大值及其单位。文档底部还有一个红色背景的“ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM RATINGS”部分，列出了绝对最大额定值和警告信息，以及关于命令输入处理的注释和公司页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is a technical document detailing the logic and operational dynamics of a three-axis flight control actuator. The top of the page features the company name "AERO-LOGIC SYSTEMS," department "FLIGHT DYNAMICS DIVISION," document number "AC-90-FCS / REV-D2," and date "October 1996." The main title, "THREE-AXIS FLIGHT CONTROL ACTUATOR LOGIC & OPERATIONAL DYNAMICS," is prominently displayed in the center of the page. The document is structured into several sections, each with a title highlighted by a blue banner. The first section, "CONNECTION DIAGRAM & INPUT/OUTPUT MAPPING," presents a connection diagram with input/output pin listings, accompanied by detailed explanations of flight control surfaces and control moment transfer equations. The second section, "AERODYNAMIC CONTROL SURFACE SCHEMATIC," illustrates a schematic diagram of an aircraft's aerodynamic control surfaces, labeling left and right ailerons, spoiler, flaps, elevator, rudder panel, and pitch, roll, and yaw axes. The third section, "FUNCTIONAL TRUTH TABLE," tabulates the corresponding roll, pitch, yaw, aileron, and elevator states for various flight conditions. The fourth section, "DYNAMIC & ELECTRICAL LIMITS," provides a table showing minimum, typical, and maximum values with units for various parameters. At the bottom, there is a red-background section titled "ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM RATINGS," listing absolute maximum ratings and a warning message, along with a note on command input processing and company footer information.

At the top of the page is a bilingual title, "黑洞解剖与质量分类谱 / Black Hole Anatomy and Mass Classification," with a patent number on the right. The main body of the page is divided into left and right sections; the left lists patent application number, applicant, inventor, and other information, while the right lists the authorization date, classification, keywords, and abstract. The content area below is divided into three columns by bold titles: "说明书 / SPECIFICATION," "构造图解 / STRUCTURAL DIAGRAMS," and "权利要求 / CLAIMS." The specification section includes a textual description of the Schwarzschild radius and a topological diagram of the Schwarzschild metric. The structural diagrams section displays schematic diagrams of the formation and structure of stellar-mass and supermassive black holes, including supernova collapse and relativistic jets. The claims section details the black hole anatomy system and its components, mentioning the jet's driving mechanism. The middle of the page features a black hole mass classification table, categorizing primordial, stellar-mass, intermediate-mass, supermassive, and ultramassive black holes by mass range, Schwarzschild radius, and typical examples. On the right side of the page, there is also a multi-band radiation emission spectrum diagram. At the bottom is a bar chart illustrating the black hole mass scale spectrum, with a logarithmic X-axis. Footer information at the bottom of the page includes a figure number, copyright statement, and confidentiality status.

BICYCLE
MECHANICS
Drivetrain Dynamics & Frame Geometry
The efficiency of the bicycle as a prime mover relies on the precise interaction between the human engine and the mechanical linkage. Through chain-driven reduction, a rider balances torque against cadence. The mechanical advantage, or gear ratio, determines the distance traveled per pedal revolution, while the structural envelope of the frame dictates the distribution of weight and the stability of the steering axis.

prompt_cn: 这是一张室内家庭生活照片，展现了一个三口之家围坐圆桌用餐的温馨场景。画面中央，父母和孩子面带笑容，孩子尤其开心地大笑，桌上摆放着火锅、整鱼及多道家常菜肴。整个房间装饰得充满节日气氛，特别是以“马”为主题。左侧墙壁上挂有“恭贺新禧 恭喜发财”和“招财进宝”的红色竖幅对联，以及两幅写有“马年大吉”和“马年吉祥”的儿童画作。墙壁和白色置物架上随处可见各种大小的马形毛绒玩具，以及多个倒置的红色“福”字装饰。右侧墙壁上还挂有一个红底黄边的“福”字挂饰。背景透过门洞可见部分厨房区域。整体画面色彩明亮，以红色和棕色为主，营造出喜庆祥和的家庭聚餐氛围。
prompt_en: This is an indoor family life photograph depicting a warm scene of a family of three dining around a round table. In the center of the frame, the parents and child are smiling, with the child laughing particularly joyfully. The table is laden with a hotpot, a whole fish, and several home-cooked dishes. The entire room is decorated with a festive atmosphere, especially themed around "horses." On the left wall, there are red vertical couplets reading "恭贺新禧 恭喜发财" (Happy New Year, May you be prosperous) and "招财进宝" (Attract wealth and treasure), along with two children's drawings inscribed with "马年大吉" (Good luck in the Year of the Horse) and "马年吉祥" (Auspicious Year of the Horse). Various sizes of horse plush toys are visible on the walls and a white shelving unit, along with multiple inverted red "福" (fortune) character decorations. A red and yellow "福" character hanging ornament is also on the right wall. Part of a kitchen area is visible through a doorway in the background. The overall image features bright colors, predominantly red and brown, creating a joyful and peaceful family meal atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 图片展示了一个历史文化展览的墙面。墙面中央有一个大型的金色垂直标题“浙江一萬年”，下方是金色的副标题“浙江历史文化陈列 TEN THOUSAND YEARS OF ZHEJIANG HISTORY AND CULTURE”。墙面两侧分布着多个浅棕色或米色的矩形信息牌，上面印有深色文字，按时间顺序介绍了浙江的史前文化遗址和历史事件。左侧的信息牌主要列举了跨湖桥文化、马家浜文化、崧泽文化、良渚文化、钱山漾文化和好川文化等史前文化及其相关地点和年代。右侧的信息牌则记录了从前22世纪大禹治水到816年新昌大佛寺建成等历史事件和人物。墙面底部有大型的深灰色浮雕文字“史前”、“先秦”和“秦汉”，作为历史时期的划分标签。天花板是深色的，并点缀着许多小亮点，营造出星空的效果。墙面本身也带有微妙的浮雕图案，可能描绘了古代建筑或器物。
prompt_en: The image displays an exhibition wall for a historical and cultural exhibition. A large, golden, vertical title "浙江一萬年" (Ten Thousand Years of Zhejiang) is centrally placed on the wall, with a golden subtitle "浙江历史文化陈列 TEN THOUSAND YEARS OF ZHEJIANG HISTORY AND CULTURE" below it. On both sides of the wall, there are multiple light brown or beige rectangular information panels with dark text, chronologically presenting Zhejiang's prehistoric cultural sites and historical events. The panels on the left primarily list prehistoric cultures such as Kuahuqiao Culture, Majiabang Culture, Songze Culture, Liangzhu Culture, Qianshanyang Culture, and Haochuan Culture, along with their associated locations and dates. The panels on the right record historical events and figures, ranging from Yu the Great's flood control in the 22nd century BCE to the completion of the Xinchang Grand Buddha Temple in 816 CE. At the bottom of the wall, large, dark grey, embossed characters "史前" (Prehistoric), "先秦" (Pre-Qin), and "秦汉" (Qin and Han Dynasties) serve as labels for historical periods. The ceiling is dark and dotted with many small lights, creating a starry sky effect. The wall itself also features subtle embossed patterns, possibly depicting ancient structures or artifacts.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于桥梁工程学的技术图解信息图表，标题为“桥梁工程学: 四种主要桥型结构与受力图解”。图片整体采用白色背景，文字以黑色为主，部分标题和图表元素使用蓝色或青色，而受力方向和关键参数则用红色突出显示。图片布局清晰，分为四个编号区域：左上角是“01/结构受力图解”，展示了梁桥、拱桥、斜拉桥和悬索桥四种桥型的受力示意图，并标注了荷载、受压、受拉等信息。左下角是“02/跨径极限特征”，通过一个水平柱状图比较了这四种桥型的跨径极限，并给出了大致数值。右上角是“03/技术规格矩阵”，以表格形式列出了梁桥、拱桥、斜拉桥、悬索桥、桁架桥和刚构桥六种桥型的类型、受力特点、跨径范围和经典实例。右下角是“04/构件受力分析”，详细分析了梁架结构、拱肋结构、斜拉体系和悬索体系的构件受力特点，如弯矩控制、水平推力、索力平衡和锚碇承载等，并配有英文描述。图片通过图文结合的方式，系统地阐释了不同桥梁结构的力学原理和工程特性。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic on bridge engineering, titled "BRIDGE ENGINEERING: STRUCTURAL MECHANICS & FORCE DISTRIBUTION DIAGRAMS". The image features a white background with predominantly black text, while some titles and chart elements are highlighted in blue or cyan, and force directions and key parameters are marked in red. The layout is clearly divided into four numbered sections: The top-left section, "01/STRUCTURAL SCHEMATICS", illustrates the force diagrams for four bridge types: Beam Bridge, Arch Bridge, Cable-Stayed Bridge, and Suspension Bridge, with labels indicating load, compression, and tension. The bottom-left section, "02/SPAN LIMITS COMPARISON", presents a horizontal bar chart comparing the span limits of these four bridge types, showing approximate values. The top-right section, "03/TECHNICAL MATRIX", is a table detailing six bridge types—Beam, Arch, Cable-Stayed, Suspension, Truss, and Rigid—listing their type, force characteristics, span range, and classic examples. The bottom-right section, "04/MECHANICAL INDICES", provides a detailed analysis of structural components for beam, arch, cable-stayed, and suspension systems, covering aspects like bending moment control, horizontal thrust, cable force balance, and anchor bearing, accompanied by English descriptions. The image systematically explains the mechanical principles and engineering characteristics of different bridge structures through a combination of diagrams and text.

PLATE LXIV
FIG. 210
CLASSICAL ORDERS
A Comparative Morphological Analysis of Greek & Roman Columnar Systems
VISUAL PROPORTIONS & ENTABLATURE RELATIONSHIPS
SCALE 1:48
TUSCAN
B
DORIC
C
IONIC
D
CORINTHIAN
E
COMPOSITE
I. GREEK FOUNDATION
II. ROMAN EVOLUTION
III. FLORID DECORATION
B The Doric Order is the most primitive and robust. It possesses no base, resting directly on the stylobate. The shaft is characterized by 20 shallow flutings and a sharp arris. The capital consists of a simple circular echinus and a square abacus. Represented most purely in the Parthenon at Athens.
C The Ionic Order introduces grace and feminine proportions. The height is usually 9 diameters. Its hallmark is the volute capital, resembling a scrolled parchment. It features 24 deep flutes separated by fillets and stands upon an ornate molded base.
A The Tuscan Order is the Roman simplification of the Doric. It is characterized by an entirely plain, unfluted shaft and a simple base and capital. It represents the height of functional austerity in the classical canon, utilized for strength and utility.
E The Composite Order is a late Roman invention, fusing the Ionic volutes with the Corinthian acanthus leaves. It is the most ornate of the five, designed to project the absolute luxury and power of the Roman Empire, often found on triumphal arches.
D The Corinthian Order is identified by its bell-shaped capital adorned with two rows of acanthus leaves and small volutes at the corners. It is the tallest and most slender of the Greek orders, reaching a height of 10 diameters in Roman interpretations.
Note on Entablature: The ratio of the entablature (architrave, frieze, and cornice) to the column height remains consistently approximately 1:4 across the various manifestations of the high classical period.
STATISTICAL TABLE OF PROPORTIONS (UNIT: LOWER DIAMETER = 1 MODULE)
ORDER TYPE
COLUMN HEIGHT
SHAFT STYLE
CAPITAL ORNAMENT
TYPICAL USAGE
Tuscan
7 Modules
Smooth / Plain
Simple Torus
Military, Basic
Doric (Greek)
5.5-7 Modules
20 Shallow Flutes
Plain Echinus
Temples, Civic
Ionic
9 Modules
24 Deep Fluted
Paired Volutes
Museums, Libraries
Corinthian
10 Modules
24 Deep Filleted
Acanthus Leaves
Palatial, Sacred
Composite
10 Modules
Complex Fluting
Hybrid Scroll/Leaf
Triumphal Arches
IV. STRUCTURAL OBSERVATIONS
NOMENCLATURE
The transition from the Doric to the Corinthian reflects a gradual shift from structural honesty to decorative complexity. While the Greek Doric expresses the weight of the stone through its entasis (the slight swelling of the shaft), the Roman Composite focuses on the surface texture and the interplay of shadow within the deep carvings of the capital. These variations represent the fundamental grammar of Western architecture from the 5th century B.C. through the 19th-century Neo-Classical revival.
Abacus: Top flat plate of capital.
Echinus: Molding below abacus.
Stylobate: Top step of temple base.
Volute: Spiral scroll ornament.
Arris: Sharp edge between flutes.

text_19:
内容: B The Doric Order is the most primitive and robust. It possesses no base, resting directly on the stylobate. The shaft is characterized by 20 shallow flutings and a sharp arris. The capital consists of a simple circular echinus and a square abacus. Represented most purely in the Parthenon at Athens.
语言: 英文
位置: 主图下方左侧第一段正文
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_20:
内容: C The Ionic Order introduces grace and feminine proportions. The height is usually 9 diameters. Its hallmark is the volute capital, resembling a scrolled parchment. It features 24 deep flutes separated by fillets and stands upon an ornate molded base.
语言: 英文
位置: 主图下方左侧第二段正文
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_21:
内容: A The Tuscan Order is the Roman simplification of the Doric. It is characterized by an entirely plain, unfluted shaft and a simple base and capital. It represents the height of functional austerity in the classical canon, utilized for strength and utility.
语言: 英文
位置: 主图下方中部第一段正文
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_22:
内容: E The Composite Order is a late Roman invention, fusing the Ionic volutes with the Corinthian acanthus leaves. It is the most ornate of the five, designed to project the absolute luxury and power of the Roman Empire, often found on triumphal arches.
语言: 英文
位置: 主图下方中部第二段正文
字体/排版: 黑色，小字号，常规粗细，左对齐
作用: 正文

text_23:
内容: D The Corinthian Order is identified by its bell-shaped capital adorned with two rows of acanthus leaves and small volutes at the corners. It is the tallest and most slender of the Greek orders, reaching a height of 10 diameters in Roman interpretations.
语言: 英文
位置: 主图下方右侧第一段正文

内容: The transition from the Doric to the Corinthian reflects a gradual shift from structural honesty to decorative complexity. While the Greek Doric expresses the weight of the stone through its entasis (the slight swelling of the shaft), the Roman Composite focuses on the surface texture and the interplay of shadow within the deep carvings of the capital. These variations represent the fundamental grammar of Western architecture from the 5th century B.C. through the 19th-century Neo-Classical revival.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于古典建筑柱式的教育性图表，背景为米色。图表顶部是标题“CLASSICAL ORDERS”及其副标题“A Comparative Morphological Analysis of Greek & Roman Columnar Systems”。主体部分展示了五种古典柱式（Tuscan, Doric, Ionic, Corinthian, Composite）的线描图，每种柱式下方标有其名称，其中Doric、Ionic、Corinthian和Composite柱式上方还分别标有字母B、C、D、E。图表下方分为三个区域，分别以“I. GREEK FOUNDATION”、“II. ROMAN EVOLUTION”和“III. FLORID DECORATION”为标题，详细描述了每种柱式的特点和历史背景。下方是一个表格，标题为“STATISTICAL TABLE OF PROPORTIONS”，列出了五种柱式的“ORDER TYPE”、“COLUMN HEIGHT”、“SHAFT STYLE”、“CAPITAL ORNAMENT”和“TYPICAL USAGE”等数据。最下方还有“IV. STRUCTURAL OBSERVATIONS”的结构分析文本和“NOMENCLATURE”的术语解释列表。页眉有“PLATE LXIV”和“FIG. 210”，页脚是“PHYSIOLOGICAL AND MORPHOLOGICAL STUDY OF THE ORDERS — PLATE 64 — 1884 MONOGRAPH SERIES”。
prompt_en: This is an educational chart about classical architectural orders, set against a beige background. At the top, the chart features the title "CLASSICAL ORDERS" and its subtitle "A Comparative Morphological Analysis of Greek & Roman Columnar Systems". The main section displays line drawings of five classical column orders: Tuscan, Doric, Ionic, Corinthian, and Composite. Each column has its name labeled below it, with letters B, C, D, and E placed above the Doric, Ionic, Corinthian, and Composite columns, respectively. Below the main diagram, there are three sections titled "I. GREEK FOUNDATION", "II. ROMAN EVOLUTION", and "III. FLORID DECORATION", which provide detailed descriptions of each column's characteristics and historical context. Further down, a table titled "STATISTICAL TABLE OF PROPORTIONS" presents data for the five orders, including "ORDER TYPE", "COLUMN HEIGHT", "SHAFT STYLE", "CAPITAL ORNAMENT", and "TYPICAL USAGE". At the very bottom, there is a structural analysis text under "IV. STRUCTURAL OBSERVATIONS" and a list of terminology explanations under "NOMENCLATURE". The page headers read "PLATE LXIV" and "FIG. 210", and the footer states "PHYSIOLOGICAL AND MORPHOLOGICAL STUDY OF THE ORDERS — PLATE 64 — 1884 MONOGRAPH SERIES".

prompt_cn: 该图片展示了一套用于游戏开发的UI（用户界面）素材精灵图集（Sprite Sheet），整体采用干净、现代的扁平化设计风格，配色以白色、浅蓝色、深蓝色、橙色和灰色为主。图片顶部居中是绿色的“Contents”大标题，每个字母均位于独立的白色方框内。左上角包含一组微型的系统功能按钮（如“Q.Save”、“Q.Load”等）以及各种图标、缎带装饰和滑动条。中部左侧排列着三组不同颜色（浅蓝、蓝、深蓝）的对话框操作按钮，包含“Yes”、“No”、“Ok”、“Cancel”、“+”、“-”等。中部右侧是三组大尺寸的系统控制按钮（“Save”、“Load”、“Config”、“Title”），分别对应白、浅蓝、深蓝三种主题色。最右侧是一列垂直排列的长条状主菜单按钮，包括“New Game”、“Load Game”、“Continue”等。右下角包含四组不同颜色（白、浅蓝、深蓝、橙色）的数字键盘按钮（“<Back”及数字1-9），以及一个绿色的圆形徽章，上面印有戴着恐龙帽的卡通女孩头像，环绕文字为“Tyrano Builder Official”，下方配有橙色“DLC”缎带标签。
prompt_en: This image displays a game UI (User Interface) asset sprite sheet, featuring a clean, modern flat design style with a color palette of white, light blue, dark blue, orange, and grey. At the top center is the large green title "Contents", with each letter enclosed in an individual white square box. The top-left section contains a row of tiny system function buttons (such as "Q.Save", "Q.Load", etc.), along with various icons, ribbon banners, and sliders. The middle-left area features three sets of dialogue action buttons in different colors (light blue, cyan, dark blue), including "Yes", "No", "Ok", "Cancel", "+", and "-". The middle-right section displays three sets of large system control buttons ("Save", "Load", "Config", "Title") in white, cyan, and dark blue themes. On the far right is a vertical column of rectangular main menu buttons, including "New Game", "Load Game", "Continue", "Config", "Extra", "Gallery", "Recollection", "Musicbox", "Movie", and "Exit Game". The bottom-right area contains four sets of numeric keypad buttons ("<Back" and numbers 1-9) in white, cyan, dark blue, and orange, alongside a green circular badge featuring a cartoon girl wearing a dinosaur hood, with the text "Tyrano Builder Official" wrapped around it and an orange "DLC" ribbon banner below.

prompt_cn: 这是一幅绘画作品，描绘了一个由大量彩色文字方块堆叠而成的扭曲山形或丘陵状结构。这些文字方块构成了画面的核心主体，占据了大部分空间。背景是蓝天和白色云朵状的笔触，山体底部则呈现深棕色或黑色。每个文字方块都包含一个白色粗体大写的英文单词或数字符号，例如“BLOCK”、“FAVORITE”、“VACANT”、“BEEF”、“24R”、“MANIA”、“HOME”、“TEST”、“CHECK”、“TURN”、“MAIL”、“CENTER”、“25¢”、“99¢”等。文字方块的背景颜色鲜艳多样，包括红色、橙色、绿色和蓝色，它们以不规则的列和行排列，巧妙地遵循着山体的弯曲轮廓。在这幅作品中，文字不仅传达信息，更作为视觉元素共同塑造了独特的景观。
prompt_en: This is a painting depicting a distorted, mountainous or hilly structure formed by a multitude of colorful text blocks. These text blocks constitute the core subject of the artwork, occupying most of the space. The background features a blue sky with white, cloud-like brushstrokes, while the base of the mountain appears dark brown or black. Each text block contains a white, bold, uppercase English word or numerical symbol, such as "BLOCK", "FAVORITE", "VACANT", "BEEF", "24R", "MANIA", "HOME", "TEST", "CHECK", "TURN", "MAIL", "CENTER", "25¢", and "99¢". The background colors of the text blocks are vibrant and varied, including red, orange, green, and blue. They are arranged in irregular columns and rows, cleverly following the curved contours of the mountain. In this artwork, the text not only conveys information but also serves as a visual element that collectively shapes the unique landscape.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影海报，画面中央是演员李连杰，他身穿深色服装，呈动态姿势，右手向前伸出。他的左半身正在消散成蓝色的光点和粒子，并伴有明亮的蓝色光线从他身后向外辐射。海报背景是深蓝色到黑色的渐变。海报顶部有一行白色的西班牙语标语：“Para que pueda salvar al universo, tendrá que pelear con el más violento enemigo que jamás ha enfrentado... él mismo.”（为了拯救宇宙，他将不得不与他所面对过的最凶猛的敌人战斗……他自己。）海报中下部是电影标题，由两行组成，上方是英文“J E T L I”，下方是西班牙文“EL ÚNICO”，两者均采用大号、粗体的浅蓝色字体。海报底部是密集的演职员表和制作公司标志，文字为白色小字，包括“REVOLUTION STUDIOS”、“DOLBY DIGITAL”、“COLOSSEUM”和“SENATOR”。
prompt_en: This is a movie poster featuring actor Jet Li in the center, dressed in dark attire and striking a dynamic pose with his right hand extended forward. The left half of his body is dissipating into blue light dots and particles, accompanied by bright blue light rays radiating outwards from behind him. The background of the poster is a dark blue to black gradient. At the top of the poster is a white Spanish slogan: "Para que pueda salvar al universo, tendrá que pelear con el más violento enemigo que jamás ha enfrentado... él mismo." (To save the universe, he will have to fight the most violent enemy he has ever faced... himself.) In the lower-middle section of the poster are the movie titles, consisting of two lines: "J E T L I" in English above, and "EL ÚNICO" in Spanish below, both rendered in large, bold, light blue fonts. The bottom of the poster contains dense credits and production company logos in small white text, including "REVOLUTION STUDIOS," "DOLBY DIGITAL," "COLOSSEUM," and "SENATOR."

手握捏制。鱼介与醋饭的黄金比例,江户前料理之核心。

海苔卷制。分为细卷、太卷与里卷。常见于铁火卷或太卷。

海苔围边。适用于鲑鱼籽、海胆等易散落的高级食材。

圆锥形卷。家庭式寿司典型形态,讲究海苔的酥脆口感。

散寿司 CHIRASHI
碗装形态。醋饭之上平铺切片食材,色彩绚丽如珠宝盒。
06
押寿司 OSHI
木匣压制。关西地区特色,通过压力使醋饭与食材紧密结合。

prompt_cn: 图片是一份关于寿司的图鉴或报告页面。页面整体采用浅米色背景，布局分为左侧垂直窄栏和右侧两列主内容区。左侧窄栏包含垂直排布的中文标题“昭和五十九年・寿司文化形态全鉴”。页面顶部中央是主标题“寿司图鉴:六大形态、解剖结构与江户前食材分类”，下方有英文副标题“SHUSHI: FORMAL MORPHOLOGY & EDOMAE INGREDIENTS MATRICES”，两者均采用较大且粗的深棕色字体。右上角显示“文献编号 EDO-1984-SHI”。左侧主内容区上方是“寿司解剖结构与规格”章节，包含一个寿司解剖结构示意图，图中标注了“种”、“泪(山葵)”和“舍利”等部位，下方是一个表格，列出了舍利（SHARI）的理想温度（36.5°C）、醋饭酸度指标（pH 4.25）、标准米粒数（320-350 pcs）和酱油（紫）盐度（16.2%）。下方是“舍利(SHARI)风味熟成曲线”章节，包含一个折线图，X轴表示时间（0h, 4h(峰值), 12h），Y轴表示“风味强度”，图下方有三条关于醋饭品尝周期、核心配比和淀粉链甜感的说明。右侧主内容区上方是“六大形态分类体系”章节，包含六个编号为01至06的寿司形态方框，每个方框有中英文名称（如“握寿司 NIGIRI”）和简要说明。下方是“江户前鱼介食材旬期与规格矩阵”章节，包含一个表格，列出了六种食材类别（如“赤身(AKAMI)”）的典型品种、脂肪含量、最佳旬期和适宜温度。页面底部左侧有“食材处理基准”的详细说明，右侧有“认证声明”的文本段落。页面左下角有一个红色印章状的“正宗”字样，旁边是“昭和联合财团・食品工业部・图志编辑部”的出版方信息。右下角显示数据来源“DATA SOURCE: SHOWA 59 FISHTOCK REPORT”和版权信息“© 1984 KEIRETSU PUBLISHING”。所有文字除“正宗”为红色外，其余均为深棕色。
prompt_en: The image is an infographic or report page about sushi. The page has an overall light beige background, with a layout divided into a vertical narrow column on the left and a two-column main content area on the right. The left narrow column contains the vertically arranged Chinese title '昭和五十九年・寿司文化形态全鉴' (Showa 59: Complete Compendium of Sushi Cultural Forms). At the top center of the page is the main title '寿司图鉴:六大形态、解剖结构与江户前食材分类' (Sushi Illustrated Guide: Six Major Forms, Anatomical Structure, and Edo-mae Ingredient Classification), with an English subtitle 'SHUSHI: FORMAL MORPHOLOGY & EDOMAE INGREDIENTS MATRICES' below it, both in large, bold, dark brown font. The top right corner displays '文献编号 EDO-1984-SHI' (Document No. EDO-1984-SHI). The upper part of the left main content area features the section '寿司解剖结构与规格' (Sushi Anatomical Structure and Specifications), which includes a diagram illustrating sushi anatomy with labels such as '种' (neta), '泪(山葵)' (wasabi), and '舍利' (shari). Below the diagram is a table listing the ideal temperature for Shari (36.5°C), pH index of vinegared rice (4.25), standard number of rice grains (320-350 pcs), and soy sauce (purple) salinity (16.2%). Below that is the section '舍利(SHARI)风味熟成曲线' (Shari (SHARI) Flavor Maturation Curve), containing a line graph with the X-axis representing time (0h, 4h (peak), 12h) and the Y-axis representing '风味强度' (Flavor Intensity). Below the graph are three bullet points detailing the optimal tasting period for vinegared rice, core vinegar ratio and salt content, and the maximum sweetness release of starch chains at 36.5°C. The upper part of the right main content area presents the section '六大形态分类体系' (Six Major Forms Classification System), featuring six numbered boxes from 01 to 06, each with a bilingual name (e.g., '握寿司 NIGIRI') and a brief description of the sushi type. Below that is the section '江户前鱼介食材旬期与规格矩阵' (Edo-mae Seafood Ingredient Seasonality and Specification Matrix), which includes a table listing six ingredient categories (e.g., '赤身(AKAMI)') with their typical varieties, fat content, optimal season, and suitable temperature. The bottom left of the page contains detailed instructions under '食材处理基准' (Ingredient Processing Standards), while the bottom right has a text paragraph under '认证声明' (Certification Statement). The bottom left corner features a red stamp-like '正宗' (Authentic) character, next to which is the publisher information '昭和联合财团・食品工业部・图志编辑部' (Showa United Foundation · Food Industry Department · Illustrated Guide Editorial Department). The bottom right corner shows the data source 'DATA SOURCE: SHOWA 59 FISHTOCK REPORT' and copyright information '© 1984 KEIRETSU PUBLISHING'. All text, except for '正宗' which is red, is in dark brown.

prompt_cn: 这是一张关于西文字体解剖学和历史演变的专业信息图。图片以浅灰色为背景，黑色和蓝色文字为主。图表分为五个主要部分，从上到下依次编号。第一部分展示了字体几何解剖结构，通过字母“b g p e t”的图示详细标注了升部线、大写字高、X高度、基线、降部线、升部、衬线、字碗、谷、倾斜字轴和字环等组成部分。第二部分是一个水平条形图，以时间轴形式呈现了旧体、过渡体、现代体、粗衬线和无衬线等经典字体类型的历史演变。第三部分包含两个圆形图表，对比了旧体和现代体的字轴倾角，分别以Garamond和Bodoni为例。第四部分由五个方框组成，每个方框详细描述了一种衬线字体类型（旧体、过渡体、现代体、粗衬线、无衬线），并配有简化的衬线形态图示和代表字体。第五部分是一个表格，对比了六种字体类型（旧体、过渡体、现代体、粗衬线、无衬线、几何无衬线）的x高度比例、粗细对比度、字轴倾角和末端特征等度量数据。图片顶部有标题“西文字体解剖学 / TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY”和副标题，右上方有板块编号和制图规范。底部有页脚信息。
prompt_en: This is a professional infographic about Western typography anatomy and historical evolution. The image features black and blue text on a light gray background. The chart is divided into five main sections, numbered sequentially from top to bottom. Section one illustrates the anatomical structure of typefaces, using the letters "b g p e t" to detail components such as ascender line, cap height, x-height, baseline, descender line, ascender, serif, bowl, counter, axis, and loop. Section two is a horizontal bar chart presenting the historical chronology of classic typeface categories like Old Style, Transitional, Modern, Slab Serif, and Sans Serif, arranged along a timeline. Section three includes two circular diagrams comparing the axis angles of Old Style and Modern typefaces, exemplified by Garamond and Bodoni. Section four consists of five boxes, each describing a serif typeface category (Old Style, Transitional, Modern, Slab Serif, Sans Serif), accompanied by simplified serif morphology diagrams and representative typefaces. Section five is a table comparing metric data for six typeface categories (Old Style, Transitional, Modern, Slab Serif, Sans Serif, Geometric Sans), including x-height ratio, contrast, axis angle, and terminal type. The image has a main title "西文字体解剖学 / TYPOGRAPHY ANATOMY" and a subtitle at the top, with plate number and drafting specifications in the upper right. Footer information is present at the bottom.

prompt_cn: 该图是一幅赛博朋克风格的数字插画。画面中，在一条下着小雨的阴暗街道上，几名身穿带有发光模块的未来感黑色作战服、戴着科技头盔的男子背对镜头站立。他们正仰望着身前一栋破旧多层楼房外墙上巨大的武士壁画。壁画被装在一个由一圈发光灯带和多块外露的绿色电路板、错综复杂的彩色电线组成的框架中。壁画主体为一名身披日本传统甲胄、腰挎武士刀的浮雕感武士，其背景为画有高楼大厦和各式霓虹灯招牌的都市夜景。大楼底部挂有一块写着“泥土画·赛博朋克”的粉蓝色霓虹灯牌，周围也分布着“深夜市集局”等各种颜色的霓虹灯字样。
prompt_en: The image is a cyber-punk style digital illustration. In a dark, rainy street, several men dressed in futuristic black combat suits with glowing modules and tactical helmets stand with their backs to the camera. They are looking up at a massive samurai mural on the outer wall of a worn-out multi-story building. The mural is framed by a glowing light strip, exposed green circuit boards, and intricate, colorful wires. The mural features a textured samurai in traditional Japanese armor with a katana, set against a city nightscape backdrop filled with skyscrapers and neon signs. A pink and blue neon sign reading "泥土画·赛博朋克" hangs at the bottom of the building, surrounded by other colorful neon signs including "深夜市集局".

prompt_cn: 图片是一张关于摄影曝光三要素（光圈、快门速度、感光度）的排版设计规范与信息图表。页面顶部为标题区域，包含黑色大字号标题“摄影曝光三要素”及英文副标题，右上角有技术规格信息表和红底白字的“REFERENCE ONLY”标签。页面主体分为上下两部分：上半部分左侧为一个巨大的斜体字母“f”，其下方有被红色色块遮挡部分前缀字母的说明文本“...SENTING PHYSICAL IRIS DIAPHRAGM”；右侧为一个包含“EV BALANCE”核心的三角形图表，分别将“ISO 感光度”、“APERTURE 光圈 (f)”和“SHUTTER 快门 (t)”关联至不同的曝光级数。下半部分包含三个章节，分别为“01 / APERTURE（光圈机构与景深）”、“02 / SHUTTER SPEED（快门速度与时间）”和“03 / SENSITIVITY（感光度与噪点）”，每个章节均包含一段中文解释文字、一排示意图（光圈孔径圆圈、模糊程度方块、噪点程度方块）以及一个参数对照表格。页脚印有字符集、参数范围和版权字体信息，右下角带有一个红底白字的“STYLE”标签。
prompt_en: The image is a typographic design specification and infographic about the three elements of photographic exposure: aperture, shutter speed, and ISO. The top area features the bold Chinese title '摄影曝光三要素' along with an English subtitle, a technical specification table on the top right, and a red tag reading 'REFERENCE ONLY'. The main body is divided into two sections: the upper left shows a large italic letter 'f' with text below partially obscured by a red block as '...SENTING PHYSICAL IRIS DIAPHRAGM'; the upper right contains a triangular diagram with 'EV BALANCE' at its center, linking 'ISO 感光度', 'APERTURE 光圈 (f)', and 'SHUTTER 快门 (t)' to various exposure levels. The lower section includes three chapters: '01 / APERTURE' (Aperture mechanism and depth of field), '02 / SHUTTER SPEED' (Shutter speed and time), and '03 / SENSITIVITY' (Sensitivity and noise). Each chapter consists of an explanatory text in Chinese, a row of visual diagrams (circles for aperture size, blocks for motion blur, and blocks for grain noise), and a parameter comparison table. The footer displays a character set, parameter ranges, font details, and a red 'STYLE' tag in the bottom right corner.

While the top navigation bar and the left and right sidebars retain the web layout, the main body area is replaced with a blend of a real photo, pixel art, and hand-drawn doodles. On the left side of the screen is a photo of a young man in a white T-shirt, resting his chin on his hand and looking forward. Surrounding him are numerous pixel-art characters with purple hair, wearing purple jackets and green shirts, engaged in various poses and actions. The scene is decorated with hand-drawn lines in pink, green, and purple, featuring shapes of hearts, stars, flames, and several speech bubbles containing pixelated text. The overall color scheme is dark, accented with neon pink and green lighting effects.

prompt_cn: 这是一张中秋节主题的复古手绘风格海报，背景为带有茶渍和水渍效果的米黄色纸张。顶部中央印有黑色艺术字标题“Year of the Rabbit / Mid-Autumn Festival / Traditional Hand-drawn Newspaper”。左上角挂有两个红色的中式剪纸窗花（分别呈现兔子和嫦娥奔月的形象），其下方悬挂着两盏红灯笼和一只红色的手绘兔子。画面中央绘制了两个金黄色的广式月饼，上面印有“MID-AUTUMN FESTIVAL”字样。右上角绘有一只红兔和一盏灯笼，下方是嫦娥身着红绿古装、手托白兔在圆月和祥云前飞舞的插图。海报下半部分排版为左、中、右三栏，包含英文标题和AI生成的无实际语义的伪英文排版文字。
prompt_en: This is a vintage hand-drawn style poster themed around the Mid-Autumn Festival, set against a beige paper background with tea and water stains. The top center features the title in black cursive text: "Year of the Rabbit / Mid-Autumn Festival / Traditional Hand-drawn Newspaper". On the top left, two red Chinese paper-cut window grates (depicting a rabbit and Chang'e) hang above two red lanterns and a hand-drawn red rabbit. The center showcases two golden-brown traditional mooncakes imprinted with "MID-AUTUMN FESTIVAL". The top right features another red rabbit and a lantern, above an illustration of Chang'e in red and green traditional attire flying before a full moon and auspicious clouds while holding a white rabbit. The lower half of the poster is organized into three columns containing English headings and AI-generated, nonsensical filler text.

prompt_cn: 这是一张蓝底白线框的包豪斯演变示意技术图表（Bauhaus Evolutionary Schematic）。版面规整对称：顶部为大字号主标题、副标题，右上角标注了系统参考号和公开度量分类。左侧及右上侧分别框选并列出了魏玛（Weimar）、德绍（Dessau）和柏林（Berlin）三个发展阶段的详细信息，包含时间段、校长及理论方法等。中央部分展示了瓦西里椅（Wassily Chair B3）的线框结构三维透视示意图，并标注了节点与尺寸，下方附有钢管规格和织物材质技术说明。右侧为八个包豪斯工作坊的信息表格，列出负责人、年份与学科。底部左侧为1919至1933年的学生数量与预算折线图，底部中央是教师名录表，右下角为带有黄底黑字“DECLASSIFIED”（已解密）标识的图签栏。
prompt_en: This is a technical infographic titled "BAUHAUS EVOLUTIONARY SCHEMATIC" set against a dark blue background with white and light blue text and thin line frames. The structured layout features main and subtitles at the top, along with a system reference and classification on the upper right. The left and top-right panels detail the three historical phases of Bauhaus (Weimar, Dessau, and Berlin), listing dates, directors, and design systems. The center shows a 3D structural wireframe diagram of the Wassily Chair B3 with node annotations and dimension callouts, supported by text boxes detailing "TUBE SPECIFICATION" and "FABRIC INTEGRATION" below. The middle-right contains grid boxes for eight workshops (WS-01 to WS-08). The bottom area is divided into a student enrollment line chart on the left, a master teacher registry table in the center, and an architectural metrics drawing block on the right featuring a yellow stamp labeled "DECLASSIFIED".

text:
兆瓦级风力发电机机舱内部构造 / NACELLE STRUCTURE
SECTION 04 / PLATE
12
风力发电机机舱是能量转化的核心枢纽，集成传动、控制与发电系统。本图册系统解析其关键组件在超大动能转化过程中的精密协作与动力流向。
01. 叶片与轮毂 / ROTOR HUB
叶片 / BLADES (50-100m)
轮毂 / HUB
能量捕获 / KINETIC CAPTURE
叶片通过气动外形捕获风能，驱动轮毂以 10-20 rpm 的低速转动，完成风能至机械能的首次转化。
02. 变桨控制 / PITCH SYSTEM
进风 / WIND
变桨角 / PITCH
气动调节 / AERODYNAMIC CONTROL
变桨电机根据风速实时调整叶片迎风角。额定风速下最大化捕获力矩，超速时执行顺桨停机保护。
03. 齿轮箱增速 / TRANSMISSION
主轴: 15 rpm
高速轴: 1500 rpm
转速提升 / TRANSMISSION GEARS
主轴输入低速高转矩扭力，经由行星齿轮箱与平行轴齿轮联合增速，将输出转速提升近百倍。
04. 发电机转化 / ELECTROMAGNETIC
转子
690V AC
动电转换 / GENERATION PHASE
高速轴带动发电机转子旋转。定子绕组切割磁感线，输出三相交流电，送往机舱下部的变压器。
05. 偏航对风 / YAW SYSTEM
机舱回转 / ROTATION
塔筒 / TOWER
对风偏差修正 / WIND TRACKING
机舱下部的偏航齿轮在电机驱动下作水平旋转，确保叶轮迎风面垂直于主风向，防止侧偏受载。
06. 核心数据规格 / TECH DATA
系统 / System | 关键参数 / Key Spec | 作用 / Phase
叶轮系统 / Rotor | 直径 100-200m | 机械能捕获
齿轮箱 / Gearbox | 比率 1:100 增速 | 高扭矩倍增
发电机 / Gen | 双馈/直驱 690V | 磁电能转化
偏航系统 / Yaw | 转速 0.5 deg/s | 全向对风修正
运行参数 / METRICS REFERENCE
兆瓦级机组在额定风速下(12-14m/s)满载运行，切出风速通常为 25m/s。

唐诗格律（Poetic Metrics）是中国古典文学的巅峰形式逻辑，核心在于对声音频率与节奏的极端控制。通过“平”与“仄”两种声调的交替排列，诗歌在听觉上形成了如同金融波段般的起伏律动。近体诗（Recent-style Poetry）确立了森严的体系：绝句与律诗在字数、对仗与押韵上有着不可逾越的标准。

text:
近体诗格律研究 / 文学与音韵学
唐诗格律图解
绝句与律诗的平仄、粘对及押韵之严密构造
其一：格律概述

唐诗格律是汉语语言文学中最为严密的建筑结构。它通过平声与仄声的交替，构成了特有的音乐感。绝句为四句，律诗为八句，均分为五言与七言两类。近体诗要求在规定字数内完成意境的转换，且必须遵守严苛的声律逻辑。

☞ 一三五不论：指奇数位的平仄可根据语义灵活调整。
☞ 二四分分明：偶数位的平仄必须严格执行交替规则。
☞ 入韵规则：通常要求偶数句押平声韵，首句可入韵。
其二：粘对结构示意

律诗平仄粘对关系逻辑图 (五言示意)
首联
对(Dui)
粘(Nian)
颔联
颈联
尾联
○ 平 / ● 仄
所谓“对”，即一联内上下两句平仄相反；所谓“粘”，即下一联的首句与上一联的末句平仄相同。若违背此理，则称之为“失粘”或“失对”，视为格律大忌。
其三：体制对比
特征 | 绝句 | 律诗
总句数 | 4句 | 8句
总字数 (五言) | 20字 | 40字
总字数 (七言) | 28字 | 56字
对仗要求 | 不强制 | 颔联、颈联必对
押韵位置 | 2, 4句必押 | 2, 4, 6, 8句必押
律诗中间两联（颔联与颈联）必须使用对仗，要求词性相同、结构一致。例如“大漠孤烟直”对“长河落日圆”，在平仄与意象上均形成完美镜像。
平仄配置样本分析 / TYPOGRAPHICAL METRICS SAMPLE

[平起首句不入韵式 - 七言]
平平仄仄平平仄，仄仄平平仄仄平。
仄仄平平平仄仄，平平仄仄仄平平。

P-P-Z-Z-P-P-Z | Z-Z-P-P-Z-Z-P (Rhyme)
Z-Z-P-P-P-Z-Z | P-P-Z-Z-Z-P-P (Rhyme)
------------------------------------
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 1234567890
LEVEL (○) AND OBLIQUE (●) TONES DISTRIBUTION
编者注记

本页内容严格依据《康熙字典》音韵部及《广韵》平水韵部编撰。唐诗之美，半由格律。严谨的平仄分布不仅是听觉的享受，更是汉字平衡美学的巅峰体现。格律并非束缚，而是通往自由表达的必经台阶。

五年级数学手报：奇妙的数学世界
分数与小数
分数表示整体的一部分，小数是分数的另一种形式。
1/2 = 0.5
1/4 = 0.25
3/4 = 0.75
1/10 = 0.1
数学小故事
高斯巧算
计算1＋2＋3＋……＋100时，高斯把首尾两数配成一组：1＋100＝101，2＋99＝101，共有50组，因此结果是5050。
几何图形的奥秘
正方体有6个面、12条棱和8个顶点。
长方体的体积＝长×宽×高。
圆柱有两个大小相同的圆形底面。
三角形的内角和是180°。
正方体　长方体　圆柱　棱锥　三角形　平行四边形
数学小故事
祖冲之与圆周率
祖冲之经过精密计算，把圆周率精确到小数点后七位，得到圆周率在3.1415926和3.1415927之间。
趣味题挑战
1. 把3/4写成小数。
2. 0.6和3/5是否相等？
3. 一个正方形的周长是24厘米，它的边长是多少？
4. 一个长方体长8厘米、宽5厘米、高4厘米，它的体积是多少？

内容: 1. 把3/4写成小数。

语言: 中文、数字
位置: 右下板块正文区域
字体/排版: 黑色手写体，编号列表，旁边配有纵横填字网格
作用: 趣味练习题
prompt_cn: 这是一张室内实物照片，展示了一块带棕色边框的大型软木展示板。展板顶部用图钉固定着一条白色横幅，上面以彩色手绘空心大字写着“五年级数学手报：奇妙的数学世界”。下方由多张橙色边框的白色和彩色纸张拼贴成内容丰富的五年级数学手抄报。左上板块标题为“分数与小数”，通过彩色饼图、分数条以及1/2＝0.5、1/4＝0.25、3/4＝0.75、1/10＝0.1等示例讲解分数和小数。左下板块标题为“数学小故事”，在彩色边框卡片中介绍高斯计算1＋2＋3＋……＋100＝5050的巧妙方法。中间板块标题为“几何图形的奥秘”，排列着正方体、长方体、圆柱、棱锥、三角形和平行四边形等彩色手绘图形，并标注几何知识。右上板块同样以“数学小故事”为标题，配有数学家肖像和“祖冲之与圆周率”的简短介绍。右下板块标题为“趣味题挑战”，列出四道关于分数、小数、周长和体积的题目，旁边带有纵横填字网格。版面点缀着直尺、量角器、大脑、灯泡、学生和数学家等卡通贴纸，底部整齐摆放一排彩色马克笔和彩色铅笔。所有标题和正文均为清晰、正确、可辨认的简体中文。
prompt_en: This is an indoor photograph of a large cork bulletin board with a brown frame. A white banner pinned across the top displays the colorful, hand-drawn outlined title "五年级数学手报：奇妙的数学世界" (Grade 5 Mathematics Poster: The Wonderful World of Mathematics). Below it, white and colored sheets with orange borders form a dense fifth-grade mathematics display. The upper-left section, titled "分数与小数" (Fractions and Decimals), uses colorful pie charts, fraction bars, and examples such as 1/2 = 0.5, 1/4 = 0.25, 3/4 = 0.75, and 1/10 = 0.1. The lower-left section, titled "数学小故事" (Math Story), explains Gauss's clever method for calculating 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 100 = 5050 inside colorful bordered cards. The central section, titled "几何图形的奥秘" (The Secrets of Geometric Shapes), contains colorful hand-drawn cubes, cuboids, cylinders, pyramids, triangles, and parallelograms with short geometry notes. The upper-right section is another "数学小故事" panel with portraits of mathematicians and a short account titled "祖冲之与圆周率" (Zu Chongzhi and Pi). The lower-right section, titled "趣味题挑战" (Fun Math Challenge), presents four exercises about fractions, decimals, perimeter, and volume beside a crossword-style grid. The display is decorated with cartoon rulers, a protractor, a brain, a lightbulb, students, and mathematicians. A neat row of colored markers and pencils rests along the bottom. All headings and body text are clear, correct, and legible in Simplified Chinese.

To the right of the desk, a pen holder filled with various brushes, two paint jars, a stack of books, and scattered pens are neatly arranged. The background wall is covered with various manga character sketches, manuscript panels, and two colored posters—one yellow featuring a man and one red featuring a woman—creating a rich creative atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 这是一张俯视角度拍摄的日本东京涩谷十字路口街景照片。天气阴沉，路面因降雨而湿滑，多条斑马线上有大量撑着各式雨伞的行人在穿行，道路上停放着多辆出租车、轿车和绿色的公交车。街道两侧高楼林立，挂满了五颜六色的霓虹灯广告牌与电子大屏幕。画面中央标志性的圆柱形大楼顶部写有红色的“SHIBUYA 109”字样，其右侧可见红底白字的“UNIQLO”招牌。左侧楼宇的广告牌上有“TOKYO LIFE”、“THIBISO”、“ヒスクリック”等标识，右侧大楼的蓝色屏幕上方显示着“TOKYO LIFE”，下方及右侧立柱上均有写着“大盛堂書店”的招牌。

Numerous pedestrians carrying various umbrellas are walking across the multiple crosswalks, while several taxis, cars, and green buses are stopped at the intersection. The street is flanked by tall buildings adorned with colorful neon billboards and electronic screens. The iconic cylindrical building in the center features the red "SHIBUYA 109" sign at the top, with a red-and-white "UNIQLO" logo visible to its right. Billboards on the left building display signs like "TOKYO LIFE," "THIBISO," and "ヒスクリック," while the blue screen on the right shows "TOKYO LIFE" with "大盛堂書店" signs beneath and on the side.

prompt_cn: 这是一张户外实景照片。画面中央立着两个巨大的、由复古木质活字字模拼贴而成的创意雕塑。左侧雕塑形状类似于数字“7”或带箭头的“1”，右侧雕塑呈矩形框架结构，类似于数字“0”，两者并排组合。雕塑表面密密麻麻地排列着大小不一、颜色各异（红、金、木色）的英文字母和单词字模。其中，右侧雕塑上清晰可见“HAPPINESS”（红色）、“BLESSING”（金色）和“GOOD FORTUNE”（木色）等英文单词。雕塑背景是一条中式传统商业街，铺有灰色石板路，两旁是古色古香的两层木结构建筑，屋檐下挂着一串串红灯笼。雕塑上的西方字模元素与中式传统街区背景形成有趣的视觉对比。
prompt_en: This is an outdoor real-life photograph featuring two large creative sculptures made of collaged vintage wooden movable type blocks, standing in the middle of a street. The left sculpture resembles the number "7" or an arrow-shaped "1", while the right one is a rectangular frame structure resembling the number "0", combined side by side. The surfaces of the sculptures are densely packed with English letters and words of various sizes and colors (red, gold, and wood tones). Prominent words on the right sculpture include "HAPPINESS" in red, "BLESSING" in gold, and "GOOD FORTUNE" in wood color. The background shows a traditional Chinese commercial street paved with grey stone slabs, lined with antique two-story wooden buildings decorated with red lanterns hanging under the eaves. The Western typographic elements on the sculptures contrast interestingly with the traditional Chinese street setting.

prompt_en: This is a real-life photograph of an outdoor guide signboard with a black metal frame. The signboard is divided into upper and lower sections. The upper half features a beige background with a large orange-yellow circular pattern in the center, depicting silhouettes of Leifeng Pagoda and West Lake. In the foreground, three realistic chrysanthemums (light purple, red, and light yellow) are illustrated with blue and green leaves. On the left, the main title '生态家园 菊花盛会' is written in black brush calligraphy, followed by the subtitle '2025第五届长三角菊花精品展暨杭州第十一届菊花艺术展' in black sans-serif font. The top right corner displays the logos of 'HANGZHOU MUNICIPAL BUREAU OF LANDSCAPING & CULTURAL HERITAGE' and 'HANGZHOU WEST LAKE'. The lower half contains a guide map enclosed in a reddish-brown decorative border. The left side of the map features a legend and lists for '菊花小品点位' (Chrysanthemum Sketch Points) and '生态阳台点位' (Ecological Balcony Points), detailing 15 participating units for each. The map illustrates the paths, attractions, and exhibition areas of the botanical garden, with a red star indicating '您所在的位置' (You Are Here). On the right side of the photo, a tourist wearing a red jacket and blue jeans is partially visible. The left background shows green trees and blurred figures of other visitors. A semi-transparent watermark of 'Tide News' is visible in the bottom right corner.

In the center of the screen is a huge black brush calligraphy character "廉" (Honesty/Integrity), whose lower part is disintegrating and collapsing into black ink splatters and falling scattered strokes, interspersed with smaller scattered Chinese characters such as "权" (power), "钱" (money), "法" (law), "职" (duty), "滥" (abuse), and "用" (use). The top left corner of the poster is stamped with a red seal containing the character "廉", flanked by vertical texts: "树清风 尚清廉" in red and "廉洁奉公 两袖清风 一身正气 光明磊落" in gray. In the bottom right corner, there is a pink lotus flower and several gray ink-wash lotus leaves. At the bottom is a black horizontal bar printed with white artwork information: "作品：《廉》", "姓名：薛冬", and "学校：天津师范大学".

text:
FORMFACTOR™
rigetti
Cryogenic Microwave Wafer-Scale Characterization of
Superconducting Resonators for Improved Fabrication Yield
Brandon W. Boiko¹, Mark Field², David P. Pappas³, Sebastian Janzen⁴, Josh Y. Mutus²
Corresponding Author: brandon.boiko@formfactor.com
Introduction
Superconducting resonators are a critical component for reading out and protecting qubits. They can be constructed in different ways as a lumped element resonator with discrete inductive and capacitive components, a distributed element resonator with a meandering coplanar waveguide (CPW), or a 3D cavity resonator. CPW resonators are commonly used to connect qubits to feedlines used to readout quantum information. They can also be used for qubit-qubit coupling for quantum gate operations.
Resonators can be characterized by a resonant frequency and a quality factor which determine what space the resonator occupies in the frequency domain. This frequency must be positioned appropriately near the qubit frequency for accurate readout and to avoid crosstalk with other resonators and qubits. Fabrication defects and processing errors can cause frequencies to shift relative to the designed values. This can lead to frequency collisions resulting in readout errors and additional loss mechanisms, degrading the performance of the quantum chip.
For this project we measured niobium-based superconducting resonators using a cryogenic wafer prober with a base temperature below 4 K. The setup used a single RF probe to measure the resonators in reflection mode. A single wafer includes 150 dies containing different resonators, and 1,440 two-port VNA scans form the basis of the dataset. A minimum search of S21 magnitude is used to find the center frequency of each resonator. A Lorentzian fit can provide a more accurate center-frequency value, but it requires additional computational resources and higher-quality data for the fitting algorithm.
IQ3000 Cryogenic Wafer Prober
The wafer prober used for this measurement was an IQ3000 system developed by FormFactor, Inc. The system provides automated testing of 150 mm wafers within a practical timescale. A wafer can be loaded and cooled below 4 K in less than 30 hours. We used a semi-automatic configuration with manual probe alignment and a single RF probe, which measured each resonator in reflection mode.

prompt_cn: 这幅现代拼贴艺术作品以深黑色为背景，上面贴满了密密麻麻的报告单和成绩单。这些单据上印有表格，表格内填有AI生成的无意义偏旁乱码字，并多处被画上显眼的红色“X”号。画面顶部和底部边缘的报告单下方，散落着多处用红色粗体手写的“不及格”和“需努力”字样。画面中央是视觉焦点，由大量写满数学公式、几何图表的手写白色碎纸片拼贴而成：最左侧拼贴出一只展翅的蝴蝶图形，右侧则依次拼贴出汉字“蜕”和繁体“變”（变），整体组合成“蜕变”的寓意。整张图片通过否定性的报告单背景与中央由公式碎纸片拼贴成的蝴蝶和文字形成对比，传达出在挫折与努力中实现自我蜕变的主题。
prompt_en: This modern collage artwork features a dark black background covered with numerous report cards and transcripts. These documents contain tables filled with meaningless AI-generated character strokes, many of which are marked with prominent red "X" marks. Along the top and bottom edges of the report cards, multiple handwritten phrases in bold red ink reading "不及格" (Fail) and "需努力" (Need to work harder) are scattered. The central focus of the image consists of a collage made from numerous white paper scraps covered with handwritten mathematical formulas and geometric diagrams: on the far left, the scraps form a butterfly with outspread wings, followed to the right by the Chinese characters "蜕" (shuck off) and the traditional character "變" (change), together symbolizing "蜕变" (metamorphosis/transformation). The artwork contrasts the negative background elements of failed reports and red crosses with the central butterfly and "metamorphosis" characters built from formula scraps, conveying a theme of self-transformation through struggle and effort.

prompt_cn: 这是一张电影《蛟龙行动》（特别版）的官方宣传海报。画面左侧展现了一艘在波涛中破浪前行的深灰色军舰头部，左上方有刺眼的日光反射。右侧竖向排列着四名全副武装的中国海军“蛟龙突击队”特种兵形象，他们身穿迷彩战术服，配戴头盔、护目镜或面罩，并手持武器呈警戒和射击姿态。海报背景以淡蓝和浅黄色为主，带有密集的纵向拉丝肌理。画面中左侧印有醒目的艺术字“蛟龙行动”及英文“OPERATION HADAL”，上方写有“《红海行动》续作”和“特别版”标签，下方是“8月30日 重装上阵”的上映日期。海报最上端有“48帧画质提升 感受海军体系作战”宣传语，下端则排列着详细的主创及出品方信息。
prompt_en: This is an official promotional poster for the movie "Operation Hadal" (Special Edition). The left side of the poster shows the bow of a dark gray military vessel plowing through the waves, with a bright sun flare reflected at the top left. On the right, four fully equipped Chinese Navy "Jiaolong" special forces soldiers are vertically arranged in tactical gear, wearing helmets, goggles or visors, and holding firearms in alert and shooting stances. The background features light blue and pale yellow tones with dense vertical brush stroke textures. On the middle left, the eye-catching stylized title "Jiaolong Operation" and the English text "OPERATION HADAL" are displayed, with the tags "Sequel to Operation Red Sea" and "Special Edition" above it, and the release date "August 30th Reloaded" below. The tagline "48-frame image quality enhancement, experience navy systematic warfare" is printed at the very top, while detailed lists of cast, crew, and production companies are presented at the bottom.

俯冲轰炸机：中途岛战役的制胜功臣，凭借高精度陡角度俯冲投弹，成功重创并摧毁日军主力航母。
F4F WILDCAT (野猫): 防御坚固的主力战斗机，通过编队战术抵消零战性能优势。
TBD DEVASTATOR (毁灭者): 性能老旧的鱼雷轰炸机，攻击中伤亡惨重但成功吸引了日军防空火力。

A6M ZERO (零式舰战): 极佳的盘旋性能与超长航程，战争初期极具统治力的主力战斗机。
D3A VAL (九九式舰爆): 太平洋战争初期日军主力俯冲轰炸机，曾参与重创约克城号。
B5N KATE (九七式舰攻): 优秀的水平/鱼雷轰炸机，战术灵活性高，最终雷击瘫痪美军约克城号。
1942年6月中途岛海战，成为太平洋战争的决定性转折点。美军凭借情报优势与SBD无畏式俯冲轰炸机的致命打击，在一天内击沉日军四艘主力航空母舰。这场对决不仅是航母吨位与舰载机性能的较量，更是战术决策与工业实力的直接碰撞。美军约克城级的损管奇迹与日军一航战的覆灭，彻底改写了海战规则。

prompt_en: This is a bilingual (Chinese and English) infographic about the Battle of Midway in 1942, titled 'MIDWAY 1942'. Set against a light beige background with orange accents, the chart is structured into four main sections: a scale comparison of the IJN Akagi and USS Yorktown class carriers; a data table comparing the displacement, aircraft capacity, and outcomes of seven participating carriers; a comparison of key USN and IJN carrier aircraft types and their tactical roles; and a brief historical summary at the bottom alongside large statistics showing carrier losses (4 for IJN, 1 for USN).
